reviews.text: My husband worked on Christmas, so I got to order some spicy food. Fidel was open and after confirming that the meats are halal I ordered Awaze Tibs because I love Berbere spice and jalapenos. Bernere has become a staple in my kitchen because it’s excellent for blackening fish. The Awaze Tibs was delicious and I didn’t need to dirty up any utensils because… Injera 🤤 My dinner tonight was delicious and spicy enough to cause my face to flush a little. I look forward to dining in someday. Thank you all for a great dinner. I appreciate you.

You guys  didn't understand what I ordered, I told you every single order is a separate enjerra and spices but they give all together.

That is not fair and please make sure your customers.
Pay attention every single order.

The wait staff was nice but hard to understand and be understood. I had never eaten the cuisine so wanted an suggestion as to what was good. Only 1 out of the 3 dishes ordered by 3 people in the party was just OK. For the $60 spent it should have been better. I could not believe it cost me $2 for a bottle of water. It also cost $2 for a warm can of soda. If you want to try African cuisine go somewhere else.

The service was horrible. But the 5 stars is for the food. Today I decided not to leave a tip. And I plan on coming back to not leave a tip again. The poor service is saving me money... bc I usually tip generously. But when I finish 2 rounds of food without a refill and no plates are picked up, there will never ever be a tip for that. But no complaints though. As you can see I left a 5 star rating bc I don't NEED service. That's what this generation needs to understand about food service. You don't get a tip just bc you showed up
I really was looking forward to finding a Ethiopian restaurant that was close to my house not only did they make me wait an hour. They gave me the entire entirely wrong order. Do not recommend.

I go this restaurant to get Sambosa. I asked whether it is fresh or not. They said it is fresh. When I try to eat it, it is too cold to eat. It is made one day before. They lied to me. I throw it in trash right away as it has fish, egg and other foods sandwiched in it and it is contaminated easily.
On top of this, they overcharged me; 4.9x for a single Sambosa!

Updates: I visited Ifka for the first time since the pandemic started. I had a breakfast dish of sauteed beef cubes, onions and potatoes with crepes. It was delicious. A cup of tea was also included and all for $10. This place has no printed menu, you just have to trust the guy behind the counter.

Looking for something different for lunch the other day and found Ifka Cafe. There was no menu but the young guy behind the counter told me I could have goat, chicken and tilapia. I ordered the tilapia and it was the best fried tilapia I have ever had. It was fresh, crispy, done just right and a dust of spices on the outside that was super delicious. The humongous plate of rice was seasoned with cumin and some other spices, perfect compliment to the fish.

This place serves African, Middle eastern, and Mediterranean foods. Their dishes are mostly rice, pasta, goat meat, lamb shank. They serve Somali tea, special coffee, and other drinks. I love their specialty under the new management. I love their sambusa a traditional somali and Indian dish. Check it out if you ever visit this place. Friendly staff.

Wow I have been going to this store for quite some time now.  thire chicken shwarma with rice is very delicious and when they give you the food they are very generous you can eat it lunch and dinner and you only pay 17.68$ it is worth it 👌

Love their samosas.   Very tasty.
Excellent goat stew.  Love their lamb shank too...
I have some African friends and they showed me this restaurant, and I have to say this is my new favorite spot!.
What a funny place. Just one thing per day on the menu?! Super good

At first when owner was there customer service was great... They hang up on you.  They advertise days of operation but be closed. If you call and you don't understand the menu they will hang up on you.  very impatient.

Wish I took a picture. Really enjoyed the food. I had spinach stew, jollof rice, some chicken/beef stew…all great tasting. I’m not African and lady at front thought I was lost. It was satisfying comfort food.
One of the best—if not the best—African food spots in Colorado! Lots of flavors and didn’t disappoint.

reviews.text:
We went in as a pretty big group excited to try Somalian food! The service and the staff are wonderful and welcoming! You don’t get service like this anymore and it’s rare. They presented us with their daily menu and we ordered off of that! Each dish was huge and almost 2 or three meals out of each! Their smoothies were delicious and my salmon wrap was cooked to perfection. Everyone loves their meal! No-frills kind of environment, but there’s also outdoor seating and it’s in a strip mall! Ample parking!

If you’re ordering as a group be cautious because our experience was they gave us extra food (which was lovely) but when we asked for individual check based on what we ordered, we were given a group price. Some of us were too happy about that.

No complaints and anything else though. All the rest was exceptional!

Small simple restaurant. I had wanted to try it for a long time and I finally did. Goat and rice were very tasty! Also really enjoyed the green sauce that came with it. I'll be back to try more. Definitely recommend it for curious foodies or anyone who wants to eat East African cuisine.
Great food great service. I really enjoyed food.

The portions are huge!!! This is by far the most flavorful chicken and lamb I have ever eaten. Both were so tender and juicy. The rice alone is worth the trip! I didn’t think to take a photo of the leg of lamb until it was nearly gone.

Not only is the food quality fresh and delicious, the customer service is outstanding!

Thank you so much for lunch!

1. Sambusa
Sambusa is a triangular fried pastry dish often filled with spicy minced meat or vegetables. It is very similar to the Indian samosa. If you have guessed cardamom as the dominant spice in this dish, you have guessed very well.

2. Bariis Ishkukaris
Bariis iskukaris, we would say, is very similar to a rice dish called pilau. It is seasoned with fragrant spices and cooked in meat broth and generally speaking, tomatoes are added to the dish, making for a superbly tasty meal.

3. Malawah
We can not say much more about this dish other than tell you it is just as easy to make as a pancake.

4. Anjero
Anjero is similar to the Ethiopian injera with the main different being the size and how it is eaten. Anjero is usually a fraction of the size of injera and Somalis love to eat it with honey spread drizzled over it.

5. Halwa
Halwa or xalwo is a festive sweet treat reserved for special occasions, and is quotidian wedding treat. With the main ingredients including sugar, butter, and oil, this may be a treat you would only want to indulge into once a while.

6. Somali Tea special.
Who wouldn't enjoy a cup of tea?

7. Sabaayad
Sabaayad is a flatbread, the Somali version of chapati. It is yet another Somali dish which can be eaten for breakfast, lunch or dinner. If paired together we are better sabaayad and a dried meat delicacy to make a breakfast on the go.

I’ve never had so many veggies packed with this much flavor all on one plate. Not to mention service was fast and employees working the front are super friendly and attentive.

I was skeptical at first. Typically the best Ethiopian meals I've had took forever and ordering fries was definitely not an option. This place proved that my skepticism was grossly unfounded and came through with a delicious, spicy meal in a matter of minutes.

So good I’m writing this review before I even leave the marketplace. Ordered the veggie platter, everything was delicious, especially the spinach. And the woman taking my order was such a delight. Will definitely be back!

I'm an avid ethiopian food consumer. I'm super excited to see more authentic, diverse options for food in Denver, CO, especially on the west side of town. While I support this business and its endeavors in a popular food hall, the food wasn't anything to be excited about. It's a good place for people needing to be introduced to ethiopian food - it's healthy - jampacked with veggies, spices, and meat (i believe it's a great paleo option)

Konjo's is overpriced, has small portions, and comes out cold. I really appreciate the "server" and staff people at Konjo's - they're friendly, and want to know how to better serve you. However, with my experience in Ethiopian food, I know good quality food, and it wasn't served up here. $14 for a meat combo, which was a tiny plate of meat, a veggie side, and a tiny salad.
Both the food and the service here are awesome. It was my first time trying Ethiopian food, had the veggie option and it was great. The sambusa was out of this world.

name: Konjo Ethiopian Food
vicinity: INSIDE of The Edgewater Public Market, 5505 W 20th Ave Suite #106, Edgewater

reviews.text:
This was my first time trying Ethiopian food, so I decided to visit Konjo in the Edgewater food court. The setup is very straightforward — you order through a kiosk/tablet, enter your phone number, and they text you when your order is ready. Easy and convenient.

I tried the Chicken Tibs Plate with Misir Wot and injera. The chicken was on the spicier side, almost like a cousin of Indian-style chicken curry, which I enjoyed. The injera flatbread was soft and filling, with the bubble texture showing it had been fermented. It did have a noticeable sour taste — I’m not sure if that’s how it’s supposed to be, but it was interesting to try.

I also ordered a sambusa for $3. It was a deep-fried pastry with a lentil/pulse filling, but the shell was a bit oily and on the harder side, so not something I’d go back for.

Just a heads-up that there’s a credit card surcharge and a public improvement fee added to the bill.

If you want a meal that feels like a hug from someone’s wise Ethiopian auntie, Kanjo is the place. I ordered the vegan platter with lentils and cabbage. The lentils were rich and soulful, the cabbage perfectly seasoned, and the gluten free injera was so soft it could easily double as a love letter from the motherland.

Also, do yourself a favor: ask for their house-blend spice. Trust me. It’s the kind of seasoning that makes you rethink every meal you’ve ever cooked. Pick some up to take home—you can gift it for the holidays, bring it to dinner parties, or sprinkle a little on your weekday meals when you need instant joy. It’s basically edible gold.

Kanjo, thank you for bringing Ethiopia’s warmth, flavor, and spirit straight to the table. I’ll be back—probably sooner than expected.

I discovered Konjo several years ago, and have eaten there many times. Their Lamb Tibs was my favorite. However, the last two times I have eaten there, the Lamb Tibs has been terrible. One time it was totally not spiced at all. The lamb was a dull grey color, and had absolutely no flavor at all. When I presented it to the guy behind the counter (circled in the photo), he said, “Yeh, I think they forgot to add the spice”. He did not apologize, he just gave me a ramekin of the bright red spice. I tried adding it to the lamb, but since it had not been cooked WITH the lamb, it tasted horrible. I dumped it in the trash and left angry and frustrated. I reached out to the owners of Konjo via their website, but they never responded. I avoided the place for about 6 months, but my craving for Ethiopian food got the better of me and I went back. I again ordered the Lamb Tibs, and this time it was properly spiced, but in the entire serving there was only two small pieces of lamb — that’s all ! I was again very disappointed, and I will NOT give Konjo another chance. They have disappointed me too many times, and I will never go back.

We ordered a plate with lamb and beef, and it was so spicy it was barely edible. We thought that the flavors were a bit odd and unfortunately both my husband and I got a food poisoning. We were excited to try Ethiopian food but that was a terrible introduction to the cuisine.

Eat here, plain and simple. If you get the chance get one of everything.

I don't know anything about authenticity, but I've eaten my way around an injera or two and I LOVE the bread here! Bouncy and tender texture and definitely sour!

All of the vegetable dishes are fantastic. Lentils have always been cooked well and the greens are tender and not mushy. My favorite is the cabbage, I could eat a bucket.

TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE!!!! I  should have went with my gut feeling. After calling the place serval times for a call in order and not getting an answer I ordered ahead via Doordash. I was notified 10 mins later that my food was ready and (veggie combo). At arrival of the restaurant It took 10 minutes for the cook to realize I was inside of the establishment. She assured that my order was recieved but not ready. The kitchen door was open but there were no pots on the stove and the microwave was running. I went outside to let my ride know it would be a minute as I was coming through the door I saw the cook plating my food from storage containers  assuming from the microwave. As she presented my food I let her know I saw that she was serving me left overs. I opened my togo box and felt the temperature of my food the injera itself  was  ICE COLD!!! I then inserted my finger in the middle  and yeh temperature of my food was like warm and immediately requested a refund in which I received.  Disappointed for sure,  but the server at least acknowledged the fact that she indeed served me left over food that was just warmed up and did not argue the fact.

Extremely disappointed I will not return or recommend.
I've never eaten this kind of food before. It was delicious and the service was wonderful!!! What a fun experience!

Very nice relaxed and classy atmosphere.  The authentic ethiopian food is great and very filling. I have heard the weekend night time vibes can be alot of fun, will return and report back.
I enjoyed the jazz music playing while we ate lunch.

Big fan of Ethiopian food so when I saw this restaurant I was excited to check it out. It did not disappoint! The food was fantastic and the staff were very friendly and made it a welcoming environment. Will be coming back!

On vacation and decided to give Zula a try. Neither of us have much experience with Ethiopian and the staff was very helpful, did a great job explaining the menu and making sure we were ok with “spicy” before we ordered. The food was very flavorful and would absolutely come again.
Delicious food! We tried different dishes, and all of them were good. The kids enjoyed it very much, and so did we. Friendly service.

The restaurant was peaceful and quiet. The server was attentive and accommodating. The food was AMAZING! I do not eat spicy food but I couldn’t stop eating the lamb dish I had. I even ordered a plate TO GO

after extensive research, I decided to take my family to Lucy for our first Ethiopian cuisine experience in Denver - and it did not disappoint. a solid 5 stars for flavor alone - the food is well worth the wait (20-30 min).

the meal is an experience of flavor and texture, ending in complete satiety and meant to be shared and eaten with the hands. not to mention an amazing value - you could feed a family of 3-4 for around $35.

we started with 2 veggie sambusas - a fried pocket pastry with a flaky crust and a filling of spiced peas. it was. delicious. the crust was perfectly flaky and they came out super fresh. the inside was spiced right and had a nice contrast to the crust.

the main feature was the veggie combo platter - it comes with most of their signature dishes and injera bread. the injera had a sour taste like sourdough bread. it was soft, spongy, and dreamy - they even offered us more when we finished ours. everything was DELICIOUS. I cannot say enough good.

we left incredibly satisfied. don’t come here in a rush. sit, enjoy the food, ideally with others.

If you haven’t tried this cuisine before then this is the perfect place to try. It seems like a lot of locals frequent this spot and for good reason. I got their beef and veggie platter and it was really good. The flavors weren’t crazy overpowering and it seemed healthy too. I like how it comes in a big platter to share. This was a home run but I wish they had lamb when I went. Guess I’ll have to come again. Oh and the sambusa was very flaky and crispy. Highly recommend starting off with those.

The FOOD was amazing! The staff was friendly and happy to explain the dishes. I personally loved the way she poured the food onto the platter. Made it extra special. I loved the Beef tips so much flavor and so juicy! I can’t wait to come back! Keep up the good work Lucy Ethiopian Restaurant!!!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5 stars for 5Star Eritrean Cafe!

I came in for a platter and a cappuccino and left with a full belly, a happy heart, and leftovers to enjoy the next day. First impression of the food? Wow. This was edible art. Perfectly plated with vibrant colors and textures, and injera that looked and tasted legit from the very first bite. Every component on the platter had its own flavor story, and together they created a masterpiece. The server even brought out some berbere spice to sprinkle on top, which was the perfect touch. The vibe of the cafe was modern and relaxed, with upbeat music playing and a chill, cozy feel. I was the only customer for most of the meal, which made the experience feel extra peaceful and personal. And the cappuccino? So. Good. Rich, smooth, and foamed to perfection. I actually caught myself wondering, “Why don’t I start every day like this?” If you're looking for flavorful food, legit coffee, and an atmosphere that hits all the right notes, 5Star Eritrean Cafe is the move. Can’t wait to go back and try more.

Nice breakfast/lunch spot. The egg sandwich was excellent, but it would have been nice to have a smaller. This portion was huge. The peppers on it were very hot. They also have some interesting Eritrean options.

Service was fast and friendly but it took a while for the food to come out. The space is nicely decorated. A video of birds chirping in a cherry garden provided a pleasant atmosphere.

There is plenty of parking in the morning,

This was our first time here and we came in over the holidays with a group of 9. Our table was set and ready for us as we called beforehand. We ordered combination meat and vegetable plates for us to share and wow!! Such flavour, delicious food! Even my young son who had never had Eritrean or Ethiopian food was obsessed with the injera and loved everything. At the end of the meal, they even gave him a mango smoothie for free! We will definitely return. Thank you!!

This is an adorable little corner restaurant. The owners are on site and really take pride in their work. It seems to be extremely authentic food, and many of the patrons were speaking in their native language with the staff. I really loved the decor. The food was delicious! We got like a sampler platter and some lamb. Each dish was perfectly prepared and seasoned. It seemed like a lot of Care and attention went into each dish and it would've taken me hours and days to make something like this, so it seems like a great deal!
We also got a fruit smoothie. I think it was hard to communicate with the waiter on this. I asked him if it was real fruit or if it had added sugar. He said yes to real fruit and no to added sugar, but it was pretty obviously a premixed product that likely had corn syrup. I think it was just that he didn't understand English well enough to figure out what I was asking.

I visited 5 Star Café Eritrean & Ethiopian Restaurant and bought the best sandwich I’ve ever had. The bread was delicious, and every ingredient inside was perfectly balanced and flavorful.

But what truly made it unforgettable was the young lady with curly hair and big, beautiful eyes. I felt like she put her heart into making it, and that’s why it tasted so amazing.

If you happen to read this, please find me on Instagram @Constantinpax — I’d love the chance to meet you!

Trybal African Speakeasy is an incredible find. The atmosphere is amazing — warm, intimate, and thoughtfully curated, making it perfect for a night out where you actually want to enjoy conversation, food, and music. The space is smaller, but in a way that feels intentional and inviting rather than crowded.

Our waitress was very kind and attentive. They maybe could’ve used one more staff member to help out, but despite that the service was still solid. Food came out quicker than expected, and everything was beautifully presented with bold, delicious flavors that really stood out. The cocktails were also excellent and came out promptly.

The music selection was perfect — great energy, culturally rooted, and at just the right volume so you can enjoy it while still talking comfortably.

Overall, this is a fantastic spot with great vibes, great food, and great drinks. I’d definitely come back.

My friends and I went after work and this place is a WHOLE Vibe!! Nice atmosphere and beautifully decorated. The cocktails are a little pricey but very good. I had the Jua Smoke with Mezcal - perfection! 🤌🏾 My second cocktail was the Hibiscus Old Fashion. It was good as well but could not compete with that Jua Smoke! Three of my friends had the Guava Glow and they all enjoyed them. For food, I ordered the chicken suya and it was good, very flavorful and moist. The beignets were just ok. A friend got the plantains and they were very good, nicely caramelized. Service was great - the waitress was very good and attentive so I didn't mind paying the 20% gratuity that is automatically added to your bill. I was a little disappointed they they don't have an actual Happy Hour, being in downtown Denver, but I enjoyed it and will definitely return.

Absolutely loved our visit to Trybal! The vibes were amazing- the perfect setting for a girls' night out. The music, lighting, and overall atmosphere created such a fun and laid-back experience. The small bites were honestly some of the best l've had at a bar. We tried almost every cocktail on the menu. My personal favorites were the Guava Glow, Zamanj Espresso Martini, and Pineapple Juju- Each one perfectly crafted and so delicious. Customer service is a 10/10 from the chef to all of the front of house staff. A special shoutout to Jacob, our bartender, who was super friendly and made some great recommendations. Definitely will be going back.

The location is very beautiful. I just wish it wasn't as dark. I decided to go all out and ordered the Motherland Plate. It was flavorful with a nice sweet burn. I found the beef too tough to enjoy. Next time, I will order the chicken.

A unique spot in demver, feels high end like a fine lounge scene.  Lighting and art create a proper ambience for relaxed and casual energy with an elevated and classy feel.  The musc set the tone perfectly, this place is a proper vibe.
Jacob and Kedar took care of me at the bar, I really enjoyed the Ayo Twist w gin, the mezcal version was nice as well.  Kedar even  made me an off menu drink which was perfect.  Dont skip the Amarula martini either.
The beef suya was proper snd so was the jollof.  Next time ill be sure to try chicken suya and some puffs.
I will definitely return to this spot along the 16th st downtown corridor with friends, looking forward to another great experience at trybal.

name: Megenagna
vicinity: 306 S Ironton St Unit C, Aurora

reviews.text:
Order #9 and you won’t be disappointed! Very authentic. The aesthetic is amazing, and the food is bomb 💣

Most meals have a little kick to it. But if you down for a little spice and good seasoned food… this is the place to go for a date night or a cool place to go with friends

Very delicious treats. We got some treats to go, some sweet cake and cookies, a savory twisted donut very tasty I dipped it in hot ginger tea at home, and some savory lentil filled pockets called samosa so good! Oh and of course this piece of cake was so great, it’s moist and my baby really liked it.

Disappointed 😞
I've picked up the veggie combo to-go for several years from here. I was in the area and stopped today.  It was not the same. Anyone can have an off day but idk if I'd want to try again. I'm giving a 3 which I think is very generous ( because of the memories).

They are still quit quick with the preparation...appreciated. Portions seem smaller.

Uploaded image is after I had taken a few bits, but it is less.

First time in Denver and we were looking for a comfort diner/food at the end of our long day. We were so pleased with the deliciousness of the dishes and great customer service. Try it for yourself, you will be amazed. Thank you team at Megenagna, one of the best ethiopian cuisine I have enjoyed not only in Denver but across the USA. :)

Best veggie combos around. The tibs and coffee are also amazing. My wife and I get food from here all the time. They also have a small grocery store connected to the restaurant. Everything is always super clean and everyone is nice.

Trust the negative reviews! The service here was absolutely terrible. It took them OVER an hour to bring out two dishes, and meantime they rarely came over to our table and the restaurant was mostly empty (and no one was a coming in for takeout orders… there was no excuse for the staff’s negligence)! What?? And it was very expensive for food that was not exceptional. So disappointed. We will not be returning.

I love the food and service at this restaurant. The staff are helpful in answering questions and I feel taken care of whether I dine in or order pickup. The vegetarian platter is my favorite. I highly recommend a visit.

Excellent customer service! The  servers are very interesting they know how to take care of customers very sociable and motivational to enjoy your moment in Nile Ethiopian Restaurant
Here is my clean and the true review of this Restaurant  after I have really ate and enjoy my Lunch
Let me start from the, professional customer service review for Nile Restaurant, including remarks about the servers
If you want it in a short about Nile Restaurant
I recently visited Nile Restaurant, and I was genuinely impressed with the overall dining experience. From the moment I walked in, the staff created a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The servers were attentive, respectful, and consistently checked in without being intrusive. They carried themselves professionally, knew the menu well, and were quick to offer helpful recommendations.

Service was prompt—water glasses were refilled immediately, orders were taken efficiently, and the food arrived on time. The servers handled everything with a friendly attitude, showing great teamwork and making the experience smooth and enjoyable. They were patient with questions, and their positive energy added to the authentic cultural environment of the restaurant.

Overall, Nile Restaurant delivers excellent customer service with server staff who are kind, responsive, and dedicated to providing a great dining experience. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for delicious food paired with outstanding customer services

I was really disappointed with my experience during my recent visit. When I sat down, the table was still covered with dirty cups, cans, and leftover food. I had to ask the server to clean it, and even then, her attitude was rude and unprofessional. It made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome. I hope the restaurant improves both cleanliness and customer service for future customers

I have called in and placed a take away order, I was told it will be ready for pick up in 20 minutes, drove almost an hour with traffic, but still our order wasn’t ready an hour & half later. We ended up waiting for additional 50 minutes onsite.

After all the disappointment with our wasted time, and poor service experience, unfortunately our food was not cooked properly. They gave us raw meat the kitfo with no flavor whatsoever and dry tibs almost looked like pre-cooked heated staled Frozen, not a fresh cooked meal even though I specifically asked them to cook it properly too. They were not busy to be overwhelmed by customer counts or anything, but the whole time I was there no order had came out for other people who were waiting before me for take out or dining. 2 other people were complaining about the time they had to wait, and one server had made a remark that her job was to put the order and she doesn’t control the team in the kitchen.

The servers were preoccupied with 2 or three guys at the one table near the bar, clearly flirting talking about meeting up after work to have a fun and so on. Very inappropriate behavior and unprofessional conversation between team members & customers at work site during business hours while others are waiting to be served.

I get it they are young ladies, and want to play, but not caring about customer’s time and messing up people’s order is not okay. I didn’t find out my order wasn’t right until I got home, and this is the second time similar situation happened.

I hope your Managment team or the owner read this message and make necessary changes to prevent disappointments for other customer since I won’t be ordering from them again.

Thank you!

Positively delightful! It was my first time trying Ethiopian cuisine and our server was friendly and patient with us. Highly recommend the meat and vegetable sampler. It could easily feed 3-4 people. We had the plantains for an appetizer, best plantains I’ve ever had! Also tried the honey wine - I would recommend trying it at least once, comes in a cool glass. We had both the gluten & gluten free injera (bread like food served with the meal) - both were delicious.
Friendly staff, clean restaurant, reasonably priced, very positive experience.

First time having Ethiopian and it was amazing! I could probably eat 20 of their sambusas and the lamb in my dish was so tender. My husband is a spice fiend and he said his dish was the perfect balance of spiciness and flavor. My kids were unimpressed with the offerings but that's on us to broaden their culinary horizons better. Anyway. Staff was very kind to us, I was out of my element so their hospitality was much appreciated. Food was filling and so tasty and I definitely see us returning in the future. Thanks!!
first time having Ethiopian food and it was so so good! My friends and I split the 7 veggie sampler, some sambusas, and the plantains. Excellent service and excellent food.

We've eaten and ordered from here several times and it's been great. Tonight not so much. The tibs were so tough, overcooked, and lacked  flavor. The interaction was stiff and thick, and was thrown into a plastic bag and came broken in bits. The lentils in the vegetable combo were thicker than usual and honestly felt like they reheated an old batch. If we were dining in, I would have sent everything back it was so bad. Really disappointed.

First time trying Ethiopian. The food was delicious and there were many vegetarian options. I had the vegetable combination with five samplers: Gomen, Yemisir Wot, Fosolia Green Beans, Kik Alicha and Atkilt Wot served on a bed of Injera. The server was very friendly and patiently explained all the dishes. The decorations, including furniture made out of straw and traditional artwork, transformed the ambience into a more authentic and wholesome Ethiopian dining experience.
Me and my kids were there on Sunday like the place good food and excellent sevice .
Awesome 👌 delicious food and great customer service

I get the vegetable combo from here often, comes with a salad. It's very delicious and always hot and fresh. I'm not sure what's in it and it changes everytime I get it but I always love it. Definitely recommend, staff is nice and the environment is very relaxed.
It's nice customer service and fresh Ethiopian food the best shero...

Honest customer service
Amazing food test.
Neat and clean.
And reasonable price.
❤❤❤❤❤❤

Back from Morocco for about a month and had a hankering for Moroccan food. Absolutely loved this place. The food is authentic Moroccan food - not just ‘Mediterranean.’ Highly recommend the Bastilla and the sweet couscous - identical to what we ate in Morocco. A friend also loved her chicken kebabs. The service was lovely, and the servings were large enough for leftovers. Will be happy to enjoy my meal again. Thank you Cafe Paprika!

Good middle Eastern restaurant in a small strip mall. The lamb dishes are great. The lamb kebabs were a lot of food for lunch. The lamb was cooked to perfection and paired well with the sauce. The rice and vegetables were very good. I had planned to go with Flan for dessert but was full by then.

Service is good - fast and friendly. The space is nicely decorated and comfortable. The music is low level and pleasant.

The parking lot is small and can fill at peak times.

I've never had this style of gyros before. The tastes were. Great blend of savory and sweet. Definitely a skilled chef in the kitchen. I did not like that the meat was cut in bite size pieces. It allowed it fall out of the gyro. I now know I prefer shaved meat. The decor of the restaurant was beautiful, it's too bad the place was not busier, it is a great place. Clean, friendly and good food.

Years ago, I had takeout from Cafe Paprika but tonight I had the pleasure of having dinner there and we were blown away by the beautifully flavored chicken tangine with prunes and apricot lamb. The hummus was the best we’ve had in years and the pita was freshly toasted and delicious too. We loved the mint green tea and are already eager to return soon. Thank you chef!
Our server was super nice. It's definitely worth a try. Good Moroccan food.  It's a bit milder in flavor.

It's crazy that I've lived in Denver my whole life and never ate here. Experienced it the first time yesterday with my women's group and the food was delicious! I got the catfish dinner. The greens were nice and a little spicy. The yams were great. The Catfish was fresh and light. We didn't have a reservations we walked in. They were a little tight but the manager was able to get us in without having to wait over an hour and a half which I so appreciated. Clean establishment and the staff was friendly And attentive. Overall a wonderful restaurant in the neighborhood ‼️

We went here with another couple for dinner. The area is interesting a lot of old buildings. I had a turkey burger, my husband had the whiting and cat fish sandwich, my brother in love have the same the whiting and cat fish sandwich and my sister in love had honey hot wings.  We shared a fried bread with cheese and broccoli. If you go be prepared to wait at least 45 minutes for your food. They tell you this when you order. The staff was friendly. Our server forgot 2 items that I ordered and I am not one to complain and say anything, but I really wanted to try the peach cobbler, but I wasn’t going to wait another 15 or 30 minutes for it. If you are not in a hurry for your food this would be a nice place to go and enjoy yourself with the people you go with. The price for the food is fair. I was disappointed because my turkey burger didn’t come with fries and when they ask if you want them seasoned they mean it. I had unseasoned and had to add salt. They do have outside sitting.

I give this restaurant 5 stars across all categories! The food was soulfully delicious! Our servers Sarah and Fathima were so friendly, professional and accommodating! My fiends and I can hardly wait to go back!

Stopped by Welton Street Cafe and was warmly welcomed by Lucille at the bar, who helped me with my order. I went with the jerk chicken dinner, paired with potato salad, cabbage, and fry bread—and wow, it did not disappoint. The chicken was packed with flavor, the sides were comforting and well-seasoned, and that fry bread was the perfect touch. If I lived in the area, this would definitely be a regular order.

I also tried the banana pudding for dessert. It was good, though not particularly memorable compared to the standout main course.

Overall, a great local spot with friendly service and soul-satisfying food. I’ll be thinking about that jerk chicken for a while.

Let me just tell you. I am from the Deep South in Alabama. We know fried chicken. This place has some of the best friend chicken I have ever had. I totally see why this is an institution. Everything about this place made me feel like I was home. The green, yams, and mac and cheese were all stellar. Don’t skip on this restaurant. I can’t wait to come back and try the hot wings next!

We went here for New Year’s Eve. It was absolutely outstanding! The owner and staff were so friendly and welcoming. The food from the meat plate to the vegetarian one every part was wonderful. Our whole family is four and the children are young adults ate for $76 and took food home. We entered dinner with a delicious spice tea.Wow! What a lovely start New Year’s evening. We will definitely be coming again and you should too.

I don’t write google reviews but I feel it is my duty to share my experience.DO NOT COME HERE!!!!
I live 30 minutes away from Queen of Sheba and the phone does not work so you have to come in person to place the order I guess. I drove the 30 minutes and was so excited to try this restaurant. I pre planned what I was going order so that everything would go as smooth as possible. I enter the restaurant and before I can reach the counter the owner looks me up and down (I was wearing sweats and a hoodie because I was planning on taking the food to go). I asked to place a to go order was she answered “Maybe. I can try.” I have a gluten sensitivity and selected this restaurant because the reviews and menu stated they offer gluten free enjera. When I requested the gf injera she immediately interrupted and said they don’t have that today (which happens at restaurants so sad but no big deal). I said that’s not a problem as I can just give the enjera to my partner that is not gluten free. She said she wouldn’t serve me at all because I’m gluten free. I explained to her that it’s a sensitivity  and that I drove 30 minutes to try to food but was met with nothing but hostility. She said I couldn’t be trusted to not eat enjera and maybe if I bring my partner next time then she could trust me. I did start to tear up (I’m hungry and have never been treated with hostility in a restaurant to this degree) and she said “don’t be a comedian” .Take your hard earned money elsewhere. I recommend Nike Ethiopian in Aurora

Best Ethiopian restaurant in town. I love that this woman runs everything herself. Her love is in the food!!! You can taste it in ever bite. The chicken falls off the bone and the veggie platter is so delicious. Highly highly recommend!

Truly a gem. Food was out of this world fantastic. Chicken falls off the bone. Lamb is tender as could be. The lentils and Yatakelt Wott stand out on their own. Split the Queens Dinner for two with a friend and it was more than enough food for each. The amount of flavor in each bite is well worth dining here. The true star of the show is Ms Zebwe. The amount of love and experience she puts into every dish makes you feel like your eating your grandma's cooking.
Food was incredible, the owner was lovely and cooked it all herself! Truly an unbelievable dinner and for a great price; we will absolutely be back!!!!

Second time coming here, and SO GOOD! Amazing food, great atmosphere, lovely service - highly recommend checking it out!My boyfriend and I got the veggie combo and the meat combo to split - it was the perfect amount. Definitely will be returning :)

First time trying ethopian food. Everything we ate was above average however they did not have sambusas and the veggie dishes were cold to warm. Meat dishes were hot but beef was quite chewy. Chicken leg was our favorite. The sweet wine was a pass for me.

We arrived late for a birthday dinner and were warmly welcomed. The food was excellent, much more flavorful than other Ethiopian I have had. The service was stellar, right down to sharing birthday cake with the staff. Highly recommended !

Here visiting from Texas and lucked up on this gem. We had the veggie combo and Shiro and it was AMAZING. You could taste the love it was cooked with. We also had the opportunity to watch the coffee ceremony. What a delight. Also, the owner and her daughter were so friendly. They explained the coffee ceremony and some of the history. We'll definitely be back.

There are a lot of Ethiopian cuisine options in Denver. This one stands out from other. However, the atmospher of the restaurant is not of high standard. Food was okay. Their injera was too sour compared to other ethiopian restaurants I,ve been to. Server was great explaining everything to us. Overall I would say this is a great restaurant.
Loved the lamb kabsa! Fall off the bone lamb with savory rice and salad. Enough for two people.  Delicious.  Very friendly and attentive owner.  Highly recommended.

Visited this place for the first time in Denver, I ordered chicken shawarma wrap and a shish kebab wrap with two lemonades. The wraps were good in taste and moderately seasoned.
However, I can note that calling the place isn’t the best approach to order food as they don’t have a designated cashier or anyone specific to serve tables and that’s why you’ll need to probably wait about ten minutes extra.
The lemonade has also extra sugar and there’s no option to choose from adding honey or not adding any sweetener which’s essential inquiry in any restaurant.
I hope to visit this place again and see positive changes.

Update:

I decided to visit Tuti Grill restaurant again together with my significant other and had even a better experience than the first one, we opted for a mix grill plate and Falafel 🥙 plate appetizers which come in 5 pieces and hummus with olive oil and I can confidently say it’s the best I’ve tried in Denver!. I attached photos for you to see.

I found this restaurant by Google search. The atmosphere was nice, traditional, no bar/alcohol.

I had the baba ghanouj for appetizer. It was very good, fresh as well as the bread. I had the Tuti Mix Grill for entree, the meat and rice were seasoned well. There was a beef that came in four pieces it was the best. I shared this with my partner who is Turkish/Iranian. We were both pleased with the portion sizes and taste. The server was great as well. I strongly recommend trying this place!

Was craving Mediterranean food and this place was close, so we stopped in. So glad we did! The food was so delicious - even the salad was flavorful. We played it safe with chicken dishes but cannot wait to go back to try some lamb! This restaurant will for sure be in our rotation.

The food was tasty and prepared to order, so very fresh. As a vegetarian I had two appetizers- I loved the baba ganoush, it was rich and tangy, and the falafel were light and crispy and perfect. My husband had some lamb dish he declared tasty. We had no leftovers because we both wiped our plates clean. Oh, and the rice was fluffy perfection. Highly recommended- we will be back

The guys here did not know me from a can of paint and welcome to me like I was a native son. I love it hear you know as a traveling photographer from Houston it warms my heart to come here like an immigrant person and feel welcome like I'm in my parents home country. Immigrant people know.  these guys in here are decent Good wonderful excellent people. Let me tell you about this food it was so wholesome and delicious if you're a vegan person, they have all kinds of lentils vegetables beets. Come on down and have a good coffee good music family friendly atmosphere. Good for me to catch up on my picture work.

I got the veggie combo to go. I've eaten Ethiopian in many restaurants in different cities. This experience was acceptable but not wow-ing Firstly, disappointed there are no greens.  NO GREENS... and the picture shows greens on the menu forvthe veggie combo. The cabbage was very good.  The beets were very good too. The yellow lentils were a total miss-- they were salty & dry for my taste.   Great ngera bread though....very flavorful. An honest rating would be a 3 out-of 5 but don't want the business to take a huge hit on their reviews.   I prefer other Ethiopian restaurants in the area over this one. But that's my truth.

The gentleman helping me was very nice.

So after looking at different Ethiopian restaurants, I picked this one to introduce my mother to Ethiopian food.It would turn out that I picked the right place because the food was very good. This place is very much a whole in the wall and doesn't look like much, but the food is good. The service is good as well. The guy even gave me a free coffee as I waited for my food. He was a little surprised when I told him no cream or sugar. I guess not many people drink it straight.
The owners are kind, a mom-and-pop type restaurant. Family owned, authentic recipes, delicious food and COFFEE. You pay for the quality. Visit them for sure!

Went here to grab breakfast and the food was great! Everything was freshly made and the coffee was good. I haven’t had Ethiopian food before but the owner guided me through the menu. The owner was very kind and respectful. He seems to treat everyone (including me) like an old friend.

Would highly recommend coming to this humble venue. From my experience, you won’t be disappointed with the service.

This place feels like home! The food is delicious and you can tell this is a well known hangout spot for community members!
I also had a chance to try the pineapple upside down cake right out of the oven, and it's one of the best slices of cake I've ever had.

I had a catfish po-boy and my husband had the sampler platter. It was really good! There was definitely a community feel to the place- there was a game on and when the Saints scored a touchdown they gave out free shots to the patrons.

The gumbo was amazing, but let’s be real... the red beans and rice came in and stole the spotlight ⭐️. Everything we ordered was a hit, no misses at all. And don’t even get me started on the pineapple upside-down cake… chef’s kiss 🤌🏽
On top of the food being a solid 5/5, the staff was just as great/super welcoming, attentive, and made sure we were happy every step of the way. Great food, great service, great vibes. If your in the area check them out (and order the red beans and rice..😉). 😄🍽️
Voodoo Tavern is a great place to go if you're missing NOLA. The food is great and the atmosphere bring you back to the French Quater.

Great neighborhood spot. Best food I had outside of the Crescent City. Gator bites and the Nola Trio all day, I even took some to go. Great service and great drinks as well. Got to shake hands with the owner him and his staff were all great. Definitely will stop every time I'm around Denver.

Amazing food, great service, everything came out fast and hot! We got the chicken tenders, chicken sandwich, and chicken katsu. They all had choices of sides and sauces. Plenty and parking and indoor seating. Love this place will definitely be back all made fresh on the spot.

I mean, it's a place. The Hot spice level is more mild if anything else.

They have a fly problem. Flies and gnats are everywhere.

Also the sauce is super small. Hardly enough for 1 tender. 55 cents if you want another which is crazy.

the chicken sandwich is FABULOUS! I got medium and it was crisp & delicious. the kickin sauce is super yummy & so is the corn. the service is excellent and very friendly! 10/10 recommend, great local spot & a must try in the denver area!
Best tenders around, the spicy ones are amazing. Every side on the menu is excellent as well. It is always my first stop every time I am in town.

Words can not describe how good everything in my basket was! The food was all hot and fresh. The chicken was seasoned to perfection, and the mac salad was the perfect balance of flavors and textures. The waffle was like none other, and the Thai iced tea was one of the best I've ever had. When I'm in the area, I'll be back, and I highly recommend trying this place. This is a must try!

Sumac Street is such a great spot. The food is incredibly flavorful and absolutely delicious! Everything tastes fresh and thoughtfully made. On top of that, they give you free lentil soup and coffee, which is such a nice touch and really shows how much they care about the experience. The staff is warm, attentive, and makes you feel genuinely welcome every time. I’ve been there twice in the last two weeks and got the chicken Shawarma sandwich which is a great price.

The chicken shawerma is the best you will find in CO. Hummus was amazing. The fries and falafel could be better but not too bad . It seemed they were understaffed as no one was in the dinning area but it is a new business and I think they have the potential to be outstanding. We will definitely come again.

Update: we went back yesterday and I was pleased to see their fries are so much better. They have a system where you serve yourself which is fine with us it is an upgrade.

The issue this time was the food was sooooo dry . The chicken shawerma was not like this last time. It was so dry and hard to swallow . The garlic sauce was not spread all over the sandwich and was just at the end. I would appreciate if they added  garlic sauce on the side … The bread was way too much in comparison with the chicken. They over pressed it so it was just dry.  The baba ganooj was good . The falafel was better cooked than last time. I love they added spicy sauce it was good.

I am trying to give them some time to perfect this place but seriously consistency is key. I am very optimistic this place has great potential.

This place definitely has some of the best chicken shawarma in Denver. It was well seasoned and the spicy version was a lot better. The mozzarella sticks were nothing special, so next time I am passing on them. But the baklava was delicious.
Took one star because of the wait time , they are new so I expected this. Hopefully it gets faster as they get used to things. When I went it was lunch rush.

Ordered the Arabic style shawarma. The chicken shawarma was really really good and so we're the pickles! I was not a big fan of the beef shawarma. Fries were not great. Fattoush lacked flavor/dressing. Their mango juice, harissa, and mhallabeya were amazing!

This restaurant is very well kept. It’s insanely clean, tasteful, and packed with different items on the menu to try. The customer service is nothing like I’ve seen before. And the staff treats you like family!!

name: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill - Aurora, CO

reviews.text:
I always enjoy a tasty Gyro! The location itself is clean with plenty of seating for dinning in. I ordered my Gyro to go but it was served to me at the table instead. Not too big of a deal, but I got a bit of an attitude when reminding the server I wanted it to go. I asked if I could get a to-go box and they obliged. Maybe they were just having a bad day or something. The food was yummy for the price.

I do recommend!

Very clean and nice looking restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating. Employees were very nice and my food came out quickly. A little pricey but the foot is worth it! Very delicious and they don't skimp on the portion. Might be my new fav lunch spot

The food was good but the service was really impressive. Cleya made what we expected to be just a semi fast-ish food run into an neat experience. It was really nice to have that interaction with her and our fam. We'd go back but mostly for the staff.

As someone that truly favors Authentic Greek Food and flavors. I was highly impressed that this location had some of the best Authentic Greek Food. I spent over 8 years in Europe and I have frequented many Greek restaurants and this by far was the best I've had. If I recall correctly it was Andrew that took my order and Nicolas was the manager. The food was amazing, the service was fast, and the restaurant was clean. Thank you for the great experience.

The food service was quick, and most of the food was excellent in taste, texture, and temperature.
However, a few pieces of the chicken kabob were really dry.

The young man who took our order was less than thrilled  when we walked in. He left before our food arrived, so his shift was nearly over, and he couldn't wait to leave.

The restaurant was clean, but it lacked any character.

I would eat here again, but I wouldn't go out of my way to do so.

Amazing food. Menu rotates every few months and everything we had was excellent. Lobster shooters, Makai paka Esquites, Spiced goat cheese, Suadero Samosa. Verde Karahi Ghosht, Plantain Cheesecake - were excellent. Turkish fig Old fashioned was amazing too. Excellent food and experience.

Second time visiting this restaurant and was there to celebrate our 5th anniversary. The staff is incredibly thoughtful and attentive. The service alone is a million reasons to dine here. The vibe is very chill with the low lights. There’s multiple different areas to sit from the bar to the lounge to dining in the main room or a private room for large groups. We decided to order many small plates & bites so we could try multiple things. We started with the lobster shooters which they poured the curry over before serving. Followed by the cornbread which was so delicious. It had a sweetness to it that matched well with the pecan butter it was served with. We had the crab cakes with tomato soup which was my favorite!! The thai croquettes were also very delicious- a little spice with the flavor. And we had the platter for our entree. The garlic spread is soo good for the meat or potato. Everything was cooked perfectly. We enjoyed our entire meal. The staff even delivered a complimentary dessert with a card signed by the staff. This was such a special touch. They also have a couple mocktails on their menu which is nice for people wanting to avoid drinking but still have a “cocktail”. Upon finishing each portion, they would take it to the back and box it up for us and at the end of our meal, our boxes were brought to the table. That was also a nice touch. And they are also really great with food allergies.

The fruit bowl isn't on the menu (at least not yet).  My wife wanted some fruit after the meal, like we were accustomed to in Greece.  While the bowl you see is already half eaten (the fruit was extremely fresh and well prepared), it speaks to the "extra mile that this establishment is willing to go for service.

Water glasses were always full.  The server circled round with a reasonable frequency.  The silverware was replaced with each course.  The tabletop was kept clean.

The menu is designed with plates to be shared.

This is a social restaurant.  It's a bit loud (even for the U.S.), but the food was very good and the service very strong.

We were original Ambli customers from when they first opened in Denver, and then became a regular patron at the DTC location when working in the area.
Was sad to see they closed due to COVID……. but …… they are and have been back in business!
Celebrated a birthday last night and had excellent service, amazing flavorful food, and wonderful drinks!  So glad they are back in business and hope they thrive! The food is so flavorful and artsy! ❤️! Thank you 🙏

Wow!!  It had been a long time since we'd been to Ambli DTC, and we were impressed by its current menu.  The setting was elegant and very quiet; and the service was top-notch...friendly and responsive.  All of our dishes were excellent:  Lobster shooters (even though they use dumplings instead of actual chunks of lobster like in the good old days), Thai croquettes, Spicy Ambli-style paella (a good number of clams, shrimp and mussels), Cilantro Garlic Shrimp & Polenta, Corn Chowder Scallops, and the Dulce de leche flan.  The wine list is quite pricy, but the selection is impressive.

Best lol in town, HANDS DOWN, TOBACCO, VAPES, SNACKS AND NICK NACKS FOR YOUR QUESTIONABLE EXTRA CURRICULARS. These guys are family. They got what you need. Period. (Any kind of pipe, and I mean ANY!)

Must have but for me is the $1.50 Texas cinnamon roll and the $25 lost/ frutti/ geek 50k 50mg/ml vapes.
I got the bole tibs. Best Ethiopian food I've had in a long time! I didn't look around much but will have to next time. It looked like they had some good spices for sale.

I am not Ethiopian, I am Asian. But I go to this market to buy Ethiopian ingredients such as their in-house injera, spices, lentils, butter and awaze made with their own family’s recipe. Fresh stuff, not caked with dust and expired products as I’ve seen at other African markets. It is small. Does not sell produce.

I also ordered the bole tibs which was so good, fresh and you can tell has that homemade touch. The order came with a side salad. All made to order, none of that pre-made microwaved stuff.

If you are not Ethiopian, do not feel intimidated. Go inside, look around. Smile and ask questions. The gentleman who owns, runs and cooks in the back is very friendly.

This is really good Ethiopian food!  That being said, this place is better for takeout than dine-in, the food is worth it but there is no where to sit.  If you're having a tough night and need takeout, go here!
It smells really bad in there; begging them to do a deep clean!

Probably one of the best pizzas I’ve eaten in my life, the bread is so fresh and the cheese melts in your mouth.
Must try: Paneer Pizza
Ps: Ask for spicy as the sauce is given on side not on pizza

The staff are so friendly. The waiter was very infectiously happy and had a huge smile on his face every time he came to the table. The wait time for food was a bit long, but the quality of food made up for it.

The spice on the Lamb Korma was surprising in a pleasant way. It had good flavor for the spice level, but did have a lingering effect.

We also had some of their Korma fries which had a delicious nacho cheese and curry spices on top.

Their garlic cheese naan is banging! Love how cheesy it is and the pull apart effect.

The apple drink they have was an interesting flavor. It was first sour and then very sweet. I think it’s better slightly diluted.

The waiter was so sweet and greeted us goodbye. I would definitely come try more of their menu if I was in the area.

We love this place and come back often. Nischal, Denish, and Lushan all provided the best service tonight (per usual). We always feel so welcome here and the food is probably the best you can find available til 3am (cocktails/drinks til 2am) nightly. No where will you be greeted with such hospitality and kindness by servers who genuinely enjoy working here. Always love the butter masala (paneer or lamb) and beautiful fried momos (the only pictured since we ate so quickly).

With a 4.9-star average and nearly 5,000 reviews, this restaurant hardly needs another endorsement—but after finally trying it, I understand the hype. I ordered the Marsala burger with medium heat, and it was exceptional. My dad had a chicken dish that he thoroughly enjoyed as well.
I got the chicken...love this for Denver ... Interesting twist way better than Wendy's... Fries are perfect.   Drink in picture is a brain damage jager vodka gin triple sec lime

Our First Visit Truly Impressed!

My husband and I recently visited Farmhouse Thai Eatery in Lakewood for the first time, and we were absolutely blown away. From the moment we walked in, the service was warm, attentive, and welcoming.

The food? Incredible. Every dish tasted just like home the flavors were authentic, bold, and beautifully balanced. As someone who grew up in Thailand, it brought back so many comforting memories and helped ease a bit of my homesickness.

We both had such a wonderful dining experience and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend for anyone craving real Thai food and heartfelt hospitality!

This place is absolutely amazing! 😋
Now kha moo , flavorful, and melts in your mouth.

The boat noodles are a true highlight

If you love spicy and flavorful Thai food, this spot is a must-try. Delicious, authentic, and so satisfying — you’ll definitely want to come back for more!

This place is amazing! Tom Kha soup was soooo good I didn’t have time to take a picture. We also had Pad Thai and Khao Soi, both phenomenal. Aom was our server and she made the experience even better, she was soo sweet and welcoming. 10/10!

Delicious food but when they say spicy they mean can't taste any flavor spicy. We got the hot because we like really spicy food and the waiter said it would be good. When we got it though, it tasted too much of chilli oil and was way way way hotter than anticipated (much hotter than a "hot" should be if there are 2 levels above that). You also couldn't even taste the flavor of the food because the chilli oil taste was too strong. I love spicy food but also love to actually taste the flavor of the dish and not just the spice oil added. The waiter was also a bit demeaning and seemed to find it funny that we thought the dish was too hot. I would have liked to have him try it and tell me honestly if he could taste the actual dish instead of the spice.

They have great vegan and vegetarian options and the food is always fresh and flavorful. I'm thrilled that they brought back the massamunn curry. It's my absolute favorite. I also enjoy their noodle-based and stir-fried dishes as well. The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. My partner and I order takeout most of the time, but when we do eat in, it's a very enjoyable experience.
Hands down some of the BEST middle eastern food I’ve had. You can’t go wrong with anything on the menu. Incredible service and hospitality. Cant recommend Jasmine Syrian Food enough!!

First time trying Syrian food and it was delicious. I ordered chicken shawarma and the meat combo platter. Both dishes exceeded our expectations, large portions, tasty food, and the service was excellent.
Great food, great prices and amazing service. Will definitely return - a must have for those wishing to explorer international food!

The food is amazing and authentic. It is the best hummus and knaffa I have had in the states.
The woman who took my order was so kind and when I told her this was my favorite kind of food, she threw in some baklava. It was so kind. And of course it also was SOOO GOOD.
It is inside Mango House which is an international food hall with incredible options. I’m so excited to have found this place.
I cannot wait to go back and try more from their menu!

I’m so happy to find a Syrian restaurant finally here in Denver, and owners from my homeland. This is 100% authentic Syrian food, from the spices to the amazing service. Anyone who rates this as less than 5 stars has no idea what Syrian food should taste like. If there is ever a wait, it’s because there is a hard-working chef putting his heart and soul into every dish, making everything fresh and from scratch. I’m so impressed and so happy that this restaurant is finally here to represent Syria and its amazing food. I will be here every chance I get. Thank you Mohamad for your amazing work.

This was excellent! Just excellent. We shared the vegetarian plate. Everything was fresh and flavorful. These are the best dolmas and falafel we have ever eaten. The parsley was so fresh and the dressing was perfect.  Dessert was the Kanafeh - not too sweet and beautiful. I think everything was made to order. The service was friendly. This place is the best kept secret in Denver!

We were welcomed upon walking in but that was pretty much the extent of the service we received. Besides taking our orders and dropping them off, our waters were never filled and it was a hot day with no/low air conditioning in the restaurant. Even when paying, the lady didn’t say a word to us and was busy talking to someone on the phone. The restaurant also has a strong smell of old furniture which really bothered some of the people in our group.

The food itself was decent. I enjoyed my Moroccan lamb shank enough and the chicken kabob was decent but one in our group ordered the lunch portion and it was like 3-4 small pieces of chicken.

Overall, if you are really craving Mediterranean in the Wash Park area and don’t feel like driving, getting some good to go here may not be a bad idea but service leaves a lot to be desired.

Absolutely perfect dinning experience with food I have never tried. It was incredible. Our first place we ate at from Montana. And the observing was friendly, warm and helpful. 100% must try! Well be back!

I believe that this could be a good restaurant again with trained employees. First, the cook arrived late. It took quite awhile for my food. A phone customer was able to order and pickup before we were served. The was a problem with the hummus so I was served rice and asked afterwards if it was OK. My friend's lamb was tough. Finally, there was something on the containers which stopped me from finishing my drink or taking the leftovers. My friend was OK with taking them. $56, too much for the whole experience.

The atmosphere was quiet and relaxing!
The tacos were absolutely delicious!😋

The Original Gyro was way better than the Chicken Shwarma. Super flavorful. The jalapeño in the jalapeño poppers was only a thin slice so it came out in the first bite which left and empty popper shell. I'd come back and try their other food.
We love the food here! We’ve been several times and always leave happy. It’s very close to my husband’s job so he will go for lunch often with his coworkers. They all love it! The staff are friendly.
Delicious Halal Burgers with fried egg. Amazing
So good! Already planning my next trip back. Got the Greek gyros wrap with fries and a drink. Super generous with gyros meat and fries! Great tasting as well! Nice little spot!

Disappointing.  Ordered the chicken Sharma and it was just chicken in pita bread.  No veggies or anything with it, very bland.  Top it off we waited maybe 10-15 min, noticed the staff was messing with each other playing around so asked where our food was and they said oh it's been sitting here

name: Junction Food & Drink
vicinity: 2000 S Colorado Blvd Building IV, Denver

reviews.text: Lots of space and a good variety of food options from Japanese to African to Jamaican to pizza to empanadas - and a nice, not too pricey bar, too. Really great spot for meeting up with people who have different tastes, or if you want to try a diverse array of bites. Also great for work events that are more casual because it's pretty easy to grab a long table. We do a white elephant gift exchange here each year!
Great food! I love that there are different restaurants to choose from. We ordered from 3 different places: pizza and pide, bowel'd masala, and the empanada place. All tasted great and fresh.

Food court near large movie theater with about 7 businesses currently operating and another 6 spots currently unoccupied. Some good options among the available vendors especially Lazo empanadas and Sonder Coffee. Unfortunately, the soup and sandwich place is now closed.

Service is generally good but may vary from vendor to vendor. There's lots of seating down the center of the court and on the east end. They do have unsecured Wi-Fi for customers.

There's lots of parking, but it may be difficult to find a spot close to the food court depending on when you're there.

After my ILD class our teachers suggested a meet and greet at the Junction food and drink- the location is very clean with several options to choose from tacos, to burgers or sushi or noodles and even a drink. It was nice to have some sushi and a Pepsi!
Great food hall concept. Brilliant idea for friends or families with different tastes.

This place is so amazing!! Miguel is wonderful and the food was really good. Jalapeño poppers were delicious and of course the cheesesteak was great! Loved the inside decor too. Could have stayed and hungout for a long time!

My wife and I finally tried this legendary place and it surpassed expectations. Yes, the Philly is the best in Denver. Having been to Philadelphia many times, this Philly is as good and, I think, even better.
The fries, wow. Special.

The owner, Mesut, is one of the nicest people I’ve met in a long time.

The atmosphere and decor is a perfect compliment of personality to an amazing meal.

Do NOT pass on varying this Denver cultural gem.

If you're looking for a local place with great food and a cool atmosphere, Aspen Lodge Bar & Grill is somewhere you need to check out. It's a hidden gem in a little unassuming shopping center in Westminster.
I went for the Philly Cheese-steak and really enjoyed the vibe.
When you walk in, you're greeted with Iron Maiden Videos on multiple screens, Multiple, fully decorated Christmas trees and dozens of Skis covering the walls and ceiling. Plus some interesting/creepy dolls/elves?
The Owner and his daughter were extremely friendly and we had a good time chatting with them. The story is great and the food was excellent.
The Philly Cheesesteak was one of the best I've had and Teresa said her Fish n Chips were good also.  The Turkish Baklava for desert was also excellent.
Support a local non-chain restaurant. Stop by Aspen Lodge for great food and cool vibes.
( Update: It was so good, we went back a second time for lunch before we had to come home. Also note: They don't open until 12. )

Was our first time stopping in. The atmosphere was comfortable and cozy. You can have a full conversation without scream over anyone/anything. Was blessed enough to meet the father/ daughter duo tonight. Service was incredible from both of them. I had the Aspen Burger and my husband got the Philly. We absolutely loved the home made food. Also had Mac N Chesse bites and Baklava, they are 100% homemade. Can’t wait to come back again.

Was visiting from OKC, we wanted to stop at a locally owned place and were not disappointed. Incredible vibe, awesome decorations, good drinks, amazing food! Was here on a quiet monday night. Would love to see the place on a friday night with live music!
Friendly service, greeted upon entry.  Had a cheesesteak and onion rings, both were good.  Will come back to try other menu items.

Decided to try this place out. Had pretty good reviews on Google so I gave it a shot.

I ordered take out with my gf. We got two sandwiches, an order of wings and an order of fries.

My gf ordered the Classic cheese steak and I got the Jazzy's South African. We opted for *no Cheese Wiz on both.
Got 6 wings. 3 were Mango Habanero and the other 3 were Garlic Parm.

Sandwiches were really tasty! Lots of flavor decent size and fresh. We will prob add the Cheese Wiz next time. The wings were mid. They were dry and chewy, they looked better in the picture. The flavor was good, the sauces. Wings were dry. The French fries were pretty good!

There was some sauces the came with the food I think maybe the Phatt Sauce dip? I wasn't too much of a fan. Regular ranch would of been OK.

Overall I would come back and get sandwiches again along with some fries. I wouldn't get the wings again.

This is a great local spot! The service is amazing. Decent prices. Great deals when you order online. I have had the pizza and their cheese steak both very tasty. They made my pizza only slightly off and made me a whole second pizza. I came in to both ready! I want not going to ask them to remake it even. Support local!! These guys are super swell!

Phatt Matt's is an absolute gem. The pizza is incredible, the wings are loaded with flavor, and the Philly cheesesteaks might be the best I’ve had in a long time. I met the owner, Matt, and his son, Miles — both super genuine, welcoming people who clearly care about their craft and their community. The whole vibe of the place feels wholesome and inviting. I’m honestly just happy they started this business. If you’re anywhere nearby, this spot is a must-try.

This is our new favorite pizza spot. My boyfriend and I decided to try it out on a whim when we couldn’t decide what to eat, and I remembered a flyer I had gotten in the mail from them. We ordered two pizzas and both of them were incredible! After picking up my boyfriend was raving about how the wings looked, so we will have to try those next! We are local to the Englewood area and are excited to have found this place.

Delicious poke! Just wish they had soy free options for the fish as well. Liked the laid back atmosphere and that they have options to purchase local kombucha (although they're a little on the pricier side). We got a half rice half kale poke and a poke on kale with some side spam & a spam musubi. It was all pretty delicious :)

I was expecting a bit more menu options but what they offer is delicious.
The pork was very juicy and full of all the island flavors you would expect.
The poke was also fresh and tender. Mac salad was on point.
We were worried about the portion size of the pork being small, but left full.
The spam musubi was standard. Not worth $4. Would rather order more Mac salad.

📸 click the photos to see what we ordered

Food pictured: Spicy tuna poke bowls, spam musubi, Japanese pickles, kimchi, mac salad and Kalua pork.
Not pictured: Injoycha local kombucha.

Everything was so flavorful and delicious! The owner was very kind and welcoming, offering a sample of the delicious Kalua pork. There is an interior and a shady exterior eating area. Highly recommend!

Absolutely incredible. We did the mix plate and mini poke bowl and everything had such mouth-watering flavor we couldn’t even speak during the meal. An absolute MUST while you’re in Denver. We cannot wait to go back! Also- the staff was the sweetest! Thank you for a great experience :)

Truly amazing food and atmosphere. Fresh, high quality ingredients with authentic Hawaiian flavor. We had the Kalua pork plate, spam musubi, and poke bowl and everything was incredible. Almost everything can be made gluten and dairy free!

The owner is truly an amazing, kind, and passionate human. Come give them a try!

Why is this place popular? Its literally chicken strips. There is nothing special about them. There is nothing special about the sauce. There is nothing special about the fries. It is as if this place won some lottery where they get super popular while doing nothing special.

The service was fine and quick, but I could buy a giant sack of frozen chicken fingers and make a whole bunch of them at home for the same price and they literally will be just as good.

Talk about a fast, yummazing, clean atmosphere with some of the most friendly employees. This was my first time eating at Canes Chicken. 🍗 My food was warm the employees were super friendly. I would recommend eating here if you want a good size meal for a fair price and a place where when you walk in you feel welcome and talk to you as if they are a friendly neighbor. I give this a 5 star ⭐✨ all across the board. Good Job Canes.😋

Canes send promotional emails if your a caniac club member which i am. I was sent a club-iversery email for a Bogo box combo. This is actually the 3rd time I've been sent something like this. And each time no matter which canes I go to there not valid. The coupon shows both ends my log in info and there system when I swipe the card. They have never let me redeem the reward. They just say its blue and won't apply. I belive this is deceptive practes by canes.

This is by far the best Raising Cane’s Chicken fingers I went to. The staff service was great. Their food is as always fresh & hot. I ordered the 4 Piece chicken strips meal with French fries,coleslaw and a drink of my choice. This store looked brand new. There is a drive thru which was so busy. So I came inside to order my food from. It was such a quick service. Great staff service.

This Canes is always on spot. Clean, nice crew, hot food.
Look at that fry in the sauce. 5 Stars!

I've come here for AYCE sushi multiple times. It's fantastic. Fish tastes fresh, rice is well seasoned, good selection of rolls. The spicy tuna is just the right amount of spicy.

The staff is very kind and the service is pretty fast, although I've never been here while it's been crowded so I can't speak to that.

Overall, I recommend this place to anyone who enjoys sushi. I haven't tried their Chinese food menu but I'm sure it's good.

It looks like they are under new management now. The menu has changed. The staff were friendly and quick, the food was delicious and accurate. The sushi was surprisingly fresh! Definitely give them a try!

I have never had great Chinese food in the Denver metro until I had an outstanding dinner at Golden Shanghai. The food was hot, fresh, and plentiful.  The manager and his staff were welcoming and some of the most friendly people I've met. All of the appetizers and entrees were spectacular. I'll definitely return very soon.

I have been to this place before I was not impressed but now I have to say with the added on sushi service and looks like a beautiful remodel is done. It is a completely different space. I enjoyed the sushi experience. It’s nice to find cute mom pop shops that have sushi in it on the side of town. Absolutely delicious, amazing hospitality, friendly service, and quality food. I truly enjoyed how they renovated and change the space. It is so much more wider and definitely a place to bring more people that has a calm elegance to.

Nice dine in area. Food was better than average Chinese restaurant. Crispy duck had a salty crunchy skin and the sauce complimented it well. Great atmosphere for date or somewhat formal dinner. Portions were very shareable. White rice was not my favorite though.

Unfortunately, my experience here was very disappointing. The staff were unwelcoming and unprofessional — the cashier even tossed the menu toward us and gave unpleasant looks, which made the entire visit uncomfortable. The food itself was decent, but the poor service overshadowed everything. I wouldn’t recommend this place based on the lack of respect and hospitality shown by the staff.
Very friendly and helpful owner. The Foul Special was terrific. Wish I lived closer and could have it regularly.

Went in here on my lunch break and got a foul sandwich in about the amount of time it would have taken me to order anywhere else. Service was SUPER fast, foul was fresh and deliciously spiced, bread was soft on the inside with a pleasantly crisp crust. I cannot speak highly enough of this place.
Lamb liver sandwich is one of the best sandwiches in town and very healthy. Restaurant is always very clean and the owner is very respectful and genuine. Love this place!

Searched for coffee shops and found this gem!  More of a restaurant but you can get various coffees like espresso and sudanese coffee also.  It's more patronized by Ethiopian natives so it's perfect.  No flash.  Very simple menu.  But absolutely delicious.  I was the only woman there for lunch but felt completely safe.  All my questions answered; such a wonderful experience!  I ordered the Foul (see picture).  Getting the one with falafel next time!  Definitely adding it to my favorites list.

White Chocolate Mocha was the best I’ve ever had, perfect balance of espresso and sweetness. My kids loved their Strawberry Smoothies and finished them fast. The Hot Chocolate came with toasted marshmallows on top…so good!
