Atmosphere inside was great and it’s an easy stop right off the interstate. The owners were super friendly, they even split one smoothie into two cups for my kids. They also gave us a card for a free coffee/tea when we come back. We’ll definitely be stopping again!

I recently visited this coffee shop to get some work done. The owners are lovely and attentive, and the coffee was excellent. I also tried some of the food, which was delicious. The atmosphere is calm and not too noisy, making it a perfect spot to focus and be productive. Last but not least, the bathroom was very clean, which is always appreciated!

Got a bacon, cheese, and egg burrito and it was not prepackaged but freshly made. Delicious! They also have pan dulce! I got a sugar donut and cappuccino and both were great. Friendly and beautiful atmosphere. I’d come back.

Coffee Celestial is such a charming little shop with an amazing variety of treat and great coffee. They have super cute decor and even offer more substantial food. I'm so stoked to have found such a a cute locally own cafe close to home.

The coffee was delicious and unexpectedly beautiful, the burrito was crisped in a panini maker and very good. Prices are reasonable. The staff were very nice and there is guest wifi for working. 10/10

This was a really tasty bite of pizza. The thin crust was awesome! There was a hiccup with delivery, but the manager corrected this issue quickly and ensured fresh food made it's way to us. The pan cheese sticks are awesome and crispy.

Well this was our first time in years trying blackjack again. My wife was wanting dominos or pizza hut! The lady on the phone taking orders was awesome and the pizza was very good. Wife now likes blackjack better. Great job staff. Pizza had extra toppings like we asked and paid for. Thank you I scored some points tonight finally 🙌
My family and I enjoyed this special 2 Large pizza deal very much. The management and Daniel who helped with my order were so friendly and accommodating. Thank you so much!
Outstanding pizza, hot and fresh and delicious fresh salad! Thank you for giving great food and service, when it’s rare these days!

Jeanine C. Was an amazing, helpful, and inviting asset to the Blackjack company. She was very inviting and helpful to the choices that we decided on. She did all the service aspect, cooking it, serving it and making sure all was sent out in a timely manner. She was amazing. Then about 20 minutes after we got home with our order we saw her delivering a pizza to my sisters neighbors. We were amazed at all she does.

name: Ocean Prime
vicinity: 8000 E Belleview Ave C10, Greenwood Village

reviews.text: Came to Ocean Prime for the first time for date night. We absolutely loved it. The food was great, made perfectly and really good flavor. Yes, it is a pretty pricey place but worth it. The atmosphere was lovely, dim lighting which was very nice. The waitress we had was so sweet and very helpful. Will be coming back again.

Wow! My partner and I came in last night for my birthday and were greeted with wonderful service. Every staff member that interacted with us wished me a happy birthday. It felt so special and considerate. The food was fabulous! Our server Landon was incredibly knowledgeable about all food and cocktails, and also charming and charismatic. Will be back :)
The food was amazing! My partner and I were there for his company holiday party. I enjoyed the salmon and the truffle mac and cheese.
Everything was great but do yourself a favor and commit right now to the Warm Butter Cake for dessert! Thank me later 😋🤙

The atmosphere is elegant.  The food was good, just good, though.  I am a Creole from New Orleans.  We have the best cuisine because food is our culture.  I had the lobster bisque which was nice, just nice.  It had a nice spoon of lobster tail meat in the middle of a small soup cup.  I also had the Caesar salad.  It was not extravagant.  I had to request cracked pepper which should have been offered.  My friends, 12 in total, had sushi mainly, onion soup, and a sandwich. They seemed to have enjoyed it.  The waiter forgot about one order of sushi for a child.  He was anxious as everyone else was eating.  The bread was good, especially the pretzel bread.  All in all, I expected a nore impressive meal.  I am sure that it was quite expensive but food quality and service should have been much better.  ~ Kevy

“Flavorful” describes it. This is a very solid example of Ethiopian food (at least as served in the US — haven’t been to Ethiopia itself so no point of comparison). If you’ve been to Ethiopian before you will not be surprised by anything.  The menus all seem to be pretty much the same and this is no exception.  But that’s not a reason not to go.  It’s damn delicious.  And, for first timers like my kids, the joy of eating with your hands / injera is something not to be missed.

Delicious Ethiopian food, one of our favorite hidden gems in Denver. Super flavorful, hearty portion sizes, great service, overall an amazing experience. Would definitely recommend checking this restaurant out! The spicy beef stew was a particular favorite.

Holy Moly! This place is incredible and so authentic. I grew up in DC which is known as the epicenter of Ethiopian food. This place is just as good as any of the places in DC and it turns out because they used to own one that my family used to frequent. Run to this place if you want delicious food.

Don’t worry about Colfax construction, there was enough parking on the side streets that it was a quick walk. Totally worth every step my wife and I took.

Amazing experience at this Ethiopian restaurant! As a vegetarian, I loved the variety of flavorful veg dishes, especially the lentils and greens. The injera was fresh and perfectly tangy. The staff was friendly and helpful, making the whole experience even better. Highly recommend for delicious and authentic Ethiopian food!

This family run business deserves more than five stars! It's a shame I don't dine here as often as I should, but it truly is a hidden gem of authentic Ethiopian food.

The staff is always accommodating, kind, and thoughtful. When I dined here regularly, the owner of the establishment would remember me!

If you're looking for a unique culinary experience, I would highly suggest this place. The meats and lentils never disappoint, and their sour bread is to die for. Paired with one of their Ethiopean beers, I don't think you can go wrong with anything on the menu. Although suitable for a small group, I think this place is best with a large group as food is often shared and you'll be able to try more things on the menu.

Le French is nothing short of extraordinary.

I have to mention first, that I’m a well traveled person and Paris is among my absolute FAVORITE cities to visit and experience. This gourmet, casual-chic Parisian bistro delivers French cuisine with global depth and soul, beautifully honoring the sisters’ Senegalese heritage while remaining unmistakably refined. From the moment you arrive, it’s clear this is not just a restaurant, it’s a thoughtfully curated culinary experience.

Chef Babacar’s influence is immaculate and deeply intentional. Every dish tells a story. His flavors are precise, layered, and emotionally resonant. You can quite literally taste his journey through years of classical training and lived culinary experience. Though new to the Denver food scene, he is unmistakably a veteran of his craft, cooking with confidence, restraint, and profound respect for technique.

The service matches the caliber of the kitchen. At lunch, Lacy guided us through the menu with warmth and expertise, creating a seamless and welcoming experience. When we returned the following evening for dinner, Annalise provided equally exceptional service; attentive, polished, and genuinely hospitable.

General Manager Mike’s leadership is evident at every level. The staff operates with cohesion and pride, and his outward respect and rapport with the chef speaks volumes about the culture being built here.

Standout dishes:
• Pesto Chicken Crêpe (Lunch): Unexplainably delicious—comforting yet elevated.
• French Onion Soup: Deeply layered, patiently reduced, and executed to absolute perfection.
• Saffron Tomato Bouillabaisse (Dinner): The most balanced version I’ve ever tasted—the saffron and tomato walk a beautiful, disciplined tightrope.
• Risotto: The undeniable star of the night. Depth, layers, and flavor that linger long after the last bite—simply exemplary.
• Tiramisu: Fantastic. I genuinely wanted to lick the bowl.

You would be doing yourself a true disservice if you didn’t experience Le French. This is a rare, full-spectrum five-star dining experience—exceptional food, outstanding service, and heart in every detail. Denver is lucky to have it.

(Dear Google, please do not add captions to my photos. I did not name these dishes in the captions and have since deleted the incorrect names that were automatically added. That’s disturbing to say the least.)

A bit of a disappointment for us. It started well. We were running late and the hostess was very nice and accommodated our change of reservation time.
Our waiter was good at the beginning, but declined pretty quickly after that.
We ordered our food and honestly, it was bland. Everything had no seasoning.  I started with the French onion soup and it had potential, but just not good. We also had the nicoise salad. Not a complicated item to make, but again, it was just ok.
We ordered the Charcuterie,  and he brought us the Fromage plate.
I ordered the boeuf bourguignon. The meat was very tender and it was a generous portion, but not flavorful.
The last thing we ordered was the Jamon crepe and it was not good. A big disappointment.
After ordering, our waiter was pretty non existent. Even the hostess came by and gave us more water. She was more attentive than he.
Overall, the visit was a bust. We had high hopes, but it was a disappointment. Hopefully it was just a bad night for them, and I hope the service and food improve.

Wow. I had the most incredible experience at Le French tonight! I made a reservation for my sorority sister’s anniversary and they could not have been more accommodating! We all ordered different things, I got the chicken sandwich and wow, it hit the spot. The portion was so good I left full and still had food for tomorrow. Our servers, Sofia and Alyssa, made sure that all our needs were taken care of even though we were a tough bunch. If you want a flavorful and exemplary meal, check out Le French!!

Jeh was absolutely amazing. She provided such extraordinary service—providing high quality recommendations and even a wonderful introduction to the chef. Will definitely be back again and again. We are so fast we didn’t get time to take photos of the food! Don’t skip out on dessert!

I drove 25 minutes to try their "chocolate and fruits" crepe. I spent maybe 8 minutes in the restaurant and had the worst experience. The hostess rolls her eyes at me when I walk in and ask to place a to-go order. I was kind of shocked. The bartender, the only nice one, took my order. I asked if they had coffee and this other girl- I'm assuming a waitress, lists under her breath all the types of coffees they have, not as a suggestion, but more as a passive aggressive way to make me feel "dumb" for asking that question. So now I'm just super annoyed and wanna go. My food comes, mind you after tip I spent $30.63. All I ordered was a SMALL coffee and 1 crepe. This "fruits" crepe was $16+tax. I get in my car and look at 5 halves pieces of strawberries and that's it. Then half a jar of nutella inside. Nothing else?! Why is this called "fruits" and description says "berries" and there's literally 5 little pieces. This is the weakest crepe I've ever had and not worth the price what so ever. This, and the attitude of the workers- very clicky, very judgmental, very mean girl vibes. Not a fan.

It's wonderful. Fast service, great food, good prices for a hearty meal, and malt vinegar on the tables. They cook it to order and the fish comes so hot it's hard to hold onto, but all the of us were trying to get our piece to eat it while it was still steaming. Their cod is flaky, firm, juicy and tender and coated in a magical tempura like batter that is super crunchy. The other seafood in the combo was good, too, but the fish was great. The clam strips were sweet and chewy crisp the way we love them. I might get a full order next time with just the fish instead of the combo. It's amazing when a place really knows what they're doing.

The fries are solid as well, but the best part are the handful of crunchies from the batter that gets loose from the fish in the fryer. So glad they add those to the bottom of each serving. It reminded me of Japan, where the tempura crunchies are something you can use to top udon bowls.

They give you plenty of tartar sauce and cocktail sauce, and there's also ketchup on the tables for those that need more than vinegar on their chips. They also have glass bottle Coke and Fanta for those that love those in addition to the regular fountain drinks. A nice touch.

Yorkshire Fish and Chips has been around for years — and it shows in every bite! They truly know how to make authentic, perfectly crispy fish and chips. The quality, flavor, and consistency are absolutely amazing. You can tell they take pride in what they do. If you’re craving real-deal fish and chips, give them a try — you won’t be disappointed!

Crunchy and delicious, this is the best fish and chips spot in the Denver metro area. This spot is a local icon and my parents have been going here since before I was born. The food is homey and sure to put a smile on your face.

Best in Denver!  Flew from Florida to get for Christmas 🎄 Best I've ever had!  Thank you for Quality & Professional Service!  Got you 10 new Customers!  Family all Loved it!  Happy New Year 2026 will be your best Year ever!

As a UK person on my US fish n chip journey I can definitely recommend it here! The batter is crispy, well seasoned and cooked well, fish was slightly overcooked but very nice nonetheless. Chips were nicely cooked, the only thing to note was there is not many chips so would recommend getting an extra portion. Very nice malt vinegar, not watered down like some places. To make it perfect it would have been nice to eat the fish as a whole fillet instead of strips, where it cooks more evenly, but this is being pedantic and it's not going to put me off coming again. Oh and a nice surprise there were fish bits in the bottom of the box! Never had that here! Best fish n chips in Colorado so far! Also tried to ask for a Yorkshire discount as that was where I was born, but unfortunately it was a no 🤣

The lady could not care less that we were there kept saying huh and she got my husband's drink order wrong he ordered a Fanta and then she turned around said what do you want and we just ended up getting a sprite. Chicken was good service not great. She also gave my husband a what do you want now look when he asked her to unlock the bathroom.

Older lady that works the drive thru was extremely rude. Gave me the wrong drink I asked for sweet tea and got Dr pepper. Asked for honey she rolled her eyes and said oh my god. It wasn’t busy so not sure what her issue was. Staff needs to be retrained

Either my taste buds have changed or the food is nowhere as good as it used to be. The customer service was terrible. We ordered combo meals and because they ran out of the cups that come with the combo meals and failed to order the proper size cups, they wanted to change me an extra .99 cents for a larger size. Because of the strong accent and fast talking I almost didn’t catch it. “So let me get this straight,” I asked, “because YOU ran out of the small cups that come with the combo meals, you want to charge ME extra for a large drink? No, that’s not how it works.” Needless to say, I didn’t pay extra for their problem.

Service was excellent and the food was fresh. The fries, however, were awful-- I wish I would have taken a photo. Some were soggy, some were burnt, and there was a piece of something else in there that didn't belong (pretty sure it was fried okra). It was like someone just scraped the last of everything from the warmer pan instead of making a fresh batch.
Ordered a 5 pc spicy tender meal with a coke. They gave me 4 regular tenders and dr pepper. Grade A service right there. Wrong food and drink and I got shorted.

Unfortunately my sandwich was cold. I know I could have taken it back, but I chose not to. The fries were at least warm, but not hot. We visited around 11:00 am so it should have been fresh. The cashier was very friendly and the manager came out to check on the patrons... which was very nice. Everything was nice and clean as well.  I've eaten hear before and didn't have a problem with the food being cold. Overall, I would go back.

Super unfortunate trip. I walked in and told the gala behind the counter i had a mobile to go order. She let me know it wasn't done yet. I sat there for about 10 minutes as she put together different orders and sent them out with doordashers and when I reminded her I had an order. She pulled it off of the top of the heating unit not from underneath. It had been sitting there for 10 minutes. The poor guy that held the door for me to come in had to wait 10 minutes just to even be able to order. Not a good performance. Worst part about it was they weren't even busy. There was nobody in the lobby and only a few people in the Drive-Thru. They just prioritized doordash orders over in-store patrons.

Went through the drive through 2 times within a 2 week period and both times, the orders were messed up. We had to go around a 2nd time both times. And the 2nd time, they still screwed up but we were leaving town so we just took what we had and called it a loss.
Food is always good at Arby's, and that deal 2 for 5 Arby-Q ain't nothin to scoff at. Just feels lacking of good vibes, but it's a modern fast food place, which is to be expected these days.

Do not come here!!! I swear they are serving rancid out of date meat. I have a very good palate and can usually taste food going bad days before it is going bad or the expiration date. The last 2 or 3 times I've ordered from here the meat has had that awful sweet flavor that is a sure sign that you have cooked rancid meat! It won't be long before we hear about cases of food poisoning at this location I'm sure so protect yourself and your loved ones go elsewhere!

We had a wonderful breakfast at Cracker Barrel! I tried the southern fried chicken, and it was absolutely fantastic. It was delicious, and the portions were so generous that I managed to get three meals out of it. My wife, who loves breakfast, had the French toast, and she absolutely loved it.

The facility was in the new Cracker Barrel style, which was warm and welcoming. The staff were friendly, efficient, and helpful.

It’s easy to get in and out from I-70. I’m hoping they’ll open on the southwest side of Denver, as it’s a bit of a drive for us to get some great southern food!

I highly recommend stopping by if you’re driving through Denver on I-70 or if you live in the airport area.

National chain for travelers and locals. The breakfast options aren't particularly fancy, but they are good and reliable. The Old Timers breakfast is two eggs, sausage or bacon, biscuits with gravy and a side. I particularly like the hash brown casserole for a side. The onions and cheese elevate it above ordinary hash browns.The gravy with the biscuits comes on the side so you can use it or not. Overall, a nice breakfast at a reasonable price.

Service was fast, friendly and unobtrusive. The space is typical Cracker Barrel. The dining area is large with a lot of country decor and a large fireplace. They do have the store side with old time candies and other things. For some reason, this one had a large Halloween display in June. They have a ton of rockers on the porch. There is unsecured Wi-Fi available.

The parking lot is very large.
As always amazing breakfast, good pancakes and my favorite side of apples and bacon. Great selection of items in the shop as well. They kept the original logo and the same decor, happy with that

The food was good. I had the chicken dippers.

The service was okay.

The seating area is pretty small, the tables were really close together. The person sitting behind kept hitting my chair with their chair nearly continuously throughout my visit.

So I read the reviews complaining about long waits, terrible service and mid food so decided to wait a month and go on a weekday lunch.   Happy to say there was no line, happy to say the food was good, but sad to say damn the service was pretty bad. And the place was not even busy so had nothing to do with that. The waitress (I wanted so badly to say their name but I'll pass for now) had nooooo urgency.  You could just tell her in walk no rush to get to customers. It took over 20 minutes from food being finished to get a bill and we had to ask a manager for it  because she was taking so long.  However, most of the food DID came out good. The corn muffins were hard as bricks, but everything else great. Everyone in the shopping area was super nice, but I'd recommend they move those people over to dining and help the waitresses who may be struggling. Also like the $6 to go meals

I’ve visited Denver 3 times this year and luckily I found this place the 1st time and have returned every time thereafter.  I’ve only tried the Pabellon, and keep getting it each time. The combo of flavorful meat and sweet plantain is perfect.  The bread has a crusty edge and their sauce is perfect.  Best Arepa I’ve ever had.

I had a difficult time with the locations, the cashier was extremely kind explaining the situation to me, helping me solve the issue. I am so happy with the service and generosity from this place. 10/10 recommended.
I chose this place because it has vegan options. It was delicious!
The arepas take a while to be prepared but they are delicious. The arepa itself is crispy but also a bit soft, and the sweet plantains are to die for. The passion fruit juice is also great.

The arepas from here are not authentic at all. An Americanized version that is over packed with avocados and cheese that over power any meat you get. Bread was dry and salmon did not taste good. The service was ok. Wouldn’t eat here again, plenty of other choices in the food court

Tried over 20 times, both locations. Solid sandwich, we always get pabellon which is shredded beef with fried plantain, not gonna lie that this is the best arepa we have had. Lowkey i believe this branch is better than the boulder one

I would like to thank 2 of your employees who work on 84th and Grant st. jB and Ineda for there excellent customer service  and professionalism! I have not eaten at Arby's in many years, I decided to stop there one day, JB made my sandwich exactly how I wanted it, not only that the sandwich was not all sloppy like i had remembered, he made my sandwich just like the commercials! I was very happy and told many of my friends and family about the well made sandwich and I have returned many times in the last few months. Ineda also has a wonderful attitude with all the customers! I will continue to eat there as long as  your employees continue such wonderful service and food! Mary Rose

Food tasted great and was fresh. Even better than that was the service at the Counter. Big shout out to Marlon. Great example of how you treat each customer! Made my day with the courtesy and speed of service! I will be back to eat again, especially if Marlon is at the register.

The fries were super fries tasted stale and hard to eat a ton of Grease pouring out of the jalapeno poppers don't get me started on the roast beef and cheddar sandwich the meat was super dry was hard around the ends and rubbery hard to chew I even smothered it in Arby's sauce always eat here and never had this issue will never eat here again order as you dip and didn't even get it after paying extra really not worth I bought a whole meal and didn't even eat hardly any of it took probably two bites out of everything what a waste of money

I asked the girl for fresh curly fries and this is what they gave me after saying they just dropped some in the fryer.(see picture below)please fill up the fries. Please don’t just scrape the bottom of the bin and refry them when asked for fresh there’s a reason I asked for fresh because this has been what I’ve received last few times going here. The cheese sticks were still frozen in the center . Also the sandwiches were skimp as hell I’m assuming because they were the 2 for six special. Look if you don’t want to serve product as it should be served then just close up shop. It’s not right you’re doing this while charging a premium price.  I spoke with Aaron the night manager and he said he’d have it made right tomorrow but the thing is I’m hungry tonight after working 14 hrs today. Instead of making it up to us after failing how bout you up your standard all the time and you won’t be needing to replace food. Sub par standards for food equate big losses for the business constantly. I’m sorry I get off work late but it’s no reason to be dishing out your trash as food 1/2 hour before closing.
Food was ok person at the window was nice but the food smelled like cigarettes. I couldn’t even finish eating it because it smelled so bad. Wont go back to this one again.

I really enjoy Chubby"s! The food is delicious and the staff are so friendly. I really recommend this restaurant. The drive thru is very convenient and dining inside is very enjoyable! I see why this business has been so successful for 35 years!!!

The food was too delicious! We had a group of 4 and a variety of dishes including a vegetarian dish.

Everything from the presentation, quality and quantity of food was wonderful! Be prepared to get a to go box!

We forgot to take pics of the food . It was just that good!!!

You will not be disappointed!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5

El Chubbies Mexican Restaurant is an absolute gem! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm smiles and genuine hospitality. The managers and staff go above and beyond to make every guest feel welcomed and taken care of — you can truly tell they love what they do.

And the margaritas… wow. They’re easily some of the best around — perfectly balanced, refreshingly smooth, and a great happy hour deal.
The atmosphere is vibrant, the service is outstanding, and the entire team makes every visit feel like a celebration. If you’re looking for great food, great drinks, and even better people, El Chubbies is the place to be! Highly recommend.

We stopped in here for lunch. I've been wanting to try it for a while based on word of mouth. It was pretty packed, which is a good sign. We got in and ordered. It took a bit of a wait so don't come hangry. I was cool to get my marg early and sip on it til our food was up. The food was pretty good for an affordable price. It was a lively vibrant atmosphere and I'm glad we gave it a try.

El Chubby's delivers delicious, fresh Mexican food with a vibrant, authentic taste that keeps customers coming back for years. The friendly staff is attentive and quick to help, even with special requests, making the entire experience a pleasure. For a satisfying meal, try their perfectly prepared dishes and don't miss their famous green chili. Happy hour margaritas are worth the trip every day of the week!

A truly unique and welcoming atmosphere! The women behind the counter were incredibly friendly and greeted everyone by name, creating such a warm neighborhood feel. They treat every guest with kindness, love, and respect, which makes this place stand out.

Today, I ordered a veggie quiche and a black coffee. The coffee had a perfect mild flavor—exactly what I needed to start my morning. The quiche was tasty as well, though I think a touch more seasoning could make it even better.

Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my visit. This is the perfect neighborhood spot for coffee, tea, and a sense of community. I look forward to coming back. 💜
The breakfast burritos are very good. Great cold brew. Very mom n pop local coffee shop vibe. Outdoor seating where you can bring your dog.

I've worked across the street for almost 8 years now, and this is my favorite hidden gem. This morning I ventured in on a pre-work whim, in need of caffeine and utterly clueless. The gentle and kind soul at the register effortlessly guided me to the perfect drink. If you're also in search of a gently caffeinated, expertly curated experience, may I recommend their Colorado latte. Replete with warm spices, markedly less sweet but more toasty than a chai, this drink will cure all that ails you and somehow payoff any karmic debt. The honey and cardamom give gentle sweetness, while the cinnamon and turmeric kick in with the perfect balance of spice to espresso to carefully steamed milk. Bringing your own vessel of choice can yield a small discount, but I believe in the small things adding up, and helping our environment.

The store is a wonder to explore, with various mugs, coffee and tea necessities, gifts and cards, spices and treats, and a vast selection of tea and coffee.

Amazing crew, always super happy to help, but as someone who has come here quite a few times it is disappointing to see what the staff have to deal with. There have been multiple times I have heard or even seen management yell at employees over minor issues. The only time the employees look comfortable is when the management/owner is out. I have also heard about tight restrictions they have regarding syrups and food that often hinders its quality. The crew turnover is insane as well, every-time I come in there are new staff members. I would not recommend supporting this business until they fix some serious issues.

It's a nice place with friendly staff and interesting selection. My only complaint would be that I ordered an iced Dragon Phoenix pearl and the taste was so faint that was it not for a very light floral taste at the beginning I could swear just drinking water. It was incredibly disappointing as I was looking forward to something with a flavor profile. I would be willing to try again since no one gets it right all the time and the staff was nice but it was pretty disappointing.

name: Jasmine Market
vicinity: 1050 S Wadsworth Blvd Unit K, Lakewood

reviews.text: I love coming here. The quality of the meat by itself is enough for you to make this your first stop and they also have an incredible selection groceries and pantry staples at reasonable prices.
We find everything we need from a Mediterranean market. Halal fresh meats, diverse friendly staff, clean place. I do recommend.
Great Arabic store with a wide variety of halal food. The prices are cheaper than others, and the staff is very friendly. Highly recommended!

This is by far the best Mediterranean grocery store in Denver. They have supreme quality meat, poultry and frozen foods. They carry a wide variety of middle eastern, Indian, Pakistani spices and grains sourced from quality vendors. The store is very clean and odor free. The owners are true gentlemen supported by a charming and friendly  meat processing  person in the back. I am originally from south Asia, and I greatly endorse this place. You will not regret coming and buying from here.

Fresh lamb Friday! Say it with me, FRESH LAMB FRIDAY!
This place is great! Small, locally owned great prices!
I ask for lamb shank, the owner grabbed the legs out of the cold case and cut them with the bandsaw out back! So awesome!
My Sunday dinner is complete.

Service was fantastic the cashier was friendly, personable and gave great recommendations. Most of us got the spanoli plate but with different insides. Canolis here are not what you're thinking if you're thinking dessert... nope, think italian sausage or meatballs inside fresh baked bread and topped with cheese and sauce! The spanoli plate also come with a side of spaghetti. Upcharge ($2.25)for old fashioned noodles. I think I preferred the old fashioned noodle but not necessarily enough to order them again. They have a steady stream of customers and plenty of regulars which is always a good sign. The canoli is the star of the show although I saw quite a few tables with the square pizza as well. The spaghetti was pretty basic so I'd skip that next time and just save room for more canoli!

This place is great. Good italian food for good prices. This is a busy area and the big plus is that they have a parking lot that makes it more convenient. The restaurant is clean and well decorated. I had a togo order and the service was great. They have great deals on the spaghetti buckets. 4 to 6 serving sizes that come with bread and salad. Both the sausage and meatballs tasted great, I also had a super sausage canoli, highly recommended item.

Lechuga’s Italian Restaurant is truly one of my favorite North Denver staples. Their sausage cannolis are always the highlight of my visit, the mild cannolis have that perfect classic, savory flavor, while the spicy ones bring just the right amount of heat without being overwhelming. Both are consistently delicious and made with so much care.

The staff is always incredibly sweet, welcoming, and attentive, and their customer service is genuinely some of the best. The location is great and easy to get in and out of, which makes the whole experience even better.

Overall, Lechuga’s continues to be a go-to spot for amazing food, friendly service, and a consistently great atmosphere.
Last reasonably priced place left in Denver? Great taste. Perfect portions.

Lechuga’s Italian Restaurant is an absolute gem! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with the warm, cozy atmosphere of a true neighborhood favorite. But the real star of the show? Their spicy spaghetti. Hands down, one of the best pasta dishes I’ve ever had.

The noodles are perfectly cooked, and the sauce has just the right amount of heat—bold, flavorful, and addictive without being overwhelming. You can taste the care in every bite, from the fresh garlic and herbs to the spicy kick that lingers just long enough to make you want more. Pair it with one of their legendary pepperonis or a warm loaf of garlic bread, and you're in heaven.

The staff is friendly, the service is fast, and the portions are generous. Whether you're a local or just passing through, Lechuga’s is a must-visit. Don’t miss the spicy spaghetti—you’ll be hooked from the first bite!

When I heard “vegan Caribbean,” I’ll admit I expected the restaurant to be Black owned. As an African American visiting Denver, I was really hoping to support a Black owned business if I could find one, so this threw me off a bit at first.
That said, I still gave it a try. The portion sizes were impressive, and the staff was genuinely friendly and welcoming. My partner actually enjoyed their meal quite a bit. I personally wasn’t too crazy about the food overall, though I wish I could remember the specific dishes I ordered so I could give a more detailed breakdown of the pros and cons.
The space itself is large and lively, great for accommodating big parties. I was staying on Market Street, and the walk over wasn’t bad at all, so it’s convenient on a nice day if you’re nearby.

Delicious food and drinks! We loved everything we ate and drank. The doubles were definitely the highlight- we want to eat those every day! The service was great and it’s such a cool open atmosphere. Definitely will be back! Their happy hour is also such a great deal!

Absolutely the BEST restaurant I've found in YEARS! And although I'm not vegan this did not hinder loving the restaurant's all vegan menu! Truly amazing flavors, unique dishes, and it made us return twice in a 4 day trip to Denver! I can't recommend it enough! Staff is wonderful and the owner Kevin, is incredibly kind and friendly! I recommend this restaurant 1000000%!

I had the Bridgeton Brunch and a side of Callaloo and I’m not kidding when I say this is the best meal I’ve had in recent memory. The staff was friendly, attentive, and informative. The owner was present, engaged, and welcoming. The space is cozy, bright, and softened by live plants and a lovely trickling fountain. Great music, lovely ambience, attentive staff, and again I can’t stress this enough—the FOOD is incredible and very reasonably priced. 15/5 stars, I would highly recommend, and I will most definitely be back!

I stumbled on this place while searching for some good vegan places to visit while my friends and I were in town visiting. We absolutely LOVED it! The vibe, service, and food were top tier! We decided to all get a different dish and share between us and I’m so glad we did - Highly recommend you do the same if going with a group (or if you’re going alone and just have a big appetite…No shame! Do you!). The whole vibe of the restaurant was great, I loved the uniqueness of it, especially the bathrooms. Everything is upcycled which makes the place even more special. I will definitely go back if I ever find myself in Denver again!

The best pupusas I’ve ever had. We tried the mixed pupusas, chicharrón, and cheese with loroco—all incredibly tasty. The curtido was fresh and delicious as well.

The chicken tamal was very good, and the sweet corn tamales were absolutely delicious (similar to what we call ayacos dulces in Colombia). The coffee with milk was excellent, served in beautiful, handcrafted cups.

The place is well-decorated, very clean, with no strong odors, and the service was great. Highly recommended. ¡Volveremos!

Excellent flavorful food… we came to try this restaurant first time .. and we were surprised amazingly with the taste and flavor of food .

If you are looking for trying something fresh and new food , We recommend it 100%.
Very cute pupusa shop with a wide variety of flavors. The curtido was very fresh and the pupusas nicely grilled. Great flavor on salsa roja also.

I was driving by and decided to stop in for lunch. The food was all delicious everything was fresh and hot. I went with the pupusas revuelta rice beans on the side and a large agua fresca ensalada to drink. A must try is the chicken enchiladas so good add the green sauce for spice or red for mild flavor. I love food from El Salvador must say one of the better ones I have had since moving to Colorado. Check this place out.
The best pupusas I've had in all of Colorado. Fast & polite service! 👌🏽

Came here while I was visiting Colorado for a weekend training. I looked at the reviews and decided to come and boy was I in for a treat. The location is good because it has other food options within the establishment. So if your family wants something different, which they shouldn't, but if they do... it's available. The food was divine and so fresh. The injera was so tasty and the perfect amount of tartness that I like. I literally ate everything she put for me on the plate. It was shareable, but I was alone and so hungry from traveling. The last thing I wanna say besides thank you to the owner is if you are thinking of coming ... I definitely recommend. Definitely get the orange tea too. I've been dreaming about it since I left!! I really need the recipe 😩

Absolutely excellent Ethiopian food and injera made with 100% teff flour which isn’t as common anymore (and more difficult to work with). The woman who owns the store is very sweet and brings the food out to you.
Atmosphere-wise seating is within the food hall but I had no issues finding a seat. The chai was also delicious, highly recommend!

Natoli is wonderful. The owner, Ameena, is incredibly kind and helpful. She really elevated the experience with a passion for her country's cuisine and offering up explanations on menu items and even letting us sample the Special Orange Tea. She prepares the injera bread fresh daily and it is very good. We tried the Veggie Combo and Awaze Tibs, all of which is tasty with plenty of variety and quantity. The spice heat level can also be customized. The restaurant is located in the Mango House, a cultural activity center. There are shops and other food vendors with a centralized seating area. It's a very authentic experience and I highly recommend giving this place a try.

The food is excellent. I had the combo plate since I hadn't eaten anything all day, and it didn't disappoint. The spiced tea was some of the best I've ever had! I also got some orange tea to go, and it was very tasty. The lady that runs the place is very hospitable. She works hard to make sure you have a great experience, answers questions with patience, and I can tell she has a passion for what she does.

I give the atmosphere 5 stars because even though it is a food court and isn't all that fancy, it makes up for it with it's sense of community. I'm impressed with what people are building there.

Absolutely wonderful experience. First of all Mango House is a gem. We love coming here and this is the first time to try Natoli, and we will absolutely be back!

The food is delicious and Amina, the owner clearly takes pride in her food and makes it with love. We were unfamiliar with Ethiopian food and she helped us choose two very tasty dishes (the veggie combo and door wot).

Highly recommend, both for the food and the experience. I came there with my three daughters, and two of them enjoyed the sushi restaurant while myself and my other daughter had Natoli. That convenience to choose from multiple restaurants was wonderful too.

Can’t recommend highly enough!

This place had good ratings so we decided to try it. And it did NOT disappoint. The service was very kind and attentive. And the food was excellent. This is probably one of the best tasting Ethiopian restaurants I have ever been to. Thank you for the great experience and I will come again! ❤️

The food is SO good here!!! Do not be fooled because it may not look super fancy. The food is amazing. And the cook is so lovely and friendly. She explained everything about the food and gave us helpful suggestions. The injera was super delicious. We got the vegetarian combo and the lamb stew. I think this is my favorite lanb stew I have ever had 😍
The vegetarian combo is also completely vegan and gluten free so that's amazing.
We also got the honey wine. It was really flavorful! We also had the beef sambusa as an appetizer. It came with salad (beware of the serrano pepper! 🌶️  its spicy haha) The menu is pretty affordable for such high quality food! Would highly recommend.🌞

The only non "5" star thing was the atmosphere and I actually loved it... It is just nothing fancy.  It is very plain but comfortable.   The food was amazing. We had someone in our group who lived in Ethiopia and other parts of Africa for a while and he said it felt very authentic.   The servers are very nice and helpful.  Plan on being there for a little longer than you might think,  which is good, because they make everything to order.  The tea service was delicious!!!  Go check this place out and when you pull up, don't judge a book by its cover!  😀

Service was great. Veggie combo was great.  Dry lamb was tough and chewy. Lamb stew was bland. Ordered cabbage and potatoes to go. Got home and potatoes were nearly raw in the middle.  Ethiopian coffee was sublime. Nice idea, but there are better consistent restaurants.

Food is fairly consistent and delicious! Service is probably some of the best you’ll experience at any of the Ethiopian restaurants. The only issues I find is that prices stay the same, or even go up, portions seem to get smaller, or things will disappear from a plate you’ve ordered multiple times before and the next time you come in you’re having to ask for it, or it’s just not provided. I really enjoy this place I hope it sticks around.

A comfortable and clean interior immediately makes you feel welcomed and draws you in. The food is authentic, delicious, and made to order. I had the Breakfast Combo with a side of beans (fuol) and an Ethiopian coffee. Truly a delightful woman owned business.

Food was absolutely delicious! The women working are extremely nice and pleasant. Feels like your grandmother is serving you. I wanted to clean the table and wash the dishes afterwards they were so pleasant.

The place feels cozy. It's small somewhat intimate. The only drawback is Colfax. Iykyk. I'll definitely go back next time I'm in Denver.

We had a delicious vegetarian meal here. The food was extraordinary. The service was friendly and kind. The coffee was out of this world. I highly recommend this restaurant and I was very, very satisfied.

Had such a great time here with my friend the cafe has a really cozy vibe, the staff were super friendly and everything came out quickly we tried the breakfast combo/enkulal firfir with the traditional coffee, and it was delicious definitely a spot I’d come back to☺️

My husband and I stopped here after picking up items from an auction - cold and snowy day.  The atmosphere was so cozy and welcoming!  Our first experience with Ethiopian food - and it was wonderful!  The coffee service was so unique, and the food was incredible - we also learned about the culture from the owners, so when we left we felt we had truly had an immersive experience!  I loved the Ethiopian Frankincense - and the owner gave me a small amount along with the charcoal to bring to my daughters to experience.  We had the vegetarian combo and the Quanta FirFir (I sauteed the leftover Quanta FirFir in butter the next morning with a fried egg on top and it was still amazing).  I would come back here in a minute.  Just wish it were closer!

name: Konjo Ethiopian Food
vicinity: INSIDE of The Denver Milk Market, 1800 Wazee St Suite131, Denver

reviews.text: The breakfast burrito is so gooood! Highly recommend going Saturday or Sunday during the time they serve brunch. Well worth it! The hot sauce they serve with the burrito is rich and spicy. One of the best breakfast burritos I’ve ever had. Sambusas were also fire!

The food was wonderful. I'm vegan and GF and also in love with Ethiopian food.
My friend tried it for the first time and he loved it.
Great value for your money and your stomach.

Konjo’s new location at the Denver Milk Market is everything! The food, the energy, the service — all of it was exceptional. I had the Lamb Rice Bowl with Gomen w/ Dinich, and my husband had the Lamb Plate with Gomen w/ Dinich — both were absolutely delicious. The lamb was tender and full of flavor, and the sides were fresh and perfectly prepared. Every bite tasted like it was made with love and intention. The service was warm and attentive, and the overall vibe was inviting and rooted in authenticity. You can tell they care deeply about the experience and the food they’re serving.
We’re so happy to see Konjo thriving in this new space — and without question, we’ll be back.

1000/10!
Amazing food!! I had never tried Ethiopian food before and I was not disappointed!
I got the rice bowl with chicken and tikel gomen. Perfect amount of spicy and soo delicious! The owner was also very kind and courteous with all the questions I had. Food was fresh and served to me literally in 5 mins. Definitely a must in Denver!!

My visit to Konjo was amazing!! The staff were so warm and welcoming and the food was incredible!! I ordered a lot because I wanted to try as much as I could. The rice bowl with beef and gomen was delicious!! I had a sambusa as well and it was the perfect texture and so flavorful!! I’ll be taking my friends and family back soon! It’s so close to everything downtown!
Website says they close at 7:30 pm but it’s 2:00 pm and they closed
Food was delicious. The owner and his family were extremely nice!
The food is so delicious I like
Her food is really good I really enjoyed it I can’t for next time.
If you live in Denver Colorado and you don’t have time to cook or even don’t like it, and you want a homemade Congolese meal, Chavie got any time.
Love the food and it looks so good, she knows how to cook
She can cook really good

name: KoBa • All You Can Eat Korean BBQ

reviews.text: Just had an amazing lunch at KoBa. The lunch combos are fresh and flavorful. I got the ox bone soup, it had a hearty, full bodied taste. I love their banchan, especially their kimchi. Perfectly balance between sweet, salty and spicy. Definitely need to come back and try out their all you can eat option. Highly recommended!

Well nothing to say. Food was not good at all. With other option available in denver area for bbq this wont be my restaurant. Price was ok but food cooking time and the taste of bbq was not there. Not sure how other reviewer find it amazing food. May be paid promotions haha🤪 idk. But for me food was good at all and other thing I heard is that they changed the menu 4/5 times within one year which made me believe that the other foody had similar kind of experience. Food will be cooked within. I wont be back at all at this restaurant.

Dinner was good, however you can only have the "all you can eat" option for dinner, which was $38 per person. The "all you can eat" also had restrictions on some of the meat options. I would have liked other options for dinner. The hostess was busy doing other things and made us wait a while to get seated,  it was not busy at all either. Very attractive and trendy on the inside. Parking and main entrance are on the south side of the building.

They finally have a la carte lunch options. I've only had all you can eat dinner at this place. Good to see that they have more options and available hours. I just don't feel like eating until I burst everytime I come here.

They have some easy soup options, I really like the new Koba soup. Be warned, they're really good but really hot. They come out in these black cauldron looking bowls. I had a hard time slowing down eating without burning myself but totally worth it. I might come here for lunch more than dinner now.

I like trying different Korean BBQ places and this one was unique. There meat was marinated really well and was very flavorful. They have a small soup option that was like having a small hot pot with my meal, Instead of getting a big pot and the entire table didn't have to order it. I had a great experience. Worth going to again.

name: Babe's Tea Room
vicinity: Entrance on, 2401 15th Street, Platte St #170, Denver

reviews.text: As a tea connoisseur, I LOVED my experience at Babe's Tea Room! We were able to try 7 or 8 teas in our allotted time and they were all delicious (I wish I kept track of my favorites but I remember one being referred to as the "Champagne of tea," that was my top). The food was excellent! Loved the finger sandwiches and enjoyed the sweets at home since I was too full to finish them at the restaurant. I can't wait to visit again!

Very cute place with great vibes and a big tea selection. However, the food options are pretty limited. The service was disappointing — when I asked for recommendations, the server wasn’t able to offer any. Ordered BEA sandwich, it was dry.
Nice spot for a quick tea stop, but the lack of helpful service was a turnoff.

A cute place to enjoy tea and delicious goodies! The staff were friendly and knowledgeable.

My friends and I went for an afternoon tea and were overwhelmed by the various tea options on the menu-- it all looked good! My friends and I chose the ballerina white tea, strawberry tea, and blueberry tea. The teas were delicious but out of the 3, the strawberry tea was our personal favorite.

We also got to enjoy various desserts and tea sandwiches and they were delicious!

Overall, the experience itself was amazing and would definitely comeback for a get together with friends or just for the heck of it!

Us ladies made a reservation for tea time. The package was priced per person, and included a tower of tea time treats and whatever tea you would like. They were very accommodating to my dairy allergy, making a separate tower just for me💕. Each tower had sandwiches and savory tarts on the bottom 2 tiers, scones and biscuits on the third and desserts on top. We all loved this experience so much!!!

First class all the way. The restaurant is quaint, simply decorated but modern and with a fresh feel. Everything was professionally displayed - you know you eat with your eyes first. Finger sandwiches, macarons, 2 different scones and petite fours were all perfect. I’d come back for that turkey with garlic aioli all by itself. And of course I have to mention the teas - they have a wide selection from white to oolong to black plus a few blends. You can try as many as you wish. I think we tried 7 different ones. I purchased the jasmine pouchong green tea to take home. Went with my two adult daughters. We had the best time eating and sipping. Kiki was our server - prompt, polite, knowledgeable plus a great sense of humor. We will be back.
We had a wonderful New Year’s Eve dinner! Steak frites and mussels were both delicious. The cocktails were strong and very tasty. We will definitely be back!

My husband ordered the muscles, he said they were very good. I ordered the  Crepe Jabon Fromage. Not impressed. The Crepe itself   was tasteless, the edges were like a cracker. No ham on my Crepe. I do not like chicken, so I believe there was a mix up. What little I ate landed hard in my stomach, couldn't eat after that. My husband did order desert, it was refrigerated, he said in the past he had eaten it, but was served at room temperature this was why the filling was waxy and the outer part was again without taste. I love eclairs the shell was like one, but this was topped with powdered sugar and almond slivers. Can't remember the name. All and all, nothing I ate was special or outstanding.

The onion soup was exquisite  lots of cheese and a hint of tanginess, just like the original.
The salmon crepe was also delicious.
I’d just suggest improving the coffee.

Came for dinner on a Thursday night and the service, food, drinks and ambiance were just perfect. I hope the new pastry chef sticks around because the desserts were insane. Take your time here and really enjoy the food!
Been coming here for years. Love their crepes. I’ve tried them all. The charcuterie board is nice. Cocktails are yummy. Brunch is my favorite time to come since they have a nice patio furniture.

Wonderful place with a LARGE assortment of pastries, sweets and other baked goods. No way I’ve sampled even a tenth of what they offer - my belly would be far larger and my cardiologist much richer - but so far everything has been fantastic. Great folks working behind the counters, very attentive and move the line along quickly. A few tables inside and 6-7 outside under the overhang. Don’t miss this place!

I fully intended to only get one item for breakfast, but I'm so glad I got other things! All of them were good, but the cheese and spinach croissant and almond pastry were shockingly delicious! I also really enjoyed the pumpkin muffin, which was filled, not just dolloped, with cream cheese. The Florentine cookie was too big and crunchy for me but lovely flavor and a lot of almonds.

This place is a hidden Gem!

The bakery is top teir and finding out that it supports it's community is such a blessing.

The bred is amazing! Pastries and baked goods are incredible! And the coffee is perfect!

Don't waste your time wondering is you should come in or not... just come and enjoy the confectionery.
Amazing! Highly recommend! Like taking a trip back to Europe to grab some pastries... absolutely the best in Colorado!!
One of my favorite bakeries and my favorite place to get banana bread! My only feedback would be no sugar Crystals on the banana bread, it’s already very sweet 🙂!

Food, Service, Drinks, Vibes, Cleanliness doesnt matter.

This bar is 100% the real deal. Not performative at all. Me and my friends from NC stumbled upon this joint and was blown away by the demonstration of every day communism.

The staff aren't just employees, they are residents of Denver who care about the misfits.

The level of care and compassion from the bar staff to the back kitchen truly made a memorial night for us and gave us a safe place in a very dark time.

But not just we were taken care of, over the course of several hours we witnessed the staff offering compassionate service to everyone who happened upon their establishment that night.

If you need a refuge. The Crypt is the place to go.

What a cool place! My friend and I went here for the first time last night and had an absolute blast. The aesthetic is right up our alley and the food here is great (extra love for the poutine and beet salad). We also loved that they let you round up when paying so that the money goes to the Palestine Children's Relief Fund. We're from Fort Collins, but will definitely be hitting this place up again the next time we're in town!

By far the BEST alt/metal pub we have visited while travelling. Excellent decor, lots of tables, food is excellent and reasonably priced, and you're allowed to smoke on the patio -- which is a rarity. We would've loved to have the opportunity to see a local show here, but were not staying in Denver much longer.

Also, PEEP the drink garnish (photo). It is hilarious!
Trevor is a highlight to an amazing spot. The decor, drinks, vibe, menu, music, pinball ,conversation, all the things. This is a dope spot to visit

I’ve been here when DJ Daddy was DJing and really didn’t enjoy it unfortunately, just not my jam. It’s all 80s music with no mixing involved. We went there the other night to see DJ $6,000,000 and DJ Daddy took over the set it was such a buzz kill and the dance floor totally cleared. Someone told me she’s part owner so I get that she DJs some nights but would be nice to know that the DJ advertised is the person DJing that night. Besides that the Crypt is awesome. The food is good.

I wouldn't really classify this as a market because it's super limited and I'm questioning the freshness of the refrigerated items since I brought a container of yogurt and it was literally rancid when I got home. However the Denver Halal restaurant is inside and if you're looking for a no frills spot to grab affordable gyros and chicken shawarma this is your spot. They will also sell you their meats on the spits by the pound. We grabbed gyros at $20/lb and they pile in in a container for a quick to go order. Let's be clear this place is NOT fancy, you don't come for ambiance and you don't come for grocery items but their meats and sandwiches hit so I'll keep coming back.

I ordered chicken shawarma from this restaurant today and took it home with me. The chicken ear was not cooked properly. My son felt sick and we couldn't eat it. I would like more attention from the restaurant management on this issue.

I genuinely love this place as an Iraqi girl. I have to always beg my dad to bring me food from here I remember when the bowls used to be 8$ now it's around 10-13$ but it's worth the money. rice fries salad chicken, lamp strips and it might sound not the best but I've never loved any food more. Honestly for 11-13$ it's the most affordable food that taste good and actually gets you full. When you go inside it's not loud at all everyone respects each other pretty quiet actually. Sometimes when it's busy people park behind your car and I've never even seen people make a scene I've just seen someone come inside kindly ask for the owner of the car behind his to just move it and take his spot. And even actually paid him for the inconvenience. The service isn't to bad sometimes usually it's good though. I loveeee it hereeee

Food, MasAllah!!!! Fresh,fresh, fresh!! Quick, fresh👌👌👌
You cant make mistake in any items you order.

On your way out, dont forget to buy their awesome bread, MasAllah👏🙏

This food is top tier. The ambience of the place is mostly a small store, so would take it to go because not a lot of seating. Overall though, highly recommend to eat the combo plate with the chicken and lamb shawarma. Too good to pass up, it’s a hidden gem for sure.

The food was absolutely delicious. I've been trying to find a good middle eastern-Mediterranean cuisine, and this is hands down the place. The meats, hummus, all the food is super fresh. 10/10 would recommend!!! Rokayah the lovely lady that helped us was very sweet and provided us with excellent service!
* We also got 2 cakes, (pistachio & coconut) which they make in-House.

Yemen Grill & Cafe deserves every one of these stars. The service was on point and had that “welcome home” vibe you don’t get often. The team treated us like family from the moment we walked in. We ordered the chicken mandy and the lamb kebab and both were insane… tender, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. If you’re in Denver and want real hospitality with even better food, this is the spot. Will definitely be back.

Fantastic and very friendly service. Food portions are generous. Drinks are delicious!! Cardamom drink is sooo good. Both the hummus and the lentil soup won't disappoint. Lamb is tender. Salad and dressing have wonderful flavor.  What a wonderful find.

Friendly service, expansive food and drink options, very happy to have finally tried Yemen Grill. The grape leaves and tabbouleh were fantastic and very fresh. Standard shawarma plate is big enough for 2 to split and the Oqda Lamb is packed with sautéed veggies, almost like a Mediterranean fajita plate. Will be back!

My bestie and I went to Yemen Grill for a Wednesday dinner and it did not disappoint. We had driven by it many times and said that we need to go there, and when we finally did it was great! We split a few dishes and it was plenty for the two of us. It seemed like a real family restaurant with delicious food and very reasonable prices. We will definitely be back.

Edit: Found a hair in the watery, white sauce. The hummus tastes super weird like it has cheese in it almost. Definitely missing salt and lemon and seems like it is made with an oil that is not olive oil.

I came here after seeing great reviews. I got gyro and chicken shawarma plates. The chicken shawarma is pink, almost like tandoori chicken that completely lacks flavor. The gyro is burnt and very salty. The plate is predominately rice which tastes how I imagine creek water would with two watery, flavorless sauces, soggy cucumber salad, and a little meat. All of this for $18 per plate… The restaurant -if you can call it that - seems to be fashioned out of the storeroom of the adjoining corner store/vape shop. The premises are very dirty. The power outlets lack proper covers, tiles falling off the walls, etc. I don’t know how this place has such good ratings.

From the looks of the inside it did not seem very clean and was off-putting. Seems really in need of cleaning and repairs. The food was not great. I’m normally a big fan of Mediterranean. I think they may have some potential to improve but I wouldn’t go back again based on this experience.

Hayati Mediterranean Grill goes crazy. Hole in the wall joint serving it up proper. The gyros slap hard and you’re not finding a better bang for your buck anywhere. Shawarma plates? Premo every time. This spot just hits.

Just might be the best value in Denver. Gyro with a good amount of meat for 8 bucks. Not to mention it tastes better than most gyros double its price from places like Byblos and Zaman.

Not the greatest to sit inside, I’d rec takeout and go eating it at fuller park.

This place caught my attention because of decent reviews, but the food quality is super low. I ordered a gyro plate and got a little bit of meat and mostly rice.

Falafel is overly salty and not pleasant to eat.

Avoid at all costs.

I am so impressed with Yemeni Grill! We ordered the chicken shawarma wrap, shish tawook with rice, lamb haneeth, grape leaves, and a jug of mango juice, everything was absolutely delicious. All the meats were incredibly tender and full of flavor, and the food came out fresh and perfectly seasoned.

The stuffed grape leaves were honestly the best I’ve ever had in a restaurant. Truly outstanding!

The service is just as amazing as the food. Aqeel is the bes.  He greets you like family the moment you walk in, always with a big smile. The hospitality here makes you feel welcomed and appreciated.

If you want incredible Middle Eastern food with warm, genuine service, Yemeni Grill is a must try. Highly recommended!

- Lebanese customer

Aqeel was wonderful as he took care of us at Yemen grill on south Havana street in aurora. He was very kind and patient while we tried to decide what to get for our first visit to this restaurant. And did not steer us wrong! We ended up with the most delicious lamb stew (Fahsa) that was plenty of food for the both of us with pita. Served boiling hot in an traditional wooden bowl and was just perfect. Since we like to try many things we also went with the Lamb kebab sandwich and it was super flavorful. I am writing this the next day because my left overs even made me do the happy dance while I was eating them.  Aqeel made sure to make us feel welcomed and continued to check on us to make sure we were doing great. We were! Thank you Aqeel and the Yemen Grill I look forward to coming again.

We had the
51. Fahsa فحسة
$24.99
14. Lamb Kabab Sandwich كباب لحم
$9.99

Wow wow wow! This is definitely a hidden gem In Aurora. The food was absolutely delicious and the serving sizes were huge! We ordered one mix grill plate, one shrimp platter and a side of fries. There was so much food that we couldn’t finish it all, it’s enough for 2 more full meals! It was all cooked to perfection and brought out quickly. I will definitely be back!

Small cozy little restaurant. Food was not only delicious, it was beautifully presented and a lot of it. I ordered Mandi chicken and it was so good. Chicken was juicy and well seasoned. Everything we ate was delicious. Service was not overly friendly but they were efficient and everything is cooked to order. You can watch them put your food together while you wait. Enjoyed this and will be back.

Such friendly and welcoming staff, especially Aqeel! He explained anything we had a question on and was very friendly. The food was amazing, fresh, and beautifully presented. We had the Chicken Shawarma Plate, Baba Ghanoush and Lentil Soup. Mint tea is a great flavor and end to the meal. We will definitely be coming back!

name: Tikka & Grill, Nepali and Indian Food

reviews.text: It was an average restaurant experience overall. The food tasted fine, but even after ordering medium spice, it turned out to be quite spicy. The ambience was okay, though it took some time to get the staff’s attention to place our order.

This place was phenomenal! The service was excellent— the staff was so friendly and even brought us free chai to try (which is amazing there, by the way). We got tandoori wings which were AMAZING and a lot of meat for the money! Also got some chicken dish I can’t remember the name of… also delicious and fantastic portion, lots of meat, no skimping here! Going to this place made our whole day better. Will be going back.
Beautiful restraint with friendly staff. This is the best Indian food we've had the pleasure of sharing in all of Denver. We always order extra to have food to bring home!

Really nice restaurant with good flavors in their food. We ordered the tandoori chicken as an appetizer and that was the only part of our meal that we didn’t really enjoy.
The food has good heat, even at medium spice. We loved our chicken tikka masala and the momo soup. It was absolutely delicious.
The servers were attentive and kind. I would highly recommend a visit.
Amazing! I could only eat via Uber Eats but I never experienced a better designed menu. Every item like your Tofu Saag can be modified via extra ingredients. All naan breads are high quality.

Been driving by this place for years never thought of trying. No big sign or attention. I was surprised how clean and organized it was. Beautiful layout and relaxed seating. Tried the avocado toast and eggs. Would definitely come back to try the breakfast burrito. Affordable and delicious. Great customer service.

I had some of the BEST biscuits and gravy I have ever had today! Biscuits was flaky and buttery and soooo soft and the gravy was delicious thick seasoned and just the right amount of sausage.  Thank you!

IT WOULD BE NICE IF THIS ESTABLISHMENT WOULD STOP PUTTING THEIR FLYERS ON MY DOOR. IT'S DISGUSTING HOW DESPERATE THIS BUSINESS IS TO KEEP PUTTING THEIR FLYERS ON MY DOOR AND EVERY BODY ELSE'S DOOR WHERE I LIVE. IF A PERSON IS INTERESTED IN WHAT YOUR DOING THEY WOULD GO TO YOUR ESTABLISHMENT AND ASK OR GO ON YOUR WEBSITE. AND SEEK.

Loved the BBQ Beef Bahn Mi
spicy bbq beef, marinated vegetables, cilantro, onion, cucumber, bahn mi sauce

Wow - just yummy

Sun Valley Kitchen has really surprised me with the quality of their coffee and tea beverages, food, and atmosphere.

The full service coffee bar has a range of standard coffees, lattes, and teas. All are very reasonably priced for Denver. I'm not sure the coffee bean they use but it is full bodied and delicious. The tea selection isn't very large, but they are all well steeped and really delicious.

Based on several lunches here, I feel qualified to say that their food far exceeds expectations. At a very reasonable price too. I'm positive you will be surprised as well, you can't go wrong with the daily special!

Aside from their products, the staff has done a wonderful job at creating a laid back cafe that's great for hanging out in. Big windows let lots of light pour in, plenty of tables and an array of big comfy couches makes the interior a wonderful place to stay a while. All of the staff members are delightful to talk to, kind, and very helpful.

Great job Evan!

*Revision at end*
I've had a bunch of dishes from here now. Ribs and catfish are the highlights. Amazing especially for Denver and good portions.
I would not recommend the fries or the burger. They both end up soft by the time they get to you. Cool flavors, just not even close in comparison to things like the wings, pork chops, catfish, ribs etc.
Wings flavor is amazing, not very spicy.
Peach cobbler was nice, not too sweet, good flavor. Could be a bit more dense with peach.
I dream of a day this place has a brick and mortar 🙏🏽

Edit: unfortunately from recent orders I have experienced a pretty sharp decline. There are no longer ribs, the wing recipe has changed, among other lackluster deliveries. Flavors are still solid on some of my favorites like pork chops and gravy, but unfortunately even that has seen poor quality of life changes.

I ordered online and of course no refund because it was brought over via Uber eats burnt piece of crap. How dare you charge six dollars for burnt hard nasty cake spread the word… Keep your six dollars trash. .

Mannn i just ordered a catfish dinner with gumbo greens and red beans with rice.  First ima say, the food was fire. DID NOT MISS A BEAT ON THE CATFISH ORRR THEM GREENS. Second, i hate ordering food from delivery services, because im scared of what they would do to my food, BUT  i made a not to package the food a certain way and they did it for and i can appreciate that the most. I will absolutely be back. Maybe this weekend lol

I’ve had this place before. I’m not sure what happened this time, but they need to change their oil. The grease from the chicken is legit black. And the chicken tastes weird. I definitely know old oil when I taste it.

I gave poor review earlier for portion and I was wrong. I'm full. The green beans were very good just a little salty. Mac and cheese delicious 😋.  Catfish nuggets were great. You get 6 nuggets in a basket.  The Kool aid mmmmm. Chicago style

reviews.text: You can’t go wrong with anything on the menu but the lamb chops dibi and Senegalese friend fish are unbeatable!! Highly HIGHlLY recommend!! And everything is HALAL!

Absolutely incredible experience all around. Chef David was clearly so excited to share his culture with us through his cooking, and he did not disappoint. Our first experience with Senegalese cuisine and every bite was amazing. We got the lamb, and chicken brochette, which came with jolof rice, fries, fresh salad and perfectly crisp plantains.

OMG!  I knew it was going to be good food based I what I heard, but I didn't know it would be amazing.  Just spicy enough, and the flavor, the flavor out of this world.  The Hibiscus and ginger drinks are better than what I make at home.  So refreshing.   I'm happy!

I went to study abroad in Senegal and this food truck really brought back all the memories in the best way possible.
The food taste authentic and delicious, and the senegaleses teranga has traveled to the US with the lovely individuals who run it. Please go visit and support.

Just tried their food at the Five Points Juneteenth celebration and 🥰🥰🫠🫠🫠
Incredible - best food I’ve had in months. Even elements of food that I normally don’t like, such as tomatoes are paired with flavors that make everything sing.

The fries were perfectly salted and seasoned, hot, crispy, everything you’d want.

By some miracle there wasn’t a line (yet)
During our short wait, the music was absolutely 🔥 🔥 Couldn’t help but just vibe.

Absolutely making it a point to find this truck in the future.

The food was delicious, the jerk chicken was amazing it leaves a good taste in your mouth and a little zing around your lips. My husband had the oxtails and was in love with how it was made, their in house drinks are delicious and go perfectly with the meals. Would definitely recommend this place to my friends.

Finally, a good Jamaican spot in Denver. I’m from JA and it is very hard to find authentic Jamaican food out in Colorado. This place is great. Beef patties are flaky and their portions are very generous. Good customer service which admittedly made my wary of their authenticity (lol) but they were simply nice and friendly. My only comment is the rice & peas could be a little more moist and tastes like it’s been sitting in the pot a bit. Rum cake was also to die for omg! Only one as good as my mom’s. Will be back and would recommend.

First time here. Curry goat was delicious. Well spiced and balanced flavors. Generous amounts of tender goat meat. Side of cabbage which was tasty. I like hotter but this was a good enough level of heat.

I’m married to a true yaardie so take my review with a pound of salt. We were completely satisfied with the portions and quality of food here. I had the jerk pork which was fatty and lean with the perfect balance of spice and flavor. My wife had the oxtail and as an oxtail snob, she was completely quiet with no notes. The real star was the coco bread and patty. When you approach the building, there is a picture of this combo on the window and I tried it. The coco bread came out fresh, hot and soft. The patty was flaky and crunchy with savory beef. I couldn’t recommend this more.

After much anticipation, this location of Reggae Pot has finally opened. It has the same authentic food as the location on University. The curried goat was very good. It's not blazingly hot, but is spicy. The cabbage and rice and peas (beans) are good. There is a selection of Jamaican sodas for drinks including a cream soda and ginger beer.

Service is still working out a few kinks, but was basically good. The space is nicely decorated with Jamaican colors and themes. Seating is either at tables or a counter. There is a password secured Wi-Fi.

There's plenty of parking.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Jamaican Jerk and BBQ Restaurant – Denver, CO

I honestly thought I had already left a review for Jamaican Flavor Fusion because I’ve been eating here for years! This is hands down one of the best places in Denver. I’ve tried a few other spots for oxtails and Jamaican food just because they’re closer to where I live, but nothing compares to this place.

I stopped by recently since I was in the area and super hungry, and I ordered oxtails, Jamaican beef patties, plantains, and mac & cheese — everything was absolutely delicious. The portions are fair, but honestly, I could eat way more because it’s that good!

One day I’m definitely going to get catering from here. Highly recommend if you’re in the area. I’m not sure if they offer delivery, but I wouldn’t be surprised if they do. Hands down the best Jamaican food in town. I’d give them 50 stars if I could!

I ordered oxtail which came with two sides plantain and rice and peas. Along with jerk pork pasta. Nothing was seasoned, I had to throw my food away because the food tasted horrible. The taste hurt my appetite. The rice and peas tasted like white rice. The pork didn’t have a taste it almost tasted boiled and then served and the pasta did not have much sauce on the noodles and lacked flavor. Lastly the oxtail was not good, I have tried many oxtails from different places and this one disappointed. The oxtail wasn’t cooked thoroughly, lacked color and taste.

Loved the private family owned business.  I came from AZ for this, and it did not disappoint.  Loved the dumplings, chicken noodle soup, and empanada. Enjoyed the history on the walls. The young lady was polite and helpful with us ordering. Will be back!

I love the vibe of the restaurant, but I was disappointed by lack of service. Which I could look past if my jerk chicken wasn’t raw in some areas. I was so excited for this food and when I realized how red the chicken was I had to throw it away, and it felt like a waste of money. I hope the owners see this see as a reason to improve, and understand that some of us just want good food and customer service.

***BETTER THAN SCOTCHIES*** Kind of food that you get an attitude about when people look at you while you eat. Jerk chicken is delicious. Make you bite your fingers while you eat it. Rice and peas always seasoned to perfection. Cabbage is always on point  honey drizzle cornbread make you slap your grandma.

name: Just Kool Jamaican Kitchen
vicinity: 2000 S Colorado Blvd Building 4 Unit 102, Denver

reviews.text:
This is a new favorite lunch spot of mine. I love Jamaican food, and unfortunately, there are not many options in Denver for when the cravings come. So how excited was I when I learned Just Kool, which used to be a food truck in Aurora, now has a brick-and-mortar spot in Denver! They’re a Black/family-run business located in a food hall that has some other great options available, including Sonder for coffee. Great space for a casual lunch and large groups. I met the husband and he was friendly and nice as he answered my questions about the menu.

I was impressed with the quality of the food here. I couldn’t decide which I liked better, the curry chicken or the jerk chicken. Both are beautifully cooked, tender, and perfectly seasoned, not too salty or heavy. The rice and beans aren’t mushy! The plantains and corn on the cob are scrumptious. And the beef patty is flavorful and not too doughy or too rich. They have an assortment of Jamaican drinks that i can’t wait to try—I had the sorrel ginger drink recently and it was tasty and refreshing.

Food’s a 12/10! Been rocking with these oxtails since the food truck days, but love the new location (attached photos to help locate)

WILL NEVER SWITCH UP! My fav place to get oxtails in Colorado!
So happy this place opened up. The oxtail was GREAT. This is probably one of the best Jamaican food I’ve had in the Denver Metro Area. Kenny was wonderful, food was hot and you can taste the love.
Delicious food and lovely staff! I’ll definitely be coming back to keep trying the menu, there were so many flavorful options! Really impressed and glad this place exists. Great job you guys!
