This place is actually inside Junction Food & Drink. The Jerk Chicken was very nice and not too spicy. The cabbage side with a little carrot was good. The corn on the cob was okay, but I would have preferred grilled corn.

Service was fast and friendly. Seating is provided by the food court and there's a lot of it both inside and out. The food court provides unsecured Wi-Fi for customers.

There's plenty of parking in free and paid lots plus a few on street spots.

We just came in here for the first time. My husband is a chef from the Caribbean, so my expectations are high. We have eaten at Caribbean restaurants all over, from New York to Jamaica to Miami.

I ordered the Coconut Curry Chicken with potato salad and plantain. The chicken was delicious with a nice kick. The plantains were amazing! The potato salad was just potato salad. It tasted really good, and it was just no different than regular potato salad. Everything was on point, though. The presentation was very nice as well.

The place has a very nice vibe. Overall, I definitely recommend it. 💗

This place is really good with one fatal flaw. The food had no spice. There's no kick to it. I don't know if this is a way they survive in downtown Denver by not making their food spicy but it was certainly missing something. Another thing is service. We were one of the two tables in the restaurant for dinner and I had to go and remind them a couple items I ordered because they forgot it. Those two factors combined made it 4 stars.

We ordered jerk chicken wings, oxtail and goat, all of them were great and melt off the bones. But things are rather sweet and no spice or a kick which was kinda obviously missing and dishes felt incomplete. The cranberry-pineapple drink was satisfactory, I think it was literally a mix of those two juices.

The place is kinda hidden upstairs in the shopping centre even though it is right on the 16th street. Generally a good location to walk around after dinner and easy to get to in downtown. I'd still recommend that you check this place out, maybe you should ask for a hot sauce with your order.

The service was friendly and fast. Nice menu selection without being overwhelming. The food was unique and very good. Wonderful flavors. I had the Coconut Curried Chicken and Jerked Wings. I tried my son's Curry Goat which tasted great too.

Was on a business trip to Denver.  First time in the city.  I started with a rum punch to drink.  My wife had their Bob Marley drink.  Drinks were ok.  I tasted no "punch" in the rum punch.  My wife wasn't overly impressed with the Bob Marley drink either.  Food was about like the drinks. Meaning, just ok. we started with jerk wings that had some really good spice but the jerk flavor of the wings was not on point.  My wife ordered ox tails, I had the curry goat as our main dish.  Neither of us finished the plate. It was ok, but my wife felt the ox tails were gamy-tasting. My goat was fine but the curry gravy had an after taste like it wasn't the freshest.  Our waitress was very nice.  She's the reason we would actually try them again next time were in Denver.

Pros: Great customer service from the bartenders! Unfortunately I don’t remember their names but anytime i come, they’re great.

Jerk wings (appetizer)

Festival (sometimes it hits, but when it does it HITS.)

Salmon

Jerk chicken meal

Cons:

The mac and cheese tastes like dish soap

The fried plantain doesn’t taste like ripe green plantain to me. Tastes more like a sweet plantain that isn’t ripe. Am not a fan

The “rice and peas” is flavorless coconut rice. It’s soooo bland and white. Don’t do it to yourself.

We had Jollof Rice which had pieces of beef In it and fried Chicken which I loved. We also had Rice and Tilapia which was good as well. Prices are fair as well and the food didn't take too long and came out hot. Owner was friendly as well and we can close to closing time but she let us dine in which was highly appreciated. She was also friendly which is always a plus. I do recommend giving it a try I promise you will like it. Definitely somewhere I'll be going frequently. Oh and don't like my pic fool you my Jollof was actually juicy not dry.

Man. I was excited to try this place. I went around 3pm in the afternoon. A few people were dining in when me and a friend arrived. I got the jollof rice. Oh boy, so the food took about 10 minutes to come out and all I can say is everything was old and I dont mean that day old.. the rice had cabbage and what I assume was pieces of roast.. these roast bit were the 1st issue.. they were definitely old. Dried out beef is terrible and it was so hard they it was crunchy at times.. the chicken was either made in old grease or just old in it self. Everything but the rice just tasted old and older. Claiming you making fresh food with part of it being old as heck is nuts to me.. this place cost me 27 bucks. As u can see from the pictures I did not finish it. They are open until 8pm so for food to taste old at 3pm is also disappointing. Maybe it wasn't my pallete but nothing we had tasted worth the rave reviews I read that gave me such excitement.  I do not recommend

Visiting Phoenix, heard about this place from TikTok. I got the Snapper. That Snapper 10/10, it didn’t stand a chance. I also ordered some Jollof rice & chicken, & goat soup with fufu to go, I know it’s going to taste amazing.

Update: I ate the Jollof Rice and Chicken, delicious. I would buy that again. This is my 2nd time having Jollof rice, this one tastes way better. I never had fufu before, so I had to get use to the bland taste. I ate it with the goat soup. It was okay. Fufu maybe not for me, but goat soup yes. Definitely recommend this place.

Amazing! I've been looking for a good place to try fufu for a while now and came across this restaurant due to a TikTok. And it is amazing. Stop reading this and go try it! We got the popular dishes: fufu (of course), Palm Butter soup, Egusi soup, and Jollof rice, with a side of plan rice. Everything was SO so so flavorful and delicious. Whatever spices are being used blend so beautifully together and make for a taste explosion. Definitely a bit spicy, but a flavorful spicy. The fufu with palm butter, oooooh my gosh. The jollof rice! mmmmmmm the chicken that came with the jollof rice was so crisp and delicious. We are absolutely going to be back to this restaurant and I would encourage everyone to go try it. The owners/staff are so nice too. Amazing all around :) Oh and for the portion sizes, this can easily feed 4-6 people.

My first time trying African food was amazing! I had the jollof rice, fufu, and egusi soup, and everything was absolutely delicious. The staff was so welcoming and took the time to explain the dishes, which made the experience even better. I can’t wait to come back and try more!

I went in with my son for the first time and we were both so impressed with the service and the food. We’ve never had west African food and it was delicious! We so appreciate they allowed our son to taste the soups to see his favorite. We absolutely LOVED our meals and how warm and welcoming the staff were. Another patron came in while we were waiting and told us we found the best in the valley, and he wasn’t wrong! We will absolutely be back!
If you’re looking for a Ghanaian restaurant where they serve authentic Ghanaian food, go to Akwaaba Agyaade! You will never be disappointed! I’ve been here 3 times and the food is always amazing!
This place has tasty food and BIG portions! Everything we ordered was flavorful and fresh! The staff are great people too!

I recently visited Agwaba Agadi West African Restaurant, and I was genuinely impressed from start to finish. The jollof rice was the star of the meal—perfectly seasoned, rich in flavor, and cooked to perfection. Every bite had that authentic West African taste that’s hard to find anywhere else. The goat was tender, well-marinated, and packed with deep, savory spices that paired beautifully with the rice. Even the salad was fresh and balanced the plate with a nice, crisp contrast.

What really stood out was how well the entire plate came together. You can tell the food is made with care, tradition, and love. It felt like a true homemade West African meal served in a warm, welcoming environment.

If you’re looking for real flavor, generous portions, and a memorable dining experience, I highly recommend giving this place a try.

My friend and I have never had African food before, this was a good distance from our houses to…so worth it! Every single item was flavorful! We got beans and rice, plantains, fufu, yam fufu, goat, chicken, so much food so we could really try the different flavors! The employees were the sweetest, family owed for sure and love that! We’ll be back, lots of other food we’re dying to try! All this food was about $60, enough for 3-4 people at least. Very reasonably priced! Thank you Akwaaba Agyaade! (Sorry photos are blurry, was a video)

name: West Hut
vicinity: 3110 N Central Ave Ste D-183, Phoenix

reviews.text: They offer an unusual menu of food choices. The server was very knowledgeable and explained the menu items. We were offered samples of the items that we were interested in to help us make our choices. I found the food to be a tasty experience. We were both pleased with our meals. The fufu is made from yams having a similar flavor to mashed potato but with the consistency of dough. The chicken is bone in leg and thigh. For the spinach dish the chicken was cooked in a tomato sauce. The spinach was chopped with mushrooms.

Very cute place, I love the decor and the overall vibe of the place. My server Yesenia was lovely. That girl was on the grind and did amazing. She also gave me a great suggestion of what to order as a first timer. The kids jollof rice with chicken was delicious however for the dish I chose on my own called the “I love spinach,” I wouldn’t say it’s my go to item. Matter of fact I didn’t even touch it after the first two bites bec it had such a strong taste of goat and I wasn’t aware that’s what it was going to taste like since I didn’t get anything goat related. Personally not my favorite but I would get the jollof again with chicken.  Fufu was ok as well, I love the texture and it tasted good when I used it for the chicken.

Overall a nice place to try out and if you like it then you like it, if you’re a picky eater I doubt this is your area of interest.

I had been wanting to try Fufu for months and we finally made the trip up to Phoenix from Casa Grande. Let me tell you something, this was such an amazing experience from the moment we walked in, to the impending fufu coma we slumped out of there with. Yesenia was so helpful navigating the menu and making recommendations, we truly appreciated her guidance and the, “I Love Spinach,” on the menu was Devine! I tried goat for the first time too! You have to try the West Style Sobolo drink, I had two! Highly recommend! Will return! Thank you!

I've been wanting to try this restaurant since they opened. I love Nigerian food. I ordered take out. Unfortunately, the food was a huge miss. The jollof rice wasn't done, the rice was still hard. The meat in both dish were far from being tender, it was extremely tough and chewy.

I recently ordered the spicy goat meat soup on Uber eats, and it exceeded my expectations. The meat was tender, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The broth had a rich, savory depth with a hint of spice that wasn’t overpowering.  The pounded yam is smaller than most places serve. The portion of the soup was generous, and everything arrived hot and well-packaged. Overall, a satisfying, hearty meal that definitely delivered on taste and quality. Highly recommend!

The fried okra soup was pretty good. Pretty spicy. If you haven't had African food it's best to look it because they don't have a menu to tell you what's in the dishes. The girl behind the counter wasn't very helpful. Overall the food was good, just a bit on the expensive side.

My husband and I went there yesterday. Because I love the food. However yesterday I was sad to hear that they are under new management. To me the food was more inviting. The portions were bigger. I order  cassava leaf per usuall but was disappointed. There were chicken wings in it instead of the turkey and beef I got pieces of chicken wings and one tiny piece of meat barely any protein. Had it with rice and yes the portion was bigger than main dish. Anyways  long story short the food was extremely salty and very little peper. I normally finish all my food but yesterday I was so disappointed that I couldn't finish my food and mind you I drove almost an hour to get this food double disappointment. However despite it all I love my sister in front very friendly and greet with a smile always good spirit it was really good to see you  great customer service  I appreciate you  keep up the good work. Now the question will I return there again maybe but not anytime soon but if the food continue to be salty probably not. You see the reason our food is so good is not because we buried it in salt please if your meat is salty then I would suggest no salt in the rice  but please watch the portion of salt.
For the new management that took over, the dry rice  and fish is good. I have tried other dishes (cassava leaves and Potatoe greens) previously and they were ok.

First time trying West African food, and I was very impressed. I ordered the fried okra with fufu and sweet plantains, and everything was delicious. The food arrived fresh and hot, like it was cooked right when it was sent out. Portions are very generous, and the flavors were amazing. I’ll definitely be ordering again.

I loved the decor! The food is delightful! The fufu is soft and sticky and soaks up and gravy and tames a bit of the kick and the heat was perfect where it's not over powering. I loved the digital menu board and that it is a simple menu. It's an order at the counter type restaurant. The service was wonderful in my experience. Of course it's a bit hidden in a very mini strip mall off of 19th/Glendale. As they say "hole in the wall restaurants tend to have the best food".

First time here as a suggestion from my friend.  The service was amazing very helpful and friendly.  There was some hot "spice " tea, omg I could have drank the whole pot. Food was excellent,  I definitely need to stop again and try other things. Mango juice was delicious!

The atmosphere was meh. Nothing special. But the gentleman serving was helpful with any question or suggestions. Quick service. I had the goat, hilib, that tasted too me like oxtail. The appetizer we had was yummy. They have a "salsa" that was served with the appetizer that was great and spicy.

I went to this place with one of my friends. From the outside and inside it looks like an ordinary restaurant but their food was extraordinary!!! Their falafel sandwich, more like a wrap was delicious. My friend and I both loved the food, we both ordered the vegetarian item falafel sandwich.
I had the bead and lamb gyro plate. The sambusa was my favorite part of my meal. The service was quick.

First time here. An Uber driver recommended it lol as I was looking for a restaurant in pheonix that served african food. I loved the huge amounts of food ( as I am a foodie 😋) , affordable prices. Above all, the food was flavorful, and the host/ manager was very friendly. We will be coming back for sure.

Let me start by saying the people who work here are very nice but, yes the service is a bit slow. We ordered a the Taste of Ethiopia and I personally enjoyed the vegan dishes more than the meat dishes. My personal fav was the Shiro Wot. This dish is very large and can definitely be split amongst 4 people. In addition to food we also ordered a fresh juice and a spiced hot tea which were both very good. If you enjoy tea please try their spiced tea. Other than service being a bit slow the atmosphere was great and very welcoming.

I almost forgot to add that we also had a Tiramisu for dessert. The slice was pretty big and can be shared.

I’ve ordered from Authentic EthioAfrican Kitchen, Bar & Cafe several times through Postmates and have always had a good experience. I usually go for the vegan combo dishes, which are flavorful and satisfying. I especially love their fresh and delicious injera.  Overall, great food and reliable delivery.  I would definitely return again and recommend it to others!

Tuesday night visit, first visit. We spent nearly two hours at the restaurant. Our order consisted of an appetizer and two entrees. The service was ok. The server was nice, things just took awhile to come out. The ambience was low lighting. We had a mix of meat and vegan items with sega wot key and meser wot being our favorites. The awaze wings were well seasoned.
We waited an hour for our food, despite there only being one or two other tables seated. My Shiro Wot was fine, every dish my party got was pretty spicy. The restaurant was quiet and dim.

This place is great, the service is very slow, so don't come in a rush. The food is amazing. Also, pro tip on Sambusas, it is a single Sambusa, no like a plate of them. Also mix their specialty drink before drinking it, its not very sweet until you mix it.

The wings are awesome and the Gluten Free carrot cake is soooo moist and the frosting is perfect. I ate it too fast to take a pic 😅.

This is not a restaurant but the service and atmosphere are remarkable. I enjoyed every moment. Don Tomas is full of wisdom. He is direct and will not steer you in the wrong direction. I left feeling fulfilled and accomplished. Will definitely be back. Thank you ❤️
Definitely was on point both times I went. Had to send my friends. And affordable!!
It’s been a great place to go. Food is so delicious people over there so kind. You need to come to this place and try the food from East Africa

Very Good Food ! My Family and I went there for the first time and We enjoyed Our experience!

Thank You to All The Staff!
Great food a nice hole in the wall i stumble upon price and good quality very nice service alittle rough on the edges but dont count it out till you try their food

Tried this place during our stay in Phoenix. The quality and portion size of food was top notch. The person serving us was very friendly and helped us with the details of Somali food that we were eating for the first time. When the food came out, it tasted just divine. Will visit again.

I love going to this place. The food is authentic and the staff are top notch friendly. They make you feel at home. The owner is always cracking jokes with all the customers. I am definitely going back again again. I recommend this place. They give you a lot of food too, I usually get take home bowl.

Great experience and delicious food here at Kare!
It was my first time here so I had the buffet which was a great way to try out different dishes that they serve. It was all excellent.
To top it off they offered coffee for free when my meal was done with incense and a great presentation.
Highly recommended if you're wanting Ethiopian cuisine with amazingly kind service and a very authentic atmosphere.

I'm a huge fan of Ethiopian food and have tried it everywhere I've lived in the US and abroad, when it's been available.  This place is so far my favorite in the Phoenix area!  We tried the vegetarian/vegan combo and foul, as well as the lentil sambusas.  Everything was incredible, service was very friendly and welcoming, and we loved the decoration and music.

Whether you love Ethiopian food and are craving shiro wot and zilzil tibs, or this is your first time, you owe it to yourself to try Kare!

The lady who served is was such an amazing soul. From preparing the food for us to telling us what everything was! She was so sweet and made sure we loved everything! And told us about the buffet they do as well! Definitely will be back!

My friends and I had such a wonderful time here tonight.  The atmosphere was relaxed, the service was great, and the food was delicious. We all enjoyed the coffee, meat and veggie combo and red wine tremendously. Absolutely recommend this establishment.

Kare has the best Ethiopian food in the valley hands down. I love how chill the atmosphere inside with Ethiopian customers chatting and watching Ethiopian music videos. First I ordered meat sambusas. They are super crispy and the filling is delicious. The sauce is very spicy but delicious. We got the meat & vegetable combo and it was delicious. I love meat but the veggies were super good. Finally I got the traditional Ethiopian coffee and that was so earthy and delicious. It comes with a burning frankincense you can smell while drinking the coffee. We hung out there for a while after dinner and had a few glasses of Ethiopian wine. They also sell spices and coffee products I feel like I must return and buy some Berbere spices.
This place could not be found. All directions led to a residential neighborhood with no sign of the restaurant.
They do not exist.

The food at Gojo Ethiopian was very good – we tried the Gojo Combo, Meat Combo, Meat & Veggie Combo, and also ordered Doro Wot. Everything tasted authentic and flavorful.

However, the service needs improvement. There was only one server for the whole restaurant, and we had to ask for basic things like water glasses. The portion sizes also felt too small for the price. For example, the Doro Wot was $14 but came with only one piece of chicken and one egg, which didn’t feel worth it.

Overall, delicious food but service and portion sizes could be much better.

A restaurant with a truly interesting atmosphere, uniquely designed to offer an authentic Ethiopian experience. The food, prepared by an Ethiopian lady chef, had a genuine homemade taste rich in tradition and flavor. A wonderful place to visit and enjoy a memorable meal.

This place deserves more love! Stopped by for lunch on a Friday. The mixed veggie & meat platter was delicious and affordable - I stuffed myself and ate the whole thing by myself, but it was enough food for two people to split. The injeera bread in particular was perfect. The decor is really cool and our server was friendly.

Home hospice patient; I went to have a Christmas dinner with my family and a friend tonight, and we truly loved the food and the atmosphere. The food tasted like a home cooked meal, and we enjoyed spending that time together. Thank you, and God bless your business!!

Owner is super friendly! Felt welcomed Great customer service. First time here and we enjoyed our dinner, if you've never tried ethiopian food definitely come here the food tasted very authentic and you might like it!! We tried their honey wine it was super good 👌
Injera bread was delicious!
Owner said his wife did all the cooking and she did really good! ☺️👍
My toddler is 2 years old and he loved the injera bread!! Toddler approved 👌😁

name: Abyssinia Restaurant and Cafe Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text: Azi was super friendly the owner! Food was fresh and delicious 😋 honey wine was good as well, most of all I loved her coffee ☕️ she offered it for free which i thought was very sweet of her, Thank you Azi for being so friendly and nice to our family and kids. God bless you 🙏❤️

To start - I’m super picky about where I go out to eat. I literally spend hours figuring it out because there’s nothing I dislike more than spending money on food that’s not good. With that being said, this place…

Love it! I went here for the first time and the food was really good.

Firstly, the honey wine is really good. The flavors of the food are so well combined that it’s a perfect balance between the spices. The spices don’t distract from the food itself. I find that a lot of places use spices to cover up the poor quality of what they’re feeding you - this was not the case at this restaurant.

The injera bread was great. Perfect compliment to the main course. The lentil samosa were phenomenal. Perfect bit of spice.

One thing that I was pleasantly surprised with is that the meat is not just precooked and then reheated. I can always tell when food is reheated (I hate the taste of it) and this was not. So the fact that it was cooked to order was made it even better.

The owners definitely care about the food they are serving you and you can tell when you eat it.

If you’re up in the air about finding somewhere to eat and you read this review…

EAT HERE. trust me….
The food was great. Traditionally prepared and served. The waitstaff were friendly and accommodating. I'll be back!

Absolutely amazing. The owner is a wonderful woman who made me feel right at home and recommended different dishes. The birz is sweet and delicious, and the lamb was perfectly cooked, served piping hot and quite literally the best butter-braised lamb I've ever had. The injera was fluffy and just the right sourness and came with a bright fresh green salad. Highly, highly recommend coming here.

The food was amazing! And honestly very well priced we ordered the veggie signature dish, 2 meat dishes and sambusas and it was very affordable. Everything was SOO flavorful!
The service was great! Our waitress was very kind and super helpful !
The restaurant itself was very cozy, authentic decor, and I enjoyed being able to have our own private area to enjoy our food.

Ordered greens, mac n cheese, fried okra, rib tips, and corn muffins. I would say greens was seasoned well with a little kick(spicy). One of the best greens I've had in AZ. Okra was good, too. I didn't care for the corn muffin because I don't eat like very sweet cornbread and that's my preference. Rib tip a lot of fat barely meat and mac n cheese it was cheesy but didn't taste the cheese. It was a little strange. I like to try different soul food places to support us. I would go back to this place for the greens. Location isn't in the best spot. Also sides were $5 each, I think price was a little high for the little amount you receive.

So my husband and I ordered fried fish combo and beef brisket sandwich combo.... also ordered additional sides, collard greens..2 cans of soda.. according to the menu the fish combo came with two pieces of fish however my husband only got one. They forgot our two additional sides. I went up to the counter and addressed it with the young man who was behind the counter and also working in the kitchen. He took care of us very quickly and was apologetic. The dining room feels like you're at someone's house which is a good feeling.. the brisket sandwich had good flavor however it was in my opinion too tough could have simmered a little bit longer and there was more fat than what I desired, but other than that it was a good meal. The loaded mashed potatoes are awesome, full of flavor. And the Collard greens, haven't had good bowl of collard greens since I was a kid they were extremely good. There was a unique flavor about everything that my husband and I were trying to figure out LOL. Overall... this was a very good dining experience as it was our first time. Will definitely come again

I wish we could give negative stars…. Just ordered the smothered chicken, rice and gravy and greens and I am very disappointed. Bit into the chicken and it was raw….. All 3 pieces! I’m going to try and upload picture because this is absolutely crazy!

Tried for first time me and my wife.
Ordering at Kiosk pretty simple
Catfish 7 out of 10 Good seasoning would have been higher if it was fresher
Mac n cheese 9 out of 10
Greens 9 out of 10
Potato salad 7 out of 10
Yams 5 out of 10
Smothered chicken 9 out of 10
Strawberry crunch cake 9 out of 10

Customer service could have been better 5 out of 10. Little warm in location, but overall I’d give a 7 out of 10 and recommend trying food items they can cook👍🏾

The man who manages this place is a power tripping psycho. He treats all of his delivery drivers and employees horribly and should be ashamed of himself. I watched him lose multiple customers today because of the way he treated me when I did absolutely nothing wrong. I was told “take a seat and we’ll be right with you” and then I stood in the corner and when he saw that I was standing and not sitting he flipped out on me. He even lost business from a customer that witnessed it because of how unacceptable his treatment of another human being was. Also, I called the customer that I was supposed to be picking up food for to explain why their food was going to be cold and late. This man refused to give me their order, banned me and called the police because I didn’t sit down, I am not
over exaggerating, nothing else happened and I’m still confused. Upon hearing this, the customer was very upset and they said they will never order from there or any of the restaurants that are affiliated with this place again. If someone other than this man owns this business know this: HE IS LOSING YOU CUSTOMERS AND MONEY! I would bet that your reviews start to go up if you got rid of him.

Customer service is always amazing! The food is made fresh and taste great 👍  it’s also a market I find all my favorite items from back home here at this location it’s a great place to stop to grab some groceries and have a meal on your way out!
Excellent service and delicious meals & Very clean area😍😍😍
5 star food. That all I can say. Great friendly staff
Great service. Delicious and fresh food. Highly recommend this place. The owner was very nice and friendly.
Authentic, fresh and delicious. Recommend! 👍🏽👍🏽

This is  one of my favorite  places to come. Very clean place. Good amount of seating.  Music is hands  down the best in the Valley. Oh yeah lets not forget about the food. I am a hot wing snob, they  by far  have the best wings in town. I love this place!
Good spot to be at if you in phoenix, very clean, music is good, seats are clean and they have some food.

Saturday night visit. My party had the jerk chicken bowl as well as the oxtail bowl with rice and peas. The rice and peas are kidney beans and rice. Everything tasted well. The jerk sauce does not have a kick at all. It was quite bland as far as jerk sauce goes. The oxtails were very small but tasted great.  I also tried one of their housemade juices that was very good. The order taker was not hospitable but was much nicer when giving the food items. Indoor and outdoor seating available.

I had the pleasure of dining here after checking recommendations from Instagram. Let me tell you, IT DID NOT DISAPPOINT!  From the start, walked in the smell was amazing, the music inside, a mix of Trinidadian Soca, Reggae, and dancehall, made me feel like I was back in the West Indies visiting extended family.  Mom n Daughter ran the show flawlessly. What I thought would be a quick birthday lunch (Sept 13th) turned into a few hours of family and food! The curry goat was amazing.The spices, the seasoning, everything was on point. I got to try the oxtail eggs rolls, and they were absolutely amazing. Even the simple things like a beef patty and cocoa bread, hiit the spot like I couldn't imagine here in arizona. If you are looking for a true caribbean cuisine experience that will have you wanting more and keep coming back.This is the place! I cannot wait to get back here again! Turn up the soca!!!

Amazing, would recommend. Got the chicken curry bowl and oxtail plate and wow, the oxtail was DELICIOUS, the seasoning on it was so flavorful. The curry chicken bowl and plantains were just as delicious.

Service was great, it’s a massive must try for me.

I had the coco bread w/ beef patties, yellow rice, oxtails, curry goat & plantains. The food was excellent!!!!!!! The service was excellent!!!! My cousins who were visiting from Chicago & my daughter all enjoyed their food. We couldn't wait to eat our leftovers. My daughter & I will definitely be visiting very soon.

The host was so nice and welcoming  and very everyone and letting each and everyone one of us when our food would be coming out. Because they try to bring the whole party plates out about the same time.  I thought that was nice so everyone could eat together.  And the food is cooked fresh. The taste and smell of  the food was off the chain. Iwas very  impressed.  I will be back and will pass the word on to my friends!

Been coming to this Ethiopian spot in Tempe for almost 10 years now and honestly, that’s the best part. The food hasn’t changed, the quality is still great, and that consistency is rare these days.

I love their food and especially the injera bread. Always fresh, soft, and perfect with the dishes. Everything tastes comforting and authentic, the kind of place you keep coming back to without even thinking twice.

Tried their house special coffee this time and it was excellent. Proper Ethiopian coffee, rich and smooth, and a great way to end the meal.

If you’re looking for solid Ethiopian food that’s been doing it right for years, I’d definitely recommend this place. One of those reliable, no-nonsense favorites that never disappoints.

Be cautious about mold on the bread.
Three baskets of bread that were brought to our table had visible mold. We informed the staff, but they did not apologize. They did remove the charge, which we appreciated.

We were told the bread was from overnight and that this was likely the reason for the mold. Serving overnight bread with mold can be unsafe, and this explanation was concerning. We were also told we could return another day to speak with the manager.

Aside from this issue, the platter itself was good. However, I would not return.

Cafe Laibela is an absolute gem for anyone craving authentic Ethiopian cuisine. From the moment you walk in, the warm and inviting atmosphere sets the tone for a relaxed and enjoyable dining experience. The restaurant has a cozy, family-style feel with welcoming staff. The food is nothing short of amazing. Each dish is rich in flavor, perfectly spiced, and beautifully presented on traditional bread. Whether you’re a longtime fan of Ethiopian food or trying it for the first time, Cafe Laibela delivers an unforgettable experience with both its cuisine and atmosphere.

The food was delicious!  My favorite is the Fasolia (green bean, tomatoes, and carrots).
We got the Vegan platter for 2. There were 3 of us and we were full with leftovers.
The service is not very friendly. The space was comfortable and very clean.

Been going to this place for years and recently visited again.  They serve a delicious cuisine of Ethiopian food. The dishes are flavorful,  abundant, and the quality is spectacular. You can get individual dishes or shareable dishes. They serve their dishes with injera which serves as your utensils and what you use to grab your food. It's so delicious 😋.  The atmosphere is very relaxed. The restaurant is very cozy and friendly.  The service was great and the staff is very attentive and courteous. The dishes were plentiful and extremely affordable.  You get a lot of food for the cost. I certainly recommend this place for the dishes,  ambience, friendly staff, and bang for your buck!

We always come here because the food is delicious. We usually get the variety plate that comes with veggies and meat. So good! I also got the ginger hot tea, so simple but so tasty! Fair price, service is great and the place is very cozy.

I’ve been eating at First Cup Ethiopian Restaurant on and off for over five years, and every single time it’s been an incredible experience. The food is always of excellent quality—fresh, flavorful, and consistently prepared with care. That consistency is rare to find, and it’s one of the main reasons I keep coming back.
The service is outstanding. The team here greets me warmly every visit, and what touches me the most is the love and compassion they extend—welcoming me barefoot without judgment. That level of respect and kindness goes far beyond food; it’s a reflection of their beautiful spirit.
If you’re looking for a restaurant where the food is always top-notch, the service is heartfelt, and the atmosphere feels like home, this is the place.
Love and ((HUGS)),
Laura Foster
Founder, Souls Healing Humanity

Second time here, and I'll definitely be back. Excellent food and service. As I am not Ethiopian, I don't know much about the food or what is customary, but the Lady here was very nice and answered all the questions I had. I had a vegetarian plate, and I am not leaving hungry. Thank you First Cup.
We visited this restaurant for the first time today. The food was great and the people were kind. We would highly recommend this place!

A True Taste of Ethiopia in Arizona!

From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted with the warm, welcoming hospitality that Ethiopian culture is known for. The restaurant’s atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant, with traditional music and beautiful décor that instantly transports you to Addis Ababa.

The food was absolutely outstanding. The injera was soft, fresh, and perfectly tangy, and the variety of wot dishes was a flavorful journey—each stew rich in spices and depth. The doro wot was tender and savory, with just the right amount of heat, and the misir wot had that comforting, earthy taste that makes you want to keep eating long after you’re full. Vegetarians and meat lovers alike will find something to love here.

What truly sets this place apart is the care and authenticity in every bite. You can tell the recipes are made with love and passed down through generations. The coffee ceremony was a beautiful experience—not just a drink, but a cultural ritual, filling the air with the rich aroma of freshly roasted beans.

Whether you’re new to Ethiopian cuisine or a lifelong fan, this restaurant is a must-visit. It’s more than just a meal—it’s a cultural experience you’ll remember and want to share with friends and family.

I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. I took my coworker who has never tried Jamaican food and he loved it, the service was excellent, the owner came out and ensured everything was great. The food is real yard food - everything well season dwn ! The portions were large, I ate for two days .

Portions are large and pricing is very fair. I would have preferred a spicier jerk chicken and the cabbage cooked longer. The rice and peas also had a sweet flavor to it, which I wasn't a big fan of.  Unfortunately I don't think I'd order again from here.
The curry goat my other half had and he did say it was very moist and he enjoyed it. I asked if he’d order again from and he said yes! So def worth trying and making your own judgement.
Also, we ordered delivery on Door Dash so I can’t rate customer service or atmosphere.

Amazing experience all around! I tried the jerk pasta, jerk chicken, and curry goat, and everything was full of flavor and cooked perfectly. The seasoning was on point and the portions were very satisfying. On top of the great food, the customer service was truly over the top—friendly, welcoming, and attentive from start to finish. Definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to and recommending to others!

Real Jamaican food here, not like these other places around. I’ve pretty much tried everything on the menu and not one thing I don’t like I have a picture of the jerk chicken and brown stew chicken attached to this review. Both were amazing. Also try the rum cake. It’s a real Buzz! Try this place you won’t be disappointed
Good Friendly Staff as well!

When I moved to Phoenix, I honestly didn’t think I’d find any real Jamaican restaurants out here. Back in Connecticut I was used to my family cooking or hitting the local Jamaican spots, so I figured Phoenix would be a big change. But Cool Vybz Jamaican Restaurant proved me wrong in the best way.

From the moment I walked in, the energy felt like home—good music, good people, and that authentic Jamaican vibe you can’t fake. I ordered the oxtail and jerk chicken, and both were top tier. The oxtail was tender and falling off the bone, the gravy was perfect, and the jerk chicken had that real flavor and heat without being too much. Even the rice and peas tasted like something straight out of my family’s kitchen.

Finding a spot like this in Phoenix honestly shocked me—in the best way. If you’re looking for real Jamaican food with real flavor, Cool Vybz is the place. I’m definitely going back.

I drove 27 minutes to come to this restaurant, but when I arrived, it was closed. It was really disappointing after driving that far. Please update your hours online so customers don’t have to waste their time.
Catering services specialized in East African and Middle Eastern food. Send all order inquiries VIA WhatsApp to number listed on webpage or call the line directly.
The food here is awesome. No complains about anything. Freshly home made. The owners of the place are very friendly and nice.
The Ric cooked maybe week ago it tastes no good I just leave the food and go

The surrounding area is very dilapidated and the place is like a hole in the wall.
But the food was amazing! A home cooked meal made by a mother and daughter team.
Highly recommend this place.
We had the goat and rice and the chicken and beef samosas, excellent.
The wait is long but worth every bite!

The atmosphere is good homely vibe and some design that reminds of the middle eastern heritage. The food is great but doesnt fulfil the hunger. The falafel is super tasty, but the pickles spoil the taste of it. The amount of sauce and tomatoes and absence of onions kinda dampens the sandwich taste. But falafel manages to save it with the juicyness. My best suggestion would be to increase the quantity and price by a dollar or two instead of this awkward price where it is not enough but still feels pricey.

I finally tried Haji baba after hearing about it for years and it totally lived up to what people said starting with the simple feta and pita that tasted amazing. Our sandwiches were great especially the hot crispy falafel and the vegetarian platter was a fun way to try a few sides. We finished with walnut and pistachio baklava that was sweet crunchy and a perfect ending.

Haji-Baba is without a doubt some of the highest quality shawarma I’ve ever had the pleasure of tasting. The chicken shawarma platter is immaculately flavorful, and make sure to have the garlic sauce. The built in market creates an authentic atmosphere that amplifies the dining experience.

I liked the food, but the menu should have been more elaborate . I ordered the chicken kebab and thought that it would just be a chicken kebab with a salad and some rice, but they put ranch on the salad. Overall, they could make the menu more elaborate.

I have eaten at this location two times now and it’s also the place where I buy my red lentil beans. The customer service is excellent. The food takes a little time not a problem. The food is always excellent here. It tastes fresh it looks fresh not soggy not like it sat there for a long time. I have visited the Middle East and this is very close to what I got to enjoy up there. I’m so glad these guys take their time and deliver proper delicious food.

name: Dragon Flame Chinese Grill 龙焱烧烤

reviews.text: Excellent experience every time we go. Some of the best Chinese food I’ve ever had. Better quality ingredients than most places and doesn’t make you feel awful when you leave. No msg! Huge fan of the dumplings, beef skewers and orange chicken. Highly recommend!

We really enjoyed the fried rice and pork—the flavors were great! The dessert was fun to try, though it wasn’t my favorite taste-wise. Overall, I had a unique experience here that you probably won’t find anywhere else, and the service was kind and welcoming. The only downsides were the limited parking (only about three spots in front, so we had to park in the garage across the intersection) and the tables could have been a bit cleaner. It is a college-town spot though, so maybe I’m being a little tough with my review.
My chicken was very vinegary and chewy. I still wonder why the egg drop soup was spicy? Although the fried chicken ice cream was good 👍  We got a free La Boo Boo....so my wife was happy.

Pretty delicious food, we came in around 3pm and it was empty so service was swift and the sever was super sweet. I didn’t take any pictures besides the dessert but trust me you will not regret coming here. Beef Skewers, Pineapple Chicken, Seafood Dumplings & Hot Beef Wonton Soup is all we got. Good sized portions, like huge honestly. Cant wait to come again!

I understand the hype surrounding Dragon Flame. The food is good not great (we ordered the lemon chicken 8/10, drumsticks 7/10 and dumplings 9/10) but the whole dining experience is just fun and unique. I’m very excited to try again in the future and order based on previous reviews.

The Fried Catfish is so tender it melts in your mouth! The Mac & Cheese is the real deal, made with real sharp cheddar cheese and mildly seasoned. The yams are firm, yet tender and sweetened to perfection. It was SOO could eat here every day. The prices are reasonable too.

I ordered the hamburger steak covered in onions and gravy along with their amazing mac and cheese. Every bite was packed with flavor! The cook truly knows what they’re doing such great food and care in every dish. I’ll definitely be back for more!

Mrs. White’s Golden Rule Cafe
808 E Jefferson St,
Phoenix, AZ 85034

Positive Aspects
I visited this restaurant after showing my listing at Crab n Spice.

Friendly Staff**: The staff members were exceptionally friendly, creating a welcoming atmosphere.
Delicious Fried Chicken**: The fried chicken was outstanding—crispy on the outside, moist and light on the inside. I absolutely loved it and will definitely return for more.

Negative Aspects
Slow Service**: The service was quite slow. I arrived right as the restaurant opened, and it took 30 minutes for my iced tea to arrive.
Tea Refills**: My tea was not refilled until I finished my meal, although the server remained friendly throughout.

From the restaurant website:

Mrs. Whites Cafe. A family-run business since its inception in 1964. We take great pride in serving up classic Southern soul food in a cozy, home-style atmosphere. Our recipes have been handed down through generations, allowing us to provide our customers with a truly unique and authentic experience. Come and enjoy a delicious meal at Mrs. White's Golden Rule Cafe and take a step back in time.

First time here, and it had to be on a game day Saturday,  so parking was a little hairy, u have to park in back or they charge you 20 to park in front. From the moment we walked in we were greeted and seated. Took our drink order right away, drinks came out pretty quick but that was the last of it.  Never saw them again for a refill. Food service was excellent, didn't have to wait too long, and it was pretty busy in there around 2 in the afternoon.  Cornbread came out before our meal. If I had one gripe, it would be, could have used a little more butter or honey, wasn't that moist  but was tasty. I had the fried catfish. Now I haven't had catfish this tender and juicy since I lived in the midwest,  off the Mississippi River! It was delicious.  I took their recommendations for the sides and had the greens and macaroni salad, both excellent.  My friend got the fried chicken with mac n cheese and rice with gravy. All and all was a great experience,  will definitely be back.

Made me feel like I was at Grandma's house sitting at her table. And the servers felt like cousins and family. Very warming and welcoming. Each bite unlocked a nostalgic memory. Walking in and seeing the picture on the wall told me all I needed to know, the food was prepared with love. Can't wait to return

Great service. Wonderful food with big fresh portions. The historic photos are fun but the music is off-putting for many people. If adult lyrics hurt your ears, bring headphones and some worship music. Yikes.

So I have been seeing these Monroe bags frequently and finally decided to give it a try! They don’t take orders over the phone, but the website is very smooth and easy to navigate. Accepts Apple Pay which is a plus in my opinion. Ordered take out, 3 pc chicken tenders and fries box, onion rings, side of coleslaw and the moon pie. I ordered Hot and it delivers, very nice heat and I don’t want to speculate what the two other heat options will do to you. Crispy outside and juicy inside. Yummy! Onion rings were delicious. Coleslaw was crispy fresh. Fries were very tasty. Definitely worth a visit and I’ll try it again (will be brave and macho & do the next level heat) … staff was very pleasant and friendly.

Nice chicken sandwich. Great sides. Awesome fountain soda.

That’s the high level.

Monroe’s is located downtown, near the stadium, and Bear a bunch of Marriott hotels. Parking is kind of difficult at times, but to be expected.

The staff was welcoming, helpful, friendly, and quick. Great experience.

The decor and vibe was fast casual. Nice place to look at the walls and figure out who the mug shot belongs to!

The food was all very good. I wouldn’t say it is the same as actual hot chicken in Nashville, but it had great flavor and was a treat to enjoy. The mild was spicy to me, so I can’t imagine what the top level would taste like.

Overall great spot that I would be happy to come back to any time I’m in phx.
Got my chicken with no heat; still a decent flavor. Fried pickles were good as well!

The chicken sandwich was so delicious!!! The coleslaw and pickles were an amazing addition. The mac and cheese with cornbread topping was also really good; the topping surprised me! The staff were really nice and friendly, so needless to say, the service was amazing!! Definitely recommend

name: Hana's House Restaurant Middle Eastern Cuisine

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I had an amazing experience at Hana’s! We got the family dinner with skewers of kebabs and kefta — everything was absolutely delicious. The meat was juicy, tender, and full of flavor. You can really tell they use quality ingredients and put care into their cooking.

The service was great too — very friendly and attentive. Even with the construction going on outside, the food and experience were still top-notch.

I saw a bad review from someone named Calvin before coming in, and honestly, it couldn’t be further from the truth. After trying it myself, I can say that Hana’s definitely deserves a 5-star rating.

Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great food and awesome service!

Do not let the exterior put you off! This was an incredible dining experience. The restaurant was dead when I came in with the exception of some online orders but the host greeted me warmly, didn’t hover despite it really just being me, gave me good advice with my Arabic coffee (which was delicious), there was a small salad while I waited, the food was hot, came out fairly quickly and everything was as a flavor explosion. The portions were also large enough that I had to take some home, which is never a complaint for me!

I will be back for sure. This is truly what the term “diamond on the rough” is used for. Thank you!

Just happen to be driving by on our way to Sedona and stopped at this GEM!!
Wow 👌 👏 😍  the flavors the portions and quality of the food was top notch!!  Everything was nicely seasoned and flavored.  And the service was once again, unmatched.  I happen to mention that my birthday was yesterday but that we had suffered an accident which prevented us from leaving for our trip.  And as we were on way we got the food to go.. well they packaged and included a nice little treat to go, a Baklava with a note that read happy birthday, free of charge!!
And then we decided to have a bite to eat before hitting the road, so as we sat there, he came back to check on us and brought us 2 water bottles, again free of charge!!  Talk about going above and beyond for a customer!! 💪💪💪🥰🙏🙏🙏😊🙋‍♂️
Will definitely be coming back and here and spread the word about this nice restaurant and the amazing food they serve!!  Thank you so much for making our day!!

🤩🤩wowww soo delicious here 🤩😋 all the meat was soft and flavorful . The mint lemonade was sooo good , they blended it up fresh so there was pieces of mint and chunks of lemon in there and it almost tasted basily 🤩❤️ The chicken shawarma with hummus was just like everybody said so mouth watering 😋❤️ the hostess/ server was great , he was friendly and polite. The place is clean, open and bright. We did get confused at the end because you pay at the front door , you don't have to wait for the check 🤭. Thank you for having a delicious family restaurant that we can come to again and again ❤️❤️🥰

Not sure what all these 5 star reviews are about. Been having this place bookmarked for some time and finally had the opportunity to drive out to give it a try.

It was 6pm on a Thursday and the place was empty inside. Thought this was a good sign because it means the food will be extremely fresh. However this was not the case - I’m not sure if it was an off day but the food we received was extremely disappointing.

We each ordered the Hana Special Mix which came with a beef kefta, chicken kefta, chicken tikka and beef tikka. The only good thing on that place was the beef kefta… everything else was insanely dry and borderline inedible.The meat did not taste like it was freshly made and tasted warmed up. There was zero char on the meat and the meat had that old mushy texture like it was sitting out all day and was reheated before serving.

Best thing about the place was the beef kefta, rice and sides. $28 for this sad plate left us extremely disappointed.

With the abundance of other middle eastern restaurants in the valley, I would not recommend going to Hana House due to the lack of quality, not to mention the portion sizes.

Did I mentioned they have a 3% credit card surcharge as well?

I haven’t had Filipino food in a while, so I was excited to try this spot — my first Filipino restaurant experience in Phoenix, AZ. I stopped by in the afternoon, and when you walk in, there’s a counter displaying different dishes along with a menu if you want to order something fresh. You order at the counter and pay. If you order food from the kitchen, they will give you a number, and you sit down at the seats and they will bring the food out.

I decided to try a few pieces of lechon and the sizzling sisig. The lechon came in big, chunky cuts that were really juicy and flavorful. The skin was perfectly crispy and had that satisfying crunch when you bite into it — exactly what you hope for with good lechon.

The sizzling sisig was tasty too — it came out on a hot plate, still sizzling, with plenty of flavor and a good mix of textures. Since this was my first time trying sisig, I don’t have anything to compare it to yet, but I enjoyed it. I didn’t think to order rice with it, but next time, I definitely will because it was pretty greasy on its own, and rice would help balance it out.

Overall, it was a nice first experience. The staff was friendly, and the vibe felt casual and homey. I’m looking forward to coming back and trying more dishes — maybe some classic adobo, pancit, or their desserts next time.

The minute I found out how close Halo Halo Kitchen was to my home, I couldn’t resist ! I swear I came here like 3 days in a row. As a Hawai’i native , this restaurant really reminds me of back home. Not only is the food amazing but their service is top notch and I love the atmosphere!! Be back soon!! 🇵🇭♥️🔥

We had the Pancit Bihon, Pork Adobo, Lumpia Shanghai, Halo-Halo and everything was fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with love. The Pancit was perfectly seasoned, the Adobo was tender and rich, the Lumpia had the perfect crunch, and the Halo-Halo was the perfect sweet finish. Hala Hala Kitchen is a true gem for anyone craving authentic Filipino cuisine. Definitely give this spot a try, you won’t be disappointed!
Delicious, such a laid back environment. Wish the hours were a bit later, but I love this place

Delicious, authentic Filipino food in a humble, comfortable atmosphere. Staff are very polite and my Filipino partner approved of the food. They have a few Filipino groceries here too, on racks throughout the store and on a wall. Will be coming back!

Stopped by Supreme Shawarma in Chandler for lunch and it was excellent. Tried their chicken shawarma sandwich and it was really good, flavorful, and filling. Perfect lunch spot.

For dine-in, they also served a lentil soup for free, which was such a nice touch. It was warm, comforting, and honestly very yummy.

Great food, generous hospitality, and a place that makes you want to come back. I’d definitely recommend Supreme Shawarma and I’ll be returning for sure.

A Hidden Gem! Supreme Shawarma is truly a hidden gem! The moment we walked in, we were impressed by how cute and aesthetic the interior was — such a cozy and welcoming vibe. The prices are super reasonable, especially considering how high-quality and absolutely delicious the food is. We were pleasantly surprised when they brought out complimentary lentil soup while dining in — such a thoughtful touch that really added to the overall experience and value. We’re so glad we stumbled on this place and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

Supreme Shawarma has a very signature mediterranean taste. The food reminds me of the flavors of Greece and it comes out fast! The complimentary lentil soup is very flavorful and the atmosphere is serene. If you’re feeling adventurous, or you’re craving one amazing gyro, I would consider stopping by.

First off, very friendly upon entering. Noticibly clean and no off putting smells.
Had the chicken schwarma sit down option. Free lentil soup that was delicious. The plate was very full and filling and a great value for the money. Also had a pistachio baklava, which was divine.

Overall, great little hole in the wall.

This place has excellent food and service.  The hummus is top notch.  Lentil soup is thick and flavorful. The schwarma plate is always a special treat and you will easily get two meals out of it.  I’m always shocked there aren’t more people eating here.  It’s a treasure!  Please pass on my compliments to the chef today!
I've been seeing these on TikTok, so I decided to come try them out. The food was really delicious. Have plenty of options to fill. No man who left absolutely five stars will be coming back!

Great place!! If you are looking for a "homemade" breakfast or lunch, this is the place to go, GREAT POPUSAS! Beans are amazing, chesse and chicharron too, they also have seafood and beers available, they serve you freshly homemade tortillas, definitely I'm going back to try more dishes and more things of the menu, I highly recommend this place.

We decided to step outside our comfort zone for dinner today. It's been quite awhile since we have had Salvadoran food. Our favorite place was Eliana's on McDowell road and 24th street. They had the most amazing food. It's hard to find another place that is close to it.

We ordered a 2 dinner plates with 2 pupusas and 1 tamal plus plantains with beans and sour cream. I don't remember a tamal being so mushy and it had chicken bones in it. So be careful when eating their tamals.

The pupusas were definitely a little bigger in size and much thicker than I remember. I wish it had a little more cheese in it. The vinegar cabbage was more like a coleslaw but it wasn't crunchy or vinegary. I'm not saying it must be all vinegar flavor but it felt like that it must be a few days old that it lost its crunch and freshness.

It was my first time having an Mexican Coca-Cola in a glass bottle and it was delicious 😋. It brought back a memory where I use to add peanuts 🥜 to the coke bottle. That was bitter sweet to remember.

I'm glad they had a warning sign that said that each order is made to order and that patience is an understanding when ordering. We weren't greeted when we entered but when they took our order she had a friendly smile ☺️.

The atmosphere is definitely a "chilled" one and uncanny that it's a little warm because I think they run a swamp cooler. They were playing music but it was on low which was fine with me.

Not sure if we will be back but it did quench our craving for pupusas and plantain 😋.

Happy eating 😋

Amazing food! My Fiancé and I have come here a couple times for Papusas, Tamales, and some great ceviche! All of it is FANTASTIC here! Super fresh they make everything to order. Brush up on your Spanish there is a little bit of a language barrier but the ladies are very nice and helpful! Will definitely be returning here it's one of our new favorites places!

Very clean mens room. Very tasty mango smoothy. Very tasty breakfast. The pupusas are very tasty and made to order. The fried plantains are like candy. The El Salvadoran Cole Slaw is refreshing and not sweet. A tiny bit spicy. The  scrambled eggs and black beans and rice were well made.

name: Stacy's off Da Hook Soulfood & BBQ

reviews.author_name: Glass Ceiling Construction Shatter The Glass
reviews.text:
My man and I visited this location for the 1st time.  It was OK, not too bad.  My Baby liked his food. He had the 2 meat plate with ribs and fish. I had the fish plate.  The mac and cheese tasted like horrible powered milk flavored pasta. I asked the cook (who was a little on the not rude, but not nice side either)

He just kept saying "that's how we make it, that's all we got. You want something else ?"

So I went to ask what was in the macaroni,  I Think He was anticipating "a complaint " from me, so he already had an attitude.  I Genuinely was just asking because Sometimes people cook with different ingredients,  Sometimes you've never tasted it before and the food may not be Nasty it may just be an ingredient you've never had before that throws your taste off.
I was inquiring about that. He had a negative attitude.  I didn't like that Especially when you Pre-Pay the tip in the order. I tipped 11 on 50. So a 20% tip Before I ever saw the presentation or tasted the product,  With a nasty attitude is a Literal cocktail of "How to Ruin a Black Owned Business."

We May try them again,  probably not tho.

PS.
The greens and cornbread are 5STARS!

Opened 2010 should've closed down same day. Men were rude, except for the 2 that took my order. Their uniform shirts were dirty. They all looked like they hadn't slept in days. Smelled like cigarettes. Food was nasty. I wouldn't go there again if there was a famine. Horrible horrible horrible. Don't revamp it, burn it down to the foundation, then rebuild with peopo that really do no how to cook. They made me go straight to the grocery store buy ingredients and the next day I cooked catfish,greens, black eyed peas and homemade cornbread. And it was delicious.

I was curious about this place and finally got to drop by yesterday! I wanted to get the oxtail but didn't know it was Weekends only, so my partner and I got dinner combos with a peach cobbler. It took a while for our food to arrive but it was fine sitting inside of the restaurant waiting. I had the BBQ ribs with fried okra and mac n cheese. It was superbly done. The sauce was great with some heat, the ribs were done well and soft with great flavor, and the sides were amazing too! The peach cobbler was really great and I wish I ordered 2 since it was hard to share. Decadent with soft dough and baked peaches. My partner got the catfish dinner which was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Our food was hot and tasty, with great breading and frying. Highly recommend this place and looking forward to trying more of the different dishes. Make sure to tip them well!

The Mac and cheese keeps changing. I just ordered 2 dinners with Mac and cheese. The Mac and cheese is literally plain noodles that doesn't taste like it's Mac and cheese. I also got yam as well those were bland and definitely not how they were from when they 1st opened. I paid $20 for each meal and very disappointed. Adding on to my comment from my food experience that I had 11/5/2025. Now when I 1st tried this restaurant the food was off the hook it was amazing. Now it's not the same as before. The yams don't taste the same, the Mac and cheese is never the same. I had the fried chicken and there was no flavor at all. I also order the fried pork chops for my other half and he didn't even finish it, ended up throwing it away once again no flavor in the food. Not only that they used the wrong type of pork chops for frying. The best chops to use for frying are the bone in ones. For the amount of money people spend at these places every bite should be the same. Can I cook these same meals at home yes, but there are times where we want to get someone else to cook it lol. This was not it! Like I stated back when they had what was the family working in there the food was good. Now I just will not spend my money there no more to keep getting disappointed. Hopefully they can bring back whoever it was that used to cook the food. The yams were actually candied, Mac and cheese was actually baked and the food was seasoned well. Not only that people ordered sides and then after they paid and had been waiting for their food, to only be told they didn't have it. The many years that I have worked and cooked in restaurants they need to come up with a new system also get someone to go in and deep clean the place. The soda machine looks like it hasn't been cleaned since they opened and from the dripping I saw from it, it needs to be serviced. BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL COOK!!!

Finally! A soul food restaurant where the food is good in this town! It’s not super salty or fatty with the cuts of the meats, I appreciate that. The cornbread is moist and fish was good too. Coming from a South Georgia girl, this is southern approved. (I didn’t try the drinks so you are on your own with that)

AMAZING!
Took our mother for dinner, we enjoyed it so so much!
Sitting outside was lovely, and the music added to the ambiance.
Our favourite dishes were the shrimp starter, the goat cheese dip, and the oxtail entrée.
Great cocktails and mocktails too! Impeccable service!

So many layers of flavors and textures for every dish - appetizer, main, and dessert. Our server told us that “Latha” means “flavor” in Swahili - appropriately named! We tried the watermelon salad, vegetable moqueca, adobo rubbed pork chop (super tender), and chocolate brigadeiro torte. Would recommend all of them. I could go on about each one. The live music was awesome too. Validated parking in the garage nearby. Great service.

Amazing spot!! The people and the vibes are beautiful and they made an early celebration of my friends bday unforgettable! Would highly recommend to pull up. We did Brunch but will definitely be returning to try their dinner menu.

We started with the Whipped Goat Cheese, which was beautifully presented, and we really liked the mildly savory cheese with the honey and the accompanying chapati. I think it was a touch too sweet though, and the black garlic component was overshadowed. The Honey Hot Wings had a nice heat level and great crisp on the skin. For the mains, we began with the Pineapple Piri Piri Chicken and while I loved the seasoning and cook on the chicken, I wasn't a fan of the labneh being layered beneath the surprisingly mild jollof rice. We also got the Lamb Tajine which we enjoyed with the spiced curry and pickled onions. The best dish of the night was the Chocolate Brigadeiro Torte for sure. Super well balanced, not too sweet, and the mousse made for a perfect bite with the chocolate and whipped cream.

The food was excellent and the service was incredible.  Peri Peri was a bit more fruity and less spicy than my preference but had excellent flavors.  The curried lamb was very good but the hangar steak with black garlic was phenomenal.  We literally spoke about how good the bread was that came with the burnt onion hummus the whole drive home.  It seemed like everyone there was celebrating a birthday and I can see why.  Don't be afraid of the avocado crema on the chocolate torte.  It sounds weird but it paired very well.  The guy behind me was raving about his oxtail so we will have to try that next time.  Can't wait to go back.

This place is honestly such a hidden gem and really underrated! I had one of the best meals I’ve ever had in Phoenix here. The Hawaiian jerk chicken was bursting with flavor and tasted like absolute heaven, while the fries were perfectly crispy and seasoned just right. The atmosphere was another highlight—it felt cozy, pretty, and calming, which made the whole dining experience even better. The staff were also friendly and welcoming, which added to the good vibe. I’ll definitely be coming back soon and recommending it to my friends.
The food and service were fantastic.  Drinks were delicious.  Perfect place to meet your people.

Went here after work with some coworkers,  it was Wednesday,  so happy hour prices until 10pm. Mocktails and cocktails were the same price so why not try some fun concoction. I had a Dr.Funk drink, it was amazing,  also tried the bites, yum. Definitely will be back to try some other fruity drink!

Food was very tasty, but I would have liked more.   They worked well at making it a themed restaurant, including the bathrooms.  There was plenty of food choices, and recommend a visit just for the experience.

Ordered 2 drinks both were pineapple n orange based little on sweeter side but at the bottom felt good during happy hour, in food ordered sweet potato fries with dips which was yummy and main course went with jerk chicken which so so yum

with highly customizable & delicious bowls, we stopped by farm and craft scottsdale for a group lunch! there’s something for everyone on their health conscious menu, with a variety of fun drinks and juices

I was really looking forward to trying Farm & Craft since it kept showing up as a top healthy lunch spot in the Scottsdale/Phoenix area—but I wouldn’t go back.

I had an OpenTable reservation, yet when I arrived, I learned they don’t take lunch reservations. It’s an order-at-the-counter setup where you grab your own water, pick a seat, and wait.  Totally fine for us, but just a heads up to the restaurant to work with OpenTable on availability.  Service was fine, but it still took about 10–15 minutes for food at noon on Black Friday.

* The salmon poke bowl was a big miss—room-temp salmon, soggy coleslaw, an overwhelming amount of edamame, and barely any greens.
* The steak wrap tasted good but was very soggy, as was the side salad
* The balsamic mushrooms didn’t have any balsamic flavor—more like generic steak seasoning—and the unseasoned almonds on top didn’t help.

Overall, not the fresh, flavorful experience I was hoping for.

We went here the morning after a bachelorette night and it was perfect! Cute atmosphere, great healthy and whole food options (vegan, vegetarian, and gluten free options), and yummy drinks! Inside and outdoor dining, definitely recommend as a rejuvenating meal.

We have been here many times now, each time the food tastes as good as it looks, which is mouth watering! The staff works very hard and efficient even though they seem a tiny bit under staffed. They’ve always been upbeat, compassionate and professional. I love their gluten free and vegetarian options since that’s what my partner is restricted in eating. It’s refreshing to have food in a restaurant that cares about how healthy and customizable their food is. I’ve tried just about every bowl they are all incredible. The sweet potatoes are yummy! You can’t go wrong ordering anything here, safe part of the neighborhood and beautiful atmosphere sitting outside or in
Shout outs to Aussies looking for actual good coffee! Pancakes were great, had a delicious savory after taste. Big portions! 🤟🏻Cheers mate 🇦🇺

Hummus Express came to my neighbourhood, and I ordered the grilled chicken shawarma platter with lamb gyro, topped with tzatziki sauce. It was so good- a truly authentic Mediterranean experience. If you love Mediterranean food, you should definitely try it. Even the pita was infused with herbs, which made it even better.

The best part, though, was the beef and chicken kebabs that my girlfriend tried—they were absolutely amazing.
Delicious authentic Mediterranean food! The price is great too. I stopped into the store but they also have a food truck and cater as well.

Nothing remarkable here. The rice was bland and mushy with random crunchy bits that might’ve been scorched or just abandoned to dry out. Either way, yuck! The salad lacked feta. The chicken was okay. Skip this place

I used to eat here all the time, but haven’t been in many years. I’m so grated that this place is still open & still just as delicious as I remember. It’s priced really well for such quality. My favorite is the braised beef bowl.

The combo plate was absolutely amazing, cooked to perfection. The fresh pita bread was made on order. The gyros are even better than the ones I had in downtown New York City. The service was second to none, very polite and courteous. I can't wait for the mobile service to come back to my area again. Thanks again

I bought knafeh this afternoon, and when I got home and opened the box, I found it heavily moldy, even though the expiration date says March 2026 (and we are currently in December 2025). This clearly shows very poor storage by the shop.
I honestly don’t understand how the Health Department allows this place to sell food of such poor quality. This is a serious violation and the shop should be fined and inspected according to the law.
A terrible experience! I will not be buying anything from this place again. Can you imagine the health risk this could cause? I'll file an official complaint!

Nice place for Indian Spices/masala’s.
Fresh Meat (chicken/beef/Lamb) in low price.

Freshest meat in town and freshest vegetables and cleanest vegetables in all of Arizona.   Come and shop value and quality.  Arizona best keep secret
Lamb is juicy.  Cucumber is crispy  and tasty 😋
if u want fresh Halal meat.. this is the place to go. It's taste so much better than other stores meat. You can taste the difference.  I don't buy my chicken, beef or lamb anywhere else

I bought the ground beef and liked it. One day I went to purchase more and noticed the liquid dripping from the ceiling of the meat display directly on the meat itself. Long story short I left without the meat. I advised two female workers and left. 3 weeks later(8/22/2025)I visited again, still has liquid falling on to the meat. I left again without purchase, but now I am obligated to review them.

Whimsical? Yes! Creative? You bet!

My first stop after hopping off the olde flying sardine can, and boy was I impressed.

Pastries were the highlights here.  Some of the most beautifully crafted croissants with the perfect, not too buttery, crunch. Sublime is an understatement.

The Tres Leches French Toast made with sorghum and squash brioche was a different combination of unexpected, yet delightful, flavors.

Mesquite smoke trout roe and yuzu mayo on a hot dog?  LOLZ!  I don’t know what to say other than it was sooooo incredibly good!  Recommended pairing : a hearty serving of chile-aioli tater tots.

What kind of beaker wielding nerd comes up with this deliciousness?

Highly recommend.

The avocado toast was very interesting! It came with green apple which actually was balanced out by all the flavors. The chai was very spicy and it left a taste in my throat which I wasn’t against but it provided as a cleanser in other foods.

A side of cornbread was small but it was unique.

All the food we got was good! The drinks took a bit long. I wish the chef that won the award was still there.

We stopped at Valentine for brunch and shared the burger and tater tots, the little gem salad with smoked trout, and the French toast. The savory dishes were delicious and well prepared. The French toast was like a dessert, very sweet sauces.

There were also a huge collection of house made pastries that looked great but we didn’t have room to try them.

What an absolute gem of a place. I was skeptical at first, but my wife said I would love it. They have the most amazing and unique drinks and foods. The vanilla corn cappuccino was off the charts good. Then I ordered the pretzel which came with a unique butter and honey, Tomato/tahini bread, and their Olive dish. Flavors that you never had before. This establishment opened in 2020 and survived Covid so that says a lot. I will definitely be going back and want to try some of their breakfast items next. Also, the staff was extremely friendly and knowledgeable.

Cool atmosphere. Attached to a vintage thrift store. Incredible coffee menu with exciting and inventive offerings. The brunch menu was robust and accommodating to many dietary needs. Only 4 stars instead 5 because of texture issues. The BLT was soggy and the tacos lacked any form of crunch or bold taco flavor. The star was the bowl of tots, crisped to perfection, smothered in aoli and topped with seeds for a fun twist.

I wanted to try a new bbq place to me. This one disappointed. Our server was great but the food was lackluster. First there are no bbq plates until 5pm. Bummer. I had wings which were okay. Pulled pork has no smoke on it at all. None. My friend had the brisket nachos and the brisket was dry. Clearly yesterday’s leftovers.

Location isn’t easy to find and is a bland clubhouse.

There are too many good bbq places in Phoenix for me to ever return.

Tucked deep within the Hilton resort grounds, Hole in Wall BBQ offers a casual and inviting atmosphere. With its unassuming name and reputation, I arrived with high expectations. While the experience was pleasant overall, the meal delivered a mix of highs and lows.

First, the setting. Despite ongoing construction that limits parking and requires a bit of navigation, the space is remarkably clean. The staff is incredibly warm and attentive. There was no wait to be seated, and the tables offer ample space for those with mobility challenges. These elements created a welcoming and relaxed environment to begin the evening.

The menu is modest, which often signals a focus on quality. I opted for the Smoked St. Louis Ribs with grilled vegetables and fries. The ribs arrived fall-off-the-bone tender, a promising start but lacked the depth of seasoning expected from a barbecue establishment. The sauce leaned heavily toward store-bought familiarity rather than a house-crafted blend with unique character.

The grilled vegetable side was notably underwhelming. Composed almost entirely of onions with a sparse showing of bell peppers, it missed the balance expected from the menu description. However, the fries and onion rings were both crisp and expertly executed; a highlight of the plate.

It is worth noting that the team is currently operating out of a food truck instead of a full-service kitchen. This certainly explains some of the constraints in execution. I chose not to rate this experience lower because of the genuinely pleasant atmosphere and the staff’s evident dedication to service.

Hole in Wall BBQ has potential. Once construction is complete and operations return to a traditional kitchen setup, I look forward to revisiting. There is heart behind the hospitality. With a few culinary adjustments, this could become a standout destination in Phoenix's BBQ scene.

We stopped in for dinner at the Hole-In-the-Wall restaurant our first night in Phoenix, while staying at the Hilton Resort and Retreat.

The restaurant decor is fun and rustic. I was surprised with how slow the restaurant was considering they are the only restaurant on site that was open for a late night dinner.
