The hostess was attentive and kind, and sat us right away. Her fun, black heart shaped glasses were also super cool and definitely added some personality to her work attire! Points to her for her fashion choice for sure!

The service was a bit on the slow side, unfortunately. This was shocking considering how slow the restaurant was. As a patron of the establishment, and former waitress myself for many, many years, I couldn’t help but notice the clumps of servers standing around and chatting due to how slow the restaurant was. This would be fine normally, because I get it, but there were also times we weren’t able to get refills on our drinks due to the lack of attentiveness by the staff.

The food was good though. The nachos were outstanding! Definitely flavorful and loaded enough to satiate one to three people. My house salad was also tasty and  filled me up well. My husband had the turkey club and mac n cheese. He loved the mac n cheese specifically.

Honestly, this was a good little stop for some late night dinner. My hope is that the restaurant will upgrade as the Hilton does because there is some untapped potential here to be capitalized on. Overall, a good experience though all things considered!

If you’re looking for breakfast with smiles and even more massive portions, look no further. I walked in, and every server was smiling like they’d all just won a lifetime supply of coffee …. 😄 contagious cheer everywhere! They asked if I wanted to sit inside or outside. I went for inside, thinking the sun could wait (note to self: wear sunscreen next time). Inside turned out to be just fine, though, because I got a front row seat to Jeff, my server extraordinaire.

Jeff knew the menu like the back of his hand and guided me to some stellar choices, which ended up being a brilliant decision. When my food arrived, I realized this place doesn’t mess around with portions … they serve up mountains! And the freshness? Top-notch. They brought out yogurt and fruit that looked like it had just taken a detour from the farmer’s market. I’m talking bright, juicy berries and creamy yogurt that made the whole meal feel like a spa day for my taste buds.

Overall, I left happily with a full belly and already planning my next trip. Just bring an appetite and maybe some sunscreen if you’re feeling brave enough for the patio in this bright sunny paradise!

Background music was 70s and 80s not too loud.  Beer wasn't real cold but acceptable.   Folks were enjoying the pool.  Weather was perfect, cooler than usual but nice.  72°
Food came out in a good time.  Brisket not too lean and not too fatty.  Just right.   Macaroni and cheese, definitely from scratch.
Server was James and he was great.
Only 4 stars because of the beer not being very cold.

Will I be back, yes.
Always a great experience from an experienced Braider. I've been getting my  crown braided and twist with Lea for a year and half and never a bad experience!
Lea left bald spots all over my head from too much tension after recommending a style to me after not wanting to do the style i asked for. Worst braiding experience I’ve ever had in my life

name: The Buffalo Spot East Camelback Rd. Phoenix , Arizona. 85016 USA

html_attributions: The Buffalo Spot East Camelback Rd. Phoenix , Arizona. 85016 USA

vicinity: 1831 E Camelback Rd Suite B-3, Phoenix

reviews.text: My daughter and I ordered 2 combos, an order of boneless wings and traditional wings. The lemonade was watery, the fries were soggy and had little to no taste to them. The wings were okay except for the overly vinegar taste. I’m highly disappointed because we love the Buffalo spot.
Me and my wife tried Buffalo spot for the first tonight. Luis was amazing. Super patient and helped us pick the best meal. Great customer service. 10/10

This is the best place for wings. Even the boneless wings are made fresh daily from fresh-cut chicken breasts, not frozen chicken nuggets thrown in the fryer. The flavors are great, and the onion rings are excellent as well.

This food was so good for buffalo chicken! I loved the fries. No spice but flavor was on point. Really didn’t like the tv on in the back playing some music videos with things I didn’t want to see. Loved the ESPN one though.

I had an amazing experience at this Buffalo Spot! Vicky, our cashier, was incredibly patient with our group of five as we couldn't quite decide on our order. She made the process so much easier. Ashley was also wonderful—when I mentioned my allergy, she made sure everything was taken care of and safe for me. Both of them were friendly, attentive, and made our visit enjoyable. I've definitely bookmarked this spot for my next trip to Phoenix. Huge thanks to Vicky and Ashley for such great service! :)

I was very impressed when I approached the restaurant. Its a nice house with a huge patio and plenty of intimate outdoor seating. We sat inside and it was like walking into a friends home. The decor is very nice. I loved the hardword floors and the African decor.  They have a littlebgify shop that sells African clothibg for men, women, and children. They have soaps, coffee, nick nacks, jewelry and much more that you can purchase.
We started with cocktails. The old fashion and a nice spice to it. The mojito was very refreshing.  We had the hummus and bread; absolutely delicious. The burgers that we had melted in our mouths. They were grilled amd so was the bun. The bun had a light sweetness. We had a side salad of arugula with it. The owner stopped by our table to ensure that we were enjoying our experience, therefore, the customer service was great! We had a chance to speak with the chef before we left and he seems to love cooking up those good meals; which means he cooks with love. Thats important and appears to be the secret ingredient. We were told they have live carribean music on the patio on Saturday nights.
I can’t say enough about how great the food, staff and atmosphere here is! The food is amazing, made with fabulous quality ingredients; the whipped goat cheese was the best appetiser I’ve ever had!
This place has been an incredible surprise. Food is delicious and staff is incredible. We cannot recommend this restaurant more. Even our two picky kids loved EVERYTHING!!!

This was our first time.  We ordered Papusa'a , green tamale, red tamale and platino, with bean & cream. The papusas are thin and was a bit burnt. It was ok. The salsa / cortido was ok. The red tamale was the best and had great flavor.  The green tamale was realy mushy and sweet. They do not offer chips / salsa. The sever was very nice. She seated us took our order. After we got our food.  We didn't see her again. The Atmosphere was best! Music 🎶 and loved the lighting.

I’m in here right now and the food is delicious,seen some reviews where people say the ladies here aren’t aware of customers ,but our server was great couldn’t get her name  but she has a neck tattoo ,she was really helpful and had such a positive attitude ,i felt very welcomed and she was quick ,definitely would be back !
Food is so delicious.  Very welcoming environment.  Super friendly service.

BEAUTIFUL atmosphere! The service was so welcoming, so friendly and excited to talk about their pupusas.
We tried the chicharron pupusas and the loroco pupusa. THEY WERE SO BOMB. And the price being just under $5/pupusa is a steal tbh. Less than I pay at the swapmeet!

Pupusas were delicious.
Went w a friend and my partner. I got 2 revueltas and 1 chile con queso. They were so good but i didnt expect the chile to be so spicy lol i got platanos fritos and casamiento as my side and they did not disappoint. We tried eachothers sides and i can honestly say i enjoyed everything we had. The chorizo and queso were good, the complimentary chips and beans were so good. The ensalada de fruta was also really good. I ordered an atole de elote to go and the server said she would keep it up front for me. Well, it wasnt. I stood at the register for about 5 minutes before i was acknowledged and then was told that my atole was not ready yet and was a 5 minute wait that actually turned out to be 10. Ladies were too busy on their phone to care.
Another down side is how dirty this place is, needs a deep clean like 5 years ago.
The food is good, but i will probably never dine in again, takeout only.

We arrived at 12PM. We ordered two plates, one brisket the other pulled pork. The brisket was a bit too dry, but to quote my wife "the sauce is the only thing saving it".

To my tastes, the sauce was a sweet and tangy with a small amount of heat. Not my favorite, but not the worst sauce. It is a thin sauce, easy to pour from the Styrofoam cup it comes in.

The pulled pork was juicy and delicious, no problems with it. The bun started coming apart from the juiciness though... Better buns might help.

The fries could use more seasoning. Unfortunately the fries don't add much to the taste combo when they are just fried potatoes with a few specks of seasoning...

The Mac N Cheese is delicious and creamy with some pepper in it. It stole the show. But if I wanted good Mac N Cheese, I can make that at home. I came for good meat and potatoes, and those could be better.

All in, it's okay. If I was seeking the best BBQ in town, I'd keep looking from here.

Honey Bear’s BBQ has been a personal favorite of mine for over a decade, dating all the way back to when they were located in downtown Phoenix. It’s one of those places that leaves a lasting impression from the first bite, and after all these years, the quality has stayed just as high. When it comes to BBQ, they really know what they’re doing. The flavor is always rich, smoky, and well balanced, and the meat no matter what you order just falls apart effortlessly.

One of the standout things for me has always been how tender their BBQ meats are. Whether it’s brisket, pulled pork, or ribs, the texture is just right every time. There’s never any chewing struggle everything just melts in your mouth. That kind of consistency is rare these days, especially in spots that have been around this long. Their BBQ spicy sauce also adds the perfect touch without overpowering the natural flavors of the meat.

And the sides? Just as impressive. From their beans to the mac and cheese, everything complements the main dish perfectly. You can tell they put just as much care into the sides as they do the meats, which isn’t always the case at other BBQ joints. Every plate feels like a full, complete meal comfort food done right. You walk out full and satisfied without needing anything extra.

I also have to give major credit to their customer service. Every time I’ve visited, I’ve been greeted with a warm welcome and friendly service. Most recently, we decided to go on Father’s Day, fully expecting a long wait and a packed dining area. To our surprise, we were given the food in just 20 minutes, and the dining area was surprisingly relaxed. It made for an even better experience not rushed, not crowded, just good food in a comfortable setting.

Honey Bear’s BBQ continues to be a top-tier spot in Phoenix in my eyes. They’ve been doing it right for over 10 years, and I don’t see myself stopping any time soon. Between the quality of the food, the friendly staff, and the consistently great experiences, it’s a place that earns every return visit. Whether you’re a BBQ lover or just looking for a satisfying meal, you really can’t go wrong with Honey Bear’s.

Came in on a Tuesday night  ordered the 4 meat combo with 3 sides no rolls or bread comes with the combo got food quick and then cashier was friendly but the food is so not athletic bbq every thing is giving oven hot links taste like hotdogs 🤢 pulled pork wasn’t juicy the baked beans were from the can with just bbq sauce added to them the Mac n cheese from the box was mid potato salad from the box was okay had to ask for bread to go with the pulled pork

I had a brisket sandwich and a bag of chips to go from this place, and boy was I disappointed when I opened up my bag.

First, my sandwich wasn't even assembled. They had a small hamburger bun wrapped in aluminum foil separate from the meat. The meat was in a container. The bun wasn't toasted, buttered, or warm; just a sorry, little dry bun. I had never had a deconstructed brisket sandwich before in my life!

Second, they don't give you any onions or pickles with the sandwich, but they do give you BBQ sauce. The sandwich is more than $15, so they should at least give you more than meat, BBQ sauce, and a little dry hamburger bun. The sandwich definitely is not worth the price, and the meat-to-bun ratio was way off.

Third, I should have known that something wasn't right when my order was ready within four minutes of placing it. There was no thought put into my order at all.

I know Phoenix isn't known for BBQ, but good grief, this sandwich could have been much better. I do not recommend this place, and I definitely won't be going back.
Pleasant experience overall, but I wish the brisket came out more tender. Otherwise delicious & great service! Get the Kool-aid for sure, reminds me of childhood!

Super laid back bar with a good vibe. The service is great! There are a lot of fun events and games going on many nights a week.
We saw a live band play last weekend. We had so much fun and will definitely be back.

Great neighborhood bar that I have been to several times. Always consistent with their food. The wings, deep fried tacos, playa burger and the fish tacos are really good..Beer selection is solid with a variety of ice cold bottles from a been bin. The tap selection covers your basics. The bartenders are all friendly and a couple of them in particular have a great snarky attitude. Drop in and give it a shot.

The bartender made my day by satisfying my thirst for a cold fresh drink. She was friendly, honest, and, professional. I purchased two of the their tees to support the night shifts power trip. The night shift staff aren't too for executing outstanding customer service. They will kick you out when your having too much fun. You can't show any signs of happiness or excitement. So, I'll just drop in during the day and avoid happy, rush hours, whenever that time comes around. I don't think I'll order any food here. But, I'm rating it a five star jus cause

Playa Bar is the perfect spot for a fun neighborhood night out. The ambiance is fantastic--relaxed yet lively, with a lot of regulars. The food is top-notch, flavorful, and clearly made with care. Their jukebox has a great selection that keeps the energy up and the good times rolling. On top of that, the servers are consistently friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Also, a great place to play pool and experience live music.

Highly recommend Playa Bar if you're looking for great food, great music, and a place where you'll always feel at home.
Random dive bar i found with large menu and interesting clientele at 6pm on Saturday. I got the wrong order of the famous fried tacos, but the ground beef ones were still pretty good.

Great people and good service. I love this place and curious about the nightlife. We came in for football and had a fantastic time.
Accommodating for us as we are are an eclectic group but no problems taking care of us!

It's a great little place to sit back, watch the game and have a beer or two if you bring cash. The beer prices are really good too. The waitresses are the sweetest nicest waitresses ever and if you don't mind me staying, they're very attractive. It's nice. I had a great time chill. Watch the game. I like it cuz there was no drama at all
That purple turtle is one of my favorite local spots with amazing food and a chill and calm atmosphere. Great food and drink specials. Shout out to Mireya super awesome service

Went here for a birthday celebration and had such a good time! The bartender Michaylla surprised us with a round of shots and made sure we were taken care of all night. Great mix of people, good music, and plenty of seating. Highly recommend for groups or special occasions.

I would not recommend to anyone until they stop stealing from customers. I stop in here on Mondays for 50 cent wings. Today I ordered 12 wings at 50 cents a piece for 6.50,basket of fries for 5.50 and a one sprite for $3. The bill brought to me was for $22 dollars. When I asked the bartender why the bill was so much she explained she adds 50 cents  to every thing and then tax she told me to talk to the owner if I have problems with how I’m charged  . This same bartender that works every Monday the heavyset woman with long hair. So owner of Purple Turtle are you illegally uncharging your patrons ? Is your bartender horrible at math or is there criminal activity going in your establishment? This is not the first time I’ve been illegally up charged nor am I the only victim of this theft but this was the final time I was stolen from in this establishment.

The place was hot my oxtails were tough and lady was argumentative when I tried to tell her about it the Patty was so over seasoned and too hot I will never repeat. That was my first and my last time so disappointing not at all Jamaican an insult to Jamaican cooking a white potatoe they passing off as a dumplingI was gonna eat there but again the fans were blowing hot air so unprofessional this makes me wanna call the health department   It with government shutdown I doubt I get amywhere
So sad to make this review but i was once a regular but quality has changed big time! Lots of bone no Chana and 3 potatoes 😭 $17 i could’ve went to the store to cook my own goat.
This by far has to be the driest patty I have ever had. Sticking to Ocho Rios. Was not satisfied at all. Seem bold and stale.

Went in to grab some food since they are close to my apartment. So far I’ve tried the brown stew chicken and goat curry. They give you a packed tray of food with plantains, potatoes, and cabbage with your entree(rice included)

Extremely flavorful and delicious and well worth the price. Typically I eat half and then eat the rest for dinner as it’s a good portion

I’m going definitely try everything on the menu!

If you're missing real Trinidadian food, Caribbean Cuisine in Glendale hits the mark, especially with their curry goat roti—it satisfied my craving, even though I wanted dhalpuri. My wife wasn’t too impressed with the stew chicken, saying it tasted like it was made with pre-cooked meat. Still, the friendly staff, big portions, and overall vibe make it a solid spot for a taste of Trini culture in Arizona, even if the prices are a bit high.

Tried multiple items today and we loved them. Zinque is right next to fashion square outside Bloomingdale’s with plenty of parking. Lovely ambiance with sofas and nice patio outside. We tried quinoa burrito, falafel sandwich, tomato mozzarella panini and egg zucchini frittata. Out of all, falafel sandwich is the best with unique eggplant roasted in it, delicious. Quinoa burrito is pretty good, panini is a bit bland and frittata is just ok. But overall totally recommend it.

Zinqué was such a lovely experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The staff were kind and attentive without being overwhelming, and the atmosphere was cozy, calm, and perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. I’ll definitely be coming back again. Highly recommend it if you’re looking for good vibes and great food 👌

I’ve always loved this place — I’ve been coming here for about a year and a half, at least once a week. There used to be a lovely waitress who was always very kind, but during my last visit there were two male servers working, and they behaved extremely disrespectfully.

I came with my child and a stroller. They told me to wait, even though only a couple of tables were occupied. My child urgently needed to use the restroom, so I left the stroller by an outdoor table and then came back and sat down. No one approached us. I eventually went to the bar, and the waiter came over, but instead of apologizing he spoke to me very rudely and told me that I “must wait at the entrance.” There is no host at this restaurant, and I couldn’t stand and wait with a baby in my arms.

I left and later called to speak with a manager. The same waiter took my number and said someone would call me back, but I’m quite sure they threw away my number — no one ever contacted me.

I truly wish the management knew how their regular customers are being treated. This is a great place with good food, and I would happily continue coming if the service were respectful.

My wife and I had brunch there. We ordered  Dungeness Crab Omelette and Croque Madam and truffle French Fries. First food was great, although there was a hitch when the food first came out and instead of Crab Omelette they brought a Crab salad and the Croque Madam was missing the egg. Service Staff quickly fixed those items. The patio seating is very nice and faces the interior street in Kierland Marketplace though on a hotter day might need more shade. We didn’t really make any reservation or provide the hostess with the info that it was our anniversary. However, they did hear me and my wife talking about it and brought us a chocolate souffle as a special treat for the occasion.

I had the day off and decided to meet up with some friends for brunch with my little one! This restaurant is located in the back of the mall, near Nobu and Francine.

They have such a nice patio area, which would be great for the cooler months. Inside, there were plenty of seating options. They gave our table a high chair and took our order.

We had really great service for our meal and she was very attentive.

I ordered the crispy eggs with prosciutto, which came with bread and a bed of arugula. This was really good, and I feel like a pretty good value for prosciutto ($18.)

I also ordered their gluten-free blueberry banana bread for my son. It was nice that the bread was not overly sweet, as most banana breads can be.

This was a nice location for our little catch-up, and we would love to come again to enjoy their outdoor seating.

I have to say the pizza was very good. Right amount of crunch with good flavor from the sauce. Oregano and red pepper flakes were open to use. Staff was very friendly and when asked about beer recommendations they actually let me taste it. Unfortunately I'm only visiting but if I lived here this would undoubtedly be a go-to.

Only extra thing I'd add is you have to wait 5-10 min for them to reheat the slice but it's definitely worth it.

I found this place looking for a Dutch Bros and decided to be adventurous and try this pizza instead of DB. I am so glad I did. The customer service was A1! It was like walking into your friend's restaurant. They were very nice and welcoming. The pizza was really good as well. The sauce was delicious. This place was so good that I brought my family back 2 days later. We will definitely be back when are back on that side of town. Thanks for a great experience.

Great experience! The pizza was really good, we also got to try the new fried broccoli cheddar bites which were super good! The ranch was delicious, which is important to me at a pizza place! They even had ghost pepper ranch that was yummy. The man at the counter helped us decide what to order and was very friendly! I can’t wait to go back!

Great customer service. The man behind the counter was very friendly and helpful.  He took his time explaining the menu options and made some appetizer suggestions which turned out to be very good.  The actual restaurant isn't very fancy or large but the pizza was as good as any I have had lately and better than most.
I will choose Zesty Zzeeke's over the larger chains in the future.

Came in for the weekend after Monster Jam 2025 and found this gem before we had to catch our flight. Had a large group and the owner was very accommodating  and helpful. Pizza and wings were great. The owner even treated us to some great dessert. Definitely stopping by again next time we are in the area.

I love this place! The food is incredible. Highly recommend getting the jerk pasta and oxtails. I cannot get enough of those items. Their alcohol options are great too, very nice drinks and I think the prices are fair for both the drinks and food options. Only reason I rated a 4 star is due to always having to wait a little while when I walk into the restaurant. Everyone is usually in the back, hidden from view and it takes a few minutes to get someone to notice you and sit you down. However once you do get a table, the staff is very nice and the food is really great! So it’s definitely still worth trying this place out!

I went here with some friends and we enjoyed the service, food, and each other's company. Everything on the menu sounded so good and we had a hard time deciding what we wanted. In the end everyone was satisfied with what they chose. The food was delicious. We will be back to try other menu items.

Food is always delicious here! This is in my opinion the best Caribbean joint in Arizona. If you crave delicious oxtail jerk chicken and curry goat you will be so happy if you come here! The chef is phenomenal and the food is always so flavorful! I crave the food because it just is the perfect blend of flavor and Spice!!

Anyone looking for a good Caribbean food experience needs to show this spot some love because they bring the service, the flavor, the atmosphere and the whole vibe! My go-to dish is the jerk chicken over rice and a side of fried plantains 🤤 and they never disappoint! The portions are generous, enough to share or eat half now and the other half later, but either way...you're leaving fat and happy 😁

The food and service was amazing. The oxtail was well cooked and tender and flavorful while the conch salt fish fritters were cooked to perfection and the sauce paired so well with it. The beef patty was also amazing!

I love this place! Every time I go, the food is on point. Everything always tastes fresh. I started coming here because of convenience. I keep coming back because it tastes better than everywhere else I've been.

Don't waste your money, the rice taste like it 5 days old , it not fresh. I was so disappointed. I bought 30 dollars of food. I paid why cant I get what I paid for. Rude lady in the front serving my food. I had to ask her to wash her hand. She handle money and food.

This place is awful.Dirty,food is bad & not cooked right. Not fresh. No water in bathrooms or machines. Drinks are warm, not cold. Rice is not fresh. Ceiling fans dirty & gross. We all got sick from this place

THE WORST FOOD IVE EVER HAD. The crab puffs were so hard I couldn't even bite into them. Immediately went back and demanded a refund. Food tasted like it had been under a heat warmer for 2 days. I will NEVER go back. I hate this place.
Great flavored, hot and delivered quick! Price was reasonable fed a family of 4 for $30 before delivery and tip charge. Would order again!
Tenders look like they’ve been sitting out for hours!! Super hard and stale. Waste of money! I recommend to Check your bag BEFORE you leave. Seems like this location loves to give out old food

The restaurant stink like they mop with old expired milk the employees clothes were dirty not from the day like old dryer up stains. I will never eat here again in life and might not ever eat at another wing stop. Overcharging for those huge nasty wings.

I've been to this wing stop multiple times as a  delivery person, but i never ordered for myself. This time, though, I had 2 large orders and the young lady at the front was very helpful. Brooklyn made sure both orders were completely correct before handing them over and she made sure that the lids were not leaky when she handed me all 5 drinks. She even helped me bring the orders out to my car. She was sweet, professional and she deserves Kudos for going above and beyond.
They took 40min to make my tenders I won't recommend this location based on that but food is good and hot

From the moment I pulled up to Jaguars, the experience was top-notch, and it all started with the incredible door girl, Yaya. She's absolutely stunning—gorgeous smile, radiant energy, and that welcoming vibe that instantly makes you feel like a VIP. Yaya greeted me with such warmth and charm; she made checking in fun and flirty, setting the perfect tone for the night ahead.

The club itself lives up to the hype with amazing entertainment, great atmosphere, and attentive staff all around. But honestly, Yaya at the door is the standout—she's beautiful inside and out, professional yet playful, and truly elevates the whole visit. Can't wait to come back and see her shining at the entrance again!

Highly recommend Jaguars—five stars all the way! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

This was a good time. First time as a couple and the guys at the door were awesome. I believe they’re names were Ricardo and Enrique.  Staff, dancers and the girls serving drinks and food were super nice.  Good time, not awkward at all and the dancers were very respectful   Definitely will go back.  Thanks guys. Sam and Lorena.
Very welcoming since the start, talented dancers, beautiful servers, food was delicious wish the girl herself was on the menu 😍😍 Ari was also such a delight! Never a dull moment when she’s around ❤️

Best club in town strip club or not! Any kinda girl you want you will find and it has a crazy amount of girls there getting dances getting wild also! Vide is incredible!!! Also Ken the manager is was 1 of the best managers I’ve dealt with over the of clubbing!
I love jags! I always have a great time and the service is exceptional. Hondo always makes sure that I’m taken care of and Ash in the vip is my favorite bartender

I haven't been to a Cane's in so long so I was excited to grab a gallon of lemonade and 2 meals. Come to find hair in the chicken tenders, the lemonade was also super watered down and like if it was left over or just being made. I went super early in the morning around 950am. I would have been ok if they told me that the lemonade wasn't ready or they were out rather than paying for almost water. Such a bummer since I used to love Cane's. I will not be back to anymore locations, let alone will not come back to this one.

Update: I called the number on the receipt and they took the information. The representative was super sweet and understanding, as well as patient.

Always a good experience at this location. Super friendly staff, the food is fresh and hot and the dining room and bathrooms were  clean. They had someone cleaning the dining tables as people were leaving so that was nice to see. Good drink selection and the outside seating was nice too.  Ask for the bread to be buttered on both sides, it's a game changer, also ask for hot sauce. Just learned they have honey mustard in case you don't like the canes sauce.

I selected curbside and my food was never brought out to me.  When I finally went in To get the food it was just sitting on the counter behind the cashier.  The place was nearly empty.  I was in a hurry and had no time to deal with the issue and did not know it had been sitting there for a while.  Went to eat as I drove and both mine and my kids order was cold and not edible.  Waste of $40.

This Raising Cane’s never disappoints! The chicken is always hot, crispy, and delicious, and the Cane’s sauce is unbeatable. The staff here is super friendly and welcoming, and they get the food out fast. The restaurant is clean, the vibe is fun, and you can tell they take pride in great service. Easily one of my favorite spots for chicken fingers!

I pull up to the window to pay and the girl says “box combo and sandwich?” I say yes. Get home expecting to eat the food I paid for and I don’t see a sandwich. Second time this has happened. This is my go to location. Disappointed.

okay so I go in and get my order taken, and the girl is taking my order and I ask for the seasoned fries but just puts regular fries, and tell me WHY my order had to take almost 30 minutes when it was just sitting there, without having my name shout out, and it’s cold and stuff. makes absolutely no sense to me. like I get it gets busy and stuff but there was like 2 tables and it was calm. but yeah don’t come to this location.

Ordered me some boneless wings and they gave me plain nuggets with no garlic Parmesan seasoning on them. No wrapper no nothing. When I picked up my order there was ranch spilt all in the bag and I open my ranch and there’s hair in it. Now I remember why I never returned back to this location the last time I went. Horrible service. It was 3 younger workers and the female at the front didn't seem too interested in doing her job.
The quality of food has gone down. There were feathers on some of the wings and weird white spots. Idk what is going on but definitely avoiding Wingstop from now on. Disgusting.

We had a lunch outing here and the service was very professional and friendly. It took a very long time to get our food, and the chicken was mildly warm to the touch, but the flavors were good and the fries were much warmer. The seating in the back is nice. The flies were present, but we still enjoyed our meal. I like the shared seating area with the other restaurants next door.
If the night crew spent more time cooking and less time talking, maybe orders would not take so damn long. I could have plucked ,cut up and cooked the chicken faster than what they did it in.

I had several meals at MATCH during my stay at Found:Re, and the food quality was consistently great! They bake their own croissants and desserts, and they were all excellent. The staff were a pleasure to interact with. It can get a bit busy on weekends, but I never waited more than 10 minutes. The Italian coffee was great, I love a well-made cappuccino!

I'm obsessed with this place! I came across Match after FEZ across the street closed (RIP). The Double Smash Burger is one of the best burgers I've ever had, and with all of the good burgers in the valley, this is high praise. All of the servers are very personable, and the atmosphere is perfect for a date night. If you're downtown I would highly recommend coming here.

I love places that are right along the light rail as they are convenient and great for people watching. This place also has the benefit of being located on a corner and also is adjoined to a hotel and art gallery that is fun to look at before or after you dine. Some outdoor seating is available too which is always nice. Was disappointed to have to go to a counter to order and then get beverages in bottles. The only service was when the meal came out, and that was 45 mins after I placed it. No chips to help pass the wait time either. My one carne asada and one sea bass street taco came out and the the shells were supermarket quality and pasty and not heated. Both tasted okay, but were not exceptional and in no way were worth the price.
The lunch counter ordering area should be visually separated from the bar/dining area and could be independently successful with lower pricing.

My team and I came here to celebrate my birthday and we all absolutely loved the atmosphere, the quality food, and the service.  They allowed my dog to sit inside as it was very hot outside, and brought him a large bowl of cold water. I love that it had a hotel with a lovely outdoor poor right next door.  Parking lot is surprisingly large, but nearly full when we arrived. I never knew about this place before today, but I am glad we came here, and I will definitely be coming back.

My husband and I are huge foodies. We stayed here at the hotel so we ate at Match several times. We are both blown away with every meal we had. The food is beyond amazing.  We will be back every time we come out here to Phoenix.  We both highly recommend eating here. The food,  atmosphere, and the service is fantastic! We can't wait to go back.

My first time here and this place was recommended by my wife's friend. My wife had a coctel and I had pulpo a la diabla. These dishes were so delicious and we plan on coming back. Our appetizer was a huge portion of multiple seafood tasty food. It's a Kora specialty. My wife and I had a great date meal!
Mariscos is one of my favorite type of foods. El Kora closes late so my family came here to eat. The band played good music but it is really loud you can’t really talk. The service was good though.
This place always hit the spot. Not once has it been trash. Always A1

New in town, decided to check this place as we are on the hunt for a good Mariscos place. I really wanted to like it since a local recommended it but NOPE! Food was bland tasted like it had been frozen. Worst part is both me and my boyfriend got food poisoning from it. He got sick first and I thought it was just him, but a couple of hours later it hit me too. They do have live music, I would recommend it only to drink and vibe. Do not eat here.

It was our first time here and we definitly enjoyed the food and music. The red and green aguachile plate was delicious and we also had the coctel de camarones and pulpo. We will definitely be back. The only drawback is we couldn't even talk, don't get me wrong though the music was awesome but just way too loud.

Had the meat combo for two. It was delicious! It was my friend’s first time having Ethiopian and he enjoyed it. All of the dishes in the combo were warm and tasty. Woman serving us was friendly and checked multiple times to see if we needed anything.

I am glad I chose to check this place out tonight and left feeling stuffed and content. Would go back again.

The google address points towards a hookah lounge, but it’s actually the next business over in the far corner.

This Ethiopian restaurant is a delight! The menu has a great selection, with vegan and non-veg platters that can easily feed 3-4 people. The injera is incredibly soft and light, alongside the flavorful dishes perfectly. The interiors are neat and beautifully designed, creating a warm ambiance. It’s a fantastic spot to explore Ethiopian cuisine, with excellent hospitality and service. The fresh, pulpy mango juice is a standout! Ample indoor seating and plentiful outdoor parking make it a convenient and inviting dining experience. Highly recommend!

First time visited this place and the foods are severed very quick and tasty. New experience and new taste and really liked it. Baklava dessert is delicious and it’s must try dishes. They have separate place for your traditional photo shoot which is awesome and cool.

Definitely a must try. If you’re Ethiopian you’ll feel right at home. Real authentic taste, and using all the Ethiopian ways of making the food, with real passion. Second time here and will be here whenever I’m in the area. 5⭐️ try the meat/veggie combo 👌🏾
Hole in the wall eatery. Only those who know about it are usual diners because the service is absolutely slow. The food is delicious. Disappointed they don't serve water for free.

Mine & my partners go to spot. He showed me a couple of years ago and we haven't stopped going since. Their chilequiles (verdes) are my personal favorite but their red ones are also very good! They have more than just breakfast options too that are really good! Not only is their food super delicious, but the authenticity of their services, and restaurant in general is very welcoming & amazing. I truly recommend!!
It’s for a Long time my best place to eat I highly recommend !! The food flavor it’s amazing!! The lady in the kitchen make excellent food the waitress is very kind

Came here once with my kids for breakfast cause we wanted pancakes they look good on the picture they have outside . We got some pancakes and they were so thin and dry very dry the strawberry’s they added on them were old the horchata was too sweet it was  like i took a sip of Sugar had to throw them away . The lady that took our order was very nice though .

Super sweet staff, Mexican soda available. The chips are fresh and delicious and this is some of the most flavorful salsa I've ever had.
There is a kids menu that has hamburgers. Pancakes and even nuggets! Today is Tuesday and they have tacos for 99c! We got one each of the beef, chicken and potato and they were outstanding, fresh and authentic. Real queso fresco & cotija! Yuuummmmm! Definitely returning.

This place definitely has authentic mexican food. I ordered huevos rancheros- my 2 side options were papas and green chilaquilles., and it came with breakfast steak on top. Holy moly.. the portions were great and everything was just full of flavor! My corn tortillas were homemade. They were amazing! We also ordered menudo, it had that yummy fresh taste and it had very good flavor.  I definitely recommend this place to any and everyone that loves Mexican food.  I can't wait to try different dishes here.
The food was okay. There were no menues beside the one scrible on a board, but with no prices. The ladies were not that friendly but okay service.  The prices were reasonable.

First experience — it was busy when we walked up, we still got extremely fast service. We ordered 2 plates; chicken flautas & fried chicken with bananas, and drank aguas frescas. The food was amazing!! I could eat it ALL DAY. Their sauce used is delicious. All together, everything tasted fantastic and I will be returning. The owner was there too, she was telling us how they’ve only been here 1.5 years but get so busy. Amazing!! Definitely head over here when you can.

Awesome food truck at the SW corner of 29th Drive and Van Buren. Easy to miss if you've never been here. Exactly next to a tire shop.

Lived in Honduras decades ago. Great service, food!

Nice cozy place, beautiful outdoor dining, amazing food. I had the Pollo con tajadas (chicken and friend plantains) and it was delicious. The portion was pretty big, enough to share. My mom also tried the baleadas and she loved them.
Excellent food and prices. Best authentic honduran cuisine in town. Baleadas are fantastic!

name: El New Yorican - Puerto Rican Food Truck

html_attributions: El New Yorican - Puerto Rican Food Truck

vicinity: behind grace walk church, 7840 W Lower Buckeye Rd, Phoenix

reviews.text: I recently placed a catering order with El New Yorican Puerto Rican food truck and everything was absolutely on point. The yellow rice was flavorful and perfectly cooked the pernil Was tender juicy in season just right and the pasteles were incredible. They were rich, authentic and clearly made with care. You can tell solo puts pride into his food. The flavors felt like home, and the quality was consistent across the entire order my guest love it and I have people asking where the food came from. If you’re looking for real good puerto rican food whether it’s a plate or catering I highly recommend

We got lunch here. The flavor was on point!! The portions were super big and the prices were the most reasonable we have seen from any of the food trucks in Phoenix that serve Puerto Rican food. The owner served us and made us feel like we had known him even though we just met him. Absolutely recommended!!!! Wepa!

Yo this spot was on point.  I was in town for a baseball tournament that my son was in and on our way out we stopped at El New Yorican!  He treated us with hospitality which I really appreciate it! If you guys are in town you need to roll through!!

I ordered half the menu and everything was on point. My first generation Puerto Rican mom came to visit and she was blown away. It reminded me of my grandmother and her cooking, almost brought a tear to my eye. Alberto is the man and treated my mom like it was his family. Cannot wait to go back.

We had El New Yorican cater our baby shower appetizers and it was amazing. We had Rellenas de Papa and Empanadas and they were so delicious. Our guests enjoyed the unique flavors of the empanadas, which were full of meat and also had some cheese inside! Yum! Everyone loves Papas, so those of course went so fast. Its basically a potato ball with meat inside. Very delicious. We had about 65 people and every one of our guests was very very satisfied. If your looking for someone to cater an event or party with some nice Latin Caribbean flavor, look no further than the best Puerto Rican Food Truck in the Valley, El New Yorican!

If you're looking for a place that combines amazing food, top-notch service, and an inviting atmosphere, look no further than Sugarcane in Downtown Phoenix. This restaurant has quickly become one of my favorite spots, and it’s easy to see why!
Let’s talk about the Lemon Pepper Wings  they are nothing short of perfection. The crispy skin is beautifully seasoned with just the right balance of lemon zest and peppery goodness, making each bite an absolute treat. Whether you’re a wing enthusiast or just someone who appreciates great food, these wings will not disappoint.
As for the sides, I highly recommend the mashed potatoes and the greens. The mashed potatoes were creamy, fluffy, and incredibly comforting exactly what you want with a hearty meal. And the greens? Full of flavor and cooked to perfection, they had that savory, well-seasoned kick that had me coming back for more.
What really set this experience apart, though, was the service. From the moment I walked in, the staff was warm, welcoming, and genuinely attentive. It’s rare to come across service this good, but Sugarcane nails it. They made me feel like a valued guest, and their recommendations were spot-on. I could tell they really care about their customers, which makes all the difference when you’re dining out.
The ambiance at Sugarcane is another standout feature. The vibe is relaxed yet stylish, with a perfect balance of modern elegance and cozy comfort. It’s the kind of place where you can enjoy a leisurely meal with friends or have an intimate dinner without feeling rushed.
Overall, I can say without hesitation that I’ll be coming back to Sugarcane again and again. Between the amazing food, outstanding service, and inviting ambiance, it’s a true hidden gem in downtown Phoenix. Highly recommended!

Came here for an event…the menu clearly states automatic 15% gratuity. When my party and I got our bills they had 18% listed on all of them(I was so annoyed. I didn’t take a picture of it). Ended up having to go and make a complaint because it was low-key a scam. You can’t have one thing listed, and then charge something else trying to get over on paying customers is crazy. They did fix it, but based on this, the wait time, and a cold food I would not return anytime soon until they can get it together.
They didn’t have many vegetarian options; the only ones available were cheese quesadillas and French fries. The spot was beautiful and cozy, and the staff were friendly and nice

The whole experience was amazing from staff to music to the WONDERFUL FOOD!
All the staff was great from security on up. Special shout out to MARK AND KATHY for keeping my cup and belly full and convo was great. The people in the building was a vibe and I loved the comedy vibes!!!+

First time there, ambience is top tier, love the deco, love that they have a patio for hookah. The food was a miss... well try again, the drinks were cool, we got some shot with whiskey and bananas and was pleasantly surprised.

Real gripe bringing the micro receipts 🧐 work on that font size please 🙃

Nice place, limited parking, good Middle Eastern food with good portions for the cost. Nice friendly atmosphere. Good selection of food.
Plan to return.
Best Somali restaurant in town.
The best Somali restaurant ever
The best restaurant in Phoenix Arizona
It was ok

Made reservations for 15  out of town family members. We arrived and greeted by owner.  Jacob(our personal server) showed us to our table (which was perfectly set up so we could all enjoy each other)  brought water over and I asked for recommended appetizers that we can start off with. He recommended 3 plates of baba/hummus/tabouleh  and had them prepared and brought out within minutes and also brought freshly made pita bread that was hot and amazing along with a zatar/olive oil/pomegranate syrup dip(for the bread) that was unique. Jacob explained in detail the ingredients of each dish ordered (since some had dietary restrictions) and suggested the house specialties.  Jacob was very attentive to the table needs and answered all questions in detail.  Jacob was aware of a birthday and once everyone was finished with our meals (he boxed the leftovers)he cleared the table,refilled all drinks, offered coffee and while preparing a fresh pot he brought out a cake for the birthday girl and played a traditional birthday song (which was very special).  The food was amazing (we are all Lebanese) and felt right at home.  Jacob made the night truly memorable.  I have eaten hear many times(local) and my family really enjoyed the evening (4 hrs of no rush pleasure).  And best of all “the Dodgers won the World Series!  Thank you Jacob

I recently celebrated my birthday here, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. A huge thank you to the owner for helping create such a special memory, and to all that work there for being so warm and hospitable — they made sure every detail was perfect. From the appetizers to the cocktails, entrées, and desserts, everything was outstanding. The atmosphere, music, and service all came together to make it one of the best places I’ve ever been. Whether you’re planning a date night, a casual lunch, or even hosting an event, I highly recommend this restaurant. They take care of everything and make you feel so welcome.
Thank you to the owner Mensna.
🎂🎉🎁🥳🎊💐🍷🍹🥂🍸🍹🍰

I tried to call this place and the recording said to leave a message or email. Nobody responded. My aunt used to be a professional dancer and I wanted her to experience the whole dance show experience. We came on Sunday and there’s no dancing. Only Fridays at 7:30pm and Saturdays at 7:30 and 10pm. The food was delicious and the ambiance was beautiful. We’ll try again now that we know when the dancing starts. I hope this helps potential patrons.

Went for a cooking class.  I was expecting to actually cook, not just watch someone make a few items.  The hummus was incredible.  Chicken schwarma was nice.  There was a belly dancing show that was very good.

Mijana is a true gem for anyone craving authentic Lebanese cuisine. The food is rich in traditional flavor. From the perfectly grilled meats to the creamy hummus and fresh tabbouleh, every dish is made with care and authenticity. The live music adds incredible energy and gives the place a warm, festive vibe that’s hard to find elsewhere. Mijana beautifully preserves Lebanese culture, not just through its food, but through its entire atmosphere. Whether you’re Lebanese or just love Middle Eastern food, this spot delivers an unforgettable, genuine experience. A must-visit if you want flavor, music, and culture in one place.

I met my friend for breakfast I had never heard of this place, but she had been there for lunch prior.  The food was great, the portions were appropriate. The service was great and clean. They were pretty busy, but this didn't affect our service. The food came out promptly and hot. Our server was very attentive. Each employee we asked to make a suggestion was more than happy to tell us about their favorites and walk us through the menu. I would surely go back when I am on that side of town.

This is hands down an incredibly good spot for both brunch and lunch. The service was excellent and the staff made us feel very welcome. It is also a great cafe if you are looking for high-quality caffeinated drinks. The menu is reasonably priced for the quality of food you get. You absolutely must try the tortillas, chocolate chip pancakes, carne asada, and barbacoa—they were all highlights of the meal.

This was something that was suggested by my nieces, who know this town better than I do even though I grew up here. This place is a gem that I didn't even imagine was a thing. I know the color coffee shop cafecito, but they don't actually sell Cuban Cafecito which is what I was really hoping for when I first saw that shop on Google Maps.

Despite the fact that no one notified our server that he had a new table, things were pretty amazing once we got started. It was hard not to clean my plate, and then offer to finish leftovers for the rest of my family.

If you're looking for somewhere comfortable, with a nice atmosphere, that you can have a nice meal and a conversation at, this is a good option.

Hands Down the Best Pancakes in Arizona — A Must-Visit Spot

Otro Café is hands down one of my favorite spots in all of Arizona. Their flapjacks (pancakes) are truly next level — honestly, the best pancakes I’ve ever had in my life. I’ve tried both the berry pancakes and the chocolate chip pancakes, and there is absolutely nothing that compares. If you haven’t tried them yet, you need to come here and experience it for yourself.

I used to visit Otro Café during past work trips, and I’m so happy to be back. This time, I treated myself to a Sunday brunch after church and arrived during their happy hour from 3–6 p.m., which made the experience even better. I ordered a customized drink made exclusively for me, and it was absolutely perfect.

My server, Aiden, was amazing — humble, friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely down to earth. He gave excellent recommendations, made sure everything was exactly how I wanted it, and we had such a pleasant conversation. He even made sure I had extra maple syrup and extra butter, and the portions were so generous that I still had plenty to take home. I literally could not finish — and that’s saying something!

Beyond the pancakes, their breakfast burritos are also fantastic, and the overall experience is always consistent and top-notch. The interiors are inviting, the restrooms are clean, there’s plenty of free parking, and the entire place has such a welcoming, comfortable vibe.

Otro Café never disappoints. Amazing food, great service, and a place that feels special every single time. If you’re in Phoenix, this is an absolute must-visit. I’ll keep coming back — happily and hungry! 🥞✨

10/10 experience! We ordered chips & salsa (green salsa was tasty & red was a little spicy!) 1 pozole blanco, 1 asada taco, 2 pork belly tacos, & a chorizo breakfast burrito. It was busy but we didn’t have a long wait & our waiter, Xavier, was so friendly & attentive! 💗 Highly recommend the pork belly taco!! I had to take my burrito to go because I wanted another taco instead! It’s also beautiful inside!

This place might be the most solid tonkatsu ramen bowl in az. Ive had so many ramen spots in az but they suck. I was genuinely impressed with the broth and noodles. The egg needs work it was overcooked but very good! Theyre curry katsu bowl was delicious as well zero complaints about it. Will definitely be back!!

An incredible tradionally styled ramen shop! An incredibly friendly atmosphere was present the second I walked through the door. I had the house special tonkotsu ramen with all toppings, and when asked I decided to get medium spiciness (which was definitely within the Japanese standard of spice, which might be lower than you're used to if you have a lot of Mexican food like I do). The noodles were a perfect texture and taste, the broth was the perfect mix of savory with the richness tonkotsu is known for. The toppings like pickled ginger and black fungus added a delightful acidity.

I also had a side of a pork katsu bowl, which was absolutely delightful and was an excellent mild compliment to the diverse flavors of the house ramen.

This is my new local ramen shop and I couldn't be happier with the quality of food and service.
First time in Arizona and had a taste for Ramon. Glad I came here. Spicy beef Ramon can use some flavor but I very much enjoyed it. 9/10 recommend if you haven’t been here before.

Ramen is very good, very close to what you get in Japan. The ramen bowl in a combo is a little bit smaller than the ramen alone, but the extra plate with the combo is a very good deal. The only problem is that the place is a little bit too tiny and hard to find parking, but at the end the food is what really matters

Wow!  I've passed this place a hundred times at least.  My lovely bride was hungry and this was a middle point to meet.  She loves ramen.

The restaurant is small and sparsely decorated.  None of that matters because it's the food that matters.  I ordered the Champon ramen with half spice in it.  It was amazing.  Delicious broth, chicken was cooked just right and healthy mix of veggies.  Definitely recommend.

We had an amazing experience at Estilo Azteca! From the moment we walked in, the service was welcoming and attentive. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and full of authentic flavor. Everything came out fresh and exactly how we ordered it.

A special shoutout to our server Karen, she was absolutely wonderful! Friendly, attentive, and always checking in to make sure we had everything we needed. Her positive attitude truly made our experience even better.

We will definitely be coming back and recommending Estilo Azteca to friends and family. Thank you for such a great dining experience!

We had a great experience here! The food was delicious, the drinks were amazing, and the service was fast. Our server, Karen, was great, she checked in on us often and made sure we had everything we needed. We’ll definitely be coming back.

This spot was absolutely delightful! The agua frescas were both refreshing and charming, perfectly complemented by a side of delicious pan dulce—an added bonus for us. We couldn’t resist trying the chilaquiles with carne asada, and it was truly fantastic. The Birria egg rolls I highly recommend as well for an appetizer. A flavorful experience you won't forget!

Ruth was my waitress and she was super nice and friendly and very attentive. I ordered the red chilaquiles with chicken and it was soooo amazing. The chips were still crispy and crunchy with the salsa on them. I got the horchata and it was mouth watering. My husband got the papa and chorizo flautas. He loved that the potatoes were fried in chunks first and then put into the flautas. Gave it an extra crunch he loved.  The pepino-limon agua fresca was so refreshing and fresh and perfect. Definetly coming here soon with my family!.

Julia was so kind and welcoming! Service was fantastic, food was STELLAR!  Today was my daughter’s 16th birthday and this is where she wanted to come. They treated her to concha French toast, which was delicious and so thoughtful!

Our server was Klara and she was very attentive, fast, friendly and very helpful in assisting us choosing what food to order.

The sushi was fresh and very reasonable priced.  Food came out fairly quickly even the restaurant was 40% full.

They have Happy Hour daily from 5pm-7pm and 9pm-close.
Overall, very happy and definitely come back.

Went here for my birthday. Loved the atmosphere. Super cute layout. Food is delicious and inventive. Prices are reasonable. Go during their happy hour. Cocktails were a little on the weak side but still tasty. Let me tell you. I don’t know what they do with the water but it was crisp and cold. Staff was warm and friendly. Overall, I will return because I loved the food and atmosphere.

This place has gone through a name change in the last few months and have removed a lot of of the stuff from the old menu went to see the difference was told that they kept the same quality as it is the same owner as before, but honestly to me the only thing that seems like the quality stayed the same was the oysters. Everything else seems that gone down a bit and the portion seems  really small now some things are priced decently and some things are overpriced and we can’t forget to mention how bad it smells in here like sewage. There's so many restaurants like this which is the problem like I don't need to come here and there was nothing memorable about it and it's a pretty far drive from me so I probably won't be coming back

This was our first time here. We will definitely be back again. The oysters were amazing! Very fresh! The Sushi we ordered was so delicious! Plus the Saki Bombs were BOMB! Our server Kiho was so great. He was very attentive and kind. I HIGHY RECOMMENDED this place. They have happy hour everyday from 4-7pm!

Outstanding! We tried Zu & Pocha for the first time, and we'll definitely be back.We started with a couple of cocktails - the "new fashioned" (smoked with cherry/mesquite) and the Zu Bramble. Both were excellent. Moved onto a dozen oysters on the half shell - perfectly shucked, nicely presented and the best mignonette I've ever had. Then, we had a few goodies off of the Happy Hour menu - calamari, kimchi fried rice and the best chicken wings I've ever had (seriously!) Atmosphere and service were absolutely top-notch too.  SO good - give this place a try.
Incredible experience. That Lomo was better than the ones I had in Peru. Highly recommend everything on the menu. You cannot go wrong. The cocktail and desserts were amazing.

Food was delicious! They gave us this popped corn. The fried calamari, shrimp, fish everything was so tasty.
My favorite part was the red onions

This place never disappoints! I had to go with the Lomo Salteado and Mariscos Salteado! We love coming here for our Peruvian food fix! I’ve honestly haven’t had anything on their menu that I didn’t like. Everything is seasoned to perfection 😋 we started with the ceviche but we started picking at it before I could take a picture 😅 Really good food and the staff is very friendly!

Small restaurant that packs some big flavor. I had the ceviche and made it spicy. The dish was excellent, very tasty. Don't order spicy unless you can handle It. It was very good and big enough to make an entire meal. Ilove this place very friendly staff. 100% recommend!

Friendly service and cozy atmosphere.  We were not very impressed with the food however. The cilantro chicken had one small piece of chicken and what seemed like a pound of rice. The mixed seafood dish was so salty (and I love salt) that I couldn’t finish it. Maybe a bad night for the chefs.

This place is fantastic. The drinks are amazing, the space is fun and lively, and the food is out of this world. My most favorite bite of food I have had in a very long time were the Mongolian Spare ribs. The flavor is out of this world! We had the meatloaf, the French dip, the amazing chips and onion dip and the wings. Give this place a shot. We are so happy we did.

Category: Fine food.  For some reason, dining at the Culinary Dropout always feels like a party.  Though we have enjoyed some of the other Phoenix/Scottsdale locations, this was the first time we dropped into the Tempe Dropout.  We had matinee tix to a show at the Arizona Theatre Company, which is only a short walk away, so we made a lunch rez and sat at the bar and chatted with the bartenders.  True to form, it felt like a party.  Both the dining room side and the open-air Yard side were moderately busy this beautiful Sunday afternoon in early November.  The place is really spacious, with high steel-beamed ceilings, exposed ductwork, and skylights.  Ceiling heaters make the Yard side usable even in cooler weather.  A small stage hosts musicians on Friday and Saturday nights.  High-top tables abound, and the Yard has large couch pits for hosting groups. Light fixtures that remind me of early satellites hang randomly.  And of course there are TVs.  I didn’t want to fall asleep at the theater so I ordered an Athletic non-alcoholic beer, which complemented the excellent deviled eggs and French dip that we shared.  I substituted the housemade potato chips for fries, as I always do.  They are crispy and golden and perfect.  I’m SO glad they brought them back to the menu.  They are the best I have found in Phoenix/Scottsdale and one of the main reasons — if not the top reason — we drop in at the Dropouts.  YouTube’s Chef’s Apprentice

Fantastic service by the staff, Hannah is an absolute joy to have service our table, for us being drunkard rednecks on vacation

Pretzel bites and deviled eggs are absolutely fantastic
Hannah's reccomendations of drinks was absolutely on point

Me-Peach and rye
Momma- Evil jungle princess
Pops- full moon party

Main entrées was absolutely amazing
Dessert was mostly the best night cap of the night

I would definitely come back. Highly recommend to anyone on vacation or even in the area

Keep up the great work ❤️
Really nice place.  It took awhile for the food to come after we ordered but it was during the lunch rush.  My first words when biting into the prime rib dip sandwich wer "wow, this is really good"

Atmosphere is inviting and energetic. Staff have been attentive and helpful. Next to ASU so parking is difficult. The restaurant has complementary valet parking. In side was kind of loud but I was able to hear people speaking at the table of eight. Unfortunately the fries were cold.

Nestled in the heart of Laveen, this the definition of a hidden culinary gem. From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by an atmosphere that perfectly balances modern industrial-chic with warm, farmhouse coziness. The interior is striking, featuring bold green accent walls, corrugated metal wainscoting, and sleek black ceiling fans that create a stylish yet comfortable environment. During my visit, the space was alive with holiday cheer, anchored by a charming Christmas tree that added a festive sparkle to the clean, inviting dining room.
The true highlight, however, is the food. I ordered the Meat Lovers Omelet, and it was nothing short of a revelation. Even as a takeout order, the quality was impeccable. The omelet was cooked to perfection—fluffy, golden eggs folded generously over a savory blend of premium meats that provided a delightful smoky contrast to the richness of the cheese. It was paired with a side of hash browns that set a new standard: golden-brown, wonderfully crispy on the outside, and tender on the inside, avoiding the greasiness that plagues lesser cafes. The thick-cut toast was the perfect vessel for savoring every last bite.
The service matches the quality of the cuisine, with a friendly counter-service vibe that feels deeply rooted in the community—a true testament to the "Laveen Vibes" proudly displayed on the counter. With its latte and cappuccino options and welcoming spirit, they deliver a 5-star experience that rivals any bistro in the valley. It is, without a doubt, a must-visit destination for breakfast and brunch lovers.

I’ve passed by almuerzo plenty of times and I’m so glad I finally made my way there. It’s tucked in a small corner plaza and it looks to be a local business restaurant, which I’m a big fan of. And I’m an even bigger fan of friendly service and delicious food!  This is a decent size restaurant with outdoor and indoor seating, and also a small bar counter. I ordered the green chile chicken burrito and it was amazing!  I will be coming back!
This place was awesome. Natalie was our server, she was amazing. 🤩 will definitely be coming back here. The food was delicious 🤤

Food was amazing! The stingray appetizer and the toast with lox was my favorite. The service was terrible. Although they were polite they were definitely disorganized and did not listen when they took your order. If you are going to shue pigeons off the table when you seat us at least offer to wipe it down. Luckily we carry clorox wipes with us. Had to repeat our order multiple times, then they brought us someone else's food. Had to finally go inside to ask for a check and a box since our waitress didn't come back out for like 15 minutes, but when you go inside there are 5 waitresses standing together talking.

100 percentage recommended.
I got the best green chilaquiles!!!
Take this recommendation from someone who cooks daily at home and knows how authentic Mexican food should taste like

I drive past this place all the time on my way to work and always looked like a nice enough spot that would be perfect for a date night with the wife. We happened to be on this side of town on s Saturday so we decided to stop in. Tbe parking lot was full and enough people were parked on the street which is always a good sign since it tells me the place is popular. We didn't have to wait long to be seated either which was nice. Decided to sit on the patio since it was January and a beautiful day. Our server came over right away too, although we room awhile to decide what we wanted so he had to come back a couple times. I decided on the Quad Cities Melt and my wife got the Perfect pair with a mushroom soup and Cobb salad. The food was excellent, I would definitely come back to try more off the menu but my only negative about this place was how long it took to get our food. From the time we ordered it must've been at least 45 minutes until our meals arrived. My wife got her soup quickly and finished it long before the rest of the food did. We could see everyone in our section was waiting a while too. Its not a huge deterrent but for sandwiches and salad its not normally that long of a wait. Looking forward to trying this place again though!

We had a fantastic dining experience. There were four of us, and everyone gave the food a solid 5 stars. The bread was outstanding, and every dish was full of great flavor. Portions were generous and well worth the price. The indoor dining area had a cozy, warm atmosphere, while the outdoor seating provided another nice option. Highly recommend.

Last minute dining. Seated outside on a beautiful night in November at 5:15 with no reservation. Staff was super friendly. Prices are surprisingly  moderate for such fresh food. We had a vegetarian in our party of three, and there were many options. My seasonal martini was exceptional. The Perfect Pear salad was delish. Soup a little salty, but that seems to be the norm when eating out. Acoustics were lovely- easy to have a conversation. I will return.

Absolutely love this restaurant and would visit regularly if I lived nearby. The spicy margarita was in my top 3 margaritas of all time. The food options were so hard to choose from. I got the spicy ginger quinoa bowl and wished I could have tried so many other things on the menu. Great flavors and super cute environment.  Our server was super sweet and helpful.

What an amazing spot!  The best part, the service.  Both gentleman, the one who seated us and the one who served us were fantastic at showing they care.

Super neat outside patio too.  The food came quick but we just beat the rush.  Clearly they are an amazing place as in 20 minutes it went from almost empty to almost overflowing.

I always forget the food pictures but the Mushroom and Brie soup was phenomenal!  The Chicken BLT sandwich was a bit disappointing though. It lacked flavor and the flavor it had wasn’t that good.   Don’t really know why but I was not a fan at all.  It was a giant sandwich so that was positive.  And honestly, the sweet potato fries were overcooked and pretty lame too.

That being said, my friend got the jalapeño grilled cheese and was very happy.  I assume I just got the wrong thing on the wrong day.  Everything looked amazing and everyone was happy.  I’d still call this place a must.  I’ll certainly be back and will try other things.

This is my first meal on my first visit to the Phoenix area. WOW! How will any other meal beat this one?! I am praying a few blocks away for the week, and I feel like I hit the jackpot being walking distance to this jewel of an eatery. I ordered the Damn Dan Noodle Bowl, because I wanted something with a little heat. It was crunch, creamy  savory, and the house garlic chili oil... give me a cup of it! The atmosphere was super chill, but not sloppy. The staff were welcoming to me as a first time guest, and I observed warm greetings to familiar faces by name. If I lived here, this would be a REGULAR dining favorite. I know that it will be for this week! My only fear, everything else will be downhill from here for the rest of my visit.

Great place for a plant based meal! The food selection is vast with a little bit of something for everyone. Ordering was easy and table service was hassle free. They do offer a few baked good to go as well.

First time trying this place and when I say amazinggggg!!! It was amazingggg!!! I got their version of a chicken sandwich and it did not disappoint and the Brussels omggg!!! And the ranchhhhhh... and the samosas perfection! I will definitely be back!!

The Big Wac was so delicious. The wings were so tasty and came with carrots and celery a super plus. The Brussels didn't miss, and the margarita made me sing, literally. The service was immaculate. We will be back. Feel free to open one in Nashville, TN... 😆
First time visiting. 5 star for the Big Wac, buffalo chicken and the bff. Fries are leaning towards the soggy side. Shake was also not solid enough.

I really enjoyed the gyro and my husband enjoyed his platter. The ingredients were fresh, even the tomatoes. The sauce was very delicious. You do need to wait a bit because they prepare your food fresh. The dining area is clean, comfortable, and organized. I will definitely return when I'm nearby.

Got 1 gyro combo with fries and a drink, 1 gyro, and jalapeño hummus and pita. Fries were really fresh and seasoned well. The gyros were full of meat, tomatoes, cucumbers, lettuce and tzatziki. Very flavorful. Also got a can soda called Vimto (tastes like red cream soda) paid $39. In my opinion as long as the food is hot and fresh the prices are worth it. Everything is made to order. I would come back again instead of a fast food spot.

Nice place to eat, serving healthy meals which is needed in this community. The menu does not have what is included in each meal; so I accidentally ordered something that had cheese and it gave a stomach ache. It would be helpful to know what is inside each meal.

Because of the good reviews, this was our first time coming here, but the food wasn't
very good. The beef shawarma rice bowls had pieces of fat throughout it and the beef was dry. One of the sauces looked more like mayonnaise than the smooth sauce. My son didn't even finish his and got sick. We won't be back
Hidden gem, the fries were fresh made with new clean oil. The gyro meat was crazy delicious! The couple working incredibly nice. I’ll be back for sure.

This place is a culinary delight. Believe me when I tell you I’m usually not much of a salad guy, but this place I could eat at all week long without getting bored. People are friendly. It’s very clean lots of health, friendly options and a big enough variety to not have the same thing twice. I have nothing negative to say about this place only positives and definitely two thumbs up. I would 100% recommend this place to anybody and I’ll definitely be coming back soon..

Ordered for a group of visiting faculty who all raved about the quality and taste. This is one of the best values within walking distance of our site and the online order is simple and easy. BOG is on our short list of go-to options.

I love this place! I've ordered food from here for the team at work and a few times just for myself and I've never been disappointed.  The flavors are perfection,  they are quick with orders, and everyone seems really friendly. The side of chicken kabobs is my go-to, but their cheese ravioli is amazing. This is my favorite lunch spot in Phoenix.

Terrible experience. I’ve ordered from their Scottsdale location many times and the food was great. The Phoenix location seems like they do not know what they are doing. I ordered once on Uber eats and it was bad and I thought it was because the food was delivered, so I gave them another chance by going in and the experience was even worse. Music has no taste and some of the items even taste spoiled. No music in the restaurant so the vibe is completely off. And I had to pay for parking to eat here, what a total waste! Management, please look into this!

I was staying at a hotel and used a delivery service to order the Grilled Chicken Caesar and Hummus. Great portion of salad. Lots of chicken! Hummus was good and fresh also. Thank you for serving fresh healthy food.

12/13/25: we have been to Cornish Pasty so many times, I can't believe I never reviewed it until now. Let me right that wrong. It's wonderful! Over the years & after multiple visits, there has never been a bad one.

The food is always delicious. IMPORTANT NOTE: the pasties are pre-made; you cannot ask for substitutes or to leave this or that item out. Do not worry, however, as I am picky (don't like onions or peppers), but I have never had an issue with finding something to eat here.

The house made bread is absolutely aaaah-mazing. Hell, I could eat multiple plates of it alone for my meal. Thick slices of goodness.

The drinks are hit or miss, though we have never had an issue with a simple Old Fashioned. :-)

It's a bit dark inside, they have a substantial patio on the north side of the building, and the staff has always been friendly. The parking is not bad as it is part of small strip mall, but don't expect to always be able to park immediately close to Cornish (especially during busy times).

Looking forward to many more visits to Cornish!

The most delicious thing I tried was the cranberry sour beer—it was genuinely unforgettable and far better than anything I ate that night. The pastry was quite good as well, but the drink truly stood out. I also really enjoyed the atmosphere of the place; it had a classic, cool vibe that made the entire experience feel warm, relaxed, and memorable.

You should only come here if you love amazing food, great atmosphere, and top-notch customer service. This was my first time coming here, so my friend and I split a Guinness stew pasty and a rosemary steak pasty, along with a broccoli & cauliflower cheese bake and garlic & herb roasted red potatoes. All of it was 10/10 and utterly scrumptious. I HIGHLY recommend this restaurant!

I’ve been wanting to try this place for a while. Having lived in New York City, I’ve really been craving an Irish pie, and the Guinness beef stew pie sounded perfect.

I’ll start with the negatives so I can end on a positive note. I have mixed feelings overall. While the crust was absolutely beautiful, I ordered a wine gravy and unfortunately did not receive it. The dish is also fairly expensive, especially when ordering through DoorDash. Not filled as the pictures they posted

The filling surprised me. There was a lot of cheese—almost calzone-like—which isn’t what I expect from a traditional Guinness beef stew pie. The gravy was very minimal, and texturally it felt a bit off. It seemed like something was missing, and the flavors didn’t quite come together the way I expected.

That said, there were definitely positives. The pie had good flavor/quality overall, the ingredients were high quality, and it was visually stunning. I was very hungry, and despite my reservations, I ate almost the entire thing—especially after making my own gravy to go with it.

To me, it didn’t feel like a traditional pasty, though I could be wrong and I’m open to being corrected. All in all, the flavors were good, the quality was there, and it was a beautiful dish—just one where some elements conflicted with each other.

1st time here on St. Patrick's Day. They were slammed! But this guy helped us out. Gave me a free pint of  Guinness for the wait. Then I  had 2 more 😊 I've been craving a ice cold Guinness🍺 for quite some time, and it was delicious!! Then my waiter asked if I  wanted an Irish Car Bomb?? And I  said YES PLEASE!!!
