Oh, it was amazing! I haven't had one in years, and they serve them every day for $5.00?! Then I  ordered my Pastie. I was in heaven! Absolutely delicious! Green chili, rice, seasoned pork, and I  think cheese. My new favorite food to eat in Tempe, Az. My family and I go at least once a week. The staff was friendly and the tone of the restaurant is chill. I truly enjoyed my evening.  I recommend this place if you are in the area. 👍🏼

great place for someone who is allergic to dairy. has lots of baked good options as well as coffee, ice cream and more. the donuts were really good. the prices were affordable too. great customer service. wish they had more locations.

I was craving ice cream but due to a dairy allergy, I’m quite limited. Stopped into Nami and WOW. They blew me away not only with the flavor but the customer service.

- The tSoynami (fluffynutter’n) was 10/10. I don’t usually care for ice creams with coconut bases but this wasn’t noticeable at all and the textures and flavors of it all hit JUST right.
- The oatmeal cream cookie was SO soft and delicious it just melted in my mouth.
- The bagel was just really good lol same with the jam love a good ole bagel with jam.

Nami offers the best vegan donuts and ice cream in Arizona! My son’s favorite item is the chocolate milkshake! Their chocolate cookies dough is absolutely delicious. You can eat it raw or baked. Their custom cakes are also beautiful and delicious. Everything is reasonably priced considering it’s all vegan and sometimes vegan items cost more.

I have not yet tried the donuts and bars that I purchased here but the ice cream....  Yum! Color me impressed. Vegan ice cream with FLAVOR! 🤔😮 Cute homie little atmosphere. Pleasant staff. If you're vegan but still desire & crave sweets like myself, give this place a shot.

Stopped in after dinner next door and we ordered 3 different ice creams because there were so many options! We got Chai Tiramisu, Coffee Coco Loco, and the Butterfinger special. All were tasty and beautiful to look at, and the staff was wonderful.

We passed by this small Mediterranean store and were so surprised by how authentic and delicious the food was. It became our favorite spot! The ladies who work there are incredibly kind, and every dish tastes truly authentic. Here are some pictures guys, you really need to try this place!
Delicious Marrocan and Persian food. Truly authentic experience. We’ve enjoyed our 2 hour lunch and the owner made us feel very welcome like we are regulars. Definitely recommended 👌🏼

Wow!!!Absolutely wonderful meal. I have never had Baba ganouch that had such depth of flavor. You can tell the dishes are hand made. No Sysco hummus here. Don’t be intimidated by the out of the way location or the security fence out front. The owner, Zhoa does the cooking and she is incredibly talented. More food than we needed. Huge, delicious, dimensional dishes. So much flavor.

So, its not much to look at and the neighborhood is pretty sketch. The restaurant has two different stores connected to it and the interior needs some refresh. The waitress was nice but she was working the restaurant and both stores by herself so the service was super slow. BUT the beet and candied walunt salad we had for a starter was amazing! I had the cucuoose, which was fine but the gyro meat was delicious. The baklava was good. They apparently do catering and I think that's where lot of their business is because we were the only customers on a Friday night for the whole two hours we were there. Overall food was great, everything else was meh.

One of the few places to get authentic Moroccan food.  I was recommended coming here by a friend who just ate and raved about it.  The outside is unassuming, but the food is the real treasure.  There’s a little store inside to get little items and even authentic Moroccan outfits for ladies inside.

I’ve been to this plaza several times for other businesses, but I never saw this restaurant! I am so glad I tried it out!

The taste of “chicken” is so on point that I kept questioning my friend if this place is really vegetarian. Oh my!! It’s soo good! I took a bite of the mutton curry, but I found it to be bland. I do have to say I love my curry super spicy (like burning my tongue) though.

I do have to say that because of too much grease, the bottom of the rice in the clay pot is not crispy. I wish they can improve on that.

The service is smooth. Wait time for the dishes is just right. I went on a weekday, so there was no wait time for a table. They also have a tucked in, more private area for a small party if needed.

I also tried the honeydew juice, which is very refreshing. If this place is closer to where I live, I would pick this over a boba tea.

I’ve been meaning to try this place for a while and I’m very glad I did today. I was pleasantly surprised at how clean it was inside and how caring the people working there are.

The food was fantastic and there are plenty of options for everyone. The cream cheese crab wontons were so tasty! Has a very mom and pap feel and I loved it! If you’ve been considering checking it out do yourself a favor and just go try it.

Omg so good. I live a few blocks away and I am just trying this place, and I can’t believe I waited so long. Everything I tried was delicious, and I am convinced the spicy noodle soup that I had got me better and cleared up my sinuses from the cold I had—legit one of my new cold remedies. Also, my five-year-old wanted to mention how much she loved her fried rice, wontons, and fries. Also, the prices were great for the amount of food you get and everyone was soooo kind.

The path thai was delicious but they put only 3 tiny pieces of tofu. My plate was almost only noodles. It was disappointing because I’ve ordered this dish in a lot of places and it always comes with a well balanced amount of tofu and noodles. Not more noodles than tofu if that makes sense. I’m disappointed. I loose my money here. Definitely not going back.
Very friendly and helpful staff! Fantastic vegan food and drinks. Highly recommend the salt and pepper shrimp and the honeydew juice with chia seeds.

The Gold Rush BBQ Burger was delicious. All meals are made with fresh ingredients. Service is quick and friendly, I highly recommend for anyone who finds themselves in the area.

All menu items priced at 9.99, I have yet to find as competitive pricing in the area

I went back for breakfast since I loved my lunch so much and discovered that they make the best coffee I have ever had at a restaurant. Their Ethiopian/Colombian coffee blend is easily one of the best I've ever had.

taking a Sky Tram. I stopped at City Market Deli because of top rating on Google and so I ordered Tuna salad sandwich and a little Italy sandwich.  very tasty and big quantity for $ 9.99 , and my biggest surprise was Country west Singer Miss.  Morgan Mooney was ordering he food at this particular deli.  KENNY , the owner was very friendly and welcoming.  I am sure I will be coming back soon.

City Market Deli 4129 is a hidden gem for grab-and-go lunch or a quick sit-down deli meal, every sandwich I’ve had has been fresh, flavorful, and generously portioned, with tasty options from classic club sandwiches to grilled hot pastrami and veggie wraps. The staff are friendly and efficient, the deli feels clean and welcoming, and it’s the perfect stop for a satisfying lunch break or quick meal without sacrificing quality. Whether you’re grabbing a sub, wrap, or salad, this place consistently delivers great food and dependable service that keeps me coming back when I’m in the area.

Great food with great pricing. Clean kitchen and the atmosphere was perfect for a quiet conversation. The City Market Burger was phenomenal. Staff was very friendly and helpful. 10/10 would recommend and I'm going to take my wife for a date

Very friendly and welcoming owner. The food was made fresh to order and the portions are perfect. The prices are so affordable for the great quality that you get, I 100% recommend stopping by. Presentation was nice even in the to go box.

Press coffee is a must every time I travel to Tempe, Az.
Originally I stoped for the lattes. My go-to is a 12 oz latte with oat milk. I always pick up yummy chocolatey notes with a hint of toasted caramel.
Then one day I tried their breakfast burritos. I have to have one every time I visit now. IDK how they make them taste so good, it is perhaps the combination of the coffee and the burrito that pairs really well. Highly recommend this combo! :)

Press also offers additional bites to eat, and if you show up early enough you might get lucky and get one of their mini cupcakes. I really like the mini carrot cake.

Wish I could have taken more pics, but was too busy eating and enjoying my coffee.

Visited for the first time today - loved it! Their staff were super friendly and helpful.

Their Cold Brew is really good. We also got their OG Breakfast Burrito and Breakfast Sandwich- both were delicious.

They have a super cool vibe inside and outside.

Will definitely be back. I highly recommend!

I LOVE press! I visited Tempe for 6 weeks and we walked up here most mornings for coffee. I tried many different coffee shops in the Phoenix metro area and Press is definitely my favourite! Best beans and really friendly baristas! Can’t wait to come back and visit ❤️

Great coffee and free refills on that. Nice clean environment. Chill

Cons: Hard to find parking, limited space inside, as well busier w more people and less seating then the location on Apache. Maybe if you walked or road a bike here and sat outside then ace.

Extra special last note: They have the best coffee cups here out of any coffee shop I’ve ever been to. Other coffee shops take note 📝

Came in the other day after my miles for the first time to get some coffee and breakfast and was so yummy and felt welcoming coming in and staff was so sweet and helpful and answered all my questions no matter how many and the coffee hot and cold was Fire 💕 felt welcoming and was nice and clean . Will be my go to coffee on my walks that way . Plus the food/pastries were yummy 😋

I’ve ordered food from Karibu Restaurant multiple times, and there’s always an issue—except for the samosas. The Congolese goat meat is consistently as hard as a rock, making it nearly inedible. To make matters worse, Uber Eats refuses to issue refunds, leaving customers stuck with overpriced, low-quality meals. Karibu Restaurant needs to stop serving burnt, subpar food to paying customers. People deserve fresh, well-prepared meals, not trash.

This place is a joke. I received a plate full of bones and old, dark chicken meat that was tough like rubber. The chikwangue was dark, smelled awful, and was inedible. This was supposed to be poulet mayo, but it’s not even close—it was disgusting, old meat with an odd yellow paste on the chicken. If you don’t know how to cook this dish properly, please hire a better cook or a real Congolese chef who knows how to prepare it. First and last time ordering here Poulet mayo here
I love the food here. My favorite dishes are the beef suya, poulet mayo, and fish attieke

It’s takeout only but WOW! It’s fantastic. I had the whole tilapia (medium), jollof rice, plantain and ginger juice to drink. The tilapia came fried and not breaded. So it was gluten free and it was fall-apart tender and juicy. The flavors are out of this world. This is a welcome addition to the local food scene. It’s in the back left corner of the African grocery store. This is the only reason atmosphere is rated lower. If this place had a few tables….look out!🤩

The food was very good. It was disappointing to find out after I arrived for a brunch with my girlfriends that they had no formal place to sit that was not outdoors. Next time we know to Door Dash our food - it was delish!

Yam fries were not as pictured on the website. They were unseasoned and stale.
Plantains were 5/5, just needed some salt
Jerk chicken was just ok, flavorful but dry
The seafood is legit!! I got the tostada chuvi during! It's a must if your in the Phx area!!

I was actually on my way to a different place, when I saw this and it’s closer to my home. I’m glad I changed my path. I ordered the mojarra, to be on the safe side, (as it was some place new to me).  It was delicious, as were the beans and rice. Simple dish perhaps but one of my favorites. The Michelada with Pacifico beer was good, as well. The staff was friendly. Due to COVID, it wasn’t packed, as seating is limited. Nevertheless, this will definitely be one of my local favorites.

Been going since 2018 ,
Food: is great depends what dish you order.   If you are a Seafood lover this is the place.   Just don’t order the shrimp cocktail any whole shrimp is not cleaned.  This is not a place to order tacos.  The meat is dry.
Environment:   It's not a big place and gets loud when they have banda.   So if you can't handle loud noise or get suffocated easily this is not the place for you.
Service:   When the restaurant was pretty brand new the service was great.  Waitresses were fully trained to provide good service no matter how difficult a client can be mostly when they were intoxicated .

Unfortunately last 3 times I have visited with family groups the service has been awful.  It's like the waitresses just serve but don't care what customers request for.  They have charged incorrectly.   When you tell them something is not correct or if they forget to provide something when you ask for it again they get upset and get an attitude
..  They don't smile or greet anymore.    Makes you feel uncomfortable as a customer
.  What happened to good service
The food was good l, but the service was phenomenal. All of the waitresses friendly and very attentive.

This is a good place to enjoy seafood, good taste of seafood seasoned Nayarit style, live music and a great service, the prices are not so cheap, for a campechana cocktail and a ceviche tostada, plus a clamato preparado 65 with the tip included, seafood is not cheap, but frome time to time is necessary.

Okay. I came here looking for the Somali restaurant that used to be here. I was disappointed but I decided to try the place anyway. The attendant seemed to be a nice guy. I decided to try the raised platform for seating. How often do you get to eat on a raised platform? I ordered the Afghan meatballs and a can of soda. This should cost me $8.00
I looked for a place to charge my phone but didn't find any convenient place. Had to grab the Pepsi myself. No biggie. Bread and sauce = fire. Meatballs = fantastic. Well, my price suspicion was confirmed. I was charged nearly 3.00 for bread that I didn't even order. Sucks. The bread was good but if I'd have known that I would be charged for it I would have left it. It's all good. I'm sure the upcharge was based on the assumption that I wouldn't tip, because I'm black. It's just an everyday part of life for me. I actually intended to be a regular but I think I'll chill on that.

Pros:
Neat place, Food tasted very good and authentic. The lady on counter welcomed and answered my questions.

Cons:
It’s little pricey for the quantity of food.

Even though the inside ambience and decors look good, but the strong odour, didn’t allow us to sit and dine. So we decided to just have a takeout of one item. Place inside and outside looked deserted.

What a unique experience! My fiance visited Afghanistan in the past and wanted to try the only traditional Afghan restraint we could find in Phoenix. We sat on their toshak and ate the meal while sitting down. It was a small little hole in the wall, but the service was amazing. Very helpful employees that seemed very excited to serve and share their traditional foods. We ordered things that we don't remember their names, but all the food was delicious. I do wish that the salad was a little bit larger with more vegetables and I think one of the other dishes we had was lamb with raisins and rice. It would have been nice to have some more lamb in the dish.

We had the absolute joy of dining at this incredible new Afghan restaurant tonight, and I can’t stop thinking about the experience. Our group included three families, including my own—and even my picky teenager was raving about the food by the end!

We tried a bit of everything: goat, chicken, beef, and lamb. Each dish was perfectly seasoned, tender, and full of flavor. The star for me was the meaty rice with raisins—it was heavenly, with the perfect balance of sweet and savory. Every bite felt like comfort food elevated to something really special.

The atmosphere is part of what makes this place such a gem. It’s a small, unpretentious, hole-in-the-wall kind of place, but stepping inside feels like entering another world. We sat on raised platforms, lounging on rugs and cushions, which made the whole meal feel like an immersive cultural experience—totally unique and so cozy.

What really made the evening even more special was the owner herself. I first met her while she was out volunteering in the community, and she is truly one of the kindest and most generous souls you could ever meet. Her warmth infuses every part of the restaurant, from the food to the way her staff treats guests.

This place is a rare find—delicious, affordable, welcoming, and utterly unforgettable. We will absolutely be back (probably many, many times!).

I had a fantastic experience at this Afghan restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious — full of rich flavors and perfectly cooked. What really impressed me was how they served multiple dishes at the same time, which made everything feel fresh and well-prepared. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, making the whole visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this place if you're looking for amazing Afghan cuisine and warm hospitality!

We ended up here by chance. I ordered the Chicken Mandi and the Masoub dessert but as an appetizer cause I’m a grown adult and I can have my dessert first 😎
The dessert was creamy and absolutely delicious. I’m so glad I ate half of it first because my entree was ginormous and amazing! I wouldn’t have had enough room to try the dessert. See how smart I am? So I took some dinner home. The flavors popped in my mouth with fresh ingredients like freshly chopped onion and parsley. You can tell the difference. I can’t wait to come back!

Mandi House never disappoints! Their grilled fish is absolutely delicious — perfectly seasoned, tender, and full of smoky flavor. The rice is incredibly fluffy and aromatic, the kind that pairs so well with every bite of fish. The balance of spices and freshness in every dish shows real attention to detail. Whether you’re dining in or taking out, the quality and taste are consistently top-notch. Definitely a must-try for anyone craving authentic, flavorful mandi!

This is a must-visit spot if you are looking for authentic Mediterranean-style Mandi! The Lamb Mandi is absolutely perfect—the meat is tender and the rice is incredibly flavorful and well-seasoned. If you want a high-quality Mandi experience, you definitely need to check this place out.

Mandi House offers truly delicious food that is both flavorful and very filling. The portions are generous, the quality is excellent, and everything tastes fresh and well prepared.

The hospitality and customer service were outstanding — very welcoming, respectful, and attentive. From the moment we arrived until we left, the experience was smooth and enjoyable.

Great food, great service, and a warm atmosphere. Highly recommended, and I will definitely be coming back.

Easily some of the best food I’ve had in Phoenix and honestly even compared to Jersey and NYC - authentic, reasonably priced, clean, and very informative server. I really liked the fact you can sit on the floor if you would like to and eat the platter there in a more traditional manner. The dishes have great sauces and there were so many options! I got the slow stewed chicken over rice (started with an h). Not too salty, and also extremely tender.

name: Hilal Grill | Indian,Pakistani and Afghani Cuisine in Phoenix

reviews.text: Definitely give this place a try! The server (a young Indian gentleman) was incredibly respectful and patient while we browsed the menu and suggested some of their popular dishes. We were starving, and the portions did not disappoint! The beef biryani and chicken shish kabab with rice are an absolute must-tries. Delicious flavors and great prices for two people. Their chai was also very strong and perfect. Highly recommend!

This was easily the best Pakistani Afghan Indian food I have had and it seriously tasted like home cooking with tons of options and perfectly flavored tender dishes. The drinks were great, the service was super kind and attentive and the space felt cozy with prices that are very reasonable for how much you get. Highly recommend if you want halal food in Phoenix.

Hands down the best Pakistani/Afghani/Indian food I’ve ever had at a restaurant— very much like home cooking. There are so many options to choose from on the menu. Everything we tried was so well flavored and the meats were all perfectly tender. We got the chicken boti with white rice, sheesh kebab with biryani, and nihari with garlic naan. For drinks, we tried their mango lassi, black tea, and chai. We were very impressed. The hostess was very kind and diligently checked on us multiple times during our meal. The ambiance is also nice—very homey/cozy. And the prices are very very reasonable—you get so much (both in quantity and quality). Highly recommend to anyone looking for halal food in Phoenix. To the locals—you’re lucky to have this spot! And to the travelers, don’t pass up an opportunity to try them out!

I’ve been coming to Hilal Grill for years now, and honestly, it still feels just as special every single time I walk through the door. There are certain places that become part of your routine, part of your comfort, part of your life — and Hilal Grill is definitely one of mine. The quality has never changed, the flavor has never dropped, and the service has always stayed warm, consistent, and welcoming.

Their food just hits every time. The spices, the tenderness of the meat, the freshness of everything they serve — it’s that perfect blend of homestyle cooking mixed with restaurant-quality execution. You can taste the care in every dish. There’s a reason why I keep coming back even after so many years: the food is reliable, flavorful, and genuinely made with love.

But it’s not just the food. It’s the whole experience. The atmosphere feels familiar, the staff treats you like family, and you never walk out disappointed. Hilal Grill has become one of those places I recommend to everyone because I know they’ll love it just as much as I do.

Years later, I’m still obsessed and I don’t see that changing anytime soon.

I recently visited this restaurant and took takeout, and I’d give it a solid 3 stars, maybe nudging toward 4 on a good day. The indoor seating arrangements caught my eye—spacious, well-organized, and inviting, with a clean and welcoming atmosphere. They serve a variety of dishes, but they’re particularly known for their kabobs, which seem to be a crowd favorite.

For my takeout order, I tried the beef biriyani and chicken biriyani. Honestly, they were Okay but not the best biriyani I’ve had in Phoenix. Both lacked the bold flavors I was hoping for, and the beef biriyani, in particular, felt a bit dry. On a brighter note, the mango lassi was good—refreshing and well-balanced, it was a great addition to the meal.

the parking situation; the lot is limited, which could be a hassle during peak hours. Overall, it’s a solid spot for a one-time visit, especially if you’re curious about their kabobs or want to enjoy their pleasant indoor vibe. I’d recommend giving it a try but don’t expect the biriyani to blow you away. They do have a buffet which is 29.99 per person (Only Sundays I believe)

A unique and very cool place. Very cool setting, ambiance, and vibe. Not ostentatious or too chic, but a fun desert landscape surrounding the main room. Outdoor seating, outdoor bar complete with misters to keep you comfortable. Indoor seating is great too, with large booths and tables. Solid menu options to share as well as main entrees. The scratch sangria, and Yuko Poloma are great to enjoy in the heat. I'll definitely come back.
Service was top notch.

Hubby and I came for date night and this place is really cool. They have the main dining restaraunt and bar, an open dining patio with misters and outdoor bar.  And the a separate bar altogether on the property just for fun.

We had the baby back ribs which were equally tender and crispy, a little salty for my pallet but overall they were decent.

Hubby got the Ribeye which was as big as my size 8 shoe (no joke) and it came with veggies and a delicious bed of mashed potatoes.

I got the parpadelle pasta which is made in house and it was delicious. Perfect amount of spice and savory flavors.

We will be back again for sure!

Parking itself is on the small side in the actual restaraunt lot but there is plenty of street parking and even a separate dirt lot we parked in.

My daughter took me shopping around to check out a few restaurants with the right vibe — great ambience, food, drinks, and customer service — and we found the perfect spot! It’s right off the I-10, right in the center of it all, with amazing drinks, beautiful lighting, and the cutest setup for a holiday party by the fire pit. I can’t wait! I went ahead and booked with Austin — our holiday party is officially happening here! 🎉🔥🍸

I was taken here by great friends who live in Phoenix who told me it was one of their favorite places in town.

They specialize in lots of locally sourced veggies, southwestern influenced preparation and sharing plates.

We ordered a lot from the veggie sharing options, and stand outs were the cauliflower, the beets and the brussel sprouts.

Service is excellent and the outdoor space is so comfortable and relaxing.

Strongly recommend a visit if you want to experience a local favorite.

Great Central Phoenix gem! The food was excellent with tons of variety for all different pallets. I went with someone who was vegetarian and she found a ton of options. Personally I'm a bit of a carnivore and the wings and ribs were both fabulous! Plus they had a really good chocolate cake that was light and airy. Definitely would recommend this place.

PS they have a good happy hour too!

The worst Ethiopian food I have ever had i my life. The worst injera I have ever eated in my life. Total cost me almost $80.00. He gave me chicken tibs, as doro WAT. This was not WAT, this was chicken tibs. I’m sad to say, this absolutely NOT Ethiopian food. This is someone who is trying to make Ethiopian food, but doesn’t know how. When I was 7 years old, I can make better beets and gomen... Even the salad was wrong. The only thing edible was sambusas, but the lentils were still hard and raw. It’s under new management. I came with short notice, they made the food quickly. Injera was very dry, the tea was bad was under seasoned and weak, the vegetables are absolutely terrible. I use to work and here and know the previous owner. The menus were dirty. The new manager is a sweet guy, he’s very nice and friendly, he’s a great host, I really like him. But he ripped me off, fed me trash food, I had a friend with me. I tried to handle it respectfully and nicely with the manager, I didn’t want to leave a bad review, but I thought about how I spent $80.00 on really disgusting beets and nasty collard greens. Worst restaurant food experience of my life. I  spent $80.00. ($76.00). I wish I could get a refund. Don’t ever come here (I had to say something.) I couldn’t have had good quality food somewhere else but I wanted show my Nigerian friend my culture. It was extremely embarrassing and the restaurant made me very ashamed. According to my Nigerian friend, the fufu was lumpy and cooked wrong. Imagine being embarrassed of your culture because someone presented it badly. 😳💔$76.00 he gave us crunchy dry injera! It scratched my throat and I kept coughing. This food was mostly garbage food. The beef and chicken was dry . He made FAJITAS!  This is the food your uncle or dad makes you when mom is not home, he learned from his wife or something, but  you lie to him and tell him it’s good because you don’t want to hurt his feelings. Whoever made this can’t cook, and is a very rude and disrespectful person. Dry injera?? DRY INJERA??????????? Dry beef and chicken? Tomato sauce in doro wat?? Where is the Berbere and kibe? Chicken breast doro wat bro???? It was dark black injera and the outside was crunchy the corners were stale. 💔😭😭😭😭😭😭😭⁉️❓❓❓❓🤨🤨🤨🤨🤨🤨🤨 why did they break my heart idk why.

I had the pleasure of dining at Addis Ababa, during my recent visit I can confidently say it was an outstanding experience from start to finish!!

The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with a perfect balance of traditional Ethiopian decor and modern touches. The service was impeccable; the staff was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable

I was on my way for work when found this unique restaurant along Bethany Home Road. It caught my attention that I had to stop in. The reception was amazing and made me feel like I was at home with family. On top of that the food was delicious. I had to tell my family about this amazing restaurant and looking forward to bringing my family to Addis in the near future. I had the Beef Samusa, Lamb Tibs, Shiro and Salad. The food was plenty that I had to take the rest home to share with family.
Best place in phx where you can find the best coffee, tea and samosa. The adj on an other level. Can get what you deserve for the weekend.
Omg the food was so delicious. Thank you to the owner for making or experience the best. And they have a really nice place where hookah and outside sitting is available. The food was so good 😊

This is a great place to go in groups. the restaurant is very aesthetically pleasing; there’s such fun paintings, the lighting, the outdoor seating area.. it’s great. Not too many waiters that I saw, perhaps because it was slow. Their customer service was nice; very understanding and attentive. The pricing is amazing! Very very affordable; I paid less than 30 for two; including extra side and drink. The food was good. I wasn’t a fan of the potato salad or the excessive fat on the pork belly, but the wings were great; crispy on the outside, tender on the inside. not too spicy though; the Nashville hot was nowhere near as hot as I expected it to be, but it’s not necessarily a bad thing; they were still flavorful.  As for the pork belly I had ordered, I’ve ordered it at other places before and really not a picky eater, but I could not stomach the extra fat; at times, it grossed me out to the point that I couldn’t finish it. Aside from the fat, the rest of the pork belly was delicious. The meat was flaky on the outside but juicy on the inside and the sauce was perfect. The mac & cheese is great not sure if it was oven baked or not, but definitely creamy.

What an authentic experience. A unique take on bbq. From the beans using a sausage base vs. brisket. To the strawberry like jelly inspired sauce. I enjoyed it all! The service was amazing and entertaining! Low key place that should not be overlooked! Highly recommend!

Often when I pass by this place, there is a long waiting period. I got lucky this time and barely waited 10 minutes. I have to say, the second I stepped in, the staff was attentive and immediately was helped. When seated, our server took our drink order. We arrived after noon and by then, I guess we miss out Bc we were told they both longer had potato salad and certain ribs (which is why I came here in the first place.)  Once we ordered our food, the wait for it took a while. (Good thing the conversation at the table too was intense to notice.) The food was pretty good: Classic Sandwich with pork meat. I would’ve enjoyed it more if it had more BBQ sauce, it was a bit dry. Flavorful but a tad dry. The music there is PERFECT—caught myself dancing in my chair as I ate. If I’m around, and if craving BBQ, I would be coming in. Great service!!!

Disgusting is the appropriate word.  Food  was....disgusting. service sucked. Prices too high.
Since they were out of all meats we ordered fried shrimp, it was oily...breading was falling off and salty. Served with tarter sauce.. ick.
Mac and chess was COLD.
6 very tiny wings with "rub" . Bland...cold and the rub was REALLY salty.
Some of us just want a menu...which server gave us after I said  "What good is ordering from the QR if you're out of everything?"
Not even worth a trip back for the barbecue.
We paid over $30 for what is pictured.  Go across the street to Taco Boys. Skip this mess.

The food is amazing ! Ordered the family platter comes with 4 meats 4 large sides ...greens have that southern kick ! Smoked Mac and cheese, black eye peas and baked beans ! Ordered the fish and a hotlink ..most definitely going back and the prices are extremely reasonable ..not pictured is "The Lou" highly recommended from the staff it is a beef brisket dawg topped with crunchy fried onions and their potatoe salad topped with their sauce ! Absolutely loved the atmosphere very urban and family oriented !

I havent been to Jamaica in a few years but this place brought me straight back! Music was nice, service was nice, but the food was amazing. I got Jerk chicken, Curry chicken, and rice & peas; i took the first bite and lost track of time after that. Next thing i remember is throwing the bone to my dog 😂 definitely have to try it be

Definitely the best Jamaican food we have had in the Phoenix area. The brown stew chicken, jerk chicken,rice and peas and cabbage were excellent. We also tried their mac and cheese and plantains all really great. Well worth a 50 minute drive from Surprise AZ. If you really want to have authentic Jamaican cuisine. Can't wait to try the other dishes on the menu. Great job Renard and his staff. Marc & Lori
$52.00 for this?? Ordered oxtails thru Uber Eats and received 6 small bones .. barely meat on them!! Garbage!!!! This is a horrible way to start off the new year!! So disappointing!!

The Oxtail was efficaciously well rendered 😌. As a Jamaican myself I have very high standards when it comes to Jamaican food & One Love Cafe one hundred percent delivered! I have been to several Jamaican restaurants in Phoenix & this is by far the best in regards to Oxtail & the festival was amazing!! I haven't tried any of the other dishes but when I do I'll be sure to leave an honest review!

I recently visited this newly established Jamaican restaurant and, unfortunately, left disappointed. From the onset, the service was underwhelming, as we were abruptly greeted with, "Do you know what you want? What do you need?" without being offered a menu— they don’t have a menu yet.

We ordered two plates along with two beef patties, which came to a total of $59. The beef patties were tough to bite through, clearly overcooked. Similarly, the side dishes left much to be desired; the rice and peas were sparse on beans and lacked flavor, and the cabbage was equally bland. The chicken curry and oxtail, however, were a standout with its juiciness and rich flavor, and it was the only parts of our meal that met our expectations for Jamaican cuisine.

Unfortunately, the plantains didn't redeem the meal, as they were dry and overcooked. Additionally, our order was served without any utensils or napkins, which compounded the lackluster service. Based on this experience, I do not plan to return. It was disappointing, especially for a cuisine known for its vibrant flavors and hearty dishes.

It's not easy buying a meal because of the business model; it's by order only-no store front. Text communication was unclear. My oxtail meal was tiny, with no options for medium or large size. The food was tasteless. Rice oily, red beans too hard, and meal only included 2 pieces of oxtails; pieces of the plantain were burnt. No napkin/silverware provided with meal. Courteous proprietor.
I bought this food at the Scottsdale farmers market, goat stew was excellent, very yummy jambalaya can’t wait to try the gumbo

They came up to Sedona for this weekend's Art Fair. I think I was their last customer on Sunday. The Chicken Coconut Curry was first-rate. Enjoyed every bite on a bed of rice. I've saved their PHX location in my Maps app so I can get more of their delicious food the next time I'm down there.
I had their food at the Fountain Hills Farmers market and it was incredibly delicious! I haven't had much Caribbean food before, but I was pleasantly surprised! The Oxtail was so tender!!

I had Catering service from this place to an event i was hosting because i absolutely love it !
The rice is always cooked to perfection. My mom was even amazed and said "seems like she cooks the rice grain by grain"
Food never disappoints, it's always high quality. If you're a foodie person, you can tell everything is cooked from scratch, even her salad dressings !
This is my go to place when I'm in the food for authentic carribean food 👌

name: Rite Yah Suh Jamaican Vibez LLC

reviews.text:
My review is strictly on the Food…..HANDS DOWN THE BEST IVE HAD IN THE VALLEY!

As for the experience, I’d rate it a 1/10. I wasn’t feeling any Jamaican vibz..no music, no greetings, no bar, the TVs are in such an odd spot, how do they expect anyone to be able to watch and eat. Just a lot of unnecessary things out in the open that is just taking up space so I was definitely concerned about my food!

With that said, what I ordered was easily a 10/10. Hot fresh flavorful!

So, my husband and I ordered the rasta pasta. He chose jerk chicken & I chose oxtails.

To start, the customer service was A1.

My husband’s Rasta pasta with added jerk chicken was good, chicken was tender & it has a spicy flavor, but it was too salty.

My Rasta pasta I added oxtails, with extra oxtail sauce was also salty, too salty & I was kinda disappointed about the oxtails still on bone in the pasta. So if you’re not careful you can choke on the little bones from the oxtails. So I wouldn’t recommend adding oxtails to the Rasta pasta. I did like the pineapple ginger drink. If you’re a ginger lover you’ll love this drink.

I gave 3 stars because it was too salty & them not telling me the oxtails was still on bone. I feel if they was not taking the oxtails off bone then put it on the side. Who want to eat pasta & pick through the pasta while eating because you feel little bones in your mouth while you chew…

Overall the location is good & the space has a good vibe. No shade just lighting up on the seasoning

Spent $51.00

From the moment you step inside, you can feel the island energy🇯🇲 The vibes hit different…reggae in the background, that warm, friendly welcome, and the aroma of authentic Jamaican flavor that I kept saying “LAWD,,  have mercy and thank you Jesus for authentic meal .  We from Maryland to find the best Caribbean restaurant ever🇯🇲 chefs 💋💋💋💋. We have good Caribbean cuisine but not like RITE YAH SUH JAMAICAN VIBESZ!!!

The oxtail dinner is authentic and perfectly seasoned with that smoky kick, the oxtails fall right off the bone, and the rice & peas were cooked perfectly, crispy plantains were amazing with just the right touch of goodness in every bite feels like a trip back to Jamaica my favorite place to visit!  The owner treated us like family warm smiles and a beautiful personality. The dinner portions are generous, the service is full of love, and  sincere appreciation we dined in and vibed with the owner and staff very good people. Whether you’re a yardie missing home or just someone chasing bold flavor, Rite Yah Suh Jamaican Vibez is THE spot in Tempe, Arizona.
💯 Authentic. Flavorful. Irie to the core.
One visit and you’ll understand why everyone’s saying — I’m definitely coming back to visit 😋🇯🇲

The best AUTHENTIC Jamaican cuisine in AZ!! Jerk Chicken and Oxtails slaps! The food is so tasty and flavorful, I've had Jamaican food at serval locations in the PHX area and Rite Yah Suh is BY Far THE BEST PHX has to offer. The chef and staff are friendly and courteous. All dishes are truly authentic in taste. Jerk sauce is perfect, the chicken tender, and the Oxtails are AMAZING, as well as the brown stew Salmon.

Me and my big back bf wanted to have Jamaican food. We had the side of Rasta pasta, oxtail peas and rice, and side of cabbage. Highly recommend! I am Caribbean and he isn’t, it was his first time trying it. It was so amazing, everything seasoned perfectly and not bland. This is super authentic and one of the best Jamaican food I’ve ever tried!! And I’ve tried a lot. Owner is super nice and welcoming. 100/10

Every time I come here the atmosphere is welcoming . The food is always amazing. Always made fresh ... and the tortillas remind me when I was younger and my grandmother was making them fresh off the stove ..

The burgers were excellent. The place was very quiet as we went for Saturday lunch. I guess we enjoyed the space and size of the space. We could hang out inside and the kids could run around all over outside as well. The food was American items such as chicken sandwiches and burgers.  The PB&J burger was my favorite!! Staff was so nice.

I read a featured article online about a new lounge/restaurant that featured Caribbean cuisine in Tempe. From the pictures and the article the food looked amazing. It looked the way jerk chicken was made back home as I’m not from AZ. I decided to make the 45 minute drive and enjoy some authentic jerk chicken. I walked in around 1:30pm and there was one other person sitting at the bar. I sat down at the bar also and the waitress greeted me and brought me a menu.

I ordered a cocktail, nothing crazy just a whiskey/sour which she didn’t seem to know how to pour. She pulled out 2 plastic cups and asked me which one I preferred, a small one or tall cup. I thought that was odd, but I told myself she probably isn’t a bartender. I looked at the menu and one side had more traditional American bar food like burgers/fries and the other had Caribbean food. I asked if they had fried chicken cause I never seen that on a menu with jerk chicken and she said they weren’t serving that today.  She did however say that the jerk chicken was really good and was served fresh. She was nice and polite.

So I ordered a plate of jerk chicken with red beans/rice with steamed cabbage. After 5 minutes or so, the waitress came back to me and told me they were out of red beans/rice would I like to substitute a side. I chose thin potato wedges and they were out of those too. At this point I’m optimistic again, because places that serve Caribbean food I have been to, running out of items is a good sign. So I just asked for a double order of cabbage and French fries. I’m sitting about 10 feet from the kitchen and I don’t hear any noise. No meat cleaver hitting a cutting board. IYKYK. I’m worried again.

After about 15 minutes out comes my food. On my plate was 2 pieces of DRY/Sliced chicken breast with a jerk sauce on it and my cabbage was so crunchy I feel like it came out of a bag. It didn’t seem steamed at all. I’m not sure any heat element was ever introduced to the cabbage. The sauce was spicy but it was good. I would give the sauce a 3 out of 5.

Even though it looked nothing like what was advertised, I still tried the food. Needless to say I was disappointed. 1 out of 5. So I showed the waitress the article that got me to drive 45 minutes in and asked when do they serve jerk chicken that is bone in. She looked at it and said they normally serve it the way pictured and offered me a discount ($4.50). The problem I have is if she told me they were out of rice/beans, thin wedges, and they normally serve jerk chicken bone in, she should of told me they were out of jerk chicken too or at the very least it would be prepared differently. I would have then ordered something else. Instead she told me the jerk chicken was good and it was fresh leading me to believe it was going to be how it was pictured in the article.

I approached the owner and spoke with him about my experience. I wasn’t upset just extremely disappointed. He immediately told me he was on his way to go get more chicken. I’m fine if an establishment runs out of items but it was a Friday at 1:30pm. As a restaurant/lounge I would think you would be ready to go on one of your busiest days with your best selling item right? Maybe I’m wrong. He assured me they cook the chicken normally the way the article showed and offered me a free meal next time I come in. I’m pretty sure I’ll never get that free meal cause I won’t be going back. Overall my bill came to $24.70. I tipped $2.00 and left my food on the plate. This review isn’t meant to deter anyone, only to inform others from another city/place what my experience was like at Flavor Eatery and Lounge in Tempe, AZ.
This is the worst food! I had several bones in my jerk chicken sandwich! Had me wondering did I order jerk chicken or joke chicken?! Glad I didn’t choke off a bone! I don’t recommend this place.
I'm not a big fan of the bar scene, but this place is bomb! Food was great, drinks were awesome too, and Tia was Fantastic! One of the most attentive waitstaff I've ever worked with!
Legit cool place soft opening and food is decent and has a pretty large menu. Staff was cool and the vibes were something that’s been I e been looking for

I've been going to Dave's for about 3 to 4 years now and he is by far the best Jamaican food I have had in the valley. His food is always fresh and delicious the oxtails are always falling off the bone and flavorful and the jerk chicken is the best I've ever had. He is very friendly a real people person and he's always greeted everyone with a smile he treats you like your family. He also has a little spot that I go to on 67th Avenue and Broadway and it's like you're in Jamaica. For the amount of food that you get the price is pretty reasonable

We saw the food truck parked on 67th and Broadway and decided to give it a try and man, are we glad we did. We ordered the curry goat, curry shrimp and jerk chicken w/ fries. The shrimp meal is so delicious, not to spicy and the rice w/veggies is FULL of flavor! The goat it tender and just as good and very spicy, so beware. The jerk chicken has the right amount of sweet with savory. you can see the fresh herbs he used in the dishes too, so full of flavor, it's ridiculous! I will definitely be going back. The guy running it was funny and friendly too. I feel like the only thing missing from the experience is some music playing outside the truck. I will definitely be going back and if you move the truck, I will look for it just to taste the other items on the menu!!

Don’t walk, RUN. I’ve been looking for a place with authentic Jamaican food and I wish I would have found it sooner. I couldn’t even drive home, the food was sooo good. My son slaughtered the curry goat and I cleared the oxtail.

Overall, great vibes, great energy and impeccable food!

Dave was in Maricopa today and we popped in for 2 oxtail plates. Not only is he fun and friendly, when I tell you everything was literally delicious. I am so full and still have half of my container left. Best Jamaican food I’ve had. Veggies were perfectly seasoned. Oxtails falling off the bone. Peas and rice, yes yes yes!!! I will be back to try the jerk chicken. Thank you!

The vegan option was excellent. After a few days of trying, we finally got to try this place out. If you're on a time crunch I recommend calling in ahead of time. Imo this food is worth the wait. Also decently priced. I would recommend trying it out!

​Forget the standard chain restaurants—this place will give you a unique experience. The parking lot was buzzing, with what looked like a full-blown party next door (or maybe a very enthusiastic church service on a Saturday night!), but once inside, the vibe was pure chill.
​The staff was friendly, and while we were sad to see no wine on the menu, the options for beer and those fun Jamaican sodas more than made up for it. We chose the delicious jerk chicken, with perfectly steamed cabbage, sweet plantains, and savory rice & peas.
​Our meal came with a Festival! This gently sweet, fried bread was a nice treat. 🤤
​This spot is a whole mood and we're so glad we decided to eat local.

My niece and daughter put me on to this restaurant! I placed my first order with Uber Eats today and the food was delivered hot and fresh! Rasta Pasta 10/10 ahhhmazing 🤩 I’m excited to taste other items on the menu.

“A Flavorful Caribbean Escape in Phoenix”

Ocho Rios was a delightful surprise, serving up bold Caribbean flavors that made the visit memorable. The oxtails were rich and savory, with gravy so good it begged to be licked from the spoon, though I wished there had been a bit more meat. The rice and peas were comforting but could have used a touch more seasoning, while the Jamaican coleslaw stole the show—vinegar-based, lightly sweet, and refreshingly addictive.

My partner’s jerk chicken had a flavorful crust and came with a sauce so delicious I could dip anything in it all day. The potato salad was simple but paired well, and the macaroni and cheese, while enjoyable, didn’t stand out as anything special. His brother’s fried chicken, on the other hand, was a knockout—crispy, juicy, and bursting with flavor, easily a ten out of ten. We also shared sweet wings as an appetizer, beautifully charred on the outside and moist inside, the kind of dish you could eat by the dozen. Everything was washed down with rum punch that was as refreshing as it was delicious.

I was too famished to take pictures this time, but when I return I’ll be sure to capture them—the food was not only delicious but also very appealing to the eye. Sadly, the rum black cake was sold out, but that just gives us the perfect excuse to come back and enjoy another round of Caribbean comfort.

Service was the one drawback. With only one hardworking server juggling orders and the bar, guests were left waiting for drinks or attention. A little more help would make the experience smoother and less stressful for everyone.

Despite that, Ocho Rios left us eager to return—for the flavors, the atmosphere, and hopefully that rum cake waiting at the end.

It’s a wonderful spot to vibe! Good music and nice ambience. It’s clean and the staff is friendly. The food is not bad, but it doesn’t taste like the traditional Jamaican food I grew up on. They have their own style, which isn’t necessarily bad. The food is a bit overpriced for what you get for the portions you get. Also everything is super spicy, and they only give you an ice cream scoop serving of greens (cabbage). This makes digestion a bit hard with all the spice. I would still recommend you try it for yourself. Overall it gets 4 stars from me.

Was originally told it would be a 10-15 min wait. Ended being 40 min. While waiting numerous people came in for pickups and the white lady behind the bar was very slow to put her phone down and tend to them. One group came in and stood there waiting for her to acknowledge them. When asked if they were picking up they stated that they wanted to sit and eat to which she responded "so do you want to order to go or sit and eat". Again distracted by her phone instead of tending to customers. The whole time I was there, there was a group in the corner eating. When my food finally came out she decided to go and see if they needed anything. Like really, I've been sitting here for 40 mins and you walk away right when my food comes out.

With the cost and the wait I was thinking this better be the best Jamaican food in the valley. Unfortunately that was not the case. This tasted nothing like I've had from other Jamaican food locations. (Jerk chicken, curry goat and oxtails). Mac and cheese is was good, plantains were good. Jerk chicken was ok, but goat and oxtails were a complete miss (flavor wise), though the goat was very tender.

Don't think that I'll be back. Dave's Jamaica Kitchen down the road is much more flavorful not too mention cheaper, if only they were open when they said they were open.

This place is amazing! Chris’ hosting skills were impeccable to say the least. From the delicatessen of the food to the warm customer service, this place is a must try. They have a variety of food options for meat lovers and vegetarians. We will definitely go back!

I stumbled upon Island Grill on a weekday night and it turned out to be a gem! The food is true, authentic Caribbean cuisine—flavorful, fresh, and satisfying. I had the stewed fish while my friend tried the jerk chicken, and both dishes were outstanding. The clean, welcoming atmosphere made it easy to simply enjoy our meal. Authentic Caribbean spots are rare to find, and this one exceeded expectations. I’ll definitely be back!

This place has great reviews so not sure what happen with me. I had high expectations for a $41 oxtail on uber eats. The white rice wasnt cooked correctly, and the plantains were soggy (over ripe). The portions were more rice than anything else. I hope this was just a one off.

The food portions were reasonable. Fish was thoroughly seasoned. I loved the plantains and festivals. The rice and peas was very nice, rich with coconut milk. I very much enjoyed my meal. Also, customer service from Chris was excellent.

Absolutely amazing! I had the curry goat and it was hands-down one of the best I’ve ever had — tender, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned with that authentic Jamaican spice. The rice and peas were cooked just right. The staff were warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere was nice. I’ll definitely be back to try more dishes — this spot is a hidden gem! 🇯🇲

Pyro near Global Ambassador is a must visit restaurant with a truly unique and elevated menu. We did the chefs choice experience which allowed us to try some of their favorite dishes and every single one was fantastic. The interior is gorgeous, warm, and inviting which makes the dining experience even better. The food was creative and full of bold flavors. My favorite dish was the sashimi with orange and a tiny pepper that added the perfect kick of spice. Everything was beautifully presented and incredibly fresh. Pyro is an amazing spot for anyone looking for exceptional food and a memorable dining experience.

Stopped in for lunch on a weekday.
The food and service were excellent. Nice size outdoor patio and bar.
We had a few shared plates such as the Sashimi, Tuna Tataki, harvest beets, gyoza and tiger prawns.
All served in a beautiful presentation.
The interior in nicely decorated and would be great for large groups and gatherings.
Parking is limited as it is next to or the Global Ambassador. Park in the garage and the restaurant will validate your ticket.

I had an outstanding dining experience today at PYRO on Camelback. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere struck the perfect balance between stylish and welcoming — a modern Asian-American bistro with warmth, energy, and impeccable service that makes you want to settle in and enjoy the evening.
I started with the Smokey Melon, and it was an immediate standout. The combination of ilegal mezcal joven, mizu barley shochu, melon soda, lemon, and melon pearls was refreshing yet complex. Lightly smoky, subtly sweet, and beautifully balanced — easily one of the most creative cocktails I’ve had in a while.
The Short Rib Fried Rice was deeply comforting and packed with flavor. The richness of the short rib paired perfectly with the kimchi, negi, egg, and nori kizami. Every bite felt layered and intentional, with just the right amount of umami.
The Gochujang Brussels Sprouts were a surprise favorite. Perfectly roasted with a bold, slightly sweet heat from the gochujang, balanced by roasted red pepper sauce, hearth onion, bonito, almond, and fresh mitsuba. Complex, vibrant, and addictive.
The Pork Belly Skewers were beautifully cooked — tender, flavorful, and indulgent without being heavy. The yuzu-togarashi aioli added a bright citrus kick, while the house pickles cut through the richness perfectly.
The Chili Garlic Noodles were pure comfort with attitude. The tonkotsu broth brought depth, the chili crunch added heat and texture, and the negi tied everything together. This dish alone is reason enough to return.
To finish, the Sticky Toffee Cake was outstanding — warm, rich, and perfectly balanced by milk ice cream, whipped butterscotch, and candied pecans. A flawless ending to a memorable meal.
Overall, PYRO delivers thoughtful, bold flavors with exceptional execution. The food, service, and atmosphere come together effortlessly. This is a place I’ll absolutely return to — and recommend without hesitation.

We had an incredible dinner experience at Pyro! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting. Our server was amazing and friendly, attentive, and took the time to explain everything on the menu thoroughly, which made the evening even more enjoyable. A special touch was when the manager personally came to our table to check in and make sure everything was going well. It really showed that they care about the guest experience. As for the food and drinks absolutely phenomenal. Every bite and sip melted in our mouths. The flavors were bold, perfectly balanced, and clearly made with attention to detail. Highly recommend this spot for a special night out or anytime you want top-tier service and unforgettable food. We'll definitely be back!

Wow, this is my second over the top out of my league fancy restaurant in one week!
And in two different cities 🤭

⭐ In a nutshell this place is very fancy, 👔very expensive,🤑  very noisy, 🙉and very tasty 😋

They don't have a valet and they don't have their own parking lot. You must park in the garage and make your way over to the restaurant.

They ask you to order all your food at once so they can plan for serving it to you without waiting between. 👍🏻

We got there early which is upmost on the weekend☑️
It gets filled up and loud by the time it's dark.

Even though it was very fancy and I was dressed nicely. Somebody walked in wearing a regular pair of jeans. With a knife in his belt no less and a baseball cap! Not my thing to see that when I'm spending $500 for 🍽️ dinner.
And speaking of that, this place charges you for using your credit card!!!💳
That's a deal breaker.😱 I will not return...🙅🏻‍♂️

Best fried fish I've had since moving to AZ! Hit your plate with a little creole seasoning and some Louisiana hot sauce and its a done deal! I think it's a fair price for what you get at $15. The folks running this business are nice as can be. I recommend asking to add an extra piece of fish to your plate if you're HUNGRY. The corn bread muffin was dry, which some people like, but I prefer it softer. I will be ordering again in the future.

So far the best soul food I had in AZ!I had the fish and shrimp plate, came with a side of spaghetti, green beans, a roll , plus a can of pop and cake! Yess, I was full ! Portions are generous, the food is delicious, I’m from Chicago and the spaghetti remind me of home!  Nice size shrimps and the fish fried to perfection! Thank you tasting soul! God bless y’all! I’m so glad y’all are here!!!

A little surprised to find out this is a private home. Conversation with the owner I found out they’re saving for a food truck. I hope they can accomplish that. It will help build business much faster. Great catfish and shrimp. Chef Steve and his wife are super nice. I’m visiting from out of town so not sure when I’ll be back, but I’ll try next time I’m in Phoenix. Give it a try!

I called & placed my order & he said 10 mins. Lol it was ready when I got there. & HOT! Fish & shrimp platter w/ Mac n Cheese,  & Green beans.... & dinner roll & choc cake & a Rc soda to flush it down for $15
That fish tasted like he caught it & fried with perfection of golden brown with a lil Krunch, very tasty as well as the shrimp.  Green beans & Mac n Cheese felt like u was at home & mom duke's cooked dinner....overall was 👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾 that fish was hitting. My only recommendation is could use some seasoning on sides. & the Mac & Cheese u gotta do it right or leave it alone. But I will be back tomorrow for the brisket , greens, yams, & Mac & cornbread 🙏😉😉

OMG! I couldn't even make it home. Never thought I would spin the block for catfish. It taste just like the south. I'm speechless. This is grade a food. Glad I dont live too close. Id be as big as a house. I ordered 3 plates. My husband order 1.
Oh and the potato salad. My lord it taste like that southern after funeral plate potato salad. So glad to have found this diamond.

Authentic Cuban food For Sure! Empanadas Are  Very Good! Everything else was really good as well. Atmosphere was very nice very clean. I like the mirror on the wall. Definitely makes the restaurant pop out. Looking forward to their Saturday evenings with live bands, salsa music. I can already feel the Miami restaurant atmosphere. A good place to take your family on a night out for some good food while you can also enjoy music watch games and have a drink !

Anything Spanish food, wether is Mexican, Dominican , Puerto Rican, Colombian or Cuban etc. the flavor are amazing, I’ve been trying to find a great Spanish restaurant. This one is amazing too will come again 😍

Glad to have found another good Cuban restaurant in Phoenix/Glendale. Tried the new fried sweet plantain stuffed with cheese, ham and steak, and it was a great choice. Their Cubano and the Pollo a la Plancha were also good.
Service was exceptional. Our server Lianis was very cordial and extremely attentive.
Parking however is a very different story, since there was no dedicated parking lot available and you are left with street parking that is not always easy in downtown Glendale.
A+ and a staple restaurant for my family. Authentic Cuban food and perfect flavor from my childhood. Hasta la sodas Cubanas tienen. Don't forget a cafecito!

First time visit, was not disappointed, food was good, service was attentive and friendly, food was served quickly and with good timing between drinks, appetizer and main course, small dining room with bar service, outdoor patio service makes for a great night out, indoor or outdoor, worthy of a visit frequently.

name: Krazy Cajun Seafood & Hibachi-Phoenix
vicinity: 24 W Camelback Rd UNIT H, Phoenix

reviews.text:
I must say that I was on my way to Tempe when I googled the address and saw that I was less than 20 minutes away 🙏

Built my own boil and they accommodated my no sausage request. The boil was lovely! Kept it in the bag to keep down the splatter🤣

Also, I ordered the chicken fried rice and to best honest…it was the best that I’ve had since I moved to Arizona eight years ago (I would only add a bump more of the sesame oil)💯

Be prepared to become addicted to those shrimp chips…delicious.  Yes, this place is small and mighty🤌

Oh yeah, I dropped my card and the server returned it to me…before I left, I had dropped it again🫤🫣

I called the next day and they remembered me!!!

This place is awesome!!!

It was a location that I found after my graduation ceremony. I just need a place to eat some feelings to be honest and it helped. Food was hot and filling for sure. They have a create your own option that I took advantage of.

Best seafood boil in AZ! They are the most consistent every time we go service is always on point they serve pretty quick and the food is amazing! They ALWAYS devein their shrimp!!!Highly recommend this place to everyone

I want to say the gentleman working the cashier confirmed in my order steamed brocoli and steamed rice, yet after arriving home, I did not have these items. I called the gentleman that took my order took full ownership and for his error asked the manager  if they were able to accommodate on the house for the mistake as I spent 2 dollars shy of $50 dollars at this establishment and the manager stated no they would not make the steamed broccoli and steamed rice on the house for there mistake. Due to the order being a take out order and we didn't checkthe food tell we got home, I wasn't going to waste gas for food that should have been accounted for. Customer Service means everything to me, and this was my first time at this establishment. 5 star to the gentleman that clearly errored and took ownership and tried to ask management for the mistake he made if they would make my brocoli  and steamed rice on The house as a courtesy for the error. I was a take out order , if I was in person and sitting down, this wouldn't have been a big deal. Other than that lovely atmosphere,   the gentleman  still gave excellent customer service, and the food that was purchased was very good!

OMG!! So glad we stumbled across this gem. We had nothing but amazing  service. Food was phenomenal and our server May was the icing  on the cake. My wife is not much of a seafood fan and this place had so many different  options. She was definitely pleased. We will never go back to the large corporate name brand crab boil establishments here in the valley.
Please give this small buisness an opportunity  to gain your buisness.  You will not be disappointed.

My partner and I recently celebrated his birthday at The Henry in Phoenix, and it was an absolutely flawless dining experience from start to finish.

We started our evening in their beautiful, vibrant dining room. The atmosphere is upscale yet comfortable, making it perfect for a special occasion. When it came to the food, we were blown away. I ordered the short ribs entree, which was nothing short of amazing—incredibly tender, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. My partner had the salmon and was equally impressed with its freshness and preparation.

The real highlight, however, was the exceptional service. Upon hearing it was his birthday, the staff arranged for a sweet and completely unexpected gesture: a complimentary dessert. They brought out a slice of the most delicious, decadent chocolate cake, which was the perfect celebratory touch. We also couldn't resist trying the bread pudding, and we both loved it. It was warm, rich, and the ideal sweet finale.

The combination of fantastic food, a lively but intimate ambiance, and genuinely thoughtful service made his birthday dinner truly memorable. We left feeling celebrated, satisfied, and already planning our next visit. Thank you, The Henry team, for making our night so special!

Highly recommend for any celebration or a fantastic night out!

I was in love with this place as soon as we walked up! The signature green woven through out the decor and the wait staff clothing was perfect.

Service was good (just a little slow), but it was a busy Saturday morning. The food was fabulous! I had the egg white turkey omelette (without cheese), and it was so tasty! My husband had the French toast and said that it was very good.

We had a wonderful visit… this place is the whole package: gorgeous atmosphere and fabulous food.

Had an amazing brunch at The Henry and our server Gene absolutely made the experience. From the moment we sat down he was incredibly friendly, attentive, and gave us great recommendations.

I ordered the Huevos Ranchero Enchilada with steak and it was outstanding. The flavors were perfect and the dish was cooked exactly right. The food was great, but Gene’s service truly took everything to another level.

If you’re visiting The Henry, ask for Gene. He made the entire meal memorable and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Highly recommend.

Been in twice. First time was a solid 3 star experience. No parking, okay service, good food.

Second time in there are still a lot of similarities but this was a better experience. The food was spot on today. Almost perfect in every way and my friends were really impressed too, which was a big reason I came in. The service is always lacking though. They must have just one bartender, because you will wait. The drinks were plenty tasty and a tad strong which is another compliment. But you’ll easily wait 10 min before anyone comes to check on you. Still no parking the second time.

Main reason for coming was the food. The skirt steak was so tender.

Save room for dessert.

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Henry, and it was an experience worth sharing. From start to finish, the food, drinks, and atmosphere created such a memorable evening.

We started off with their coffee selection, and it truly set the tone for the meal. The latte was smooth and perfectly balanced, while the cappuccino had that rich, bold flavor topped with velvety foam—just the kind of warm welcome you’d want before diving into a meal. For appetizers, we had the Spicy Tuna and Crispy Rice, and it set the bar high for the rest of the meal. The crispy rice had the perfect crunch, and the spicy tuna topping was fresh, flavorful, and just the right amount of heat. It’s one of those appetizers you’ll want to order every time you visit.

For the main dishes, I tried the Roasted Chicken and Avocado Salad, which was absolutely refreshing and well-balanced. The chicken was juicy and perfectly seasoned, while the avocado added a creamy richness that tied the whole salad together. It felt light yet satisfying, a perfect choice if you’re looking for something wholesome.

The Grilled Shrimp Taco Platter was another highlight—generous portions of tender, smoky shrimp tucked into warm tortillas with fresh toppings that added both crunch and zest. Each bite was bursting with flavor, and the presentation was as inviting as the taste itself.

To complement it all, I had the pineapple drink, and it was incredibly refreshing. Sweet, tangy, and vibrant, it was the perfect beverage to balance the spices and flavors of the meal.

Beyond the food, the service was attentive, and the atmosphere at Henry is warm, stylish, and welcoming. It’s the kind of place that works equally well for a casual lunch, a dinner with friends, or even a special night out.

I’ll definitely be returning, and I can’t recommend it enough to anyone looking for a restaurant that consistently impresses.

This was a great place for a date night with my wife. The food was pretty good. My wife ordered the Alfredo (with salmon), and I ordered the Sunday Gravy. The Alfredo was made to near perfection, with a creamy base and perfectly done noodles. \I was slightly disappointed with the Sunday Gravy. There were a lot of rougher bites where I had to pick out tendons from the meat, and it disrupted my meal for sure.

The service was very good. We were never waiting for too long or wondering when we would be helped. They were very prompt.

As far as value goes, I'd say things were slightly overpriced for the quality of food. It was okay, but I'm not sure I would go here again, unfortunately.

Used my Amex quarterly Resy credit for lunch here -- honestly, Resy really needs to add more restaurants in AZ because our options are so limited. Tried this spot for the first time since it had a solid 4.6 on Google... sadly I think we must've hit an off day.

Service? Fantastic. Our waiter was super friendly and attentive -- truly the highlight of the meal.
Food? Eh... not so much.

Here's what we tried:
*Arancini: Not crispy, overcooked rice, and just missing flavor.
*Meatballs: Pretty good, but nothing to rave about.
*Caesar salad: Passable.
*Cacio e Pepe: Pasta was overcooked and seriously lacking that peppery punch. Isn't that literally the whole point of the dish?
*Chicken: According to my husband, one of the worst dishes he's had.
*Banana pudding: The star of the show! Honestly, this dessert and the service was their saving grace.

Ambiance was simple and comfy -- your standard neighborhood spot, nothing fancy. Would I go back? Nah. But hey, at least my Resy credit didn't go to waste!

This is a comfortable, neighborhood, food-forward Italian -American Cafe with above-average food and service.  There is very limited parking so use the complimentary valet service, which is recommended.  You can choose regular table seating, "hi-top" or bar seating.  The happy hour is 4-6 I think and is a good value with deals on drinks, appetizers and pizza.  But even during happy hour you can expect to spend $30-40 with drinks & appetizers.  We shared the brussel chips and fried calamari which were both very good.  The pizzas are large and really can serve two otherwise you'll definitely be bringing some home.  And speaking of doggy bags, the servers pack your food for you which is something I wish more restaurants would do instead of tossing a box on your table for you to have to manage on your own.  The servers are attentive but not overbearing and the owner(?)/manager(?) really seems to be paying attention.  The Nook is a nice break from so many cookie cutter chain places (eg the Fox clones) and if you're in the area you won't be disappointed by giving it a try.  RECOMMEND

Trendy, vibey spot with a fun atmosphere. We really enjoyed the pizza dough—it had a great texture—but the sauce and overall flavor of the pizza itself felt a bit average. The wine selection was solid, and the service was friendly and attentive. We also tried the capicola sandwich but were underwhelmed: there was far too much bread compared to the small amount of meat, and the aioli’s flavor didn’t really work for us. On the bright side, the house-made chips were excellent—perfectly seasoned and wonderfully crunchy. Overall, I’d come back to give one of the Bianca pizzas a try, as those looked especially appealing.

Amazing experience. Was initially drawn in through the Resy app is part of the new AMEX rewards. Was the best meal we have had in a long, long time and the service was great. The 3 course dinner was great. Choose an app, pasta or pizza, and dessert for $44. Left so full and happy.

I found this place by accident, pretty much smelled something really good and went towards it.  The customer service was excellent and friendly.  The fried catfish, shrimp, okra and hushpuppies were full of delicious flavor and the homemade dipping sauces for extra taste.  Topped it off with sweet kool-aid.  We didn't have a place to sit and eat, so we ate in the back of the truck and that's OK because it was worth it!  Thank you

DO NOT be fooled by how the place is in small corner or how they don’t have seating. Who freaking cares cause THE FOOD IS HEAVENLY. GOD SENT. And I mean that, truly. Cooked to perfection. I had one of the best burgers of my life here. It made me go back to compliment them on it. That’s how good it was. Don’t take my word for it. Look at the picture! It was so big and cooked so well. Wasn’t even expensive either. I’d pay $12 for a burger with the side any day if it comes out like this. Oh man.

So, I tried Missy’s for the first time last week as I’ve always wanted to try it out. Needless to say after trying it last Tuesday, my entire work team got it for lunch Thursday. The wings are next level. You can tell they make their own batter for the wings. And all their sauces are made in house as well. The ranch is phenomenal. Steak fries, hush puppies, all of it. Top notch.

Hidden gem in South Phoenix and tucked away in the corner of a strip mall, this place is delicious. I got  fried catfish, fried okra, hushpuppies and Kool aid. This is some of the best catfish that I've had in the valley
Food was absolutely incredible. Great prices, great food. Fried green beans were absolutely phenomenal. Customer service was great too.

name: Nigerian Cuisine by MJ
vicinity: 5006 S Maryland Pkwy Suit 11, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Ohhh, it was actually terrible. Why would you specify that a plate of food can serve two people (grown adults, I suppose) and it’s just 2 spoons of rice? For $50! Talk about the wait time for delivery!! So upsetting. I wouldn’t recommend it.
Horrible Nigerian food experience in Las Vegas!!! We paid over $80 for the meals we order and waited over an hour before food arrives. No meat on the food!!! Do not waste your money at this place.

This is the worst nigerian food I have ever ordered. First of all the food cost $250 for only 4 plates of food, plus $25 for tax and $20 for delivery. The food took almost 3 hours to be delivered and then when the food finally arrived, every single item was terrible. Even the plantain tasted so bad. How can anyone mess up fried plantain!!!!!!!. The reviews are either lying or they don’t know what Nigerian food should taste like. Just look at the beans and the yam porridge, the food was not completely cooked. DON’T ORDER FOOD FROM HERE

Worst place to order food! This was an order $25 meat soup. Ordered delivery order. When I called they are said  ' it was to be picked up'  yet I was charged a delivery fee. Finaly pictured that is what was delivered $25. The soup was all in the bag and had to put back in the bowl. No pounded yam as expected. I tried calling several times nothing. DO NOT ORDER!
It should be all Zero though no option for zero

I'm a Nigerian and visiting from Boston Massachusetts. I visited Las Vegas for the first time, and have a notch for Nigerian food. Nigerian cuisine was highly recommended. I drove down to the spot and I was amazed. The guy is humble and down to earth experienced caterer. I ordered my Eba and Egusi soup. It was so delicious and fresh. I fully recommend the Nigerian cuisine. I will be back in December to Vegas and I promise to visit the Nigerian cuisine again.

name: Calabash African Kitchen
vicinity: 1750 S Rainbow Blvd Suite 6-8, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Food is amazing! The best goat pepper I had! Snapper was scrumptious! First time ever having oxtail soup and don’t know how I have lived without it. We also had the chicken empanadas but wasn’t able to get a picture before we dug in. They were so good! Drinks are amazing! I highly recommend the Lemon Sip! The Royal Flush and Sideways Baobab were also delicious. Wonderful service!

My Nigerian husband and I visit Vegas quite a lot for work and have been on the hunt for a Nigerian spot. Our search is over! The egusi was FANTASTIC and the service was even better. Afrobeats playing, Nigerian beer and good vibes. Will be back for sure

If I could give ten stars, I would. Everything was phenomenal, from the service to the food. Our server, Nyla was beyond amazing as she provided some helpful information about some of the menu items and made some excellent recommendations. The Oxtail stew was so flavorful, and it was so good, that I was scraping the bowl after I was finished. This is needs to be on everyone's LV bucket list.

Delicious West African food. Well seasoned and flavorful. We had meatpies, the jollof with chicken, attieke with fish and oxtail with rice and I have nothing bad to say about any of them. The two cons is the wait time for the food to be served; but the wait is worth it for sure. Also the food is pretty pricey.

My experience at calabash was 8/10
The food was good and the service was really good too. I went there with my friends that come from Swiss for a work conference and they loved all the food. The only thing for me they sells empty jellof rice for $21 and sell meats separately $8 or so while on the menu they are vegetables and fish or meat but when it served it some how different. Too pricey. I recommend this place. Have lots of money in the bank lol

name: Mama Putt @ Flavor House
vicinity: 3900 W Charleston Blvd Suite 120, Las Vegas

reviews.text: We held a brunch event at Mama Putt last week and couldn’t have been more pleased. Every dish arrived hot and bursting with flavor, and the presentation was lovely.
