The menu felt like a genuine cultural experience — exciting, authentic, and very satisfying. The staff were attentive and professional, which made the whole event run smoothly. Would definitely return and recommend Mama Putt for anyone looking for delicious food and a memorable brunch experience.

1st time trying this place. Got the teriyaki salmon bowl, empanadas,  fried musubi. Sweet chili sauce for the empanadas was perfectly flavored and spiced for me. I love spicy! Fried misusing was delicious! Salmon bowl was perfectly grilled and delicious.  The man who rang up the order was pleasant and personable. Will definitely try again...
I ordered  rice with beef. The beef was super tender, easily could cut with a spoon. The Suya was hot temperature, seasoned well with some heat, lots of heat.

Service was interesting. It was around 6pm, my husband and I walked in to what seems to be an empty restaurant. We must have missed the crowd because the server proceeded to inform us that their teriyaki items ran out which was alright as we weren't there for teriyaki to begin with. Anyhow, we decided on chicken curry with Fufu. Shortly after, the server tells my husband that they ran out of curry. I was a tad disappointed but quickly browsed the menu again and picked the chicken stew with Fufu. The cashier seem to have difficulty getting our orders in and getting our change back to us. Again, not a problem. Service was just nothing to look forward to.

Food was a 5 out of 5. I've been wanting to try Fufu for a few months now and I must say.. I wasn't disappointed. The chicken Stew with Fufu was delicious ! The flavour was on point, meat was tender, and Fufu was well done.  Knowing how to eat Fufu is key to a good experience, so YouTube it if you have to.

Atmosphere of the dining is decent. Nice music. Spacious dining room. Overall clean and tidy.

We will definitely return for the food. 😊🔥

I came here yesterday, because I wanted to try Cameroonian food. The server came over and greeted me which was very nice. Very polite man, so I asked for recommendations since it was first time. I went ahead with his recommendation and I wasn’t disappointed. He recommended Ndole and it was good I liked the bitterness. I will be back again to eat and I left something there so I do have to be back. 😂🤦🏽‍♀️

South Asian trying African dishes for the first time and I have to say, the food is absolutely delicious, flavorful, and served hot. Ordered red snapper platter, fufu, and hibiscus juice. The portion were gpod for family of two adults and a 6-year-old. Everything about the food was excellent, and the staff were very friendly. They also have an African market next to the restaurant with clothing and artwork that makes you feel like you’re getting a glimpse of their home country

The lady’s and gentleman in charge of the restaurant were very welcoming and kind individuals who made my first time trying authentic African food the most amazing experience I could ever have! The food itself is truly phenomenal and delicious! LOVE THIS PLACE AND WILL BE COMING BACK 👍

I appreciated the friendly service when I ordered delivery. However, the “jollof” was very rubbery and difficult to eat, although the fish was good. Unfortunately, this experience means I won’t be returning.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Exceptional Service, Flavor, and Hospitality

I hosted a private group dining experience here on very short notice, and this restaurant absolutely delivered. From the moment I reached out, they were responsive, flexible, and incredibly accommodating, even reserving the entire space for our group of nearly 20.

The staff prepared a hot West African buffet exactly as requested — everything from spinach and stews to a full range of proteins. The food was flavorful, well-seasoned, and authentically done, and my group couldn’t stop raving about it. The house-made drinks — ginger, hibiscus, tropical— were powerful, refreshing. The egusi, pounded yam, was a hit amongst the Nigerian crowd.

The Afrobeats playlist and ambiance was ON POINT: lively enough to set the mood but soft enough for real conversation. The owner went above and beyond, even helping us capture photos of the group and making sure everyone felt welcomed.

People left full, happy, and satisfied- especially those trying West African cuisine for the first time. This restaurant truly helped create the exact experience I envisioned.

If you’re hosting a group event, cultural gathering, or just want genuinely good African food in Vegas, I highly recommend this place. Great food, great service, great people and they executed with speed, heart, and accomodating service.

I had such a wonderful experience here! From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted me warmly and made me feel welcome. The service was quick, attentive, and genuinely friendly throughout my entire visit.

The food was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish tasted like it was made with care and attention to detail. My favorite part was how well-balanced everything was, both in taste and portion size.

Overall, this place exceeded my expectations. Great food, excellent service, and a welcoming atmosphere—I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to friends and family!

name: Soul of Afrika
vicinity: 4972 S Maryland Pkwy Suite 21, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Soul of Afrika was a really nice place to eat, with flavorful food and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The staff were especially helpful, they checked in on us, asked if we needed any help, and were genuinely kind, which made the whole experience feel comfortable and enjoyable. Overall, it was just a nice place to be, and I’d definitely recommend it.

Absolutely loved everything. Visited Vegas from DC and honestly was not expecting much. We actually visited Nigeria Cuisine first and had a horrible experience then came here. The difference was CLEAR!!!!! The place is cozy and inviting and cleannnn. The service is great and did I mention the place is clean? Okay. Now to the food, I wasn’t expecting much as I previously mentioned, but I was pleasantly surprised! The food was a solid 9/10 and generous with the goat meat. Loved every bite as shown in the picture attached. Clean plate club. We are so happy especially after the nonsense experience we had at Nigerian Cuisine. I highly recommend - this is the standard we need to support and uphold!

We got the stew and rice/ chicken and the jollof rice/catfish. Little gem of a spot. Boyfriend said it almost tasted like Dad's growing up and was so happy and full on just half the stew plate.. !! So happy and can't wait to come back and get more and then some!! It all tastes RIGHT. When you walk in and the smell/atmosphere, we want to stay and eat next time. Thankyou guys for an amazing lunch/dinner!!!

I wanted to love this place. I understand this isn't Ghanian food, but a soup isn't meant to have the texture of stew. We didn't get something we ordered. Spent over 200 dollars, and the family we brought here was definitely not impressed.  I ordered jollof rice and beef, and there was barely any meat. It was a huge bone and tons of fat. I'm so disappointed.  😢  Our server was nice and definitely tried. As soon as we sat down, it was so dark that the kids were scared. Thankfully,  someone turned on some lights. My jollof rice did taste okay.  I don't like to write anything but 5 star reviews because I know some days aren't good days, but I felt I needed to share.

Also, they have none of the appetizers on the menu or a kids menu. I wish I had known that before we drove and ubered all of us over.

Great customer service.

But..

Food is overpriced.

You guys charge $6 for malt. Seriously? And $2 for tiny bottle of water.
Your egusi soup with fufu is $27 which is way overpriced. Your Egusi soup was tasty but lacking good seasoning. Your meat was tasteless.

Your restaurant location is in Las Vegas not in NYC, ATL, Seattle, Miami or San Francisco. Make it affordable for everyone just like the hotels around you in Vegas.

name: Le Bon Goût Chez Fa
vicinity: 3920 W Charleston Blvd # A, Las Vegas

reviews.text: I’m writing this review as I still sit in the restaurant. This place was absolutely amazing. Everything was so delicious. I came with my family and everyone was absolutely delighted. We tried red snapper, yassa tofu, yassa yap, fataya, nem, oxtail soup, and fried plantains. Please try them so you can be delighted like we were. The empty dishes just prove how delicious everything was, lol!

Had a delicious Senagalese meal and experience with friends here. Mr. Mohammed & Chef Fa were so welcoming and kind. They offered us 6-7 samples of the different drinks available. I loved the Ginger Juice & Ditakh the most. All the drinks were sweet and refreshing. We also had these stuffed Fish Empanadas/Fataya, Yassa Yap w/ Jollof Rice, sweet plantain, oxtail stew, & fufu which were all so good with and without their spicy sauces. We ordered more Fataya to go because they were bomb. Will definitely be back for the food, good music, & vibes.

First time having African food. It was amazing. The flavors were intense. It's a family-run business. The nephew who waited on us was very sweet and helped us through the menu and gave us some options that we absolutely loved. He told us about the oxtail which was amazing. The beef dish I had was delicious. The plantains were thick and sweet but not too sweet.  The food takes a while to make as it is made by order. It was definitely worth the wait. I will be back again and I highly recommend this restaurant.

The food is crazy! The best red snapper in the world! Auntie Fa is sooooooooo nice, we tried the oxtail and fufu and red snapper with jollof rice and it was crazy. The jollof rice had a perfect spice and the fufu texture was next level. The food takes a long time to get because the family works hard in the restaurant, it’s an amazing restaurant. Deserves a Michelin, actually THREE Michelin stars

Wanted to try something different, and authentic. Saw a highly recommended review on Instagram so i decided to give it a try.  Food was amazingly flavorful, and savory.  Love how they let you sample the drinks if you not familiar with them. Had the signature Red Snapper w/rice, and salad. The fish was slightly overcooked on the outside but the inside was delicious. Presentation was awesome with the Africa shaped dished. Looking forward to going back and try the oxtail soup.

It taste so bad.I was here today .. the experience was horrible..the fried rice wasn’t nice it looked bad with a very dried meat. The suya stick taste bad I couldn’t eat it. I asked for tilapia on my porridge the porridge was bad they gave me can fish instead of the fried tilapia. The meat pepper soup meat was tooooooooooooo soft …in all the food was not food at all ..it 0/100% for me.i have not seen a catfish pepper soup like this.

We ordered the Suya “ meat sticks” it came with maybe 10 dry pieces of beef jerky and some onions and tomatoes. It was the most dry,  hardest, beef jerky  meat and not anything close to suya. My husband ordered the jollof plate with goat meat and plantain. The goat meat must have been there for 10 days as it was hard dry and ugh. The plantain wasn’t fresh , more like rubber or plastic . The jollof rice was actually good. I’m pretty sure they have the food made in bulk and just warm it up in the back. The server was nice and refunded my suya sticks. Unfortunately , we will never eat here again.

CoCo’s African Kitchen is hands down one of the best restaurants in Las Vegas. It is absolutely outstanding! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warmth and hospitality that makes you feel right at home. Truly a home away from home! The food is absolutely delicious,authentic, flavorful, and prepared with so much care. Every dish bursts with rich African spices and tastes that remind you of the motherland. Whether you’re trying African cuisine for the first time or you grew up with it, CoCo’s will exceed your expectations.
The atmosphere is welcoming, the service is excellent, and the portions are generous. It’s more than just a meal. It’s an experience!!
If you’re looking for a place that serves outstanding food in a warm and vibrant setting, look no further. I highly recommend CoCo’s African Kitchen to anyone in Texas (and beyond). Once you try it, you’ll definitely keep coming back!

CoCo’s African Kitchen! Authentic. Delicious. Unmatched.🍲
Come Hungry, Leave Happy!🍛

This restaurant should not exist at all, I was on a vacation in Vegas, and the moment I came in town, I decided to check if there's an African Restaurant on doordash, and bang this restaurant pop up without me looking at the review, I placed an order for a 2 jollof rice, 1 for rounded and egunsi, and a plate of pepper soup  , spending over 116$, jollof rice doesn't even taste like a restaurant jollof rice, the moment I ordered on doordash, I realized they didn't ask me for the option of protein on my food, I called the restaurant and a guy picked up,  and after I explained the situation he got my order and told me I ordered 2 sides of jollof rice and it doesn't come with meat, at the end of the call, he said I will throw some goat meat in there buddy and dude hung up, I got my order and it was a mess, the pounded yam doesn't even taste like pounded yam, either flower or pounded, the egunsi was all white , no sign of vegetable what so ever in it, I manage to eat the pounded yam but trust me, I had food poisoning for the first 3 days of my vacation,  I tried leaving feedback on doordash but for whatever reason it didn't let me  ,saying I can't get refund. But am not talking about refund but the quality of the service here,
Talk about the pepper soup,  I don't even know what to describe it with , I couldn't eat it at all. All ended in the trash,  this restaurant is nothing to write home about, I ended up spending over 600$ at Calabash African Kitchen,  mennnnn, the customer service was good, quality of food was 💯.  Cocos restaurant,  you guys are not representing African restaurants well at all.

The owner responded to my review talking about i ordered side of Jollof rice does not come with protein, I did not order side of Jollof Rice, I ordered 2 plates of Jollof rice, and i paid 30$ each, so both rice i paid 60$, is your side of Jollof rice 60$? what about the fact that your food gave me food poison???? did you read about that in in my review? why not address that part?

Why not allow me to reply to your response? why do i only have one option to delete my review?? this is so unfair and you are just selling rubbish to your customers, especially those that are not from Africa, who dont even know what it looks or taste like.

I am trying to upload the receipt for my order but for some reasons wont let me.

JUST CHANGE THE QUALITY OF FOOD YOU ARE COOKING FOR PEOPLE TO EAT TO THE BEST. when people order from the restaurants its not that they cant cook at home, they sometimes just want a better taste than what they are use to.

if you get a chance to read my review before eating here, please don't go there if you don't want to damage your health.
The beef patties were sooooo good! And the plantains were perfect. Definitely a must try
This place is original Nigeria food with home taste. price is right.

name: PSAINT ROC LLC DBA LAS GIDI
vicinity: Westlake Center, 4529 W Sahara Ave, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
My wife ordered egusi soup from this restaurant to surprise me, since she knows how much I love it. The result? Pure disappointment—and serious concern. The soup was nothing but salt, no authentic flavor at all. When my wife called to complain, the owner openly admitted he loads it with Maggi and salt because, in his words, “people in Las Vegas like spices.” That is reckless and dangerous. Excessive sodium and artificial seasoning at that level isn’t just bad cooking—it poses real health risks, including high blood pressure, kidney damage, heart disease, and long-term organ strain.

This is not food—it’s poison disguised as a meal. The owner even said “it’s all about business.” That tells you everything. Please, do not order from here. For the sake of your health, your family’s health, and the community’s safety, this place needs to be reported to public health immediately.

⚠️ WARNING: This is a serious risk to human health. Be careful and stay away.

Ordered on DoorDash, food took twice as long to come because they had the door locked. Certain items on the menu weren’t available but overall, the food was pretty good. Fried rice and plantains were delicious but the soup swallow was really watered down. The meat was terrible, not as advertised. Fried rice was supposed to come with meat, but didn’t have any. By the time we got to us, it had leaked all over the bag as well, terrible packaging.

First of all, they should remove that “las gidi” from their name because they are a disgrace to Lagos.

I ordered 1plate of ofada sauce with white rice and 1plate of jollof rice and chicken

The ofada sauce had a very nasty smell, not ofada smell or the iru smell, something nasty. It  was literally smelling like poo, just 1 spoon of it and I almost threw up

The jollof rice was nothing to write home about, no taste at all, just red colour and oil. Also had a nasty smell, I don’t know what kind of useless oil they use in that kitchen

The chicken was not cooked, inside of the chicken tastes and smells like the chicken has gone bad.

This restaurant is literally a health hazard and should be closed down

How I wish I can make a formal police and health report for the US government to look into this sham of a restaurant

I hope this review helps someone out there, DO NOT BUY from this restaurant, you will be left traumatized!!!!!

THE ABSOLUTE WORST—food and service alike. I ordered two plates of spicy noodles, asun, and chicken suya, and beef kebab, but I received soggy, salty noodles (both portions served on one plate), and it looked disgusting! They even added shrimp, which I didn’t ask for, with no regard for allergies. We also never received the beef kebab.

By the way, the asun was basically three tiny pieces of goat meat drowned in lots of veggies and oil. When I called to express my displeasure, the man had the audacity to tell me the plate was big enough for two portions, so there was no need for two plates. He added that it’s only Nigerians who complain, well, he’s absolutely right because we know what the food should taste like! He also tried to play the “I have people your age at home” card, which goes to show the deep level of unprofessionalism.

No apologies were rendered, the worst customer service, crowned by the mediocrity of a Nigerian man trying to prove a point when he’s clearly wrong.

🚨 ABSOLUTELY THE WORST PLACE EVER – RUN AWAY!!! 🚨

This so-called restaurant is an embarrassment to food, hospitality, and basic human decency. The food is disgusting beyond words. Overloaded with salt and Maggi until it tastes like punishment, not a meal, the owner literallytold me he loaded it with Maggi. Every bite felt like they were daring me to keep eating, and the worst part? They serve it with zero remorse, like they know it’s trash and don’t care.

The customer service? A total disaster. Rude, careless, and offensive.  The owner himself is the crown jewel of the nonsense — arrogant, unprofessional, and flat-out disrespectful. He had the audacity to say he doesn’t like Nigerians because “they complain.” Excuse me? People complain because your food is HORRIBLE, your service is HORRIBLE, and your attitude is even worse.

This isn’t just a bad restaurant — it’s a health hazard, a scam, and a shame all rolled into one. If you value your health, your money, or even the tiniest bit of self-respect, avoid this place like the plague. Don’t walk away — RUN.

name: Africa Love Food Market
vicinity: 3375 S Decatur Blvd unit 2, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Yes I’ve found ingredients for momma African dish
TASTY!!!

name: Abyssinia Restaurant & Lounge
vicinity: 4780 W Tropicana Ave Suite #108, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
I definitely recommend dining here for an evening out. Another recommendation: the Meat & Veggie platter. It's a must try for first time visitors. Be sure to ask about the spiciness level. Some of the spices will get you, and is worth the sampling.

Good atmosphere, good food, and good service. I'll return to explore that lamb menu.

We hadn’t had Ethiopian food in years and were craving it and thankfully we found this spot. The restaurant is small but the interior is beautiful and comforting. They have traditional music playing in the background which we very much enjoyed. The host was very kind and service was excellent.

We ordered the sambusa lentil and the vegetarian platter. The sambusa was fresh and crispy. The platter came with a variety of lentils and vegetables - each one extremely delicious and flavorful! My favorite was the yellow mung and my wife’s favorite was the green mung. It reminded us of Indian and Sri Lankan cuisines.

Overall, it’s a solid restaurant and we would recommend to those who enjoy similar traditional dishes. We would definitely come back again.

Hey, y'all, hey. I hope y'all are having a great day 🤗 About 3days ago I went to Abyssinia Restaurant & Lounge. It's near the blade. When you walk in right away you see these beautiful soft leather, purple sofas. You seat yourself well at least we did.. Right away I asked to use the bathroom. To see if it was clean. Because if a Restaurant bathroom isn't clean I'm not eating there. It was VERY CLEAN. I don't like where it's located but that's just me 🤭 Anyway we order the platter part veges & part meat. It took a while but when it was brought to us, the AROMAS...FROM THE SPICES WAS EVERRRYTHING. I'm closing my eyes & I can still smell the freshness of it all!! The colors from the lentils to the greens to the  tibs were so colorful. We order the injerah I probably spelled it wrong. The only thing was the injerah was cold. I mean cold like it was just taken out the fridge. I told our server I think her name was Mani. She apologized & when she brought it back it was warm. The other thing the food wasn't that hot either. It was more room temperature.  But when I TELL Y'ALL THIS FOOD WAS CHEF kiss  😘 SLAP YO MOMMA as they say.. GOOOOD it was REEEEEEEALLY GOOD!! I was disappointed they didn't have any honey🍯 wine. But I'd definitely will go back. Aye, stop reading this & get to the Abyssinia Ethiopian Restaurant 🤭
Continue to enjoy y'all day smooches 🤗 btw the injerah what the food is placed on is so make your toes curl DELICIOUS due to the seasonings having soaked in i loved it!! See y'all at my next review 🤗

Really Good Ethiopian food. My wife is from Ethiopia and we always try to get some injera when we travel. First time for us in Vegas and the injera was really really good.  Very good service and overall good experience.
Clean.. delicious Ethiopian food.. superb ambiance. We tried the Tibs and the veggie platter. The taste takes you back to Ethiopia.

name: Gursha Ethiopian Restaurant
vicinity: 3711 S Valley View Blvd suit H, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
We were really curious about tasting Ethiopian food so when we saw the sign we decided to go and give it a try.
The experience was superb!, we were greeted at the entrance with a kind and joyful smile; this was our sign that we were in for a treat.
We stepped in, she gave us the menus and we told her it was our first time and asked her to explain us the menú and food.
She graciously suggested a few and went in for a fabulous tasting of a magnificent cuisine. We waited for our food and in the meantime we started seeing that another table came in and then another one and we started believing that this place has the magic of the cook and hostess (all in one for that day) she makes you feel like you arrived at your grandmas house.
Each dish was a delight by itself, we finish it all: clean plate. After that we saw a few friends and told them about this fabulous place and food.
We will definitely tell the world about it!!
Don’t miss it!!!

I LOVE small businesses and small restaurants. This was my 1st visit to Gursha and I'll DEFINITELY be coming back again! Gursha is a very warm and inviting restaurant. I was welcomed and seated immediately. Having only had Ethiopian food once before, decades ago as a teenager in Chicago, I wasn't sure what to try from the menu. The recommendations were soooo greatly appreciated. The lamb special was AMAZING!!! Absolutely DELICIOUS!!!
Finished the meal with baklava and spiced tea for desert. Very nice too.
The Ethiopian music playing on the TV added to the relaxing mood.
Check this place out. It's a local gem here in Vegas...and only a few minutes drive off of The Strip if you're visiting.
Highly recommend.

We can't say enough good things about our experience here. Mimi the owner is the most warm, friendly person. We haven't had a lot of experience eating Ethiopian food and her recommendations were so perfect. The food was incredibly flavorful the most wonderful comfort food. She even showed us how to use our hands to scoop the injira bread into all the yummy stews and fed my toddler and mother in law a bite. We left feeling so content and full!

I'm from Hawaii and the only Ethiopian restaurant there closed a few years ago. I've always enjoyed it and I'm glad to discover Gursha Ethiopian Restaurant on the 9th Island.

The food came out quickly, Mimi, the owner is super friendly, and the food... The food is amazing. I had the veggie sampler (of course) and the awaze tibs. The tibs was spicier than they made it back home, but I love spicy food.

I asked Mimi what Gursha means, and it means feeding each other. It's a tradition to share good food with everyone on your table.

Yum! I'll be back for sure.

First time trying this cuisine and wow! Splendid! Mimi was a sweetheart and cooked the meal entirely by herself from scratch all while teaching us about the food. It was great, Thank you Mimi!!

Highly recommend for people who have never tried Ethiopian before - step outside your comfort zone for a wonderful meal at a local business :)
Excellent and perfect Nigerian African touch food, prepared while you wait and play African games. Place to visit.
If you're looking for that great home cooked African food, this is your place. Try it..
It’s really Indians and the restaurant is a cover up!! Be safe y’al
A little small and maybe no for everyone but nice food

Never eat a big belly in Vegas like I do in Karod cafe! I couldn’t help recommending that to uber drivers. And the genuine coffee will be a must to try! Appreciate Karod’s the best Ethiopian kichten in Vegas!

I’m so amazed I found this place. The food is incredibly authentic and honestly reminds me of my mom’s cooking. The flavors, the spices, everything tastes real and homemade. The portions are huge too, which I didn’t expect at all. I can’t believe I never knew this spot existed. This is definitely my new and only go-to for Ethiopian food from now on. 😊

I highly recommend Karod Café to anyone looking for a real taste of Ethiopian cuisine. Whether you’re Ethiopian or just discovering the food, this place is a hidden gem in Las Vegas. I’ll be back soon—and I’m bringing friends!
Authentic Ethiopian food must try ….everything is delicious home cooked food style amazing taste n hospitality .
I was in Vegas for two days and ate there twice. Great food and great service. I enjoyed their delicious kitfo and shiro.
A must stop if you’re in town and craving habesha food . Tg was our server and her attention to details and pleasant smile was really nice 💯
It is one of the best ethiopian food u could find in Las Vegas.

By far the best Ethiopian restaurant in Vegas. The atmosphere is not pretentious but genuinely Ethiopian. It feels like Addis. If you are a fan of meat this is your place. You must try the goat dishes. The people are very friendly and inviting and the food is consistently the best. It's also a butcher shop. Meat is super fresh. Try it and, like me, you'll keep coming back

Seble Market is a gem in the community! The variety of fresh produce and quality products is impressive, and the staff is always friendly and helpful. I love the wide selection of local and international foods. The store is clean, well-organized, and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great restaurant experience!!!

The best Ethiopian place to get a fresh food and same test.
The owner so friendly approach to everyone.

name: Nigerian Food
vicinity: 953 E Sahara Ave E-22, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Amazing Nigerian food, and if you haven't had it before she will help guide you.  Get off the Strip and come eat fantastic food!  Call ahead if you're in a hurry, all food is made fresh.  Homemade style.

First time trying fufu and egusi soup. Got level 3 I believe and it was tasty although next time I'd go higher. Service was nice and the restaurant was cozy and I really liked the dish a lot.

It's also in a neat little area with a great view of the strip once you walk out.

Food was magically delicious!! If you want authentic Nigerian cuisine, then lol no further. Whenever I travel I always look for a Nigerian restaurant to try and besides me going to Nigeria last year, this is as fresh and authentic as it gets. With it being made fresh, it will take more time to
Prepare but it’s worth it and very professional

I won't say I'm the best person to review Nigerian food. This is only the second place I've had Nigerian food and the other was in California. The food was tasty to me but very pricey therefore I don'tknow if I'll be able to eat it often. I liked the egusi though level 3 was not spicy enough for me. My husband got the jollof rice with mixed meat which he said was a bit tough and the rice a bit too wet. The flavor was good though. The staff was friendly and the decor could be updated a bit but I don't mind those things as much as food.

I had a truly disappointing experience with the owner’s service. Her rudeness and lack of basic customer service skills were shocking. After we were told to expect a 55-minute wait, we were informed via text over an hour later that our food was ready. The kicker? She expected us to arrive in just 2 minutes, despite it being already 7:55 PM!

When we explained that our Uber was on the way, she had the audacity to question why she should wait for us. Seriously? She claimed to be a pharmacy, but that doesn’t excuse her unprofessional behavior. To top it all off, her own business hours on Google clearly state that they close at 9:00 PM!

This experience was not just frustrating; it was infuriating. Customer service should be a priority, and this encounter proved otherwise. I won’t be returning.

Definitely check out their catering option if you have to do an event or you’re looking to feed several people. The food is amazing and the set up is great. Call and ask for Chef Elijah to it set up. They make it pretty easy

Elijah is a great host and phenomenal cook! We came in Christmas eve, and we tasted and i have to say, the food is amazing we will definitely be back real soon thank you the oxtails fell off the bone the seasoning is amazing. God bless this owner he is an amazing soul

Had an amazing experience at Jerk Dat on 12/28/25. My boyfriend and I met up with a friend. Upon arrival we had to wait to have our orders taken, but the wait was totally worth it for such delectable food. The owner recognized our friend almost immediately after helping him out on the side of the road over a year ago - talk about an elephant memory! 🐘 He treats everyone like family, and we felt right at home. Before we even ordered, he gave us samples of his homemade soup 🍲 on the house and free bottled waters. That soup? 🔥 Made with love, it hit the spot and warmed my soul. I was getting over a cold, but after tasting it, I felt like I could run a marathon.
Food was delicious, and the portions were generous. I ordered curry chicken with noddles on the side as my boyfriend and our friend ordered jerk chicken with noodles on the side. Would've given 5 stars for the food, but my noodles were a bit cold- no biggie, still devoured it 😋.
The real MVP is the owner, who gave us a free big container of soup to take home. I was nice and let our friend have it since he showed me this place and paid for our meal-not gonna lie was willing to fight over that soup😅. If you're looking for a place with heart, come here! Highly recommend.
P.S. Owner, what's it gonna take to get those recipes? 🙏🏻

We came in HUNGRY from out of town, and the owner was kind enough to let us sample before we ordered. He prepared our plates and we enjoyed his conversation. Our plates were so hefty, we were able to eat leftovers for 2 additional meals! Very happy we found this gem!

So glad I gave this place a shot, I got the jerk chicken and oxtail with collard greens.

The oxtail and chicken were so tender they practically melted in your mouth and fell off the bone, and overall the food was really good and the lady serving me was very friendly and kind.

I try not to eat out very often, but I'm definitely adding this place to my cycle of try again's.

This place is very dirty. It isn't even a restaurant. The owner lives in the establishment and has a living room in it. I went to pick up a Uber eats order from there and he with held the order for a unknown reason. He was very rude and the place smelled.

Incredible Ethiopian food with excellent service. We had the tartar and the lamb and they were so good. The lamb chops were so tender and super flavorful. I wish we had gone there before our last day so we could have gone back again. Big portion sizes. The staff were super nice as well. I felt bad we couldn't eat it all as it was so good and they were so nice.
Super clean interior and nice place to talk too.

The food is outstanding—rich, flavorful, and authentic. Every dish is perfectly seasoned, with generous portions that make it easy to share.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting. It’s a place where you can enjoy a casual meal or settle in for a longer evening with friends and family.

The staff is friendly, attentive, and genuinely happy to guide you through the menu if you’re new to Ethiopian cuisine.

It is a great spot if you're looking to try delicious Ethiopian food. The food is flavorful, the place is clean, and the vibe is modern. The service is a little bit slow; they take a while to bring the food except that It's definitely worth a visit if you want a good experience.

After a 5-hour drive from LA, we arrived around 10 pm and were warmly greeted by Hanna at the entrance. Since it was our first visit, she kindly recommended the Kitfo and Beg Tibs. The food was served promptly, and both dishes were absolutely delicious — flavorful with just the right amount of kick.
The service stood out as well. Hanna and Hermela checked on us multiple times to make sure we were satisfied and had everything we needed. Another highlight was the restroom — clean and well-maintained, something that is often neglected at some Habesha restaurants.
Overall, a wonderful first experience with excellent food, attentive service, and a welcoming atmosphere.

When the food is so good, you order extra and the owners win your heart!
The kitfo brought back the sweetest childhood memories of Kitfo bets in Yohannes area in Addis Ababa, and the owners’ genuine hospitality made us feel right at home. The mom cooks in the kitchen while the dad takes care of the customers a typical Ethiopian feeling brought from thousands of miles. The food was so delicious we couldn’t resist ordering extra and even though we couldn’t finish it, they were so kind and didn’t charge us for one of the dishes when we came back on another day. Luhen in Vegas, this is definitely one of our favorite spots! we’ll be back! 🇪🇹❤️🍽️

Very cool niche store with international goods!

Efraim was especially helpful and great at small talk and customer service! Will be visiting here often

Me and my friends went there for a break time around 7pm. The restaurant is attached with the market, at the front by the market side looks busy but at the back  the restaurant part a little bit quit.  The building,the chair,the restroom is brand new, excellent, clean and the room smells nice.
We ordered "agelgil" (አገልግል)  and "tibs" (ጥብስ). The portion of the agelgil is more than enough for two people and the taste was super. My friend also likes the tibs and was fresh. Our server was very polite. Every time when I went to a restaurant I expect a very tasty food, enough portion and a nice polite server,here I got all! Thanks. Oh btw the price was reasonable. Defiantly I'll bring families and friends.
To be the best of Vegas needs some improvements on
1: our food was late, as a matter of fact other than us there was only one family in the restaurant and shouldn't be that late.
2: even if the server was very polite she didn't ask us how was the food,or what else should we need, ( I saw a coffee with jebena ጀበና ቡና)
3: keep it professional የአገልግል ምግቡን ለመገልበጥ ስትቸገር ተመልክቻለሁ፣ she needs a help, when we need something we have to wait until she come from kitchen. I saw a lot of employees or family friends walking by but no offer to ask.
I wish you to grow one of the best Ethiopian authentic restaurant. See you in a few days.
They sell you things getting expired like meat 2 weeks old meat people at the counter for no business bad experience ever

Just passing through and got a great gored gored (one of the best I've had in a while) and Ambo water to go, and got to practice some Amharic. Friendly staff there and the place is very nice with easy parking.

I asked the cashier if they sell kategna, he replied not yet, but he went to the kitchen and got one for me for free, and it was tasty!
I have no words!
Thank you sir!
Will definitely come back again.

html_attributions: Axum Palace Resto Bar las vegas nv

reviews.text:
When Merkato closed some years back, I gave up on the hunt for good Ethiopian food.. One of my best friends let me know about this gem that I seemed to have looked over. BEST ETHIOPIAN FOOD IN THE CITY OF LAS VEGAS.
My favorite dish is the awaze tibs. They did not disappoint. Flavor was ON POINT! They served the lamb without bones as well.. major plus! I have eaten twice through delivery and food came at perfect temp. They serve a plentiful helping! Do yourself a favor… grab a bite!
So much flavor and just enough heat... spice blends are on point!! This is my favorite Ethiopian Restaurant in town, food is great and everyone was super friendly.
Axum was awesome! Very friendly staff. Nice bar area and restaurant and stage area and Ethiopian music. We got doro wot and kitfo and both were great! Thanks!

I have been looking forward to this place and oh what a disappointment. The place had 2 or 3 people, seem mostly employees. Looks nice and cozy I will say. Service was terrible. Server doesn't speak English so a gentleman who apparently works here came over to help. Many menu items not available.  Ordered some drinks mainly water and beer. After that we sat for a long time with no one coming over to take order. They just stared from the bar. After waiting too long, I went over to the bar to close out and pay for my drinks.   No questions asked as to why. They all just stood behind bar talking and laughing.  I have  NEVER had such terrible service even in the worst restaurant I've eaten in. This was beyond worst. I will definitely not be back. All i have to show is my water and beer. Do better folks. I am all for international restaurants. I hope to have one of my own but they have a reputation that needs to be remedied. Poor service to the point I am embarassed!!! Horrible service. If the food is great, I guess I wouldn't know
Our flight landed late and we didn’t want fast food, I was so grateful they were open and served us a delicious, fresh dinner with a smile on their face at 11 PM! Thank you!

We not impressed at all! The specialty drink was EXTREMELY SUGARY. I was told by the waitress the red snapper dinner was 5 pieces, only to receive 2. When I asked the quanity the guy there dismissed me and I had to be forceful and inform him "had i not been told that, I would not have spent $30 on a 2 piece fish meal dinner!" He was not attempting to make it right, instead wanted me to simply accept the misconception. The lady checking out requested the order be corrected, but left with cat fish instead of red snapper (realized after i was home and ready to eat, what i thought was red snapper). My red beans and rice was not good at all, the beans were not fully cooked. My rice and gravy was plenty of rice with minimal gravy. I understand were in a certain time in the US but don't charge for quantity if you can't provide quality!!! Soda machine was not working, did not have the debit/credit terminal working. The lady before us had to get her order corrected over 3 times. The lady after us had to request to have the drink watered down due to the sugar amount and her food with less salt... A waste of my money and time. Not to mention the gentleman's poor customer service.

This is a home away from home. I’m actually on here now about to place an order for smothered chicken, Black Eyed Peas, macaroni and yams two complementary cornbread and of course a peach cobbler and some tropical punch Kool-Aid mix with a little lemonade always bring my people here from all over the world. #Vino🎬LoveYouMore!!
Great southern style food in a friendly lively environment.  Staff was very friendly. I had catfish, greens, and blackened peas for good luck for the new year.  Delicious!

Order ahead if you’re in a hurry! Because these cooks ain’t .. all they’re worried about is making some of the best food I’ve ever eaten!  and they had a bunch of celebrities on the wall that I didn’t know …but the food was amazing. Eat here today.

I have been in Vegas 4 days. Kenny ran this place with ease.  When I say it was our first time and we were nervous. This man was so accommodating, attentive and kind. The cornbread was hot water deliciousness. My catfish was fried to perfection. I don’t eat anyone’s greens, but my mom’s. He let me tase the greens 🔥. That lemonade and dessert delicious.  Please don’t at here you will not be disappointed.

name: Vitos Tacos
vicinity: 7380 S Eastern Ave Ste. 118, Las Vegas

reviews.text: It has a sewer smell to the restaurant. If you are into dirty tables with a bad sewage smell well here is your place. One side has been masked off with tape for over 2 weeks. The prices are too expensive for the quality of food and service. You are not served your food so basically for a family to easily spending $70 on tacos you have to walk up and get it yourself like McDonalds. The food is very inconsistent as you can see the eggrolls are very greasy one day, the next chance they were coming unrolled when fried. Don’t waste your time.

Best taco Tuesday deal. Honestly, the Birria tacos are great and they exceptional price-wise, even for a normal day. Also, the nice lady cleaning my table was so sweet. I only understood half of what she said because I can only speak as much Spanish as a 1 year old. But she was so incredibly sweet and spoke as soft as a Disney Princess. 15/10 would go back again.

First time trying Vito Tacos, and it was so tasty. Their birra tacos are very good and the consomme is flavorful. The green Verde salsa is just the right heat, and the red is a little more spicy, both of them i enjoyed. I was the first customer because I was waiting for them to open up at 10:30 am and I'll be repeat customer guarantee.

I completely love the fact that their new location is closer to me. Vito’s tacos serves up the freshest variety of Birria  that you ever want to experience.  The food taste even better when you have quality staff that cares such as Veronica Thank U;  look forward to more frequent visits from me…

I love their egg rolls, are the best ones, and yes don't expect your typical rolls, this are filled with birria and is super good. The quesadilla was also good, but I got surprised that their horchata is really good, especially to be from a fountain drink. And the ice pop are really good. Definitely my new favorite birria place.

Lou’s Diner is the kind of place you hope to find on a road trip — nostalgic 60s Americana Style — 🇺🇸 make me feels like stepping back in time.

Old-school diner vibes, generous portions, and food that hits the spot every time. Breakfast is solid, coffee keeps coming, and the service feels genuinely warm—like they’re happy you stopped by. Simple, honest, and satisfying.

A must-stop if you love real American diner energy.

“stories from another era” since 1969!
This place isn’t just a meal, it’s a memory :)

A huge thank you for the wonderful time we had with you!

We ate extremely well: every dish was a real delight, perfectly executed, generous, full of flavor, with that little extra touch that makes all the difference. You can feel that the food is made with heart, high-quality ingredients, and real attention to detail from start to finish.

The service is absolutely exceptional: a smiling team, incredibly kind, attentive without ever being intrusive. Special mention to Pickles, our waiter, for his good mood, professionalism, and sense of hospitality, thank you to him for making this moment even more enjoyable!

The decor is really fun and full of personality: a warm, lively place where you feel at ease as soon as you arrive. There’s a real identity, nothing pretentious, but a lot of taste and humor.

The value for money is incredible: given the quality of the food, the service, and the overall experience, the prices are really very reasonable. It’s rare to find this level for such an accessible price, and it definitely makes you want to come back.

In short: a perfect meal from beginning to end. Thank you for this wonderful moment, the great energy, the lovely team (and thanks again to Pickles!), and such high-quality cuisine at such an amazing price. We’ll be back with great pleasure! 🌟🍽️

Great place to visit when in Las Vegas. Wait time was not too bad. Breakfast choices were fantastic. Great tasting Jams made in house. Good tasting French Toast, Pancakes, Sausage, Ham, Hashbrowns and Eggs. I have to give it to the cooks 100% on taste.The Hot Chocolate was on point. Loved the atmosphere. Servers were great on checking in. Always made sure we were enjoying our food. It was so great we visited twice while vacationing in Vegas.

Lou’s Diner is the real deal — great breakfast, fulfilling portions, tastiest Iced Coffee, and even better people.

‘Amy’ made our experience. She was exceptional: warm, kind, and genuinely welcoming, not just “doing her job.” On our first visit she recommended the waffle with pecans, and it instantly became my favorite. We liked it so much that my fiancé and I came back a second time before leaving for Vancouver just to have it again and to say hello to her.

We also met another incredibly kind staff member who added to the good energy and made us feel at home. She was super kind! The food was excellent, great portions and worth every penny, but the human side of this place is what stands out. If you’re deciding where to go for breakfast in Vegas, this is worth it.

Cheers to the guy who hosts and greets people while coming in. He has such a positive vibe.

We came to Vegas for a show at Sphere and first morning we came to Lou's Diner we were so impressed we came the second day, also.

I ordered Kielbasa and eggs first day and The Haystack the next. Both breakfasts were top notch!

The service - from the host at the door, to the busses, the servers, to the manager - were all so nice, attentive, prompt, and professional! Just very friendly folks!

The place is a quaint old style diner with lots of knick-knacks everywhere,  but there was no gunk or dust on any of it. Everything was clean including the restrooms - which is an important indicator of a places dedication to cleanliness.

Give them a try! You may have to wait 10 or 15 minutes outside, but it's worth it!

Greens and grill is a spot that the surrounding community needs. They serve everything fresh from the grill with quality ingredients. The flavors of the Kabob (my favorite is the spicy chicken) is authentic and robust. You can taste the saffron they use, you can taste the measured out salt and other spices they use for marinating.
Not only is the food great but the service and atmosphere is amazing as well. I always love seeing Amira there, it’s like an aunty welcoming you into her kitchen.
I love this place and will continue to come here!

first two pics are the old wrap and the last two pics are the new wrap. the chicken is still bomb but they got rid of the wrap that wrapped around the entire thing and it’s dry and thick now. I used to spend so much money here and went out of my way to get it. I paid like $16 for just a bunch of lettuce basically. At least change the videos, pictures, and description you advertise so people know.  BRING BACK OLD WRAP :(

I had a great experience at Greens and Grill in Las Vegas! I ordered the chicken and beef kabobs, the double cheeseburger, and the gyro — everything was delicious and served in generous portions. The gyro, especially, was huge and flavorful. I also really loved the steak fries — perfectly cooked and a great side for any meal.

What really stood out was the friendly service. The owner runs the place and takes care of everything himself, which makes the experience feel personal and genuine. You can tell he takes pride in his food and in making sure every customer leaves happy.

If you’re looking for great food, big portions, and friendly service, this spot is a hidden gem in Vegas. Highly recommend!

Casual establishments with insanely delicious food. The food here is simple in ingredients but sooo flavorful. I got the spicy chicken kabob with rice and salad and roasted tomato. I love me a roasted tomato. The portions are generous and the chicken was so tender and juicy and spicy and flavorful. I want to try their beef kabob next.  This is the new place I’ll crave when i want a healthy and fast option (food is cooked to order, takes about 15 minutes). It felt like a meal a friend would invite me to their family’s home to enjoy. 10/10

Delicious food, fresh meats and chicken, good portions, nice place to eat.

The atmosphere is kind of fast food style, the whole order came in one congested plate, the seating area give the same feeling (fast food style), hope the owner could rethink it.

The location is good, plenty of free parking space, the staff are friendly and welcoming

Overall excellent experience.  We stopped in and ordered take out and did not eat in the restaurant.  The portions were exceedingly generous.  I really enjoyed the pulled pork and the hot links, but the brisket was a little too fatty for my liking.

We will definitely return and most likely add this to our regular dining rotation.

Absolutely delicious place! 😋 The smoked meat is incredible — especially the brisket and ribs, so tender and flavorful. We’re sad we discovered this spot only on the day of our flight, but we’ll definitely come back someday! The staff is super friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend to all smoked-meat lovers! 🔥
Killer BBQ, great service, awesome environment, free play arcade game to keep the kids busy. Chopped brisket was the best but the fortress is a feat to behold. Give them a shot you wont regret it.

My mom and I went here based on a few Tiktok videos that had them in their Top 5 spots in Vegas. Great choice. Got a 3 meat plate with 1 side, and a 2 meat plate with 1 side, and since we both wanted mac and cheese, got the large side. The brisket was nice and tender, the pork ribs were fall off the bone amazing, the pulled pork was great, and the the chicken had great flavor I did mention to the hostess that the chicken was slightly dry, BUT, because we came in near closing time, I don't have a problem with it because I'm absolutely positive that if we came in an earlier time, it'd be crazy juicy. The baked beans were fire, the spicy coleslaw definitely hit good, and the mac and cheese was mac and cheesy. The sauce selection was great, and that spicy one was addictive as hell (only complaint was the tip kept getting clogged, lol).

Overall, everything was delicious to the point where I drove back home to Bakersfield with the leftovers, and the girl absolutely loved it, even after about 15 hours.

My only major complaint is one I always have with BBQ joints, and most restaurants in general, is the brown paper towels that are absolutely useless when dealing with such savory and delicious handheld foods.

Definitely a must have better time we go to Vegas.

I absolutely LOVE this place. I try a lot of BBQ places across the country and this is by far the best Brisket I've ever had! I live in Washington State. But, from here on out, whenever I visit Vegas, I'll make a stop by Jessie Rae's!

I really liked this place!! We didn't really have a wait because we arrived 10 minutes before they opened. They're were people outside waiting, but sat everyone as quickly as possible. The service was wonderful!! Chris was very nice and accommodating. The food was good but not great. My chicken was seasoned, crispy and juicy, but pretty small. They looked like more like chicken wings not chicken legs. The waffle was delicious and the cheesy grits were plain grits with no seasoning and shredded cheese on top. I would still go back and maybe try something different because the food and service is good 👍🏽

I will start by saying my rating is not indicative of the food because it was delicious nor my server once I was seated. It stems from when I arrived at 1pm being put on a list by a gentleman outside and being told there was a 45 min wait for seating for 1. I was ok with that especially in Vegas on a busy Friday. But 1hr and 30 mins later I was still waiting outside in thar Vegas heat because that's the only place one can wait and standing because the benches were all filled. I was visiting and didn't have a rental car so my optionswere slim after walking there from my hotel. I was tempted to leave but I was already invested and by the time I would've walked or Ubered to somewhere else I figured by that time I'd be eating by then, right?? WRONG. I wasn't seated until 3:30 pm yes you read it correctly 3:30pm. So 2hrs and 30mins later. I'm truly embarrassed to even admit that I waited that long because imo no restaurant is worth waiting that long unless it's an extremely large party that needs special accommodations but for a party of 1 that's totally unacceptable for me. I will say once I was seated that it didn't take long to get my order in and receive my food which was a fear of mine. The atmosphere was nice it gave me ATL brunch vibes, the prices for the food were reasonable, alcohol beverages though not so much especially for the size served.  Plus the server offered multiple flavors for the drink I ordered but failed to disclose there's an upcharge for those flavors. $18 for that small drink which on the menu it shows the drinks in mason jars so I asked and the server stated they didn't have anymore jars, huh 🥴? Maybe tell a person before they order the drinks. So the drink was not worth it especially since my meal was $28. But other than that my server was nice, knowledgeable, and gave good recommendations. Also inside there was a picture lady walking around asking ppl did they want their pics taken. I thought that was a bit weird and something I haven't seen before except on a cruise. I would go back because again the food was delicious but it would have to be early during a week day and if there's any sort of wait I'd leave immediately lol

🌟🌟🌟MUST GIVE IT A TRY!!!🌟🌟🌟
I had a wonderful experience at this establishment. The staff was attentive, the food was flavorful with generous portions, and the drinks were outstanding — both the alcoholic options and the Kool-Aid. I especially want to acknowledge the bartender, Rodney (if I have his name right), for his excellent service and great attitude. Thank you for making my first visit so enjoyable!

This is our second time coming to Lo Lo’s and the food is what keeps us coming back! They accommodated our party of 7 within about 15 minutes, which was great. Our drinks were delicious, and even though the food took a little long, every table was occupied so it was understandable. Overall, another great experience we’ll definitely be back!

Visiting and the food was delicious! And the service was excellent! Vic was our server and he was very professional and friendly. The wings are my favorite. Waffles were delicious too. Added grits and scrambled eggs with cheese and onions. Delicious!! Will definitely come back when I'm in Vegas.

name: Pretty Soul Kitchen
vicinity: 7365 W Sahara Ave b, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
I visited Pretty Soul Kitchen in Las Vegas after seeing Keith Lee’s recommendation on TikTok, and I’m glad I did! When I arrived, I was greeted by a friendly young lady who provided excellent customer service. I was the only guest at the time, so she walked me through the menu and gave great suggestions.
I decided on the Catfish Soul Bowl, which included two catfish fillets, collard greens, cornbread, and mac & cheese for about $33. The food was flavorful and satisfying. My only critique is that the collard greens had a lot of stems—quite a few—but they still tasted great overall.
The location offers plenty of parking, which is a big plus. It’s not near the Strip, so you’ll definitely need a car to get there, but I enjoyed being away from the hustle and bustle. Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my meal and experience. Thank you, Pretty Soul Kitchen—I’ll definitely be back!

I was in Vegas for a few days and was told that the food here was absolutely delicious. I was also warned that the service wasn’t good. However, we were greeted, seated, and served by Schanelle, who was extremely warm, friendly, and welcoming. We arrived about an hour too late for brunch, yet she went in the back and found me a couple of biscuits (they’re available during brunch hours only). Schanelle was a pleasant surprise based off the reviews I had seen online and the warning I received from my referral. Nevertheless, I was thrilled with her service and my shrimp basket. My honey and best friend ordered the shrimp and grits. He loved it but I wasn’t too crazy about either. If I’m ever in Vegas again and hungry… I’d definitely visit again. The vibe was cool too. The female DJ was nice and kept us bouncing to the beat. Thanks, Schanelle for excellent service and for being so personable.

I love to support black owned business ❤️ I'm giving it 3 stars because the food it was okay. The greens had too many large stems. Fish was decent. Soul rolls were good. Bartender gave us our food before our appetizer. I think she forgot to ring it in. We did get a free shot so that was cool. $19 for a drink and $12 for a side of yams is insane. I paid it but overall I give this place a 5/10 bar was empty but dirty they wiped it off with a wet towel but didn't dry it. Customer service I'll rate it a 7/10. My friend had the spaghetti and fish the spaghetti was watery tho. They got some work to do but I think they can get it together.

Ok y'all, I stopped in for lunch at Pretty Soul Kitchen on West Sahara right past Rainbow to the left behind L.A. stereo.
I had the catfish sliders my coworker had the smothered chicken mash potatoes and cabbage. We split some soul rolls. The food was well seasoned. The soul rolls was not what I expected. Full of favor, chicken, sweet potato and Mac and cheese. If you are looking for a culture food experience this is the place to try out. I have to go back for bunch to give the a grade.
Stop by and tell me what you think. #prettysoul

The restaurant had a nice vibe with a dj playing music until around 4pm. The service was a bit off. There was a 20-30 minute wait for catfish so we ordered appetizers, which we did not get until after our actual meals came out. It took about 30 minutes for me to receive my drink, which I had to let the server know I had not received it yet. The food was okay. It was a bit to salty or too much seasoning for my liking but good. I got a fried shrimp bowl. I had to take the batter off the shrimp to eat it due to the excess seasoning. The atmosphere was great. Good vibes and there was a dj playing some great hip hop & R&B music. They were very busy, so a reservation is highly recommended. Not sure if I'd go back and try them again but we'll see.

ood was mediocre.

name: Balkan Bar and Grill
vicinity: 953 E Sahara Ave Suite B26, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Irene, of the Balkan Bar and Grill, followed through with us and helping us build our timeline, select our décor, and choose our cake. The venue looked absolutely beautiful, and the cake was stunning.

We had 50 guests. The package included the venue with decor, dinner, cake and the DJ. Irene threw in a 360 Photo Booth and the champagne toast. There’s even a cute Las. Vegas sign that’s great prop for pictures.

For the ceremony, I walked down the stairs from the second level to make my grand entrance.

We opted not to add money for alcoholic drinks but the bar is easily accessible for guests to buy their drinks through a doorway of the venue.

Irene played such an important role in keeping us on track with the planning, setup, and service. This took the  stress off of us by letting The Balkan Bar and Grill, handle so many details and guiding us through the process.

We couldn’t have done it without Irene!

From the moment we stepped into their establishment, we were treated like family. Majda and Irene's hospitality is unmatched, creating an atmosphere where you feel genuinely welcomed and valued.

The food is a culinary journey through the Balkan region, connecting Europe and Asia with every bite. Each dish, from the refreshing Shopska salad to the savory Grill combo, is made from scratch daily with real ingredients.

The Parlenka pita bread and Feta cheese Guveche are must tries and the stuffed grape leaves (Dolmas) are a delightful taste of tradition. Don't leave without trying their famous biscuit cake for dessert!

Beyond the exceptional food, Balkan Bar & Grill offers amazing event halls for rent. The Main Event hall, with a max occupancy of 300 and upstairs changing rooms, is perfect for large gatherings.

For smaller events, the Crystal hall in the same parking lot accommodates up to 150 guests. Whether it's for lunch or a special event, Balkan Bar & Grill is a gem that embodies tradition, flavor, and heartfelt hospitality.

When we first moved to Vegas 3 years ago, this is one of the very first restaurants we visited... and it was unbelievable! Our evenings are pretty busy and they recently started lunch service. Thank goodness we noticed because yet again the Eastern European food is so authentic and so mouth-watering. This combined with the fresh, clean, comfortable atmosphere makes this spot one of the BEST OF VEGAS!

Thank you to the staff of this fantastic restaurant for bringing us back to the family service and care we remember of the Balkan countries!

Thanks soo much Irena for your attention and tour of your impressive establishment. Your staff was nice and friendly as well. Anna made. Wonderful veggie pizza with some real distinct flavors that makes it your signature pizza for bar and Grill. Marina thanks for your service and smiles.  I like the olives and it look like a pesto sauce mixed in with all those wonderful other veggies you had on the pizza. It was a great price for a 16 inch pizza.
Marina thanks for your service and smiles. I look forward to try some of your other dishes that my friends had as well.

Loved the warm European
You’ve got a lot of space for big parties and events. I see and was really surprised to see the selections of wines you had.

I really like some of the decor you had from the pictures too other interesting items of show in the photos below. Again thank you for such a wonderful experience and allowing our small group to set up the screens and wonderful visuals we had for our meeting.

JESUS care say your prayers. Amen!

The Balkan Bar and Grill proved to be the finest venue I’ve experienced in Las Vegas. The DJ curated an exceptional playlist that perfectly matched the vibrant atmosphere, creating a true musical haven for guests. The acoustics in the hall were impeccable, with no echo and high-quality sound complemented by impressive lighting and speakers. The DJ also excelled as a host, skillfully announcing meal times and raffle music cues. Overall, our Christmas party was an outstanding choice, making for a memorable celebration. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was pleasant. Plenty of space , the host were so nice and the owner is present and made sure all was well. I also enjoyed the mimosas at the entrance, as it was a great place to host a brunch Christmas Party. Our Union members were pleased and I will definitely recommend this venue and DJ together. Lovely time was had.

We decided to visit for the first time after seeing their Instagram story, and the restaurant is tucked away on the outer edge of the Vegas Strip. You can tell the building has been well-loved and maintained. The atmosphere is decent, and the food comes out quickly with great presentation.

We’re big BBQ fans, and while the smoke flavor was fine, it wasn’t anything exceptional. I ordered the tostada plate, which comes with three small tostadas brisket, chicken, and another beef. Those were great, and the chicken was amazing. 2nd order ribs and sides. The ribs, however, needed a bit more time; the meat didn’t come off the bone easily, so they were just okay overall.

Great BBQ and worth the drive!

I’ll start by saying I don’t usually go to places I see on Instagram or TikTok — but my son asked if we could check this one out, so we made the drive. Totally worth it in the end!

First impression: the place looks kinda closed from the outside (half the signage is out, so maybe fix that, guys). But don’t worry, it’s definitely open during normal business hours.

We walked in and were greeted right away. The hostess asked if we wanted a booth or table, we went with a booth. The dining room isn’t huge, but it’s clean and comfortable. Looks like they do a lot of takeout, too. Our waitress could’ve been a little more upbeat, but the food runner totally made up for it — super friendly and took time to explain everything.

We ordered the Grande Family Platter ($110) which came with:
•	Full rack of pork ribs
•	1 lb pulled pork
•	1 lb brisket
•	1 qt Hatch chili mac & cheese
•	1 qt sweet & spicy Brussels sprouts
•	6 Hawaiian garlic biscuits
•	Plus pickles and pickled onions

Everything came out hot and fresh. The smoke was on point, the flavors were fantastic, and the OG BBQ sauce was legit — a little spicy but really balanced.

All in all, great food, solid service, and definitely worth checking out. You won’t be disappointed!

This pace has been on my radar for awhile and I am glad that I got a chance to check it out veggie heading back home.  We ordered a variety of items on the menu just because it all sounded good.  The barbacoa tacos, burnt ends, ribs, brisket, and hot link were all tasty. I did really enjoy their Hatch Chile Mac & Cheese and street corn as well.  I really don't think you can go wrong with anything here.

We finally got to try Humo barbecue and it did not disappoint. Their concept is a fusion of Mexican and American barbecue. If you’re a meat lover, this is your place!

We ordered the half rack, mouthwatering ribs, Barbacoa tacos, sliced brisket, half roasted chicken, and an order of fries. Our favorite were the ribs and tacos.

The prices were great, the service was fabulous!

The 3 different employees I encountered in my pickup order were all extremely friendly and made me feel welcomed! The food quality was fantastic! I really enjoyed everything we ordered the burnt ends, the brisket, bacon jam brisket, brisket taco, and the hatch chili mac and cheese. I jave been wanting to try this place for awhile and it did not disappoint!

name: Ramen Boys
vicinity: 3650 S Decatur Blvd suite #3, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Amazing vegetarian ramen near the Strip!
Ramen Boys is a must-visit if you’re in Las Vegas, especially for vegetarians. This was easily one of the most delicious ramen and fried rice meals I’ve ever had and both were made completely vegetarian (no egg, no meat).
The staff customized the fried rice for us, and it had an incredible smoky flavor that really stood out. We asked for both dishes to be made spicy, and the spice level was absolutely perfect flavorful without being overwhelming.
Everything tasted fresh, comforting, and full of flavor. This place truly made our Christmas Eve night special. Highly recommend Ramen Boys to anyone looking for amazing vegetarian ramen and fried rice near the Strip! 🍜✨

At Ramen Boy, I ordered the tsukemen. The dipping broth is very thick and coats the noodles well, but the seasoning leans too salty. The noodles have good bounce and chew, though they feel a bit broken into shorter pieces.

The pork is flavorful and tender, and my favorite item is the ajitama (marinated egg). The seasoning is excellent, though the yolk isn’t as runny as I prefer.
It was very delicious. We got the starter karaage, it was very juicy and crunchy. I got the Classic Tonkotsu and my wife got the RB Signature. Both were very good as well.

Their Ramen and shaved ice are awesome. I’ve been a few times and they always deliver. The pork is great. Noodles cooked perfectly. Staff is always so kind and helpful. Great environment and decor too. Love this place.

We wanted to try authentic ramen while visiting Las Vegas, and the Ramen Boys name kept coming up in our research. We happened to be near the Chinatown at lunch time and decided to give it a try. My partner had RB signature ramen and I had shoyu Signature ramen with truffle, which I really liked. It had a very complex flavorful clear broth. The pork pieces in both of them were very soft and tasty. Highly recommend!

Great atmosphere and decent priced drinks. I didn't order any food so I'll definitely be back to try it. The outside patio is spacious and had great ambience however if you want to sit at one of the two fire pits you better get there early.

Some of the friendliest gaming staff in town! Very attentive and great service for drinks & food.

As for the games, there is always the Progressive and the Card of the Day which come with substantial bonuses!

I like that you don't need by your physical player's car, you simply log in with your phone number
Awesome place! Very good service. Best Burger I ever had. Casablanca Burger! Try it! Great atmosphere!

A bit out there, but some of the best bartending service I've had in town.  Went there for pool league and I'd put an empty beer on the counter, when I went back there was a new beer waiting.  Food was solid, tables are decent (Valley), and plenty of bar seating with slot machines.  Definitely worth checking out.  Don't remember his name, but the bartender on Thursday evenings deserves a raise.
The entire staff is incredible. Any time or day you go, each bartender makes you feel at home. And the machines hit so frequently. Its really a neighborhood gem. I highly recommend it.

Green and Grill is a wonderful Afghan restaurant in Las Vegas that truly stands out for both its food and customer service. From the moment you walk in, the staff is welcoming, friendly, and attentive, making you feel comfortable and valued as a guest.

The food is absolutely delicious and full of authentic Afghan flavors. Each dish is well-prepared, fresh, and beautifully seasoned. The meats are tender and flavorful, the rice is perfectly cooked, and the portions are generous. You can really taste the care and tradition that goes into every meal. Whether you are familiar with Afghan cuisine or trying it for the first time, the flavors are rich, balanced, and incredibly satisfying.

What makes Green and Grill even better is the consistency in quality and taste. Everything is cooked to perfection and served hot, with great attention to detail. The restaurant offers a warm, inviting atmosphere that pairs perfectly with the amazing food.

If you are looking for authentic Afghan cuisine with excellent taste and outstanding customer service, Green and Grill is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
Great Kabobs! Staff is awesome and the food was made perfect 🤌🏻 Got my team lunch today and they take pick up orders. Fast service hot and ready.

Came here and I am glad we did.  The owner was wonderful and we went with his recommendation and ordered the mix grill.  It did not disappoint.  The kabobs chicken and lamb kabob was juice and well seasoned,  rice was excellent and  the salad was fresh. I have had my fair share of afghan food but this was the best.   I am sure all his food was excellent.  The owner Haceeb Jaan was very nice.  I wilm be back🙏

When we visited this place while in Vegas, it was excellent!  There is really nothing on the menu that you can go wrong with.  We ordered the burger and fries, the gyro, and the combo plates with hot beef and spicy chicken kabob.  Everything was perfectly seasoned, flavorful, juicy, and delicious.  We got extra kabobs to take with us and eat later since they were so delicious. The entire staff made us feel very comfortable, and the owner was really friendly and welcoming.  This is going to be a must-see whenever we're in Vegas.  I'm hoping to visit a place in California shortly!
Juicy, flavorful patties with a great sear, quality toppings, fresh buns, and well-made fries, with a great service. You have to try this burger. The best in Las Vegas!

The food here is made with love. This is a joyful place. Brooke was awesome and super attentive. The scenery is just beautiful in rich blues. If you're in the mood for exceptional, fresh food, this is the place. I highly recommend!

Vegetarian meals, besides meat. Server was kind and friendly but not very helpful as she didn’t really understood the menu and didn’t explain the food nor portion sizes. Food was flavorful: some spicy, some with turmeric. I don’t like collard greens but this was fantastic. The special bread is cold and used to eat with (no utensils). The Habesha veggie plate is definitely for 2 people.

We got the vegetarian combination plate which came with several different types of lentles, some cabbage, collard greens and salad along with injira, the teff pancake. We also got the lentle sambusa. Everything was OK. The waitress was very engaging, kind, friendly and attentive and made the experience memorable.

Truly phenomenal! When I moved here I was hoping to find a good Ethiopian restaurant and "boom!" Food is beyond wonderful, the decore delightful and the service divine! And ask about indulging in the coffee service!
Great food, great music, friendly staff. I will be coming back.

name: Urth Caffe
vicinity: 6820 Helen Toland St Suite 110, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
This café has a hip vibe and a really nice atmosphere. It feels like the kind of place where people with good work-life balance come to relax or get some work done. The prices aren’t cheap, but they don’t feel overpriced either. The space is large, and if you sit outside, they bring your order to your table by number, and you don’t have to bus your own dishes.

Most importantly, I’m someone who doesn’t like acidic coffee, and their coffee was genuinely good. It has more of an Italian-style flavor profile, which I love. I definitely plan to come back, and I’ll be choosing a seat outside again.

i got the mocha mint & the margherita pizza, and i found them to be very delicious! i lowkey had to fight with the stubborn pizza crust when trying to eat as it was very crispy & tough to chew through, i still enjoyed it though! and the mocha mint was indeed very minty!! the building was crowded & full of people but that’s how you can tell people love the food here! :)

Came for breakfast. Menu has has a lot of options. The Cafe Mocha was fabulous! I had the Urth Bread Pudding Breakfast, it was sitting in a delicious sauce and there was a banana for every bite.  This is big and rich, we thought next time we would share it.  Husband had the Organic oatmeal with raisins and a chocolate croissant. He ate it allll. He also enjoyed the Macciato.  Loved the atmosphere and the staff was wonderful.

Located inside the uncommons community right across the Durango Casino & Hotel, it has a nice ambience both indoor and outdoor.  The coffees are pretty good and so are the croissants and fruit targets. Only complaint we had was that the Macha came with very little cup and it’s very dry and bitter, taste with too much macha powder, not enough milk at all. It costed $8.75 too!   We asked for more milk both in the granola bowl and to add in the tiny Matcha tea cup as well.  We probably should have ordered the omelet.  Other than that, great ambience and location!  Next time will come and try their omelet and keep on ordering the coffee but not matcha

This place was so cute and very tasty! It's nice to visit a place that cares about organic and heirloom ingredients. I had an unsweet iced soy-milk matcha latte that was perfect and the plant-based huevos rancheros burrito. The burrito was a little pricey, but ended up being worth it for how filling and delicious it was. My only complaint is that the menu can be confusing for fully vegan/plant-based customers. It sounds like many menu items can be made vegan-friendly, but it's not always clear which ones. The website only shows one breakfast item as 100% plant-based, but I'm not sure if that's accurate because we were offered other items. Same with drinks, some of them say "(can be made 100% plant-based upon request!)", while some don't say anything, but another part of the menu says "all drinks can be made plant-based". Overall, I'm so glad we tried this cafe spot, but it was a little stressful when ordering as a vegan couple.

BESO in Las Vegas is an absolute culinary gem! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was incredible—sophisticated and vibrant, with the same world-class feel as top dining destinations like PRIME Steakhouse in Las Vegas and Gary Danko in San Francisco. It’s the perfect blend of energy and elegance, setting the stage for an unforgettable evening.

The food is nothing short of spectacular—the white fish is simply incredible and the German shnitzel was the perfect fit for my kids. Every bite was pure perfection. In my opinion, the price of the food was affordable for everyone.

And the dessert? One of a kind. Truly a masterpiece that balances creativity and taste in the most delightful way. You must try the biscuit cake, was one of the kind.

The service was exceptional as well—attentive, friendly, and genuinely welcoming, making the entire experience even more memorable and the most important that you eat in the restaurant, but you fill home.

The only problem? I only have one belly, and I couldn’t fit as much as I wished to—every dish was so tempting that I wanted to try it all!

If you’re in Las Vegas and looking for an extraordinary dining experience, BESO is a must-visit. I can’t recommend it highly enough!

My Girlfriend and I wanted to eat close by so we found this spot off Buffalo near Flamingo.
Lola was our server, she was friendly.

We were seated immediately late afternoon visit.
What we ordered:
