1.) Filet Mignon Salad $18.00 my friend ask for med-rate and got Medium instead and she said the beef was very salty!
2.) Lamb Chops $24.00 the lamb was tasty but the potatoes were a bit overcooked and also salty.
3.) French Layered Cake $10.00 I asked if this was a light dessert and was told yes, but it is far from light in texture nor in taste.
We might try again, but my friend is a bit hesitant.

How does this place not have 10,000 5 star reviews? And yet, that's part of the charm. It's cozy enough and not too crowded that the staff can give you a very personalized experience, and you don't need to take out a loan to eat there... Yet the food deserves to be twice the cost and the restaurant deserves twice the exposure. Also a really great atmosphere; this would be an amazing date night spot.

The atmosphere is peaceful, elegant, has patio and plush seating. Food was tasty however could use tad more spices on filet mignon kabob specifically but very fresh salad. Family friendly and staff was kind. Can’t wait to visit again!!

My best place in Vegas.  Here is my Romanian Skinless sausage - MITITEI. absolutely fenomenal taste like my childhood.
The recipe it's the right one.  And classic French fries with feta chees

Good bless to this managment. Keep doing same quality work.

The food was ok, peruvian chicken rotisserie was dry and without aji salsa and oil vinegar for the salad was awful.  Picarones weren't fluffy. Anticuchos came with red pepper aji, that is not the tradicional peruvian service. The corn was good but I will not come back here. Less than average peruvian food!

I love Peruvian food. I’ve been going to the other locations for years. I just tried this location today and the food tastes exactly the same. The lomo Saltado is so good and packed with flavor. The 3 girls working there are nice and attentive. It’s sort of like a whole in the wall. The setting is modest, but it’s clean, so it doesn’t bother me.

The food here is good. They just need to fix their customer service. I ordered a pick up order of tallarín verde, one with steak and 1/4 chicken with rice and beans. I sent my mom to go get the order and when she arrived back home they gave me the 1/4 chicken with fries and salad. I called and the lady on the phone & she was saying no I ordered it with French fries and salad. That honestly made me upset. I know what I said and I never asked for French fries and salad, why would I order something I don’t eat. She sounded annoyed but was able to fix my order. Had to drive back myself and get it.
Ordered take out and food was delicious. We will be coming back. Happy we found this spot. The gentleman who helped us order was very kind.
The papa a la huancaina was very good. The arroz chaufa de carne was very large, but the beef was tough.

name: Urth Caffe Wynn Las Vegas
vicinity: 3131 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Urth Caffe location at Wynn Las Vegas is absolutely worth the visit.
The place is specious and lovely decorated with beautiful art of nature and the fountain in the middle of the store. Very modern looking picturesque decor and it has nice coffee shop vibes.
They have a great selection of food and drinks on their menu. This time we had lattes and dessert Urth tiramisu cake.
Everything was freshly made and it was delicious. Our lattes were delicious and we love the fact that their drinks are all organic.
The staff and the manager are very nice, attentive and welcoming. The restaurant was clean and inviting.
We definitely love this coffee shop and highly recommend it!!! We will definitely be coming back to explore more of the menu items, because it is so versatile and everything looks so delicious.

We love going to Urth Caffe when we are in Las Vegas.  The coffee, food, and pastries are amazing but it’s definitely not an inexpensive option.  The one in the Wynn is always very crowded so it may take a little while but it gives you a chance to look at the menu and all the pastries on display.  On our visit my wife had a Spanish latte, we shared a NY sandwich (pastrami, Swiss cheese, Russian dressing on marble bread) and a banana cream pie.  All were delicious but it came out to $40.

I was honestly blown away by this place. Everything was just perfect. The coffee is on another level — seriously, I haven’t had anything this good in a long time. And the pumpkin cheesecake… wow. It’s honestly something from another world.

For the quality you get, the prices are more than fair. You really couldn’t ask for better. ❤️

Absolutely loved it and will definitely be back.

Maybe my favorite breakfast on the strip. It can pull a crowd, but I’ve found the line to move at a good pace. Lots of options, but all delivered with high attention to detail. It’s in a mall and a little unobvious to find, but well worth seeking it out.

Urth Caffé at the Wynn Las Vegas is absolutely worth the wait! The atmosphere is bright and welcoming, and everything from the coffee to the pastries is exceptional. The menu offers so many delicious, fresh options, and the quality really stands out. Service is friendly and attentive, making the experience even better. If you’re looking for a coffee shop that delivers both amazing drinks and a great vibe, this is the place to go. I’ll definitely be back on every trip!

First— NO not a marijuana dispensary.

I’ve left quite a few reviews for restaurants. I would have to say that this is an absolute hidden gem in Las Vegas and a must try. Like the saying goes never judge a book by its cover. doesn’t have any kind of flashy entrance, but the food is fantastic. They don’t use frozen meat and they use ground chuck not ground beef.  And when they say half a pound, it is half a pound. There is a full bar with some table top slot machines they have jazz bands come in every Thursday.
Special to know about Wednesday and Friday is $4.90 house burger (1/2 lb) also do wings by pound or two pounds.  Images of menu included

I’m very lucky to have found this place. Best cheeseburgers in town!  Handmade with thick patties like my mom used to make.  An older man waited on us and he was perfect!  Friendly, informative and funny (he might have been the owner) he was also working the bar. Considering all the jobs he  seemed to performing, our service was excellent.  There was live music and the place has a true “Vegas Vibe”.  The second time we went back, on a Wednesday, because he told us they had five dollar cheeseburgers on Wednesday, the same man greeted us and treated us like old friends.  The kind of service you don’t really see anymore. For years I thought this was a pot store due to its name, “Dispensary Lounge” but pot is neither served or sold there.  It’s our favorite place here along with The Italian American Club. The two best places in town. They’re both extremely affordable and have live music.

Nice place. Good bar food and regularly have good entertainment but success has gone to their heads and prices have skyrocketed. They must think that they're on the Strip. And nights when the entertainment is best the kitchen seems to get backed up.

Okay. What? How have I never heard of this place? Not much seems to have changed here since 1976 and I love it! It is like visiting The Regal Beagle from Three's Company. Dark, cozy, clean, friendly, strong classy drinks (try the wild cherry one!), outstanding burgers, and staff is the friendliest in town. Thursday night is live jazz night and the last Sunday of the month is Vintage Vegas night. Can't wait to see what that is like! Don't miss out on a great burger ($12 or $8 on Wednesdays!) and a cool vintage vibe at this Vegas gem! Oh! Pay the $2 upcharge for waffle fries. They are much better than the regular ones. I tried both. Thanks to Don and Carl (I think we're their names) for a really great experience today!

Wasn’t able to make it in the location and doubt it if I will. Called in to ask about your prices and deals and guy over the phone was either being smart or sarcastic neither one of which I appreciate. Good luck with that business model!

name: Vesta Coffee Roasters
vicinity: 1114 S Casino Center Blvd #1, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Amazing specialty coffee shop. I tried their housemade macadamia-almond latte (they make this milk in house). Steamed perfectly with gorgeous latte art! Also tried the herbed avo toast - definitely going to try to replicate this at home. Great experience - authentic staff who care about the product they’re making. 10/10 would recommend.

Absolutely delicious!! We had an almond croissant (unbelievably good, light and airy with an amazing filling), the Herb Avocado Toast (amazing sourdough bread with great herbs), and the Vesta Breakfast with Turkey Sausage (probably the BEST breakfast sandwich I have ever had! Had some slight honey flavoring throughout, I was worried the bread would be too heavy but it was light and airy.) also had the chicken soup (this was not a favorite and didn’t taste very fresh but was still good), and had a Vanilla Cardamom Latte which was amazing!

It is a loud atmosphere and there was a long wait to order but the food came out fairly quick after we ordered and it was worth the wait!

A decent boutique coffee roaster, offering up their own for drip, pour  overs, espresso. They are sporting a modest kitchen, which is a tad smaller than the coffee counter. They offer a short slate of house made pastries as well as packaged coffee. The kitched also does some breakfast dishes, toasts, salads, etc..
On the North side of 18b with its own parking lot, seating for about 25. The La Marzocco machine impresses, and it means they MUST be filtering this Las Vegas water.
Roasts from what I can see in the grinder bins are on the light side of medium roast, and a tad dry on the outside. The one 12 oz. drip I got ran true to form with that dry observation (one free refill). Less my style, but well executed.
Mr. Barrista chatted with me a bit, and handed me an Americano. Definitely shows a lot more character, but subdued. These always come out too hot for me, and oxidized a bit in the cooling. Aromatics of... sorry for the beer jargon, dried grain, almost bready, reminsicent of a good Brown Ale or an English Dark Mild. Taste includes lightly vinuous, or wine-y character. The dry sensation is gone. Def. if you want the more complex characteristics, go for the espresso options.
There is a third crew tending to the roaster, which is adequately vented,or the whole shop would smell of it.

Clean and neat facility, !~20% dedicated to roasting.

Like other location- This Vesta location didn’t disappoint. Place was packed at 10 am in the morning on a weekday.

There is a long line but moves to get to go goods.  Tried their special of the day - pan de muerto with black sesame.   Bread was fresh, delicious, and tasted well.

Avoided getting our usual and tried the seasonal drinks- loved the salted caramel banana latte- delicious.

Will definitely come back and eat in nice time.

We are coffee and pastry snobs of the highest order.  My wife is a professional, French-trained, pastry chef and we make it our living to try coffee and pastries everywhere in the world that our travels take us.

We went off-Strip because that is how we roll and prefer more authentic establishments.  Vesta Coffee Roasters did not disappoint.  Quite the contrary, we were delighted and will be back before we leave even though we are in Vegas for just a few days.

The croissant was excellent.  I could tell from the moment I touched it.  The lamination, butter content, and baking was, I dare say, near perfect.  Crusty and flaky on the outside, moist and perfectly cooked elastic on the inside.  I would have added a tad more salt to the butter but that is my own personal taste.

My wife lost her mind with the cardamom bun.  We are big fans of cardamom buns and she felt that this is one of the best she has had, ever.  We are coming back for more of these and packing them with us for our trip home.

The salmon toast hit the spot.  The sourdough toast was excellent and the cream cheese and dill spread was exactly right.  The salmon was thick and plentiful.  I wish the salmon had been a bit smokier but again that is a personal choice.  I would order it again in a heartbeat.

Finally, the coffee.  We ordered extra hot (160F) cappuccinos and, although we tend to like our roasts a bit darker, the quality and taste was excellent.  Probably the best we have had during our stay in Vegas.

Five stars all around with some small suggestions that would take Vesta Coffee Roasters well over the top.

Make sure you visit them while in Vegas!

This is the best Ethiopian restaurant that we have ever experienced!  The food is absolutely delicious and the service is magnificent.  Hannah went above and beyond to make us feel welcome.  Her recommendation enabled us to try small portions of each special dish.  We will be new regular customers at Lucy from now on.  Highly recommend giving it a try.

My husband wanted to try something “new” 🙂
I’ve eaten the food before but not at this location. It was delicious!
We ordered 1 meat combo, 1 meat and veggie combo and 1 veggie combo. If we would have ordered two combo platters it would have been enough for the 4 of us.

Today was the first time having Ethiopian food and it was amazing. The beef samosas had great spice blend with a nice dipping sauce. We ordered the Lega Tibs and Doro Way. The Lega Tibs were tender with wonderful garlic herbiness. Yum. The Doro Wat was also amazing. Spicy, but not in a make your mouth on fire way. It was the kind of spicy that made your mouth warm and happy. The service was fantastic and super friendly. Thank you to our wonderful server Heran. We definitely be back to try other items on the menu. I didn't give a 5 rating because I've only been there once.

reviews.author_name: Green Sea Shells Mag: Wellness by KK
reviews.text:
If you’re in Las Vegas and craving Ethiopian cuisine, Lucy Ethiopian Restaurant is a decent choice. Tucked away in a quieter neighborhood just off the Strip, it’s easy to find with plenty of parking. We discovered it thanks to our Eritrean cab driver, who highly recommended it.

We ordered a veggie combo and two samosas, which were the perfect portions for our family of three. The food had a home-style touch, satisfying without feeling heavy—something we appreciated. The service was surprisingly quick, especially for an Ethiopian restaurant, and the staff was warm and welcoming.

That said, there’s room for improvement. The women’s restroom was clogged during our visit, and while the flavors were enjoyable, they could have been a bit more complex. As someone who regularly cooks Ethiopian food and has dined at nearly every Ethiopian restaurant in NYC and Los Angeles, I’d say Lucy is a good option if you’re craving hearty vegetarian dishes or Ethiopian fare in Las Vegas.

Wow! SO DELICIOUS! My family and I got the veggie combo, prime beef tibs, doro wot, ceremonial coffee set, honey wine, and samosas

Our server Genet was so kind and friendly. She took care of our entire order, and she was also very patient with us and gave us her favorite dish. Honestly every server was amazing.

MUST GO! Best ethiopian food of my life.

name: HASHTAG INDIA - Indian Restaurant
vicinity: 855 E Twain Ave Suite 101-102, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Recently visited this restaurant in Las Vegas, and it was such a beautiful experience! The place truly gives Indian vibes, and the food tastes absolutely amazing. The Mutton Mandi and Biryani are a must-try — both were flavorful and perfectly cooked. It’s the same franchise as the one in Dallas, maintaining the same great taste and quality. Highly recommend this spot, especially for Indian and Telugu people looking for authentic flavors and a homely atmosphere.”

We have tried buffet on December 31st at this restaurant, not even one item is good in taste. The goat doesn’t have any salt and any spice, all other chicken items are way, worst The same branch in Milpitas Bay area is very good at taste.

I had an amazing experience at Hashtag Indian in Las Vegas! The food was outstanding, and I couldn't stop raving about the dishes I tried. Here's the breakdown:

### The Hits
- *Dal Fry*: Was amazing and delicious! The flavors were spot on.
- *Gobhi Manchurian*: Also amazing and super delicious. Loved the mix of textures and tastes.
- *Vijaywada Chicken Biryani*: All I can say is WOW. This was incredibly delicious.

- *Presentation*: While the food was top-notch in terms of taste, the presentation could've been improved. Maybe a bit more garnish or styling to make the dishes pop visually.

Hashtag Indian is a restaurant in Las Vegas serving up Indian cuisine. Given my experience, I'd highly recommend trying their Dal Fry, Gobhi Manchurian, and Vijaywada Chicken Biryani - but note you're vegetarian, so you'd skip the chicken biryani.

#IndianHypePlace
Waited ~40 mins for a table, staff response was poor. Chicken mandi was below expectations with too much food color. Mutton mandi and mutton biryani were just okay. Overall, more hype than taste.

Had an incredible experience at Hashtag India! The ambience was warm and inviting — a perfect mix of modern style and authentic Indian vibes. The service was top-notch, with the staff being friendly, attentive, and welcoming throughout our visit.

The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. I highly recommend trying their juicy Lamb Mandi — it was tender, aromatic, and cooked to perfection. Definitely a must-try spot for anyone who loves great Indian cuisine!

name: Sivas Vegas Mediterranean Grill & Lounge
vicinity: 4850 W Flamingo Rd Suite #31, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
We came here for Turkish breakfast and absolutely loved it! Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was excellent! everyone was friendly and attentive, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

The chef, who is originally from Diyarbakır, was incredibly kind and welcoming. He went out of his way to make sure we had a great time and even surprised us with a small treat at the end. It really felt like a piece of home away from home.

If you’re looking for an authentic Turkish breakfast experience with warm hospitality, this is the place to go. We’ll definitely be coming back soon! 🧿☕🍯

I tried Sivas for the 1st time. Diana, the Hostess and server, was delightful!! She helped me choose menu items. I tried the lamb kebabs. Great! The salad I had was great too. The kunefe dessert was a wonderful way to finish off the meal. I will return.

Came here for lunch on a Thursday wasn’t that busy but the manager in the server were very friendly and it was service with a smile and I ordered the falafel which was absolutely delicious and then some kind of meat patty thing I think it was lamb or a mixture of that made into like these mini burger patties with rice and veggies, etc. And then had a sparkling water came out to be like 40 bucks and service chargers included, but I left some extra but the food quality is absolutely good and I was looking at the entertainment list. Seems like it’s a late night place with some music and some fun so definitely check this place out not only for dinner, but for lunch is deliciousand give them the support

Nice inside outside area. The blonde bartender was really sweet and congratulated us for our anniversary. The food was authentic and fresh. We had the feta dip the chicken kebab and falafel with a pot of tea. It was regular tea and I  was hoping the tea was cardamom, but that was on me for assuming.

This is a fun place to go for brunch.  The whole table was filled with delicious foods: pita bread, shakshuka, cheeses, tomatoes, cucumbers, olives, jams, honey, and more.  We enjoyed a big pot of tea served in Turkish teacups.  The service was outstanding.
We will definitely go back.

name: V ETHIOPIAN RESTAURANT AND HOOKAH LOUNGE
vicinity: 4230 S Decatur Blvd Suite 200, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
It's a scene here late at night for bar, DJ, hookah time? Local vegas vibes, meaning everyone comes here with their own posse. Tables is the way to go, and order drinks and your hookah at the bar. Very casually run, mom and pop style? After midnight, maybe closer to 130am or 2am is when the place gets crowded. I visited only once in 9/2024 and thought it was an underground type of venue with no sign, or such?

Someone mentioned it's difficult to be a DJ here. The DJ needs to play a bit of everything, because there's like 16 different countries worth of people just there at night. The music jumps around so much, it's difficult to get into it. Everyone is just waiting for their genre, dance and then sit back down. Music is loud. No EDM, thank goodness.

I've only been once and everyone was welcoming. Attire is casual to dressed loungey. I've only been once, and I was the only non- Black, African descent, Islander/Caribbean looking person there. Everyone was nice and didn't stare in a certain way like how I was stared at in Arizona or even parts of Vegas (....like Stoneys Rockin Country).

We had an incredible experience at this Ethiopian restaurant! The food was absolutely amazing—flavorful, authentic, and beautifully presented. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared, and the injera was perfectly spongy and fresh. Our waiter Micky was also fantastic—very knowledgeable, friendly, and clearly passionate about the cuisine. You could tell he took pride in the food and service, which made the meal even more enjoyable. I’ll definitely be coming back soon!

I love  Ethiopian food. They also have a bar,  hookah lounge all in one plaza. Same owner. By the way the owner is laid-back very friendly. I have tried also the hookahs. No complain. Not far from China town

I came to Vegas for vacation and staying on the strip. I was looking for a hookah venue and stumbled upon this place in my search. As a first timer, I’d have to say the customer service was outstanding and food was delicious. I got here around 4pm and didn’t know the hookah spot doesn’t open until 9pm. Only the restaurant was opened. However the staff and owner were so kind and accommodated me wanting both food and hookah. Additionally the restaurant opened two weeks ago so I feel great I had the experience of both. Highly recommended and the Hookah menu is amazing. So many flavors and ones I’ve never knew about it. I’m high impressed and I will be back again soon! Thank you all for the exceptional customer experience.
I LOVE IT HERE ..... THE FOOD IS AMAZING AND THE VIBE FEELS LIKE HOME THANK YOU MICKEY FOR COMIN SHORT NOTICE.....YOU ARE APPRECIATED..... CANT WAIT TO TRY YOUR SHRIMP MOJO 😋

name: Yeshi Mart
vicinity: 4755 W Flamingo Rd D, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
As part of my mini Ethiopian food tour, I stopped by Yeshi Mart and ordered the veggie platter. I have a sensitive stomach, so I’m always mindful of how my body reacts to different preparations and ingredients.

Unfortunately, my stomach didn’t respond well to many of the stews here, and the injera seemed to contain more than just teff flour; it had a noticeably lighter, almost white color, suggesting added wheat or other grains. That could explain why it didn’t sit well with me.

That said, the portions were very generous, and I appreciated that they provided extra injera with the meal. However, compared to other places I’ve tried , the food didn’t feel quite as fresh or carefully prepared. The flavors were mild and lacked the depth and balance I’ve come to expect after visiting several Ethiopian spots in the area.

If you’re looking for large portions and convenience, Yeshi Mart may still be worth a try; but for those with sensitive stomachs or gluten sensitivities, I’d recommend proceeding with caution or confirming ingredients ahead of time

I have lived in many cities around the country. As an Ethiopian, Yeshi's food, dishes, and injera are by far the healthiest and most delicious food I have come to love. Their injera is clean and doesn't upset my stomach. Their dishes are made from real, pure, and simple ingredients that are nurturing to the body without feeling full, one can reach satiety. I have been on a healthy, clean eating diet for a couple of years and Yeshi's food is where I go when I am not eating at home. It is primarily set up as a store but their food is beyond a restaurant options that are available in Vegas area. I recommend their veggie combo and Tibs.

Old days yeshi mart used to be great atmosphere even food amazing until another owner took over, I'm talking about 8-10 yrs ago 2 days ago I stop by yesterday to pick up my Togo order 💔 I order combination which is ketfo and  tibs so much oil not even organic butter its like graceys oil letter that even my stomach heavy bloating  i hope health administration will show up to door until fixing this is issue.

Exit the strip and try Ethiopian cuisine - you get huge portions fresh made (so take a little time) all under 20$. The Injera is hand made because what you cannot see is a huge bakery behind and also butchery. Of course it is finger food and if you dislike spicy meals just tell it - they are wonderful people and cook with lots of love.
I order them so often online that I feel guilty I am not giving other places a chance. I udually get the veggie combo, sometimes switch it up with a meat dish.

name: Paradise Place Jamaican Cuisine
vicinity: 6985 W Sahara Ave suite 119, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
The atmosphere was genuinely enjoyable; clean, festive, and inviting. The décor and overall vibe set the right tone for what I hoped would be a positive dining experience.

Unfortunately, the service did not match the quality of the environment. From the moment I arrived, I didn’t feel welcomed or acknowledged, which was disappointing given the otherwise pleasant setting.

In addition, the restaurant did not have several of the menu items I was interested in. I chose a dish directly from their posted menu only to be told it was sold out, despite it being the beginning of the week and still two hours before closing. This raised questions about preparation and inventory management, and it took away from the overall experience.

The potential for a great visit was definitely there...good ambiance and a clean space..but the lack of customer engagement and limited menu availability made the visit less enjoyable than expected. With improvements in service and consistency in menu offerings, this place could truly shine.

Never again. I paid $46.56 for one meal. I should have gone to the Dutch pot. Or the other Jamaican spot on flamingo. Online and in the restaurant menu said $28 for curry goat. I asked why it totaled to that much, lady said goat curry is $35. And the rest is “taxes and fees” how is it still $46.56? How??? That’s over 35 percent !!!!  This is lunch, just one order.  One meal. Not a dine in. I opened the meal in the car and all I got was bones and fatty meat. And mushy veggies. $35 for ox tails but not boney fatty goat no meat. I didn’t have time to argue because I had to go back to work. When I love eating at a place I make sure to advertise and  give good reviews. The restaurant has to be realistic. This is Las Vegas you can’t just decide to charge what u want when u feel like it and add extra fees and taxes for to go meals. It doesn’t work like that. I called to make sure and the lady lied and said online it says $35 well maam that’s not true. I’m disappointed my hard earned money paid for bones. Look at photo would you pay $46.56??? This is not a fancy restaurant in a nice location.

Went as a part of three. Waited to be seated at the door (like the sign said) no one acknowledged us for almost 10 mins, so i flagged someone down to get service. There was only one table open when we got there and that’s because a couple had left. They only had one server helping a packed restaurant so I understood. I did see what looked like two kitchen staff trying to help up front.

It was a night that they had live music. It was great so it made the long wait to order easier. However, once our food was ordered it came right out.  Food was really good.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Paradise Place is an absolute gem! The food is absolutely delicious—everything is full of flavor, and if you’re craving some tasty oxtails or curry goat, this is the spot. The ambiance is superb, with a warm and welcoming feel that makes you want to stay a while.

Customer service is outstanding; the staff is friendly, attentive, and makes you feel right at home. The atmosphere is amazing, and the live music on Tuesday nights takes the dining experience to another level.

I would highly recommend Paradise Place to anyone looking for great food, great vibes, and a truly memorable experience!
Food was 10 outta 10. Flavorful yet not overly spiced. Amazing rice and peas(beans). Good prices, good food, great people.

Gritz Café was hands down the best place we tried in Vegas. The food was a solid 10/10. The grits with bacon are an absolute must-have. The chicken was crispy and seasoned to perfection. Don’t forget the hot sauce and a little sugar for the grits, it takes it to the next level. The service felt warm and homey, and everyone was incredibly kind. Truly a 10/10 experience.

If I could give Gritz 100 stars, I would. Everything from the food to the service to the ambiance was phenomenal. From the minute you walk in, it feels like home and every single one of the staff members was so friendly and attentive that it felt like family. And the food? My God..! I don't even like grits but I felt it would only make sense to try some here and they did not disappoint! Nothing I ordered disappointed - the hot links, the waffle, the eggs, EVERYTHING was cooked to perfection. If I was a local, I'd be in there all the time and I will definitely be back to visit whenever I'm in town.

The food was amazing, cooked to order, and delicious!  The wings and catfish are seasoned and cooked to perfection. The grits are a must to try.
It's a small spot, but the turnover is quick and they have takeout.  Our server was knowledgeable and attentive.  So good I went back the next day for lunch.

The Holy Trinity is my favorite meal! Gritz cafe uses turkey for their collard greens and OMG they are so delicious! I love the food here and have not had a bad experience. They cook the food fresh and the waitresses are so sweet and friendly. I’ll always visit Gritz cafe when I visit. All the food is always on point. I definitely recommend this place!

Grits Cafe is hands down one of the best meals I’ve had in a long time! The food was absolutely 5-star, and the service matched the same level of excellence. The prices were reasonable, and the portions were delightfully generous. It was so good that we all ended up ordering an extra plate to take home for later!

The staff was friendly, welcoming, and very accommodating to my daughter’s shellfish allergy, which gave us peace of mind and made the experience even better. We truly felt at home, and we all left happy and satisfied.

I’ll definitely be coming back on my next trip to Vegas—this place is a must-try!

Last time we were here was 3 yrs ago, so today we went back to see if the food is still good as how we remembered and it was!

Customer service/hospitality is great:  Friendly, checked on us, personable.

Food is still good:  the beef and chicken koobideh kabobs were tender, moist and seasoned nicely.  The rice was a little dry and wasn’t as buttery as I remembered but still very good.

Prices went up, like every where else and everything else, but I noticed a “processing fee” on the bill.  I don’t know/remember if they have always had that and I just noticed it today, tbh.  This is before they run the credit card, so I am not sure what that is for and it is 3.75% of the bill, plus taxes.  Our bill wasn’t much so I didn’t ask about it but if you have a large party, that may end up being alot, so heads up about that.

DO NOT ORDER TAKEOUT! I ordered takeout and was honestly shocked at how bad it was. The salad and dessert were both completely soggy — they packed everything together with no separation. Most restaurants separate hot and cold items, dressings and sauces while ordering takeout. Otherwise you get mushy gross food. When I called to let them know, they acted like this was totally normal… which is crazy to me.

For a place charging over $120 for takeout for 2 people, the food and service should be way better. I’ve been a loyal customer, but after this experience and the attitude I got when I called, I’m officially done.

This place is amazing😍😍the atmosphere is very comfy there is decorations everywhere, it is very clean. The food was absolutely amazing and it was soooo fresh! The portions are very generous.The service was fast and very accommodating they didn’t rush me. Get the baklava and saffron duo it’s 10/10🤤

Dream Kabob is one of the best Persian spots I’ve tried in Las Vegas. The koobideh combo was juicy and flavorful, the rice was perfectly cooked, and the grilled tomatoes added the perfect touch. The portions are generous, and everything came out fresh and hot. The staff was friendly and welcoming, making the whole experience feel like a home-cooked meal. I also loved the taftoon bread and the refreshing mast-o-khiar. Whether you're craving authentic Persian food or just want something different from the usual Vegas fare, this place is a must-visit. Clean, cozy, and consistently delicious!

If you’re looking for an authentic, warm, and truly memorable Persian dining experience in Las Vegas, Dream Kabob is an outstanding choice.
From the moment you walk in, the genuine hospitality and warmth of the owner, Behnam, make you feel like a welcomed guest rather than just a customer. That personal touch is rare and sets the tone for the entire experience. The staff are polite, attentive, and professional, providing excellent service throughout.
And then there’s the food absolutely exceptional:
The joojeh kabab is perfectly marinated, juicy, and full of flavor, the mast-o-moosir (yogurt with shallots) is fresh and beautifully balanced,, the doogh is refreshing and authentic,, the rice is aromatic, fluffy, and cooked to perfection.
A true highlight and something that makes Dream Kanal stand out is the tea.
The special tea with Behnam’s own unique formula has a distinctive, unforgettable flavor and feels like the signature of the restaurant. It’s not just tea; it’s an experience and a must-try, highly recommended at the highest level for exceptional Persian food, sincere hospitality, and a welcoming atmosphere that feels like home, Dream Kanal is a top-tier destination in Las Vegas.

Pre-ordered lunch at 11:17 AM for a 12:00 PM pickup. Despite the bar and dining area being slow, I waited almost 10 minutes just to be acknowledged. At 12:30 PM, I learned they hadn't even started my food (ordered over an hour before). I finally got my order at 12:45 PM.

Food was good (one star), but the service efficiency is a joke for how kind of pricey this place is. I won't be returning lol.

Food, was pozole was green, limoney, spicy, delicious and hot in temp. Just how i like to have once every other week. So if God permits, my taste buds will tighten up for the first retouch, 🔂

Service, was there.

Atmosphere, too cold i waited outside. Nice wall decor, chill spot w music loud enough to cover my slurps.
Outside is pretty too. Nice runway to walk or chill lot to walk down the food

Fantastic! Our first visit and it was great. The bartender Jason was great - very friendly and attentive. The food exceeded our expectations and we had heard great things about the cantina, which is why we came. We will be back and try different things on the menu. Delicious!

The atmosphere was fine, it was a clean establishment and looked aesthetically pleasing. The server/bartender was doing the best he could as he was alone and had all the tables alone. Food was not good at all, super salty, the fries were cold. The guac had too much tomatoes in it. The esquite and drinks were good even though they didn’t have one of the drinks we wanted.

Worth the $$! Atmosphere is spectacular, food is dreamy, service was good. The place is also very big as there is space to the left, right, and outdoor seating.

I got vegetarian tacos which did not disappoint. Best tacos I’ve had in a long time and packed with so much flavor. Also tried the steak fajitas which were so palatable. It’s like the steak melts in your mouth. No complaints whatsoever.

I will be back.

name: Rainforest Cafe
vicinity: 3717 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Rainforest Cafe in Las Vegas was a fun and memorable spot for breakfast. The atmosphere was lively and entertaining, making it a great way to start the day. Damon was FANTASTIC!  He gave excellent recommendations, was attentive, and stayed on top of everything from start to finish. We tried the espresso martini and an Irish coffee, along with the chilaquiles and the country fried steak, and everything was absolutely delicious. Great food, great service, and a fun experience overall. Would definitely recommend stopping by, especially if Damon is your server!

My first time in Vegas so wanted to kickstart things with a themed restaurant. This place is awesome with a great atmosphere and also kid friendly which is nice to see. The food was so good and they had some interesting items on the menu. I went for the korean stir fry which was so zesty and refreshing with a slight punch to it. Our server Lisa was amazing and provided an outstanding service! She is great with all the customers - so friendly and attentive and complimented my outfit which made my day! Great deal on the refill cocktails too and the complimentary photo was a nice touch. Definitely a great place to come if you’re visiting Vegas for the first time!

This themed restaurant fits right in with the glitz and glam of the strip - but its family friendly and to top it off they serve good food at a relatively reasonable price.  One walks into the shop and is shown their seating by the wait staff.  The menu is ecelctic and there is a little something for everyone.  We went with a breakfast burrito, some fresh toast, and an order of chilaquiles - all were excellent but I think the chilaquiles took the prize this time.  I went with the green salsa, which had a bit of pica to it.  Overall the food was very fresh, cooked to order, and was served in the middle of a rainstorm amidst a host of chimpanzees and other very large mammals - the animatronics are the show here and are a delight for adults and kids alike.  Service here was outstanding - the wait staff was especially attentive, knew their menu, and provided excellent recommendations.  Great experience - highly recommend!

My child picked Rainforest Café for her birthday, and it was a great choice! The jungle-themed ambiance and fun environment made it really special for her. Our server, Craig, was friendly and fast — our food came out quickly and everything was just right. She ordered the kids’ pizza and loved it (she ate the whole thing!). I had the Cajun mac and cheese, which had great flavor — pasta cooked al dente with a nice spicy kick. Overall, a fun and tasty experience!

Someone did come by to make balloons for tips and we had a turtle and a crown made.

Our waiter Dominique was very nice! The atmosphere was fun and the Raspberry Rainforest drink was delicious; it tasted like a red Jolly Rancher. I also got to take home a souvenir glass cup! The nachos were good and the Korean lettuce wraps were pretty good but a little salty. Overall this was a fun place to try out here in Vegas!

name: Rick's Rollin Smoke BBQ
vicinity: 725 S Las Vegas Blvd Suites 110 & 210, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Friendly and professional staff! After visiting the pawn shop and making a deal on my gold Canadian coin, we decided to give this place a Texas taste test to see how it stacks up against our BBQ back home. Their BBQ passed the Texas test Yee-Haw— and it was delicious! We had the chopped beef sandwich, and it was spot-on. The place was clean and spotless. Keep up the great work, team!

My group stopped by Rick's twice while visiting Vegas. The first visit was on Saturday,  09/13/25. We ordered ribs & they were so good! In fact some of the best ribs that we've had! We stopped by on Monday, 09/15/25, & had to greet the gentleman at the counter for service. We ordered the 5 meat platter (brisket, sausages, ribs & chicken) & I'm assuming there was a different cook than the one from Saturday because the food tasted completely different. It was a bit of a disappointment after having such a great experience on Saturday.

First time having Bbq in Las Vegas. Being from NY I didn't expect such GREAT tasting food.  The meat on the St.Louis Ribs fell off the bone! Collard greens and Mac are amazing. Food service was fast and the customer service was great.  9.5/overall. I recommend.

Stopped in for some BBQ after a long work trip. Atmosphere was basic, not lively but it could have been due to us getting there at opening time.
Staff were pleasant.
I had the pulled pork, brisket and smoked mac and cheese.
I must say the smoked mac and cheese was bomb!
The pulled pork and brisket  were so dry that no amount of sauce could hydrate this meat.
I was so disappointed that I couldn't finish my expensive meal.

My wife and I stopped in at Rick’s Rollin Smoke BBQ during our last trip to Vegas and we were blown away! The ribs, mac and cheese, and slider were absolutely delicious—packed with flavor and cooked perfectly. The staff was friendly and welcoming, the atmosphere was fun, and the restaurant itself was spotless. Everything about our experience was fantastic. I’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend this spot to anyone visiting Vegas!

name: Pier 88 Boiling Seafood & Bar Las Vegas

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had an absolutely wonderful experience at Pier 88! We ordered the seafood boil with a mix of different seafood, and everything was incredibly fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The seasoning was spot on and made the whole meal such a fun and delicious experience.

What really made the evening special was our waitress — she was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and took great care of us throughout the entire visit. We felt truly welcomed and well looked after.

Fantastic food, great service, and a relaxed atmosphere. We’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend Pier 88 to any seafood lovers! 🦞🦀✨

Came here to celebrate my brother’s birthday! It was my husband’s and my second time here, but the rest of the family’s first — and everyone loved it. Cole was our amazing server — patient, attentive, and made sure everything went smoothly. The manager was also very hospitable and welcoming. They even sang happy birthday for my brother, and we were able to bring our own cake in! Such a great experience overall. We’ll definitely be back again! 🎂💕

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Pier 88 Boiling Seafood & Bar is a seafood dream come true! The oysters here are insanely delicious — fresh, briny, and bursting with flavor. Their Cajun-style boil is loaded with perfectly cooked shrimp, crab legs, and mussels, all drenched in mouthwatering sauce. Friendly service, fun vibe, and generous portions. If you love seafood, this is the place to be!

Love the vibe at Pier 88 and aside from the amazing
seafood and appetizers, they know how to get it crunk on birthdays! Thank you to our server Cole and staff for making our first time at this place a great experience! :)

Had so much fun here with my family
Food was so good and filling
Server was nice and kind and helpful
I will for sure coming back 🤭
Fresh delicious food at Davy’s! We went to the ReBar for drinks and the food was from here.  Highly recommend if you’re in town.  Service is also very quick and friendly staff.

I Stumbled upon this treasure after apartment hunting in the Arts District. I was hungry for something fast, but I wanted to sit down to enjoy my food. Security did check my ID to enter(21+) , but he was very kind and directed me to the bar to find a menu and order food. It was around 8pm on a Friday, so there was plenty of seating, including these cute little couched booth areas. I actually wanted to sit in one, but decided to leave them open for bigger parties. I sat at a tall table near the bar and it was an aesthetically pleasing vibe with cool pirate’s artifacts shelved behind me and beautifully dim lighting. (My inner mermaid felt comforted). I ordered the “Pork and Bacon Cheeseburger” with a coke… AMAZING! The bacon was fresh, the pulled pork was juicy and the burger was tender! The chipotle mayo was a wonderful addition. The burger was served with chips instead of fries… and that was an unexpected textured delight. The bar tender suggested I try the pulled pork nachos next time. I’ll definitely be back for lunch. They do have WiFi, so I could definitely see this spot as an content editing comfort zone
So many great deals on Beers,Drink and love their Vegan Food options.The veganGerman Hotdog was a perfect pairing with my beer.Really attentive daytime bartender as well,will be back!

The food is a complete rip-off. I have never seen wings this small in my life, and they were $12.00 for just six. And I could count by hand the number of chips they put on my plate..
I understand the economy is suffering, and prices are up, but this is off the charts. I also pay more for food at other establishments, but the portions make up for it.
This place has good reviews, so I'm assuming the drinks are good, but I don't drink alcohol, and so I will never come back.

The only reason I didn't give it 1 star is because the bar tender was nice and had on a cool shirt.
Davy’s is our fave spot to spend the afternoon! Such a fun vibe, can sit and enjoy cocktails and the patio for hours!

We were on our way to another restaurant near by, which had a line out the door, decided to give this diner a try, we were so glad we did.  We were seated immediately, our friendly server approached us right away, food came out on a timely manner.  The Food is delicious,  I ordered the Biscuits and Eggs, my husband ordered the Fried Steak with Grits, plus we had French Toast with Fresh Strawberries .  Everything looked great and tasted delicious.  They are doing things right here.  Also, they have so many Vegan options. The decor is just like the name Black and Blue, they also played oldies music.   Will definitely be back soon!!

This was the best breakfast I've ever had! I got the vegan steak omelette with hash browns and toast, and my husband had vegan steak tips and eggs and everything was literally to die for. This is everything you could dream of in a diner. The vegan menu is huge! This was our first time, but we are going to make it a regular spot of ours. I cannot recommend this place enough!
First timers and will go back every time in Vegas! Customer service was fast and friendly! Huge menu and all cooked to perfection! Got a free slice of red velvet cake on my bday!
Our waitress Amber, was on it in us never needing to ask for refills. Portions were good as was there reasonable prices and they have a many vegan options.

Never realized this place was actually open. Looked good inside with plenty to choose from. Tons of vegan selections. Im a carnivore and mine was good but I felt it was bland. Others in my party enjoyed theres.

Missing some traditional sauces and portions, but it is called "express" and the food does come real fast! The lamb was DELICIOUS. Regret not ordering 2 screws... The falafel was very different than I ever tried, but it was close enough. Offered sauces were yogurt which reminds a Greek restaurant. Tahinni would be much more appreciated.
Prices are convenient and the food was good enough.
Give it a try!

The food is soo good! The salaam soda is one of the best colas I've ever had. We ordered the #10 it was enough for two! The humus was perfect and the tadziki was so fresh! Amanzad was such a warm welcoming host!

Amazing food, experience, EVERYTHING. The recommendations were a hit. I had to stop half way eating to leave this review, we drove from Kingman, AZ to try this place and wow it did not disappoint. Thank you so much for the amazing service Amanzad!!!

Popped in here for a quick guro  saw that they made their own naan bread I was like $15 seems a little bit expensive for a guro I was completely wrong. It is ganja ganja ganja you will not be disappointed. Good service awesome food getting on bread to go. You will not be disappointed. Pick up some quick hummus you’re set thanks guys for a great lunch. We are stuffed worth every penny.!!! So happy we gave you a try we’ll be back

I had the Sultani platter at Kabob Express and it was amazing. The beef was incredibly tender and the chicken was juicy and well seasoned. The rice was flavorful and paired perfectly with the fresh salad. The kaboos was outstanding and really tied the whole meal together. Overall, an excellent experience with great food, highly recommend!

name: Philly Freeze Me
vicinity: 1021 S Main St suite 100, Las Vegas

reviews.text: What a fantastic new addition to downtown Las Vegas! Philly Freeze Me offers a wonderful experience. We thoroughly enjoyed our orders of the Philly Freeze cake and the refreshing strawberry and banana. The interior is spacious, creating a great atmosphere, and the highlight has to be the outdoor patio. It's the perfect place to relax with your delicious treats and have some fun with the available Connect Four and Jenga games.

Yummy and delicious! Definitely a recommend when its over 100 degrees outside. The Italian ice comes with many flavors that are suited to the taste buds. Overall, would come back to try out other flavor combinations.

I absolutely love this place! Glad to have an ice spot close-ish to home. Let me tell you though, the flavors, especially the cherry, are fantastic. The ice is always perfectly frozen, too! (Drove 15 minutes home and it didn't melt) I recommend it wholly and if you're on the fence, GO! They also have spiked ices!! (Please open a spot in NLV, we're starved for an ice spot)
While on vacation in Las Vegas my wife found a fantastic treat place, Philly Freeze Me! I had the mango and it was amazing! Nice ambiance in the Arts District of Vegas. Well done!

Freeze drinks were yummy as they have a lot of fruity combinations. Staff was really friendly. The place also accommodates a lot of people and folks can hang out and play card games. Bathrooms could have been a bit cleaner.

name: Grand Lux Cafe
vicinity: 3327 Las Vegas Blvd S #1580, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
The breakfast at Grand Lux Café was amazing. Our server staff were wonderful, attentive, friendly, and on top of everything. The only area that could be improved is the host stand; the staff handling the waitlist could be a bit warmer and more welcoming.
I ordered the scrambled eggs with smoked salmon, served with toast and hashbrowns, and it was absolutely perfect. The kid’s breakfast with eggs, hashbrown, toast, and sausage was also excellent, according to my kid, who finished nearly everything. The cappuccino was well made too, smooth and crafted just right.
Overall, a great breakfast experience with just a small area for improvement at the entrance. Would definitely return!

We do all our dining at the grand lux palazzo when visiting Vegas. This visit for dinner we noticed the prices have increased by about 10-15% from last year. Food was still excellent but noticed our ribeye was a little thinner more like a breakfast steak but tasty. Our garlic shrimp pasta was delicious 🤤. Our waitress was so nice and accommodating. We will be going for happy hour tonight.

Love Grand Lux Cafe! It’s always an amazing experience 😊. The food is flavorful, fresh, and cooked well. every dish I tried has been great. Portions were generous, and the presentation is impressive.

The restaurant is clean and inviting, with a comfortable atmosphere perfect for a casual meal or a nice night out. The staff is friendly and attentive, making the whole visit smooth and enjoyable.

If you’re in the area looking for great food in a welcoming environment, Grand Lux Café is absolutely worth a visit. I’ll definitely be coming back!

We convinced some friends to come to the Grand lux Cafe and they are glad we did. Our experience has always been superb. The food is flavorful, well presented and there are nice portions. The potstickers, lettuce wraps, and the calamari were out of this world. The short rib tacos were not as flavorful. The next night we got pizza which was great and the miso salmon was the best we've ever had. To top it off, the puff pastry apple pie is absolutely to die for. You must try it. Our server Tanya was fabulous. The happy hour margaritas are also strong and very good. Enjoy!

We had the breakfast buffet and it was a fairly typical breakfast buffet. I've had very similar breakfast at hotels for free. The only exception would be the made to order omelets.  I had a veggie and cheese omelet and it was perfect!  The atmosphere was nice and convenient to our hotel room.

name: Birria El Compa | Charleston Location | Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Really good food, the location doesn’t stand out but the food does. It has that homemade taste that you would want from birria. I had the quesabirria special buy 2 get 1 for a $1 and it was worth it, I would recommend it.

The cashier was friendly as well as pretty and very helpful. Good experience, I will be back.

-Eduardo
Riquísimo 🤤 the food is perfection. They have 2 locations but this is my favorite. Customer service is always on point and the food is delicious! Love the hand made tortillas

Food was excellent! Some of the most flavorful birria I've ever had. The tacos are extremely filling. The homemade tortilla for the quesadilla was delicious. My daughter loved the strawberry horchata. I'd definitely eat here again.

Customer service is so so (maybe they don't get many African American customers?). The restaurant was totally dead for some reason. And it's in a sketch part of town.

Update: they must really pay attention to the reviews, tried them again and portions were way better. Thank you for the delicious food.

Tacos are full of flavor and service was great. Just wish the tacos would’ve had more inside of it.

Food was good but cold , portion size was small for $20 possibly a 16oz cup others are usually a 32oz
Making me wait 30 min till I got up to ask for the food after people that came in after me got served over and over ? Bad 1st impression.
Seemed like people were more worried about the photo shoot being taken place for promotion than the customers waiting. Waiters asked everyone on tables 2-3 times if everything was good and if they needed anything I was never approached once. Even if the food was good I wouldn’t think twice to come back as a choice.

name: El Tamalucas
vicinity: 2987 Las Vegas Blvd N Suite 9, North Las Vegas

reviews.text: Delicious tamales! I bought half dozen chicken in green sauce and half dozen birria. They're both very tasty. The green salsa does have a little mild fire to it. I ordered online 2 days before pickup.

Service was awesome, but the tamales were just okay. I was able to try different types - green chicken, beef, beef and cheese, and cheesy jalapeño. They were all kind of dry, and the cheesy jalapeño only had a small piece of jalapeño in it. I’ve had other tamales in the past that were so moist, juicy, and flavorful that you didn’t need sauce with it. These didn’t match up. For the price ($54 for 10 tamales, they charge you extra with card), I wouldn’t eat here again.

Wow.... I can officially say I finally found someone who makes birria as good as I do, it's really a battle and trust me, I’ve tried a lot.
We ordered the quesabirria, birria chilaquiles, and El E.T., and everything was absolutely 🔥 Hands down, this is my go-to spot from now on.
The drive was 100% worth it.
Gracias, carnalito 🤘🏻🤙🏻😎

This place is a hidden gem in Las Vegas! I truly believe they serve some of the best tamales in the city.

They're only open from Thursday through Saturday.

When I worked nearby, I made it a point to stop by every Thursday to pick up tamales for the office.

If you plan to go, arrive right when they open. There's consistently a line forming outside the door.

Keep in mind that this is a pick-up spot only. There's no seating or tables; it's just a counter where you place and collect your order.

The prices are reasonable, and the food is incredibly delicious.

The only minor drawback is the limited parking. Arriving early is definitely recommended to ensure a smooth experience.

We found out about this place through our visiting friends from San Francisco. The place is really a carry out. The lady was very nice and told us that if we put an order online at least 24 hours before, the tamales is $35 a dozen otherwise it's $5 each in the store. Anyway, we got 6 different tamales to try since we were already there. The tamales were filling and really good! They come with spicy salsa too.

If you’re missing home and you’re from the Philippines, this is the place to be. Seafood City is famous throughout the United States for catering to the needs of Asians and then particular Filipinos. There are several branches of other popular Filipino stores located within this supermarket, making it all the more popular.

Stopped by this location from Red Rocks Casino. Love the Christmas decorations and parols. I wanted the I’ve halo-halo but they were out so I got mango instead. Red Ribbon is probably the better option for desserts

Fish meals designed for the Easter Islands.
Fish stores from within the deep blue sea.
Some fish are not made fishy. Certain fish work for their marketplace.
Seafood City has something in store for everyone to enjoy.

If you like my comment please click on the ❤️ and show some love 😽

I honestly have been to other seafood city supermarket better than this one...

This one has rude cashiers, butchers... It's mostly the elder women, some men are as well but only some.

This one honestly is horrible on how they treat people of other ethnicity.

No I don't recommend this spot to anyone.

Be careful, the Goldilocks siopao was so moldy.  The expiration date was may 2026.  The assistant manager Aileen was so rude.  She wouldn’t even give me her name at first.  She made it seem like I was making up my story. She did not care.
Horrible customer service and needs training.  It turns out others have returned  this as well due to the mold issue.  But Aileen seemed like I inconvenienced her.  I made a mistake while eating this in the dark while watching a movie so i accidentally ate one and got sick but that’s my fault. I’m not blaming anyone for that.  But I blame seafood city for continuing to sell knowing others had issues and then pretend that this is an isolated issue. I shop here for my Filipino food needs but I might have go to other locations.
Best Nigerian restaurant in Vegas hands down! It’s a beautiful lounge with a chill vibe. Highly recommend. Ps. Egusi was chefs kiss!

The food looked good I got it delivered via Uber eats . I wish I had know how spicy it was going to be. Please guide people about spice level. I could barely eat my meal  and I paid 80 dollars for it .

Unfortunately, our experience here was very disappointing. This was our first time visiting this place, traveling from Phoenix, and we were really looking forward to it. It took over an hour for our food to come out, and when it finally did, it was extremely salty. The Ogbono soup served to my oldest sister was cold, which raised even more concerns about the quality and care being put into the food. After the meal, my sisters and I ended up getting food poisoning — my younger sister even threw up several times, which was very alarming. It was heartbreaking, especially since we were excited to try something new together. I truly hope the restaurant takes this feedback seriously and makes major improvements in both food safety and service.

I recently visited this African restaurant to celebrate my girlfriend's birthday, and unfortunately, the experience was deeply disappointing. To begin, the food was served cold, which immediately detracted from any potential enjoyment of the meal. The temperature suggested that the dishes had been prepared well in advance and left unattended for an extended period.

Moreover, the portion sizes were shockingly small, especially considering the prices on the menu. It felt as though we were paying a premium for minuscule servings that hardly justified the cost.  My combo came with 2 small plantains- I could literally count the pieces of meat on one hand .

Adding to the issues, the establishment appeared to be severely understaffed. The host was also responsible for cooking and serving drinks, which raised serious concerns about hygiene and food handling. It seemed as though the food was not freshly prepared, but rather reheated, possibly in a microwave.

To make matters worse, the restaurant seemed to be out of almost everything, including the fufu, which was a major letdown. The food was also overly spicy - the egusi , jollof rice combo and the ogbono soup -

Overall, the combination of cold food, inadequate portions, and questionable food preparation practices made for an extremely unsatisfactory dining experience. I cannot recommend this restaurant and strongly advise others to consider alternative options for African cuisine.

I love the chicken and beef egusi soup so gooooood!!!! I always get extra pounded yam but the one provided is bigger than most I’ve had which is great!!! Some places are stingy with the pounded yam I have to buy 3 or 4 but not here!! The hookah is always good love it!! Owner is very nice and welcoming atmosphere, drinks are good as well. My favorite spot I can eat egusi have some hookah and drinks and music what’s better than that? Love this place if I’m not able to go in I order it online and expectation are always the same. Highly recommend

name: NU Ethiopian kitchen
vicinity: 4230 S Decatur Blvd Suite 200, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Great Ethiopian food and service. Very vegan friendly. Got two veggie combos for two people, though a single veggie combo could definitely be enough for two to share with how generous the portions are. The stewed red lentils (center of the plate) and the beets were my favorite, though even the potato and cabbage and collard greens were so flavorful (honestly everything was). Will definitely be coming back!
So happy there's another Ethiopian dining option in the valley.  Good food and great service.   Standouts are the lentil samosas and coffee.

Amazing food and great service!
Mini took good care of us and made us feel like we were guests of royalty at her home! Really health, great prices and you won't leave hungry.
Good food. The injera is really good.  The spice and flavoring are on point.  The service is a little slow and takes some prompting.
Good food and extra friendly service. Limited menu, but what they offer is delicious and is served with plenty of injera.

name: Gir Giro LV
vicinity: 3385 S Decatur Blvd suite #33, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Stopped by on a long road trip through Las Vegas and it was absolutely amazing. The owner was very kind and great to talk to and the food was delicious. It was all very fresh and tasty and the owner and his wife were thoughtful enough to create a spontaneous vegetarian dish for me from different items on the menu. I will definitely be stopping by my next time through Las Vegas and would definitely encourage others to!

My first time eating Ethiopian food. It was " Amazing ! " The owner made sure my first time eating this Awesome food was an experience I would not forget ! Believe me I will not ! Can't wait to go back and eat more foods on the menu. Go there, you will not be disappointed !

The owners, Zee and his wife, are great. They are friendly and honest. The pricing is very affordable for the high quality Ethiopian products they offer. They have the best quality Ethiopian food and products I have found in Las Vegas. My wife will attest to that too. She is Ethiopian.
Had one of the best experience of an Ethiopian restaurant. Host/owner was very friendly and food was delicious. Love seeing owners who are attentive to their customers' needs.

Best customer service. The place is very clean and neat. The owner is very friendly and approachable. The  food server that served us has a good customer service skill.
We really enjoyed the food. I will recommend this restaurant to my friends and colleagues.

name: Boss Daddy's
vicinity: 3310 S Nellis Blvd Suite 25 & 26, Las Vegas

reviews.text: So we ordered in and let me tell you. The Mac, rice, yams and baked beans were bomb. My wife said the spaghetti taste like her and her mom made it together which is a great memory. Fish was crunchy and soft inside. The Ribs fell off the bone and taste amazing. Peach cobbler was 3 out of a 5, not nasty but needs more nutmeg & cinnamon . We plan on ordering here again. It’s hard finding good soul food but they are now added to our list.

Food really had me questioning my life choices.. like why haven’t I been eating here every day? The catfish was crispy yet juicy, the wings were so good, and the yams and cabbage? Therapy on a plate.

The spot was clean, the portions were generous, and I left full, satisfied, and low-key ready for a nap. Definitely a must-try.

I really love this place.
Finally a down home, finger licking,jaw smacking, eatery. Food is always consistently on point 👉.
I really like the cozy atmosphere inside.
The young lady that took my order was so nice and polite.
The portions are worth the money.
Catfish was not greasy and very flavorful.
The meat was tender and seasoned to a perfect balance.
I have found my forever food establishment.
Keep up the good work.

The vibe in here is old school music, very laid back but kinda small. We were here by 1230pm to find out oxtails won't be available til 130pm.... ok we'll be back. Upon returning oxtails were ready so we order that, rib plate and combo fish and wing plate. Again someone HYPED these oxtails and they were really TRAGIC TRASH. No real seasoning, gravy bland, served on clumps of mushy rice. DISAPPOINTING waste of money. Also to this establishment had any faith in the taste of its food, they wouldn't put that unnecessary garnish on top of every DANG THING

The vibe was definitely it for me. As soon as I drove up, a gentleman handed me the menu, which set the tone right away. What stood out even more was the fact that the owner was right there, personally making sure the ribs and everything else were on point—you don’t see that often. The team was incredibly friendly, which was a huge plus. The cashier was such a sweet girl, and I jokingly call her “Upsell” because I came for one thing and left with just enough extras—she was that good!

For about $30 plus tip, it was absolutely worth it. Now, the food—fire. The ribs were perfectly cooked, falling right off the bone. The chicken was seasoned just right, and they give you a generous portion. The macaroni and cheese and the greens were amazing—honestly, the best I’ve had in a long time. The yams tasted just like grandma made them, and the peach cobbler was the perfect finish.

Everything was delicious, and I promise—I’ll be back.

I tried this restaurant for the first time last Saturday evening. The owner greeted me and took my order right away. I ordered 4 different dishes and was informed of how long it would take to receive my food. I did not mind waiting at all because Haitian Cuisine is the best when you have a great chef cooking the food.
Everything smelled so good and tasted amazing!!! All the dishes were fresh, hot and authentic. And the portion sizes are big. I will for sure come back to this restaurant when I vacation here again.

The food was incredible! The service was amazing! My husband was treating me to dinner for my birthday and it was our first time at this place. I had the oxtails--which were tender and falling off the bone, the beans & rice, the cabbage--which had so much flavor, and the plantains--which were cooked to perfection! My husband had the shrimp--which were huge and cooked in a delicious & crispy cornmeal batter, the cabbage, plantains, and the mac & cheese--which tasted like a southern mac & cheese made by mom! We also tried a Jamaican ginger beer which is the best I've ever had so far! This place is great! We definitely want to go back and try other things on their menu!

Delicious food and great service. The owner is very friendly and cooks very tasty food. We got the medium oxtails and medium jerk chicken. It comes with cabbage, plantains, and your choice of rice or mac and cheese.

We liked the oxtails the most, but everything was great. We put the oxtails sauce on the cabbage and dipped the plantains in it, which gave them a boost of flavor.

We wanted to try the red snapper too, but we knew we wouldn’t finish everything. We had to take a bit of this order to go. We will definitely be back for it!

We ordered a medium Oxtail plate and a side of French fries. The flavor of the oxtail just melts in your mouth. The meat tears softly off the bone, effortlessly. We had two servings of the oxtail with the delicious rice and beans. The plate normally comes with plantains, but we requested to have it removed due to my allergies to bananas. Kerby politely replaced it with seasoned cabbage that paired so well with the meat and rice. The plate was shared between my girlfriend and I for a late lunch after attending a koi fish show. The French fries were amazingly delicious, they were evenly seasoned and fried to a crisp. It’s hard to find crispy and well seasoned French fries that aren’t soft and wilted. These fries were perfect. We spent about $30 with tip and enjoyed the full service care Kerby provided us. We will always come back here for her food.

We ordered before going next door to the vape shop and returned to wait on our food. Kerby freshly prepares her food daily, the food is always perfectly portioned for to go orders and dine in options. There are tables and chairs setup to allow for dine in service. Kerby takes care of everyone attentively with care. The prices and menu is great for anything Caribbean. Thank you for your great care every time we visit.
Best Haitian Food I've ever had and I'm a Haitian raised in South West Florida!!! Portions are unbelievable! I'm having my left overs for breakfast! Thank you so much!!!

Local gem.

We wandered off the street, put our names down (party of 2) and came back after a 25-30 min wait.  Worth it.

We over ate, so my warning is order wisely. Bigger group will let you try more things.

We ordered the in house sourdough with three different sides: chicken liver (winner), burrata (good, not mind blowing), and the beets (nice complement).  Unfortunately we couldn't stop eating and this filled us up.

We had the roast beef sandwich and garlic/lemon pasta mains.  Pasta was ah-mazing. Would highly recommend. The sandwich was good, not a standout.

We sat by the bar, which, for lunch, was a great vibe.  Big windows and sunlight made it lovely. I'd sit there again vs a table. Our server/bartender was super nice - very comfortable and could adapt with whatever we wanted and how we were rolling through the meal.

Would come back and recommend checking it out if in Vegas.

This was the final dinner stop on our recent Eagle Fang Golf Club trip to Las Vegas. And wow…what a dinner it was. There was about a dozen of us so we decided to go family style and order a bunch of appetizers and entrees. I enjoyed everything served this evening including the bread with spreads, cauliflower which was incredible, chop salad, meatballs, spaghetti and raviolis. Service was great, wine, cocktails and beers were awesome and everyone left happy and satisfied. We’ll definitely be back the next time we’re in Vegas. 🤙🏼🤙🏼🤙🏼

The service was great. Explained menu and made suggestions. The bread was fantastic. We ordered three options. We requested the beet conserva but got the burrata, not sure if miscommunication, was a bit loud. Burrata was another option we were considering so maybe it was meant to be :) Regardless the Nduja and Basil Ricotta were great. We enjoyed the radiatore more than cacio.

It was our first time visiting Esther’s Kitchen and we  were excited because of the high rating reviews, but it was just okay, nothing special.

The restaurant is nicely decorated inside, not so much as an outside curb appeal , it is decent size with a big bar section and the upstairs cocktail lounge. The ambiance is great. They have an open kitchen which was pretty cool.

It was hard to get a reservation and when we did get one, we showed up and still waited an additional 30 minutes. The hostess didn’t know how to operate a system for seating and it created a mess. As foodies who make it a point to support local restaurants, we've learned to be patient and understanding.
Well , after we got seated our waiter was not so attentive either and we have left abandoned most of the time. It took forever for the food to arrive. But the restaurant was very busy, so again we were understandable about it.

We have ordered a couple of pizzas, pasta and their famous sourdough bread.
We were not impressed with the food: the hyped up sourdough bread was too hard like a brick,you couldn’t even bite the crust.
They do have the best butter I've ever had. But it was hard to enjoy it when the hard crust was nearly impossible to cut.

We also had eggplant pizza and Diavola pizza. It was an okay pizza ,but nothing to say you have to have it. The crust was softer than the usual brick oven pizza. And the middle part was too soggy and not cooked enough . I am a big pizza fan and that’s my favorite meal and I have had a real Neapolitan style pizza in Rome and it was not undercooked like this one.
The pasta tasted great and we really enjoyed it the most. It is homemade, prepared fresh in house.

Overall: our dining experience was ok. The Esther’s Kitchen was just overhyped, they still need to work on their reservation system , better train the staff and the kitchen, they have a lack of communication skills.
They do have a great potential and they are still a good Italian restaurant, but I highly recommend eating elsewhere , like Eataly  at Park MGM ,  if you’re looking for an authentic Italian cuisine.

There were 9 of us and we had a reservation.  They did have a table ready for us prior to our arrival.  Our server was nice and she gave us recommendations from the menu.  During the lunch hours the restaurant does get pretty loud so it can be heard to hear people in your party.  I had an Italian chopped salad and OMG it was amazing!!!  The presentation of it was beautiful and it was full of favor.  The servings are mainly family style.  I also had a meatball sandwich with sweet potato chips.  The sandwich was descent but the chips were excellent.  I also had a slice of sausage pizza it had a bit of a kick to it but it was good.  The bread that they bring for the table is a bit hard, so I could only eat some of the inside.  The spreads they bring for the bread is good.  I believe there were 5-6 spreads they brought us.  So if the bread was a bit softer that would be great!

There was a chicken pasta that we had that really didn’t have much flavor in it.  Everything else we had was pretty good.  I would visit this spot again and I would definitely get the Italian chopped salad!!!!

reviews.author_name: The Celtic Caterer & Chef Eric W. McBride
reviews.text:
Great Sandos during the day.  But the hidden Gem is the back speakeasy dinning room.  The ceiling is covered with Cherry blossoms,  and the food is amazing.  Loved the Chilean Sea bass, Salmon tartar, and the grilled Wagu and meats skewers.  I have been there on multiple times and always enjoy starting off with the clams.

Not to mention they have a live professional vocalist (Sage Waters), who perfumes there every Saturday night!  She is amazing!

This review covers the 05 December special tasting menu event held in the GYU+ Speakeasy.

I tend to home in on any mention of a restaurant collaboration like a heat-seeking missile. So when I read on Food and Loathing that GYU+Social Lounge was teaming up with Marufuku Ramen on a special one-night-only menu, I quickly booked the first seating on OpenTable.

All in for $180.42 (5-courses $99 + $48 optional premium sake pairing + $4.02 tax + $29.40 20% pre-tax autograt).

Courses were sizable, featuring proteins like pork, beef, octopus, and shrimp. The presentations and preparations were perfect from the soft bao to crisped tempura and fatty belly to moist cake. Roe toppings were generous. The ramen bowl from Marufuku was creamy without cloying thickness, packed with complimenting ingredients, with the noodles at a toothsome doneness, while the main course of the wagyu from GYU+ was so juicy and came with a cute pipette filled with rich yolk. The final course from Pastry Chef Yuka of Moignet Café featured an adorable and tasty Christmas tree with contrasting crumble, cream, and berry.

Everyone received an overflowing glass jigger of Marufuku's "best with ramen" sake. The course pairing selections by GYU+'s Master Sommelier Luis de Santos were the food friendly and accessible Joto Junmai Nigori, Joto Junmai Ginjo, Fuku Chitose Yamahai Junmai Ginjo Happy Owl, Maboroshi Mystery Junmai Daiginjo, and Joto Yuzu. The pourers explained each sake's creation style, flavor profile, and pairing logic.

Service: Superlative in warmth and attentiveness. Managers from both venues circulated the floor and engaged with diners throughout the event over food, drink, upcoming concepts, and local topics. Main server Chai was delightful.

Atmosphere: Very pretty space, with pink "blossoms" covering the ceiling and traditional murals on the walls, with more modern touches like neon LED lighting. Great sound system. Music moved between covers of holiday classics to phenomenal live singer Brianne(sp?).

To be thorough, timing was a small issue. The start was delayed, which forced a somewhat abupt end to the dinner soon after the dessert course so the room could be set for the second seating. But it was handled in a very friendly manner.

Value: Wonderful for a special full-package evening.

The sandwiches are good. The bread is thick and soft with a little toasting on one side. The only change I'd make is adding some salt to the egg sando. This is not a must visit for every Vegas trip but if you're craving this style of sandwich, they do a good job 👍

Came here at about 1230 afternoon on a Saturday and I ordered the chicken cutlet sandwich that was spicy and absolutely & ridiculously delicious and side of potato chips & a bottle of sparkling water and boy Oh boy this place is absolutely delicious and the counter lady was very nice. She was genuinely sincere when she asked how my food was. I sat outside by myself and I’m sure this place gets busy becausethey the partners is the mochi beignet shop two doors away so definitely give this place to try because I’m gonna go in there and try some other stuff so support small business with some extra love and thank you. Keep up the good work.

I had an excellent experience at Gyu Sando Restaurant! From the moment I walked in, the warm and intimate atmosphere set the tone for a wonderful meal. The staff were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu, which made ordering a breeze.
The star of the show was, of course, the wagyu beef sando and the Seabass.
