Perfectly cooked with a tender, melt-in-your-mouth texture, it was balanced beautifully by the crisp top yet moist in the inside. Every bite was rich, flavorful, and incredibly satisfying. The presentation was just as impressive—simple, elegant, and clearly prepared with care.
Another highlight was how well-maintained the restaurant is. The restroom was spotless, modern, and equipped with a heated bidet—something you don’t often see, but it really shows their attention to detail and commitment to guest comfort.
Beyond the food, I appreciated the traditional Japanese yet modern decor, the thoughtful plating, and the genuine hospitality. It’s clear the team takes pride in delivering not just great dishes, but a memorable dining experience.
I would highly recommend Gyu Sando to anyone looking for top-quality Japanese dining experience. I’ll definitely be coming back!

We heard about the mochi pounding event and came to check it out. There were people pounding mochi outside with drums going as well, very festive!

We tried a couple items from their mochi menu and items from their regular menu as well. The age dashi mochi was delicious. I loved the texture of the mochi. The red bean soup with mochi was a miss for us. The mochi itself was again fantastic but the red bean soup seemed off.

The miso cod entree was delicious and immediately inhaled. The curry stew was good but the beef bites were tough and dry. We ordered the sashimi don and it almost didn't arrive by the time we got tired of waiting and wanted to leave.

The service staff were nice but seemed inexperienced. We had significant waits between dishes. We spent most of the hour sporadically waiting for food rather than eating.

I appreciate that they took the item off our bill and still gave us the dish anyways since it was already being made by the time we asked to cancel it. It boogles the mind what could take an hour to serve a sashimi don.

I would come back to try other items. The food tasted freshly made and were executed well. I also appreciated the new year mochi celebration!

I came here recently for a late lunch with my friend and it was worth it. We ordered a few things to share - Gyudon Philly (w/ Truffle fries), Wagyu Truffle burger (w/ furikake fries), and an order of chicken wings. I really liked how the gyudon Philly tasted as they did a good job of incorporating the ingredients. The wagyu Truffle had a great flavor profile to it. I don't think you can go wrong when there's Truffle involved. The wings were fried perfectly and came with an assortment of dipping sauces.  We also had a couple of cocktails  to go with the meal.  The Light of the Pear (a slight variation of an old fashioned) was very easy to drink and made well.  We also had a Toki Highball, a classic drink. Overall,  the bartender/server was super attentive and made sure we had everything we needed. I had a great experience and hope to check them out for dinner next time.

Delicious food, great atmosphere, and friendly service. The truffle sliders and lobster rolls were a delight! The wasabi truffle mashed potatoes were gourmet comfort food at its finest. The menu had such a great selection, I have to go back to try even more!

The food, drinks, desserts, and atmosphere were all outstanding and perfectly balanced. The friendly staff and bartenders, along with the cheerful guests, created a warm and welcoming vibe that made the whole experience special. Whether visiting alone, as a couple, or with a big group, this place has the perfect space and flexibility for any occasion!
⭐ Highly recommended: the French fries, mini burgers, and crème brûlée are absolute must-tries!
I can’t wait to come back again!

Zabuton steak: Unfortunately, the steak had the texture of chewing gum. I had to spit pieces out, and I didn't finish the rest. The bok choy and mushrooms were good though 👍🏽. Truffle fries were also really good!

I've been coming here for at least 4 years now, but the last 2Xs, the food has been horrible . No flavor and just not good. The service is still amazing and the sever is really friendly and good atmosphere is cool local vibe plus kid friendly for lunch. Hope they get a new cook soon and bring some items back.

Hey taylor thanks for responding back i will definitely like to go back and give it a try again .like I said the last 2x have not been the best but at least 8 other times I had great food and great service,The Pic I posted is from a Lil less the 2 years ago and didn't take pics of my most recent visit.

Atleast Nebraska won.  While in Vagas find the Nebraska bar.  We are used to busy Huskers games and this was exactly like home.  Sadly the food is just uninspired bar food.  FromNacho cheese sauce to bad chicken fingers.  The burger was actully pretty decent but a bit over cooled.  Service was a little lacking even for a busy game day.  I've worked them and it's tough day but it seemed like we were last on her list.  Will we give it another chance... if it's a Nebraska game yes but other nope.

Bentleys Steakhouse and Bar is a great spot with a local vibe. The staff is super friendly and helpful, adding to the welcoming atmosphere. The only downside is that smoking is allowed at the bar, so there is a slight cigarette smell in the air.

I tried the meatball Parmigiana Sandwich, which looked amazing but tasted underwhelming. It seemed like frozen meatballs on a hoagie with marinara and melted mozzarella. However, the onion rings were a hit - crunchy and well-cooked. My wife had the chef salad with blue cheese dressing, which was just okay in terms of taste.

The fries were pretty good, especially when dipped in their spicy teriyaki sauce. Overall, the food was decent but not outstanding. It's more of a casual hangout spot than a true steakhouse, but still worth checking out for the friendly staff and relaxed atmosphere. Perfect for grabbing a few drinks and enjoying the local scene.
Great Husker bar!!!! Food average but fine! Thanks for having a Husker bar in Las Vegas!  GO BIIIIGGGGG RREEEEDDDD❤️

Found a gem of a restaurant this morning.Stop by Bentley's Bar and Grill on Sunset for breakfast. The decor and ambience were quite impressive.
I had the steak and eggs and it was only $7.95! My friend had the vegetarian omelette and she was quite pleased with it.
I will most definitely be back!!!

This is a great little Thai spot. I walked over from Encore for dinner and was glad I did. The staff was welcoming and I was seated right away. Plenty of vegetarian options, which I appreciated. I ordered the egg rolls, tofu satay, and green curry after asking the server which she preferred. Her recommendation was spot on.

The food came out quickly and was high quality, hot, and extremely tasty. The only odd thing was the sauces. The peanut sauce for the satay and the sweet sauce for the egg rolls were oddly gelatinous, either too cold or mixed with too much thickener, but they still tasted good.

The green curry was the standout. So much flavor, and at a spice level of 3 out of 10 it had just the right heat for me. I saw another review saying level 5 was no joke, so I played it safe.

Prices were fine, not great, but that seems to be Vegas now. Overall, I really enjoyed this place and would definitely come back.

Guys, I don't review food. Seriously.

This food is phenomenal. Truly authentic flavors. The family is endearing.

I try Thai food everywhere I go. The Khao Soi is a dish that I've never seen/tasted before. It is a wonderful curry dish with noodles, crunchy noodles, bits of fresh carrot and onion, and some mustard greens to add a unique tasty sour flavor.

It is amazing. Try it if your a curry lover. Can't hype this place up enough.

We ate family style for an opportunity to taste several dishes. We had fried calamari,  combination basil fried rice, crispy pork stir fry, pad see ew, coconut water, and thai iced teas. All the dishes were served promptly, they were flavorful, and plenty to share.

I ordered the Chicken Pad Thai, it was out in just 3:44 from order to table, very impressive! The server was attentive and quick to task.

As far as the flavour: I think you shouldn’t expect better for the price, and location. It would be unreasonable to expect more value than you get. The portion was very generous and I was full after eating, they did not skimp on the protein either!
Visited this by chance and found the best ever Thai food. Their food is very fresh and has the absolute best taste. The server is also very polite and very helpful. Must visit place.

This place has the best Mediterranean Food in town, I have tried the best Mignon Steak of my life in Sunrise, all their  Servings from Pita, Meats, Salads are incredibly delicious. Excellent server is Mustafa. They have all kinds of Halal Meat. Thank you for your kindness and hospitality! Will always support your business

I love this place. Super friendly staff. The restaurant serves fresh delicious food with decent portions for the price and it always leaves my tummy feeling good. Highly recommend checking this place out. The market sells interesting snacks worth strolling around and try something new if you're feeling adventurous.

Had the worst experience today usually always have such a great time here no problems until today in the bakery area. There was a woman working who I haven’t seen before, but she was so rude unbelievably rude yelling at us from across the store even when we’re at the cashier leaving the store she’s yelling at us Weirdest experience of my life. I’ll never be going to that side ever again. they were the ones in the wrongs and she yells wow , my poor grandma is talking to them trying to let them know what she wants The guy tells the lady to go get her a bag and then  Another customer comes up. The lady getting the bag then goes ignores my grandma helps the other lady does even acknowledge or look at my grandma and doesn’t say a word to her and I tell my grandma forget it they’re ignoring us. We don’t need bread that made the lady so mad she started yelling at us literally yelling. I told her you were ignoring us. She said the lady walking to the store first I said the store we were here in line though first waiting how does that make sense to you? I said forget it. We don’t want your bread. She said you have to learn to be patient I said ma’am we were here waiting forget it already. We don’t need it. She continues to yell yell yell while we go to the cashier the cashier is telling us it’s OK relax don’t worry about her. She continues to yell I don’t care I don’t care if you tell them go ahead tell them they have nothing to do with us. I said are you serious? What is your problem? We’re leaving the store. No one is talking to u So stop talking to us

The atmosphere here is incredible, creating a welcoming vibe that draws you in. The products are top-notch, offering fantastic quality that truly stands out. Plus, you can't beat the prices – they’re remarkably affordable! It's an experience you won’t want to miss!
I stopped by with a few friends while visiting Vegas. We ordered grilled meats. Food was fresh and taste great. Everyone left happy ! Also try the Kunafa, it’ll hit the spot.

name: Omakase Kyara Sake Bar
vicinity: 6555 S Jones Blvd UNIT 120, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
We came here to celebrate a belated birthday, and had a great time.
We chose the nigiri focused omakase course and each fish was very fresh and thoughtfully prepared.
The staff also gave us a great recommendation for sake pairing.
Thank you for being a true highlight of your vegas trip !

Overall, Omakase Kyara Sake Bar is a decent choice. If I could go back in time, I would have opted for their a la carte menu instead of the omakase menu.  I personally cared more about the nigiri then their appetizers.  The appetizers were alright,  nothing special and definitely not worth the omakase price.  A la carte in fact may be cheaper and more worth your money if you just want nigiri.

After our omakase menu, we opted for extra nigiri from their a la carte menu and that took over 20 minutes. Towards the end, the service was really slow and we had to remind our server of our missing food.
First time eating at this spot. Food was on point, fresh and delicious.  The staff was attentive and knowledgeable in introducing each dish. Price was reasonable @$168

Very good. Every omakase is a different experience and I highly recommend trying out a few places if you love sushi. Kyara's omakase was unlike any other I have had. Where as I feel most omakase's center the majority of the meal around fish, Kyara was equally balanced with non-sushi dishes. Take for instance the paper-pot shabu, this is not something typically seen in an omakase menu and was a prominent part of the meal.

I would say Kyara skirts the line between omakase and kaiseki. It's not a bad thing by any means, in fact I think it makes it more enjoyable for a wider range of people.

I also found Kyara to be reasonably priced and an enjoyable experience. There wasn't as much interaction with the sushi chefs as with other omakase experiences I have had however. There also wasn't the traditional handing of individual sushi pieces to the guest from the chef as you tend to associate with a true omakase experience.

All that being said, I thought it was a great experience, everything was delicious, and it was very reasonably priced. Well worth it and I would 100% return. They also had fresh grated wasabi as an add-on. If you have never had fresh grated wasabi, you need to experience it at least once, it has such a beautiful floral flavor and is far less pungent and "spicy" than what you usually get in the paste form.
I had nothing short of a fantastic experience. The vibe in there is immaculate, great music great people. Every dish during the tuna cutting was delicious. I was so full after its worth it.

name: Thai Legends Authentic Thai & Seafood
vicinity: 2904 W Lake E Dr, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Hands down the BEST Thai restaurant we’ve been to in Las Vegas & possibly ever? We were sat down & the server was very attentive & sweet & our order came out fast! The food, drinks & dessert were outstanding! My husband & I both agreed there wasn’t anything we could complain about because nothing was lacking in flavor, the presentation for every dish was absolutely beautiful as well! The restaurant was fully packed midway through our meal so I’m glad we got here around 5pm because this is not the place you want to miss out on!

We will for sure be back I can’t believe this was our first time because it will definitely not be our last!

This is my second visit to this restaurant, and unfortunately, I've had to remove some stars.

An honest question for the chef: Why do you offer a non-spicy option if you're going to make it spicy anyway?

I understand this is a Thai restaurant, but I've been to countless Thai restaurants in Las Vegas that serve 0% spicy if you ask them to make it that way. I also understand that every business is free to offer their product with the characteristics they consider appropriate. However, if you're going to offer 0% spicy and then serve it medium-high spicy anyways, you're lying to your customers and serving them something they didn't order.

My husband likes spicy food, and even he said you guys are not doing it right. The first time we visited, he ordered medium spicy but got a super high spicy level and could barely eat it. On our second visit, we both ordered no spicy at all and still received medium-high spicy food. Two visits, same issue.

I've read other negative reviews about this exact problem. While I understand that spice levels can sometimes be confusing, adding any spicy in a dish when a customer specifically asked for none? Very hard to get that wrong in my opinion.

For those who don't want spicy food, AVOID this place. We won't be coming back.

What a great find. I work in the area and I wanted Thai Food. Thai Legends is a nice quaint restaurant and tucked away from the main streets.  Beautiful decor and friendly staff. Great menu selection and they offer lunch specials.  I had the Panang Curry with Tofu and Sticky Rice.  The curry was delicious and creamy.
Im excited to go back and try different dishes.

The incredibly kind gentleman working gave me an iced thai tea on the house while I was waiting for my to go order. I’m pretty sure it was because I tipped. Right away, the customer service is through the roof. I immediately knew the food was gonna be good. Scrumptious fresh spring rolls with shrimp were awesome and I inhaled the chicken drunken noodles in five minutes. They’ve immediately got a returning customer in me. 5 stars.

Great portion sizes, great hosts, delicious food. We had the green curry, pad thai and half chicken. The curry and pad thai were very good-the chicken was a little dry.
Prices are reasonable, not the cheapest you can find BUT the portion sizes are great. My friends have gone back several times and keep trying new things, saying everything is delicious.

name: Kaiseki Sanga
vicinity: 3650 S Decatur Blvd Suite 22, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
We came here for my husband's birthday and had a great time! The service from the moment you approach the door to when you leave was fantastic. We were greeted outside as we were approaching the door to he restaurant. We were guided to our seat and the timing of each bite was so well executed and practiced, they make it look so easy. I've eaten at other similar fine dining places where the timing is off or doesn't make sense like a party arriving after us finishing before us. The pacing was smooth and well timed here.

The food was yum! Such great quality ingredients and excellent preparation of the food. I didn't leave hungry and I did order an extra sushi but I could've gone for more of the delicious goodness.

I highly recommend and would love to make time to come back in the future!

Sanga, the perfect place for a holiday, or any reason, dinner.

Set menu, which changes monthly, of nine courses ($250), with two types of sake pairings (opted for the basic $85 one). Bottles and beverages could be purchased separately as well.

In short, one of the most amazing meals I have enjoyed.

The experience was a feast for the senses, from the premium ingredients to the traditional and stunning techniques, presentation, and flavor. A5 wagyu, Maine lobster, kobako, sake lees, caviar, black truffle, milt, fish like yellowtail, barracuda, tuna, seabass, snapper, just a small sample of the treats in store. The accompanying enhancers received no less care, from the red wine salt to the soy sauce to the hand-ground wasabi.

The $85 sake pairing consisted of six pours, each delivered with history, rice type, and into its own particular vessel whether a wee latticed porcelain cup, murano glass, color-changing saucer, or enameled gilt chalice.

Service: Unintimidating formality, cheerful and informative.

Atmosphere: Elegant, traditional, minimalist modern. Light music set a peaceful tone, while the chefs fascinated with their skills to create edible art.

Value: Incalculable.

Give these chefs a Michelin Star! This was my second time dining at Kaiseki Sanga and it was just as incredible as the first. Every single bite was better than the last, the sushi course is spectacular. This is Japanese food at its finest. The experience is personal as the counter only accommodates 10. There is care placed in every detail from serving drinks, folding napkins, explaining the food and preparation, to a basket to store your purse below your seat. I will make sure to dine here every time I am in town!

Oh, my god! I never imagined being able to have authentic Kaiseki dinner in Las Vegas. I'm a Korean-American, who have been in Japan over 20 times for the last 30 years and tried almost every kind of Kaiseki dinner. So I can discern a real Kaiseki from a fake one. Without further ado, this is one of the world-best authentic Japanese restaurants. I really mean it!
This is sure to have price-value for 250 dollars per person.
Easily one of the best omakase experiences in Las Vegas, hands down. It genuinely surpasses what you'll find on the Strip, offering exceptional food and service. Must try

Have been here twice with my Spanish speaking American friend and love the food here.   Well decorated and the servers are fast and efficient. They also know how to accommodate customized request.

The food is more towards American style Mexican food but good enough to enjoy.

Nice choice inside Santa Fe Casino.

The steak is good portion but is on the expensive side when it comes to price.
Went Saturday the food was great!! The margaritas and the Michelada was awesome!! Our server Raul was very attentive, professional and very welcoming. I am definitely returning.

Food was amazing. Our server was very backed up. But she communicated it to us. Gave us some chips to get us through until she got caught up to take our order. Food was huge portions. The elotes needed more chilli powder but was good. Server was very attentive. Definitely make a reservation.

My mom and I just came here for happy hour and were blown away by the excellent service! The bartender turned on the game we wanted and we ate and drank like queens! Our waiter, June, listened to our preferences and made the perfect recommendations. We’re already planning on coming back with more family.

The place is fun and exciting visually. The food really lacked. I ordered the Biria.
My plate came out looking like it had been sitting around before being brought to the table.( A sort of crusted over look to it from the photo I have attached.)
The flavor was not there. My corn tortillas were hard around the edges.(Again; like it was left under the heat lamp for some time.)
Small portions for the price. Everything just was bland and underwhelming.
The meat in my friend’s street tacos was so overcooked it was not chewable.
Enjoyed the margaritas and the company of friends but would never recommend or eat here again, unfortunately.

name: Sushi Koma
vicinity: 8665 W Flamingo Rd Ste 127, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
This was our first time trying out this sushi restaurant and it definitely hit the spot. It wasn’t too busy when we arrived, so we were able to get seated immediately. The server let us know that they were currently offering a $19.99 AYCE lunch special, which I thought was a really nice incentive. Their menu was quite extensive so we narrowed down our “must-have” items that we always tend to order when we go out for sushi.

We started off with a few of their appetizers, nigiris, and sushi rolls. The food came out really fast and our server was very attentive to our needs. All of the appetizers we tried were so tasty and very flavorful. The sushi was presented elegantly, tasted very fresh, and were proportioned well. As for the rice, it kept falling apart every time I would dip it in the soy sauce. Overall, this is a solid spot for some reasonably priced AYCE sushi.

First time here today and it was amazing. We just left and I had to write a review. My toddler loves sushi and was a bit restless. The waitress was so kind and patient with us and gave him some sour patch kids. But before she offered them to my son she discreetly asked me if he could have it which is appreciate. Definitely will be back. I didn’t take a picture until after but it was really good.

Was in Summerlin in Las Vegas taking care of some business and while driving seen this place Sushi Koma. Service was super fast and friendly. It was only 2 tables going at the time. Food was NASCAR fast and fresh. I gave them 4 stars instead of 5 because the menu was sticky and gross I had to wash my hands before and after I ate. Other than that I recommend this spot if you are in a rush or in the area. Dinner all you can eat is $32.99 per person. Got full really fast and had to tap out quick!!

Food was fresh. And all the flavors on point. Service top notch! Chef was amazing. The owner was there and gave us samples of sushi we didn't order. He was so nice ! And made sure he was taking care of his dinner guest.
The music was a bit too loud.and the booth seats were a bit uncomfortable.
Will definitely be coming back for more fresh sushi!

Husband and I have been going to Sushi Koma for over a decade. Their menu has all the best specialty rolls, SO fresh! The best appetizer is their tuna carpaccio. Service is speedy and super kind. The venue is trendy and always clean. And best of all, the prices are reasonable and competitive. Absolutely the best sushi in the Las Vegas valley!!! #musttry

Blaqcat Ultra Lounge & Cuisine stands out not just for its atmosphere, but for the level of service and staff expertise that truly sets it apart.

The staff is incredibly knowledgeable, especially when it comes to hookah. They do not just take an order, they guide you. From helping you choose flavors based on your preferences, to explaining mixes, heat management, and longevity, it is clear they understand the craft. The hookah is consistently smooth, flavorful, and well maintained, which speaks to their attention to detail and experience.

The food is where Blaqcat really shines. The seasoning on the dishes is balanced, intentional, and layered with flavor. Nothing tastes rushed or generic. Each dish reflects an understanding of how to season properly, allowing the spices to enhance the food instead of overpowering it.

What truly stands out is the variety of preparation styles. Whether dishes are grilled, sautéed, fried, or slow cooked, each method is used thoughtfully to bring out the best texture and flavor. The execution is consistent, and the presentation matches the quality of the food.

The service throughout the experience is professional, attentive, and confident. The staff knows the menu well, can clearly explain ingredients and preparation methods, and offers recommendations that feel genuine and informed. You feel welcomed, cared for, and never rushed.

Blaqcat Ultra Lounge & Cuisine delivers on every level, expert service, knowledgeable staff, perfectly seasoned food, and thoughtful preparation. This is a place that understands hospitality and takes pride in every detail. Highly recommended.

I cannot say enough good things about this place. From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel genuinely welcomed, not the forced “hi, welcome in” energy, but the kind where you can tell they actually enjoy being there. Everyone was super friendly, attentive without hovering, and quick to help whenever we needed anything.

The lounge itself? Immaculate vibes. Cozy, inviting, and just one of those spots where you instantly relax. We ended up staying for three and a half hours without even realizing it because we were having such a good time. Everything from the atmosphere to the service made it easy to settle in and just enjoy ourselves.

If you’re looking for a spot that feels warm, comfortable, and effortlessly fun, this is it. Already excited to come back!

Great hookah bar with amazing food and a relaxed vibe. The hookah was smooth, flavorful, and lasted a long time clearly high quality and well prepared. The food was fresh, well-seasoned, and came out hot  honestly better than expected for a hookah spot and love the baghlawa.
Friendly stuff

I go to Blanca often. The atmosphere  is always  amazing. If you want a chill vibe to relax and smoke some good hookah this is the place to come to. The staff is always great and give great recommendations  on hookah  flavors!!

From the moment we walked in, the service was outstanding—warm, welcoming, and truly made us feel like family. The staff was incredibly attentive, always checking in to make sure everything was perfect.

The hookah itself was top-tier. Smooth pulls, clean setup, and some of the best flavor quality I’ve had in a long time. They offer an impressive variety of flavors, bowls, and hookah styles to choose from, so there’s definitely something for everyone. Whether you’re into classic blends or more unique mixes, they’ve got it all.

Overall, an exceptional experience. Highly recommend if you’re looking for great vibes, great hookah, and even better service!

First time trying Ethiopian food and it was probably the best thing I’ve ever eaten. The serving sizes were enormous and everything was phenomenal. The workers were super friendly and helpful and the atmosphere was great. Awesome place to relax and have a great meal.

Absolutely would go here regularly

Lovely no frills place with a beautiful interior and great food. We are the vegetarian platter and foul. Also got a side salad. Food was better than other Ethiopian resultants I have been to across the country. We are the only ones eating there so it was a peaceful dinner. Highly recommend for vegetarian and vegan food.

If you're looking for authentic Ethiopian, this is a great choice. The Lamb Awaze Tibs were delicious and the Veggie Platter was very fresh. My only critique would be the portion of the Doro Wot; it only included one leg piece, which left us wanting a bit more protein for the table.
That said, the ginger tea is a must-try, and the staff is wonderful. Our server went above and beyond to explain everything to us.

4/26/25, This was my first time experiencing Ethiopian food.  I had the vegetable platter and it was very flavorful. Eating with injera bread and no utensils was actually satisfying. Service from Natalie was great and the atmosphere in the smaller dining area was nice and calm.

Photo on first shows kitfo what I got was mixed left over and when I called she said different kind of kitfo I order from them many times the first 2 times was great the last time was like this can’t tell what kind of meat and it tasted weird couldn’t eat it like they just mixed whatever they had and put in box.

I loved the food at Mesob. Semirah was lovely, she is very sweet and generous, she invited me to have some coffee after doing the beautiful ceremony with incense which smelled so good and the coffee was delicious. I got the veggie plate and it was all vegan and so yummy. Next time I am back in Vegas I will definitely be back!
Food was delicious and service was outstanding. Came here with my family and we all loved it here. This was our first time trying Ethiopian food and we will definitely be back!
So friendly here! Food was delicious. Definitely share- plates are very large and Intended to be shared. Wonderful time. Very down to earth.
Best spot!!! Super clean!! So tasty!! So vegan friendly !! Family owned !!! very grateful to have this place serving the community food for the soul

I have a sensitive stomach and tend to be mindful of quality and ingredient balance, so I was curious to see how a “fusion” twist on Ethiopian cuisine would hold up. I ordered the veggie platter. I could definitely tell where the fusion influence came in; the dishes had a creative spin that set them apart from the more traditional stews I’ve enjoyed over the past 20 years.

Notably, the Gomen (which is typically made with collard greens) included peppers, giving it a unique and interesting flavor. I only wish the peppers had been cooked down a bit more for that signature tender texture, but I could tell the chef had put real thought into the preparation.

I was a little disappointed in the cabbage and potato stew, as the potatoes were slightly undercooked, and I also felt the portion size was on the smaller side for the price — I usually have leftovers, but this time I didn’t.

On the bright side, the yellow lentils were magnificent; smooth, rich, and full of flavor. They really stood out as the highlight of the meal.

What truly made this visit special, though, was the staff and chef. They were incredibly kind and welcoming, with a clear passion for both the cuisine and the community.
If you visit, take a moment to chat with the chef — he’s full of knowledge about the area and the inspiration behind the dishes.

name: Sky Cafe Lounge
vicinity: 4170 S Decatur Blvd suite A-3, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Sky Café Lounge is the perfect spot to unwind with chill vibes and a relaxed atmosphere. The hookah is smooth and flavorful, the service is friendly, and the prices are surprisingly great for the quality you get. Whether you’re hanging out with friends or just looking for a laid-back place to decompress, this lounge delivers on comfort, flavor, and good energy.

We had a wonderful time at the Sky Cafe hookah lounge. The service was amazing. The staff is so nice and the hookahs are a 10 out of 10.  I also love the vibe and relaxing atmosphere! A must visit if your in Vegas!!!

Hands down the best hookah spot in Las Vegas! The vibe is chill, the hookah is top quality, and the customer service is unmatched. The staff is super friendly, attentive, and always make sure everything is perfect thank
from setting up your hookah to checking in without being overbearing.

They know their flavors and gave great recommendations. The lounge is clean, comfortable, and has a great atmosphere whether you’re coming with friends or just to relax solo.

If you’re looking for great hookah and 5-star service, this is the place. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I love coming to Sky Lounge when I want to unwind. The atmosphere is super cozy, the hookah is always great, and the service is amazing, staff really makes you feel welcome. Being open 24 hours is a huge bonus, especially for late-night hangouts. Definitely one of my go-to spots.

Cozy spot tucked away from the bustling traffic.
The host is an absolutely wonderful woman. Hookah was excellent.
Expect to spend around $40 for food and hookah.
Would recommend to anybody wanting to try hookah.
Good food. Had the chicken sandwich and the fried fish.
Enjoyed my time there. Food was delicious

Delicious food wonderful service
Everything was great
Excellent food, friendly service and great place to dine.
Wonderful food and atmosphere.

We visited this restaurant during Christmas and were thoroughly impressed. Initially, we were waiting at the noodle shop next to Weera, but it took an eternity. Fortunately, Weera welcomed us right away. From the moment we stepped inside, we were captivated by the beautiful Xmas decoration and design. The restaurant’s decorations showcased the dedication and care that went into its creation.

The food was simply delicious, and the cocktail menu and bar looked incredibly appealing. Our server was exceptionally friendly and attentive. She even gave my son a coin to play with at the claw machine, which was a lovely gesture. The food arrived beautifully presented, and I couldn’t help but wonder if this was the reason for the slightly higher prices.

I usually frequent mom-and-pop Thai restaurants, where the food tastes just like you’re eating at an expensive Thai restaurant. It’s like homemade Thai cuisine. However, it was Christmas, and we had indulged in some splurges, so the $32 price for the duck curry seemed reasonable.

Despite this, I wouldn’t recommend ordering the duck curry on any regular day. Nevertheless, I’m eager to return and explore their other menu items.

I came across a previous review mentioning that the server rushed the customer. I want to clarify that during peak hours in any busy restaurant, there are time limits. People are waiting outside to dine. Therefore, it’s understandable that the restaurant needs to accommodate as many customers as possible. I hope that when the restaurant feels the need to rush due to the large number of customers waiting outside, they will also inform the customers during peak hours that there is a minimum table limit. This would help the customers understand the situation and make informed decisions.

If could, I’d give this place 4.5 stars. We came here for a family dinner, and everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. The only thing I’d mention is that our server seemed to rush us out a bit after dinner — we were just chatting, but the check came quickly and the table was cleared right away. I’ve been here for lunch and the service was great, so it might have just been an off night. The ambiance and décor are really nice — such a beautiful restaurant overall.

I wanted to share my feedback regarding my  experiences. The Happy Hour prices were great, the drink was awesome, and the portion sizes were perfect. I also really appreciate that you have a pet-friendly patio. The server service was nice and friendly. But I did have a couple of uncomfortable experiences that Host Service at times, the host service was lacking. We stood waiting at the front and had to initiate the conversation to get seated, rather than being greeted and asked if we needed a table. Also, Inappropriate Comments that I felt very uncomfortable when I visited with my Asian friends. Because they understood Thai, they overheard staff members making inappropriate and unprofessional comments about them. It is unacceptable and unprofessional for staff to talk about guests in this manner. Other than that everything was great!

I ended up at the shopping center looking for something else and I happened to stumble across this Thai restaurant. My family and I decided to give it a try and see what was all about. To our surprise upon entering this amazing restaurant The first thing that hits you is the amazing design and decor the attention to detail that contributes to an amazing atmosphere is by far one of the most unexpected experiences at a shopping center. And the food was really good everything was very tasteful and delicious service was a little on the slow side but not a big deal we were just absorbing that atmosphere of all the beautiful decor that surrounded us. So if you want to impress that special someone this is an amazing treat and surprise because it is just beautiful all the way around the decor and the food is top notch for sure. Highly recommend it.

Weera Thai @ South Rainbow Blvd has such a great vibe! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, perfect for a casual lunch or a relaxed dinner. The food is fresh, flavorful, and authentic—every dish we tried was delicious. Service was friendly and attentive, which made the experience even better. Definitely a go-to spot if you’re craving good Thai food in Las Vegas.

name: Weera Thai Kitchen - China Town
vicinity: 4276 Spring Mountain Rd C-105, Las Vegas

reviews.text: I was in town for a visit and craving some authentic Thai food, and I’m really glad I came across this place. The atmosphere was genuinely enjoyable—warm, inviting, and beautifully decorated, with a lot of attention clearly put into the details. The service was absolutely top-notch; everyone was friendly, attentive, and made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. As for the food, it was good. great dining experience, and I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for quality Thai cuisine in the area.”

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5

This Thai restaurant has quickly become our absolute favorite spot in Las Vegas! Every dish we’ve tried is incredibly flavorful, the kind of bold, balanced flavors you can only get from truly great Thai cooking. The ingredients taste fresh, the seasoning is always spot-on, and you can really tell how much care goes into each plate.

We’ve built quite a list of favorites here: the crispy duck Panang curry (rich, spicy, and perfectly cooked), the crab fried rice (so fragrant and satisfying), the pad see ew (comforting with that perfect wok-char), the pad prik king (bright and spicy), and the sukiyaki (full of depth and unique flavors). Each dish hits perfectly every time.

All the servers here are super nice and welcoming, but especially Tana, he is always incredibly kind, attentive, and makes us feel taken care of every visit. His outstanding service really elevates the dining experience.

The location is super convenient too, right in Shanghai Plaza along Spring Mountain Road, which is already a hot spot for amazing food. Whether we’re craving comforting noodles, fragrant curries, or vibrant appetizers, this place never disappoints. Highly recommend to anyone looking for authentic, delicious Thai cuisine in Vegas!😋

One of my favorite places to go to for Thai food. Been here a few times and it never disappoints.

It's located in Shanghai Plaza where parking can be difficult to find during busy hours. The staff is very friendly, attentive, and helpful. The interior is beautifully decorated and very clean.

On previous trips, our favorites were the crispy papaya salad, drunken noodles, and green curry to name a few. The crispy papaya salad is just something you can't get elsewhere, or it's not the same.

I believe for most of their dishes that have a spice level, you can choose 1-5. 3 is great if you want a good amount of kick in your dishes to start. If you're sensitive to spiciness, I'd recommend a 2 to start, maybe 3. Most of the dishes I like a level 4 since I do enjoy the spiciness

Get the papaya salad (original or crispy), you can't really go wrong. It's refreshing, spicy, and delicious. I like this in a level 3. I prefer my papaya salad more sweet and refreshing with some kick to it, but I want the spiciness from my other savory dishes.

Really like the drunken noodles (level 4 or 5, and add beef). I'm a huge drunken noodles fan and this place satisfies my craving for it. I'll eat some during our visit, and take some for later in the night and it's still excellent.

I got the fried pork and papaya salad dish this time and it was a good dish. The fried pork belly was perfectly fried. Some of the pork belly was tough though.

Their thai tea is very well made, the sweetness and tea is well balanced compared to a lot of other places where the thai tea is overly sweet and just not balanced at all.

Fresh coconut was very refreshing. Really enjoyed the coconut meat after. Just reminds me of being back in SE Asia on vacation.

We'll usually come here when we're in Vegas. It's one of our favorite places to eat and a perfect getaway from the Strip.

We absolutely love the Khao Soi with Chicken here! The curry broth was so flavorful and we finished it all off with a bowl of jasmine rice after we ate the noodles. I highly recommend trying their Khao Soi!

Their Pad Kee Mao was a bit underwhelming, with the noodles just slightly overcooked. It didn’t have much flavor even though it came out before the flavor bomb Khao Soi. The main flavor was the spice! At level 3, it seems they put 3 diced Thai chili peppers, so we mainly tasted that.

The atmosphere and decor inside are fantastic! Parking is hectic in that lot, so be patient and hopefully someone leaves as you’re coming in.
Best meal we had in Vegas so far. Every dish is soooooo delicious!! We finished all the meal~ BTW, Emmie was super warm and kind, which made the whole experience even better.

Kind Staff, but Food and Decor Fall Short
​If you are looking for a meal where the service shines brighter than the plates, Marigold Indian Restaurant is that kind of place.
​The Food
​To be honest, the food was just okay. While it was edible and "fine," it didn't hit the mark of being truly high-quality or very good. It felt like standard fare that lacks the vibrant, punchy flavors you usually hope for with Indian cuisine. If you aren't a picky eater, it's a safe enough choice, but it’s not a "must-visit" for foodies.
​Service
​The highlight of the experience was definitely the staff. They are incredibly polite and good at what they do. The service was warm and welcoming, which made the meal much more pleasant than it would have been otherwise. It’s the kind of hospitality that makes you want to like the place more than you actually do.
​Ambience & Energy
​The restaurant is in desperate need of a refresh. The ambience feels quite old and dated, lacking any real "vibe" or character. It feels like it hasn't been updated in years, which contributes to a bit of a dull dining experience. A bit of modern lighting or updated decor would go a long way in making the space feel more alive.
​Final Verdict
​Marigold is a decent neighborhood spot if you prioritize a friendly face and a quiet meal, but the food and the decor both need a significant boost to compete with other growing spots in town.

Amazing Halal Food in the Heart of Vegas!
We tried the Chicken Pakoras, Vegetable Pakoras, Lamb Coconut Curry, Chicken Korma, and Goat Biryani and every single dish was finger-licking delicious. Each plate was packed with bold, aromatic spices and bursting with authentic flavor.
The raita that came with the biryani deserves a special mention, it was perfectly balanced and made every bite even more enjoyable. The portions were generous, and everything tasted freshly made.
Service was equally impressive, warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming from start to finish. We absolutely loved our experience here and can’t wait to come back. A true gem for anyone looking for amazing halal food in Vegas!

Marigold in Las Vegas delivers a satisfying and authentic Indian dining experience with generous portions and well-balanced flavors. The garlic naan was soft, buttery, and perfectly blistered, pairing beautifully with the rich curries, while the dal was comforting, hearty, and finished with a flavorful tadka that felt homestyle yet elevated. The paneer dish stood out with its creamy texture, fresh ingredients, and just the right level of spice, complemented nicely by fragrant basmati rice. The ambiance is warm and inviting, service is attentive, and overall the food feels thoughtfully prepared, making Marigold a great choice for anyone craving quality Indian cuisine.

I have been coming here multiple times. Now they have bigger place.
One the best indian food I had in the US so far. All the curries are amazing. I like their daal tadka and goat curry. They have yummy tandoori chicken as well.

Delicious Halal Goat Rogan Josh & Great Service!

I had an amazing experience here! I ordered the Goat Rogan Josh with Garlic Naan and a Mango Lassi, and everything was absolutely delicious. The meat was tender and flavorful, the naan was fresh and perfectly garlicky, and the mango lassi was cool, creamy, and refreshing.

What made the experience even better was that the food was 100% halal, which is always a big plus. The service was fast and the staff was friendly and professional. The place was also very clean and well-kept which made dining here even more enjoyable.

If you're looking for authentic halal Indian food with great flavor and quick service I definitely recommend checking this spot out!

This is a highly recommended coffee spot by my friend and has been on my bucket list. Finally tried it now but slightly disappointed.
Nothing fancy inside but with plenty of seats for your computer work. On a Monday noon, it’s a full house.

The lady cashier is very friendly and patient with our orders and gave us suggestions.

We got their seasonal salted caramel banana latte which is the most popular item but we don’t like it. You taste banana first, then the coffee bitterness following with the burnt caramel scent. I think it might be the male long hair barista who seems absent-minded. He didn’t mark our drinks’ flavors, and when we asked, he wasn’t really attentive.
But we all like the orange spice hojicha latte, which is light but with great flavor.
We ordered our coffee hot, but all came out barely lukewarm. I’m taking mine home to warm it up.

I’ll probably give their other location a try.

This location has a drive thru and bakery on site. Regret not trying any of the bakery items. The other location has a roastery on site.

They have a decent menu with many choices for drinks and light breakfast. Their giant pastries are bigger than my hand!

We got the vanilla cardamom latte and honeycomb latte. We liked both of our drinks. Jasmin syrup was the sweetener in the Honeycomb latte and it was perfect. No complaints about being too sweet. The cardamom spice did not over power the drink.

Just got back from a week in Vegas and I'm already missing this place! Found Vesta Coffee on my first morning and ended up going every single day - that's how good it is.

Their El Matador coffee became my daily ritual. Perfect way to start each morning in Vegas. It's got this rich, bold flavor that really gets you going. I'm not even a coffee snob but this stuff is next level.

Had to try the churro muffin one morning and it was amazing! Sweet, cinnamon-y, and goes perfectly with their coffee. Exactly what it sounds like but so much better than you'd expect.

Tried their matcha a couple times when I wanted to switch it up. Really smooth and not bitter like some places make it. Good quality stuff.

The staff started recognizing me by day 3 which was cool. Super friendly people who clearly love what they do. Always had great energy even early in the morning.

Honestly made my Vegas mornings so much better. Had my perfect little coffee routine to start each day. Already planning my next trip back and you bet Vesta Coffee is on my list!

From a visitor, this place is a MUST any time I find myself in Vegas. The menu is full of fantastic coffee (from what seems to be solid Producers), hand made syrups and milks(damn!!!?!) and tasty food. Everything is quality quality quality.

Also, I feel so cared for by any team member I interact with - so refreshing.

Thanks yall! Cant wait to be back

I’ve been buying their bagged coffee for a while but just had never gotten around to stopping by one of their shops until now.  I ordered a latte and a bodega sandwich and they were both absolutely excellent.  I didn’t really like the interior seating area, felt like a bright modern Silicon Valley open office or something, not very cozy, but sitting outside was nice.

Food Quality: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Value: 5/5

This is easily my favorite coffee shop in town. Take it Easy Roasters is nestled in the heart of Chinatown and I’m so glad I ran across this place! They have the cutest storefront and the most incredible espresso machine setup! We came here to grab a quick snack and coffee break and got the Ch-ube latte, Hoji-Thai latte , burnt suga, and the pumpkin cream cheese tart. Watching the drinks being made explains everything - you can tell the baristas take pride in their craft and they made the most perfect drinks I’ve ever tasted. I seriously can’t wait to go back to Vegas just for this!

The staff was also very welcoming and nice and the cafe was very well kept. Can’t wait to try more of the menu!

Great experience. Liked the cortado so much that I bought a couple pounds of their beans. Their espresso machine was unique in that it was built into the counter and there was a flow profile setup by the roaster to get the best out of that specific blend. Highly recommend. Didn’t have one of these cookie croissants but thought it was noteworthy enough to take a picture of.

Absolutely amazing experience at Take It Easy Roasters!
From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was calm, inviting, and perfect for relaxing or getting some work done. We ordered coffee and were blown away by how well it was made. The microfoam was silky smooth, and the roast was rich and flavorful—clearly made by someone who knows their craft. If you’re a coffee perfectionist or just love a great cup, this place is 100% worth the stop, especially if you’re on the Strip.

The staff was super friendly and welcoming, and you can tell there’s a lot of care behind everything they do. They also bake in-house, and we had a vegan muffin that was so good it disappeared before I could even snap a photo.

Amazing place and totally worth the drive from downtown. Highly recommend!

One of the best coffees I've had in Las Vegas I don't know what the blend is they use but boy is it ever nice I don't like a bitter coffee.  I also had some delicious Colombian cheese bread they have some interesting pastries here. The people were super friendly and a service was amazing.
Excellent pour over. I had the Ethiopian Yirgacheffe. They say it was medium, but much closer to Light. Good flavor profile and nice little patio outside to check emails.

name: YEHAGERE MARKET
vicinity: 6125 W Tropicana Ave D, Las Vegas

reviews.text: The Best Ethiopian market clean and very organized with great service.
Best injera in Vegas, my favorites place one stop shop for Ethiopian groceries !!!!
Amazing Ethiopian market nice service👍👍👍👍👍
I went to yehagere Market Most of the time New place they have everything I need thank you.

Had a great time at the location but the food is HORRIBLE and NOT COMPLIANT. I ordered two orders of wings and they weRE completely RAW. I didn’t even want to even leave a review but since no one has responded to my calls or messages, I had to.  I do not understand why I even waited AN HOUR FOR RAW CHICKEN. I would like a complete refund.

What a way to have VIP status

Nice location.
Easy going bar and roomy space.
The colors was very nice and music was greatly selected.
The drinks and food had a great taste. The Wings was delicious.
The plates are very filing.
The server was very nice and knowledgeable of the menu. Not to sure if it just my luck but this place was it. Enjoyable for friends, family couples, locals and tourists.

Never been to this establishment before, and it was a busy weekend in Vegas. The staff initially said they weren’t letting anyone in for a few minutes, which was fine — but then claimed that entry required buying a section. When we asked about pricing, no one seemed to know and kept giving us the runaround. The security lady was extremely rude, even mocking a gentleman who was trying to buy a section. Her attitude was very passive-aggressive and unprofessional. Absolutely no hospitality — not the Vegas experience you’d expect at all .

A group of friends and I went to Elevate to celebrate a friend’s Master’s degree. After waiting in line for 15 minutes, we observed groups of individuals leaving the establishment while we were still being denied entry. After another 10 minutes, the situation persisted, with people leaving but no one being admitted. Complaints arose regarding the club’s emptiness, with individuals suggesting that the presence of people outside was used to create a false impression of crowds. This tactic not only demonstrates rudeness but also misleads patrons. I went under the ropes to understand why the club had people waiting outside, when clearly it wasn’t over occupancy. This is when the owner denied me entry and said I wasn’t allowed to come in. Accused me of trying to sneak in, as if I would leave my friends behind to get into a club! I was simply trying to figure out the hold up! I will refrain from patronizing this establishment and advise others to do the same. The owner’s management appears to lack the necessary business sense!!
Elevate is a really fun spot with culture and can be anything from relaxing and somewhere I can get work done in the day time to a lively party at night. Highly recommend

name: Westside Deli & Pasta
vicinity: 3360 W Sahara Ave Ste 110, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Great experience! The meatball sub was absolutely delicious — full of flavor and perfectly made. The restaurant was clean, and the service was professional and attentive. Several team members checked in on our table to make sure we had everything we needed, which made us feel truly cared for. Highly recommend!

Literally the best meatball sub I've had in a long time.  I stumbled across this restaurant in the office building and couldn't believe how good the food is.  The chef was so nice, very helpful and said all of the food is great.

I'm coming back for sure.  The best meatball sub in Las Vegas!

No fuss, fast, and accommodative service. Lisa tailored a breakfast
sandwich that amped up the protein and lowered the fat content. I also enjoyed an unflavored almond milk latte to accompany the sandwich.  I will be sure to return on my next business trip.

Solid choice if you need inexpensive quality food but don't like standard fast food options. They actually open until 4.30 pm, not 3pm. Located at the back of the administrative building. I would give the place 4/5 overall.

Their sandwiches are very tasty. The bread has a nice crust on it. Portions are solid. I would give it 4.5/5

Cappuccino needs improvement. Tastes like Starbucks. Strong but not tasty. The foam is mashy. Not for you if you are a coffee lover. On the other side: they have an espresso machine, which is unusual for a tiny places like this. I would give it 3/5.

Service is quick and super friendly.  5/5.

The atmosphere and interior are very  basic. Not particularly inviting. It feels  similar to those newer Subways.
However, the place is clean and up to date. 3/5

Price is very affordable, which makes it a place I could recommend. Caprese sandwich with ton of french  fries + cappuccino = $15.50 Awesome. 5/5

***
Note to the owner: I would recommend switch to warmer lights (warm white light bulbs) and pick one theme for basic decor. Like adding photos of one particular Italian city and a few iconic memorabilia from there. It will create a story behind the place.

This is a great spot to check out!

The food is good, the prices are good, and the staff are friendly.

Our group had the Chicken Caprese, Philly Cheesesteak, Pastrami Cheesesteak, Toasted Ravioli and Buffalo wings and we were happy with everything!

We will definitely come back

name: Parlour Coffee and Cooking
vicinity: 616 E Carson Ave Suite #140, Las Vegas

reviews.text: I seen the place on TikTok and decided to give it a try. The lattes here were so good I was tempted to get another one before I left. This cafe has tons of drink options. I’m don’t eat pork since they really didn’t have non pork breakfast meat I tried the chicken and waffles which were pretty good. My friend had waffles eggs and bacon. The prices were very reasonable and this place is a short walking distance from Fremont street. The only reason why I’m rating 4 stars is the cleanliness of the restaurant could be better. I can during the week day and it wasn’t that busy , there were several dirty tables and my silverware had food particles on there I got had to get my one clean ones. I would definitely go back for some coffee or delicious latte or even to take any new drink  that have on the menu.

The Parlour Coffee & Cooking is hands down one of the best brunch spots in downtown Las Vegas. The food is incredible — the fried chicken and waffles are perfectly crispy and golden, and the breakfast sandwich with bacon, potatoes, and a runny egg is next-level comfort food. Their candied pecan latte tastes like dessert in a cup! The vibe is cozy, the staff are super friendly, and it’s a great place for casual meetings or slow weekend mornings. Chef Antonio Núñez and his sons created something really special here — comfort food, coffee, and community all in one spot.

Counter service where you pay then sit down. They bring the food out when ready. The food was decent jalapeno ranch was perfect with the fluffy fries. $40 for 2 burgers didn't match the quality expected. it wasn't good enough to make me want to come back. Meat on the non smashed burger tasted basic. Coffee drip out the canteen was cold. They should have taken it off the bill altogether but offered to switch out a soda in the cooler. After we left a big tip and paid for it was not a good recovery on their end. Kind of weird to not focus on coffee temperature and freshness since coffee is in the name of the business. You would think they would have hot coffee or offer to make some fresh. The protein style burger had all the sauces slapped on it instead of the side as requested. Messy and too much mayo. Maybe a good spot for a quick breakfast bite but that is about it.

sooo yummy! we came for my birthday and it was a great start to my bday! got the tacos huevos and torta bagel + 2 bloody marys. all delicious! plays the best tunes too and staff all seems chill as hell. i’m a local and so bummed it took me so long to try this spot. will be back!

I saw a Review on YT a Famous Hollywood Chef Recommended this place although he went to the Henderson Location , which I am assuming was much better all around due to his High Excellent Review . This was New Year’s Eve at 12:30pm.  Buckle up it’s gonna be a long one….
Unfortunately I was Extremely Disappointed. As we entered the tiny place NO ONE bothered to Say Hello or Greet us. I had to take the initiative to ask the man behind the counter should we wait to be seated? He seemed extremely bothered by my questions as to what exactly is the procedure here. He then shortly halfway explained that we have no menus everything is up on the board .We already knew what we wanted. I ordered the Chicken Fried Steak and my sister ordered the Chicken n Mac. He didn’t ask us what we wanted to drink. I ordered 2 orange juices. I handed him my CC he rang us up and said Nothing else. Like seat your self anywhere you can find a spot, didn’t give me a Number for the order I had to ask everything it was like pulling teeth. The other staff gave No greeting or Smile whatever. I went back to the guy and asked how will we know when our food is ready? He slid a Number over. We found a spot to sit. Our food came quickly the girl who brought it just put on the table no smile, no eye contact , saying only what was necessary, “do you need anything else?” I said Eating Utensils would be Helpful. She got them and quickly left. The presentation of the 2 dishes were nice. My sister was not impressed with the Chicken n Mac Waffles and it came with a tiny plastic container with a lid like take out with approx 2 tablespoons of maple syrup definitely not enough for the dish. No one came back to see if we needed anything else. As I dug into my chicken fried steak Uncuttable with the table knife that they left me. It was also un chewable. I had to hate to say it spit most of it out into a napkin it came with.with Overcooked Poached eggs on top some sort of sauce and overcooked biscuits And under the biscuits were like homemade fried potatoes. After drinking my tiny glass of orange juice, I was very thirsty so I decided to get up and ask if they had ice water the same man that took our order pointed at something on the bar that held water and says yeah it’s a self-serve water and there’s a plastic cups so that was that and I also had to get up and get my own Tabasco and salt and pepper for the table . Definitely wouldn’t go back way overrated by the Hollywood chef unless maybe the Henderson location is better. Also the food was over salty so I didn’t need the salt after all. I certainly hate giving bad reviews especially dropping $55 on this meal for the two dishes . Oh and I almost forgot I went back up to the counter because I saw somebody had those wonderful looking french fries and tried to order a side and I was told you’re not able to order side dishes.
I should’ve gone to Chinatown and tried the dim sum. That was my second dining choice.
I was so hoping to love this place since it’s only 2 miles from my residence. I’m wondering if the owner chef knows about the food there and the attitude or lack of personality and friendliness of the staff there it definitely all around left a bad taste in my mouth.. Thank you for taking the time to read. I sure hope your experience is better than mine. Have a blessed and prosperous 2026.!

Dark and intimate area in downtown Las Vegas if you’re looking to grab a drink. The area is spacious inside and outside depending on the vibe you;re going for.

The main thing to try here is  their 24 hour jerk chicken. It may be a little pricey and you only get 4 pieces of chicken, but it is really packed with flavor and worth a try at least once.

When we came here, there was only one person at the bar but we also came here a little before the night started. The service was pretty easy even with little staff, but they eventually started to have more bartenders once the night kept going.

Parking is similar to any downtown area where you kind of just have to find place around the area.
Cool spot in Vegas Art District. Tasty food n drinks, cool bartender, chill spot across the board. Break away from the strip, visit LV Art District, and enjoy the goodness. One love brah!

I’ve been here a couple of times and will continue to visit when I’m in Vegas. It’s just affordable, chill, and delicious. I love the food. The drinks are expertly made. The Mai Tai is something I get every time because it’s that good. I highly recommend it if you want a chill place off the strip!

Would not attend again. Food 3 as it was good but not worth the wait times. Husband and I were stopping for a snack during first Friday. We stopped here as it was open and close and had very few people they were serving. Probably 4 tables outside all night. Even on a slow night, they were lacking in the service department. The blonde girl in charge of our table seemed really passive aggressively rude and inattentive . She only took our first drink order, the manager took an order for us, even though the courtyard was empty and this lady was no where to be seen. We got a 2nd waitress and she was more helpful but the waits on food and drink were still Unbearably slow. To the point we canceled our last food order because it was taking too long. Even with 3 waitresses circling around our table.

When we finally said we don’t want the sandwich anymore and we don’t want to pay for it, they insisted on packing it for us as it had come out last second. The initial waitresses response to our disappointment and declaration of not wanting the food and not wanting it on our bill was “aaaaaahhh buuuummmmmmeeeeerr you guys were so fun. I hope it wasn’t meeeeeeee” (it was) we spent 3 hours there with terrible service as we couldn’t get the bill fast enough. They charged us for the packed sandwich we said twice we didn’t want to be billed for as it took too long.

Our intention was the explore the first Friday festivities. By the time they got us the check, it was 11pm and everything was stopping festivities wise. The service here really ruined our night and timing for the evening and landed us stuck in this bar that we were hardly being attended to. The band was nice. The vibes were okay, but that waitresses demeanor put me off and the general lack of management for the staff was apparent. I shouldn’t have to beg my waitress for attention or beg for my tab or turn down food because it did not come out in an appropriate time. I shouldn’t have to wait 30+ minutes for a sandwich. Terrible experience. We had absolutely no justification to tip the staff as it was disappointing and they had 3 whole hours to make it right. I would not repeat

The jerk wings were very tasty but didn’t feel like a great value since you only get four whole wings. The cubano sandwich was good, nothing crazy.

The jammy coloda was the best drink we had in Vegas, had almost a nuttiness to it that made it super tasty and crushable.

This place is dangerously unsafe.

On 1/3/2026, my husband was brutally attacked with a gun—not for starting trouble, but for simply saying, “Please don’t touch my wife.” That single sentence nearly cost him his life.

Somehow, this club allows people to walk in openly carrying firearms. The man who attacked my husband had a visible holster. Nothing hidden. Nothing subtle. And yet, security did nothing—until it was too late.

My husband had to board an airplane with three puncture wounds to his head and stitches in his eye, traumatized and injured, because this establishment failed at the most basic level: keeping people alive.

Yes, we are pressing charges. But my first issue is this club itself.

We paid for bottle service that we never received, but instead of service, we received violence. Instead of a night out, we got terror. One wrong move—one second longer—and someone could have been killed. All of us could have lost our lives.

I do not recommend this place to anyone.
This is not a club.
It’s a liability.
A nightmare.
And a tragedy waiting to happen.

Imagine going out for a drink and leaving in fear for your life.

That was our experience.

I dont know what happen to this place 2022 and 2023 it was very classy up scale and now it's just ratched. No real dress code, bottle service sucks and is expensive for no reason. I just saw the review about the man being attacked. Not hard to believe, there are always crowds in the parking lot drinking to avoid paying for the drinks inside. Such a sketchy crowd we wont me returning. Black establishments do better

Absolutely horrible!!!!  Traveled a long distance to support black businesses to find everything on the website is a LIE!!!  Do not waste your time. 4 menu options, freezing and the excuse was the chef left. To think its acceptable to mislead people is crazy.  The fact that it has been weeks and they still havent updated their site lets is know what value they place on other black people. They don't care!!    Back to the strip I go😒😞

As a fellow small business owner, I truly dislike leaving negative reviews about other small businesses, but this was one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve had in a very long time.

I booked a reservation for 15 guests for a surprise party for my husband. We had family flying in from all over, and with most of us being small business owners, we were very intentional about supporting Black-owned businesses during our trip. I had discovered this place on social media and was impressed by the 30–40 menu items pictured on their website, along with their advertised happy hour (30% off until 9pm).

I received a confirmation for our 7:30pm reservation in a private VIP room. However, when we arrived, the bartender looked shocked to see us. The owner eventually came out and told us to “sit anywhere.” When I reminded him of our reservation for the private room, he walked us to a dark back space and had to wake up a sleeping security guard from one of the booths before turning on the lights. It was clear they were not expecting us.

When we scanned the menu, it was completely different from what we saw online—only about 6 items were available. The owner explained that they had recently changed chefs but hadn’t updated the menu yet. At this point, we considered leaving, but finding last-minute seating for 15 people would have been nearly impossible.

Service was painfully slow. It took about 30 minutes for drinks and nearly an hour for food, which arrived cold. Most dishes had to be sent back. The only highlight was the loaded potato, which tasted good but was served lukewarm.

We expressed our concerns to the owner, and while he did send over a $10 complimentary bottle of champagne and discounted our meals at happy hour pricing, it felt like too little, too late. The pricing also didn’t match what was advertised online.

All night I found myself apologizing to our guests. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this establishment in good faith. While there may be potential, the lack of transparency, poor planning, and overall execution made for a very disappointing experience.

I went here on a Wednesday night to have a few drinks before heading home. The bar area was pretty full so we were told we could sit anywhere. Other than the bar area it was pretty empty. When we walk in I was told the drink deals. The atmosphere was cool very laid back good music. The service was fine our service was nice. My issue comes it at how over priced everything was. We ordered tequila lemon drops basically with Don Julio for the first round and  the second round they were out of Don Julio so they gave us another top shelf liquor. The drinks came out in a Solo Clear Plastic Squat Cup Couldn’t have been no more 8 oz and a mixed drink. I’m thinking they’ll be about $10-$12 a piece at max because they were so tiny. Mine you it’s only two of us. I went on the website and looked at the menu and decided to get wings to go. I thought $15 for six wings and fries was a little over priced But OK the pictures looks so good I wanted to try and decided to give it a shot. I assumed the bill would be about $65-$75 for four mixed drinks, six wings and fries. lol boy was I wrong $80 bucks for 4 mixed drinks in a small plastic cup not even glass?? Smh the the wings were $21 bucks not the $15 listed on their website smh. Can’t lie the food was good but way over priced. I did not complain, I paid my bill plus tipped but I’m sorry I will never be back or recommend. I’m a local and that’s just insane. And to add insult to entry, I asked for ranch with my wings only to find out when I got home they game me blue cheese lol Salty.

name: Mott 32 Las Vegas
vicinity: 3325 S Las Vegas Blvd #206, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
I had a really good experience at the Mott32 in Vancouver so I made a dinner reservation to try this location in Vegas. I would describe Mott32 as upscale Chinese.

They’re known for the Roasted Peking Duck which you need to reserve in advance by email and then will take 40min to prepare to be brought to your tableside to be carved. One Duck is about 16 portions and comes with the classic wrap, sauces, onions.

The duck was truly very good. The skin was incredibly crispy. The meat was juicy. It was cooked perfectly enough for a lot of the duck fat to be rendered and so didn’t taste overly greasy or chewy, like most Chinese ducks.

The cocktails were good as well. The matcha one was my favorite. We also ordered a few other food dishes which were just okay, nothing special. I thought the dim sum in Mott32 Vancouver is better in comparison.

With every order of duck you also have the option of using the leftover scraps of the carved duck and turning it into a second dish such as a soup or fried rice. They make it seem like the second duck dish would be made with your leftover duck meat but in reality there is hardly any actual duck leftover. Our table had two whole ducks and barely any duck in our duck fried rice.

As for the ambiance - very moody, luxurious and classy, definitely a nice date option for Vegas. Service was just okay.

Really enjoyed my meal here. Service was attentive but not over the top. To eat we had the iberico pork dumplings, preordered the bbq iberico pork, green beans, general tso’s chicken. (The general tso’s chicken is uniquely prepared with a funnel cake like batter!)
The pace they brought everything out was also great. I really enjoyed the autumn bloom gin based cocktail with the pebble ice

such a beautiful place with beautiful service and even better food. We were first greeted by the receptionist, my partner and I were celebrating our anniversary and they surely took note of that. We checked in with Jana and she was very nice and made sure to check that we were celebrating an event and although she noted we would have to wait awhile the wait was not long at all. We were then greeted to the table by Kezlie and she had set us up with utensils and towels on our laps, and later we were checked on by Alexis, all of which were all so welcoming, comforting, and surely catered to us. We had Mike and we were fairly new to the establishment, but he had recommended such good dishes and the service was exceptional. We will definitely be back to try more, so so yummy and we had such an amazing anniversary.

TLDR; I went here for brunch and the food was absolutely delicious but the service was abysmal. This is my 2nd visit to a Mott 32 - I went to the one in Vancouver BC, where the food was also outstanding. The hot and sour XLB are AMAZING and unique. The har gow were delicate and super fresh. We also had the duck spring rolls and the bean curd rolls, both of which were quite tasty.

However, the service was abysmal from the moment we entered. The restaurant was quite empty when we arrived and the hostess was on the phone with someone. She didn’t even acknowledge us and we stood there for at least 2 minutes until someone else came by and seated us. Ordering went fine. We ordered tea, and while I was pouring it the handle broke off on my hand. Luckily, it broke while the teapot was very close to the table and it didn’t spill - I can only imagine what that would’ve been like spilled in a lap. The staff apologized but no other compensation for a pretty dangerous equipment failure. We asked for chili oil when our food was served, and it took 10 minutes to come out. We obviously had eaten all our food by then since since we didn’t want it to get cold. We ordered one more dish and were able to use it then. However, as they were clearing the dishes from the first round, the server took my little plate because it had some soy sauce on it, telling me he would get me a fresh one. But he never did, and neither did the guy who dropped off our last order. And, our primary server seemed to comically be avoiding looking at any of her tables. So I had to eat my last dish WITHOUT A PLATE.

The Mott 32 in Vancouver had impeccable service - this one was ridiculously terrible and we tipped accordingly. The restaurant was NOT busy; the staff were just incredibly inattentive and inefficient.

Mott32 at the Venetian - An Unforgettable Night!
I’ve enjoyed great meals before, but this dinner truly took things to the next level — not only because the food was absolutely decadent (seriously, each bite eclipsed the last), but also because the experience itself was extraordinary. As Chief of Staff, I coordinated an executive dinner for a party of 25. At the end of the night, we all agreed this was not a regular dinner. It was an experience. I highly recommend trying the wagyu beef short ribs, the Signature Peking Duck, and the crispy sea bass. It was a night to remember.
From the moment we stepped through the door, the staff made us feel thoroughly looked after. Everyone was warm, attentive, and right on the ball — but our Maître d’ Isa was the real star of the show. She struck just the right balance of being knowledgeable, friendly, and incredibly intuitive. It was like she could read our minds before we even said anything. She made us feel genuinely welcome without ever coming across as overbearing — just smooth, thoughtful service from start to finish. The whole evening had that rare vibe where everything just falls into place — the food, the atmosphere, the company. It didn’t feel like just a regular dinner out; it felt like something special. I can’t wait to go back.

name: Mr D's Sports Bar and Grill

reviews.text: Been coming here for years.  This place always has a great crowd and awesome service from the bartenders and waitresses.  Another great thing about this place is the Taco Tuesday Car Show. Come have some tacos, tall cold beers and watch a Knight’s game while people checkout your rides.   Also may win some money on the machines at bar.

Excellent local bar! I can't say enough about the beautiful bartenders and wait staff. Everyone is friendly and efficient. The food is quite good, too. Breakfasts are hearty. Burgers and sandwiches are good, and the Mexican menu is great. Bike night and car night are really fun.

19 TVs, inside and out with heated patios. The place to be for Dallas Cowboys and Golden Knights games!

Just an all-around fun place to go.

We went here on a recommendation from a friend that they have 15-dollar steaks on Thursday nights after 5:00 p.m. tonight's special was ribeye, where sometimes it's also either porterhouse or T-Bone. Of the three, one was undercooked, one was overcooked and one was properly cooked. All three were extremely large commercial grade meat, plenty of fat and gristle. But, at least two-thirds of the meat was edible, and pretty good. Served by a scantily dressed server with yellow corn and a baked potato with sour cream and butter on the side.
