Service was a bit spotty, at best. Probably because we didn't order any alcohol. The place is dimly lit, and smells like cigarette smoke. Lots of TVs showing lots of sports and things all over the place. There was only one low table to sit at, the rest are all high top tables. Good classic rock music playing. Some gaming was available at the bar.

Haven’t been inside but just by  passing by there, there are Nice rides where you can tell what kind of crowd it is 😎
Captured this 7/29/25
Absolutely the best bar we have been to in over 20 years!!!!! Food was amazing,  drinks incredible and bartender Rin was the BEST!!! OUR NEW GO TO BAR!!!!!!!!
First of all the appetizers were so good it didn’t make my photo roll. The fresh hot pita bread was delicious with the eggplant spread. And the food just tasted so homey.

How have I lived in Vegas all these years and never been here. The food is amazing. The service was friendly and fantastic. I loved the grocery store attachment. I was able to find all the spices and seasonings I use to cook in larger quantities with more affordable prices than Amazon or Walmart. Absolute hidden gem!

I had an amazing experience at Zaytoon Restaurant, and it truly exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and comfortable, making it the perfect place to enjoy a great meal.
The food was absolutely outstanding—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. Every dish was full of rich taste and high quality ingredients, and you can really tell that a lot of care goes into the cooking. It was hands down some of the best food I’ve had.
The service was just as impressive. The staff was friendly, attentive, and professional, always making sure everything was perfect without being overbearing. They made us feel genuinely valued as guests.
10/10 the koobidehs taste like they do in Tehran, can’t get much closer than this. Beats every kabob shop in LA, phenomenal food and service. Nice stuff Zaytoon!

Get ready to immerse yourself in an unforgettable event that you won’t want to miss! It’s a unique experience like no other, packed with excitement and extraordinary moments that will leave you amazed. No need to rush—just come and enjoy every delightful moment!

name: Mother Wolf Las Vegas
vicinity: 2777 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Every time I come to Fontainebleau, this is an absolute must-visit.
Hands down one of the best Italian restaurants in Las Vegas.

The service is outstanding, and the food is exceptional without ever feeling overpriced. You can truly taste the freshness of every single ingredient, and the pasta feels like it’s made with real craftsmanship and care. Each dish reflects true Italian soul and attention to detail.

Michelle took care of our table during a family reunion, and her passion and energy made the experience even more memorable. She went above and beyond, and her service genuinely stood out.

If you’re looking for a place to experience high-quality Italian cuisine in Vegas, Mother Wolf is a must. Highly recommended.

On our last night's stay at the Fontainebleau we were looking for somewhere special to celebrate, and we picked Mother Wolf. This place did not disappoint one bit. The elegant ambiance matched the caliber of the food. From our table, we fascinatingly watched the action in the kitchen.
As for our dinner, we started with the sfincione (focaccia bread), which we quickly polished off. For our main courses, we split the margarita pizza and the short rib pasta. The pizza was nice and thin and crispy, which we loved.
The short rib ragu pasta simply melted in your mouth. And we finished off our already amazing dinner with the tiramisu for dessert, which is made in house and honestly was one of the best tiramisus I've had in a long time.

Our waitress, Michelle, was a rockstar: from her helpful menu suggestions to always keeping watch on our table. She also brought out a second complimentary dessert to help us celebrate. The blueberry and bergamot ice cream with the adorable bow tie cookie on top made our celebration that more special. Needless to say, we're already planning our next Vegas trip and another unforgettable dinner at Mother Wolf.

Blown away, Mike drop (Boom!!)

I am no food critique, but I've eaten my fair share of Italian dishes to say .. Mother Wolf foods, drinks and service is another level ... scrumptious, delicious, exquisite, I dunno. Just go try it, I mean I highly recommend to give it a try. It's located inside the Fountain Bleu .. you can get valet parked and validated at the restaurant.

Okay I had their linguine pasta, and the Finnochi salad .. incredible. The cocktail drink was delish. And dessert and coffee phenomenal.
I am so going back next time I'm in Vegas.

Highly recommend to book ahead of time. :)

Squash blossoms seemed like the recommended item, but I was let down. The price point was high for something that is extremely cheap to produce. I felt the way they were fried canceled out the delicate nature of the blossom, and also needed a flaky salt topping because it tasted of pure neutral oil. The filing, while yes ricotta, was bland. The prawns were one of the best things I ordered!! I also got the short rib pasta but it GENUINELY tasted identical to Chef Boyardee, not in a good way. I was having ratatouille style flash backs to the 90’s. It needed some acids or something to elevate it. Lemon sorbet was delicious, 10/10. The salt and olive oil drizzle hit. Service was attentive, shoutout Passion!

Mother Wolf Las Vegas: A Home Run for Italian Comfort.

Mother Wolf in Las Vegas delivers a fantastic dining experience that combines a great atmosphere with truly satisfying Italian food. If you're looking for pasta that feels straight out of an Italian home kitchen, this is the place.

The Food: Straight-Up Delicious Comfort
The rigatoni is exactly what you want it to be: straight Italian home comfort food. It's rich, authentic, and deeply satisfying—a must-try for any pasta lover. We also tried the Arrabbiata, which was delicious, featuring just the right amount of heat—it was a tiny bit spicy and perfectly balanced. Paired with a couple of great drinks, the meal was absolutely spot-on.

The Service: Spectacular Robert
What truly elevated our experience was the service, especially our server, Robert. He was spectacular—attentive, knowledgeable, and ensured everything was perfect from start to finish. Exceptional service like this makes a huge difference.

In Short: Mother Wolf is a great choice for authentic, deeply comforting Italian cuisine in Las Vegas. Go for the rigatoni, enjoy a perfectly spiced Arrabiata, and hope you get Robert as your server!

QUESTIONABLE 3% CARD SURCHARGE

I had a disappointing experience when paying my bill. My total came to $86, and when I used my card, I was told there would be a 3% charge for not paying in cash. However, the amount added was $3, bringing my total to $89, which is more than 3% of $86.

When I asked for clarification, the staff said it was a new policy implemented about two weeks ago, but they weren’t able to explain what the 3% charge was actually for. This fee was not a tip, and it was not clearly explained or accurately calculated.

I understand businesses adding card fees, but they should be transparent, correctly calculated, and clearly communicated to customers. Unfortunately, that wasn’t the case here.

Really wonder why this place has such bad reviews. We had a great experience, food was very good, authentic and came out quick and hot. We were in and out in about 45 minutes, which food only took 10/15 minutes to come. Everything was GOOD! Waiters were polite too, one had a bit of a better attitude than the other, but still very nice service. Pupusas are so good here, 10/10, and everything we tried was good as well.

Bahía Centroamerica Restaurant

In the middle of a strip mall, this place sits quietly. My wife and I were greeted and told we could sit anywhere. The staff was very friendly and accommodating.

On the wall behind me was a saying. It’s in Spanish but translated: “We do not serve fast food, we serve fresh food as fast as we can.”
The food, as advertised, wasn’t fast, but it was quite worth the wait. I had a pupusa with asada, something I have never seen anywhere else. I also had the Churrasco Salvadoreño, which is steak with a cabbage slaw, casamiento (beans & rice), chorizo, and fried plantains. The pupusas were freshly made and hot. The steak was well seasoned and went well with the rest of the flavors on my plate, especially the cheese.

My wife had a pupusa revuelta, a pupusa with cheese, black beans, and loroco, and a baleada. My wife loved everything!

The only downside to the whole night was that, once our food was brought to the table, they didn’t check up on us for refills. All in all, the staff was great! We will definitely be returning.
Went when they first opened,  looks like they have live bands at night, good food.

Pupusas were good, Service was slow and at times it felt that i had to beg just to get the servers attention; Also i never received the Flan that i was charged for, Lastly i understand this is a bar/karaoke vibe but the music is so loud it makes it difficult to effectively communicate with your waiter.

The jollof rice was kind of basic to me it was literally rice with some okay seasoning. Im used to more veggies and things mixed in my jollof rice, the oxtail and the goat combo was literally so small. 2 pieces of goat and only one oxtail In some sort of unique, almost tomatoey tasting  sauce  over it, not horrible but not what I’m used too, I like gravy. The rice and peas didn’t seem to  have many peas at all, but it tasted okay. It’s not the most terrible meal, but it’s overpriced for its portion, and doesn’t taste like the best  Caribbean food I’ve had in the city in my honest opinion. There’s other places you can go for the same price that are way more flavorful with bigger portions to be for real.

Extremely poor customer service. The light skin waiter lacks professionalism. While taking orders, he sat down which was sooooo unprofessional. Menu does not have pictures to help those who are not familiar with african food. I ordered Egussi with oxtail  and a side of plantain. The food was very good, love it. But portions are RIDICULOUSLY small. Management( if there is any) should do something about it and give their waiters a better training. If you can overlook details, you'll be fine. If you can't, please go somewhere else.
I’ve been here a few times and my favorite is the Egusi soup with chicken (spicy) with fufu. My friends had the same and oxtail, which they said was really good.

if you're looking for the most unique Caribbean-African experience, THIS IS YOUR NEW FAVORITE SPOT! delicious food, super cocktails, great music and dope vibes from the coolest owner (Miss Roseline, you're the GOAT!). I moved here recently and discovered King-N-Queens by accident but I recommend it without the slightest hesitation..

Don't eat any food here, no seasoning, high price, low quality. My friend is being polite to take her wings home. Ask for at least half of the money from the awful food and the want me to order something else from the menu. Gotta be kidding me, never again. Y'all go to another hookah spot with good food, people that actually show up.

Today talked to my credit union, the scammers added an additional 8.00 on my bill. I will be reporting the to BBB and Clark county food administration

Y'all just go to Cork n Thorne or Classic jewel. Better everything.

This beautiful plate fed 9 adults. It had a lot of flavors! We were all complementing the food as we were eating it 😄 Matter of fact we are going to order it again, and this time for a bigger group of people! Pearl was very accommodating, kind and her customer service was amazing. You guys will not be disappointed! I talk about this restaurant to anyone looking for amazing African food!
Thank you for making our birthday wonderful, I will contact you again in a few for my bigger order!

PS: Their Cassava Leaf with rice and fried plantains dish is AMAZING too! I order it all the time!! 😋

I was extremely excited to find an African food restaurant in Vegas only to be disappointed by the amount of food that was given after a 30 minute drive. This pix was taken b4 i ate any. My daughter and I buy Egusi at an authentic African restaurant in LA CA and it is superb and they give you your monies worth.  It is in a tall and  wide container for the same amount that I paid here for I was still hungry and I'm not a big girl. Idk if these people are getting over because it's Vegas or what but this is a rip off. It was not nasty but definitely didn't experience all the different spices and flavors that I know it should have.
Very delicious egusi soup ordered on door dash today and tried this for the first time and was very happy with it. Yummy yummy yummy 😋 so glad to see African food on door dash!

Amazingly delicious food! The fish was juicy and not oily. The seasoning on it superb! The sides were just as tasty! The chicken wings were flavorful and goodly sized! The Fufu was Huge! Soup with meat super tasty! Kudos to the chef! We will be back! Thank you for bringing such a delight to the neighborhood!

Afro fusion in Las Vegas the Summerlin area is now a must see and TASTE  hotspot.

I have now had my second wonderful, flavorful dining experience in this unique family owned authentic dining establishment.

I started out my first meal with Jollof Rice a famous traditional west African dish. As soon as I ate it I knew I had to come back and try other taste sensations.

Everything about these items I tried were unique and I feel like I’ve been missing a whole part of the food spectrum until now.

On my second visit I had the Palm Butter / Banga,
a yucca dough that you dip into spicy peanut sauce utterly unique flavor. I will have to have this dish several times more but I will try something different the next time.

Everything was made fresh in the kitchen while I waited and cooked to perfection.

If you’re a restaurant guy like I am you’re crazy if you don’t try this place.
The food is amazing. Real African food. The Chef is really awesome. I definitely recommend this place. If want to eat great food or enjoy a night out in town this is  the place.
The best place for great food and entertainment. The staff is friendly and the environment is clean.
Good food and superb entertainment spot...

name: House of Dutch Pot Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Amazing find outside of the strip. This is a must go to spot if you want to try Jamaican food. Tried their combo meals of Oxtail and Jerk chicken and then Salmon and Coconut Shrimp. Both were good but I gotta give the best one to the Oxtail as it was very tender and their original sauces were really good.

We also ordered desserts: Bread pudding, carrot cake and cheesecake. We love everything especially the cheesecake.

Kudos to Chef O and Ashley who was an amazing waiter for us.

Found this place on Yelp and decided to try it out. We were greeted when we walked in and seated right away. We did put a reservation in before coming but it wasn't needed as the place was empty of dine in guests but had a steady take out service. We wanted to order the Red Stripe chicken wings but were told they were not available. So we got regular chicken wings and a jerk sauce. They were well cooked but lacked flavor. I ordered the Jerk Chicken and Jerk Shrimp with festival and a side salad. The main was super tender and very flavorful. The side salad, well, was horrible. The menu said it was to have a mango vinaigrette but it was served with ranch. My first time having festival and it was great. My friend had jerk chicken and jerk oxtail, also well cooked and flavored. He had garlic mashed potatoes. Just average missing the garlic flavor. He also had Mac and cheese which was really good. Over all a few misses but the meal was good. The biggest drawback was the competing music. Caribbean music in the dining area and Whitney Houston blaring in the kitchen area.  Also, these are fine dining prices and a casual restaurant. 128.00 for 2 people.

Open from 10:00am daily House of Dutch Pot lies tucked away in an area of failed concepts on Durango, the "first Jamaican Caribbean Authentic Restaurant" featured on Diner's, Dine-Ins and Dives making a go of it with friendly service and hearty Caribbean plates.

Helmed by St. Thomas native Chef Oniel Smith, the former occupants remembered only by circular lighting and blinged-out banquettes, House of Dutch Pot submerges guests in a sea of blue while music plays at medium volume over TVs showing sports.

Known as “Chef O,” his passion for Jamaican cooking evident across a menu that veers from tradition plates like Jerk Chicken to Mac & Cheese Oxtail Eggrolls, prices may look steep until one realizes most plates come with two sides beyond shareable portions.

Spread across starters including Coconut Shrimp and Tacos, six Cod Fritters for $15 more like Hushpuppies than Baccala, Food arrives quick whether one selects tender bone-in Goat Curry or one of several combos such as the $40 Oxtail and Jerk Chicken with their own complex Sauces.

Selling Seasoning on-site, the Jerk appropriately punchy with lingering heat, Seasoned Fries prove fairly basic in comparison to aromatic Rice, stretch handmade Roti or “Festival Bread” best compared to a Churro or Fritter more lightly sweetened with hints of Coconut.

Open from 10am daily, the space’s small footprint about 1/3 full for lunch on Sunday, Desserts should not be skipped as both Rum Bread Pudding and Carrot Cake arrive piping hot beneath stewed Fruit steeped in booze.
This place is beyond words! The food was infused with so much flavor that I've never experienced! I ordered the Ox tail and curry goat, with ox tail fried rice, which was to die for!!!

Katie was very kind and attentive! I told her it was my husband's bday and at the end of our lunch, she brought out a pineapple carrot cake and it was DELICIOUS! Oxtail and Jerk pasta were super flavorful and my Father said the Oxtail tacos are his go to meal now! Honestly, everything had so much flavor and spice, it was a great experience. Chef's kiss! Thank you all at House of Dutch Pot! We will be back!

name: Caribbean Flavorzzz LLC
vicinity: 333 W St Louis Ave, Las Vegas

reviews.text: This food ain’t it ! They put in more effort with the food that they plan to show on Instagram. Me and my folks got three dinners and none of our food looks like what they post. I got jerk chicken, rice and peas and the LoFredo Pasta. The lofredo pasta was dry as hell and too spicy lol I was expecting some type of creamy cheese sauce with Jamaican spices. We also ordered a fish dinner with cabbage,  Mac and cheese and was given greens instead of the cabbage which was too spicy and the Mac and cheese looked nothing like what was on IG, it looked like noodles with a little cheese and wasn’t good... I don’t recommend

Yesterday I placed an order for two dinners —one for oxtails and the other for catfish. Unfortunately, my experience was disappointing. First, I waited over an hour before receiving a call from them  letting me know that rice and peas were no longer available. While I appreciate being offered a substitute, I wish I had been informed sooner. After waiting so long, I ended up choosing a side I didn’t really want. Regarding my second order, it arrived with only one piece of fish instead of the full portion. Although the fish itself tasted fine, the yams were extremely dark and burnt, to the point that I couldn’t finish them. The Mac n cheese has not been good at all the last few times I had it.
I was genuinely looking forward to enjoying my meal, especially after such a long wait. Instead, I received incomplete orders, missing items, and poor-quality sides.

First off our food looked NOTHING like what we seen on instagram curry chicken had no potatoes and carrots …then the service was mid…the extra wait times were WILD we got our food a good 30-40 mins after they said we would…the food tasted like they just put jerk seasoning on everything …maybe that’s the point idk. I legit took a couple bites and tossed it and we spent a good $60. Maybe it was a bad day but I won’t be back to find out .

I ordered online.. they called and told me about 3 items they ran out of. I pull up.. they tell me more items they ran out of. Waited an extra 30 minutes. Finally make it home 🗑️ chicken soggy. “Lemon pepper Jack wings”.. taste burnt and can’t taste any lemon pepper.

Put my order in at 7:30 my order wasn't ready til 9:28pm after it said it would be ready between 8:10pm-8:20pm and I was the only order waiting for this restaurant got to a point where the guy at the front said there back there playing with your food and I was waiting with my two young boys waited years to try this place will be the last the food was hot hot that's about it

name: Lucky 3 Food Co
vicinity: 333 W St Louis Ave, Las Vegas

reviews.text: We got pizza & a cheese steak. Everything was wonderful. The owner came out and greeted us. He was so nice. Definitely recommend this new business to anyone looking for something quick and affordable!!!
Araujos Plant Powered has the best Vegan Tacos and Empanadas I've ever had. The best in Las Vegas Hands Down!!! Highly recommend

Even if food is excellent across several restaurants, having walk-in customers wait for 1h+ without ANY updates on order and conflicting messages from the various kiosks in restaurant is absolutely absurd. No humans to interact with and people seem to actively avoid customer interaction. If you order from here, steer far clear of ordering from kiosks in store.

The fries were just okay for the price. Had better for same price. Little meat and it wasn't even flavorful. If anything it felt like the put the meat on the grill to warm it up and that's it. Wouldn't come again.

I visited the Lucky 3 Food. To pick up
Am order from one there cloud kitchen client: Thai Asian Treat. This spot offers a Thai infusion, the flavors are remarkably done great, the beef sate was so yummy with the Teppanyaki style noodles and the green curry, & green curry fried rice was so good. I am definitely coming back to try more dishes. The lady who handed me my hood was so nice and appreciative, this Thai spot shouldn’t be passed up.

If your in the mood for some yummy authentic cuban food. I HIGHLY recommend habanos cafe. They were sweet, quick and decently prices for Goood food. Check them out and let me know how you like it.  👍🏻

Best Cuban pizzas i've ever had. Friendly attentive staff. Food came out quick. Clean placeMusic was good.Not too loud. Didn't have to wait even if they were busy. There's plenty of open parking. The dishes were delicious.  Their pepperoni and Hawaiian pizzas are the best you'll ever have.  I also had these mozzarella stick like things that were pretty good too.   Would definitely recommend it here.   Will be a return customer for sure

If you don’t speak Cuban, you might have a tough time going here. They are definitely here for their people and there’s nothing wrong with that. The food is all right. Service was great good people. The only reason for the three star is their piece is not cooked all the way through the top of it still raw. I don’t mind dip deep dish, pizza. They got a good crust on the outside, but when you go to take a bite and half of it is still gummy and raw hard for me to give a good review for that. I’m sure their other food is better. good portion size easy to get in and out of. I don’t wanna throw too much hate because they seem like a good restaurant should’ve ordered the small. Maybe it wouldn’t be halfway doughy

BEST PAELLA IVE EVER HAD! We come from Phoenix 5-6 times a year and every time we have to come eat here!!! Everything is 🔥🔥🔥 Empanadas are delicious too… Everything is!
I even uber eats when I fly in! Got to have it!
My wife is Cubana and I told her if she wants to be with me forever… She needs to learn how to make this dish!😂🤣😂🤣😎👊
Very good cuban food and nice place to eat by your self or with the family

Last year my boyfriend and  I pulled up to try their food after seeing it said open on Google maps. When we arrived, to our surprise it was closed. We were disappointed but this year we called ahead to verify they were open. I only mention this because if you’re an out of towner; you may wanna call to verify if they’re open before driving 20-30 minutes.

Upon entering you’re greeted warmly by the cashier. We ordered the soul food 3 fish piece meal. The only reason I rate it a 4/5 is because they didn’t have a side available an hour after opening. We wanted to try their yams but unfortunately they didn’t have any yet. They also didn’t have any desserts.

Our food took about 30 minutes or so to come out. You can tell they make to order! Our cat fish was perfectly seasoned. It also comes with their signature sauce that’s sweet / sour & spicy , delicious! It’s definitely a plate that can be shared between two as the serving sizes are generous. The cabbage was DELICIOUS, so soft and well seasoned. The Mac & cheese was simple but good.

The music playlist was fire! Super chill spot to enjoy your food.

Came here on a Saturday and the food is AMAZING! Very friendly and helpful with recommendations- the Arnold Palmer and the mixed Kool-Aid are must tries. Had the wings, fries and some shrimp- everything came out hot and perfect. This is definitely on my list for any trip to Vegas. Lots of parking but not a fast food place- the wait is reasonable and worth it!

I’m a midwestern probably spoiled by Chicago’s grand cuisines…The greens were okay. Macaroni and cheese was very average, nearing basic - to be considered soul food… the greatest dissatisfaction was the 4pc rib being fried… if I wanted a pork chop I would have went to find a pork chop. The batter was amazing though so the chicken is probably amazing. Tried them after Keith Lee’s review…

I felt welcomed as soon as we walked in! We didn’t wait for long to get our food $50 for 4 of us and right behind the strip! Fried fish, fries, shrimp po boy, pastrami po boy wonderful flavors and atmosphere. We will be back!

Came here Monday with my girlfriend and everything was phenomenal, got the catfish with the hot sauce and lemon pepper rub, with greens and mac and cheese. Everything was delicious, the hot sauce on the fish could’ve been covered a bit more, there were a couple of naked spots but the pieces are so big I can’t even blame them. Wait time wasn’t too long maybe like 15 minutes, and they even gave me and my girlfriend some complimentary waters while we were finishing up and were checking up on us consistently before that. Will be back for sure 100%.

name: Tasty Island Jamaican Restaurant
vicinity: 6820 W Flamingo Rd # H, Las Vegas

reviews.text: I’ve never actually been here but I have ordered several times even today and let me say the food is absolutely amazing I spend about $40 but it’s soooo worth it!!!! You guys will always be in business cause I love your food thanks for always being fresh and hot and flavorful thank you!

Being a Jamaican born and grown..... Cooking from age 10. I do not approve this food. The seasoning is wack. The pepper is overbearing. Jamaican food should be tasty not peppery like how you make it seem. You're supposed to taste the flavor, not be fighting to eat your food. I just wasted my money to be looking like I'm crying.

I ordered oxtails dinner and jerk chicken. When I got how the food was nasty and tasted old. I didn’t get the food. They have a sign saying no refund or exchange because they know they serving old nasty food. Please do not take your business to them. The oxtails is 28 something dollars and the portion was little baby size crazy.

Bless up the chef! This is a small authentic Jamaicans mom & pops shop. They give you that home cooked feeling. Made with love!
I’ve tried most if not all of their menu.
Best Curry chicken and Oxtails, both are  delicious and not spicy. Jerk chicken is spicy kick! They’re A bit Pricey but well worth it being for filled with heavy food. Great portions , enough leftovers for a snack later. Try the lunch special if available. Call in your orders as to restrictions prevent dinning.
Great Patties, my favorite is veggie patties. D&G KOLA champagne is always ice cold!
If the prices go any higher, I’ll probably have to cook it myself. Perhaps they did not like the service. I provide details photos of they’re most popular items. Bless up!
Keep in mind Some Ppl don’t have anything nice to say. I actually post the pictures or videos to help the next person have a greater experience.

We tried here before and had a good experience, but today was disappointing. I ordered a combination of jerk chicken and brown stew chicken, while my husband chose an oxtail and jerk chicken plus 2 patties. It was about $70.
Unfortunately, the rice tasted old and hard, and the brown stew chicken was overly salty. The jerk chicken had a stale flavor and smelled like leftover meat. The oxtail was also tough and seemed old.

We called the restaurant to express our concerns, and the owner spoke to my husband. He mentioned that they had cooked the food this morning, which worried me because it raised concerns about the quality of the chicken.

I cannot recommend this restaurant until the freshness of its food is improved.

So I have had the pleasure of enjoying authentic cuban food all my life till recently . While visiting numerous states across America 🇺🇸 I have had mainly one dish . Picadillo hamburger meat rice beans negro of course and plantains.   I can't say that I have enjoyed any of the places I have had food at  . So I will be honest the meat was salty about a cup of grease fat not drained from meat instead left in meat and sadly the plantains were soaked in it nasty . Rice was OK 👍 black beans watery and tearfully tasteless .  I grew up with Cubans and the food that I love .  I think what happened is that the ones who moved outside florida have lost the way . You see you can sell someone cubam food that truly hadn't tasted the authentic flavors started in a kitchen at home and they will eat it as great but no it's not authentic .

Came in on a Sunday morning eager to have some Cuban breakfast and was truly disappointed. I should have looked around for a different Cuban place. They didn’t have half the menu so I couldn’t get pan con bistec or ropa vieja sandwich. Settled for a breakfast sandwich ham, bacon, egg on a roll with fries. Nasty, the fries were cold the ham stunk literally the roll was cold and my cafe con leche wasn’t even good. They were already open for an hour and a half and nothing ready. 60 dollars gone to waste. Very disappointed.
This place is fantastic! Generous portions, great prices, and a super friendly staff. Don’t leave without trying the Cuban sandwich and a Cuban coffee—absolutely delicious! 😋

This place is a lifesaver. I stay close by during my week stay and I was traveling every day for 3+ hours. I needed a strong breakfast but not fast food. This was the best combinations of flavor product and availability. Food is fresh staff is helpful and cheerful and the food is as good as homemade. Next time in vegas I will give be there again.

Update: 11/29. Went back for the lechon. Much more tender, fresh. See photos. I’ve been here before a few times, but this is my first review. I’ve had the Lechon roasted pork, rice beans, and other side dishes but today I decided to have the roasted chicken which was not moist, but not too dry. I wouldn’t say it was my favorite meal. I would definitely go for the ground beef or the pork next time versus the chicken. The service is as friendly as it can be. I guess could be friendlier, but I don’t know. Maybe it’s a Cuban thing.

name: Carlito's Cuban Food
vicinity: 2680 S Maryland Pkwy B, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Eccepcional! Wow, today, two visits around my workout. Tamales, Chicken, and a Flan. Upon return, Guava Pastel (dessert) ... crazy delicious! Friendly, wonderful service. A must experience in Las Vegas. Pasteles hacen en Casa ♡
Was leaving town and had to catch a celebratory Pastel, knew I had to return ... Quatro Leche Pastel ... Fantastico! Git Over Here ... next time Camerones (Shrimp)!

I went for the ropa vieja, which is tender shredded beef stewed in savory olives and peppers then poured over a bed of yellow rice. It's absolute magic. Add in those sweet plantains and you’ve got a full-on flavor explosion.

- BEST Cuban food here in LAS.
- MUST try CUBA tamale 🫔, CUBAN pizza 🍕 , and CUBAN sandwich.
- Everything is well seasoned.
- They service BIG portions.
- Plenty of sweet treats like cake and flan to enjoy for dessert.
- They have all the common Cuban fav drinks like Jupiña.
- Tons of seating for a big group.
- It’s a choose your adventure plate which gives you a lot of control to choose what you want from the choices you can see through the glass.
- WORTH the stop.

The lady who took the order was rude and the tamales had almost NO meat, should've checked before leaving but a Cuban friend referred me here, super disappointed. Look how these fat tamales have hella masa and like 3 little pieces of meat in them for 3.50$ each this is a joke.

Everytime I go I try to get something different to enjoy all of their options. I love Saturday and Sunday for their oxtails, super tender and flavorful. Their cubano is very tasty with the plantain chips too. It's usually buy one get one, great deal. They offer a variety of desserts, full size cakes as well. They just opened a location on Rainbow and Oakey area so that's nice. Great food, great customer service, highly recommend.

When I looked up Jamaican food near me. This was it. Open late and serves Jamaican food. I'm in. Its a food truck downtown. The menu has traditionally items like jerk chicken and oxtail with a twist. Jerk chicken fries,oxtail fries, jersey chicken nachos, and oxtail nachos. I told my daughter to order some oxtail fries. She did and we waited. Eights minutes later, the gentleman taking the orders let us know they ran out of fries. But they would could do an oxtail nacho instead.  Never had anything so wow me with the fusion or give me Doritos Nacho Cheese chips with minced up oxtail that is sweet. My daughter's ate half and stopped. The older one asked me. Dad, sooo where are the nachos? I was taken back too,  the name is not right, cheese chips with oxtail is exactly what it is. However, is it oxtail or just shredded meat. No bone and sweeter than honey. Change the names for the nachos. Then give me the meat on the bone. My chips won't be as soggy and I'll know its oxtail. You start to get close to running out communication. In the moments after I said yes to the nachos. I thought nachos(a dish of tortilla chips topped with melted cheese and often also other savory toppings) this is the definition word for word. You have a audience that likes it that way. I see that and appreciate you. It just doesn't taste the same as traditional Jamaican with scotch bonnet, never sweet tasting.

They catered my wedding reception recently! The food was AWESOME, 10/10. Professional & great people, would highly recommend. All my guests couldn't stop stop talking about how good the Mac & cheese was
The short rib was the perfect texture: soft but not falling apart. Good balance of salt, fat, and acid. Green beans were not overcooked. Mac... might be nostalgic for someone else

If you’re looking for bold flavors and perfectly cooked comfort food, Midwest Jerk & Greens is a must-try! Their jerk chicken is packed with smoky, spicy goodness, perfectly balanced with just the right amount of heat. The greens? Absolutely delicious—tender, well-seasoned, and the perfect complement to any dish.

The portions are generous, the flavors are rich, and you can taste the love in every bite. Whether you’re a fan of Caribbean spice or just craving some good, hearty soul food, this truck delivers. The service is friendly, and the food is always fresh. Highly recommend!
Best oxtails in Vegas. Great portions and food has that cooked with love feel. Honestly never had anything I didn’t like. One of the best spots you can go to if you’re looking for great soul food.

name: Lazy Dog Restaurant & Bar
vicinity: 6509 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
We did not know about this restaurant however the experience was good.
We were celebrating a friend’s birthday and we decided to arrive a little earlier so we can have a taste of the bar and prepare a little set up.
The hostess were extremely understanding, helpful and polite which we were not expecting to be honest.
We found a nice table in the bar and the waiter she had full attention to her tables and to what was going on with us. So she quickly managed our order and we really enjoyed our break there. Their bar menú is pretty outstanding and also the spirits list is quite good. We had a Patron tequila and a Guinness beer while seeing the huge bar they have and the game.
We got our table before our friend arrived; it was a surprise dinner so we quickly arranged the table and the waiter in this area I must say was doing good enough, maybe the rush hour or else however the last meal served was the birthday girl and we did actually mentioned to her, a few times.
We were a party of eight so we understood that the order was affected somehow. However when we asked her she kinda snapped when asking.
Our food was good, the mashed potatoes and spinach were fantastic, the chicken a little dried and when getting our coffees to close the night.
Again, the hostess saved the experience and the waiter at the bar, their actions while being there made the whole experience better.
I will definitely suggest you to go and experience the food yourself, it is gooood!

We came in for a dinner date with my husband. We have been to Lazy Dogs before, but our first time to this location. This is a very large restaurant and there is a ton of seating. The atmosphere has a lively vibe, chatty, and energetic. If you are looking for a quiet dinner, this would not be the place for you. If you want a fun place, then definitely come here.
Our server was awesome and attentive to our needs and refills of drinks. The umami fries are the perfect appetizer to start off your meal, and I highly recommend them. I got the blackened shrimp tacos which were amazing!! I tried my husband’s ahi tuna meal and the tuna was perfectly served.
I would come here again when in town and always have a great experience at Lazy Dog restaurants.

First visit to Lazy Dog at Town Square, and it was a great lunch experience.

The vibe is relaxed and welcoming, with indoor and outdoor seating (and it’s pet-friendly, which is a fun bonus). Our server, Brock, took good care of us and brought out a tasty welcome snack of house-made chips and dip.

We ordered from the lunch specials — grilled cheese and tomato soup, a cheeseburger, wedge salad, wings, and the Korean bibimbap. Everything was fresh and flavorful, and the bibimbap was especially good with its savory-sweet balance.

Friendly service, good food, and an easygoing atmosphere — I’d definitely come back.

Delicious food! This place gives you your own water to keep pouring, which I absolutely love when places do that, service was quick and very friendly! The black and bleu burger was soo good, and the cajun fries were also amazing! Their house made ranch was also incredible! We will probably be back here soon!

Fun, casual, and very American in the best way. The service was fantastic—our waitress was friendly, attentive, and made the experience even better. The food portions were enormous (come hungry!), and everything felt generous and indulgent. A great spot if you’re craving big plates, good vibes, and warm service.

name: Island Deli and Smoothie Bar
vicinity: 1014 E Charleston Blvd STE 1014, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Ate here two days in a row during my trip to Las Vegas. Incredible food and prices. Fresh food. Very kind owner and I love the atmosphere of the restaurant.

And so the sandwich definitely doesn’t travel well but it was STACKED with chicken and tasted great.

I was recommended to visit by a friend! Staff was very friendly, portion size are amazing and the food taste was dreammyyy 10/10 would recommend. I got the loco moco panini and the island boy smoothie. They also gave me to try their orange passion fruit smoothie, any other yummy drink.

Island Deli & Smoothies
This place just feels good. The people here are so nice — you can tell they care about everyone who walks in. The food is fresh, the smoothies are great, and there’s just this calm, friendly vibe that makes you want to stay a little longer. Even the people who stop by seem easygoing and unassuming. It’s the kind of local spot that makes you appreciate small-town kindness.  Even in vegas

This is a great fast-casual with fresh food and great flavors. We had the teriyaki and jerk chicken plates: The teriyaki sauce was flavorful, and the chicken was tender. The jerk chicken is also tender, but quite spicy. The employee we encountered was really friendly. We would love to try the sandwiches next time.

The food was so delicious! We got the loco motors and the rueben. We went back a couple days later and tried to jerk chicken and the prime rib. The mint lemonade and the hibiscus tea were also refreshing. The service was good and welcoming. Highly recommend!

name: XoticEats Caribbean kitchen...online & pick-up orders only 🇹🇹
vicinity: Sierra Vista &, S Maryland Pkwy, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Amazing is a understatement!! He is the only one in kitchen !!! This is exactly what ive been looking for ! I ordered the oxtail with rice and peas with cabbage , fish , shrimp, wings and the Hennessy wings! All 10/10
So delicious! One of a kind taste will definitely order again

5 out of 5 Stars. Food was fresh and delicious. Presentation was top quality. Ordering process was easy. I was a little skeptical because maps pulled up a apartment building but this man knows how to cook! Definitely will be returning soon. Gained another customer! Thanks again

I met the cook Joseph, an amazing wonderful person who’s passionate about his food. Me and my friend ordered the Jamaican Jerk Chicken wings and oxtails and they were out of this world. The spice and flavor on the rice and veggies with the chicken was unbelievable. Cooked and amazingly wanted more and more. Thank you Joseph. Highly recommend.

This business has the best customer service in and across the strip. Mr. Joseph cares about his customers and even if the DoorDash driver messed up, Mr. Joseph made sure he took care of us and he absolutely is God sent. The food was 😍 amazing 🥰 like kicks your socks off good. Like y'all, I am not playing. This man's food makes these other spots taste like yesterday's stale food. Honestly, I don't have anything else to say other than it's phenomenal. The End!!!!!
Loved it in Hawaii so we were excited about being able to get some on our stop in Vegas.  It was great and appreciated they gave us extra of their yummy bbq sauce.  They need to sell the stuff!

Having lived in HI for 3 years, I can honestly say this branch is a perfect representation of the original Haleiwa Konos. Same awesome quality of food (notably the bombers), passionate staff, and a relaxing atmosphere. I was shocked to see the restaurant branched out to continental US and was even more shocked to enjoy their food like I regularly used to on island.
Got a pork plate and it was extremely overcooked & small portions, didn’t even look like pork anymore also I live 4 mins away and my plate was not warm i opened it as soon as I got home.

I ordered the Kalua pulled pork plate and the bomber both were absolutely delicious! The pork was tender and flavorful in each dish, and the eggs were perfectly fluffy. The Hawaiian sauce that came with the plate completely blew me away!

I really wanted to like this place, but breakfast was a big disappointment. I ordered biscuits and gravy, and unfortunately it was one of the worst I've ever had. The biscuits were cold and doughy in the middle, and the gravy was actually ice cold and flavorless -- not just lukewarm, but straight out of the fridge cold and lacking any seasoning. On top of that, the eggs that came with it were burnt, dry, and completely flavorless. The coffee was coffee was the only  great thing! Boiling hot and served in a paper cup that you cant even hold comfortably but otherwise tasted good.

For a spot that seemed promising and had that Hawaiian comfort vibe, I was expecting at least a warm, hearty plate. Instead, everything tasted rushed (or worse, like it wasn't cooked through or heated properly). Definitely not worth the price, and sadly not a place I'd come back to for breakfast.

name: Simply D's Licious Express Las Vegas NV.

html_attributions: Simply D's Licious Express Las Vegas NV.

reviews.text:
If I could rate this place higher I absolutely would. Despite it's small appearance there's a whole Lotta love that goes Into this food.
Everything is cooked to order so it's FRESH.
I ordered a large gumbo and their two piece fish that comes with two sides. With that I got the greens and macaroni and cheese. All of it bomb and they have the holy grail of all kool-aid 😌

For $18 my Mac n cheese had burnt hard cheese. Yams were dry and hard. Fish was fire. The place looked like it was falling apart inside. Not going back I really tried to support the local small business but there's no saving this place with bad food SMH.

I was in the mood for soul food! Gonna be honest, it was a little sketchy for what I’m used to in Vegas so I knew he had to be good. Anyways, go and order, he was out of a lot of things but it worked out. Got a 5 piece chicken with Mac and cheese and rice and beans. He was out of some chicken so he completed with some wings. Wanted them candied yams but he was out. Let me tell you, FLAVORFUL!! Mac and cheese was cool but the rice and beans was also really good. Definitely want to stop by and grab another plate!! Like I said, FOOD WAS DELICIOUS AND FLAVORFUL.

I ordered the oxtail meal, large gumbo, strawberry shortcake dessert cup and a slice of 7up cake. Everything was delicious! The facility was clean and organized. “A” rating! The oxtail came with 4 sides. The oxtail meat was so tender and juicy and flavorful! The gumbo was amazing and had sausage, chicken, shrimp and crab legs in it. It made about 3 serving in a large cereal bowl  days after. The flavor got better and better! It only took about 10 minutes for my order to be ready. There’s a cute patio area right outside. There was a monitor set up at the foot playing oldies. The chef was super nice and professional and skilled! I’ll definitely be back to taste the rest of the menu! I didn’t take pictures because I was too busy feeding my face…
*🔥current menu posted🔥*

We're visiting Vegas from Miami and searched for "food near me" while at the Las Vegas Convention Center.  we walked there  & it was worth every step.... drizzling rain and 48° 😃 It's in the cut, but big on flavor. There's a side table in the corner which was perfect to dine in but it's definitely a takeout place. EVERYTHING was well seasoned and fried to perfection!  I had the 2 PC fish (catfish) with red beans/rice & mac/cheese. Soooo sooo good 😊

name: Solamente Pizza
vicinity: 8390 W Sahara Ave STE 130, Las Vegas

reviews.text: The girl behind the counter taking orders was working her butt off. The atmosphere with different styles of seating is amazing.  The pizzas were delicious 😋 pesto sausage,  the dessert pizza and spicy special.  The place is chill. We prepaid for the food and just relaxed and ate. The lemon and orange sodas were amazing too. Definitely coming back.  Wonderful experience.

I found my new favorite white pizza at Solamente - the Biana Miele. I don't like when the ricotta is too overpowering on a white pizza and despite the abundance of ricotta on this pizza, it didn't steal the show. The honey ricotta has a mild sweetness that is paired beautifully with pecorino Romano then kissed with fresh basil. The spicy pep was delicious as well. The Calabrian peppers were a nice touch. They use quality pepperoni... Well, quality ingredients period.

The Italian flag sauce trio was the cherry on top. I enjoyed adding the honey ricotta to the spicy pep, pesto to the Bianca Miele and dipping my crust in the marinara. I love ranch with my pizza but I like having multiple options for dipping sauce.

This was our 2nd time having their pizza but we will be sure to come back. Staff was sweet and lively - all smiles. They were playing my jams and didn't shoo us out before closing time. I'm happy to support a business that knows how to feedband treat their patrons well.

We ordered take out. The pizza was cold. They didn’t have it sitting on a warming tray. Once reheated it was pretty good. The crust was chewy and the croutons were tasty in the salad. The Nutella bites were tasty, but needed more Nutella. The price before discounts would have been $80, but still felt overpriced at the discounted rate of $32 for two pizzas, a salad and the bites.
Pizza was amazingly delicious!  Best we have had in Vegas, EVER!!  And there are good pizza places here.  But this was super nummy delicious!! Recommend you try.  We are customers for life now.

The cheese was very complex and delicious. Rarely is the cheese something I notice, this one was the star of the show. Loved the fully gentle crust, it was a tender crisp and cloud interior. Very memorable pizza honestly. The place is large and the smell of good pizza fills the air, happy to have stopped by.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The Guilt Free Glutton is easily the best restaurant in Las Vegas! The food is absolutely amazing with a healthy twist, proving that you don’t have to sacrifice flavor when eating with care. The staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely mindful of dietary restrictions—yet there was nothing restricted about the taste.

I had the fish tacos, which were fresh, vibrant, and perfectly seasoned, while my husband had the Caprese Burger, which was rich, juicy, and unforgettable. Both dishes were paired with thoughtful sides that elevated the meal even further.

The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with creative touches that make it feel unique and memorable. It may feel a little off the beaten path, but once you discover it, you’ll be so glad you did. This place is a true hidden gem for locals and visitors alike.

Highly recommend—you’ll leave happy, full, and already planning your next visit.

I went to this restaurant on a Tuesday afternoon at 11:30am for lunch.  My review is based on my experience.  I met an employer that I was working with there.  I am Vegan and he is not.

The restaurant was completely empty when I first arrived.  It filled up by 12:30pm.  There is outdoor seating and I counted 2 high chairs.  The restaurant was clean and the waitress was kind but not the most attentive.  I ordered the Vegan Beyond Burger and my guest had the Turkey burger.

I thought my burger was one of the best that I’ve ever had!  It was really amazing!  My guest also enjoyed his Turkey burger as well.  The atmosphere is laid back and the music is a mix of solid rock and pop sounds.

I enjoyed the food and the atmosphere.  I would definitely recommend it for very delicious food at a good price.

We are both obsessed! I am celiac and they have a separate fryer for their fries if you ask! The gluten free bun was the best I have had. The burger was juicy and delicious. Our server is calm, kind, and knowledgeable! Ask for DJ! This place is adorable! I highly recommend coming here once, because you will come back!

Stopped by for a meal that would include some vegetables and got their Teriyaki Bowl with grilled tofu. It was spectacular. Perfectly cooked broccoli with a nice crisp and nicely flavored bowl including brown rice. A member of our party had Celiac Disease and the restaurant has easily identified gluten free options as well as a dedicated fryer to avoid cross contamination for any fried foods. Highly recommended if you are looking for great food at a reasonable price in the airport area of Vegas.

Very cool place to grab lunch. I had the steak sandwich with a side salad, and the sandwich was one of the best I've had in my entire life. I was shocked to recieve perfect medium-rare. The salad with raspberry vinaigrette was good but slightly more bitter than I prefer (not more sweet just a little less bitter). The waiter was very attentive and friendly. I recommend trying this unique little place.

If you’re craving a taste of Guam, you have to visit Island Comfort. We loved everything!!! Amazing authentic flavors that reminded us of home. The hospitality from the whole staff was appreciated - we highly recommend paying them a visit!

This place is a must. If you haven’t tried food from Guam you gotta try it from here. Definitely tastes like my family’s cooking. His food has so much flavor. Delicious. When we’re in town again we’ll be eating here.

I am one happy Chamorro girl. We ordered the Fiesta plate, shrimp patties, diago and got chicken soup and buchi buchi. Everything was absolutely delicious and authentic. Meat so tender and juicy, and everything so flavorful. I will definitely come back next time I visit Vegas.

This is the real thing! If you want authentic and delicious Chamorro food, this is the place to go! Had to try it after everyone kept telling me about it. It was EVERYTHING they said it was. The portions are large and everything was packed with flavor. I felt like I was back home at a barbecue on the islands. The food is SO good!

It’s been a few years since my husband, daughter, and I had real Chamorro food, and Island Comfort BBQ did not disappoint. Being from Texas, where there’s no Chamorro food anywhere, this place was such a treat. The flavors were spot on and brought back everything we’ve been missing. We felt right at home, and we’re definitely coming back next time we’re in Vegas!

The food is SOOOOO GOOOOD! We had the deluxe plate with (3) Salisbury steaks, red beans and green beans & dinner plate with neck bones, baked chicken, mac-n-cheese and greens. The greens had a good kick of spice and the cheese sauce tasted like it's made from scratch. I don't know what to say other than show a before and after. We almost made a trip back to get another plate before they closed but we needed a nap first. The place was very clean and had a full spread of every kind of soulfood item you would want. This was a gem not far from our hotel that we wish we would've found the day we arrived. Would definitely come back the next time we visit.

I came in with an open mind and high hopes for Southern Express Soulfood, but unfortunately, my experience was disappointing. The ribs were just okay — nothing special. The cabbage was extremely salty, and the mac and cheese lacked flavor and creaminess. For the price, I expected much better quality and taste.

I paid around $75 for two plates, and honestly, it just wasn’t worth it. The cooks refer to themselves as “chefs,” but based on the meal we received, that title felt a bit misleading. Overall, the food could use major improvement in both seasoning and value for the price.

I wanted some soul food pig feet and this was far from it. The greens were to salty and vinger. The pig feet are mostly bones with ginger over load and the Mac and cheese is bland not the soul food I’m used too and for 25$ not ordering again total came to 45 on DoorDash
Great food and wonderful service. This is a must stop whenever I’m in Vegas. Wish I could find this kind of food in Arizona. The fish and Mac & cheese are bomb.com!!
The best food ever 💯💯💯💯 can’t wait to come back and eat here again. I love it , everything was amazing the atmosphere the music the food etc was amazing

name: Cubanidad Express
vicinity: 3585 S Fort Apache Rd #203, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Cubanidad is gem for sure! went here for lunch. I had The "305" sandwich and My buddy had The Ybor Original sandwich. We split the sandwiches so we can try both...They were both delicious! The pork was so juicy, the Cubano sandwiches were so succulent, the bread was perfect with an amazing bit and chew. Everything came out fresh and hot...It's a charming place and the employees were very friendly. This was our first visit but will not be our last definitely will be back next time in Vegas! 100% recommend!

Now inhabiting the block south of Spring Mountain Road on Fort Apache since just before Memorial Day 2019 Cubanidad can safely be considered a success story thanks to traditional Food made well plus several new items added by customer demand.

Dubbed “the Ybor Original,” locations in Tampa Bay as well as Miami highly regarded for the Cuisine of Chef Dennis Martinez Miranda, it was by Toast that fourteen items were ordered for take-out thus saving both sides several dollars in fees.

Packing everything in temperature-controlled containers, it was with goods unpacked that staff explored flavors novel yet familiar, Hispanics quick to praise Empanadas packed with shredded Beef and Plantains.

A locally-owned import, Chef Miranda’s Cuban upbringing and professional training in Venezuela yielding products with big flavors, Beans and aromatic Rice outperform expectations while Medianoche features housemade Bread that stands up nicely to Smoked Ham, Roasted Pork, Swiss Cheese and Mustard Sauce.

Not about to skip Dessert, Pastelitos eat light, flaky and better than those at any local Panaderia thanks to Butter-laminated Pastry nearly bursting with Coconut Jam or Guava Jam and Cream Cheese.

The restaurant had a special where I could save a few dollars if I got the classic Cuban. Very good sandwich with ease of ordering. Nice quaint interior and place to chill, eating good food that reminds me of my travels to Miami. The sandwiches here might actually be better than how I remember over there.

First Tim here and the food was delicious. Huge portions, so many different choices of empanadas on display, and a variety of drinks. Love their lemonade. Will definitely come back and it’s seriously worth a try.

Absolutely delicious. This place is my go to for the best yummy Cuban cofee with a spinach and cheese empanadas. And I love their avocado salad with some sweet bananas. And having the most  great in service costumer service. I go Monday evenings and the great energy, vibe from the cashier is priceless

This place is a secret in the Vegas area. This is one of the best tasting Cuban food places in Vegas!!

I love the taste!! They have only been open about a month but they have perfected the food! The cook is from Cuba, my wife asked.  The service is great!

They have plenty of covered outside seating and a few small tables for two inside and a small bar are to eat.

Go check them out and have  some of best tasting Authentic Cuban food in the area!! You will thank me when you taste it!! Let me know what you think.

I'm back and it's still the best cuban food in vegas! Don't let the size of the place keep you from going. Support the locals! Yum!!!!!

So so cute and the food is very authentic. Only downside is limited seating. I had rice and peas, beef stew and plantains and I bought an extra side of yucca. I was craving cafe con leche and decided to take the drive up that way based on online reviews. They did not disappoint. Also, the art work and decor inside and outside is detailed and reminiscent of Cuba, Miami and the Caribbean. It’s like your little happy place away from the strip and all the craziness Las Vegas has to offer.

Saw this place while eating at Snappy burger and wanted to check it out. Great place to stop by for a large plate of Cuban food. We ordered the ropa vieja combo (shredded meat) w/ black beans+rice & plantains 10/10⭐️. The ropa vieja had excellent flavor, very tender & juicy and went perfect with the beans/rice. We also got the Cuban sandwich that had a good crusty bread, shredded meat & ham + fresh fries 8/10. The pina colada drink was delicious and so were the fruit empanadas. The place seemed very authentic. Staff was super nice, greeted in Spanish… seemed like a small family business. Two large tables outside & just a few seating areas inside (but it was very warm inside). Highly recommend coming here. I will be back to try the other meats.

One of the best Cuban food I've had in Las Vegas I had to go a second time and was not disappointed. My Cuban friend approved 100% on the food. Desserts were nothing special but the food was amazing 🙌

My first time here at El Bolero. Delicious roast pork with the highlight being how moist, fork tender and delicious it was. They even included some crunchy chicharron. The rice was cooked perfectly and full of flavor. The plantation chips were a nice compliment to everything. HUGE portions of great quality food at very reasonable prices ($12-13). I felt like I was in old Habana. 10/10 highly recommend!!

name: BLVD Bar BQ & Wings
vicinity: 3200 S Las Vegas Blvd #1265, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
We avoid chain restaurants when traveling, we really prefer to try the local fair. We were really pleased to find this barbecue restaurant on the Las Vegas strip. It was just a short walk from our hotel, very conveniently located.

We had the opportunity to speak with one of the owners. We were pleased to find that this is family-owned.  Our server was able to seamlessly guide us through the menu. We got one of the barbecue plates that was more than enough food for the two of us.  It included ribs, wings, and sides. Everything was absolutely delicious.

One of the best things about this restaurant is we were able to sit outside and enjoy the fresh air. We did not have to walk through a smoky casino to get there!!  I would definitely add this to your itinerary if you're going to Las vegas.

The BEST BBQ spot in Las Vegas!  the food absolutely lives up to the hype. Everything is packed with flavor, perfectly cooked, and consistently delicious. Whether you’re ordering wings, BBQ plates, or sides, you can tell they put real care into the food they serve. My favorite is their brisket, my husband's are their burgers.

The prices are great, especially considering the quality.  Locals receive an amazing discount, which is almost unheard of in Vegas, and there’s free parking at the mall, making it super convenient to just go there and chill after shopping.
They also offer special discounts for mall employees and convention attendees, which makes it a great spot for anyone working nearby or visiting for an event. On top of that, they provide catering for local businesses, and their food is perfect for group gatherings.

The atmosphere is relaxed and fun, especially on nights when they host entertainment. They have karaoke on Thursdays and Saturdays, plus open mics and a DJ on Friday nights. It’s a great place to hang out, enjoy good food, and have a great time.

Highly recommended!

After getting rained on bringing in the New Year on the Blvd. , we were looking for a spot to get outta the rain and get some grub. We had been turned away by several restaurants as they were closing but the guys at Blvd BBQ took us in with warm hospitality and some great BBQ despite the fact that they were already starting to shut down for the night. Prices were very reasonable, as previously mentioned, the level of respectful service was second to none and the food felt like we were in the backyard on a summers day with friends and family. We will definitely be making our way back to Blvd BBQ during our future trips to Vegas !

BLVD Bar BBQ and Wings served up a delicious meal from start to finish. We had a burger, ribs, and steak—all cooked perfectly and packed with flavor. The burger was juicy, the ribs were tender and smoky, and the steak was seasoned just right. Portions were generous, and everything came out hot and fresh. The atmosphere was laid-back and welcoming, with friendly staff who made the experience even better. A great spot for hearty, flavorful food in a relaxed setting!

THE BEST BBQ PLACE IN LAS VEGAS!!! If you're a fan of BBQ and wings, BLVD BAR BQ & WINGS on the LV Strip is a must-visit!

Great location with a patio seating overlooking The Strip. Indoor seating is available if preferred.
Located across from Wynn just outside Fashion Show Mall on the street level.

They have a large menu full of your BBQ favorites. Definitely could please everyone in a group. From wings, to burgers, to racks of ribs, pulled pork, brisket, wings and burnt ends, hotdogs, and really tasted sides such as tried fries, onion rings,coleslaw , beans and more.
Very good selection of beers, cocktails and other drinks.
We had sliders, loaded fries, chicken sandwich , wings and steak burger .Everything was cooked perfectly and packed with flavor. The steak burger was juicy, the wings were tender and smoky, and the steak was seasoned just right. Portions were generous, and everything came out hot and fresh.

The owners son was very cool and made us feel so welcomed! The staff is genuinely kind, making every customer feel like part of the family.
The atmosphere is laid-back and inviting , with friendly staff who made the experience even better. A great spot for hearty, flavorful food in a relaxed setting!

Overall:Absolutely fabulous BBQ! The place where you can enjoy the true American BBQ experience on the Las Vegas strip!
We highly recommend it!!!

This is a truly authentic Italian restaurant with a wide variety of food.  All of it is so good!!  We live in Nashville and first stumbled across this place 10 years ago.  It is a must stop on each trip since.  Enjoy the great food and great people!!

When I'm in town, I  always go to this place. This is real authentic Italian food. Incredible pastry selection. World class culinary cook and Chef, The owner, Pete really takes pride. He tells me it's all his family's recipes that's many years old.

Even the cheese slices are not so thin, really moist and *Yummy*, the Sicilian Square pizza slices and pepperoni rolls are amazing! *Best* I've tasted in a while.The spaghetti meatball marinara , *WOWWWZA MIA* Lol, I would definitely give a try. It's unbelievable! Incredible taste!

The pastry selection, and the cannolis, and cheesecake*Yum! , It's a must try. Hard to find places like this. I went on the strip and went to two other places that were twice the money, yet the quality wasn't even close. I give this *5*Stars*, and recommend , try this place! , if you're local or visiting town,You'll be happy you did!  You can try it for either, taking out or sit down dinner, Which is even better if you can.

Has that old Italian ,old school feel.
The marinara sauce is out of this world! *try it with the *pepperoni* rolls.

Really reasonable prices, and incredible food! You must give this place a try.. Really authentic Italian food. 5 *Stars* All the way.

Mamma mia, Cuginos Italian is a gem. This isn’t your fancy vino date spot but if you’re craving authentic Italian food this is it.

Pizza with that perfect crispy crust, lasagna layered with cheesy goodness, meatballs that taste like grandmas recipe, strombolis with magic sauce and fresh mozzarella made in house. The gaahlic knots are bites of paradiso!

Pete, one of the maestros behind the counter made sure our dishes were una delizia and autentico!
I think I found one of my favorite Italian restaurants.  It is a MUST try if you're visiting Vegas, obviously it's off the strip but it's not far.

Looking for the best NY style pizza while in LAs Vegas? Cugino’s Italian Deli & Pizzeria is your place!

2 large slices and a drink for under 8 bucks located just off the strip. The best pizza in town.

It also has a cute little market and diner surrounded by photos of all the famous people that have visited. Highly recommend!

Maybe good for more Western taste buds? Where pad thai is a dish to get? Price wise it's cheaper than many Thai and Laos around. Dishes are $13.95ish vs all $15-$16.95+. Menu includes fusion options (like many places in Vegas). Thai spicy of 1-10. If youre a mild person, then 2-3 might be for you. Not for us but maybe good for the area?

Staff is super nice.

Papaya Salad $11.95. Thai style, level 1 spicy because the seeds are usually pretty spicy. Wasn't spicy at all. It was okay.

Drunken Noodle $13.95. Pork, level 2 spicy. This was overly sweet. Wasn't spicy at all. It was more mushy than expected.

Spicy Catfish $15.95. Level 2 spicy. It felt like level 2 spicy. It looks like orange chicken sauce but it's not the same taste. Overly drenched sauce. I would not recognize this as a Thai catfish dish. Maybe Laos or westernized version?

Crispy pork with Chinese Broccoli (comes with rice) $16.95. Level 2 spicy. Wasn't spicy at all. Also drenched and overly salty. Crispy pork was a little stale.

What's not for us, doesn't mean its not for others.

This restaurant is a family favorite! I’ve been here multiple times and keep forgetting to write a review. Favorite dishes we’ve tried - Pad See Ew, Pad Thai, and Drunken Noodles. We normally order to go and 3 dishes are perfect for our family of 4 with some leftovers. I think the prices are decent for the portions you get. Would recommend!
(These photos are after we’ve had a few bites)

This thai restaurant does not attract attention from the location its tucked away in. In a discreet corner on Nellis and D.I. you will find Maya Thai. The inside of the restaurant has been complete redone. A very warm and welcoming dining area. I ordered by phone right when they opened and my food was done in about 10 min which is how long I took to get there from my place.
When I got home, I was pleased to see that they had taken the time to write on every box to easily identify which dish was which. The second thing I noticed was the portions, or lack there of. From experiences with other Thai restaurants, Maya served me about 2/3rds less food than most places. Though the dishes were good, it was small portions.
Let's start with the crispy rolls. Those were fresh and crispy and served with a nice dipping sauce. The beef jerky for me was a little too crispy. My wife and I were debating if the meat was deep fried or if it's dehydrated. That's how dry the texture is. Good but dry. Next was the papaya salad. This was disappointed a bit. The flavor was good but the portion was very, very small. And the papaya salad had 3 literal shrimp. I would expect more if I'm paying over 10 dollars for this. The green curry was good, nothing special here. The shrimp pad Thai was decent, nice flavors and a very nice heat.
The reason for my score was mainly due to price. Overall the food was a definite 4 but due to the current economy and the sizing of my plates and how much I paid, I feel like I could've got more bang for my buck.

Was shocked to see how tiny the serving is. I ordered broccoli w/beef which cost almost $16 due beef is extra $2 but it came in a little container that is not even half full. This sucks coz I use to order her both dine in and take out. Even my daughters order pad thai was very small in serving. Never again

My friend and I went to this thai restaurant for dinner. We ordered crab fried rice and stir-fried chicken with basil, adding a fried egg, as usual. I was very impressed with the food here. The taste was delicious and very satisfying to me. If anyone passes or stops by this area, I recommend stopping by to try eating here.

name: EllaEm's Soul Food
vicinity: 775 W Craig Rd, North Las Vegas

reviews.text:
I visited EllaEm’s Soulfood in Las Vegas based on a recommendation from a local I met after arriving—and wow, it did not disappoint! I ordered the swai fish along with greens, mac & cheese, potato salad, and yams. Every single dish was packed with flavor, just like a home-cooked meal from someone’s grandma. The portions were generous, and although I couldn’t finish everything, the leftovers were even better the next day.
The customer service was exceptional. I was greeted warmly as soon as I walked in and seated immediately—no wait at all. The atmosphere felt welcoming and comfortable. I did try the Kool-Aid, but it was way too sweet for me, so I stuck with water. Honestly, that’s the only thing I’d change.
Overall, EllaEm’s is a solid 10/10! I can’t wait to come back on my next trip to Vegas. Thank you, ElleEm’s, for an amazing experience!

The food is excellent and actually plentiful for the price. Workers were nice but they appeared very busy due to so many people placing phone orders for delivery on New Years Day (must be very popular). I got the Swai catfish, blackeyed peas, yams, potato salad and cobbler which was REAL cobbler (I should have got some butter pecan ice creak for this). The atmosphere for me (12 o clock on a holiday) was nice and quiet, but seating is limited so you might want to make a reservation. So far my favorite in Vegas since Big Mama's Rib Shack closed down. Im not sure that its possible for the food to get any better with prices so reasonable!

This place was delicious! Mac & cheese was on point, candied yams(although I like a lil more butter and nutmeg in mine) but they were still a hit, my pork chops were cooked to perfection, and my black eyed peas and cornbread were good too. Food was fresh and hot. Prices were affordable and you get a lot of food. I definitely had leftovers. 3 people could've ate from my plate. I will return whenever I visit Vegas for sure 💯only thing I'll say is the order are a lil bit of a wait when you dine in so next time I'm going to order over the phone or online then eat it in the restaurant.

Been multiple times and both times were great. First time, went with my dad and it was awesome. Second time had a togo order, but believe me, once I plated it, it didn't stay long on the plate. Very delicious.

The food is amazing. 10s all around!
Rib Sandwich - Tender and flavorful.
Chicken wings - PERFECT
Snapper Sandwich - Gone before we could take a pic.
Now for the sides---
Potato salad so good my husband lied at the table and said mine was the best ever in the world.
Mac - flavor, cheese on point
But the YAMSSSS MELT IN YOUR MOUTH..
The mashed potatoes and gravy, you will regret not ordering them... THE GARLIC!!
DO NOT come in there rushing because GOOD FOOD TAKES TIME.
I can't wait to eat my left overs!

name: White Whale Cocktail Bar Fremont Street
vicinity: 111 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
I’ve been going to White Whale almost every week since they opened, and it never misses. Every visit is consistently great—from craft cocktails to the service. The owners truly care about their guests and it shows. They make everyone feel welcome and pay attention to the details that matter.

The craft cocktails are easily some of the best in town—no exaggeration—and the quality never dips, even when the bar is packed. The space strikes that perfect balance between classy and cozy, which is exactly what downtown Fremont has been missing. It’s perfect whether you’re catching up with a friend, on a low-key date, or enjoying a live DJ on weekends.

The interior deserves its own shoutout: Japanese anime-inspired decor, warm wood accents, leather couches, and low lighting that creates an intimate, chill vibe. Whenever friends visit from out of town, White Whale is always the first place I recommend—and it never disappoints.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for great drinks, great energy, and a space that feels intentional and welcoming.

I absolutely love what they did with this entire venue. Its clean, modern, artsy and upbeat. The service is fabulous from the door all the way to the bar.  Such a fun atmosphere to chill, drink, and vibe the night away. There is alot of attention to detail in the design of this place. They have the bar and bathroom countertops boasting the Japanese art form of Kintsugi! I also adored how the ladies bathroom was surrounded by mirrors, so cute and fun!🙌🏻🤩💃🤳 not to mention delicious cocktails! Whether its on or off the menu, the bartenders here deliver😎👍🏻

White Whale at Downtown Fremont in Las Vegas just took the cocktail experience to the next level! Their front room is fun, colorful, has a DJ and even has some awesome custom dragon ball z art on the wall. The servers and bartenders were very polite and provided very quick and friendly service. We also managed to make it into the back room which is a more exclusive and speakeasy sort of vibe. The back room is quaint but what I REALLY enjoyed was how their craft cocktail menu isn’t a set menu and it changes from night to night depending on the theme or bartenders’ choice that night… an Omakase bar experience, if you will! Which is something I personally haven’t heard of yet, and those were some of the best cocktails I’ve ever had. I also heard they feature some amazing drink specials on happy hour. So we will definitely be back to try those next! Thank you for the incredible time everyone down at the White Whale! See you again soon!

Great new bar towards the end of the Fremont experience. Nice ambiance, and good mix drinks. One of the owners is born/raised from Oahu so come and support.

While there, hit up Evan and Daniel for good drinks. Very knowledgeable in mixology, if you’re craving something that’s not on the menu, ask them what they suggest and they can create something good.

Best craft cocktail lounge in downtown! It’s located right off of Fremont St and Las Vegas Blvd. Great setting for large groups or fun date night spot! Besides the delicious cocktails, the service is why we keep coming back to this gem! The prices are reasonable and they also do an all day happy hour every Monday for locals and industry peeps! Such a great addition to the downtown area!

name: Cafe Americano at Caesars Palace
vicinity: 3570 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
I was shocked at the quality and taste of this cafe. I thought it would be another over priced restaurant with average food but I was wrong. The food turned out excellent.

I started off with an espresso martini and it gave me the kick that I needed at 10pm. It was strong and bold.

We ordered calamari, pepperoni pizza, assorted empanadas, 16oz ribeye, and rigatoni alla vooka to share between 4 of us.

The service was great and attentive. Seven stars and Diamond reward status gets special seating area.

Being incredibly hungry from all the winning (of $10) we were doing the night before, we decided to stop by Cafe Americano in Caesars, a modern breakfast spot with a nice decor and view. We walked in pretty early with no reservation and were seated very quickly. Although we didn’t make one, we definitely recommend making reservations as Vegas itself can be extremely busy and it’s better safe than sorry. The interior is clean and sleek with both indoor and outdoor options available. Our server was pretty nice and attentive, making sure we were always taken care of despite him seeming to be the only one on duty.

For our food we went the route of their buttermilk pancakes with a side of bacon and their breakfast burrito. The food took a bit of a while even with there being not too many people so heads up on the wait time. When we finally got everything it looked very good. The pancakes are light and fluffy with powdered sugar sprinkled atop and the bacon is cooked well. To be honest, the pancakes and bacon were okay. Definitely better than the average diner, but nothing to write home about. The breakfast burrito was okay as well. They seemed to go light on the inside with each bite leaving a bit more to be desired.
