The flavors of the eggs, chorizo, cheddar, and avocado were well balanced though and the side of breakfast potatoes was a nice compliment to the meal.

Cafe Americano is a decent breakfast spot but one we would say is more of a convenience than a go to. The food is alright, but the setting and service are good. Unfortunately for the meal you eat, you pay the Vegas price and for how much it is by the end of it, there is probably better value and food to be found elsewhere. This is a good spot to go to if you want breakfast and you’re staying in Caesars, otherwise it’s a skip.

There was a bit of a wait to get in during brunch. We were initially seated at a table where some of the glasses were dirty and were about to be used to serve us water, but we asked for them to be changed and the staff addressed it. The food was okay overall, but the fries were a standout—super crunchy and really enjoyable.

I had a wonderful experience at Cafe Americano in Caesars Palace. The atmosphere is vibrant yet relaxed, making it the perfect spot whether you’re starting your day or winding down after a long one. The menu has a great variety, and everything we tried was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

The service was outstanding—attentive, warm, and efficient without ever being intrusive. Our server made sure we were comfortable and well taken care of throughout the meal.

The location itself is also a plus—conveniently situated inside Caesars Palace with a stylish and welcoming vibe. Whether you’re in the mood for breakfast, brunch, or a late-night bite, Cafe Americano delivers on quality, taste, and service.

I would definitely return and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Caesars Palace!

I celebrated my birthday this evening and had the pleasure of being served by Alex and Cheven. They were absolutely amazing, attentive, friendly, and made the whole night feel extra special. Their service was seamless, and they went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. Truly grateful for their care and energy, it made my birthday dinner unforgettable! thank you so much once again!! :)

name: West Side Oasis
vicinity: 808 W Lake Mead Blvd, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Great atmosphere.  The live band is really good. They even allowed folks on the audience to sing songs as well. The food was served piping hot, just the way I like it.

The WSO is my favorite spot. They play good old school R&B. Everyone dresses well, and comes to dance. The food is great.  It's and older crowd, everone is friendly,  with no trouble. I love this place.

I think the outside of this place used to look like a fish and ships restaurant. Well, it’s different now. The outside got a overhaul. But the inside is where you spend the most of your time. And I have it say... it is nice inside. Not too small, and not too large where there is no intimacy. You want an excuse to walk past someone you like by the way without being too obvious.

Anyway, my first time there and besides being searched - it was enjoyable. Then I realized I was supposedly on the West side of town,  it that preconception faded away fast as the crowd was all grown folks. Which translates to chill and enjoyable.

There was an entertainer named Sly, who is a one man band and he was excellent. He played music from the 60 to 80s - I think because I did not know some of the songs because I am an 80-90’s era person. But I was still entertained.

I had the Calamari and Chips. Which was good. I started at 6pm and ended up leaving at 8 on a Friday night.

So, yes. Ignore the environment outside and get inside. It is safe. Has security, who will search you - and there was at least 7 staff on duty including the owner.

See pictures, I will definitely go back when I am around that area to catch an eat and listen to the live music.
Food is not seasoned well and could be better quality. Some bartenders are not polite. DJ is Ronnie O who plays good music. I go because of the DJ. 😊
Great Night out with my Sister's and Niece everyone in the place were nice and friendly like if you were around Family having a great time together.

name: 18Bin Bar & Restaurant
vicinity: 107 E Charleston Blvd Suite 150, Las Vegas

reviews.text: I'm glad we gave 18Bin another shot.  We first came across this establishment during the pandemic and thought it was just loud and too cool for us.  Fast forward 5 years and we milled around the arts space connected to 18Bin and a pleasant surprise.  The vibe was so chill (also midday, a day after a big holiday - xmas) and Ingrid was accommodating and also very chill.  We had chips, salsa and guac to tie us over (before our over-indulgent buffet in 4 hours) and as a lover of mezcal, the Desperado was the perfect peaceful cocktail for day drinking.  I didn't catch the names of the other staff, but loved the gal behind the counter (bussing mostly) singing along to almost all of the songs and the Latina woman who provided us with some good Mexican food recommendations!  Thank you for a nice 'after the holidays' drink and snack.

18bin surprised us with the double DJ, Sunday funday in the Arts District. Drinks were awesome. Brunch food was delicious and the service was really solid.

Dogs were allowed and the music was great.

Thanks!

We will be back.

Great atmosphere.  Outside patio dog friendly with fans and misters. Live DJ but music was super loud making it hard to hold a conversation. However if your looking for lively place on a Sunday this is the place.

On weekends 18bin offers their legendary bottomless mimosa brunches, while weeknights feature events like themed parties and comedy shows.

It’s the kind of place where your happy hour might turn into an all-night dance party

My wife and I returned specifically because of our favorite waitress, Aubrey – she always made the experience special. We were pretty disappointed to learn she’s no longer there. The spot itself is nice with a good atmosphere, and the food is decent, though nothing mind-blowing. We’ll probably hold off on coming back for now, but who knows – things change!

Best hidden secret in Vegas!  This is now our #1 spot to hang out and drink incredible Belgian beers. My wife and I stopped by twice on our 3 night trip.  The staff is amazing and we felt right at home. We will definitely be back.

Such a gem! We popped into The Silver Stamp and were immediately welcomed by super friendly and knowledgeable staff. They gave us great suggestions for places to visit around town based on what we like to drink, super thoughtful! Loved the vibe, loved the service. Definitely coming back! 10/10!

Welcome to the best hidden gem off the Strip for quality craft beer scene. The style when you walk in feels a bit like a speak easy style, tons of memorabilia lines the walls, vintage beer cans and cool blend of music. The beer dudes at the bar knew their craft and they carried Lambics, Kölsch, Hefe’s that are straight from Europe. Locals only kinda place. Worth the $15 uber to get here.

What an awesome hidden gem of Vegas. Came here after seeing some recommendations and loved it right away. It was nice, quiet, and cool inside on a super hot day. The beer selection is great and the bartenders are super friendly. I highly recommend the pickled eggs as well!

At first glance, walking up to this bar feels like you're stumbling upon a hidden gem-it's just a door surrounded by stickers, giving off total hole-in-the-wall vibes. But the inside? Completely different-and I absolutely love that contrast!

It's a small, cozy spot with a great selection of craft beers. The place is clean, comfortable, and the bartenders are friendly and really know their stuff. I was a little surprised at first by how much head was on the beers, but it turns out they're pouring them properly to the line, which is actually how many craft beers are meant to be served. Still, sometimes the head can be a little too generous (looking at you, light beer in the photo).

All in all, this is 100% a spot l'd recommend if you're looking to hang out at a local Vegas bar and enjoy some really good beers!

Where to start.  Walked in and found a quaint small place.  Very few tables to sit at.  The menu board was not great, kinda scared me away a bit.  But said I'm here so let's give it a try.

That said, the young lady at the register was very nice and inviting.  I was very pleasantly surprised at the prices.  In Miami I'm use to my meal being Rice and beans, meat and plantains or yuca.  Most places in town it's just Rice and beans and meat the plantains or yuca are extra.  Well this place was like Miami and that makes me happy.

I had the Ropa Vieja with Rice & Beans and Yuca.  A t amal, and 4 ham croquets total was 15.   Unlike a recent visit to another place in town with smaller petitions and was 24 for same thing minus the croquets...  Yet I was criticized for the review about that place cause I thought was expensive and bad portions.

Oh well I can tell you I will be going back for sure... Check it out see what you think, I'm sure you will like it.
Great food and great service.  Murals on the wall represent the province of Camaguey which  boasts of beautiful palm trees and a mixture of Spanish and Caribbean flairs.
The best Cuban food in Las Vegas. The best tamales ever!!!!!! My only suggestion is that they change the hours because the place closes way to early, especially on Sunday.

$3 charge to pay with a credit card.
Attitude from the start from the girl taking my order.
Threw my change on the counter. Wow.
Cuban sandwich not great and the Pork Tamal 🫔 was garbage .
Authentic Cuban restaurant. Friendly and good service.

name: Earl of Sandwich
vicinity: 3667 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Amazing sandwich. Reasonable rate for the strip. Portion was big and enough for a dinner. Serving time was around 10 minutes. Good seating area. Vegetarian options available and tasted great. We liked white bread option than wheat bread.

Came here to grab breakfast after our first night at Planet Hollywood. It's in the casino just beside one of the inside entrances to Miracle Mile Shops. They have a number of breakfast sandwich and wrap options as well as regular sandwiches. You enter the line queue and order and get a buzzer. There are a few tables to sit and enjoy your meal. The decor is your typical Earl of Sandwich with some pictures and text on the history.

If you get soda or coffee you get a cup and you fill it yourself. Also, there is a selection of flavored cream and different sugars for your coffee. The fountain pop area has a spout for cold water so we were able to fill our water bottles as well.

Today, I ordered a coffee for my wife. At 2.99 it's one of the cheapest on the strip. And for the family I got 1 ham, egg, and cheddar and 2 sausage, egg, and cheddar. Everything was really good and tasty. The bread was nicely toasted and had a little crunch when you bite into it. If you don't like it toasted you will have to let them know ahead of time. Only thing noted as with other Earl of Sandwich locations I reviewed is could use a bit more mayo and sauces. While the sandwiches were flavourful, I like a lot of mayo.

They are efficient from taking your order to making your order. I also noticed a few order kiosks at the front of the restaurant so if the line is long which I noticed it can get at meal times then you may want to order from there.

There’s something so special about a Vegas morning, and breakfast at Earl of Sandwich was the heart of it for us. Before we headed up for those breathtaking views, we fueled up here. I can still taste that warm, toasted artisan bread nothing beats their breakfast sandwiches. It wasn’t just a quick meal; it was that quiet, happy moment of anticipation before the excitement of the day began. Simple, delicious, and filled with good memories. It made our morning feel complete.

This sandwich shop is located in Planet Hollywood.  They are fantastic.  You can order at desk or through the kiosk.  Order is ready in like 5 min or so. There is seating available. We ordered 3 different sandwiches.  My absolute favorite was the Turkey Holiday sub. It was the best sub I have ever had. The staff was so nice and friendly.  There are a lot of places in Vegas that now close before midnight,  but not this place, always open. I will be back next time I am in the area. Plus, decent prices for the area! 5 stars!

We visited twice.  First we tried the “Original 1762” sandwich in the Planet Hollywood location in Vegas.  While the sandwich was a little smaller than expected (the pics AlWAYS look bigger), the flavor profile was good and the bun was nice and toasty.   The next morning we tried the bacon egg and cheese sandwich and the sausage egg and cheese sandwich.  Both were good and pretty much as inexpensive a breakfast as you can find in Vegas.

Visit “The Four Chains Travel” on YouTube to see our full-length Vegas travel videos and reviews.

name: Soru Ramen Sushi & Seafood
vicinity: 5061 E Sahara Ave Ste 1D, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Had the best experience. Another random google search that lead us to a phenomenal place with great art, and amazing food. An a bonus my infant daughter received a delicious ice cream popsicle from them. Amazing hospitality! Recommended to all my friends from out of town and definitely coming back the moment we are in the Vegas area!

Two separate trips only days apart because I really wanted to go back so soon! Had a chicken and pork katsu and takoyaki the first trip which insured i came back, next i tried the fried rice an beef gyudon bowl that reminded me of yoshinoya in a great way!  For the price this might be the best casual asian dining in the area.

Food is amazing. I love spicy food but I warn you now to be weary of their "oh my god" level 4. Very reasonable prices and quick service. Fruit slushes were good too. During peak times I can see parking being an issue here as there are other restaurants in the same strip mall.

It’s a different atmosphere at night, it’s calm and tame and great place to take someone here to eat.

All the food is up to expectations and seen on menu photos I love it.

Just ate here with the fam... and it was amazing.  If you like spicy... "OMG," hot is the way to go.  I have searched for a long time for a Japanese restaurant to offer legit spicy and besides a handful of shabu shabu places this is the first to nail it; I had the curry Ramen.  My wife and son devoured the sushi and my girls had the Udon and everyone loved it.  This place is definitely an Eastside gem for sure.

Nora’s is truly a standout Italian restaurant. From the moment you walk in, the warm and inviting ambience sets the perfect tone for an unforgettable meal. The atmosphere is cozy, elegant, and full of charm—ideal for everything from a casual dinner to a special night out.

The food is absolutely amazing. Every dish is crafted with rich, authentic flavors that make you feel like you’re dining in Italy. And the best part? Their unlimited garlic bread is simply unbeatable—fresh, perfectly seasoned, and dangerously addictive.

If you’re looking for a place that nails both exceptional food and a fantastic dining atmosphere, Nora’s is the place to go. Highly recommended !!!

We were looking for a new Italian spot away from the strip and Nora's popped up. I must say they amazing and delicious dishes!

We made a reservation and were seated right away, I highly suggest making a reservation as they were pretty busy when we came (7pm). Also, the parking near the restaurant gets packed but they have additional parking across the street.

The service was excellent! We were checked on plenty of times to the point that we didn't need to get their attention. Our server was lovely, I didn't catch his name I wish I did! Very efficient service!

Extensive menu(drinks and food) plus they have a visual menu!! (Idk about you, but I need to see pictures of food before I order)

We got Wild Boar Pappardelle which was amazing btw! My friend got the Melrose Chicken she said it was tasty! Oh and their bread??? Wow! For dessert, a tiramisu of course and that was great too, not too sweet so the flavor was very balanced.

It was a bit loud inside but felt very homey in a way, it was like a family dinner setting.

Overall, 5/5!

Hidden gem!! Don't let the location or distance from the strip mislead you. Nora's is A.M.A.Z.I.N.G!

THE BEST PART (drum roll please...) It won't break the bank!!

Man this place is awesome! The food..BOOM!

The service...Al Dente!!

The prices....Fahghet about it!!

Seriously, a MUST try. We tried a little bit of everything we could and we will definitely be back for more! Check out the pics...and do yourself a flavor...go to Nora's! You'll be glad you did 🥳

On a Friday night at 5 PM it was already packed inside.  Good thing they have outdoor seating, which was kinda cold since it was raining that day in Vegas.  Weather permitted aside, that would have been wonderful! We were passing time and we happened to pass by this restaurant and we thought of having a light dinner, so pasta, calamari for appetizer and pork shop with arugula salad was what me and my wife had.  Service was moderate but the server was so nice.  We anticipated waiting a bit since there were already several people ahead of us when we came.  We didn’t have a reservation but they still accommodated us.  Food was good and decent, although I’ve had more flavorful pasta.  I’d still give this a high rating for service and great ambience.

Good god! This place is absolutely delicious!!! Walked in and you could smell the aroma of garlic and greatness!! The atmosphere gave family friendly and romantic date night! Very welcoming from the time we were seated, until the time that we left. We had the peanut butter cup martini and I’ve never tasted something so delightful in my life! The food was beyond my expectations!!! I know someone’s nona is in that kitchen! I’m so happy to have stumbled across this place. As a new Las Vegas resident, I’m adding this to my collection of top rated restaurants! Thank you all for the beautiful experience!

Starboard Tack is an absolute gem!

Starboard Tack never misses. The cocktails are next level—balanced, creative, and honestly some of the best in the city. Their merch is super cool too, the kind you actually want to wear, not just toss in a drawer.

If you haven’t been on a Tuesday, you’re missing out: the puffy tacos are a must. Light, crispy, flavorful—truly addictive. Pair them with a cocktail and you’re set.

The vibes are always chill and welcoming, with great music that fits the room perfectly. It’s one of those places where you instantly feel at home—thanks in large part to the charming owner who personally greets everyone like an old friend.

Also the machines are HOT!! As an avid keno player- I love playing here! I always win!

Bonus: they serve breakfast and the kitchen is open 24/7, so whether it’s morning, midnight, or anything in between, you’re covered.

If you’re looking for a spot with personality, great food, killer drinks, and a laid-back atmosphere, Starboard Tack is the place. Highly recommend!

I will say that my wife and I went on a Sunday morning, so I'm sure the place becomes a bit more lively at night. The food was surprisingly good, the crab rangoon dip and the vegan chicharon are a must.

Hands down the best kept secret in Vegas. Amazing food, drink's and staff ( Krystal ) One of the best burgers, fish and Chips in town and you definitely need to try the oysters. Keep an eye on the specials wall board they do off memu wing flavors of the day plus drink specials.
This place is the tits! Krystal is amazing, ambience is second to none, food is fantastic. If you want a good time and fun dive off the strip this place is it.

Cannot believe we haven't been here before! Not smoky at all, the sweetest bartender Krystal, an amazing chef, romantic loungy old-Vegas feel. Agh! We loved it. Food and cocktails are great! The highlight for us was definitely the 4 skewers for $13. Really cool place we feel lucky to have found!

name: Tommy Rocker's Mojave Beach Bar & Grill

reviews.text: Our company hosted 2 times’ luncheon in this restaurant & bar place.  The service was attentive, space was spacious and the food was good, in particular the Angus beef hand patties burger dish.  It took a while for the kitchen to make it but who cares if you’re getting quality beef burger?  The price per person is very fair and they hace several options for corners to host small group training or luncheon for 20-30ppl.  Strongly recommended!

I had the grilled cheese deluxe and coleslaw. The food was average at best, and I wouldn't order it again. The place was empty but it still took quite a while to get the food. The only really good part of the visit was the service that the waitress provided.
The service is excellent always. They have delicious food selections. It’s a cozy strip view food corner.

I remember when this place opened in the 80's. Good thing they stayed in business for decades because I just finally made it in there in 2024. To our delight they had live music and it went very well with dinner. Can't remember the servers name buy she's a petite brunette with excellent customer service skills. This is a nice place to chill in their combined dining area/bar. The female bartender was excellent as well. We'll be back for sure. Nice strip views!

First time there. Happy hr drink featured  flat coke. The potato skins were soggy, I ordered the lite fare steak. It was 30% gristle and unseasoned. Their peanut sauce side for my rice was just plain inedible. The chicken for the Monterey sandwich was overcooked and tough. Worse yet the bill was $86. Not a good night out. No wonder the bar and restaurant were empty.

name: Lucino’s Pizza
vicinity: 3035 E Tropicana Ave Suite E&F, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
As of today, my favorite & by far the best New York Style Pizza in Las Vegas! We decided last minute to try Lucinos’s, a place I tried years ago that was always good. I don’t remember them being this great.

Crust was perfectly cooked, sauce was so tasty, & they had a great Vegan cheese option. The Margherita pizza was perfectly cooked too. We tried their poppers which were delicious & the homemade vegan ranch was incredible. They had mozzarella sticks that were huge & the kids enjoyed them.

Everything is priced well & the service is impeccable! Erika, our server was exceptional. The place is super clean & has a lot of space. I’m not into sports but if you are they have a handful of tvs to watch games.

Team Luciano’s! Thanks For everything. See you soon!

**Lucino's Pizza — A Philadelphia Gem in Las Vegas**

Lucino's Pizza is more than just a place to grab a slice; it embodies East Coast authenticity right in the heart of Las Vegas. The dining room is a tribute to Philadelphia sports culture, adorned with framed jerseys, memorabilia lining the walls, and TVs playing the latest games, creating an atmosphere of camaraderie and excitement. This is a venue where the joy of sharing a good meal pairs perfectly with a sense of tradition.

In the kitchen, classic techniques are employed with skill and care. The hand-tossed crust is a standout feature, striking a balance between chewiness and char. It boasts a gently blistered edge with just the right amount of texture and a tender center. The "original" slice delivers a harmonious flavor profile, with tangy tomato purée, stretchy mozzarella, and a touch of salinity that enhances the overall taste. The pepperoni version adds a delicious contrast with crispy edges from rendered fat and a hint of spice, while the cheese slice, satisfying yet straightforward, highlights the beauty of quality dairy.

Value and practicality shine through with Lucino's 2-slice-and-a-drink lunch special—a wise choice for a midday meal that offers both comfort and affordability (the complimentary soda adds a charming, nostalgic touch). The portions are generous yet sensible, fitting perfectly with the lively sports-bar vibe where patrons gather, cheer, and enjoy their food throughout the game.

The Lucino's Fries deserve special mention. Their crinkle-cut shape provides an extra crunch and maximizes seasoning retention. Dressed with the house garlic-parmesan sauce, the fries achieve a rich umami flavor. The addition of Pecorino cheese adds a salty, nutty contrast, while parsley flakes provide a fresh touch to keep the dish exciting. Overall, the fries are well-crafted and complement the Pizza beautifully.

Service is efficient and friendly, matching the casual pace of a sports-themed lunch or a lively evening of game-watching. The staff handles orders with a warm, approachable demeanor that fits the restaurant's confident charm.

For anyone craving an authentic East Coast pizza experience and a lively, sports-friendly atmosphere in Las Vegas, Lucino's Pizza is an excellent choice. It avoids gimmicks and instead focuses on delivering honest, well-prepared food at a fair price, making it ideal for gatherings, game nights, or anyone looking to savor a taste of Philadelphia with genuine craftsmanship.

Highly recommended!
Very friendly staff, the server was great!
She checked on us all the time.
They deserve every penny you give 💗

The service was top notch! The lady was very polite and went above and beyond to help me with the large order. The food was good, but needed a little more to get that fifth star. The atmosphere is great if your an eagles fan. I recommend the supreme and the Philly pizza.

Best pizza in town and reheats the next day even better (that’s if there’s leftovers)! I enjoy supporting a small family business that really cares and creates delicious food. Can’t wait u until the next time I can treat myself!

During our trip to Vegas we were recommended to try Blueberry hill, west flamingo and we can see why. The menu was extensive, so much amazing choice. Service was fast and efficient with consistency on coffee refills and water. Sizes were great, food was tasty. It was so good we went back a second time before we left. If you are in Vegas Please visit! It's a must!!

!!pictures taken part way through meal!!
The service was good, we got in fast for how busy it was. Got our order put in quickly and food arrived quick. The pancake was good, we had the blueberry ones. The waffles tasted like something you’d get at a hotel breakfast so I wasn’t impressed and I wasn’t a huge fan of whatever the chicken was fried in, that was the traditional chicken and waffles. The eggs were real not the box stuff so that was good. The turkey sausage tasted as if it was prior frozen then thrown in the microwave then seared real quick, was not a fan. The hollandaise sauce  was good. We got a side order and added it to the eggs and the chicken. Other than that it wasn’t bad. I’m sure other things on the menu are good but we were just passing through. I would probably try a different place next time I’m in the area.

Wow! We were in Vegas for The Weekend and we were looking for a place for Breakfast off strip. So we kind of picked Blueberry Hill because it was close to Where we were staying. It will now be my go to place every time we are in town. Service is very Good and Friendly.  Food is exceptional.  You will not leave here hungry. My Beautiful Wife ate here Saturday morning and was such a great experience. We decided to come back Sunday morning.  Thank you Blueberry Hill keep up the good work
Best breakfast in Vegas! Food was super tasty and fresh. The service was great and the atmosphere was pretty nice. Large restaurant if you have a large party.

This place is a must visit, especially for breakfast. Had some of the best French toast with fresh fruit and amazing compote. Coffee was spot on as well. The quality of the product they use is noticeable. Our server was adequate, not the best but they were busy. The host, on the other hand, was absolutely incredible. Super friendly, funny, and quick to help my grandma (who is in a wheelchair) to find the perfect seat. We will absolutely be visiting again!

name: Stanton Social Italian
vicinity: 3570 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas

reviews.text:
This is a place you go when you want to pad your Instagram, not when you want great food.

Service and atmosphere were great but everything else fell short. I started with the tuna tacos and the "famous" French onion soup dumplings. The tuna tacos were decent but far from being something I would ever want again. They were server with lime which I think gave it too much acidity and took away from the dish. I think a ponzu sauce would have been a better choice.

The French onion soup dumplings are famous because they're probably the only restaurant that has them, not because they are good. I appreciate the creativity but unfortunately I thought they were less than decent. I would never order them again. A complete miss.

The Thai BBQ mushrooms were ok. I appreciated the fact that they served mushrooms in a non traditional way than you usually see at a steakhouse. I was still disappointed.

The French fries were run of the mill. Ordered them because they came recommended, disappointed that I did. Definitely nothing special.

The steak was actually really good and the reason I am giving Stanton Social Prime 3 stars instead of 4. It is a steakhouse after all so the steak should be good, and it was. Perfectly seasoned and cooked but the steak knife was all looks and not function.

I don't think I'll be back considering there are far better steakhouses just feet away. As nice as the service and atmosphere were, it just fell short where it mattered.
We loved the bolognese the lamb was also good. The service was great and the food was very good. It was abit expensive for what we got but thats kind of everywhere in vegas. Would definitely go back.

Scheduled a dinner here before heading to see Rod the Bod at the collisum. All I can say is that it was first class. Now, I was hindered a little from the 3 previous double shots of Bullet that I got at the bar while throwing sheklkles onto the gambling devices, but from what I remember and was told, we shared a streak and salad and had a delicious prawn appetizer, along with a couple drinks, a bottle of wine, then an after dinner beverage. I remember the concert, but not the Uber back🥴

The absolute best! The market fresh oysters were both from the East coast and West coast...soo good! The lightning was great and music fantastic! Big juicy scallops. Shout out to Norma & Tyler. Their service was outstanding & I believe they are without a doubt who made the dinner a WONDERFUL Experience!

The lamb chop and salmon were great. Fried eggplant was good as well. Service was fantastic. The restaurant only had a few tables occupied which felt little empty but that could be because of Sunday evening. Taste was great.

I'm glad I found this place while I was thrifting nearby, the food was very tasty and fresh.I felt like I was at home and my grandma made me breakfast. It was exactly what I was looking for. The staff was very attentive and friendly.

This place used to be a mix of mexican and salvadorian food but now its strictly mexican. They fired the salvadorian cook (very common for resturants for them to make the salvadorian train the mexican cook then immediately replace them) my family have been going to this place for the last 7 yrs but this last time they served us dry tortilla like pupusas and gave a a bowl of hot sauce. No true Salvadorian restaurant would ever give you tapatillo hot sauce for your pupusas. It does come with a sauce but not freaking store bought hot sauce. Im glad the last cook pulled a fast 1 on you guys cuz they definitely didn't teach the new guy right. Go down the street on Maryland for your salvadorian dishes.

Loved the food, variety (I was able to throw a papusa into a traditional combo 😀) and price… the little tangy cabbage salad, the micheladas, and the people working there were all amazing and a relief to the Vegas heat.  We just happened to be walking by when we first arrived in town, but I would make it a point to return my next trip, there’s a cool bar down the street next to Savers (half off Mondays!) too.

Wow! Just like home cooking ,I was so glad to find food just like I grew up eating traditional Salvadoran and Mexican dishes. Waitress was very helpful and attentive. You won't be disappointed, Great Job!
This place is a gem. The prices are fantastic and the food is tasty. I'm a big guy and I can barely finish 2 pupusas. The sauces are delicious .

name: Old School Sunday's @Caribbean Knights
vicinity: 2440 Las Vegas Blvd N, North Las Vegas

reviews.text: Stop playing, you’re charging 10 dollars to get into a empty building with a dj smh

name: Rockhouse
vicinity: 3377 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas

reviews.text: We were heading to an event at the Sphere  and popped in to grab lunch. We were seated right away and got some cocktails ordered. If you're a fan of espresso drinks, I found The Shakedown delightful. The stoli vanilla and kahlua combine to make it so balanced and smooth you definitely want more.  We went with the Mac Burger and Western 50/50. I found the combo of burger and pork patty with their BBQ sauce make the 50/50 a flavor winner!  The burger prices are low for the Vegas strip, but sides are sold separate.  We just ordered fries to share.  Our server was friendly and we liked the overall vibe of the place.  It's certainly worth checkin' out.

Nice place.  Walked in and sat at the bar while waiting for a show to start at the Sphere.  Ordered the Western 50/50 Burger and onion rings.  The beef & pork patties, with extra pork (bacon) were juicy and full of flavor.  The onion rings were large, plentiful and tasty.  Service was friendly, food was a bit slower than expected but not finger chewing late.  It was a good visit and I would go back.

Stayed the night at the Palazzo so this spot is any easy walk from our suite. It’s off of Las Vegas Blvd so that’s a plus too.
Had a 50oz. to share with a friend.
Service was great!
Wings and quesadillas could’ve been cooked a bit more, but flavor was alright.
Wedge salad was delish!
Good spot to meet up with friends if you don’t want to leave your hotel.

It's loud here today but it can't be helped when there is a conference group getting Together 😄. I asked for a Taste the Randow and the bartender has never made it before.  It come out looking like a cup of water you use to wash your paint brushes in. It may not be pretty but it is good. The hamburger sliders are good so are the chicken tacos. The vegetarian egg tastes good to. I am a happy camper. The staff is great.

Amanda and Freddy, amazing staff. Such courteous professional service. Wings, pretzel bites, and buffalo cauliflower very good.Beer cheese as good as anywhere. They carry all sports packages. TV audio very loud and clear. Great decor and ambiance.  Highly recommended.

I'm visiting Vegas for the week and wanted something quick and easy to take back to my room. Because I'm just visiting, I have no idea how to get around or where anything is without using a map. I ended up in the Albertson's parking lot where China Joe's is and figured instead of randomly driving around or spending time looking for something on Maps, I'd give China Joe's a try. The reviews were good, and I haven't had a bad experience with any Chinese food place I've been. I placed my order online and waited a little before going inside since the website said there would be a bit of a wait.

One of the gentleman there called me to confirm that I placed an order, and I went inside. After I paid, I waited maybe 10 minutes inside for both my meals to be ready. When I walked in, it was empty. While I waited, three other people came in for orders. One person ordered at the counter, and the other two were there for pickups. They all got their food quickly. Once I got back to my room, I was pleasantly surprised by the amount of food and the quality. Because I didn't have any expectations, I figured it'd be ok at best. It was perfect! It was made fresh, and the flavors are on point. I got two veggie egg rolls with my order, which I was also surprised by since I'd usually have to pay for them in Cali.

Overall, this place is a 10/10. I ordered orange chicken with half lo mein and half fried rice and honey shrimp also with half and half sides. The quality was perfect, the food was piping hot, and everything tasted great.
Ordered family dinner A for $33.95 with sweet and sour chicken and moo goo gai pan. Everything was very bland. The amount was fine and waited the normal amount of time.

The lady taking the order was very pleasant. It was my first time there and was patient in explaining the menu and recommended items. Items are made to order and very fresh, savory, and delicious. Highly recommend this hidden gem!
Really good Chinese food. The General Chicken is one of the best I’ve had in Vegas. Chicken corn soup is excellent. Prices are very affordable and I have enough for 2-3 meals.

This place was a complete waste of money. The orange chicken tasted like they poured orange soda in the sauce and my mushroom beef had no mushrooms in the dish. The portion size was small. As you can see no mushrooms and the portions barely fill the box.  I know this is take Chinese food but the entire $65 order was disappointing in every way. First and last time customer

name: Taste
vicinity: 7945 S Rainbow Blvd ste b, Las Vegas

reviews.text: Welcoming atmosphere with delicious food. The dishes are flavorful and well-presented that make it great for casual dining or a relaxed meal with friends. Service is friendly, adding to the overall pleasant experience.
Delicious food! I absolutely adore their 小笼包! Definitely coming again!

This place only gets one star because it's a good location in a nice part of town and the restaurant looks nice. The food is marginal at best. We went there and ordered the half roasted duck and it was all bones and the smaller parts of the duck. The breast was NOT included and neither were the larger parts of the thigh and drumstick. I could tell by the taste and size that they use the cheapest quality of duck available. The marinade tasted like it was out of a jar. We also ordered the deep fried pork shank and that too barely had any meat. The service was horrible. The deep fried shank arrived almost a half hour after the half roasted duck. Our server never came to check on us once after she served our food. I had to waive her over for more rice and two more times for more water and napkins. Every time I tried to waive her over she was on her phone. She had seemed annoyed every time we called her over. Horrible food and service. Especially given the price. If you want real Chinese food, go to Spring Mtn. Rd.

This place is authentic, the food temperature is perfect especially for slow eaters because it stays hot for a long time with the heated plates. Food is fresh and vibrant and the staff is beautiful & loving. Highly recommend this place.

The portions are big enough to share with two or three people.

They are also hosting monthly Business & Entrepreneurs elevation luncheons. First one on August 29th 2024 … No one leaves the elevation lunch the same. You will be better , improve your brand and have more customers. Great experience ..
Came here with family for a birthday. Got a variety of dishes and they were pretty decent. I did find it a bit salty (as most Chinese dishes are) but overall, the price was good for the portion.
I haven't ate Kabsa ever like this it's was so delicious. I recommend as a middle food.

I ordered Nigerian food catering from them, and the food was delicious! Ordering was easy and they accommodated all my requests. I can never find Nigerian and African food on this side of the states so I am so glad to have found my new favorite caterer!!
Delicious food and amazing Karak tea. Feels like you’re in the gulf. Come and try this food and you will come here everyday
Ordered Mandi and tasted very authentic. Great customer service and I’m happy to find a spot with very delicious and quality authentic food.
AfroHalal’s Mandi was absolutely delicious. The rice and chicken was very well-seasoned. I highly recommend this caterer to everyone in San Diego.

African Cuisine is an amazing restaurant with amazing food! They used to be a restaurant at the SDSU farmers market, but a while back opened up this restaurant with the same great food! They're great because they always pack the plates full!
The chicken is always moist and flavorful, and all their sides are incredible. They have 2 different rices, but i always get the saffron rice since i find it more flavorful and often has a piece of potato with it.
I also always get the spicy jerk chicken, but it can be pretty spicy, so be careful ordering it! And I recommend the lentils if you're unsure about a side!
There is plenty of seating inside, but they also wrap the plate in saran wrap if you're taking it to go.

Dropping my daughter off for school and wanted a quick bite. Stopped in here and was not disappointed! The girl at the counter was so helpful. She offered samples and even split up our servings so we could try everything. She gave us 1/2 sweet jerk chicken (which had a very small kick but more BBQ sweet) and 1/2 chicken curry. 1/2 curried lentils and 1/2 collard greens. We only paid $18 (I think) as we shared and were both stuffed! Everything was delicious. The inside dining only had 3 small tables in the A/C so we had to sit in the patio that was a little warm. But the food was so delicious and a great value! Will definitely be back as there were a lot of vegetarian selections were interested in.

Excellent and welcoming service. Was nearby looking for food and decided to give this place a shot. Amazing. Between my gf and I we tried everything, we got 2 of the big plates (2meats and 2 veggies and rice) and it was all amazing. The jerk chicken and curry chicken was so good i can't wait to come again. Also their drinks ( e got the mixed berry and mango) were perfect.

Also we had our dog with us and they had no issue with us dining inside, the dining area is really nice.

If you don't visit this spot trust me you're missing out.
Really nice & positive service, great portion size, awesome vegan potions, everything was super tasty. Worth my visit for sure and happy to get some restaurant food that’s veg forward. Thank you!!

Very nice comfy restaurant 👌🏼 open space...The food here was delicious 😋flavorful first time trying it & i was satisfied💯I got the large plate: coconut rice,sweet chicken,curry chicken,plantains,collard greens they give you alot of food!You get your money's worth plus some🎯
I highly recommend this place. I will be going back 😊with my family!
Worst chapatis ever. Do not buy their chapatis. They are burnt ,dry and greasy they taste like the been cooked 3 or 4 days ago and they are selling them. Please dont buy

I would give African Spice a 100/5 stars if I could for all of the above categories food, service, and atmosphere. Since my first time trying it, I honestly can't stop thinking about the food. The sambusa was the star of my very first visit with it being crispy on the outside and perfectly seasoned on the inside. It is just packed with so much flavor and a must have! You can tell it’s made fresh because every bite has that perfect crunch. It is definitely one of the best sambusas I’ve ever had. Another thing I love about African Spice is the customer service. It is family owned and you can feel the warmth as soon as you walk in. They are always giving me free samples to try of new dishes and desserts. Everything is done in a timely manner and made to perfection. Every time I went it genuinely felt like they cared about making the experience enjoyable. If you’re looking for delicious East African food with warm service then African Spice is absolutely worth a visit.

Food was delicious! We ordered the fufu with lamb, chicken squash, and some chicken sambusas and all of the dishes had a unique exquisiteness to them all served in generous portions. The man behind the counter was nice and allowed us to turn off the fan hitting our table when we got cold. We will definitely be back
The only place where you can have best food is in the town of San Diego is here
Yummy Somalian food. Food cooked fresh and good price. Nice people working at the restaurant

I ordered Egusi, Efo, and Suya, and honestly every single dish was a big disappointment. The food was very low standard and tasted wacky, like no care was put into it at all. This is my first time visiting San Diego, and sadly this restaurant gave me a terrible experience with no good memories. The pictures of the food look nice online, but in real life the food is nothing close to that just very underwhelming and not worth it at all. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

I tried almost everything on the menu at Fufu Lounge, and my absolute favorite was the jollof rice with plantain and protein. Add on the suya on the side for an extra delight! Definitely a 10/10 meal! The flavors were spot on and tasted just like authentic, home-cooked Nigerian food.
The service was amazing, with a super friendly owner and staff who made the whole experience even better. Even with delivery, the food arrived with such great quality and care!
If you’re looking for a spot with delicious Nigerian food and great vibes, Fufu Lounge is it. Highly recommend!

First time ordering. It’s better you order online first since from reading the reviews they only have one chef on duty at a time. I ordered through Uber Eats.

I got the Ofada stew with plantain and pepper soup with plantain, but be aware — neither comes with any meat or fish. You have to order protein separately, which was surprising. Luckily, a lady chef from the restaurant called to confirm and kindly added protein (I requested goat meat) at no extra charge. The protein was very small & the  food itself was very salty, almost too salty to enjoy. Pickup was easy through their food locker. Overall, an okay experience that seems to depend on which chef is cooking that day.

I ordered eba with egusi and the meat literally smells like rotten. The meat also had some weird green film on the outside. This was my first time eating this type of food so I assumed it must be normal but after trying other places and reading these reviews im convinced there is something wrong with this restaurant. im not the type to waste food but I threw the whole $40 meal away. Would not recommend.

I have order their suya and jollof rice thru door dash nearly 10 times. I used to live in Atlanta and go to Nigerian restaurant there religiously and after trying different Nigerian restaurants, even in Nevada their Suya is the closest I have ever tasted to the one from Atlanta. They also have this very very rich, hobo ginger, spice purple drink, and sometimes it’s not in stock and they gave you the grsvf  drink, which is the only reason I gave a four star. Sometimes the suya can be a little dry it comes with raw red onions exactly how it was served in ATL Overall, the experience is really lovely. I have never been in store but just having the same food from 10 years ago definitely the best Nigerian place in town.

I came to Flavors of East Africa today for the first time years. I brought my folks with me because they’ve never had East African food. Overall the experience was awesome and just as good as I remember from years back!

We ordered sweet jerked chicken, Kuku curry chicken, fried eggplant, plus two types of rice, collard greens, and mashed potatoes. Of course, these side items all have African names but for the sake of clarity I’ve written out their nearest English adjacent dish titles.

The chicken in both dishes was absolutely incredible! It tasted like it had been stewing for hours. The flavors were deep, aromatic, and memorable. It’s hard to choose a favorite between the two chicken dishes, but the jerked chicken’s sauce was incredible…at the same time, the chicken breast in the curry was extremely succulent and had a coconut-y vibe.

The veggies and rice were all pretty tasty as well, with the mashed potatoes and eggplant being highlights. The eggplant’s tomato relish topping is a little oily, so it pairs better with some rice. The turmeric & ginger juice I had was also delightful—they added some sugar or honey to it so it wasn’t extremely overpowering.

All in all, I definitely recommend Flavors of East Africa. It’s a really high-quality, consistent spot for amazing meat dishes—including oxtails, stewed beef, goat curry, and more—and it isn’t overpriced for the portion and level of craftsmanship they bring.

P.S. If you’re looking for a slightly cheaper version of the same great food, come anytime before 5pm to get access to the lunch combos, which bring the same punch for $3-5 less per plate.

Ann was so hospitable and the food and service were great! We tried the lunch combinations so we were able to try 3 types of chicken, beef, 4 veggies, all 3 rice and ugali. Lots of food for the money. We enjoyed sitting outside on a beautiful day.

The food tastes great, very well flavored. And the lunch portion was overflowing my plate. I ordered the spicy jerk chicken, beef stew, coconut rice, fried plantain, and eggplant. They gave me a sample of the ugali, which was delicious with the stews. I would definitely come back.

Ive been coming here now for 3 years, and every time, without fail, my meal has been fresh, flavorful, and fricken delicious. If youre vegan/vegetarian and you haven't tried this place, get off your ass and come check it out. Such a highlight in my life and I hope they never ever close.

We didn't go to the restaurant but we had their food at the Ocean Beach Farmers Market and it was INCREDIBLE. We had decent portions of both the sweet and the spicy (level 4 out of 10) jerk chicken, a bunch of different rices, collard greens, and fried plantains (oh the plantains...!). Highly recommend their food!

name: Nigeria Breeze Restaurant
vicinity: 925 E Plaza Blvd Suite 106, National City

reviews.text:
This was my first time trying Nigerian food, and I’m really glad I stopped by Nigerian Breeze. I ordered several items, including the fish, igese, spicy beef, plantains, and a meat pie.

The fish was amazing — the flavor and texture were absolutely on point. It was cooked perfectly and easily became my favorite dish of the night. The spicy beef definitely lives up to its name; it’s very spicy, so if you’re sensitive to heat, I’d suggest skipping that appetizer. The plantains were perfectly cooked, sweet, and flavorful.

The meat pie was delicious overall, though it had a bit more bread than meat. I would’ve loved a little more filling, but it was still enjoyable.

Overall, I’m really happy I came here and tried something new. The atmosphere is great for a date or a relaxed meal — plenty of seating, no overpowering music, and a comfortable space for conversation. I’d definitely come back and recommend it to anyone curious about Nigerian cuisine.

I had an incredible experience at this Nigerian restaurant! The food was not only flavorful and authentic, but the quantity was so satisfying — you definitely get your money’s worth. The quality of every dish truly stood out, from the seasoning to the texture. Whether you’re craving jollof rice, egusi soup, or peppered meat, everything was cooked to perfection.

I dined in and also ordered takeout, and I was impressed both times. The packaging for the takeout was top-notch — secure, neat, and still hot when I got home. The service was just as amazing — warm, professional, and attentive from start to finish.

I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants a true taste of Nigeria with excellent value and top-tier service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

First time trying this place and Nigerian food and I loved the experience. Authentic Nigerian dishes and the service was really great. During our stay we noticed a lot of clients coming in to purchase to go. I strongly recommend. My son even used his hands to try the fufu. The portions are very big, enough to share and actually spicy but not too spicy.

This was my mother and I’s first time coming to this restaurant and trying this type of food and we were very pleased with our experience! The food was delicious and the service was great, very friendly people! Highly recommend!!

Huge shoutout to the owner Maria for the amazing hospitality and food! We came in right before a rush, everyone came in and ready to devour the delicious food! Definitely one of my favorite restaurants in SoCal!!! We literally couldn’t decide which of the dishes we liked more! This is a must try!
The location of the restaurant might discourage you but the food is really good. After moving out of San Diego, I still drive an hour just to order my favorite rice and goat. Worth the drive !!!
Amazing food and genuine hospitality, they treat you like family! I love how humble the place feels.
Worst service out of all the Somali restaurants in the city. Matter of fact, worst service I’ve ever seen in any restaurant if you can call this a restaurant.

This had to have been the most "unpretentious" place I have ever eaten at in recent memory! I thought I had entered an auto repair facility but then I noticed some gentlemen sharing the evening Iftar meal. They beckoned me to a nearby table and the chef soon came and took my request. There was no menu, just suggestions of what he was offering this day.

Moments later, he returned with a heaping plate of macaroni, salad, chicken, and rice. It was so good and the price was so compelling that I left with an order of flank steak, macaroni, salad and rice for the following day’s Iftar dinner. Good food is wherever you find it!

The food is amazing!! We got the spicy and sweet chicken, coconut rice, plantains, and juice. We got there at 8:01pm, because the website says they are open until 9, and Google says they are open until 8:30. The blonde woman who works there was incredibly kind. She heated us up food to go even though they were technically closed. Amazing food and employees. But please update your hours.

Small restaurant serving delicious home cooked Somali cuisine for 16 years.  It is located in a strip mall that’s not fully occupied.  Its menu is limited and occasionally they might not have some of the dishes.  However, once you take a bite of the food, you will forget about all of that, as all things are cooked just right, with good flavors that are not overpowering, and in good portions.

The goat plate is very tender and the fish in both fish wrap and fish salad is moist and savory.
Service is polite and courteous.  There’s a discount for cash payments, too.

During our recent visit, it was impossible not to notice that nearly every table had ordered the "2 Person or More Sports Plate." At just $35, this platter is an absolute steal, especially given the generous portions. The chicken and beef were seasoned to perfection, delivering a depth of flavor that truly impressed. The pasta, served with a marinara sauce — my toddler’s favorite. The platter also came with a fresh, crisp salad and refreshing mixed drinks, making it a well-rounded meal. You can feel the warmth and love in hearty Somalian food.

We opted for the watermelon and mango drinks, which were delightfully sweet and refreshing — just what we needed on a sweltering summer day.

The service was exceptional; the staff was not only attentive but genuinely warm and welcoming. To top it all off, they surprised us with complimentary sambusas, a thoughtful touch that left a lasting impression.

Overall, this spot delivers on both quality and value, making it a must-try for anyone looking to enjoy a satisfying, well-priced meal for a family. Highly recommended!
Amazing Somali food, very flavorful! Perfect place to bring friends and family

I went with my husband cause I was really interested since the name "Farida's" and my name is Farida lol (I'm the Mexican that went the other day) and the service was 10/10 it really worth it the price since they give you big portion and is so delicious + they gave us banana which I feel really respected as they want us to eat the traditional way, the rice has delicious flavor, the goat, the bread the best! Really really worth it, I love it, I can't wait to go back!

This is my go-to restaurant for take out Somali food.  We always order the Chicken suucqar with rice, pasta, and salad.  So delicious with big portions!  The green hot sauce is pretty spicy and flavorful and the ranch is really good too.  Make sure to get it with the mango or watermelon juice, and the side of banana for the full experience!

The best spicy chicken sandwich I have ever tasted! The flavor is so bomb. I devoured mine so quickly. The samosas are also so good. Definitely will be back and I highly recommend for all chicken sandwich lovers.

Sabor Piri-Piri was some of the best unique ethnic food (Mozambique/African) food I've had!

We first had them by ordering online and having them delivered. We got their sweet potato and also their chicken peanut curry. We really liked the food, so we then went physically to check out more menu items.

We ended up having the red chicken curry made with their (slightly spicy) Piri-Piri sauce! And omg that was amazing! Apparently Piri-Piri is a spicy pepper from Africa, so it had a unique flavor I never had in San Diego. Their kale and black eyed peas was made with the same sauce so it gave it that nice slightly sweet and spicy flavor. I honestly didn't have high hopes but it ended up being one of my favorite items! The staff was welcoming and really nice. They answered my questions as I was unsure and new to Mozambique curry.

The shop is really small but has decent seating inside as well as a nice spot outside to eat. There's Tahona next door (great to grab to go margaritas), so it's nice to grab a few different items with friends and enjoy the spread outside with a Marg!

There's still more on the menu we haven't tried, so we want to go again!

I really like Sabor Piri Piri from eating it at the farmers market.  The restaurant didn’t disappoint. We are outside. I didn’t take a picture of my food from the beginning but I made up by taking pics of the menu. The chicken samosas are delicious!

Sabor Piri Piri is the place to go for some delicious food! We had Eva cater samosas for our staff and those Samosas flew off the tray. The sweet and spicy sauce was amazing, everyone kept raving about it! The sauce paired perfectly with the chicken and vegan samosas. We loved hearing all about how she learned to make samosas. She was so sweet and knowledgeable about her craft. Can’t wait to try more of her delicious food!
Healthy and comforting all in one bowl! This place is really making a name for themselves. Very delicious and for a good price. Definitely highly recommend.
The rice and lamb was absolutely spectacular and the price was very good huge portions probably enough for two people unless you eat a lot of food

The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor! The service was fast and friendly, and the staff made us feel very welcome. The atmosphere was clean, cozy, and perfect for a relaxing meal.
Highly recommend this place.
amazing service! the staff went above and beyond to make sure we had a fantastic dining experience.

I came across this randomly and it was awesome!  The salmon and spaghetti were perfectly seasoned with interesting spices and a peppery green sauce for some kick!  I can’t wait to try other items!  There’s no menu on the wall or anywhere to be found which to me is exciting! The staff and customers were very friendly :-)

Im So Glad i Ran into this Place
... the stuff is Very Friendly and Helpful... and the food is very Good!!

My first time here and it was a wonderful experience!!! The food, customer service, ambience ---everything was out of the world. We hand the Mandi rice with half chicken and Beef  (order for 2) but 3 of us couldn't finish it.  It came with soup which was so delicious, a side vegetable and salad. I also ordered the Sambusas.... so very delicious and that's because it was made from the scratch.  The price was very reasonable.  I ordered my Mandi rice with half chicken and sliced beef. But by mistake they put both chicken meat. When I brought it to their attention, they immediately brought me the beef  and let us enjoy the sliced chicken as well. It was a wonderful customer service they provided. They served banana with the meal which we are not used to and the owner who standing nearby explained the whole story behind it. So we not only enjoyed a great  10 out of 10 dinner, we also learned history too!!  I also tried the cinnamon tea. It was so fresh and refreshing.  We heard about this place and drove 130 miles from North Hollywood to try them and IT WAS WORTH THE DRIVE.  We are planning to go back again with our friends soon to try the goat meat (which they were out of when we went because of high demand). I wish all at the Bisbas  restaurant all the Best. Keep up the good work and THANK YOU FOR TREATING US SO WELL.

First time trying Somali food. I'm so glad it was here! Heard good things about the cuisine and always wanted to try it. Was looking for a lunch spot between the Toyota dealer and home (near SDSU) and noticed the 4.9 rating. Went for dinner on a Thursday night. Not very crowded. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Menu was varied, portions were generous and prices were very fair (for the quality and quantity of the food, we each took half of our entrées home!).
I had the Chapati KK Chicken ($16), which was diced up flatbread mixed in an amazing sauce, with chopped chicken, onions and peppers. Served with a wedge of lemon, some very flavorful, but VERY spicy "salsa" on the side, and ... a banana! I also tried the traditional Vimto drink, a carbonated spiced jamaica drink served cold over ice (tasty). 😁
My wife got the Goat Mandi, served with a generous serving of rice pilaf and a green salad ($22). It came with the same nuclear hot green sauce and a kind of ranch dressing and a garnish of seasoned fries, and ... a banana! The goat was falling off the bones tender (some of which were very small, so exercise caution there) and the flavors were exotic and delicious (she took more than half of hers home, too). Part of that might have been the desire to try their fries, which I saw came with other dishes on the menu. I figured $5 for a side of fries just to be able to try them was a good deal. They brought them out late (after I inquired), but it was a whole heaping plate of shoestring fries (think McDonald's, but better) and they were too good to leave (took half of them home, too!) 😎
She also had the hot Shaah Caadeys (Somali spiced tea with milk), like an Indian Chai, but not too sweet.
Both of the young men working were very pleasant, friendly and helpful, taking the time to explain everything and patiently answering our questions. The setting is just a strip mall in an odd part of town, but they have obviously taken pride and care to create a warm, welcoming space. ALL of the dishes were absolutely delicious and the dinnerware was beautiful, in contrast to the cheesy napkins and the over stock stacked near the bathroom. 😁
We will DEFINITELY be back to try the rest of the menu and are very glad to have another wonderful variety of great, international food in the neighborhood.

Great Somali restaurant. It was absolutely worth my drive from LA to try this amazing restaurant. Food was delicious and the prices were very reasonable given the amount of food. My wife and daughter loved it. Will be back to try again soon.

Bisbas Restaurant is hands-down the best Somali spot in San Diego! From the moment I walked in, the warm, welcoming vibe and the incredible aromas pulled me right in. This place truly transports you with authentic flavors that are bold, fresh, and perfectly balanced.

I ordered the half chicken with rice, and wow—it was a masterpiece. The chicken was marinated in rich Somali spices, grilled to juicy perfection with that beautiful char, and served in a massive, shareable portion (though I didn’t want to share!). The rice was fluffy, fragrant, and mixed with veggies, and that creamy green bisbas sauce on the side? Absolute fire—spicy, herby, and addictive. I couldn’t stop dipping everything in it!
The service was top-notch—friendly, attentive, and happy to explain the dishes. I also tried the Somali spiced tea (shaah), which was the perfect sweet finish. Everything felt homemade and made with love.

If you’re craving real Somali cuisine, big portions, and a genuine cultural experience, Bisbas is a must-visit. I’ll be back soon—5 stars all the way! Highly recommend to everyone in SD! 🇸🇴🍗

Man ! First time having Somalian food and it was amazing ! I came here with my buddy and we started off with mango drinks and Sambusa ! Super good both a must try. We got the platter for two and the portion was huge ! We got half rice and half pasta for our base, with a half chicken and goat mendi as our proteins. Then I got the beef suqaar plate and that meat was so flavorful. My buddy got the  beef bisteeki fries( similar to carne asada fries ) which he loved ! We both finished off with Dubai chocolate! Definitely coming to this spot to try some items ! Restaurant was clean! Service was great !

I highly highly recommend this place. Not only the food but the people are beautiful. Will make you feel a part of their family. We told them that a few of us are having Ethiopian for the first time and they made sure it’s a great experience.

We ordered a Vegan special platter and got to try a bit of everything. One vegan special is sufficient for two people. My friends also got the Ethiopian Tej (honey wine). It was too strong for me but they absolutely loved it.

My daughter and I wanted to try Ethiopian food and we were not disappointed. The cafe is neat with lovely and unique decor, the menu is extensive and reasonably priced and the food was very good. We shared the vegan sampler plate and it was more than enough for us both. The service was fast, and the server took the time to explain the food and answer our questions about the process of making the injera. It was a lovely cultural experience that I would gladly repeat.

This is my go-to Ethiopian spot in San Diego! I usually get the vegan special and add another veggie or meat dish. It’s always delicious! The vegan special has 8 good dishes. I also appreciate that I can eat a lot and still feel great afterward, not heavy or sluggish.

There’s street parking in the front of the restaurant or the side street. I like to park in the back lot and then enter through the back entrance.

Just a heads-up, they serve tap water for free or you can buy bottled water.

Delicious food! My first time here and I’ll be sure to return. Staff was friendly and gave me some wonderful recommendations. We started with the house salad and sambusa try both the potato and lentil! So so good!
We were a party or two and ordered the meat combo! Plenty of food more than enough for two! I tried the Ethiopian honey wine, it was also good not too sweet. Beautiful decor and music. Thank you!

Ethiopian decor, very unique.  Meals served on large, round, thin bread plates with rolled bread that were in place of forks.  Very similar Middle Eastern/ Arabian style. The place was very clean and the service was very good.  They roasted the coffee beans when we ordered and it was delicious. Great place to go if you are looking for a different experience. Parking is on the street so it can be unpredictable.

Food was great. Service was excellent. Ginger tea was amazing. I really enjoyed the me combo. I usually eat the vegan combo meal, but this time I decided to try the meat combo. It did not disappoint. Very nice environment to have a nice conversation with my friend. Music was not too loud.

This is a restaurant run by an Ethiopian from Africa, which has been in business for many years. The shop has a very unique style, full of local cultural characteristics. The owner is very enthusiastic and will guide you on how to order. Traditionally, Ethiopian meals are served on a large injera—a type of flatbread—topped with various stews, meats, and vegetables. You eat by tearing off pieces of the injera and using them to scoop up the dishes, which is a distinctive experience. If you’ve never tried Ethiopian food before, it’s worth a visit. However, the injera has a sour taste overall, and neither my friend nor I were quite accustomed to it—but it was all part of the experience.

I have taken my friends here twice. Would be way more if I lived closer! The food is delicious!! The portions are large and the service is fast. The owner is very kind and funny. I love coming here. Please give it a try!

Excellent food.

We had ethiopian wine and beer that actually paired very well with each other. I had a veggie plate while my partner had the lamb.

They have redone the dining room beautifully. The service is, as always, amazing they make you feel like a member of the family. The food is incredible, it's so delicious and they even have gluten-free and injerra if you let them know that you need it. We will always be back. It's a family tradition and such a fun place to take food adventurers.

You can definitely tell that they take their time to cook. It shows in the taste. The burrito shell is put on the grill for the perfect amount of time. The ingredients taste fresh. I am totally going back, God willing.

This restaurant, formerly owned by a Somali owner, is now owned by a Mexican owner. Surprisingly, they don’t offer any halal food except for salmon fish with pasta. However, I tried the salmon fish with pasta, and it was incredibly delicious. I highly recommend it.

Food was absolutely delicious. I finally found an amazing pasta spot, that also sells a variety of different food, located in SD! Easy to spot, vibes are cool, and employees are very nice n helpful. Portions and prices are reasonable and worth it too!

Nice owner. The neighborhood guys comes around and talk a lot.
Noise but fun and chill out
Goat rice was fantastic. It tastes balance moisture and has great flavor. Free banana water, so friendly and welcoming atmosphere.

The food was great.  Service is friendly.  Prices are reasonable.  The only thing preventing me from giving 5 stars is the cleanliness.  I got pictures of the sticky napkin holder and one if the disgusting fans.  The floor has loose tiles which is a safety hazard.  It's a shame these people don't put as much pride in their facility as they obviously do in their food and service.

name: BLUE NILE Ethiopian market and restaurant

reviews.text: This place is LITERALLY A HIDDEN GEM! Modest kitchen in the back of a market with kind people & DELICIOUS food. I had the Abay Special T'ibs (Chikina) & added collard greens + lentils. The food was so flavorful, hearty and comforting. It was a good amount of food, and despite being super hungry, I saved about 1/2 for my next meal to go. Although it was delicious, after tax/tip I paid $45 for this plate of food. the sides seemed a bit overpriced given their size. this is my second visit & I’ll be back to again to explore the menu further with some of their more affordable options. Impressive food, low key atmosphere and so satisfying 🇪🇹🤤

This is a delightful little place. Restaurant is in back of store and it is absolutely delicious. Really cool staff and it’s hard to describe the tastiness of the food. Absolutely authentic- don’t expect silverware and don’t complain about it. Use the fantastic injera bread and enjoy the entire experience!

This is a chill, unassuming hole in the wall spot - so you know the food is going to be GOOD. This restaurant did not disappoint. So delicious. Run by very kind people. Don’t sleep on this restaurant! There is a small downstairs part of the restaurant in the back behind the storefront, but there is also an upstairs area which I did not see. Highly recommend.

Excellent dining experience at SD's newest Ethiopian restaurant utilizing the outdoor patio space. Everything was made fresh to order, and the awazé (hot sauce) was super savory and spicy! Will definitely be coming here again our my next trip. Highly recommend for Vegan, vegetarian, carnivore and those with food allergies!
We love Ethiopian food and this place was truly a hidden gem. The food was on point we got the vegetarian platter and durowat and sigwat.

Absolutely delightful. Came here a few times, food was great every time. And the novelty (i.e. you have to eat with your hands) was fun for my friends’ first time experience. I love the spices and the flavor of the food! I don’t know much about their food culture but I got a briefing every single time by the waiter. He is very friendly and humorous! Would definitely still go back.

This place is pretty special, you can't get good Ethiopian food just anywhere. It's fun to eat the injera bread with the entree of your chosing. For anyone who's never tried it, it reminds me of Indian food but with spongy bread instead of rice. They offer beers from Ethiopia and surrounding nations (I recommend the Walia). It's a unique experience and definitely worth checking out. I hope they open up a restaurant in northern San Diego some day.

Extremely friendly staff, they gave us extra complimentary options to try. Good food, definitely try their sambusas, absolutely delicious. The entree was a bit a mild on the flavor, but definitely a 4/5. Make a reservation prior to visiting, it's a small cute place, fills up fast.
Incredible food, every bite was amazing! Also our server was working really hard serving a bunch of tables mostly by himself and he was so kind and energetic. Highly recommend any of the shiros!

Muzita was such an enjoyable experience  for all our senses. It was our first time experiencing Abyssinian food and it won’t be the last. Abel cheerfully greeted us upon entry and helped us with our order. What a great ambassador for his cuisine. We decided on 3 vegetarian lunch specials. We thoroughly enjoyed each one of them. You taste the multi layers of flavors and spices and we didn’t even miss eating meat, it was so satisfying. Abel was attentive, gracious and we loved how happy he was to share his  culture with us

My review is based on take out.
I’m from Haitian-Brooklyn. So I was nervous coming here thinking it wouldn’t be good. But the food was delicious.
The staff is friendly and service was smooth.
I ordered Griot and diri djon djon (fried pork and mushroom rice ) paid $30.  It’s a lot of food.  You won’t be mad
I love the fact they fry the griot when you order and it’s not just siting in warmer.  It tasted nice and fresh. They give a nice amount of sauce which was real tasty.
The rice was full of flavor. They definitely have a the Haitian flavors.  They have seating for those who wants to dine in.  Looks quiet and clean.
You have to go up the stairs to get into the restaurant.  So if you drive by and don’t see much activity in front just keep that in mind.   I will definitely be back.

Delicious food within walkable distance from home. Pleasure to try Haitian food. I got the jerk chicken and husband got the oxtail. Food was fresh and tasted authentic. The spices came together nicely in the jerk chicken and it gave the broth a kick which I liked. I would recommend this place and I like the Mom and Pop feel.
Great food. The chicken was not dry at all, and the amount of rice I got was enough for 2 people. The passion fruit juice was super sweet.

This restaurant is one of the best in town. The food has a unique taste. We, the whole family, ordered different food and had a taste from each other plate. We had fish, goat, chicken, plantain, and mixed rice. Everything was outstanding. The people are very nice. Highly recommended with five stars.

It was our first time to eat at this Haitian restaurant and we loved the food we ordered. We had the Bouillon soup and it became an instant favorite. We also had their fried plantains and pikilz and it goes really well with our food. We also had the jerk chicken and rice and beans and it's really really sumptuous and hearty. We will definitely come back.

name: Awesome Jamaican Jerk Wings by Laylahs

reviews.text: I love the small family filling when I come into this establishment. I have been out of the country and craving Jamaican food. Now that I'm back... I've found my second kitchen 😍.  I think I eat here like 2-3 times a week. :)

Food was total Garbage I found a piece of plastic in the hard salty rice. The stew chicken was stale and was breaking up in pieces. Good attendant didn’t have the courtesy to apologize or offer something else I just threw the food away. He went on to replying under my review stating I’m Brooke n I should never return. They really need to close this place down seem like there are not following proper health protocols and serving stale food

Upon returning from a three-city trip in Jamaica, I immediately looked for places that serve the food I in Kingston,  Ocho Rios, and Montego Bay. I don’t have to look any further. This is my third visit having eaten curry goat, jerk chicken, and beef and chicken patty. I have been absolutely pleased. Each worker that I have encountered were very kind and conversational. I felt right at home. I HIGHLY recommend Laylah’s.
I love their jerk chicken plate. Every time I'm in San Diego, I will make sure to grab a plate, it's very difficult to find great jerk.

I always drive by here, but never tried it until today. I got a Patty and a slice of Lemon cake. Customer service was amazing, the lady register is SO SWEET and helpful. The patty is so flaky and satisfying. The lemon cake was my FAVORITE! So moist and just the right amount of sweetness. Will come here again, no doubt!!

Although there is not seating and a little strange to drive up to, it was well worth it! The food was fresh, the chicken delicious, and super friendly service! I would’ve added a picture, but it smelled so good I kinda forgot before devouring it lol.

I would suggest to order online then call after arriving so they know you have arrived. The entire trip was only 15min (10min drive and 5min wait at the location).

We will definitely return!

Amazing falafel bowl!!  And service with a smile - delivery to your vehicle!  Almost didn’t stay because we didn’t realize you can’t even order at a counter, but so happy we did.

So, order online, then head over there and check in (online). It’s actually a cool setup if you have somewhere to enjoy the amazing food.

Wow! Yummy!! I was very impressed with the food from here, and the wrap I got was HUGE! Plus the pickup was super simple and quick. Be aware this place looks like it’s a warehouse which threw me off at first, but you just call and they bring it right out to you. My only suggestion would be for better signage so that customers can find it more easily. I don’t believe there is an “inside” but I could be wrong, I just didn’t see one or where you would go in.
Amazing food! Just order ahead and pickup. I  had the saffron chicken kabob bowl and it was incredible. High quality and good sized portions.

If you haven’t tried Fusion Kebab yet, you’re seriously missing out! The flavors are absolutely incredible ,a perfect blend of spices, juicy meats, and delicious sauces that come together in every bite. Even if you try it just once, I promise you’ll be hooked. It’s that good! The quality of the ingredients is top-notch, and you can really taste the care that goes into every dish.
