An absolute vibe!!! Eddie V's is everything!!! I was there with a soon to be husband and wife celebrating thier upcoming nuptials. The decor and ambiance are unmatched! My favorite piece had to be the wine wall. Our server was knowledgeable, sweet and funny. Our order came quick. THE DRINKS AND FOOD ARE UNMATCHED!!!! The Love Eddie is a must have! I had shrimp cocktail, lamb chops and asparagus and BAAAABY WHEN I SAY I WAS SATISFIED!!! You pay for what you get, so with that being said, the prices are absolutely reasonable!

Made a reservation for my husbands 45th birthday. When we got there I checked us in.  They seated us very quickly and when we got to the table, it was beautifully decorated with rose petals, and confetti. Our server was very accommodating as we had our 3yr and 4yr old. He made sure our questions were answered, gave us the specials, recommended a good whine for my liking. The kids asked him questions and he was happy to joke with them and answer questions. Our food came out pretty quick as well. Everything was delicious, didnt need any seasoning whatsoever... the place itself was beautiful. All the staff was really nice and welcoming. Dessert was amazing.
I think we will be celebrating here more often💗

Their surf and turf special was pretty solid, as well as their mashed potatoes. I especially enjoyed the live music, our waiters' hospitality, and the atmosphere inside the restaurant. Overall, a great experience with good food and good vibes.

This place was really something special. The WW1 vibe was done with such attention to detail. The ambience and food was just incredible. The pictures of the exterior really don't do it justice. The tri-plane is worth a close inspection. I have never had a brunch that had such a variety of outstanding food. 94th Aero should be on your list of places to visit for a unique dining experience.

The theming was great.  Amazing world war I artifacts.  Awesome atmosphere! Be aware that the food was not good at all.  What appeared to be all the same exact shaped round meatloaf slices like what you buy in the frozen section of your grocery store freezer aisle.   Just be aware before you go.  If you like great theming, interested in World War I, and don’t care as much about the food… then definitely worth a visit.  If you are Weston’s the hefty price to Include good food, then definitely skip it.

Overall sadly I would have to say I didn't love this place. We went here with a couple of friends for Sunday brunch we had a reservation but still had to wait almost 30 minutes in line. We got sat in the back with a ton of big tables I felt like I was in a work banquet hall and I honestly hated it. It really tainted my dining experience. I felt like I was in a motel brunch. The food quality is fairly decent but the layout of the restaurant and Buffet is not appealing at all. And for $86 per person it's definitely not worth the price. I think it's just not my vibe or type of restaurant I would enjoy. I will say the service and everyone who works there is very nice in hospitable but does not offset the overall experience feels very cheap.

I've been coming to this place for about ten years. I even planned my wedding here. Sense, either new owners or covid or whatever excuse that they're gonna use has happened.The service has gone down.The buffet for holidays is now a hundred dollars and they no longer include free champagne. David's scheduled us for eleven o'clock in the morning, even though they didn't open till twelve, so we had to wait around for an hour. We even have a text confirmation stating that they made our reservation for eleven. I don't know what's going on with this place.But the quality of service has gone significantly downhill.The food has gotten worse. Service is now subpar They randomly tell you that the omelet line will be available on the christmas buffet, then when we get there, it's not available. People remembered a vote with your wallet. If a place like this exists, stop going there so they no longer make money and hopefully go out of business or fix their problems. Ninety fourth aero owners.I'm talking to you get yourselfs together and fix this.

This place used to be very good. It has gone way downhill with mediocre food and zero service. Do not go for their very over priced holiday buffet. It is all store bought food. Sliced deli turkey and ham. The desserts included tiny hostess donuts as a choice. Be prepared to pay at the door including tip!! That is a big red flag as they will not refund anything. A sign at the front even states No refunds. Sadly, no more Aero Squadron for me.

The food was wonderful. Dishes from West Africa, Dominica, Puerto Rico and Colombian were all authentic, flavorful and well balanced. The tropical fresh salad was my favorite starter. The Jerk Chicken, super spicy, with jollof rice was my favorite main. The music and ambience were dynamic and fun.

This place has changed over the years and it's a good change, although it's known as a nightclub it's also a restaurant / bar, the food is Caribbean so usually you can get Puerto rican, Dominican and sometimes Jamaican food. They have two bars and plenty of drinks and the service is very good. At least a couple of times a week they will have live music and a DJ every weekend. The only negative is that they are only open on certain days typically Friday, Saturday as a club and restaurant but Sunday's usually just the restaurant. But I've been informed that it's also available as a venue so I believe that will make this place even better.

Amazing food! Highly recommend!! Attended a special event with ten tasting and drinks.  The event was a set price which was more than if just eating a regular meal, hence the higher price per person rating on this review.

This was an amazing opportunity and on my Birthday! The hospitality, entertainment but most of all the food was very enjoyable and greatly appreciate it to put together all the different island and African flavors was incredible. Thank you so much.😊 ❤️💋

Amazing experience.  The food took you on a journey to the true spiciness and bold flavors the world has to offer. Definitely a welcoming experience and an added exciting addition to San Diego county.

Excellent experience... The owner is so nice what a great place. I only tried two items on my first visit. The breakfast sandwich was a nice size and delicious. The cappuccino was so good. You can take out or eat in.

We really enjoyed the food here. I got the egg sandwich and it was exceptional, so well seasoned. My wife got the fava bean dish, which was also so good. Freshly made food with very attentive service. Definitely worth the visit.

This egg sandwich has to be one of the best I've had. It was fresh and tasty. Bread was soft but with a crispy top... Yummy. The balsamic lemon drizzle she makes from scratch. It is delicious! The sandwich wasn't heavy on the tummy. Cappuccino was delightful. Tried the beef sambusas...crispy and meat well seasoned. The woman was so friendly and cheerful. Definitely recommend trying this place.

Wonderful customer service and good food!!

Me and my family enjoyed our visit to this little coffee. I absolutely recommend, if you want to enjoy authentic experience of a little travel to the horn of Africa.

The Eritrean food is delicious, healthy and homemade. The owner very friendly and attentive. Definitely can recommend the Veggie Combo plate with injera bread which is very reasonably priced. Nice cafe/dining area. Hope to return soon to try the coffee!

Valeria met my friend and I so warmly today.  We always look forward to lunches at Jyoti Bihanga!  The light streams in the corners windows and it's comfort food, servers and atmosphere is so refreshing! Soups are some of my favorites there...especially the  lentils.   Beyond the Smile veggie burger is  the best one in town...or anywhere!  This is the only restaurant where I will eat mashed potatoes and gravy. Apple pie is all natural, no filler additives.  You really TASTE the apples.  Tea selections are quite pleasing  as well. Eating here is a peaceful and palate pleasing respite!!!!!  All the best servers and staff!  Thank you for exceptional spiritual quality!

This is My Favorite Restaurant in USA.
Its very difficult for me to find the perfect ingredients (gluten free, sugar free, no seed and canola oils and so on) in the salads and meals. They have the best food. And also the team is meditating every day before they open the restaurant.  How important it is to cook with pure and kind head !!! The price is very very very affordable.

Since 1986! Impressive. My review is redundant - but here goes: VEGAN food! Plus other WELL LABELED options like vegetarian and gluten free. Lilting music, soft lighting and pastel blue surrounding - like a meditation bath - with nibbles! Interesting information about Sri Chinmoy abounds. Indian lamps and lovely greenery. The Rama Bowl was enjoyed by my table mate. I had a small nachos. The beans were seasoned in a yummy way and the fresh guacamole was delicious.

Super friendly staff, great outdoor seating and very dog friendly. Large menu, with a variety of options. Vegan, vegetarian, gluten free. There’s a reason this place has been here for nearly 40 years. The vegan neatloaf is great, So is the beyond burger. Mashed potatoes and gravy is an amazing side to have with the sandwiches.
The food is absolutely delicious, fresh and healthy! Even my husband, who enjoys red meat, loves eating here.! The carrot cake is amazing!

This is an amazing restaurant for a vegan food. The restaurant is fully raw and is the only other raw place in the Southland. The only other one is in Los Angeles. Both locations in San Diego have a great atmosphere. The goodies at the register shelves and cooler cases are worth it alone. There is no other place you can get both kale chips and wonderful raw deserts like the twix bars and awesome cakes. The menu has wonderful dishes plus the specials listed at the register.

I love the food at Peace Pies! Whenever I’m in San Diego, it’s one of my go-to spots. On my last visit, I had the Rainbow Salad, which was packed with fresh, colorful vegetables and a delicious dressing. I topped it with some kale chips — perfection. We also shared the avocado toast, which was also very good. Highly recommend

Peace Pies in Ocean Beach is a raw food paradise! I tried the raw lasagna, and it was absolutely delicious—layered with fresh, flavorful ingredients that made every bite a delight. I also had a durian smoothie, which was so creamy and unique, and I couldn’t leave without taking home a Butterfinger bar and a slice of lemon blueberry cheesecake. Both were to die for—rich, satisfying, and all guilt-free!

Everything here is not only delicious but incredibly healthy, and it’s clear they put so much care into every dish. The vibe is laid-back and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to enjoy a meal or grab some goodies to go. If you’re into raw, vegan, or just great food, Peace Pies is a must-visit! I'll definitely be back for more!

This place is amazing! A true raw vegan cafe that has ridiculously delicious food, friendly staff, and a chill a$$ vibe. A friend and I visited recently for a healthy wholesome meal.  We tried a few of their menu items, and we were not disappointed. We started with the chips (cucumbers) and guacamole and avocado sunseed toast.  Entrees: the bliss burger and the daily special carnitas (mushrooms)  fajita burrito (coconut tortilla). Drinks: chocolate milkyway and horchata shakes.

We left with a Twix bar and a hostess cupcake for dessert. Again, I was not disappointed at all. If you're in the OB/Point Loma area, I definitely recommend stopping in for some good eats.

Hidden gem with delicious wraps and outdoor seating

Looking for a healthy and delicious meal after a long week? This place definitely hit the spot! It has a cozy indoor area and a beautiful outdoor seating option, which I highly recommend. Parking is available on the street nearby, and there are plenty of good food options in the area.

Must-try dishes:
* Mango curry wrap (the MVP! The sauce is amazing)
* Luna tuna wrap (very good)
* Peaceful pizza (unique but delicious)
* Strawberry milkshake (very good)

I loved the food so much that I ended up buying their recipe book! They have a variety of options to explore, so I'll definitely be back to try more.
Great local café, awesome food and great atmosphere. Must visit if you looking for breakfast or lunch. Tried chickenini and garden omelete.

Café Vahik is a great place to get breakfast! They have a high-quality menu with something for everyone. We especially enjoyed the healthy Mediterranean options--the omelets were delicious! Vahik is very nice and works hard to  provide a good experience for his customers. Atmosphere is chill and cozy. We look forward to coming back!

Best bagel I’ve ever had!! Mediterranean bagel. 🥯 Guy that was in the front was awesome!! He was handling everyone’s order quickly and quality. Parking was easy and there seating inside and outside. Price was very good as well. We spent around 25$ for our breakfast.

So I had ordered only drinks from this place and I am staying at a nearby hotel. The drinks are what you would expect from a cafe. But here is the reason I’m giving 3 stars. The espresso. It was bad. The main guy is super friendly, and I have nothing to say bad about the atmosphere. But as for the espresso which is the basis for lots of coffee drinks. It is bitter. I watched the main guy make a shot in under 8 seconds. If you know a thing or two about espresso, you know you need ample time to make one properly (~25 sec), even if you have the best machine in the world. It still takes longer than he took. I know some home machines can do it 10 seconds but that’s because they have much more pressure, usually 20 bar. He had at least a $3000 machine. I know because I looked it up online to see how much it cost. And the result from how he made it is what you would expect, bitter. Now I know it isn’t by no means easy. Everyone struggles with it. But for the base of lots of drinks, no matter how much you try to drown it out with cream and sugar or whatever. The bitter taste will persist if it is strong enough. So that’s why I’m giving three stars. Maybe it was just my shot. But that’s my experience there. Also, I have visited two other places in the area, Rosemont’s cafe and Immersion Cofee. And they also do not have good espresso just fyi if you are looking for some.

I had such a wonderful breakfast experience here! The food was absolutely tasty and the location is perfect. A special shoutout to the owner, Vahik—he is such a great person and incredibly friendly. He really made us feel welcome. Highly recommend stopping by

I cannot share enough how fabulous this restaurant is. The food was amazing, fresh and so full of flavor. Its the best Chinese Restaurant we have visited in years. The service was impeccable and ever so friendly. We are great full for our time spent there and will be back!
The complimentary salad and ice cream are great, and their portion is huge. The drunken noodles are wet (which is interesting) and the Hainanese clay pot is good.

What a local gem! Clearly a favorite among Normal Heights locals and I can see why. Great impression from the start with a free tofu and ginger vinaigrette salad starter while you browse the menu. The cuisine label of “Vietnamese” on this Google listing is too limiting because their menu is a smorgasbord of Japanese, Hainanese, Vietnamese, and Thai dishes. All. Delicious. We ordered Eric’s Stir Fry and it was lovingly reminiscent of a Hong Kong chow fun. My friend ordered the Hainanese Cast Iron Pot with swai fish and the garlic sauce it came with was divine, not to mention how well it complimented the crispy rice at the bottom of the pot. We were almost too stuffed for the free ice cream for dessert, but pressed on and were treated with a scoop of vanilla ice cream drizzled in mango syrup and a slice of cantaloupe. All in all, a fantastic dinner. And super affordable! Don’t pass on DAO Fu!

I’ve been traveling through the US for five weeks now and this has BY FAR been the best restaurant I’ve eaten at.
It already starts with complimentary salad, lots of water and a huge variety of vegetarian option. The food was amazing, portions were big and the overall quality was great. The Tofu here is just a blessing!
The complementary (and very delicious) ice cream rounded-off things perfectly. I would 10/10 recommend this restaurant to absolutely everyone. Don’t forget to bring your tip money - they sure deserve it!

I wish I had pictures but,, the portion sizes are incredible and very well priced. There are so many flavors to every dish yet not to the point of overwhelming. Trip was in the end of October but the vibrant flavors reminisce of summer afternoons. I absolutely adore the family that owns and operates, and the atmosphere and hospitality makes you feel like your going to a comfy family dinner. (The fruit ice creams for desert are so rich and not too sweet its amazing)

Pomegranate was a great experience! Everything was packed with flavor. The lamb chops I ordered were packed full of flavor and cooked to perfection. Overall everything was seasoned well and the presenatation was beautiful too. The customer service was also amazing! It was my first time trying this food and I can't wait to come back. If you want something different and are in ther area, please try this restaurant. Highly recommended!
Eat up!!!

Let's start off with how awesome our waiter, Eddie, was. Can't speak higher, he was so helpful in menu selection, funny and knowledgeable. We hadn't tried Russian/Georgian food before and he was helpful in what to order, mindful of our walnut allergies, and how to eat or pair the food authentically.

We ordered the Khinkali and Chakapuli. Both were really good, but our favorite was the lamb stew - so flavorful and came with yummy rice. Lemon, mint, tarragon flavors and the lamb was cooked to perfection, fell right off the bone - it was a delicious cozy meal.

We also got marani chacha shots, Georgian beer and a pomegranate martini which was so good! (Also made by Eddie)

Highly recommend to trying this spot and the cuisine!

This the best place in town. I go as often as I can. I love borsch and their borsch is fantastic. The service is second to none. Great atmosphere with a great selection of Georgian food. Highly recommend 100x over.

The staff and the entire team are very kind and welcoming, have never been so welcomed anywhere else, amazing atmosphere and overall experience! This is my second visit, and there’s no doubt it’s the best food in San Diego—and California in general! Everything is homemade and fresh - actually made with love. Many thanks to everyone!

The sampler salad is great for trying out if it’s your first time there. We ordered all the popular food and everything was delicious!
The sever was super helpful and friendly. Definitely must come back

The food pictures look good but when I ordered it came out...not as expected. The San Diego on croissant had old avocado (it was brown) and so little it was like a smear rather than avocado, barely any chorizo, liquid eggs, and the croissant was hard. And it was $12.99???
Its a no from me

I ordered a breakfast açaí bowl from this spot through uber eats. It was decent overall, but definitely not the best I’ve had. The base was the standard frozen açaí blend, topped with banana, strawberries, almond butter, and granola. While it was filling and refreshing, the strawberries didn’t taste very fresh—more like frozen fruit.

It was okay for a quick meal, but I’ve had much better açaí bowls elsewhere in San Diego.

The food here is super good... but most of us ordered sandwiches,  which are the bomb, but one of us ordered a waffle, which didn't come out until everyone was done eating. It did look like maybe 1 person was working the food+coffee+register. All in all, it was a great, local little place! Didn't try the coffee, but food was good!

Local Krave – A Cozy Breakfast Gem in San Diego

Local Krave is a fantastic spot for coffee and breakfast in San Diego. The service was excellent—friendly and efficient. They offer a great selection of breakfast options, and everything tastes fresh. I had the Caprese Croissant, which was deliciously crisp and flavorful, paired with a cortado that was smooth and perfectly balanced. The ambiance is warm and cozy, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a morning meal. Definitely worth a visit!

Charming little cafe, perfect for tucking away for a few hours to get some work done. Great lighting, nice atmosphere due to the decor, and a nice cozy study area. The inside is pretty small, but it could fit at least a study group or two, plus there is outdoor seating and a bar to fit more people. Overall, a great small place to lock in and study.

I like they gave sweet while waiting. I ordered a beef kebap bowl, but it was tooo way small, barely was a portion for its price. I ate all of in minutes and still feeling hungry. Also beef was half portion, and not kind of burnt and untasty

When this place first opened, the food was amazing—fresh and absolutely delicious. Unfortunately, that’s no longer the case. I just had the beef shawarma, and it was cold, super dry, and not tasty at all. For $15, it was no pleasure at all.

i absolutely fell in love! i was a first time customer and received such a welcoming experience. everyone was so friendly and helpful and not to mention, the food was amazing! i got the chicken shawarma fries and it was seriously the best fries i have ever had in my whole life! we even received recommendations for the next time we come back, which we most definitely will! 10/10 recommend!

It was first time in here today. Ordering and paying is confusing. If I say chicken shawarma, the chaser has no idea what I want as they have like 3 dishes with that name. I asked for chicken shawarma a la carte, which would mean a wrap anywhere else in the United States besides this restaurant. What I got was a container of chicken. Another guest also complained of a messed up order due to this naming convention on the menu. They don’t know what people are trying to order. Secondly, I waited 15 minutes outside with my dog for what I thought would be a quick one item order. After the first 15 minutes I had to leave my dog outside alone and wait inside because I suspected something went wrong. I waited for another 15 minutes staring at my order ready to go with my ticket on it, holding my buzzer, ready to say something if anyone had approached me and asked what my number was. My buzzer never went off the whole time, and no one asked why I was standing there, they just made other orders. After a 30 minute wait, I watched the other guest receive their messed order, and the employee throws the ticket on my food in the trash and offers it to the guest. At that point, I say it’s mine and she hands it over with no other words exchanged. I was ready to forget about the wait until I opened a box of plain chicken. Why would I want a box of plain, now cold, chicken? The menu is not clear, and the employees don’t have the capacity to bridge misunderstandings at time of order. I will not be coming back here.

We tried this place for the first time and got two of the beef Shawarma platters. The food was cold and could have used a little more seasoning. The portion was a decent size, but I think it could’ve been better for the price. Their pita chips were very good. The real downfall of this visit was the service. Several of the employees ignored me while I waited to order at the cash register for over 5 minutes. We definitely won’t be back

This was a vibe. It gave you Mediterranean small cottage vibes on a sunny day. I ordered the patty melt. My gawd!!! Delicious is not the best adjective, mouthwatering is better. That reminds of the chicken skewers… they were orgasmic with each bite. In the neighborhood make sure to check this place out.

Olympic Cafe offers an exquisite Mediterranean experience. The beef kebabs were especially well seasoned and the chicken was tender and delicious. The salad was fresh and the dressing complemented the rice and protein combo really well. The meat was freshly off the grill and my friend and I really enjoyed being able to talk and catch up over this delicious meal. David, our server, was such an a great curator of the experience and he really offered a level of service that inspires us to come back. If you’re in San Diego and looking for Mediterranean food, you have to check out Olympic cafe

I don't usually take time out of my day to write reviews but this spot truly deserves it. Ever since I ate here last week, I literally cannot stop thinking about how delicious my meal was even though it was so simple. I ordered the charbroiled chicken platter with roasted potatoes paired with a side salad and OMG the flavors of every component was truly divine, Id genuinely be so honored to eat this everyday for the rest of my life. If anyone can share a recipe I'd praise you for life. 🙏🏼

The food was absolutely amazing—delicious, authentic, and full of flavor. Honestly, it was one of the best cheesecakes I’ve ever had. The only downside was finding a fly in my overly sweetened Greek coffee, which was truly disgusting. While I understand accidents can happen, the response was underwhelming—a brief, almost dismissive “sorry” with no effort to make it right. Had they handled the situation better, I would have happily given them a 5-star review, but the lack of care left me disappointed after such an otherwise wonderful dining experience.

We had the kebab platter and it was fantastic. The food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Avani took care of us and delivered outstanding service: attentive, friendly, and professional. Highly recommend this place for a great Mediterranean experience!

Loved the food. My wife said they have less oil than other Thai restaurants. The flavor was outstanding 👌🏾 Rice was okay; she had white, I had brown. My Cashew Mock Duck was good and she had the Pumpkin Curry 🍛
We always split the food and we both dug (slang), both.

Pros: Taste, Waitresses, Ambiance

Cons: Fried Tofu was not fresh

Lighter Thai vegetarian restaurant with many mock meat options.

The duck noodle soup was excellent. The mock duck was crispy with a pleasant texture. The herb soup base was tasty (great for a cooler evening) and complemented by fresh vegetables, soft noodles, and a lime sauce.

The brown rice and steamed tofu were great options with Plumeria’s Mixed Fiber Plate.  This was a moderate and healthy option - not too light or heavy.

The fried rice noodles were wide and soft.  The sauce was flavorful and not overwhelming.

The yellow curry had a thinner sauce (almost a buttery component on first taste) with crisp carrots and potatoes. In comparison, the pumpkin curry had a robust flavor and body, which was a popular dish (recommended!).

Overall, the steamed tofu and mock duck were good options for our group. The mock beef was not as popular due to the texture.

A spice level of 2-3 out of 10 was true to the scale and worked for the kids in the group.

We stumbled upon this after visiting Balboa Park. Every item on the menu is delicious. We had the Tom yum soup, Spicy rice noodles with Vegan Chicken, Khao Soi with Tempura vegan duck and the Thai tea. I would highly recommend this for a visit.
Lovely Thai food for vegetarians. Really enjoyed the service and ambience and the rich taste of Thai food. Special shout out to khao Soi and the spicy basil fried rice

Overpriced for quality, taste and quantity. Wait staff judges but service is quick.

Tom kha is spicy coconut milk with few pieces of boiled veg. Not your typical authentic Thai.

Satay were just fried vegan meat.

Evolution is a true gem for anyone seeking exceptional plant-based cuisine. As someone who values both vegan and gluten-free options, I was glad to discover this restaurant that offers both. The kitchen clearly takes pride in making everything fresh from scratch, and you can absolutely taste the difference in every bite.

While the interior seating is limited, the atmosphere actually adds to the charm of the dining experience. The staff are knowledgeable about the ingredients and care about ensuring every guest has a great meal.

Don’t skip dessert! Their gluten-free vegan desserts are absolutely divine and prove that dietary restrictions don’t mean sacrificing your indulgences. Evolution has mastered the art of creating delicious, wholesome food that happens to be vegan.

Highly recommend for vegans, those with gluten sensitivities, and really anyone who appreciates freshly prepared food. I plan to be returning soon!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​  Enjoy eating more plant based foods.

Wow......I had to delete my old review because I recently visited the new location and I gotta say things have definitely changed. And definitely not in a good way. The burger was bland. The chicken fingers looked all sad sitting on some dried up lettuce and the young girl working the register was weird and has limited customer service skills. And the menu is like a 1/3 of what the old menu was. Geez....
For several years I've enjoyed coming to the old location. The staff was way better and the food was a 4 or 5 star rating. Now I really don't care about ever coming back. $30 for a burger and  chicken fingers that was just okay? I can cook at home and get way more and better quality than what Evolution is currently serving.

We have a very limited amount of spaces where we can eat out at and this is quite the disappointment!

What happened.... !??

I've always been a fan of this place. This is the first time since they've moved that I've been here (great upgrade btw).
First time ordering this sandwich and definitely will be the last. One piece of lettuce, soggy so-called "bacon" tempeh that had ZERO flavoring.... Very very disappointed. $13 spent on this is not it!! I really hope this is not the quality that they are putting out due to their upgrade.
Wish I had a better review.... I was really looking forward to an enjoyable meal, which did not happen.

Ok, the vegetable wrap I had was absolutely delicious yet healthy! It was so very tasy! Huge! I was stuffed!  Customer service was okay. I ordered inside. I had to wait for someone to come to the register to place my order. Someone eventually came out telling me they'd be with me. That's not so much the issue. It was dry customer service and not very welcoming. However, I truly enjoyed the food!

I used Happy Cow to find a spot to eat while visiting San Diego, and chose Evolution Fast Food based on the positive reviews, which were well deserved

It was fairly busy, but the food was prepared well, tasted great and the staff was very friendly

had a burger & fries and the hemp milk shake, WOW !!

I will deff return

A Plant-Based Dream in La Jolla — Truly One of a Kind

We were in San Diego for a business trip and stumbled upon Trilogy, and honestly… we ended up eating here every single day (and ordering takeout). This was the only place in the area that checked every box for us: organic, gluten-free, plant-based, no processed ingredients, and no refined sugar. That combination is almost impossible to find. There are plenty of vegan restaurants, but you never really know what’s in their food and lots of places rely on processed substitutes, seed oils, or sugary sauces. Trilogy is different.

Everything is clean, intentional, and made with real ingredients. I usually have to cook all my meals when I travel because I don’t trust restaurant food, but it was such a relief to finally relax and enjoy a meal knowing it aligned with everything I look for. It honestly felt like my body could breathe.

We tried almost the entire menu:
– Nachos
– Breakfast Burrito
– Miso Bowl
– Adora Bowl
– Plant Power Bowl
– Cosmic Quinoa Bowl
– Chili
– Avocado Bruschetta
– Mac n Cheeze
– Perfect Tacos
– Enchiladas
– “Best Burger Yet”
– Carrot Cake
– Pumpkin Pie
– Paradise Cheesecake
- Coconut Cortado
- Latte
- Matcha

Every single dish had flavor, freshness, and that homemade feel you can only get when the kitchen cares about ingredients. Nothing tasted heavy or artificial just real food prepared with love.

We need more restaurants like this. Trilogy made our trip 10x easier, and we wish every city had a place we could trust the way we trusted them. If you’re serious about clean eating, this is the spot in San Diego.

Trilogy is the best vegan cafe in San Diego hands down! The seared spring rolls, enticing eggplant, mac & cheez are all delicious options, but the real star of the show is their sweet treats — I pretty much order their transcendent brownie and vegan cookies every time I come! The ingredient and flavor quality is so good, although it better be for the price haha. Only other downsides are the run-down environment and often unfriendly service, but I will still be back for the best healthy, vegan meals!
Nice place to have brunch and enjoy the view. We ordered nachos, dumplings, baked sweet potatoes, avocado toast and enchiladas. Everything was great, dumplings were a bit chewy.

This vegan restaurant stands out as one of the finest places I have ever dined at. I tried three dishes and they were all a delightful experience, showcasing the vibrant flavors and textures that fresh, plant-based ingredients can offer. I wholeheartedly recommend this exceptional establishment to anyone looking for delicious, high-quality vegan cuisine. The attention to freshness and creativity in their menu truly sets this place apart!

What a gem the Trilogy Sanctuary is. Easily missed, the elevator transports you to a rooftop oasis right in the middle of La Jolla. The smoothies were tasty and wholesome and left us energized for the rest of the day. Looking forward to another visit next time we're in San Diego!

Was it delicious? Eh I'vehad WAY BETTER. Did I spend $35 without a drink yes- will I stop in again probably not.

First let me say the atmosphere and Customer Service were EXCELLENT- now let me explain why I probably won't be back. The food is just ok, over priced, and not enough of a portion size for the price. A side guacamole and chips cost $11.55- see picture. There IS NO reason the should cost this much.

My guacamole does not taste Mexican- it tastes very much American, just avocado loaded with tomatoes, onions, and onion powder- I didn't taste cilantro, lime juice, or salt.

My black beans taste like they came from a can and were seasoned with salt and what tasted like a smokey flavor. My rice was giving Rice-A-Roni- not good at all.

My taco choices were veggie, chorizo, and asada- couldn't taste the difference between the chorizo and asada but were flavorful. I also ordered a side of guacamole (2oz) $3.15- cost more than the actual avocado.

$35.08 wasted- this amount should have included a drink and or a sweet treat.

6 out of 10
Oh also good luck finding parking!

Ehhhhhh…

Barbacoa was good. The asada had a vegan beef jerky flavor to it, not so much an asada flavor…

Their rice is very bland and their refried beans are also very bland/dry.

Too close to the mexican border to be this inauthentic. Also too pricey for the lack of flavor.

Chips were good. Tortillas were good.

Came for the nachos and also left w/ a burrito for the road!! Nachos were packed w/ flavor and the Seiten meat left me feeling plenty full w/ that extra protein!! Plant-based protein gains 💪!!! Will definitely be back for the entire menu !! 😋

My husband and I tried take-out from  Tacotarian for the first time today and we were both very impressed! We both mainly eat vegetarian at home and absolutely loved the options here. We each tried the Crunchwrap, mine with “carne asada” and his was just veggie. Both were absolutely delicious! I was very impressed by the vegetarian take on carne asada, the texture and flavor was amazing! The Crunchwrap itself was also quite big and filling.

My husband also tried two tacos, one “Al Pastor” and the other a Veggie Taco, he enjoyed both but raved about the Al Pastor! Their green mild salsa was also delicious and added another amazing layer of flavor.

This place really has their flavors and recipes dialed in! We will 100% be back to try more of the amazing options! The restaurant itself was also very clean, had a nice modern decor and was spacious. Definitely give them a try!

Really good vegan Mexican food. I loved the elote and the vegan birra tacos. I always stop here when I visit San Diego. The drinks were good too and the staff were nice. The environment is half inside have open air bar. My friend who is not vegan also loved the food. We took churros to go!

name: Saigon Vegan Bistro
vicinity: 1905 El Cajon Blvd Suite B, San Diego

reviews.text:
The food from here is amazing!!! I've tried several items on the menu, and everything I've tried has blown me out of the water. My favorites are the Saigon Garlic Chicken Bahn Mi, Saigon Garlic Fried Rice, and Shrimp Garlic Noodles, but trust me when I say you will love anything you order. The food is fresh and flavorful, not to mention the amount of food that you get for the price you pay is phenomenal. If there was a vegan heaven, Saigon Vegan Bistro would surely be there. I've only ordered via delivery so I can't speak to customer service, but my food has always arrived as-ordered and delicious. I highly recommend this place to vegans AND non-vegans.

I recently found out that this is a pop-up kitchen and not a stand alone restaurant, I truly hope that they are here to stay. Thank you!
The sandwich was tasty, but the soup was too salty to eat and the sweet potato fries were so burnt I couldn’t eat them either. Definitely disappointed.

It was our first time ordering from Saigon Vegan Bistro, we didn’t realize it was the ghost kitchen of Loving Hut. We love LH and now happy to have SVB as another option to add to our vegan food weekly rotations. We love the beef noodles and fried rice. You a taste the quality of food in every bite. I love the texture of the noodles. I’m really picky about my noodles and the chewiness of the ones here are superb! I’m salivating just thinking about them now. :)

The garlic chicken bahn mi is without a doubt the best bahn mi I've ever had! Just could not put it down.

Also loved that they had more items that are less/ not available elsewhere like vegan Thai iced tea and pandan cake. I had both and they were botj delicious too!

I ordered Uber Eats. I need this feedback to reach the manager. Was EXTREMELY disappointing to place an order like this that was delivered with no ketchup for fries (who does that?!) no soy sauce for a tofu bowl that had no sauce on it (super dry) and no utensils ( the one time I actually needed utensils). Disappointing this wasn’t packed with more care.

name: The Purple Mint Vegan Bistro
vicinity: 4616 El Cajon Blvd suite 3, San Diego

reviews.text: I’m not vegan nor vegetarian, but you would never guess you’re not eating vegan meats based off of how delicious the food truly is! Each dish I’ve had here is so flavorful, it left me craving it for another time!! And the portions are pretty big, I’ve never finished one on my own. As far as the service it’s always top notch. Even when the restaurant is a bit busier, the food comes out pretty fast and as expected! And with that I’ve been a loyal customer since 2015, even before their relocation! Also huge shoutout to Sun & CJ for serving my family, friends, and I for all these years!! Always a pleasure to see them working when I dine-in or call in for takeout!! Also thank you guys for maintaining the same quality of food and service after all these years!!

We love love love The Purple Mint Vegan Bistro! We have been repeat customers for quite awhile now and have never been disappointed with the food or service. The ambience is cool, calm, and collected, pleasant music playlist, and the decor has a wonderful Bali jungle type vibe. The menu has plentiful options, there are plant based meats, we ordered: Shrimp Spring Rolls, Crispy Rolls and Grilled Beef, and Lemongrass Beef Vermicelli.. all delicious choices.. and the Thai Iced Tea is bomb! The food is hot, fresh, and seasoned nicely, and the servers are friendly and attentive. (Some of the dishes and sauces contain peanuts so be very cautious for those with peanut allergies). Please support this beautiful vegan eatery whenever you can!

I am not a vegan but our friend is. We are very familiar with Asian cuisine from Vietnam and Thailand. The aubergine was the best dish. While most dishes from this area are vegan until protein is added there wasn't a lot of flavor in the dishes. You can have bland spiceness but it shouldn't be bland taste. Service was really good. I really hope they do improve as the could be really good. Protein should be offered separately for each dish IMHO

A MUST-eat in San Diego!!
I’m never afraid to write a critical review, but I have no ounce of criticism for this restaurant!
In my Vietnamese family, my cousin is vegan and I am vegetarian. We managed to convince our family of 8 to give this place a try, worried that any negative experience would dissuade them from trying meatless food again. Everyone LOVED the food. Expansive menu with SO many options. Flavorful, properly cooked vegan beef, chicken, fish, duck, shrimp, tofu (yes, we tried them all, via passing the dishes around the table!). I’ll never forget the delightful shock on my grandmother’s face when she tasted and saw how authentic the fake “sizzling beef” was. 11/10 will be back again, and will recommend to friends in the area- to both meat and plant-based diners :D
Service was exemplary- our waiters constantly checked on our water levels and satisfaction.
Menu clearly labelled and organized - only suggestion would be for the restaurant to come up with a “family” meal consisting of all the different proteins with a group bowl of rice, so everyone can try different things!
Venue is recently renovated- so very clean and modern.
Plenty of parking nearby, on the residential streets and plaza parking lots.
All the other diners around us seemed excited and happy with their food- we all kept turning our heads nosily as each dish came out from the kitchen.

The menu is diverse and very yummy. Highlights were the fried tofu, mapo tofu lettuce cups and jasmine milk tea. They have done a phenomenal job with the ambience and the food. The only downside is the surrounding location. Will definitely revisit when we are in the area.

At first I was excited to find a healthy lunch spot near work. I ordered the Thai Chicken Salad and the chicken was still raw. It also had frost bite on it. It looks like they cooked it previously, not all the way, then froze it. The  just threw it on my salad frostbitten but raw. Also, I was the only one in there and stood for a few minutes but the order counter before the two girls behind the counter acknowledged me. No “welcome in, I’ll be right with you” just straight up ignored. I won’t be coming back here for fear of raw chicken again.

10/2025 Updated Review:
I am saddened to say I need to update my review from 5-stars to 3-stars. Ever since the kind lady that made most of the açaí bowls has left, the quality and service have decreased in the past couple months. I respect the business and truly hope it improves again, it is literally one of those special foods that make me go “mhmm!” after each bite. I used to visit regularly 1-2 times each week for this açaí bowl. Sadly, the bowls the past couple months are lacking their aesthetic/neat presentation, their consistent fruit portions, and need to ensure fresh fruit is used (I had to pick out browned bananas).

I also hope they improve their service and quality check as well. These bowls are not pre-made, when you order one - then they make one. They have the açaí in a big tub and they make a big, fresh batch of in-house granola as needed. I got my most recent açaí bowl (and did not order ahead) and took it with me to go. My office is just a 4 min walk over and when I opened it, the açaí had spilt and the whole bowl was thoroughly melted! :( It was a melted açaí soup, I had never been given a melted bowl before. I didn’t have time to go back and return it, and I honestly believe I was given someone else’s açaí bowl order who hadn’t picked it up yet. My friend’s bowl in the same order was freshly made because she doesn’t like coconut, yet my order with everything on it was melted. It takes at least 30+ mins for these bowls to thoroughly melt. A few days later I returned and politely shared the feedback with the owner and sadly did not receive any reassurance and felt dismissed. I wasn’t expecting a free bowl or anything, but something like “I’m sorry that happened, that is not normal. Thank you for letting me know, I’ll look into this so it doesn’t happen again.” Instead I got “I don’t know how that happened. I don’t know. Okay, take care.”

Again, I truly hope they improve. I’m not visiting as often, but I hope my next açaí bowl and the açaí bowls going forward improve because I still believe they’re one of the best açaí bowls in San Diego. The pictures are from when the quality was unmatched before, you can see the care and time the kind lady took before to make each one. If it wasn’t strawberry hearts, they were displayed neatly like the bananas. ❤️

Original Review:
This is my fav place in central San Diego to get açaí bowls! The staff are so friendly and welcoming, the service is great, and omg the açaí bowl is delicious! What really sticks out is the granola they use is made in-house and they put it on generously! I went on Valentine’s Day for lunch and the kind lady who makes the açaí bowls cut the strawberries as hearts - so cute!! They really pay attention to their customers and make it a great environment.

I have only had coffee here so far, a spicy mocha. Delicious. I've heard good things about the food and saw multiple call-in orders being picked up while I was waiting, it's a popular lunch destination. The menu looks yummy and the staff are super friendly and accommodating, kind, and awesome. I can't wait to go back for some grub.

I tried the turkey/bacon/avocado , and honestly, I was a little disappointed. I ordered an entire sandwich, but for $14, there was  just had 1  piece of bacon and two slices of turkey, mostly lots of lettuce. Felt a bit pricey for what you get.
On the brighter side, I also tried a breakfast croissant with ham, egg, and cheese. It was very good and hearty.
The place itself is super cute, with plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. They offer daily specials, sandwiches, coffee and lattes, salads, fruit, and other drinks.
All in all, a nice spot with good vibes and some tasty items, though the sandwich portion could be more generous for the price.

Super cute, hole-in-the-wall place. I love the design and the mission - serve healthy locally sourced food. The workers were super friendly and kind, and helpful. The wait wasn’t very long at all. Everything I want in a cafe. One noticeable unique feature they have is the “coffee honor box” where it seems like you get to make your coffee and you just put the cost of the coffee, about $3, in the cash box, no wait at all. Love that for coffee drinkers that are just starting their day or on the go.
I personally ordered a mint tea latte and a Turkey sandwich and they were both really tasty. I loved the tea latte because I thought I only made them at home, it was nice to see it at a cafe like this one. The reason why I put 4  stars ⭐️is because the sourdough on my sandwich tasted a little old, kind of stale. Perhaps it was just an off day or I got the bad part of the loaf but it didn’t taste like a usual sourdough. Overall a great experience. If I’m around the area again, I would definitely come back.

Wow, phenomenal food! We got the summer rolls and pho and thoroughly enjoyed both. The summer rolls come with a delicious pineapple peanut sauce that was unique and very flavorful. The pho was outstanding - the broth was rich in flavor and the tofu was unique. The server was also very kind and welcoming. We’ll definitely be visiting again any time we are in SD!

Okay, I liked the Loving Hut I went to in San Francisco and thought this one in San Diego would be similar. It wasn’t. The food was tasty but didn’t stand out in any particular way. The service was poor. The cashier hardly engaged the customers unless asked to. I had to ask for water, dishes and a serving spoon - things that should just be usually done. Then the floor was sticky as if mopped with dirty water. Not going back. So disappointed for a what could be a great place for vegans.

Heard good things about it. Went to try it. Empty place. Dirty kitchen. Saw red flags but still decided to order.

They served old microwave food, yucky. Overpriced for disgusting stuff. $9 for a single piece of fried oyster Mushroom.

Danny at register was chill. He was quick to help out.

We stop here about once a month or so and always get bounce between our favorite spicy cha cha and the Bahn mi but everything is outstanding. The Bahn mi tastes just like you'd remember and the cha cha are faux shrimp that are equally convincing and delicious. In a strip mall of chains, this place is a jewel.

I ordered on uber eats so can’t speak on atmosphere & service too much but if you are going to order or eat in listen to me! I spent 40 mins combing through reviews. I decided to order the garlic noodles with the shrimp & the Mongolian beef. I wanted to try it for myself but could’ve used the advice of one review let me just say it lacks flavor and not that much garlicky. It’s literally noodles nothing special. The shrimp however is good and seasoned nice. Someone said it reminded them of imitation fish meat that’s spot on. Tastes good to me. Now the beef lacks flavor I really was thinking I was going to get saucy WELL seasoned food. Nope. That’s disappointing. The noodles came with a free Thai tea that is ok. I ended up spending near 50$. For the noodles to be around 16$ with a few shrimps is just not it. Charging for utensils crazy. Especially spending that kind of $. On top of charging for a little siracha pack still crazy. I put it in the details they didn’t give it to me. I wonder would the mock chicken meal have been more flavorful. Welp at least I can say I tried it.

My wife and I were the only ones in the restaurant for the lunch hour. Now Mind, you this was a Monday afternoon and we had everybody’s attention. Our waitress was very friendly but easily distracted by the bartender she never came back to check and see if we needed refills on our water or sodas. The food was mid at best.  I would say that the tots were so heavily seasoned with salt that they were unbearable almost to the point where you thought did the lid fall off the salt container. I would’ve sent them back, but we couldn’t get the attention of the waitress as she was still flirting with the bartender. Like I said nobody treated us poorly and I don’t have anything bad to say about them personally, other than I just felt like the service was off and the food was definitely off.

We had walked by this place a couple times during our stay and visit the gas lamp and decided to give it a try. I think it would be a fun place to get drinks, but I would skip the food.

Great food and atmosphere.  Our first visit we were greeted by Christina. She was sweet, attentive and fun to interact with. The owners struck gold with this bartender. She's a keeper.

Spinach salad and nachos were amazing!

Great experience at Whiskey Girl. Shout out to Gustavo, security guard extraordinaire. He’s 3 employees in one. Greeter, buser and security. Our server Valeria was on it too. She knows her trade and is warm and friendly. We’ll look for her next time we are in. We had the nachos, they were yummy.

Ordered the whiskey burger with tater tots which comes with a shot of Jack Daniels! Our waitress was friendly and beaming with positive energy. One person in our group had a mistake with their order. The waitress took care of it fast. Plenty of screens to watch various sports.
Fun karaoke nights. Food is basic bar food and the atmosphere is also your basic pub. I enjoy it here every so often.

The food is great, service is even better. They're so welcoming and are always happy to come around to check on you but give you plenty of time to browse their menu. Love the vibe here and will keep coming back!

Fun place!
Love the theme and feel of this place!
Welcoming and inviting!
The BBBlt will FILL you up! It will leave stuffed 😉!🏳️‍🌈

Visiting SD and stopped here after landing and waiting for my hotel. Jason the bartender was so incredibly nice that I came back while waiting for my flight back home. Such a sweet guy. You can tell the regulars really love him too! When I return to SD, this will be first on my list!

We just arrived in town 3 days ago and every time we go by its packed, so we stopped in today and its great. A little loud on my end since its hard for me to hear with all the background music. The menu has plenty of breakfast items along with salads, burgers and wraps. We split the Mo Burger, so delicious, it was served pre cut in half with an extra plate!
POPULAR BAR AND RESTAURANT WITH OUTDOOR BAR AND SEATING . FESTIVE ATMOSPHERE AND BARTENDERS . NICE SELECTION OF SEATING AREAS . GREAT MENU AND COCKTAIL LIST

Such a fun beach spot! Loved the sand floor that makes you feel like you’re right on the beach. Yummy treats and refreshing drinks, with good music and great vibes all around. Lunch items are fairly priced and tasty. Perfect place to relax and enjoy the atmosphere! 🌊🍹

Got day access for Fit Social through resort pass. It’s promoted as a co-working space with some wellness aspects. This place looks fantastic on all the photos & videos but there is not enough atmosphere in reality. The ocean view is mostly blocked by the dry sauna and some food truck/ trailer. There are are no restrooms for guests. You must use the public restrooms behind the building that smell like pee and mold. You do not have access to Fit Athletic, be advised! Fit Social is only an outside space. The server was pleasant but I had read the reviews about food and since I wasn’t feeling the vibe I did not spend any money on it. The only upside are the dry saunas. However they’re so small I wonder what that’s like on busy days?! Do yourself a favor an get a day pass at a real SPA and find a better hub to work at afterwards.

I need to say, this place is great! I generally have friends and family meet me here. It's right by Belmont Park, and the ocean. Feet in the sand, watch the ocean and people watch on the boardwalk. Great food! Just perfect all around!

Finally had a chance to check out For social - newest beach club in San Diego.

As a gym member I was able to use lounge chairs without any minimum spend.

Love the club area, lots of lounge chairs, tables and chairs for dining, bar area and also tall tables if you need to work.

Menu is on the healthier side and not too expensive.

Difficult to find parking in July, but understandable.

WiFi not working.

My first time in San Diego with my husband. We did not try the food just a couple drinks to relax. Great Place to visit.
The Frose probably was not ready or the machine not working but it was more like water, not frozen.  Maybe next time I will definitely try food

Societe Brewing Company has a nice central location in Kearny Mesa just off of Clairmont Mesa Blvd with a traffic light so relatively easy to get in and out of. Lots of tables both inside and outside and great to meet up with friends for a quick drink. Now the place is extremely loud with terrible acoustics so if the place is relatively full you have to yell to hear people right next to you. Also, under the Marine Core Air Base so lots of noise from the jets. I would not recommend any business events or groups except just friends that don't mind hanging out. Having  Chacho’s food truck right next to the brewery is fantastic as you can get quick eats while drinking beer.

Great beer selection. Lots of room. And tacos at Chacho’s food truck are good!. The loaded fried are Loaded. If you are in the area - come here. Loved the hazy and IPA options. My friend liked the Sours.

Fantastic experience here. Respectful, friendly, and outgoing service. Good beer selection. IPAs on one half of the menu, everything else on the other side. If you're sticking with the non-IPA side, the kolsch, blonde, Belgian golden, and their stouts are all great. The Debutante amber all was a highlight. Vibe good here, too. It's a large, destination brewery, with lots of available seating inside and out. A handful of bar stools, too.
Nice space, nice beer, and always good music for those Clairemonsters who grew up in San Diego (they basically play the jams from 91X - Blink, Green Day, Offspring - it rocks, literally).

Society  is always a great spot to stop for a beer! They have indoor and outdoor seating. The tasting room is wide open, and you can see the whole brewery and all the fermentation tanks. There is always a variety of beer consistently on tap.  It's a great brewery if you have a large party too, much better accommodations than other breweries in the area. Almost every time, there seems to be some sort of food truck or pop up to grab a bite to eat.

Four employees working super hard, Jose (chef) delivered my breakfast in 15 minutes, attention to details, the bionic waitress was alone, very professional, room was packed!
The music was blasting, it didn’t bother me or hurt the experience.
The food was delicious, a diner from 1973 doesn’t have to be reinvented!

First time at this dinner 🍽️
Most reviews point out the biscuits and gravy, but I opted for something different. I ordered the steak and eggs with bell peppers hash brown. I think that if a dinner can't execute on this basic order than everything else might not be great. But this place delivered. The 🥩 was cooked medium as I ordered. The 🥚s where cooked over medium and they delivered. The 🥩 and 🥚s were well seasoned, fyi I never put any sauce on steaks because it hides the flavor on a well cooked 🥩 (IMO). The has brown were delicious, and it was plenty. Coffee was good, I went early Sunday around 7:30am, it didn't have a that burn taste, sign that was on the heat plate for a long time.
Service was quick and friendly. I believe I heard the waitress name is Amanda. She is very attentive and friendly.
Parking in OB is difficult to find, so I recommend going early morning.
I'll definitely visit this place again and try the other menu items.

The waitress, whom I assume may be the owner was very rude rushing my wife and I. She was very unattentive and unhelpful when it came time to pay. My wife is someone who genuinely assumes the best in people's intentions and she noticed and disliked it as well. I am guessing this is normal for her to be so unpleasant with customers.
The food was okay, but not great. I had their special. I wouldn't suggest it or have anybody go out of there way for it.
The environment had funny cheeky signs which were nice, but some of them were inappropriate for a business. The chairs were old and worn down. Very uncomfortable and with how far the booth tables were from the tables I had to lean in to hear my wife with still being mindful of others.
Over all I would not suggest this place.

Food was good,service was average although I'll  cut her some slack because  they were busy, the bus boy and dishwasher was working ther behinds off! So I did manage to make my way to the kitchen area and tip them both the server also.tge only set back was the flies, i was told their bad this time of year.

Old school classic vibe as expected. Really liked the layout and decor. Staff was very friendly and inviting. Food was meh…ordered the waffle breakfast with sausage, eggs and hashbrowns. The waffles were super thin, sausage tasted cheap like from the frozen isle, eggs were good and Hashbrowns were cooked perfectly but tasted stale. My Momma had the biscuits & gravy and wasn’t impressed. Our server was great food wasn’t bad just mediocre quality with plenty room for improvements.
Reliable appetizer and the choices end early. Today we discovered the beef suqaar. The fight was on and the place is very welcoming.  The food was delicious.
I would say it's a hidden gem in San Diego. Amazing halal food and lovely people.

Good rice ,very tasty chapati with whatever choice of sukar.The prices were very reasonable for the quality and portion size. Given how flavorful the dishes were and the unique flavors of the cuisine, it was great value for the money."

I had the pleasure of eating at madina delicious restaurant The food here is absolutely delicious! Every dish we tried was bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. Highly recommend the wasla with rice.
Excellent
The place is not very good and not visible and there are a lot of Somali taxi drivers but the rice with meat is very delicious I went there several times
The food is good, but the cleanliness is not good.
Quality food that exceeded my expectation. Highly recommend to my friends and fam and local community.
Exquisite taste and great Sambusas!!!
Great good & great customer service!
The Sambusas are the best!!

The food is fantastic and the servings are HUGE.
The restaurant has a very open and spacious feel to it.
The service was outstanding (we had a server named Skye).
Easily accessible from the boardwalk.
Nice patio too!

This place is absolutely epic need to come in anytime of the day or night they open at 11 they carry Happy Dad and Happy mom Raspberry!   Started with the coconut shrimp the appetizer absolutely perfect. I had the chicken sandwich Caribbean bbq sauce and guyere cheese  with some delicious fries and Sam had the chicken wrap Jamaican chicken wrap really good.  We had great service from Shaq and this is a cute place in Mission Beach they get all of the bread next-door at Olive Bakery which the best in the city!  I highly recommend this place come and  grab a Happy Dad.
The server we had was great! Very attentive and friendly. Cool atmosphere there. The cubanella sandwich was very good, the fries were plentiful and solid,but the fish was too fishy tasting.

Will be back for Crab Croquettes and Puff Puff Passion cocktail! Server seemed uninterested in being there and forgot multiple things. Will probably sit at the bar.

Went for a week day lunch. Sat on in the patio area facing the street. About 10-15 mins went by after our server told us he’d be back with waters. We had to get up to find him. He forgot about us. The bartender did bring a complimentary shot to apologize. The Puff Puff Passion cocktail was delicious. The food was good but a little more than I thought it would be. I expect beach food to be more because of the location but this location is not never Belmont park nor does it have a beach view. My friend ordered a ginger ale that never came (the server forgot)
Highly recommend the coconut shrimp and the Cuban sandwich. The Cubano flavors were well balanced and the bread was so soft and delicious!

LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!! Been looking for a really GOOD Jamaican place since I moved to California in 2023 and this is IT!! I ordered the large curry goat with extra festivals and ginger beer. The goat meat was sooo tender and juicy. Rice and peas, macaroni, fried plantains…everything just reminded me of home🇯🇲🇯🇲. The portion was definitely a large and had lots of gravy which I love. The people and their service, top tier!! Very respectful, very friendly and they are quick with your order. I’ll definitely be coming back. The picture was me almost done lol, I couldn’t wait.

Hands down the BEST jerk chicken I’ve ever had!

I ordered the jerk chicken today, and it completely blew me away. The flavor was bold, smoky, and perfectly spiced — tender on the inside with just the right amount of char on the outside. The sauce on the side? Absolute magic. I could pour that on everything!

I also tried the oxtail and it was fall-off-the-bone tender with incredible flavor. The plantains were caramelized just right — sweet, soft, and perfectly cooked.

My plate came with rice and peas, sweet plantains, fried festival, and a creamy potato salad — all of it was on point. The portions were generous, and everything tasted amazing!

I don’t know much about Jamaican food but I do know about good food and this is it! I finished up my lap at Rohr park and hit the food truck. I got the Large Entree 1 Jerk Chicken which had great flavor inside and out, rice, and a pasta salad on the side which was honestly enough to feed two people. The sauce with the chicken and rice was flavorful with a slight kick of spice. I need to go back to try the other stuff!

Talked with the owner for a few minutes before ordering. Decided to get the goat curry since I haven't had it for a billion years. It was very tasty. A lot of food jammed into the go container. I would have liked a little bit of sauce to go with the meat. It wasn't dry but just I like a da sauce, you know? I don't eat pasta but tried a couple of nibbles and it wasn't bad but a little on the sweet side.
I want to go back and try the oxtail next time.

Look no further…hands down the best Jamaican food in San Diego. I have been to all Jamaican restaurants in the San Diego area and this by far is the best. You want a plate food with good presentation, flavor that make your taste buds dance look no further this is your place. I must admit I was skeptical because many spots missed the mark. These fine island men did not disappoint. The pictures speak for themselves. The music playing was a plus. Definitely spinning the block on this one. Perfect date night w/ myself.

What a great place to hang, since the first time I went there the Bartender Steph made me feel like home. It’s the best bar in San Diego and with the best service for sure! Food is also amazing, would definitely recommend. Gave 5 starts because I couldn’t give 10. Go on Thursdays that Steph is working, you won’t regret!!

In town to meet up with friends, wanted to grab a quick bite and drinks before starting the night and found this spot around the corner from our Airbnb. The place was nice and pretty chill, their fries were really good and their salad as well.

The food was absolutely terrible. We ordered grilled fish tacos, side salad, and cheese fries. The salad was ok, without the gross dressing. Fish was way overcooked and dry. The sauce, I mean sour cream didn’t help. I suppose they’re ready to be demolished for the giant tower and they don’t care. It was Sunday and they were clueless about football.

I had a work party at Froggys and we all had such a great time. The bar staff was so warm and gracious (Shoutout to photographer Marcos for getting great pics of our group). We really enjoyed putting tunes on the jukebox and hanging out. Drinks were delish, food was good, service was outstanding.

Good to see this bar return.  Great place to grab a bourbon and a burger. Chicken wings and flat breads are good too.   My neighborhood needed a bar focused on bourbon that has bourbon priced for drinking not status.  I hope to see their collection grow, Prices and pours are good

Cheers

Coco Maya is one of my friend’s mist visit recommendations. 🌴It is located in Little Italy, San Diego, make sure to get a reservation because the place is absolutely gorgeous! The vibes feel like you are in Bahamas or Honolulu! The food was so delicious. We tried the Spicy Mango Ceviche, Maine Lobster Tacos, the nachos (dressing was a bit wet but still tasty). For drinks, we had the Mango  Guava Spritz and Frozen Coconut, both no alcoholic hehehe. The server was nice and the vibe was amazing. So happy we tried it!

I never write Google reviews but I just had to write one for this gorgeous venue!

I was tasked with organizing a summer work party here for our staff who are mostly remote workers, hoping for a relaxed rooftop San Diego vibe… it couldn’t have been more perfect.

The venue felt airy, sunny, colorful and full of that effortless holiday energy. With views over Little Italy Plaza and beautiful dappled light softening the heat, it was the ideal setting for our group of 25. The décor was fun and vibrant, and absolutely set the tone for the rest of our day.

The food and drink were outstanding. Presentation of the cocktails was beautiful, and every drink was packed with flavor and flair. The poke tuna and shrimp coconut dishes were huge hits, and the Pistolero Paloma and White Negroni were also fan favourites.

But for me, the most important thing was the service... it was exceptional… efficient, friendly, and genuinely passionate about what they do. Natasha and her team went above and beyond for us at every step.

Natasha was incredibly attentive to our needs throughout the planning process, even though I was based in New Zealand on the other side of the planet! They were open to us bringing in a Mariachi band to perform for a surprise moment during the event. Natasha also created a custom menu featuring our company branding and set up our food table with personalized Flaviar touches, which made the whole experience feel elevated and special.

This was easily the best hospitality we experienced in all of San Diego.
I would 100% recommend this venue and truly hope to work with Natasha again for future events.

The food was OK…nothing really to write home about. The Lobster Benny had a claw and a half of meat and barely any sauce, I had to ask for more, not worth the money at all. The steak sandwich was decent but the chicken and waffles were horrible. The chairs we sat in were very uncomfortable and painful, I couldn’t wait to stand up. The alcohol selection was as extremely limited with the only vodka being Absolute. We were then told they specialize in tequila but they didn’t have any other the brands we asked for. I wish I had chosen a different location for Sunday brunch. This places is very over priced, spend your money somewhere else where you can get good food and actually be comfortable.

After running the SD marathon I was super hungry and this place was the place we stopped to eat. The entrance gave a jungle/George of jungle vibes. As you entered the building you have to go up stairs where you'll be greeted by the host. Lots of natural light with a bar right in the center. Our waitress super nice and even recommended the shrimp plate seen in the picture below.

The menu isn't super busy but enough to chose from. Food is good over all and it is a place I would come back to if I was in the area again.  The prices are a bit on the higher end for drinks specifically but that's just my opinion.

I’ve been to Coco Maya many times — it’s one of my go-to spots in San Diego. This visit was a Saturday afternoon before heading to an event, and I was thrilled to find out they were running happy hour on food (the host initially said no, but our server confirmed it). I ordered my favorite: carnitas nachos, which aren’t on the regular menu but pop up during happy hour. They were as delicious as ever and served in a portion size that’s generous without being overwhelming. The rest of my group had burgers, which they loved, and we shared fries that were good but took a backseat to the mains. Service started a little slow but was friendly and efficient, and they managed to turn our table quickly despite being busy and recovering from a large event. Coco Maya always delivers solid food, a fun atmosphere, and plenty of drink options.

name: Havana Grill
vicinity: 1652 Camino Del Rio N, San Diego

reviews.text: Nice clean restaurant and decor. Ordered the lechon. Good flavor and very juicy. I enjoy the mojo sauce, which is a garlic and olive oil combo. Service was friendly, but a little slow and the waitress seemed overwhelmed, despite only having a couple tables. She forgot to bring drinks multiple times and the drinks that arrived, were warmer than I would like. Definitely recommend the food, but hoping they can improve service. I hope I can upgrade to a 5 star next time.

Honestly I've never had anything close to Cuban Food/Coffee and this place made me want to come back again! Their empanadas were so good! Personally I liked the Chicken more than Picadillo one! And I had the Cononut Cream coffee and the Havana Burger! 10/10 would recommend and will be back to try the Chicken one!

INCREDIBLE!!  Our family reunion with 40+ people had our 'big dinner' at Havana Grill, Mission Valley.  Our group of many Cubans including my 89 year-old mother-in-law who left Cuba over 60 years ago, thoroughly enjoyed the ENTIRE experience!  The Alex-es (there are 2 of them) and their staff, particularly Emma, made us feel like family and took exceptional care of us over the 3 HOURS that we were there!  They served us 'family style' which worked GREAT as there were large plates of a variety of Cuban food (recipes from Alex's Cuban mother) that were passed around easily and happily from one table to the next.  The restaurant had brought in a live band that kept us entertained all evening and had many of us including my grandson and his great-grandmother dancing around the restaurant.  The food, the ambiance (including the live music) and the customer service were absolutely exceptional!  (and the price was very reasonable!)  Our group included many people from the east coast, including Miami where there are many Cuban restaurants, and everyone raved about the food and the experience!  Thank you so much for creating lifetime memories for all of us!  P.S - while I thanked the staff in the front of the restaurant, I failed to thank the kitchen staff - please pass along our SINCERE ADMIRATION AND APPRECIATION for their work!!

Havana Grill delivers every time! I have been to the other location in Clairemont Mesa several times, but this was the first time I have been to the Mission Valley spot; it's just as great. My friend and I ordered the sampler platter and the Cubano Sandwich. The sampler platter included an Empanada, Papa Rellena, Sweet Plantain, Yuca Fries, Tostones, Ham Croquettes, and Plantain Chips. The flavors were all on point, everything was well seasoned, and the meal was hearty as well. The desserts were also delectable. We ordered the chocolate torte, the chocolate profiterole, and the best dessert they carry(in my opnion) the giava cheescake. This cheesecake is worth the return trip alone! Our service great as well. The interior is bright, clean, and inviting. I can't wait to come back. Eat up!

Vaca fritas was amazing. The beef had a crispy outside and still soft and tender texture as you bit in. The flavor of the mean was delicious, both savory and a little citrus maybe. It had an odd sense of being refreshing. Beans were delicious, just black beans but well cooked, food texture, and nice subtle flavor. Fried plantains were a nice touch for the meal and quite yummy. Also, the meal came with melted garlic butter which maybe had some other flavor in it but it tasted great with the beef.

Empanadas, the crust on all of them buttery and flaky and perfectly cooked. The crust is actually a strong flavor so for some of the more miler flavored empanadas, it overpowered.

Reviews of the flavors from favorite to least favorite:
Braised beef: This was very flavorful, mine and my partner's favorite of the bunch. I'm not a huge fan of bell peppers (though I'm not offended by them), but it complimented the flavor of the beef so well that I really enjoyed it.
Picadillo: 2nd favorite was this seasoned beef. It smells stronger than it tastes but it has a nice flavor. My partner said he wouldn't think he'd be able to eat the whole thing because it would be overpowering over a while, but I think I'd enjoy the whole thing. It was savory and seasoned well.
--
For the record I don't always prefer beef, but I think the stronger flavor of these had better balance with the strong buttery-flavored crust.
--
Beans: this surprised me. I didn't have high expectations but it actually was really tasty. I'm not sure what cheese they use but it was stringy and balanced nicely with the beans.
Cubano: My partner put this as his third but is my fourth. I actually think maybe even 5th for me. He liked that it had the mix of ham and pickle flavors. It looked and tasted like it had ham and chicken and pickles. I couldn't taste the cheese at all and expected some kind of sauce or mustard with it like the sandwich does, but alas it did not. The meat also was a smidgen dry. Not bad but could have been way better.
Lechón: my 4th/5th favorite. The flavor of the pork was quite good and it was tender and juicy enough. However, this is one where it suffered overall because it's a milder flavor and the empanada crust overpowered it.
Chicken: I like chicken. It's so versatile. This just tasted like boiled chicken, very flight flavors, overwhelmed by the crust. Also, the chicken was overcooked and dry. It wasn't so bad you wouldn't want to eat it, but it was distinctly not tender and juicy. I wanted a sauce to dip it in to give it flavor.

Oh the dessert....
It was delicious. The balance between the mouse and the cake was great. It wasn't too sweet or rich, but had a decadent chocolate flavor. The crust was nice with a little crunch to it. The cake inside was very moist. Also it looked like there were two different chocolate mousse in the layered cake, but I didn't try them separately to explore further. I ate all layers together and the cohesion was perfectly balanced.
My partner took a bite with the rose petal, do not recommend.

Great authentic Puerto Rican Food. Pernil (pork) cooked to perfection and the mofongo the same.
Good service and spacious seating area indoor or outdoors.
Plenty of parking also

HORRIBLE service with long wait times. I am a PR and was so excited to go here for my bday. The food was very underwhelming (burnt alcapurria with no flavor, extremely salty steak in my mofongo). We will never be returning! What a shame😭.

So happy to have found this restaurant.  Their food is flavorful and delicious.  We had the Beef Pastelillio.  It is hot and crunchy with yummy dip.  We also had the Jibarito Lechon Plate and Pollo Frito Plate.  Delicious.  Our server was very nice and friendly.  The restaurant was nice and clean.  We will be back.

This is not an authentic Puerto Rican restaurant food. I was so surprised when they gave me my Mofongo. It looks like a birthday cake with beef on top. The food was so salty that I did not eat it. I order a platter and it was also very salty too. It appeared the oil they used appeared to not be cleaned and was burned. I don’t know how people can give a five star to this restaurant when the food was the worst food ever had , not really Puerto Rican or Dominican food. The service was OK, but it was not to my expectation ,unfortunately I think this is more of a tourist trap. I will never go back and I’m in from out of town who travels all over the world. A Mofongo supposed to be with meat inside like a Cuchifrito restaurant. it is  just unfortunately that I don’t think they know how to really cook authentic Puerto Rican or Dominican food. As a business owner, I was very surprised. The manager never came by to discuss my displeasure with the food when I explained to the waitress. In conclusion, if I can give a zero, I would.

As other reviewers said, don’t be fooled by the building. It’s a restaurant in a night club.
