We came for lunch so was not crowded and music was not loud , just odd to have lunch right beside a dance floor. Ignoring the dance floor and low ceilings and dimmer lights, the food was excellent. Everything we ordered was amazing. Already trying to plan a next visit.

Great Peruvian food and amazing service!

This place serves authentic Peruvian cuisine, and everything we tried was delicious. The chicha morada was such a nice touch, especially that it was complimentary.

Huge shout-out to our server Kylie — she was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made the whole dining experience even better. She explained the dishes patiently and checked in on us at just the right moments.

The atmosphere was warm and cozy, and the service really stood out. Would definitely come back and highly recommend!

Bold flavors that pack serious heat don’t underestimate the spice level here! But it’s that perfectly balanced kind of spicy that keeps you coming back for more. The portions are generous. It feels fresh and authentic. We were in a rush so we called in our order and was ready right when we arrived.
Their churros. I’m going to be bold and say they’re better than Disney’s. Crispy on the outside, perfectly tender inside, and worth the visit alone. If you love authentic, Peruvian flavor, this is your spot

This is my 2nd time coming here per my friend's recommendation! Our server Kylie was very friendly and sweet! We got to try an interesting drink called chicha morada which was really good! The yucca fries are also really good! I ordered them during my first visit and were really good so my friend and I made sure to order them again! We orderded the exact same thing which was  the Tallarin Verde (see attached pictures)  honestly, everything was delicous! I definately recommend the yucca fries ✌️☺️

We just had half the menu here and everything was absolutely delicious. Service was fantastic.
The wings were super crispy and flavorful, the fried plantain was sweet and not overly greasy (get it with the green sauce!)
Pork tacos were very fatty but so tasty, with super fresh corn tortillas.
Ropa Vieja was very tasty.
They offer lots of drink offers that are very refreshing!
Highly recommend

This was our first here and it started out as a wonderful experience became quiet unfortunate at the end. We  had half of the leftovers from the main meal and a few of the appetizers we wanted to take home but we were splitting the food. The waitress was on point from beginning and the middle however as I was going through their unexpectedly long prompts for payment she was in quite a hurry after I said give me a minute as I was paying she cleared the main dish to the kitchen and the food we were going to bring home was trashed. I completely understand that mistakes happen but this was literally half a plate of food that was wasted. She did offer to make it right but my friend was very upset and I was in geniuine shock that good food was wasted. I was looking forward to writing a really good review but the place wasn't busy enough to be in a hurry to clear the table. There was plenty of room for everything to be left. I only noticed after we were leaving that the table behind us had stacks of plates with the customers at the table as well. But our table plate needed to be cleared, it made for a very chaotic situation. The waitress was very apologetic and gave us options to make up for it. Unfortunately I left a decent tip before I realized the food was trashed. Good fusion food.

This place is the real deal! The hot chicken sandwich was perfectly crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, with just the right amount of heat. The pickles added a great tangy bite, and that bun? Soft, buttery perfection. The fries were seasoned beautifully and had that perfect crunch. You can tell they care about quality here. Super satisfying meal and definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to again. Highly recommend!

My friend introduced me to this place via three bites and I was hooked. I got the chicken fries. The service was pretty quick and the customer service was on point. It was really clean inside as well. I’ll definitely be back.

It was a spur of the moment order. We saw the sign once, and it was cute. Decided to order for a later night dinner pick up. The cashier was sweet and attentive when I arrived. The sandwiches , the western chick and the side chick were really good. We preferred the western out of the two the most as the bbq sauce and onion ring took it over the top. The special fries (can't remember which it was, think it was the cali chick) were good. I like them alot. They were too spicy for my boyfriend but I thought they were perfect as this is total preference. We will be going back to try some of the skinny chick options (grilled vs fried)  i recommend trying this place for sure.
I loved the Side Chick fries and onion rings too. So Yummy. Definitely getting it again!! Thanks  guys.

I hate that the use DoorDash for deliveries! I never got my order because DoorDash SUCKS!! But the crazy part is SIDE CHICK was responsible for the refund. The refund that I NEVER RECEIVED!!!! So I called them... Yeah I'm still waiting for that return call 2 weeks later!! It's been over a month since this happened and still NO REFUND!! I can't make this shit up!!! #LostAcustomer 😟

One of the best places in San Diego!

Seneca Trattoria is perfect for celebrations, with an incredible view and even better food. Everything we tried was amazing: the Carbonara, Linguine Nero Pasta with Clams, Wood-Fired Prawns, and Chocolate Espresso Martini were all top-notch.

The staff is very responsive and kind. We celebrated our wedding anniversary here and were surprised with a couple of complimentary drinks and the best table with a view, even though it wasn’t guaranteed.

Huge shoutout to Jaycee, our wonderful server, who made the evening unforgettable. Highly recommend this spot for a romantic dinner or any special occasion.

and everything was amazing! The Panna Cotta Flip was absolutely delicious. We also tried the Dark Chocolate Nemesis Torte and the Pear Hazelnut Mousse — not very sweet, but still good if that’s your preference.

The sunset view was incredible and made the whole experience even better.

Seneca is owned by the same restaurant group as Born & Raised, Lafayette Hotel, and Morning Glory, and the quality definitely matches. Highly recommend for drinks, dessert, and a beautiful view!

We went here yesterday for my friend's birthday dinner. Our server was Michelle, who was excellent, attentive and navigated us so well through the menu. We had the arancini, tuna tartar, focaccia bread and white sauce clam pasta with the banana bread for dessert. All were delicious and satisfying but the dessert had to be our favorite. Dynamic flavors and textures in one bite. We loved it!

They really make it special when you let them know it's a celebration. The ambiance and design of this place is also so magical with so much attention to detail. I believe it was the manager who also came over to check on us with the rain and for the occasion. They really went above and beyond and we appreciated every aspect of the experience.

Unfortunately, the rumors I’ve heard of this place are true, it is just another overhyped Consortium restaurant. I will say, the overall aesthetic, location, decor, and ambience of the place are well done. It’s a clean restaurant with a unique look and great views. Pizza and pasta dishes were nothing special, not something I would go out of my way for to order again. Our group really enjoyed our appetizers, specifically the arancini and the garlic focaccia. The squash and burrata, wasn’t the favorite, again, nothing really special.

The service is what really took a dip for our experience. We had a reservation for 7:30 and called hours before to update it to the notify we would be having less people. Seneca only had an automated system so we had to leave a voicemail, however, it’s clear that they did not check it or make the necessary adjustments, because when we arrived, the hostess did not know about our request and it took us nearly 15-20 minutes to be seated WITH a reservation. When we finally got seated, our server shortly took our drink order, however we did not see a trace of her for 30 minutes. This “service” continued on for the entirety of our dinner- extended wait times and our server was not checking on our table unless we would flag her down first. Given that this was a Tuesday night, the amount of time it took for us to wait for our orders when it was not even that busy was ridiculous.

The ambience was amazing and the food and service was great. We got the Caesar salad, Brussels sprouts, and mortadella pizza. Everything was delicious. Our server Adam and his assistant (forgot her name sadly) were great. We went on a Saturday night and it was really busy, you definitely need to make reservations well in advance. This is definitely a spot I recommend and if you’re making a reservation try to request outdoor seating because the view of the city was gorgeous!

name: Mama G’s Kitchen & Sauces
vicinity: 407 Camino del Rio S, San Diego

reviews.text:
Hands down the best Peruvian restaurant in California! As a Peruvian myself I may attest this place has the authentic flavors every Peruvian-American looks for. Homemade authentic taste, family owned, and friendly staff.

Special shout out to our waitress who was very attentive and friendly!🙂🇵🇪

I recommend the cheviche de pescado as a starter.
For our enteee we had the Lomo saltado and Ají de gallina.
For desert don’t forget to try the Lucuma ice cream (special Peruvian ice cream) and picarones for desert.

My husband and I visited Mama G’s Kitchen and Sauces, and we absolutely loved it! The restaurant is beautifully decorated with touches of Peruvian culture, including llamas, alpacas, flags, and vibrant colors, which makes the atmosphere so fun and authentic. They even put little Peru flags on every dish, which I thought was such a cute detail. We started with the Loaded Yuca appetizer, which was really tasty with their special sauce. For our entrees, my husband had the Lomo Saltado and I had the Tallarines Verdes—both were delicious. For dessert, we had the Lucuma Cheesecake, one of the best desserts I’ve ever tried. We also had a chance to try local Peruvian beers, which were delicious. Highly recommend!

Absolutely incredible! The flavors here are out of this world — every dish tastes fresh, vibrant, and authentic. The ceviche was perfectly tangy and bursting with flavor, and the presentation was beautiful. The staff and the owner were warm, attentive, and made us feel like family. You can tell they put their heart into the food and the service. This is hands-down the best Peruvian food I’ve had in San Diego . Can’t wait to come back!

Any time a friend comes to town I take them to Mama G’s !! 10/10 easily the best Peruvian food in town. I’ve been to multiple restaurants here in SD but none of them come close. Mama G’s is the only one that reminds me of grandmas cooking with authentic Peruvian flavor 🤌🏽 food is delicious, atmosphere is nice with indoor and outdoor seating. Highly recommend Chicha (purple corn drink), Pisco sour (egg white cocktail), and the lomo Saltado 🔥

Mama G’s Kitchen & Sauces is an absolute gem! The moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm, friendly vibes and the smell of amazing Peruvian flavors. The star of my meal was the shrimp ceviche—so fresh, zesty, and perfectly balanced, it’s hands-down the best I’ve had in San Diego. Every bite was bursting with flavor and you can taste the quality in every ingredient. This place feels like home, but with flavors that take you straight to Peru!

Michelin Guide recognized restaurant located inside the Grande Colonial Hotel. Had a reservation for five on a Sunday for brunch and were seated immediately. It’s $10 for valet parking when you dine at the restaurant, and you need to show your restaurant receipt when picking up the car. We ordered the octopus, sourdough bread, a pecan sticky bun, and tuna crudo for starters.  The octopus came with potatoes and a cheese sauce that was tasty. The tuna crudo came in 6 pieces and I liked the citrusy dressing. The pecan sticky bun was a sleeper hit (the candied pecans were particularly good); I only wish that the coffee machine was working so we could’ve had a latte on the side to accompany it.  My entree, I had the huevos rancheros. It was quite filling and I took half home for leftovers. We rounded out the meal with the half baked chocolate cake, which had the consistency of a molten lava cake soaked in ice cream - definitely split this with other people. Our waitress was very nice and the vibes were chill.

Not even being dramatic this was top 3 meal of my LIFE. Cannot stop thinking about how good each bite was - absolute perfection. Tuna crudo and brassicas salad with persimmon jam was life changing for real !!!
Food was pretty good, although kind of standard brunch, but we could taste some differences in terms of paying attention to the details. Too bad, only breakfast menu was available

I had an incredible experience at Nine Ten Restaurant tonight! We indulged in the tasting menu, and every dish was absolutely delicious. Our server, Jose, was fantastic—super attentive and friendly. He made sure we had everything we needed and provided great insights about each course. The whole team was on point, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. I can’t wait to come back! Highly recommend!
The food is absolutely amazing and you can tell that the chef truly loves what he does. Every bite is filled with refreshing flavors and each dish sparks a memory

Went to get food from Classpass. Decent food ,but didn't realize it was prepackaged and fridgerated food. I loved the chocolate chip cashew cookie. My 5yr old daughter was disappointed in the bean and cheese burrito since she was expecting a pure cheese/bean burrito. Good for meal prep.

I got the chipotle turkey burrito and was pleasantly surprised at the portion and flavor. We ordered this for a lunch meeting. Others had salads, bbq chicken, and  chicken shawarma. All were happy with their meals.
Don’t believe their photos. Extremely tiny portions that don’t look anything like they advertise. I feel so ripped off.

I use to love getting meals here but the last 3 or 4 times I’ve picked up from here (I usually get 12 meals for the week and make sure they aren’t expired) every plate that has cheese in it smells so tank and does not taste good! I think they keep using cheese that went bad 🤮

I have been waiting for a restaurant/meal option such as this! Ready prepared meals, healthy ingredients, and reasonably priced.

All the meals are under $10, and they also have fresh juices. Natalie was super helpful and informative. I grabbed three meals and received the first one free.

This will become a go-to for me as someone who works in the area.

We really wanted to like this place. Was excited to see that they had oyster pooboy, but it was a really distasteful experience! First off we were there when they first opened. We ordered seafood gumbo, catfish and chicken tender combo(that don’t come with no fires) oyster pooboy, and a pecan pie and a small bowl or eetouffee. All this came up to a $69. We dined in and when they brought the food out they severed it in cardboard Togo
Bowls. Seafood gumbo was terrible, it had bland crab scrap pieces, okra was hard, and two big oysters that was very strange. The bowl was shallow and it was more gravy than it was substance. They had a side of rice that seemed to be uncle Ben microwave minute rice, no seasoning , the gumbo lack true flavor, 2 out of 10 experience. Next was the oyster pooboy it honestly needs to be removed from the menu. Oysters acutely scared me they were very mushy with an unpleasant taste. 0 out of 10. The shrimp eetoufee was good. We ordered a small for $9 that came in a very small cup with three shrimp over rice, I thought the cup was extremely small for $9 but the shrimp was the best thing we ate. Next was the combo plate was thrown off that a $15  combo plate don’t come with fries, fries were an extra $5. A little extreme. But besides that the chicken tenders were amazing very tender, the catfish was okay I thought it could have been fried harder and it had no flavor, but it was good fresh once it started to get cold it wasn’t good. 7 out of 10. The pecan pie was amazing a 10!

The service was bad in our eyes. They were just standing around we were the first customers. The guy kept coming and grabbing our trays while we were still eating. He was there grabbing stuff before we even got up, like they were watching us eat and as soon as we were done he came and grabbed our trays and we still had stuff on the trays. I was literally trying to hurry to put the last piece of pie in my mouth to put the trash on the tray the worker was holding. Like what if we wanted to sit back for a minute we definitely felt rushed. There was no hot sauce bottles so  we had to use hot sauce packets at a pooboy shop? Wasn’t mad to spend such a large amount of money to support a black owned business but was very upset at the quality, and service of this place. I will not be returning and I would not recommend anyone to the place. And if you do go order the shrimp chicken and pie.

Well, I was going to grill on the night I ordered, but this recipe came on the TV for Gumbo and I was pretty much redirected in another direction and found a little place called The Gumbo Pot. I went through my delivery service of choice and placed an order for three items:

Gumbo Z'Herbs (Collard Greens, Turnip Greens, Mustard Greens, and Okra)
Gumbo Ya-Ya
Chicken Creole

I took a couple batches of photos here. The first are the "As Delivered" photos and the second is after I made it more presentable for a family dinner. You'll pretty much be able to look at them and figure out what is what so I'm not going to waste your time reading useless prattle.

Now, the first thing I noticed was the fact that all containers were clearly labeled with what was inside. Not many do this, so that was quite appreciated on the entrees and if a person can't figure out rice...well...yeah. Speaking of Rice, this rice was beautifully cooked and kicked steamed rice from a Chinese place straight out of the ballpark! Awesome rice here. I used the Rice as a base for the Gumbo Ya-Ya as well as the Chicken Creole when I plated it (in the two black bowls. White is Gumbo Z'Herbs). It made an excellent base.

Onto the Gumbo Ya-Ya... I thought this was pretty good! I don't know much about Gumbo, but I felt it was pretty good. I did find some Bay Leaves that weren't pulled out, so you might want to look out for those. Flavor wise though, I have no complaints and as long as you like that bit of slimy from the Okra, you are good to go here!

Chicken Creole:
This was amazing. The meat was tender and cooked perfectly, and I mean came apart with a fork perfect and flavorful. This will not disappoint and I suggest giving this dish a try!

Gumbo Z'Herbs:
I wasn't quite as thrilled as I expected with this one. Perhaps it is because I first had Collard Greens in Georgia? I don't know, but I'm not an expert on Collard Greens, so I can't provide much more information than how I felt about them. The vinegar was a bit strong, but they were cooked perfectly and well worth exploring!

Final Verdict:
The Gumbo Pot provided a great tasting meal and they offer a lot of options to choose from and I'm pretty sure you can find something for everyone on this menu. I know I had to make some serious choices and I will definitely be ordering again. Go see these folks or order and support small business!!

Food is amazing here. Have eaten a majority of it. No cash accepted. Gumbo filled with big chunks of sausage and chicken. Same with jambalaya. Sides were all delicious. They are in the plaza next to Little Caesars since late 2024. Older reviews are irrelevant. I highly recommend. Better than other Cajun/New Orleans restaurants in San Diego. Trust me. I’ve had it all.

We ordered for to go. Chef was communicative about the wait, and it was really fantastic. Everybody was really pleased. Highlights were the seafood gumbo, fried shrimp, red beans and rice and the okra.. And of course the po boy. Could use a lil more ventilation inside.

I FaceTimed my boyfriend while he was dining in this restaurant. He was immediately reprimanded by an employee for having his phone on speaker phone. If him being on the phone was an issue they could have approached him politely and asked him to turn his phone down. A paying customer should not have been dealt with in such a rude manner.

Edit:
There was no one else in the restaurant at the time. And he was never asked politely to lower volume. I could hear the whole interaction.

Great service and great food. Love the 36 oz. Sapporo beer. Watch out because the spiciest really really spicy.

Also, the restrooms are very clean.

My only complaint is they use plastic plates and bowls.

I love BbQ chicken ! It’s my third time - once on college Ave and twice at convoy both were amazing and this time I tried the rose bodoki delicious I went with a recommendation from the man who took my order at convoy the honey garlic it was incredible. Great recommendation he was very patient and helpful , the restaurant was so clean and great friendly atmosphere. I highly recommend! Both locations great chicken and kind staff

The man was so nice right when we came in, he asked if we were 3 to be seated. We said we were getting take out. He was very patient because I couldn't decide what I wanted to order and he answered my question about the sweetness level very nicely. He was so polite and told us out special sauce boneless chicken with a side of fries would be 20 minutes. We left and when I came to pick it up 15 minutes later it was ready. He gave it to me so nicely and asked if I wanted some utensils. He even remember there were 3 of us so he asked if I wanted 3 utensils and I said yes please. It was a very pleasant experience I was so happy and I felt good to order from a place that has such nice workers!

First time trying this spot,.think it's the fourth KFC (as in, Korean Fried Chicken) spot I've visited. The food is really great! The only thing I might complain about is the service time, they were not super busy but the wait staff took some time to seat us, a party of 3, while we awkwardly stood at the front next to an empty waitlist. I also might not have been specific enough, but they charged me for a sandwich and sweet potato fries outside the combo price (though also partially my fault for not noticing we were outside the time frame, I did mention combo and they did not correct me). Just something to be careful of next time!

Pictured are the food options we grabbed, definitely solid food choices. The spot was very clean and had tons of space to sit, the parking was also lucky for a Sunday early evening compared to usually around Convoy.

The family combo 2 is a bit restrictive in flavor choices (half has to be original, and the other half their secret sauce), but it's still plenty of food alone. We grabbed a ton more appetizers just to get a feel of the place. First time I've had kimchi rice and it didn't disappoint (I normally avoid kimchi, but I decided to give it a shot). Cheese balls are always good, the corn salad was certainly similar to esquites, and the corn cheese was an improvement over the kind you normally get at a kbbq.

I'd definitely give this spot a try if you happen to be nearby, but maybe try the other chicken dishes since you can pick their variety of flavors.

10/10 went for my first time today it was amazing! I got the Spicy Chicken wings just to test it out… Chicken was Juicy crunchy flavorful all in one bite yes I’m coming back to try more!!! Thank you for a wonderful meal!

I’ve been coming here for years thanks to my sister who lives in SD. This is where she usually takes me for a bite before we watch the sunset on the other side where the cliffs are. That’s where the view is.

This time around, our dad was with us, visiting from Asia for the holidays.
We got our usual order. Pho, spring rolls, the fish and that rice that is so damn good. I keep forgetting that it happens to be spicy. I’m always pleasantly surprised when I get a bite that happens to be spicier than usual. Everything we got was so good. All plates and bowls were cleaned. You can tell we were so into our meal because the moment our items were dropped off the table, we all went silent and shifted to chow time.

Service here has never been consistent. It’s always a hit or miss. We had a super late lunch the day after thanksgiving after spending a few hours at Sea World so we were starving. Our server Dominic was great. He was super busy tending to all the tables outside.
We were howe super put off by the runner who dropped off our food. He initially dropped off a set of plates that my sister thought were too small so she asked him for the bigger ones. His facial expression indicated he was annoyed with her request. When he came back with the plates, someone else at our table asked for another item and this time around he was even more irritated.

Do yourself a favor and go get this food. Service was wonderful. Food flavorful. Neighborhood so cool. My company was excellent as well. You’ll have to find your own good company but the great food and service is waiting for you there. Crazy good.
We’ve been coming here for years. Always delicious food. Their Spicy garlic wings are amazing. The Vietnamese crispy egg rolls have a really dense filling. Friendly staff. Good selection of beers.

I have always enjoyed food here at Ob Noddle House. My go-to are the sizzling fish, the house-fried rice, and the fried wings. The wings are definitely top three in San Diego. The house-fried rice and the sizzling fish are definitely the top of my favorites to eat. Excellent service; everyone is nice and really goes above and beyond to make sure you have a good experience.

Sat on the patio. Uncomfortable seating. Noodles were hot but kinda bland, even though I requested spicy. They brought chili oil, but it’s not the same as when it’s mixed in in the kitchen. Service was friendly.

Came here for the first time and boy was i glad. Staff from the jump was so nice and helpful. The bartender was very nice giving me recommendations on what to try. I didn’t know they also have specials during the padres games! $1 wings (min of 6) $9 classic burger with a side salad but can upgrade to fries. They also have taco Tuesday specials. I highly recommend you come also the atmosphere is very nice, I’ll definitely come back again. Thank you again to the staff who treated me and my family very nicely.

I purchased a gift card that was advertised on channel 5 San Diego and I thought it would be a good way to celebrate My Friend‘s birthday when we arrived the location in fashion Valley. It was advertised that it was open, but it was closed and there was a person at the counter and or a cook in the back no one acknowledged us so we decided to go across the way use the restroom at the pizza restaurant and then come back yet. It wasn’t open  on a second try, so we decided that we would just try again out on another day. I do want to mention that the chef on tv was different on than that  of your restaurant, but to be honest, the portion size was minimal With a ton of fries to cover up the portion.

Before watching Materialists, my friends and I had dinner at The Craft House in Fashion Valley. It was my first time there plus with my other friends too, my friends introduced me to it and encouraged me to try the food. I ordered the short rib mini tacos (my friend’s favorite!), guacamole and chips, Caesar salad with grilled chicken breast, fish and chips with parmesan cheese, Brussels sprouts, and charred octopus. Everything was absolutely delicious!

The atmosphere was chic, with both indoor and outdoor seating. I loved the vibe, and the service was great too, the staff was knowledgeable and knew exactly what we needed. Always a win when you find a place with great food and great service!

Dropped here for a quick bite after the movies and it was way above expectations!
Cool vibes (my girlfriend liked the woven lights) with nice house music playlist.
Food was amazing, we got shirmp gambas (the bread was so good) and the short-rib mini tacos which were very juicy and flavorful with the salsas on the side. Their Burgeon draft beer was clean and tasty.
They also have happy hour for the starters and the draft cocktails as well. They close the kitchen at 10pm but 11:30 for the bar.

Lots of fun gourmet burger choices, just wish we had more people with us to try all the options. The bread and buns were amazing. Especially the “not so basic” burger! They got us seated quickly. It was a cool atmosphere and we enjoyed it.

Fantastic authentic Cuban food and ambiance, along with excellent service. Free crispy and tasty plantain chips with two salsas to start. The Cubano sandwich is an excellent example of the classic, especially the delicious, perfectly seasoned pork. It's served with a few perfectly fried fat plaintain fries. The Camarones Al Ajillo appetizer was among the best appetizers I've had with succulent shrimp, mushrooms, and garlic in a white wine, capers, and lemon juice sauce. It's topped with hot red chile peppers that seep a subtle heat into the sauce when it's cooked. Toasted Cuban bread is included. I could make a meal of just this dish.

Super fun place!! A short walk from the convention center, it was perfect for a late lunch! I came during happy hour as well so was delightfully surprised with the great prices. I had the picadillo papa relleno and it was fantastic! The picadillo was super flavorful. The server was super nice and attentive. I also had the cuban sandwich which was great as well. Overall, a great experience and I am so sad I'm not in the area to try more on their menu!

Came in for a late lunch, pretty much had the restaurant to ourselves, sat by a window upstairs. Tanya was friendly and attentive, able to give good recommendations. Food came out hot, delicious, cooked properly. We came on a Tuesday so the empanadas were 2 for 1 which was perfect. We had the croqueta de pollo and the croqueta de jamón y queso along with the la Cubanita and de carne empanadas. So a total of 4 empanadas and 4 croquetas were enough to fill the both of us so we’ll have to save the $94 filete tomahawk for another visit. We look forward to the yucca fries too, and I think they do live music some nights which always sounds fun when we’re walking by.

Located in the heart of the Gaslamp, Havana 1920 is such a great Cuban restaurant/bar. Food was tasty, service was above and beyond with some great conversations with our server and the people watching is totally top notch!  We were there Thursday around 2:30 and all their sandwiches were 1/2 off!  And they were delicious!

As a Cuban American,  I know authentic Cuban food when I see (and eat) it.  I stopped in for dinner with a couple of friends and the atmosphere is super Cuban,  from the decor to the music.  We tried the Cuban sandwich and it was just as good as you'll get in Miami.  The empanadas and croquetas were amazing.  The tostones were slightly over cooked but still good.  Our server was great and the prices are reasonable.  Definitely recommend if you are a fan of great Cuban food.

What a gem of a happy hour find. First, our server Madison, was friendly, enthusiastic and knowledgeable. I was surprised that she hadn’t been working there that long.

The 1/2 price HH shareables were very well done - large portions, as well. The tenders and calamari were perfectly lightly breaded and piping hot. The dive wings were huge and flavourful.

The one disappointing thing was that the drink prices on the online menu (part of the reason for going) showed lower than the actual menu ($6 vs $8 actually for the HH cocktails). Given the food prices being so reasonable, it wasn’t that big of a deal.

Dinner: Wonderful server, fun atmosphere, comfy booths, delicious “take me to Mexico” cocktail, and scrumptious ‘from the very first bite’ beer battered shrimp and blackened mahi mahi street tacos.
Brunch: yum! Lived the fresh fruit, eggs Benny, and fish and chips! Again- great service! Fun decorations!!
Spent a lovely mid morning in to lunch time there.  Great cocktail menu.  Good food.  Excellent service.  Anfew tables not under cover are dog friendly.

10/10 across the board. The food was amazing, the portion sizes were great for the price, the staff was all super friendly and accommodating. They made us fun and tasty nonalcoholic drinks. We will definitely come back!

The food is great and I highly recommend the duck dive burger, but the service is another story. We had the most impatient waitress who was rushing us while ordering and seemed like she was trying to spend the least amount of time at the table. I understand that you may have a lot of tables to work with, but it’s the 15 extra seconds that you spend with a table while ordering, giving them suggestions or just being helpful that makes all the difference. On top of that when we wanted to pay she didn’t want to split the way we had requested. Splitting the check the way we requested takes 1 more minute and would’ve made the service much better. I would come back if it wasn’t for the horrible service.

name: Havana Grill
vicinity: 5450 Clairemont Mesa Blvd Suite G, San Diego

reviews.text:
12/23/25 We visited the day before they were to close for a week so they were out of the chicken vegetable soup, guava dessert, and the different kind of fries that comes with the entres. That was ok, because there was plenty of other things to try. The server up front was so helpful to give suggestions and explain what each thing was. She gave us a paper menu near the register to help us.

We tried the Cuban sandwich with fries. The fries were thin, long, crispy, and great! The sandwich was cut in half and warm. The steak dish I got had rice and beans, plantains, carrots, a sauce, and pulled apart meat that was crisped up, garnished with herbs, and delicious. I took half home. The iced tea was good, water was flavored with cucumber, and the mojito was lovely.
They have plenty of free parking, two unisex bathrooms, and a walk up to order set up. Upon entering, go to the right then toward the bright menu at the front, look up on their menu, then walk to the left to order at the register. Then you take your number to the table. This is not clear when you enter, so some folks just walked directly to these register. The seating was arranged a bit oddly or maybe the tables are too big for the space. The drink station was to the left of the register.

I always tip cash. There was a container for cash tips. On the credit card tipping, there were high percentages to chose from. I thought those percentages were for full table service, but perhaps things are different after COVID. They closed at 7 pm.
I think because some folks are unfamiliar to this food, they want to consider having menus with bigger print, and a knowledgeable person nearby who can answer questions.

Absolutely delicious Cuban food and a wonderful atmosphere! Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The grilled meats were juicy and perfectly seasoned, and the sides—especially the plantains and black beans—were authentic and full of taste. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made the experience feel warm and welcoming. Great drinks, vibrant decor, and lively music add to the charm. Whether dining in or getting takeout, Havana Grill never disappoints—highly recommended for anyone craving genuine Cuban flavors!

Omg y’all, this Cuban place was the bomb!!! Food was cooked to hit every taste bud in your mouth ( talk about perfection). Talk about authentic!!! We tried the crazy Cuban, Cuban sandwich, Picadillo empanada, guava with cheese pastry and the brownie cookie ( no judging lol). All was a 10 out of 10 🙌! Service was amazing!!! Super friendly gentlemen, made sure we had everything we needed and checked up on us several times. Ambiance was super chill and lax… highly recommend

Got the Cuban hot sandwich, Bavarian cream cake & an iron beer. Everything was delicious, the sandwich was rich with lots of meat & flavor, crispy bread & the garlic butter/oil was yummy. The Bavarian cream cake was delicious, not too sweet (there was an odd flavor in the round thin piece but otherwise everything tasted great. Washed it all down with an iron beer. The place is ridiculously cute! It's an outdoor feel, inside & the staff is all dressed in uniform with cute hats. They were all very pleasant & friendly. Prices are fair for the qualityIt's Located in a giant Plaza with plenty of parking

If you're craving authentic Cuban cuisine with bold flavors and generous portions, Havana Grill is a must-visit. I stopped by recently and tried the classic Cuban sandwich and the sampler platter, both were 🔥 delicious and satisfying. The sandwich was perfectly pressed, with that savory combo of roasted pork, ham, pickles, and mustard that hits all the right notes. The sampler was a fun way to explore multiple dishes, and trust me, the portions won’t leave you hungry.

💁‍♂️ The staff were friendly and welcoming. You’ll hear upbeat Cuban music in the background and catch whiffs of garlic and mojo as you walk in, instant mood booster.

One small wish: I’d love to see this place evolve into more of a sit-down experience with table service. Ordering at the counter works fine, but the food and ambiance deserve a more traditional dining setup.

🎶 Great food, great people, and a taste of Cuba right in San Diego. I’ll definitely be back for more empanadas and maybe a flan next time!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Bali Hai Restaurant
📍 2230 Shelter Island Dr, San Diego, CA 92106

We dined at Bali Hai on Sunday, October 19th to celebrate a birthday, and it was absolutely wonderful from start to finish. We had 7:30 p.m. reservations, arrived about 15 minutes early, and were seated right away by the window with a breathtaking sunset skyline view overlooking the San Diego Bay.

Bali Hai is a Polynesian-style restaurant known for its relaxing island ambiance and delicious menu. While their Sunday brunch offers an incredible spread of crab legs, oysters, prime rib, omelets to order, and more, we came for dinner and enjoyed every bite.

We started with the Ali‘i Tasting ($28) — a must-try sampler that includes coconut shrimp, Bali Hai tuna poki, spinach lumpia, beef skewers, and firecracker ribs — perfectly portioned and full of flavor. For entrées, I ordered the Honey Cashew Shrimp, featuring lightly battered shrimp with bell peppers, onions, candied cashews, and jasmine rice. My son loved his Korean Fried Chicken with scallions, sesame seeds, and sweet sesame sauce, while another family member ordered the Crispy Pork Belly, which looked incredible with spiced lemon, pickled peppers, black vinegar, and balsamic jam.

Our server, Diego, was friendly, attentive, and professional, and the hostesses and beverage team were equally warm and efficient. Our drinks arrived promptly around 7:45, and the food followed shortly after — impressively fast for such a busy evening. We wrapped up just before 9 p.m., fully satisfied after a long, fun day at the beach and park.

This was my third visit to Bali Hai, and each time it continues to exceed expectations — from the outstanding service and delicious Polynesian cuisine to the stunning waterfront views and relaxed, elegant atmosphere. I’m already looking forward to returning on my next trip to San Diego. 🌴✨

Came to San Diego for my honeymoon and this restaurant was the highlight! The food was amazing, absolutely adored the cocktails, beautiful venue & the best service. Our waiter was so informative and truly kind - he went out of his way and even wrote a list of recommendations for things to do in the area. We went back basically every night of our trip even if it was just for drinks.

Such a gem! My girlfriend took me here after sailing. Talk about a walk back in time to fully immersed Tiki Culture!

The ribs were a major highlight. We felt like it was plenty of food for the price. Drinks were absolutely out of this world. Service was awesome and the views can’t be topped.

One of the old school Tiki bars still standing! Must stop for tiki lovers. Food was good but not amazing. Drinks were strong! Almost to strong! Tried the Mai tai, Pina colada and the jetty. Food we tried the fried rice, calamari and the tasting for two. Desert was the best! Great selection of custom tiki mugs!

We had an amazing lunch today filled with delicious Polynesian and Hawaiian-inspired flavors—but the true highlight wasn’t the food or even the stunning view. It was our incredible server, Ava.

From the moment we sat down, Ava guided us through the menu with such enthusiasm and knowledge that we assumed she was a seasoned pro. To our surprise, it was only her second day serving! She recommended standout dishes that ended up being our absolute favorites, and her understanding of the drink and food menu was unmatched.

Ava made our experience not just enjoyable but genuinely memorable. We will absolutely be back—and when we are, we’ll be requesting her by name. She’s a gem and a true asset to this establishment!

The atmosphere here is not merely casual, but community-centered. The service shows this, too, and it’s a wonderful and relaxed place to enjoy a meal. They played Oldies and 90s R&B while we ate outside under an umbrella with a nice breeze.

Everything we tried was delicious: brisket (under the ribs), beef hot links, ribs, baked beans, collard greens, cornbread, and lemon cake. (We had Coke and root beer to drink.) This is East Texas style BBQ, and it was my first time having it. I will happily come back for more and if I am travelling I will happily try more Texas BBQ.

A Blk Review 👀:
I got the brisket sandwich. The sandwich on its own it was great I like the brisket needed a bit more sauce so make sure you get extra. Now the sides, the mac and cheese was so disappointing like I had a taste for some mac and cheese and some baked beans on the side and I wanted to let them touch. Definitely a let down! Nasty, taste like too much chicken bouillon or I'm not sure I didn't like it though and the color was a little off too Orange. The baked beans were okay, sweet, it almost hit but kind of tasted like bushes from the can with no added seasoning. It was my first time I was a little disappointed because it smells great from the outside. Now the service everyone spoke everyone smiled auntie was going off at the cash register felt like home. The entrance has like a living room feel a little table you could see people playing spades at a patio area is a very cozy space and everything just feels black real black feels like childhood nostalgia. I'm going to go back and try the ribs and the tri-tip and the other side definitely skipping the mac and cheese.

Oh my gosh, this barbecue place was incredible—easily one of the best I’ve ever been to! Deanna at the front was super friendly and helpful. I definitely ordered way too much food, but no regrets… leftovers for days!

Everything was amazing: the tri-tip, brisket, ribs, mac & cheese, candied yams, and even the catfish—all perfection. I’ll definitely be back!
Love it here! The food, hospitality, the sense of community. You can tell they take a lot of care. Can’t wait to be back. 10/10 would recommend. Thanks for having us.

Hello my wife and I ordered while on vacation through door dash.. we had the 3pc chicken greens and Mac n cheese and yams all were bomb had an amazing flavor a little bite nothing was overpowering .greens didn't have meat in them and the yams did not have marshmallow on top. 10 of 10. Highly recommend great 1st meal to start our vacation EXCELLENT FOOD.

I was visiting San Diego for a couple of days and came across this gem right on Pacific Beach. Parking took a few minutes to find, but it wasn’t difficult at all since it was a weekday.

I was greeted and seated promptly at a prime patio spot overlooking the beach and ocean—hard to beat that view. I ordered the seafood taco trio and was impressed with the portion size. The fish, calamari, and other seafood were generous, and everything tasted fresh. The veggies and salsa were especially good.

As I usually do, I asked if they had fresh-squeezed juice. They had orange and a couple of other options, and I went with the orange—it was excellent.

Service was top-notch throughout. I was checked on a few times without it feeling intrusive, and overall the pricing felt very fair for both the quality of food and the prime beachfront location. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area.

A quick brunch after a morning of surfing that satisfied and delivered. Not too busy when we were there so got seated right away with beautiful panoramic view of ocean, beach, surfers, etc. friendly service (our server Hannah was very nice) I ordered the açaí bowl which was phenomenal. I practically inhaled it. Bathroom situation was a little lackluster, awkward path to get there with one sink and paper towel dispenser that didn’t work at the time of our visit. Other than that however, everything was fabulous and we look forward to returning in the future.

Went as two couples for a weekend lunch. We started with the mimosa option and their Award winning World Famous lobster bisque with sherry. Do not skip this. It’s absolutely amazing! Everyone ordered a different menu item and they were all prepared to perfection! Very reasonably priced too! We chose a window seat in the outdoor covered patio area to enjoy people watching, in addition to our fabulous meal.

A Mixed Bag on the Boardwalk

My boyfriend and I were looking for a classic San Diego beach brunch and decided to try World Famous. We arrived around 10 am on a Sunday and were told the wait would be about 40 minutes. Luckily, we got a text that our table was ready in only 20 minutes, which was a pleasant surprise. We were seated outside in a shady spot, which was perfect since it was already getting hot.

The one major drawback was the strict menu schedule. I have an egg allergy, so I was hoping to order from the lunch menu, but we were told the kitchen wouldn't start those orders for another 45 minutes. It would be great if they could be more flexible with allergies. When I was finally able to order, I got the fish and chips without the chips due to a potato allergy and chose a side salad instead. The fish was a bit heavy on the batter, but it was flavorful. The side salad was pretty standard, nothing special. A suggestion for the menu would be to offer sweet potato fries as an alternative for people with nightshade allergies.

My boyfriend had a much better experience. He ordered the World Famous Wipeout and said the bacon was perfect and the pancakes were delicious. Our server was very sweet and attentive throughout our meal. The Drunken Mermaid cocktail was also a hit!

We would consider going back, but next time we’ll aim to arrive closer to lunch service to avoid the wait for the kitchen to open the lunch menu. Overall, a nice spot with good service, but the menu constraints were a significant issue for my allergies.

We are regulars for a reason!
The manager, Roxanne, is incredible! My parents have mobility issues and she ensures that we have a table that can accommodate them EVERY time we visit. The staff, especially Luz, are so helpful and friendly. The food is terrific but the people who work there make this a step above the rest! It’s why we always come back!
The tacos are INCREDIBLE! You cannot go wrong with any menu option.
You have a view of the ocean and boardwalk! People watchers will love this place!

There's way too much competition in San Diego to be standing in line for 40 minutes and waiting another 20 minutes for the food only to just barely get a table. However, this La Jolla and it's my first time trying this place. It's a very very solid spot for tacos especially for being a small chain, perfect no notes minus the service speed. The Baja fish tacos were an absolute stand out. The best taco here and might be the best fish taco I've had. The meats were good too but something about that Baja fish taco I will think about for a long time.

I stopped by The Taco Stand in San Diego and it was awesome. I got the Carne Asada and Al Pastor tacos, and both were super flavorful and smelled amazing. They have a separate sauce bar so you can load up on salsa and toppings however you want, which I loved. I also grabbed some churros, and they literally fry them right in front of you. They were super crispy, warm, and crazy good. Definitely worth a visit if you’re nearby!

This might just be the place to experience truly authentic tacos. Every topping is available in unlimited portions, and each one tastes incredibly fresh, adding layers of flavour to every bite. The tacos I ordered were absolutely mouth-watering; perfectly prepared, vibrant, and bursting with freshness.

I would highly, highly recommend this spot to anyone who loves genuine Mexican flavours. Even the churros stood out; they were exceptionally soft, warm, and beautifully made.

One thing to keep in mind: each order comes with one taco. But trust me, the quality, taste, and freshness make every single one worth every penny.

Heard good things and decided to check it out- it was great! I got the burrito Al pastor, which is a filling burrito! We also got an order of churros which were perfect and a great price. Others got burrito carne asada, and fish taco and everyone said they were great. Make sure to get sauces while you wait for your food, I loved the salsa cilantro sauce and pickled onions.

We waited an hour and a half just to place an order at this location, and another 30 minutes for the food to be ready. The tacos are indeed delicious, but given its proximity to La Jolla, the wait can stretch far beyond what most diners might expect. Among the several tacos we tried, the carne asada stood out for its aromatic grill flavor and well-developed seasoning.

Operationally, the strain of high demand is hard to miss. Ingredient portions varied noticeably from taco to taco, and the salsa station had slipped into disarray by the time we reached it. The canned margaritas, overly sweet and priced well above their value, are an easy skip. Despite the food’s strengths, the management challenges make this an experience best approached with patience—and perhaps a backup plan.

I ordered 2 vegan dishes (veggies with tofu & kung pao tofu) & 2 servings of sesame balls.  The large portion size of 1 dish can feed 2 aduls in my family.  The kung pao tofu is surprisingly delicious -- I wish I can learn how to cook it.  Service is the fastest I have ever experienced.  Servers are always smiling.  Free appetizer of chips with chili sauce, & fortune cookies. The restaurant is beautifully & lavishly decorated with Chinese decors. The tables & cloth napkins are clean. I highly recommend this place.

Went to Bistro City to try their Salt-n-Pepper Wings. Unlike most places, they heavily spice the batter the wings are fried in. It was too spicy for my liking. I left the wings for my co-workers and they said the wings were really good. So if you like spicy, you will love the wings.
I also got some orange chicken. It was good, but nothing I would make a special trip to get.

Me and my fiancé recently went to bistro city for an early dinner date as soon as we walked in. We were greeted right away, and we were seated. Great customer service, very respectful and honestly me and my fiancé underestimated how much food we ordered. We got the house, fried rice, and The house noodles along with a salt, pepper, chicken wings, and that’s all we intended on ordering, but we got recommended the pork belly, which is amazing. Highly recommend, but when the food came out, it was way more food than we thought. So we left with plenty of leftovers that lasted us. The Food was amazing The Customer service was amazing. We look forward to coming back, but this time with more family and friends, because there’s definitely plenty of food to go around

This place is so good! I have been here about three times and nothing had disappointed! Finally reviewing it so I’m going to post all the dishes I’ve had! I’ve had  the Fried wontons as complimentary snack. Singapore Stir Fried Thin Rice Noodles, Dry Beef Chow Fun, Triple Mushrooms with Egg Bean Curd, Salted Fish Fried Rice, Crab Rangoon and Salt and Pepper Chicken Wings

The Singapore noodles were delicious and such good flavor, and the chicken in it was delicious! The dry beef chow fun was so good also honestly if you have a noddle craving this will settle it. The triple mushroom with egg bean curd was light and delicate but crispy at the same time.. the salted Fish Fried rice was so good also, don’t get it if you don’t like salty things. even though it was salty it was in a well balanced way. The crab rangoons were also perfectly flavored and  lightly crispy such a great appetizer and the salt and pepper chicken wings are a must! So so freaking good! Perfectly seasoned and great crunch in every bit.

YOU CANT GO WRONG HERE!

The wings are great but if you happen to see a chow mein (bean sprouts) item, just know it will be NO noodles and a ridiculous amount of bean sprouts, broth and whatever you may have added. It will leak all over everything else you ordered and you will never want to eat bean spouts again. Also, way too expensive, unless you really love bean sprout chow mein.

Picked this establishment on a whim and from first taste, it was evident that FLAVOR comes first here!  We were shocked.  Family run and owned, the careful control of flavor is no more evident than in their house sauce of garlic and cilantro.  It is perfect and I would put it on everything but sweet pastries!  I have never had a Cuban sandwich like theirs.  The chicken empanadas were breathtaking.  The stuffed potato balls are delicious.  The sweet empanadas are almost as good as the savories.  Perfect French fries.  The daughter mans the counter and her dad is in the kitchen.  A perfect meal!  Cuban sodas are on offer.  DO NOT MISS THIS EXPERIENCE!!!

As a vegetarian, there are a few options. I recommend the potato balls stuffed with jalapeño & cheese and the spinach & cheese empanadas. They are so delicious! For dessert, we have tried the guava & cheese pastry which is so good. This is hard to find anywhere else so I’m happy I found a place in SD! I always make it a point to stop whenever I’m in the neighborhood.

This restaurant exceeded expectations with its excellent food and service. Upon entering, the environment felt inviting and well-maintained. Staff members greeted guests warmly and showed great attentiveness throughout the meal. The menu offered something for everyone, with dishes thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor. Food arrived at the right temperature and in generous portions, leaving everyone satisfied. The dining area was clean and comfortable, with just the right amount of background music. The entire experience felt organized and enjoyable. Every detail showed care, from the friendly service to the appealing presentation of each dish. A wonderful place to dine.

I missed Cuban potato balls..especially from Portos, so I decided to research where I could find something similar without having to drive to Buena Park or Glendale! Wow I'm so glad I found this spot.... their potato balls were delicious! Bought a dozen beef potato balls for a birthday potluck party and also brought guava cheese and manago cheese strudel - so crispy and flaky! The owner person upfront took our order, very polite and in a happy mood! The restaurant is small inside with 2 small tables, there is option for sitting outside with more tables. When my large order was ready he step out to bring me my food! Nice guy, great service....delicious food!

Great food, fair prices. The Cubano sandwich is amazing, their guava and cheese bocadillos are to die for.

A hidden Gem in Chula Vista, don't sleep on their bowls, they are around $10 dollars and have more than enough food to give you a food coma. Also a great eay to explore cuban dishes.

name: Lazy Dog Restaurant & Bar
vicinity: 1202 Camino Del Rio N, San Diego

reviews.text:
From start to finish, this was a standout experience. Josiah was an exceptional waiter—attentive without hovering, genuinely funny, and incredibly engaging. He anticipated our needs before we even had to ask, which made the whole meal felt so relaxed.

The food was on point: beautifully presented, perfectly timed, and delicious across the board. Everything arrived exactly as it should—hot, fresh, and clearly made with care. You can tell when a kitchen and service staff are truly in sync, and that was absolutely the case here.

Great service, great food, and a fun, welcoming atmosphere. We’ll definitely be back—and hoping Josiah is working when we are.

Had a great time at Lazy Dog! I ordered the bison burger, and it was absolutely delicious—juicy, flavorful, and cooked exactly how I wanted it. The French fries served with it were crispy, golden, and seasoned just right—definitely a perfect pairing.

The bar area has a comfy, cozy vibe that makes it a great spot to kick back with a cold beer and hang out with friends or family.

The staff were super friendly and welcoming, which added to the laid-back and enjoyable atmosphere.

All in all, a solid spot for good food, great service, and a chill time. I’ll definitely be back!

I recently visited the lazy dog with my girlfriends for some dinner and a chat, and I was not disappointed!

The lazy dog is a really big place, which is a plus! They also had happy hour but we got there late.

We ordered noodles, and salads. Everything was very tasty! Ended up ordering dessert which it was delicious.

Our server was really nice and helpful.

Overall a great experience! Can wait to go back.

We stopped by Lazy Dog and overall had a good experience! We started with the bacon cheddar biscuits and the lemon pepper tots, the  biscuits were hands-down the best thing we ordered, warm, cheesy, and packed with flavor. The tots were great too, perfectly crispy and seasoned.

For entrées, we tried the Teriyaki Chicken and the Mediterranean Chicken Bowl. Both dishes had good flavor, but the rice in both was undercooked (or had been sitting out a bit too long), so it was a little crunchy. The chicken itself was tasty and well-seasoned, though.

Service was great, friendly and attentive, and the restaurant was clean with a nice, welcoming vibe. Despite the rice issue, we’d definitely come back to try some other dishes, especially after how good those biscuits were!

It was difficult to rate this place. It was my first time and living just a block away, I was happy to find such a dog friendly establishment. I went yesterday afternoon for happy hour. The HH menu and dog menu were wonderful.  Ordered the watermelon margarita and it was the best I’ve ever had. Ordered a couple apps and another marg. Food, drink, waitress was all incredible. My waitress’ shift was over and I was told another would be taking care of me, I insisted on paying with my original waitress so she would get the tip. After that no one came to check on me. She assured me they knew I was there. I waited, and waited, and waited. Trying to get one of the waiters attention to order more. But they just ignored me. Finally got someone’s attention and no one knew who my waiter was. How does that even happen? I was on the patio with my dog. In the end it was frustrating that I didn’t have a waiter to order another drink or request more water for my dog. Instead of them trying to find out who my waiter is I just asked for a box and left.

Editing my review because I ordered takeout last night and it was trash. I’ve never see a cheese quesadilla flat as a piece of paper. Every single piece looked like this. Did they forget the cheese?

Mid cooking style but indeed best seafood and sauce. It was the freshest scallops I have ever had. The bourbon butter was such a fire especially with rice. Loved it so much. The plate also came with salad which was nice. Lemon garlic butter flavored jumbo shrimps also hit. Wouldn’t really recommend fried calamari and garlic bread because there’s nothing special.

Blue Water Seafood is definitely worth a try if you are nearby! We ordered the Ahi Tuna Sandwich with lemon garlic butter dressing and pepper jack cheese. I can't describe how amazing this sandwich taste. The fish just melts in your mouth! It's so soft and perfectly cooked. The tomato and lettuce taste fresh and compliment the fish and bun perfectly. Your mouth is filled with flavor with this sandwich! 10/10!

I got there right before the lunch rush.The place looks nice they were playing tribal seeds which was cool.There was big cuts of fresh fish you can see through the glass.When I ordered the girl said 15 minutes and im pretty I got it on less than 10 quick service.I got calamari and fresh onions rings which was amazing. 🤤  I also ordered red snapper and cod fish and chips,the fish tasted fresh but it was lacking flavor which was disappointing maybe they didn't put seasoning or enough seasoning in the batter? Not sure. It was a bit pricey but fish always is.
Parking was hard but normal for that area. I will be back to try it again.
So good! Fresh and tasty seafood. The “Track Taco” is amazing. Fish and chips are delicious, as well as all things with shrimp. Friendly staff and a good ambiance both inside and outside.

Came here to try the award winning Tack Taco, and it was worth it. The lineup was long, waited around 45 minutes to order and get a table. The track taco was the biggest, tastiest, messiest, and most incredible taco I have ever had. All of the seafood is super fresh and delicious. The staff are very friendly and appoint you a table while waiting in line. There is lots of street parking nearby for free.

The view is incredible and the "big" drinks are excellent to share (or drink on your own 😉!)

We travel with our dogs and they are always welcome and the staff is very kind and receptive to them. Our dogs are bigger and the staff will make sure we are seated somewhere they can be comfortable.
Everytime we come to San Diego , we make a stop here and we don't regret it!

This place is basically a nacho shrine disguised as a beach bar. The nachos? Absolutely the main character—cheesy, crunchy, loaded, and totally worth coming back for. Service is friendly and quick enough to keep your margarita flowing without breaking a sweat. Add in those unbeatable beachfront vibes and a location that practically demands you kick your shoes off, and you’ve got yourself a solid spot to chill. I’ll be back—for the nachos, obviously.

Loved the atmosphere here! The ocean view alone makes this place worth visiting, but the food and drinks make it even better. The fish tacos were fresh, the portions were generous, and everything came out quickly even though it was busy. Staff was friendly and the whole place has this fun, beachy vibe that makes you want to stay longer. Perfect spot for a relaxed meal, good margaritas, and people-watching by the ocean. Definitely coming back.

The location is why you come here. The food was alright. Nothing special about it, not gonna lie. Carne asada fries would be better over chips, so order nachos. Their fries aren’t crisp enough to have cheese poured on them. Fish tacos were alright. But the location is great. Patio was awesome to sit on. We enjoyed it overall.

I wasn’t sure how the food would be here, but it ended up being really good! I wouldn’t say it’s the best quality, but it was very good still especially since the margaritas we had did the trick! It is a perfect place to go grab food if you want to be on the beach but aren’t willing to put on your bikini(that’s exactly how we were feeling). It was great though, good drinks, pretty strong, and we had plenty of food options to choose from. We also were fortunate to get one of the best tables over by the beach walk way.

Good acai, lots of topping options! Definitely recommend building your own bowl and heaping it with all the yummy add-ons. Just a warning that prices have gone up and some things are extra $ now. Good parking out back.
I usually only get the mango mania smoothie but today I tried their Tuna Sandwich and it was also excellent! No pic of the sandwich because i gobbled it down lol 🤤😋

THE BEST Açaí bowls in the city. I’ve had bowls all over SD & hands down this place is superior 🤙🏼 Ingredients always fresh, & the roots bowl in particular is SO good. Prices are fair too. Friendly employees, Rosa was very sweet. I love Roots Bowls I’ll recommend them over any place here.

I have tried several Acia bowls in San Diego and this 1 is the best. It’s super fresh, all the fruit is cut into bite size pieces and it has so many choices to add on. I am in love plus the Chai latte was delicious. You won’t be disappointed.

My little brother went into this location to grab us bowls, while I waited in the car he came out extremely upset, tears in his eyes. and I was shocked. The woman working the counter was very rude and condescending. Talking down to him because he hadn’t been there before and wasn’t familiar with the menu. He asked for the bowls to go and she rolls her eyes and smashes the lids on top, didn’t close them and wrapped them in cling film. The bowls were dripping everywhere all over the plastic  bag they were shoved in.

This was a very unfortunate experience especially during the first day of pride month.

View is amazing at sunset!! Food was great! Loved the sweet chili wings! Gets a little cold after sunset if you’re seated by the windows but they closed them for us no problem. It’s a great spot to enjoy the view, a drink and people watch 😊

Visited this location on a work thing. Gave me an excuse to try as many things as we wanted (lol) kept it simple and we ordered a fish sandwich, Caesar salad (I know boring), fish and chips, fried calamari, and some other stuff that I forget.

Food was good, definitely got our moneys worth (and by ours I mean the company chose well for a tax write off). Staff was super friendly and helpful and took their time answering our questions, especially given how large our party was.

We visited in the evening around 5pm on a Wednesday night and the restaurant was not as busy as it appears in some of the other reviews. It was actually surprisingly quiet and it gave is the chance to talk to each other without having the need to yell over music or other tables.

Parking is super tricky, there is some parking in front of the place but because it is a busy area, I would not rely on it. There is parking to the sides of the building but it's not super close and its a few minute walk.
Great location, but we asked for no cilantro in our food, came with cilantro, waiter could not care less and called it "micro greens". Mac and cheese tasted off. Mahi sandwich was nice

Pretty nice restaurant overlooking Pacific Beach. Food prices are on the higher end, the taste of the food was decent, but needed something more for a higher review. The calamari appetizer dish was a little greasy. The fried fish from the fish and chips was good but the fries tasted "off". Scallops were made perfect but the combination on the plate with the blanched peas and carrots lacked some flavor. Also had a sushi plate that was tasty.

Great views! The food is mid and the waiters are inattentive. People come here for the view and the most “restaurant” type on the beach in pacific beach.
Reasonable prices- they have a limited happy hour.

We tried the Antojito Salvatrucha -  a sampler plate. Hot, delicious, crispy. Authentic flavors…how do I know??? Because my good friend Rosa is from El Salvador and I spent countless hours at her kitchen table. You’ve got to come by. Service was great - fast & friendly.
food was awesome and delicious and right pricing. finding parking is hard, park on the street at your own risk.

The pupusas and curtido here are delicious. From the revueltas con todo to the loroco with cheese, we tried them all, and they are all delicious! Their horchata is different, it reminds me of a drink in Mexico we call agua de cebada.  The ensalada drink is a mix of different fruits, mainly tastes like pinapple juice with a hint of apple juice, it's very refreshing. The atole de elote is ok, it's more of a micena with elote (corn). Overall this place is very good, I'll definitely be trying more dishes!

We were a party of 6 and it was our first time eating in this restaurant. We went Friday night at 7 pm, and it wasn’t busy.  It is a casual restaurant with several tables.  Our server was very attentive and friendly.  The menu items were reasonably priced & the portions were good.  Everyone enjoyed our meal.

TASTY MIXED PUPUSAS! My family and I stumbled upon this place near Grant Hill after craving something warm to eat all-day, we were definitely impressed! We ordered a variety of different pupusas ranging from mushroom,  vegan, revueltas (mixed - beans, pork, and cheese) and chicharrón. Each pupusa was about $5.50 EACH.

My order included the chicharrón and revueltas. The clear winner was the revueltas as the pork was absolutely delicious and flavorful. The chicharrón was also good, but it didn’t blow my mind like the other pupusa.

El Salvadoreño also serves refreshing fruit drinks called Ensaladas (not to be confused w/ a Salad) which include chunks of fruit. My Mom particularly liked these and informed me that it tasted pretty authentic!

Service was great, our waitress was polite and refilled our drinks quickly! The dining room is sizable and fits both small and large groups. Restrooms are available! I’ll definitely return to this place and suggest it to my Yelp friends.

Good experience. I liked basically everything I ordered, whether it was the acai or the smoothie. My only issue was that the guy who served me did not treat me warmly, and I felt it throughout the stay. I'm not saying I expected a brilliant conversation and interest, but he just seemed unwelcoming.

I have been driving by this place for the past year and today was the day I stopped for an açai bowl. Maybe my brain wasn’t registering a health food place in this part of town. 🤷🏽‍♂️ Who knew. Back to the review…

The peanut butter cost extra and they did not want to add more granola in place of the strawberries that I did not want. That’s ok… just as long as the açai bowl was tasty. And wow… it was on point. It had plenty of granola, bananas, coconut chips and a good amount of the extra peanut butter that I asked for. Oh, there was a nice drizzle of honey on top. The portion was massive. I just came back from my workout so it was perfect 🤩

I’ve read some of the other reviews on the açai bowl, but if they are consistent from what I ordered today, I’ll be coming back pretty often.

5 stars on the açai bowl.
Amazing food and fast, friendly service. My teens said the torta was the best they ever had. Their ingredients taste fresh. We will definitely be back!

Friday December 12th The egg in my breakfast “bagel” was super over cooked. The bagel wasn’t a real bagel, it’s a cheap multigrain bread.  I’m very disappointed in this, the salsa was also obviously from a jar. I rather pay more for better ingredients. This is just sloppy.

Absolutely disgusting! I ordered a veggie sandwich, and it was a complete letdown—soggy, bland, and clearly thrown together with no care or attention. Nothing about it tasted fresh. The pictures speak for themselves.

On top of that, the people I spoke with at the restaurant were shockingly rude and unprofessional. Zero customer service, no willingness to help or even acknowledge the issue.

It’s frustrating to spend money on something that feels like an afterthought. I won’t be ordering from here again, and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

name: Nishiki Ramen
vicinity: 1040 University Ave ste b-111, San Diego

reviews.text: Probably one of the top two ramen spots I’ve had in San Diego. I damn right licked the bowl clean. Noodles were perfectly chewy and broth was just right. Drank every last drop of that broth. They include 15% service charge in all bills so no need to tip. Waitress was attentive and to the point. 100% will return, drooling as I type right now

Nishiki Ramen in Hillcrest absolutely delivered on both flavor and fun! We kicked things off with the Russian Roulette Takoyaki, one of them is secretly stuffed with wasabi, and of course, my girlfriend was the one who got it. Her face was priceless, and it totally set the tone for a playful, memorable meal. For our mains, we ordered the Nishiki Ramen and the Spicy Chicken Ramen, both of which were excellent. The broths were rich and savory, the noodles had great texture. The only thing I could say is the atmosphere/environment could have a bit more decorations or even a dimmer/warmer light. But between the great food, fun atmosphere, and friendly service, Nishiki Ramen has definitely earned a spot in our regular rotation.

My wife, our three year old daughter and I ate here for the first time after landing on this place as a locally recommended ramen spot. The food was good but not great. I got the Akuma bowl which is the 2nd or 3rd most ordered dish according to the menu, and it was less spicy than I anticipated and also less flavorful than I was hoping. My wife got the Gyokai Tonkotsu, and she didn't particularly enjoy it. The service also wasn't particularly great as waters were left unfilled for a while and our request to two different servers for extra plates was never fulfilled despite there being only one other table with guests and three servers working.
Hands down one of the best Ramen spots in town, Smoke Bomb Black Signature ramen is something! best combination of creamy/smoky and garlicky flavors.Karage chicken is delicious as well!

Stay away from this place! They have roaches. We were having dinner and I saw a cockroach running around on the floor and the employee literally killed it in front of everyone. Would give no star if possible. Disgusting! Our water had dirt in it.

Ordered takeout and the sandwiches are absolutely delicious & delightful.
The dutch crunch bread paired with their dirty sauce is by far the best flavors I've EVER tasted in a sandwich. We both got the Barry Bonds but were able to make modifications and add our favorite veggies. I'm already looking forward to the next time we get sandwiches for lunch and can eat the other half for dinner. Also, shoutout to the Hillcrest location - the employees were so friendly and kind!!!!

I love ikes I usually go to a different location but happened to be in the area so I stopped in to get one of my faves. As I first walked in the music was so loud I could barley think and the staff seem to be playing or messing around after they saw me they turned the music down and eventually someone came to help me. As they were taking my order I looked down and noticed the guys gloves were very dirty and from the time of taking my order making orders and me leaving he had never changed his gloves! Also while I was waiting I was looking around and noticed overflowing trashcan and trash on the floor and instead of doing something about it they were walking around it. There was at least 4 people working and they weren't busy but they seemed more interested in having fun then doing their job.

To anyone thinking of eating here you should go to another ikes location or anywhere else!

One of my new favorite places!  A non meat eater and a vegan go out to lunch….and we’re very happy with their choice. Ike’s has a wide variety of sandwiches, and many of them can be made vegan on request in addition to having an already large vegan selection on the menu. I have always looked longingly at sandwiches that have turkey stuffing and cranberry sauce in them. Well no stuffing but vegan turkey, cranberry sauce, We got the “Falling for Ike’s” on sourdough and it was a real treat for non meat eaters. Subbed vegan cheddar. Split the sandwich, sat outside, and anxious to go back!

This was my first time ever trying Ike’s sandwiches and I was super excited because my friends and family always rave about them and I’m sad to say that I was left unsatisfied. I ordered the Menage A Trois. It has chicken in it and I asked for lettuce and tomato. Honestly, the ingredients were tasty but not necessarily the freshest :/ my sandwich was dry and flat and didn’t have enough chicken and barely any lettuce or tomato considering that it was $16!! There was a lot of bread left over because of how little filling there was. Maybe I will try a different location to see if that changes anything.

Ike’s is a cool little sandwich shop. It was my first time ordering from there so I didn’t know what to expect. The sandwich was huge and decadent. The sourdough bread is a nice texture. Not dry. The only thing that could have been better was the sauce situation. They drowned the sandwich in sauce. I couldn’t taste anything else. Had I known this was the case I would have asked for the sauce on the side.

Go to Gold Coast Bagel or Cheers Deli around the corner for way better service and food!  Sandwiches are twice the size of here. Today will be my last visit there. I asked for the veggie sandwich to be put in a wrap instead of a bagel. I have ordered this here 3x previously. The owner was sitting down in his seat and told the clerk NO. I said why I have ordered before? You just literally put everything in the wrap instead. Then he again told her NO. Would not bother to get up or even look at me. So won’t ever be going back there and urge you not to bother as well. Go spend your money somewhere they will be nice to you and make a sandwich or a wrap the way you want it!  I mean it’s $14 for a veggie wrap. You think they could fulfill your request but apparently too much to ask. Shame. Place is never busy for a reason and now I know why. They don’t appreciate their customers.

I stopped into Golden Bagel after picking up coffee next door at Starbucks because I prefer to support small businesses and thought I would grab my breakfast sandwich there instead.
Unfortunately, the experience was extremely uncomfortable and concerning.

The employee preparing my sandwich was sick. She was coughing while making food. After I received my order and sat down to eat, I became even more alarmed. The same employee went into the restroom and was violently ill. It genuinely sounded like she was struggling to function. On my way out, I asked the staff at the counter to please check on her, and they confirmed she was not feeling well.
At that point, I could not stop thinking about the fact that someone who was clearly ill was handling food for customers.

I am the primary caretaker for my father who has serious immune and autoimmune conditions, and I now have to worry about possible exposure because of this visit. No customer should be put in that position. Basic food safety and common sense require that sick employees not be preparing food.

To make matters worse, my bagel was barely lukewarm and certainly not “golden.”

I wanted to support a local business, but this experience was unsettling and unacceptable. I will not be returning.

Very great spot we walk to from our home it’s only about a 15 minute walk.
