The wait can get kind of long we waited 20 mins for our two bagels but it was Saturday morning so understandable.

Lovely staff and bagels are always delicious

The place was very nice. It was quiet cause it was early in the morning, a little after they opened. I ordered my food (2) bagels and Lox,  and in a few minutes it was ready.
I'll be back there again when the craving for bagels and Lox hits me again.

Service and atmosphere of the place was great. Ordered 3 smoothies, bought a bag of the day old bagels, and a tub of the veggie cream cheese to take home to the family. Smoothies and cream cheese were good, ALL the bagels were moldy with green mold and fuzz on the bottoms. It was so disappointing. I get they are the “day old” bagels, but these had to have been like 3 day old bagels. We just threw the whole bag away and spread the cream cheese on toast bread.
I really enjoyed my lunch . The staff and food were just so comforting . Everything has just the right kick of spice and hit the spot.

I’ve ordered food for take out before but it’s my first time dining in. I gotta say the first experience wasn’t great. The decor was modern and I liked the bar area.

We got seated in about 5 min when we arrived around 9pm. The waiter (i think he’s the manager) took our order. Another waitress brought out edamame first, and then tuna poke and tonkatsu ramen. The karaage didn’t come until mid-way through our meal. They didn’t give us utensils so we had to ask for them. We were told that they usually only give a spoon?!

Now food…the tuna poke wasn’t anything special (tuna looked fresh though). We ordered two bowls of Tonkatsu ramen. They were not as salty as other ramen places but then they didn’t have much flavor either. There was a very strong yeasty taste (or a distinct flavor that I wasn’t able to identify) from egg noodles and soup. It came with a very small piece of pork (the smallest I’ve seen from a bowl of ramen). The karaage came last. Each piece was big and not enough crunchiness. The spicy mayo was delicious.

We paid for the check but then later noticed that they charged more than the menu price (I didn’t even realized that at first so it’s good to pay attention to your bill). We told the manager about it and he was nice to adjust our bill. Anyway, it’s recommended to check your bill.

Overall, our first dining experience wasn’t great.

The service is fast, the staff is polite, and the food is delicious and good price ! The location is really nice, indoor and outdoor seating is available, great place to bring family or friends. Haven’t tried out the other location but definitely recommend this location.
The ramen is rich, flavorful, and one of best I’ve tried in San Diego, the bao bun is crispy and one of my favorite starters, can’t wait to try the rest of the menu items
Awesome spot, super chill. Staff was helpful and super positive, ramen 🍜 was awesome. Will definitely come back when I'm in town.

Honestly, the broth needs improvement, it was okay but had a minor bitter taste. And we tried two different ramens! The Tajima fries are amazing and have a great flavor. Definitely recommend those! We had a server who started us and towards the end, she never returned and a different waitress just came to ask if everything was okay but not informing us she was our new server. So that’s where the service threw us off!

name: Pop Pie Co.
vicinity: 4404 Park Blvd suite a, San Diego

reviews.text:
Dropped in late, just before closing. Still had plenty in stock. Opted for slices of Mushroom Leek Quiche, and Key Lime Pie with a mini-football of whipped cream.
Both were excellent. They offered to heat the quiche, which came out piping hot. The leeks might cause some stranding, so compact fork work might be a challenge. It is all tasty, though.
We are officianados of Key Lime Pie. Anything green, forget. This pie ROCKS! Though the crust is a tad underperformed compared to the filling. Not quite as flaky as in the keys, it still stands up to what one needs a pie crust to do.
I am glad there are many locations, just wish I could rely on such a solid resource like this anywhere near my neighborhood.
We were too excited to take photos before diving in.

The pies are delicious (both sweet and savory)!! What I love about their pies is that the ingredients taste so real, and the presentation is on point. We devoured the pumpkin pie!

Shout out to Michael! Super friendly and considerate. The space is super comfortable, even for a party of 12. Would definitely recommend!

Out for a sweet treat after dinner wanting some dessert and pie definitely sounded good, it was almost about 8pm and quite busy line moved pretty fast. They had plenty of delicious options mini pies, by the slice whole pies and piescream. I like always wanting to always try a little bit of everything ordered an ube slice, apple caramel slice and a apple piescream. All delicious definitely craving satisfied, highly recommend and visit they also serve chicken, steak and breakfast pies. Coffee served too, glad I found a pie location that I can come and satisfy my cravings.

I enjoyed my brief stop here. Pop Pie Co was a great place to just rest for a little bit on my walk on Park Boulevard. You won't be disappointed, I went with the chocolate chip walnut cookie which is something I would come back for in the future.

I stumbled upon this place while driving by and realized I hadn’t had a pot pie in forever, so we decided to stop in. The spot is a bit small, but they offer outdoor seating, which is a nice option. They have a great variety of pot pies to choose from—including vegan options. Don’t let the size fool you—they’re surprisingly filling! I couldn’t decide on just one, so I ordered one to eat there and another to take home.

Then dessert caught my eye—I’m a sucker for key lime, so I grabbed a slice of that and an apple pie as well. They also offer sides; I went with the kale salad and mashed potatoes with gravy. The mashed potatoes were fire, and the kale salad was tasty too.

They serve coffee as well, and the latte I got to go was made perfectly. The staff were super friendly, and the place was clean and welcoming. If you’re in the mood for something different, this place is definitely worth a try.

So my first time going to Kitna exchange very excited to try this place out so I book on OpenTable for New Year’s Eve. They have a set dinner menu for New Year’s Eve on paper sounded amazing so I arrive with my wife they put us at a table that was against the wall, which wasn’t even a table which at first I wasn’t too mad until I saw a lot of other tables that were still open that were a nice view I was wondering, why didn’t they just sit us there which they weren’t reserved because 20 minutes later somebody comes in and gets sat there. And again everything was already prepaid with my Chase sapphire card so I’m already in $360. Drinks not even included service was pretty up to par very tentative, but the food which is the reason why we’re here was not the best part might’ve been the dessert and the scallops the shrimp dish, which looked amazing but lacked flavor. My wife didn’t enjoy some of the meals more than me. We go to probably 80 restaurants a year and wanted to close out the year with something special and it fell far from that. Maybe it was because it was a fixed menu so I didn’t really get to try there better selection, but for the cost, I usually would give another place. Another chance this is probably a never again would I ever advise no even when I went to waterfront after the bartender there so that place used to be good but with the new chef doesn’t come close anymore especially for what you’re paying so 1000% even if I was offered a free mail there highly doubt I would go. Honestly, the best thing I appreciate it was the Photo Booth that they added easily was the best part of the night at that establishment.

Love this place. Def a great a lot to come to when in San Diego. The food, the vibes, and they even have music at night.  Great drinks and bites.  Love coming here and Everytime I come here I have a good time. Highly recommend coming here any day of the week and seeing what all the talk is about.

Pros:
The food was absolutely amazing. I had the butternut squash dumplings and the "Mapo" and both were phenomenal in terms of taste.
The staff were friendly and the server was able to recommend popular dishes or which dishes pair well together.

Cons:
Finding parking is very difficult unless you want to pay $10+tip for the valet. I circled the surrounding blocks for around 20 minutes until I got lucky and found a spot 2 blocks away right as somebody else was leaving.
The dishes are tiny for how much they cost - especially the dumplings. $16 for 4 dumplings that don't even have a protein stuffing is insane. The "Mapo" was a little better on the size, but I still left without feeling completely full afterwards and I have a pretty small stomach.

If cost isn't a factor, this place has amazing food, but I personally don't think it's worth the price.

Every bite was absolutely incredible! Spicy tuna, cauliflower, burrata, peanut pepper dip, duck meatball, lamb noodle… all insane! And the best was the Caesar Twinkie was the best. This place blew me out of the water.

It's an Experience that's Meant to Be Shared. Top-notch Service Coupled with Great Ambiance and Paired Dishes Creates a Unique Memorable Adventure Worth Coming To. This is a 5 star Restaurant that is Fun and Serious at the Same Time. It takes its culinary delights seriously but after hours/weekends it turns into a fun social experience shared with friends and coworkers. A San Diego Must.

I have to admit this is a great restaurant! This is my last day in San Diego. I searched for this place on the map. Their soup base is really good 👏！！！I didn't add chili sauce or hoisin sauce. There's music and a bar. Claw Machine！！Great for couples dating, family dinner.

Updated：06/052025

The bún bò huế was super flavorful. The broth had that deep, savory kick with just the right amount of heat. It came loaded with tender beef slices, pork, and a strong lemongrass flavor that made every spoonful satisfying. Definitely one of the better versions I’ve had in the area.

The shrimp ceviche was surprisingly my favorite. It was bright, tangy, and packed with fresh herbs, sesame seeds, and crunchy cucumber. The prawn crackers were crisp and perfect for scooping. It felt refreshing and fun to eat.

The green papaya salad helped balance everything out. It was light, crisp, and zesty without being overwhelming. It added a nice contrast to the rich broth and punchy ceviche.

If you're in Convoy and want something comforting with bold flavors, I’d absolutely recommend this spot. I’m already thinking about going back for round two.

Definitely come for the All You Can Eat BBQ!

We saw that all the restaurants around here had lines out the door, but people are sleeping on this place. So we tried it.

Mark was super attentive and professional as our waiter. The food was fresh and tasted amazing.

It’s not as marinated like Korean BBQ, and that’s neither bad nor good, just different. The flavors really came through from the different meats and seafood, and the option to make them all spring rolls was cool! It was refreshing to try something different!

And the meal included a drink and ice cream (ice cream was delicious too!)

Loved our food at Mignon Pho + Seafood! Great atmosphere and friendly staff, and the food came out quickly. We started with the beef carpaccio and tofu rice paper roll. For entrees we ordered the grilled ribeye pho and the garlic lobster noodle. I was really impressed with the amount of lobster that was in the noodle, whole pieces with shell of the tail and claw, a lot of places will give you just small pieces. Definitely recommend if you enjoy Vietnamese and Asian cuisine.

Located in a bustling plaza, Mignon Pho + Seafood is not just a traditional Vietnamese pho restaurant but also features a modern, spacious design. The interior is clean and organized, with uniform wooden tables and chairs in both square and round shapes, thoughtfully arranged to maximize the large space. The hanging lights add to the open and inviting atmosphere. They also offer fun activities like a lottery machine and claw machines for entertainment.

One standout feature is their stylish bar, where you can enjoy Cocktail Happy Hour daily from 3-7 PM. During Happy Hour, they also serve $1.5 fresh oysters, which I’m definitely planning to try on my next visit.

I visited during lunchtime and opted for the lunch special menu. For $17 (before tax), the combo included a bowl of pho, two egg rolls, and a drink or tea—a great deal! The pho allows you to customize with three ingredients. I chose flank, brisket, and bok choy. While the meat portions were not overly generous, the pho and herbs were plentiful, making it a satisfying meal.

The staff was friendly and attentive, enhancing the dining experience. I look forward to coming back during Happy Hour to enjoy their drinks and oysters!

Here’s desserts are too beautiful to not get any! We tried 4 different kinds and they are all very yummy, and the price is cheaper than when you get from coffee shops or restaurants. But somehow they taste quite similar, nutty, flaky and sweet. Overall, I liked and probably will go to get more in the future.

Fantastic market for all your Persian food needs! Super clean and well organized! Find your Iranian or Afghan saffron behind the check out counter! Also, an IMPRESSIVE baklava bakery complete with Turkish delight!

We always buy the cous cous here. Top quality products.  We love the pistachio and saffron ice cream and the fresh bread. We ended up buying three kinds of bread because we love it! The bakers are always very kind.
Yesterday I missed the fennel root. Balboa International Market is one of the few places in San Diego area where you can buy fennel bulbs. I hope they bring them back. Another thing that I like of this market is the variety of fresh herbs and shallots. I think it's the only place where you can buy fresh lemon basil. And the pomegranates! They have the biggest and most beautiful pomegranates.
Prices are decent. Products are good with a good selection of products as many things you would not be able to find elsewhere. Produce is good with reasonable prices. Parking is horrendous.

Terrific little market.  Excellent selection of unexpected items in produce, deli, and baked departments, all at fair prices Fresh homemade candies are delicious.  The best made to order pizza and fresh baked breads.

Great music, vibes, and some of the best sushi I’ve had in my life.

We got the beef gyoza (fried), Baja lemon cilantro roll, flaming ahí roll and crispy rice roll. Each were unique and delicious in their own way, but also incredibly well thought out and paired with toppings.

Sit on the patio even in the colder months because they have heaters!

Enjoyed a great lunch here today.  We ordered the upstream poke bowl which had crab salad, enoki mushrooms, and salmon with macadamia nuts. Atmosphere is quite typical for a quick stop sushi bite, food was reasonably priced and great quality. Service was adequate, food was delivered timely. Like many coastal dining establishments it may be on the slower side, which some people are not accustomed to, but that is common in our beach communities. It’s a great reminder to slow down and take the rush off when you’re in town enjoying the day !! We stopped in for lunch on a weekday which was perfect.

Sushi Nekosan in La Jolla served incredibly fresh yellowtail carpaccio, perfectly crisp soft shell crab hand rolls, and rich salmon nigiri, all elevated by an amazingly smooth plum sake that tied the whole meal together.

Very happy - great recommendation from a nearby bartender.

Patio seating had heaters and was comfortable.

I highly recommend coming to this sushi restaurant if you are in the La Jolla area. One of the best sushi places with outstanding fresh sushi with a variety of roll types that are delicious and a good portion. We had the Dank, Crunchy and The Drew Sen-Yea! Deserves all the attention. Wonderful service too, great atmosphere with heaters and good music.

Great sushi dinner at Sushi Nekosan in La Jolla! All the fish tasted very fresh and flavorful. We started with the albacore mango sashimi and veggie spring roll and got a lot of special rolls; the Bryan garrie toro trio, flamin ahi, scallop delight, west coast, and dank rolls. Everything tasted great. We enjoyed the plum wine as well. Very friendly and quick service. Lots of outdoor, dog friendly seating. Recommend!

Amazing little hidden gem! Been around the area for years and have never tried it until now. When I tell you the miso, chicken karrage , avocado tempera ( my new favorite)
And the chicken teriyaki was so delicious it tasted like something from a hibachi restaurant.

We will definitely now become regulars after finding this amazing and unique Jahawaiian Japanese restaurant ❤️

The atmosphere was great, and the service was immaculate. We were the only ones dining in the afternoon. I was dying to try the fried rice and was disappointed to find it bland and the chicken extremely dry. However the spam rolls were exceptionally good! I'd return for the rolls and skip the rice. Maybe the recipe can be tweaked so that it tastes better?

Placed a take out order for 4 rolls. The Philly roll was small and missing avocado. The salmon didn't taste fresh. California roll was also only crab and was missing avocado. The roll o was looking forward to the lake was the tokomo dynamite roll and it was super mushy and all one flavor. Pretty disappointing for a $17 roll. All in all I wouldn't return. The people working ignored me for over 10 minutes as I was waiting outside and it toon almost an hour to get my food when I was told 20 minutes.

Small but cozy place, with a very delicious chicken Katsu place!
I wish we could have found desserts, but the service and food was great!

I’ve been a Sushi Diner fan ever since the days of only location next to Mesa college. Then Sushi Diner 1 closed and only Sushi Diner 2 remained. Then Sushi Diner 2 owner retired and it has been sold to Tappi Sushi.

I was worried the menu has changed or quality has gone down from the limited new reviews, but was happy to find out that it’s still the same old Sushi Diner menu with a few new additions.

I love the daily lunch special meal set which is a great deal. The Kalbi bbq ribs was actually BETTER than previously. Previously they were also really small pieces and burnt black, but under new management were cooked perfectly. The endless summer roll was also better than before.

Service on Saturday was quick and courteous. Bob Marley decor is still up with Bob Marley music playing.

My wife and I enjoyed our experience here. We started with drinks, I had an HI Mai Tai and she a mocktail. The Mai Tai was excellent and strong. I was surprised at the number of mocktail options they had on the menu. We had the salmon sashimi, granny and train wreck rolls, truffle fries, and Tokyo shrimp. The train wreck roll was my favorite. Their truffle fries were some of the best we’ve had and the Buffalo Tokyo shrimp was delicious. Service was amazing as well. We will definitely be coming back whenever we find ourselves in San Diego next

Delicious food!! Pork belly tacos were amazing with the crispy fried pork. Tasty Marry Jane sushi roll, a happy hour special 😄 Scallops with mashed potato tasted great as well. Wish there were more than 3 small scallops. Quality made up for the lack of scallops! Great variety of drinks - lots of beer on draft, and outstanding margaritas! Attentive service!!

Great experience! Food was delicious and came super quickly. We had a bunch of small plates to share (5, which was a little more than enough for 2 people). Everything was good, but the standout for us was the pork belly tapas. Service was great, and very friendly as well. So, this is a great spot for some dinner after watching the sunset on the beach for sure.

Busy joint, smart menu with a blend of Japanese and Spanish cuisines, great staff (20 people work at this place) and they cater for all kinds of people, everyone is welcome here! Bartender is crazy busy, super efficient… don’t miss this place when you visit OB.

We were in town for a conference and asked the 22 year old daughter of an attendee to find a place for all of us to go. She chose this place based on something she saw on TikTok.

The service was great. Our server was very nice and helpful and very personable. The atmosphere was very chill. We ate out on the patio. We all ordered different types of sushi. Everyone liked what they had. The Rainbow sushi was great! We would definitely eat there again.

Tacos de tripa are always crispy and fatty and delicious. I love that they have the mini road tacos from the kids menu. I have a gastric bypass so I can only eat small portions. Everything is made fresh to order. Basically everything you want and a taco shop and they have Chipotle sauce some taco shops don't
Got the regular burrito de carne asada it was very delicious💯 the orchata was a bit to sweet but it was good overall

The food is amazing, however while some of the ladies that take the orders are nice and very helpful there is one young lady in particular where if you ask her for something she will act like you just asked her to cook the food herself and you’re forcing her to work there. Very condescending mean attitude, just hope you don’t order from there when it’s her work day, other than that I recommend this place! I’m still giving a good review as that’s the only issue.

Came here 10/29 for takeout and they messed up our order soooo bad it was honestly shocking been coming here for two years and idk if they got new cooks/cashier but tbh they were ALL horrible tonight.. I asked for 3 quesabirria tacos and the cashier working this night REPEATED my order in the same way I asked but then gave me 4 birria tacos w/consome NO CHEESE but she literally repeated my order right and now I get it served WRONG. I go in and ask for cheese and two cooks working that night decided to come up and act like it was a problem that I was aking for what I paid for? She even gave me attitude saying that I said this and that and the cheese would be extra I said FINE how much? She proceeded with oh it's on us acting like a privilege rather then I'm getting for what I just paid for/YOU LITERALLY REPEATES MY ORDER WITJ 3 QUESABIRRIA tacos. LAST DAY coming there they always mess up and really disappointed tbh

As A local that just moved back in to town (D.T) this location is the closest to me. I grew up on Cotijas(Nasty city) the OG Religiously!
Been craving Cotijas 😋 so my partner picked me up an order of Pollo Asada Fries, after leaving another taco shop of his choice...I specifically asked for food from cotijas KNOWING I was safe to order here...surprise SURPRISE ITS disgusting!!! 😫
Not even any Guacamole on it!!
I had to add seasoning and sour cream...the one star is because the pollo was of good quality!
But What happened Cotijas!?
Definitely disappointed!!

name: Bankhead Mississippi Style Cooking
vicinity: 8300 Paradise Valley Rd ste 102 "-103, Spring Valley

reviews.text: Delicious spot for Southern food! I ordered a dinner plate with smothered chicken, pork greens, and mac & cheese. The portion was perfect , not too little to feel unsatisfied. Everything was so good that I ended up grabbing a peach cobbler to go, lol. The staff was super friendly and kind. Definitely coming back for more!”

I was really excited to try this Mississippi restaurant after reading so many great reviews and seeing how delicious the food looked. But honestly, how much would you pay for this? Maybe $10 or $20 at most? It definitely was NOT worth the $30 price tag. They got me once, but never again!!!

UPDATE: My family lives in the South, and I’ve really missed authentic southern home cooking, so I decided to give this place a try. I ordered through Too Good To Go, which claimed the meal was worth $30—but honestly, it was mediocre at best. The chicken was decent, but the vegetables were terrible. I tried the cabbage and green beans, but they were so bad I threw them away. The only side that was remotely good was the collard greens.

Since the restaurant replied to my first review, I’d also like to mention that the staff could use some customer service training. They mostly talked among themselves and only spoke to me to take my order. Overall, it was a disappointing experience and definitely not worth the $30 value advertised.

Ordered three types of fried fish. I have to say that I like that they make them fresh to order. Size portions are decent.  Catfish was our favorite with the red snapper second. Do note the fish is fried, so if you have salt or dietary issues I would skip for now. Collard greens with pork was good and not too overcooked. Food is comfort food, not fancy. Place was busy so that's a sign of good food. Prices were very reasonable. Take out only. Food is packaged well. Staff is mellow, so just place your order and move on.

When I want a good "to go" soul food dinner, this is where I go. You can see the prepared dishes in the glass case. The selected is expansive, i.e., three choices on Collard greens. I enjoy the smothered chicken with rice, gravy, and greens with pork. Nothing fancy. Just hardy portions (2 meals) and the tasty soul food selections you want. Fried catfish, fried chicken, and ribs are also available. Dine in is available in two areas.

I really hesitated to write this review but we were so disappointed. We had a variety of dishes from catfish, fried chicken, greens, yams, Mac and cheese, peach cobble and sweet tea. Nothing was good… the tea was watered down, Mac and cheese flavorless and dry, chicken tastes old or fried in old grease. Greens were decent but the yams nothing special. The peach cobbler was a big cup of soggy peaches and soggy crust. We drove a long way to patronize this business. The overall feel was the food is not fresh. I understand Bankhead has been in business for several years so apparently many people like the food. This is just our experience and opinion. But first impression is lasting and we will not be back.

Oh my GOSH best dinner I had in a while. Everything was delicious, the savory alligator cheesecake, fried chicken and biscuits, mac n cheese, collard greens, catfish, and the appetizer rolls fried w the mac n cheese and buffalo chicken. Just wish they had a bigger beer selection as the cocktails all seem to be sweet. Food was absolutely worth the price, support local Black-owned business by a REAL chef, amazing ingredients and FLAVORFUL food! Already planning to go back to try gumbo and brunch. The patio isn’t cold at all, it’s pretty cozy and heated even on a rainy day (it’s basically indoors). It’s small so definitely make a reservation if you’re coming for dinner. Fun music but still very easy to chat. LOVE LOVE LOVEEEEEE

Unfortunately, I had a bad experience on my birthday. The service was slow, and the food was okay. The sweet tea was not sweet at all, and when I asked for another drink, I never got it. I gave up on asking the server because they barely came around. I ordered the lemon pepper catfish that had no flavor, dirty rice that had too much of one seasoning, and Cajun fries, which was the best thing on the plate, sadly. The lemon pepper wings were overly seasoned and hard to eat. Everything looked good, but the flavor was not.

Amazing food! Friendly service! Beautiful weather! Visiting from Texas, so great that I went today and yday! I absolutely could not believe that the food actually looked exactly like the social media pics! I'll be back AGAIN! Wings, gumbo, catfish, yams, greens, EVERYTHING was delicious! Portion sizes were amazing!

Food was delicious.  Atmosphere was great.  Enjoyed the music and initial greeting.  Pricing seems very high and the 5% surcharge is actually illegal without notifying patrons at time of order.  All went very well until we had to wait several minutes trying to find our waitress for our check.  Suggest find a larger location.  With the splendid food you will have long lines but pricing will have to meet standard restaurant pricing.  Remove the 5% surcharge.  Standard pricing for surcharge is 3% and patron must be notified prior to order.

Wow! Louisiana Purchase in North Park totally blew us away! We came hungry and left so happy. The Jambalaya Skillet with fried shrimp was insane. Seriously, hands down the best shrimp of 2025 so far. Perfectly crispy, juicy, and packed with flavor. If you’re a shrimp fan, do yourself a favor and order it. We also tried the Dooky Chase fried chicken with the oxtail dirty rice and oh man… comfort food heaven. The chicken was crunchy on the outside, super tender on the inside, and that dirty rice with oxtail had so much richness it could have been its own meal.

The vibes inside were great too. The staff were all really nice and made us feel super welcome from the second we walked in. You can tell they actually care about their guests, which made the whole meal that much better.

For drinks, we went with the Hurricane, which definitely a fun one! It came topped with pop rocks, which made it feel like a little party in a glass. It was wild (in the best way), though I’ll admit it leaned on the sweet side for me. Still, points for creativity because it was super fun to try.

Overall, this place is the real deal. Amazing food, great people, and a unique, lively vibe. Can’t wait to come back and work our way through the rest of the menu.

Great taste of home in Orlando!
The food was very authentic and flavorful — exactly what I was craving. Jollof rice was well seasoned, the egusi was rich and delicious, and the portions were generous. Service was friendly and welcoming, and the vibe felt like true Nigerian home cooking. If you’re looking for real Naija food in Orlando, this spot definitely delivers. I’ll be back!

My husband and I were a little nervous to try this place because of some of the reviews, but we really wanted to try African food. We were so surprised. It ended up being one of the best meals we have ever had, and the portions were pretty big. I actually got full halfway through my plate.

If you are new to African food, definitely try the egusi with chicken. It’s a great gateway. As Mexicans, we thought it was similar to Mexican food but with different presentations.

We will definitely come back. Don’t let the bad reviews discourage you. They are probably from picky eaters expecting foods they’re used to. The woman working the front was very kind and helpful, and the restaurant was clean. There was a bit of a strange smell, but that usually comes with the combination of spices and meats used. It did not bother us, so don’t let it put you off. ❤️

I had a great time at Flavors Nigerian Kitchen in Orlando. I ordered white rice with stew and it was delicious. The stew was full of bold Nigerian flavor. I also had fried plantains—they were sweet and crispy. The staff were friendly and welcoming. The restaurant felt warm and homey. If you want real Nigerian food in Orlando, try this place. I’ll definitely go back again!

The first sign that this was a good place to eat was the flood of Nigerians coming and going to pick up food items from the restaurant. The menu items were explained to us by a kid (the owner's child), but his recommendations and explanations were great. The food was fantastic. This unassuming restaurant was a must try place, go back for more.
Wonderful Joyce served us and explained every dish! Wonderful Delicious Réal African food for the whole family!
amazing restaurant, delicious food with exceptional service. cozy atmosphere, perfect spot for a lovely dinner. would definitely come back!

AMAZING FOOD! AMAZING SERVICE! My family and I are on Orlando for a week on vacation and we were able to find this spot. The women that cooked was so sweet, and we picked up our food late right when we got back from the airport and she had it ready for us nice and hot and they were getting ready to close. We appreciate that so much because we were hungry! Lol We will definitely be eating here again while we are in town. Kembe la, Nou fe bon Manje, Nou bay bon sevis! 👍🏾👍🏾👏🏾👏🏾🇭🇹 🇭🇹 🇭🇹
Food looked amazing and tasted even better and great customer service will be coming back !!!

I just ordered griot and it is the best I had so far. I will say there is a little more fat than I would like. But the meat pieces are actually pretty big. The food did take a while to be cooked but it was definitely worth it because it was hot and fresh and very good. I’m definitely going to be eating here almost twice a week 😭

I went to visit my family in Orlando and we stopped by this restaurant called Gen Bagay and the food was to die for. Honestly some of the best Haitian food I have had in a while! And it was so affordable!! I would definitely recommend eating here. The staff is also super pleasant and the place is so clean!! Can’t wait to go back when I visit again!
Remember to ask for marie, her service is exceptional! she made our dining experience truly magical.
I tried the herring patty and the order of acra.  Delish.  The owner was such a nice lady!
Just had the rice, red beans and chicken with pikliz. It was delicious!! Great customer service from Monia. Cant wait to go back!

I stopped for lunch today and it was delicious 😋
Finally found a great place to eat some Caribbean food. I highly recommend 👍
Great food. Nice people. Customer service is always good.

Selam Ethiopian & Eritrean Cuisine is an absolute gem—especially if you’re vegan and gluten-free. The veggie combination platter was huge, beautifully presented, and packed with rich, complex flavors. Every dish was delicious and incredibly satisfying.
The honey wine was amazing (a must-try), and the hot tea was the perfect complement to the meal—warm, comforting, and thoughtfully served.
On top of the food, the service was excellent: attentive, welcoming, and genuinely kind without being overbearing. You can tell they care deeply about the experience they provide.
If you’re looking for incredible vegan and gluten-free options with generous portions and outstanding hospitality, Selam is absolutely worth the visit. I’ll definitely be back. 🖤

I really like this restaurant. The manager is extremely welcoming, and the food is great. They sell the type of food that people from Ethiopia eat. Furthermore, all the staff are from Ethiopia too. This is a really good family-owned business. The only problem is that the waitresses are not well trained.

Heard so many people recommend this place and the hype was justified!! Abraham was so funny and recommended that we add the lamb to our meat combo. It was delicious! The coffee was so good, the alcohol recommendations were also good. It was a little slow because they seemed short staffed but I can't fault them for that. Will be back!!

Great experience and delicious food. First time trying Ethiopian and very pleased with the experience. I steered the vegetarian plate and beef tips. My favorite was the mushroom dish followed by the cabbage and lentils.

We had the samosa trio (lentil, beef, and chicken) for appetizers, and they were all delicious—crispy on the outside and perfectly seasoned inside. For our main course, we ordered the meat combination, and every single bite was full of flavor. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful, especially since it was our first time dining at an Ethiopian restaurant. They took the time to explain the dishes and how to enjoy them. We also tried their iced tea, which was so refreshing and flavorful that we ordered extra to take home. We’re so happy we found this place while on vacation, and we can’t wait to come back the next time we visit. Everything about our experience was amazing—great food, wonderful service, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommend!

Amazing! The chef / owner has fantastic customer service. While I was waiting for my food to finish, I was offered samples of other foods to try. The inside seating is about 6 chairs at the bar plus a few chairs around the pool table. Seems to be a bar / pool hall that was converted to a restaurant. Plays hip hop / pop music at a medium level. You get to watch your food cook right in front of you. Btw, the owner is from the US Virgin Islands. My food was so good. My life is complete. Haha. I’m glad there are some thriving business in Parramore. I’ll admit, the area was a little sketchy but there’s street parking directly in front of the restaurant so I didn’t have to walk far from my car.

I wasn't able  to  taste the food because  I  went to early / late not sure since I got two different  reasons but the lady at the truck window was the most pleasant  person I've encountered in a while and  I'll definitely  try again

Do not waste your time with this place.  A friend was sending me a Valentine gift of food from this restaurant delivered by Uber eats.  My friend lives in Thailand, and she was trying to surprise me.  Something went wrong with the order and my friend asked me to call the restaurant.  The man answering the phone didn’t want to listen, as I was asking about a order placed through Uber eats.  He just stated he didn’t know anything about and doesn’t care and hung up.  I called back to ask to speak to someone to sort this out, I got the same response and he hung up on me again.  If an order is received to be delivered by Uber eats, they would have a record of it.  They charged my friend $45 and didn’t fill the order.  I never got the food.  They don’t care and don’t want to be bothered with a customer who is checking on an order??  Just taking from people and they just don’t care.  Don’t go near this place.  They really don’t care.

Update one.  My friend in Thailand resent the order.  I actually received the food this time, since I stood outside waiting for Uber eats to deliver.  Not the best delivery service, driver couldn’t figure out that the note, call the number provided for delivery meant to call me when they arrived at the gate of the apartment complex.  As for the food, it was ok.  As a gift from a very special lady living in Thailand, it is one of the best gifts ever.  As the quality of food here in Orlando, it was nothing great.  It was wings with fries and a shrimp meal with grits.  Red velvet cake for dessert.  I think they let the food sit a while under the warmer.  The wings were small and dry, although they covered them well in a sauce.  The fries were also dry from sitting.  The shrimp and grits were bland. I think most of the sauce leaked out of the dinner carton into the bag.  They should have realized filling the entire base with grits will leave no room for the sauce on top, so it all leaked out into the bag.  The red velvet cake was very dry, old. Regarding my phone call earlier to the restaurant to check on an order through Uber eats to their establishment; well, they know what orders are made and should have the tracking numbers.  I don’t know if my friend received a refund or adjustment from the first order, or if they just sent the same food three hours later (most likely), but the fact that I am told they know nothing about the order and don’t care, then hung up on me without saying another word..twice, says a lot about the quality of service.  They really don’t care about the people who order their food, so I would assume they don’t care about the food just the same.  As the restaurant stated, they really don’t care.  I advised my friend in Thailand to never order from this place again.  If you don’t care about the quality of your service or food, you shouldn’t be in the food service business.

The lady who wears glasses is horrible she has absolutely no no customer service. I google her place and arrived at 10:44 she replied she just got here and she’s is not opened for business as yet. Then proceeded to slam her metal gate. WOW unbelievable
I was impressed to try this Caribbean restaurant. I picked up curry goat, cabbage, cornbread, rice & peas (and mac and cheese for good measure). Everything was great. I'll definitely be back.

name: Just Like Momma's Soul Food & Wings

reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of eating at Just Like Momma’s, and it truly lives up to the name. The oxtails were tender and full of flavor, falling right off the bone, and the yellow rice underneath soaked up every drop of that rich gravy. The mac and cheese was creamy and cheesy, the collard greens were seasoned just right, and the cornbread muffin was warm and fluffy — the perfect finishing touch.

This is soul food cooked with love, the kind that makes you feel right at home. If you’re looking for authentic comfort food that satisfies both heart and stomach, Just Like Momma’s is the place to be.

This is a quaint restaurant with welcoming customer service that makes you feel like you are family. I don’t usually eat soul food but the restaurant came highly recommended so I tried it out. I absolutely loved the greens and greens are not my favorite vegetable!! The Mac and cheese is the best blend of creamy cheesy goodness hands down! I ordered the ox tails which left little to be desired, it took some work to eat them, the meat did not fall off the bones, but they had a good flavor. The Key Lime cake was awesome!!!!! I took one bite and couldn’t stop I ate it before my meal and forgot to get a picture. The owner also made fresh baked macadamia nut cookies, so I got them while they were warm, this felt so good to eat! I can’t wait to return on a night with entertainment.

Only thing i complain about is it takes time for your order to come out because i think they cook it fresh every time. We waited approximately 1 hour to get our order for take away and its not really full of customers in there. I noticed that there are only 2 women in the kitchen and one of them is also the one taking orders and doing the cashiering. The lady did apologize to us for the inconvenience but I hope they will address and resolve this issue because an hour wait or more for the food is totally unacceptable and tend to lose customers especially if you have kids with you.

Regarding the food, honestly, its really good. The fried chicken wings is so fresh, flavorful and the breading crunchy and is not too salty. Gravy is on point. My 1 year old daughter liked the mac & cheese. My husband ordered the CheeseSteak and said it was delicious. The cornbread is too dry!

Ambiance is quite good tho but i think more lighting will be perfect. We will definitely comeback and check out other dishes in the menu, but i hope next time we won’t be a very loooongggg wait!

I was visiting the area with my daughter for an event and needed place for my son and I to eat, as we skipped lunch and it was now dinner time. This place popped up in my Google search with high ratings. So we decided to give it a try.

The restaurant is nice and clean. With lots of parking. I loved the library nook in the corner.  The staff is very friendly and wait time reasonable . I ordered smothered chicken wings, fried okra, mac and cheese and fried okra. The fried okra was the best thing on the plate. My son ordered fried chicken, green beans and mac and cheese. He didn't care for any of it.  He really wanted french fries but they were out. He probably would have enjoyed those more. The portion size is more than enough.

I wanted so much to love this place but the food lacked flavor.  The fried Okra was the best thing on the plate. I wish them the best and pray they can flourish in the community. But, I'm Caribbean, seasoned food is a necessity for our enjoyment.

Atmosphere,  service, and portion size is spot on.  If they add just a little more seasoning this place would be the talk of Apopka.

Was visiting from out of state and wanted to try some local food. This was such a great pick! It really felt like someone had us over to their house for dinner and cooked up their favorite dishes. We tried some foods we had never had before. Fun experience with friendly staff. Very clean. Would recommend!

Food was delicious like the fried food/appetizer.  The salmon was dry over cooked. I finally got my lemon water by the time I almost done eating.  I only ordered lemon water. Ensure if theybwere under staffed.  Nonetheless, it' disappointing to experience. The waitress seemed overwhelmed and we have to ask multiple times by several people in my party. Unfortunately the service was poor.  The food was good, however,  not worth the experience.

We called about 30 minutes before closing to let them know we had a party of eight and would arrive in about eight minutes, and thankfully they were kind enough to accommodate us. My brother and his family drove an hour and a half to meet us, while we had just flown in from New York, so after a long day of travel, all we wanted was a good meal together. The food was delicious, and the service was truly outstanding. Our waiter was kind and attentive, and even though it was close to closing time, the staff made us feel welcomed and never rushed. We are incredibly grateful for their hospitality, especially since we stayed until 10ish, even though they closed at 9p. Friendly, good vibes with traditional and modern Haitian music.

As a Haitian let me tell you this food is amazing!! The service Top Tier. This place needs to be packed to the brim. If you in the area check this place out you will not be disappointed. Don't forget the drinks!! Yes!!! And thank you Jean you served it up!

We had a great experience at Kalalou. Words cannot describe how much we appreciated our time there. The atmosphere was inviting. There was music playing and ambient lighting. Kevin, our waiter was personable and always ready to assist us with any questions. The food came at a very reasonable time. The food was delicious. Compliments to the chef. You can tell there is a lot of attention and care made in the meals. If you’re Haitian, you will have a sense of nostalgia from these exquisite flavorful dishes.The fried food was fresh, not greasy. A wonderful time all around. 10/10!
I enjoyed the Fresh food. No complaints at all. Dine in and the restaurant always had friendly waiters with both of my visits.

Run, dont walk to this unassuming gem.  Fabulous food and knowledgeable staff. The beet arepa was AMAZING. The tator tots, unique and delish. The menu is sufficient that if I lived close by,  I'd be here often!

Rosey is the best! She introduced me to some new tacos on the menu. We always order the same yellow curry-dusted tofu tacos, but the other options she suggested were so good as well! Love this spot, I feel like it’s a healthy option for us when we are out and looking for a filling meal.

Very relaxed low key outdoor space with food that will have you wish you ordered more. Ordered the braised beef taco, bulgogi taco and the Korean wings. Came back for the Apple Ginger Empanadas and washed it down with a tall Mexican Coke. Really nice for a late night bite or just a chill spot to unwind after work without the bar scene. Definitely a must do and already looking forward to my next late night bite.

THE BEST. The best. I will go out of my way to eat here anytime I drive through Orlando. Perfect combination of Latin & Asian flavors. The Korean dog does not disappoint. Been coming here for a decade and I swear the food gets better!
It was such a cool experience and it was very good. I do think the burrito I had should have had more beef and less rice but it was very good.

It was my first time visiting this location, and the food was surprisingly good. The service was also very good. The atmosphere was a little dated but reminded me of old times in Jamaica. Overall, it was a great experience. I think I just found my go-to spot when I'm in Orlando. I will be back for more.

Local Jamaican food 😋  plentiful food. Service is non-existent frills - order and you get what you wanted.
Goat curry and jerk chicken come bone in. Jerk chicken is a bit spicy- the side sauce it comes with is delicious

Seems like the people thats been coming to this location for years are being served poorly.
I came there and ask for fish and what not I was told it was cook to order  and it will be 25 minutes so I left and came back and ask for the fish and I was served dry fish lacking taste and everything that I were served seem as if it was sitting in the back. In fact they took less than 5 minutes and brought me this plate. For $30 they should not be in business providing service like this that fish was dryer than jerkey and the peppers we’re sour nothing like Escovitch Fish

to me that fish is small for it being dry it lack meat and could barely be eaten as is
If you want real authentic Jamaican food. You just stop at Island Vibz. Food is the bomb.

Best Jamaican food you’ll get in Central Florida. 5 stars for every plate, the cooks are extremely talented.

Lisa is also very talented, I’ve seen her do 10 things at once. She’s a great listener, and she puts her heart into everything she does. It was a pleasure being served here.

name: Delightful Nigerian Cuisine
vicinity: 4701 S Semoran Blvd STE B, Orlando

reviews.text: The Nigerian food was absolutely delicious. Everything was well seasoned, flavorful, and tasted authentic. The spices were rich without being overwhelming, and the portions were very satisfying. You can tell a lot of care went into preparing the meal..I’d definitely order it again

This was my first time ordering. I was a little skeptical. But wow! The food portions were incredible. The service was fast and efficient, and even when I didnt receive a tint add on, she went above and beyond to deliver it again. As for the taste, being a full Nigerian, I can tell you that the taste is incredible. Just like the local vendors in nigeria. Plus, they do platters. I know I wont be cooking as much now that I can order meals for the week.

Amazing dining experience! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, perfect for dine-in. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, flavorful, and truly authentic Nigerian cuisine. Every dish was well-seasoned and served hot, with generous portions. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made sure we felt comfortable throughout our visit. You can tell a lot of care goes into both the cooking and the service. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy real Nigerian food in a relaxed, clean, and inviting setting. I’ll definitely be back!

I recently dined at your restaurant and wanted to share what a wonderful experience it was. The food was absolutely outstanding from start to finish.
Every dish we ordered was prepared beautifully and bursting with flavor. You could taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into each plate. The seasoning was spot-on, and the presentation showed real attention to detail. It’s clear your kitchen team takes pride in their craft.
The balance of flavors in each dish was impressive, and everything arrived at our table at the perfect temperature. We left feeling completely satisfied and already planning our next visit.
Thank you for such a memorable meal. It’s restaurants like yours that make dining out special.

This place is wonderful! From the incubator to this beautiful restaurant! Clean very nice, designed beautifully and exceptional service with a smile. The flavors are wonderful and nice size portions. Worth every dollar!  The vibe is unmatched!! Love it here!!

Spent $50 for 5 LITTLE dry oxtail bones that they threw sauce on and put on some hard $2 pasta. Smh. Best thing was the lemonade. Spoke to the manager about how I feel cheated out my money and could I at least buy extra oxtails before I even tasted it. He called the owner and the owner wanted me to buy a whole other plate. First and last time going here. I’ll take my $50 back to sunshine carribean where I get enough meat for what they charge. Then it’s always “oxtails high”. Yea but not $35 a plate with 5 bones. Garbage.

Best Soul Food I have tried in Florida! I ordered the fried cat fish, with Mac and cheese and cabbage, everything was an explosion of flavors, nothing disappointed. This food took me back to my childhood! The Customer service was also exceptional, Very kind felt family oriented. I highly recommend this place. A nice chill environment as well. Loved everything about it!

My first time trying Caribbean soul food, was definitely a good experience. The chicken was cooked amazing, I got the jerk chicken. The rice was flavorful. It is definitely worth paying a dollar more for the side of mac and cheese w collared greens. I definitely recommend. The staff was polite and nice, felt welcomed.

Everything was amazing and food came out pretty quick. They were out of a good amount of stuff and I wasn’t a fan of the mac but other then that it was great and i can’t wait to go back. My friends had the catfish and the wings which were also excellent. The drinks were great as well highly recommend the sweet tea

Let me start but saying that I would still absolutely recommend going here. This trip I went in person and ordered curry chicken over rice and peas, steamed cabbage and mac n cheese. $16 gets you  a hefty plate and a drink, a deal you’ll hardly find in Orlando. Here’s the thing, the curry chicken wasn’t what I expected. If you’re looking for chicken that’s simmered in its curry, that’s not this. Seana’s curry chicken is just baked chicken with curry gravy over it. The curry itself is a little lackluster. That being said, I will vouch for everything else on the menu. Especially  honey fried chicken and catfish.

The food was positively edible. While I want to support this business, I have to be honest. I spent $80.00 for a family sized meal of ribs that taste okay with sides that could have easily satisfied one but not a family of 4. The worker there was really nice as long as they knew I was the one who put in that $80.00 order. I would recommend this place if you don't have a tight budget and you just want to grab some food real quick. The food was prepared in the time they said it would be, so thay was a big plus.

This is an authentic spot for Southern and Jamaican style homecooking. Everything is made to order so food is always fresh and flavourful. Millie took good care of us and gave great recommendations. Oxtail was incredible, catfish was light and flaky. Sides were all excellent and the fried chicken is crispy and yummy. Worth the visit and will definitely come back.

Very small portions.  Cabbage had very little season. Collard greens was just ok. The chitterlings 🫤. Sat on top of the peas and rice juiceless . Almost taste like chicken gizzards instead of chitterlings. Didn't finish it. And if you looking for service with a smile,look elsewhere.

Turkey Wings was NOT it!
Skin fat and bones. Salty and  Old  rancid taste in the bone
Okra n tomatoes were sweet and  tasted like can food
Black eyed peas tasted like warm and sweet.  🤢
Greens were Meh
The corn muffin was good.

Definitely not worth $20

It pains me to spend good money on bad product

We drive all the way from st lucie county just to eat here, food is always amazing and consistent,  fried chicken is so good and fresh and we love the sides, especially the corn bread dressing. 10 out of 10 every single time!

Whewww I just ordered off door dash.. food is ok I paid 57$ for 3 meals. I got lamb chops. It comes with only 3 lamb pops. The seasoning is over powered and that’s a lot coming from being from  Chicago we jerk everything!! I paired it with the Rasta pasta overwhelming as well hellllaaaaaa spicy on top of 3 pieces of lamb that’s spicy.
And broccoli.. Broccoli is bland.. I opted out on cooking tonight had a long work week .. I dont know if I’d give it another try. Ordered for my mom and husband I didn’t ask yet how they feel. But when I told my husband I would order this place he said ummmm I don’t really like it an I said well that’s what we gone eat lol.. Anywho give a few more lamb pops and dial back on the spice and we may have a hit… An I love spicey food soooo… welp I just asked my not how was her good she said she couldn’t eat her wings the cause was to overpowering she couldn’t even taste the chicken..

A much needed meal after a busy day, I stopped into West Lakes Food co, located on North Dollins avenue, in Orlando, fl for EZEATSAFROSOULFOOD where I know passion and flavor go hand in hand. Anytime I am in the Orlando area and looking for a quick bite to eat this is my goto. I went inside and placed my order on the kiosk which was then handed off to me by the front desk tenant. I went with two of the popular dishes the honey jerk lamb chops, baked beans and rice. As well as the passion fruit barbecue jerk wings, now both of these dishes are packed with flavor offering both jerk, sweetness and savoy. If you ask me thats the perfect flavor profile. The food is always hot, fresh and delivered in a timely manner. I plan to come back soon and I highly recommend checking this place out.
It was like a inside drive through.  The food was OK, I'll try it again but something different.  Oxtails was good, rice was sticky, pasta was sticky and spicy, and mac was sticky

I’ve ordered this many times before. So this is very disappointing!!! Originally, I thought my Afro soul bowl had no cornbread, but when I got to the bottom, the cornbread was flat and dry.. This is my first complaint from this place, but I don’t understand why they would serve something that should’ve been thrown in the trash.

I got the honey jerk lamb chops with rice, definitely one of my favorites. Food here is absolutely amazing with multiple options to chose from. 10/10 must try again. Service is great and fast I’ll definitely from here every time I’m in town.

Hidden Gem Alert!
The food here is absolutely phenomenal and the service is good. The menu offers great options for every craving. I started with the wing basket perfectly seasoned with a flavorful sauce paired with a delicious rum punch.

For lunch, I had the fried shrimp with a sweet honey glaze, rice, and a double serving of their creamy mac & cheese, along with one of their specialty drinks. Everything was fresh and cooked to order.
I had such a wonderful time here , my sister and I are not from here and wanted to come to experience a Caribbean club and it was very nice , not too many people like other clubs  and great music .

We were visiting from Baltimore during the week, and was looking for a nice vibe on a Wednesday for happy hour. So glad we came here!!! The waitress Shanelle was the best!!! Very friendly, and made sure we were good. The dj was great! (Throwback R&B and reggae music), the happy hour food and drinks were a nice price and very good. We did not stay for karaoke, but we will be back.

Tried this place randomly and will definitely be coming back!!! Ordered the Garlic Mango Habanero wings - hot, crispy, and juicy - and the Shrimp Tacos with the Junction sauce, which was seriously finger-licking-good. You could tell the food was fresh and cooked to order. Also ordered a drink the staff recommended, I think it was called a Coconut Breeze, that was delicious and only $3! The staff was super friendly and even brought us a sample of the Bake because we asked about it - deliciously buttery with a slight crunch to the outside and a fluffy, warm inside. We chatted with out server about other restaurants around town that we love, and I really appreciated how genuine and conversational they were! Had a fantastic experience, and I look forward to coming back to try their wing Wednesday! Seriously, try this place out.

Amazing place! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was truly outstanding. Everything from start to finish exceeded expectations. Highly recommend! Great place to chill after a game at camping world stadium!

Food was delicious and very excited to find a good dominican spot to come with hubby and friends. We had a chimi as I was craving one and it was amazing. We had a server who was very attentive and sweet. Her name was Yalien i believe. Im sorry we came over the weekend and forgot to write our experience. We will for sure come back to try other goodies. Also awesome food presentation! Loved it

The food was average.  The mofongo was good.   I dont think it was bland as other reviewers mention.  i thought flavor was average.  Food came out average time.  It wasnt crowded only 1 other party there.

Great experience! We wanted to try a whole snapper and they delivered. Food was good but my mojito did not pass the test. The mojito straight frozen passion fruit and cheap gin.  My waiter was awesome though, thank you  Yailen for welcoming us. Will come back again.

My family and I have been coming to this restaurant for years and have always had great experiences — until now. Our server, Leodela, who is also the manager, was extremely rude and unwelcoming from the moment we sat down. She barely acknowledged us, spoke with an attitude, and made us feel uncomfortable the entire time.

Throughout the entire meal, she never once checked on our table, which made the experience even worse. We actually found a hair in one of the dishes, and while we understand that things like that can happen unintentionally, we had no chance to mention it because she never came by. The food was also cold and noticeably not as good as usual, which was disappointing considering how great it’s been in the past.

The only person who showed any kindness or professionalism was Gabriela, who wasn’t even our server but still took the time to check on us and help with what she could.

At the end, I told Leodela directly how disappointed we were with her attitude, the poor service, and the decline in food quality. Her response was just a sarcastic “thank you” and a smile — no apology, no accountability.

It’s truly a shame to see this place decline like this, especially because we’ve been loyal customers for so long. After this experience, we will not be returning, and I hope management seriously addresses this issue.

Absolutely amazing experience. Yailen provided outstanding service from start to finish attentive, friendly, and professional. The food was incredible: fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. Our kids loved it so much that they kept saying it was the best food ever, which truly says a lot. Portions were generous, everything came out quickly, and the atmosphere was welcoming and family-friendly. We will definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place.

Oh my gosh !! It's been so long since I've had such good couscous, and now you can even order your merguez sausages to go! They're absolutely delicious, just like their other dishes. I thoroughly enjoyed it. And to finish, a little mint tea with some biscuits... oops, I ate the biscuits before taking a picture (I'm such a glutton!😌☺️). Seriously though, I highly recommend this place if you want to discover authentic Moroccan cuisine. If I could, I'd give it way more than 5 stars! They absolutely deserve it.
Abiba and IIham are really very pleasant .. thanks 🙌

We absolutely loved the food and the way we were treated. This small place is a hidden gem that everyone should know about! The dishes had the perfect temperatures, authentic Moroccan flavors, and beautifully balanced portions. 100% recommended — we’ll definitely be back soon!

**Authentic Moroccan Delight in Orlando! **
During our trip to Orlando, my daughter and I discovered Moroccan Breeze in the Apna Bazaar food court, and it was an absolute treat! On our second day, we shared the Lamb Couscous and the Lamb Tagine with prunes, both bursting with rich, authentic flavors that transported us straight to Morocco. The dishes were incredibly delicious and masterfully prepared.
To complement our meal, we enjoyed refreshing mint tea and a selection of delightful pastries. Everything was perfect! We were so impressed that we returned on our last day in Orlando to bring some of this culinary magic back home to Tampa to share with my husband and son.
Moroccan Breeze has truly captured the essence of Moroccan cuisine, and we can't wait for our next visit. If you're in Orlando, don't miss out on this hidden gem!

The food was fantastic—I loved it! It felt like I was eating at home. The place is very clean and well-organized, with friendly customer service, and the food arrives quickly. I loved this place and will definitely be coming back.

My family and I were invited to this restaurant by our Moroccan friend to try authentic Moroccan food. The food was amazing! We had the tajin, kefta and the MOST AMAZING coconut pastry I have ever had in my life! I had to control myself and bring some to my mom to try because she is a coconut lover! (She absolutely LOVED IT) The staff is so kind and hospitable and make you feel at home! The atmosphere was family friendly,we really enjoyed this experience and will be coming back!

Delicious authentic Yemeni food. We ordered Chicken mandi, Lamb haneeth and Tabbouleh salad. Everything was great, both the chicken and lamb were falling off the bone, really flavorful and tender. The Lemonade was refreshing and the Basbosah was delightful! Even the complementary tea was great. Portion sizes are generous and easy on the pocket too. Service was top notch and our server Banna was very attentive and gracious. I would highly recommend this place.

Our server was Muhammad and him along with the food was superb. Personally, this was my very first time trying Yemeni food, and I was truly impressed. Our server was very patient and thoroughly explained each item I was interested in on the menu. With Muhammad’s help, I made my selections for the food and was very happy with the quality, taste, and quick service I received. If we are ever in the area again we will be sure to stop by.

Delicious, authentic Middle Eastern food in a warm and welcoming setting. We ordered the haneeth and mandi, and both dishes were outstanding, tender, flavorful meat and chicken , perfectly cooked rice, and rich spices that made every bite enjoyable.

A special thank you to Banna, who works there and made our visit even better with great and genuine hospitality.

Halal food

The food was fantastic. I enjoyed my chicken mandi with saffron basmati rice and my husband had lamb fahsa and loved it!! Perfect baklawah! Highly recommend!! Small staff, have a little patience when busy. Worth the wait!!

This was such an amazing stop after a long day driving! Truly the food felt so homey and delicious. It was as if I was invited in someone’s home! 100/10. The server Banna was honestly very nice and recommended the best of the best foods. This was the first time some of us tried Lamb Haneeth and WOW it was so good ! The rice and the lamb 😍. The chicken Kabsah WOW ! As if I was overseas
Fattoush salad was perfect.
The dessert Basboosa was OMG! Sooo soft and moist and flavorful. This place is truly a hidden gem and should be visited more!

The food was delicious. I had the shrimp dinner with candied yams and collard greens. I liked that the shrimp was crispy and seasoned. The strawberry lemonade was good too, but I wasn't told that there was an upcharge for the favor strawberry. The collard greens had a little spicy to it that I liked. It only came with 6 shrimp. Wish it came with more. My husband had the steak dinner with Mac and cheese and candied yams. He loved the steak ! He ordered a sweet tea, but it didn't taste like sweet tea. It tasted like it had some kind of fruit in it that we could figure out. He didn't like it. The gratuity was already included on our check. I would have left more for a tip until I checked our receipt and seen that it was included. You should go early like right after it opens, if not it gets packed quickly.

I was truly disappointed in the food the chicken was overly salty , the greens were too spicy , too many red flakes. The Mac and cheese was good. I was upset about the wait it was over 1 waiter which was the General Manager Trey he was nice but overall the restaurant can use a little bit more moral , can be more welcoming and a little cleaner .

The food  & atmosphere and my waitress was amazing per usual.

Dine in service: Ordered the Tilapia dinner from the menu, $16.99. When I received my bill it said, my dinner was $26. I asked our waitress to explain the difference on the menu that was placed on our table. She said, that’s not the price of the dinner and that the prices can change.

Listen, I’m not petty but I needed a manager to explain the differences. Here comes the manager who said that the menus are old menus. He flipped the menu over, and when I tell you the wording it so little that know one will catch the fine print.

I did advised that know one explained that to us upon being seated.

Overall, the manager, Tone, I believe his name was, who was unprofessional in his manager skills, blamed our server for not making us aware of the menu being outdated. He never honored the price and offered me a side to go. No, SIR, the damage is already done.

Feedback: Update your menu to reflect the prices, be honest with your customers upfront if something should change, and honor prices if you never advised of any changes.

If you’re looking for a place with friendly service, don’t visit this establishment. I discovered it on Instagram and was excited to try the food, but my experience from start to finish was disappointing.

I ordered a Lemon8 drop flight, which took 20 minutes to arrive. The young lady forgot my order. When the drink finally came, it was undrinkable—it tasted like straight rubbing alcohol. When I brought this to her attention and asked to replace it, she said no, explaining that the drinks would still be charged to my tab, which I accepted since it was only $20.

I also waited 35 minutes for my food. While it took a while, the dishes were fresh, delicious, and worth the wait. However, the young ladies working there were not pleasant at all, and that’s the main reason I won’t return. Good food and excellent customer service are what keep people coming back, and this place lacked both during my visit.

Okay, if you are in Orlando, hungry, and love soul food… you have to stop in “The Licking”! The price point is great, the food is well flavored, and our server was very attentive. There is music played in the background but you can hear conversations at your table. It was a really good vibe.
I had the baked chicken dinner with green beans and candied yams. Other orders placed were, the seafood fried rice, grilled red snapper with greens and mac and cheese, and the chicken quesadilla. Everything was good.
There were 5 of us in our party, 4 adults and 1 child. Our bill was not even $130 total, including the tip. @DJKhaled we hope you think about opening this restaurant in Vegas!

I came here,  and I was pleased for tasting the food originally made just like HOME country 🇲🇦, this is a serious invitation to ALL Moroccans and Every Arab here in Florida Orlando to come and bring your family members, the Food, Service & hygiene is IRREPROACHABLE & Blameless.

And to Everyone else, whatever you are looking for, sandwiches, fries, grilled meat and chicken, this is your place

I read some reviews before ordering and was not sure if I should take the risk, I was wondering why Tajín Express Orlando has gotten a few negative reviews, but after my experience and a little research, it’s clear those comments are coming from haters or people with hidden agendas. The food I received was excellent—honestly exceeded every expectation I had.

Everything was fresh, flavorful, and high-quality, exactly what you hope for when ordering from a place that takes pride in its dishes. The portions were generous, the ingredients tasted top-tier, and the care put into the food really showed.

On top of that, the packaging and delivery were perfect. My order arrived neatly packed, secure, and still hot—exactly the way you want your food to show up. They clearly put effort into presentation and customer satisfaction.

Tajín Express Orlando definitely deserves more appreciation. Based on my experience, this place is the real deal, and I’ll definitely be ordering again. Highly recommend!

As an active-duty officer in the U.S. Air Force, I can confidently say this place goes above and beyond. TajineXpress not only serves outstanding food, but they also show incredible appreciation for those in uniform. Military members, police officers, firefighters, and all first responders receive up to 20% off, and they even offer a free meal above that all.

If you have kids, you will be amazed by how warmly they are welcomed and treated—family hospitality at its finest.
The hygiene is spotless, the food quality is excellent, and the menu is rich with authentic options. I highly recommend this restaurant to everyone.

Enjoyed our dinner here. The lemon chicken tajine was great. It was flavorful and the lemon melded perfectly with the flavors. I thought the fries with a tajine sounded odd, but they were extra crispy and added an accompanying texture that I enjoyed.
The lamb couscous was good, it had all the spices, but they were muted and overall it was mildly bland. The lamb and vegetables were cooked perfectly.
We would come back and try some more dishes.

Delicious Moroccan food that’s fresh and flavorful. There are several vegan options. They have weekend specials, the price is reasonable cost. Staff is very friendly, the restaurant is clean and beautifully decorated. I highly recommend the mint tea after your meal.

My meal consist of the smothered cube steaks on a bed of rice, which was absolutely amazing and fork tender I wished I had more gravy lol. Yams was sweeten to perfection not overly sweet, my mac & cheese was very flavorful. Only one complaint not really a complaint I just desired more gravy.

Definitely a hole in the wall that I wasn’t quite sure about at first but after walking in, nothing but warm welcomes. Chicken fried fresh. Collard greens had no meat but was really good! I have no complaints. Even hear conversation with the owner while we waited for our food and he was very nice and hospitable. I will definitely be back!

P&D Soulfood Kitchen catered our Christmas dinner. The food was completely amazing. Those beef short ribs were Capital T tender!! The family was so happy!! I personally hurt myself eating those Collard Greens. And Ms. Paula was the BEST!! I feel like part of the Family. Highly recommend P&D for all your Catering needs. I will be back! Ms. Paula, you and your people KILLED it!!

If you’re looking for a place that tastes like mom or grandma home cooking, don’t over salt their food, and give you nostalgia, then this is it! I ordered their 1pc roasted Turkey wing, cornbread dressing, macaroni and cheese, and potato salad meal. I loved it. It looks like they forgot to put gravy over my meat, which I wanted, but it was still delicious. I may have needed to request that, so I won’t hold them to it. I truly enjoyed that they did not over salt their food like other places, in order to bring out the natural flavors of the food. The macaroni and cheese tasted like macaroni and cheese, and the Potato Salad tasted like potato salad! If you know you know. Thank you for staying true to the taste of southern cooking.

Let me get started food 😲 😱 wow it's very good I had the smoothed pork chops large comes with 2 side to good sized chops and mostly Black own for all my black own business supporters out there go and check it out.

Mario Peters and Marvin held an incredible evening for our office Christmas party. The food was amazing and perfect. We had an incredible time at the event and it wouldn’t be possible without them and their amazing team. I have absolutely no complaints and this is a great place to host a party and spend time with family. The attention detail and atmosphere was amazing. I truly wished I took more photos. Everyone should eat here it’s an incredible experience.

If you're looking for an elevated Haitian Caribbean dining experience, this is the place to go! We were looking for a classy establishment to satisfy 3 generations of my family, with a bunch of dietary restrictions (picky eaters), for my father's birthday celebration.

Chef Mario, Marvin and the rest of the team went above and beyond. Beautiful presentation, with food that tasted just as good and a great attention to detail. Thank you for an excellent experience!

This is absolutely the best dining experience I’ve had. The attention to detail, this is Haitian Haute Cuisine. The level of service, the food, the experience. The Chef came out to greet us. In all my years of eating at Haitian restaurants I’ve never experienced service like this. I strongly recommend. Chef Mario well done.

I came here for dinner and was grossly overcharged for my meal. I would like someone from management to reach out to me. I had fried goat, green, plantain, and a side of broccolini, and a gin and tonic mixed drink. Before tip this all was a total of $70. I thought the bill was kind of high when I paid and I was not given an itemized receipt. It was late and I was tired, so I didn’t dispute it, and I should have and not have been so trusting. When I look online, the goat itself is not even $45 on the dine in menu. Not to mention my gin and tonic was made incorrectly because there was no tonic, yet it was rang up as a cocktail. A gin and tonic is not a cocktail. Also, I did not even get the two sides included with the goat, the broccolini was a substitute either way $70 before tip and tax is too high for what I had between the service and the food.

If you’re searching for a restaurant that delivers unforgettable flavors, warm hospitality, and a truly welcoming atmosphere, Kalalou Signature Restaurant is the perfect choice. From the moment you walk in, you’re embraced with a vibrant yet cozy ambiance that immediately makes you feel at home. The décor is stylish, the vibe is inviting, and the entire space feels thoughtfully designed for comfort and enjoyment.

The food is the real star here—every dish is prepared with remarkable care, bold seasoning, and authentic flavor. You can taste the freshness in every bite. Whether you’re enjoying one of their signature entrées or exploring something new, the plates are beautifully presented and bursting with taste. It’s the kind of meal that leaves you satisfied, impressed, and already thinking about what you’ll try next time.

The service is exceptional as well. The staff is friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They take the time to explain menu items, check in at the right moments, and ensure every guest feels valued. From drinks to dessert, everything flows smoothly.

Kalalou Signature Restaurant is more than just a place to eat—it’s an experience. With fantastic food, great ambiance, and outstanding service, it’s the kind of restaurant you’ll want to return to again and again. Highly recommended! Big up to Chef Mario 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👍🏽👍🏽

Our meal was great and extremely fast. Manoli was an excellent server. He was quick, polite, and attentive. The food had generous portions. If we had any complaint, it was that the food was just slightly saltier than we liked it. But that may have been a preference thing. We would still gladly return!

It was a great experience today! They made my birthday one to remember! Our server, Manoli, went beyond expectations with great service ! The food was amazing!
