We’ve been here before but not for lunch, great experience! The lunch menu deals for this season are to die for! Definitely we will come back soon! The loyalty program has been revamped and  it does offer an incentive to come back 🙂
Phenomenal taste and presentation! Great service and amazing food. Pure delight to the eye and the nibble in every piece and sip. Thank you!

Vanesa did a great job serving our table. We ordered a Parilla Mix Surf and Turf Deluxe, food was excellent, everything was hot and fresh. One drink we ordered was a Passion Fruit Sangria which was delicious and refreshing. Same as The Coconut Lemonade and Passion Fruit Juice, made with fresh ingredients.

Loved this place. It was our first time. Once we were at the entrance we were greeted by a sweet young lady that took us to our table. Immediately we were given the menus and a bottle of cold water. Ordered our food and drinks and it was awesome. The food was so fresh I was amazed. The cocktails were delicious. Our server was on top of everything and made our experience awesome. For sure I recommend it 💯%

This place deserves zero star. The owner of the restaurant is rude, and always rushing you. Let’s not talk about how nasty the food is, fry plantain is very stale fry pork is hard to even chew it. Don’t waste your time going there.
the service was decent, but the food was average, and the atmosphere could use some improvement. overall, an okay dining experience.

I  DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE!

Should be Zero star, but one is the bottom. Here's the reason for my review.

A little over I week ago, while visiting Orlando, my family and I had the craving for local Haitian Cuisine. We unfortunately stumbled upon this place and agreed to give it a try for dinner. Unfortunately, I did not read the lack of google reviews for this place. Therefore, the time waste to go there was in part mine's to bare. Needless to say, I want to spare others from the disappointment in the future.

As stated above, this place was a disappointment. I am confidently stating that because of my experience listed next.

As we exited our vehicle, we were first approached by a woman selling bootlegged perfumes out of the trunk of her car. She respected our polite rejection. Then we entered the facility to NOT be greeted by a man working behind the counter who obviously would rather do anything but serve customers. Nonetheless, my wife had her heart set on it, so I exercised more patience than normal. We asked for a menu, for which the man responded "we don have a menu", followed by how do we know what you have available? We inquired. For which he answered just ask me what you want? Our follow-up request was for fish, and guess what...they did not have fish. What do you have? We asked. Just pork, he answered. Then we asked, not even chicken? Ff which he said, oh yes, we do have chicken but that is all. By this point, I knew this place was not getting our money, This was beyond my customer service patience. My wife, disappointedly asked me what I want to do. Although, she knew I was done with this place and this worker.

Needless to say, we found a better Haitian restaurant, Kalalou Caribbean, with more professional wait staff who actually made it worth spending my money in that place.

These are the reasons I would not recommend "Sabiensa" Instead go to any other Haitian restaurant, including "Kalalou" just 5 minutes away .
Just save your time and a stomach ache
Wonderful food. Wonderful service.

Honestly, the worst meal I’ve ever eaten at a restaurant.  Everything was overcooked.  Like beyond well done and very dry.  The only steak they had was variations of sirloin, even though they tried to dress it up as “garlic steak”, “steak with Parmesan” blah blah blah.  It was all sirloin.  It was fatty and tough as nails.

Service was just okay, not spectacular.  The waitress was okay, the guys bringing the meat were as inept as humanly possible.  Like, helping two of us and ignoring two of our friends, literally walking off mid sentence while asking for a portion.

I’ll never never never be back.  Even at $36 it wasn’t worth the money.  Spend the $60+ to go to Fogo or Texas De Brazil

It was really really good. Their buffet was incredible, they have a lot of variety. Rice with milk, yellow plantain (maduro) garlic pasta, beans… Their meat was awesome and they gave us pan de queso as an appetizer. I would come back!!

Excellent Brazilian
steakhouse! The meats were flavorful, perfectly cooked, and served with great variety. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making the experience even better.
Outstanding service by Leonardo Nobre and Raphael Junqueira. Highly recommend
Café Mineiro!

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the staff, because it was our first time at this establishment, and we were warmly welcomed by the hostel. They provided us with comprehensive information about the dishes and how they were prepared. Special thanks to Tatiana, she was excellent at her job and provided outstanding service! I recommend it for the whole family. You will truly enjoy the excellently prepared cuisine and get a lot of pleasure from the dishes! 100 out of 100%

This restaurant was recommended by a friend who came two years ago while vacationing in Orlando.  We came on her recommendation and she was 💯 correct.  We all ordered the rodizzio lunch.  The food was absolutely delicious.  In addition to the several cuts of meat that came out routinely, there was a wide variety of food choices included with the buffet.  The service was outstanding.  Tatiana took care of us and was very attentive.  We did not feel rushed at all.  We will be recommending the restaurant to anyone we know who will be in this area.  Hopefully they will be lucky to have Tatiana wait on them.

This was our first time visiting Thrive. We came for happy hour. The mezcal margarita was excellent. I had two. We also tried several bites. We ordered the Sprout Chaser (not on the HH menu but so delicious and worth it), drunken belly (I’ve had much better pork belly but it was tasty), and mochi wangs. My fav of those were the mochi wangs. By the way, they have Saratoga water as their still bottled option but don’t charge a ridiculous amount for it. It’s definitely worth a stop in.

We received an immediate greeting upon arrival and the service by our waitress was awesome. Attentive and helpful.
The Fire Fries were crispy and fluffy on the inside. It tasted like a sushi roll made of French fries, very delicious. The Bonito flakes were cool, they sort of swayed as if they were alive bc of the heat of the fries. My friends were creeped out lol.
The shrimp on the Double Play dish was perfectly seasoned and crunchy; the Big Shrimpin’ roll with the tempura flakes + spicy mayo was *chefs kiss*
The dumplings were so good, short rib inside was tender and juicy.
I definitely would return!

My boyfriend and I went to Thrive on a Saturday for brunch and WOW. I wasn’t expecting what we got. The vibe here is 10/10, the music was great (hip hop and r&b from early 2000’s), the entire place was just pretty and definitely a place I would visit often if I lived in Orlando. I got the steak and eggs with sweet potato tots and it was absolutely amazing, the steak was cooked to perfection, the eggs were nice and fluffy and the tots had the perfect crisp. I did have the Juicy J which was pretty good and since they didn’t offer bottomless mimosas we just got a bottle of champagne and juices were brought over. Our server Mia was fantastic and never let too much time go by before checking on us which was great. If you’re thinking about coming here, do it!! I don’t have a single complaint.

Love a trendy tapas restaurant! What an eclectic menu, full of MANY flavor profiles, everyone’s favorite cravings - upscale sliders screaming MAJOR flavors (foodie’s dream), sushi, bao buns - you can get a little bit of everything here, and we did!! Definitely share with your party so everyone can get a lil bit of everything. Thrive did not disappoint, definitely MAKE a reso - it’s not a large restaurant! We walked right in and others had to wait 2 hours on a Sunday evening.

Came on a Tuesday before a Broadway Across America show and made it in time for happy hour! Great food and drink specials for happy hour! We ordered three dishes to share, each was more delicious than the last! The wangz were good but a tad sweet for my taste.  The Brussels were fantastic, I think my favorite item we got. The sliders were delicious, well cooked and seasoned. The service was great, very attentive. Our server, Brendan, made great recommendations! The vibe was vibing too! We will definitely be back soon to try more of the menu!

Allure Restaurant and Lounge is a fun brunch spot if you enjoy good food paired with loud music and a lively atmosphere. This is not a quiet sit down brunch. It is a place to eat drink and vibe. The DJ played a mix of RnB and Afrobeats and it really set the tone for a fun experience.

The unlimited mimosas are a big plus and I liked that you can switch up the mixers. The steak and eggs with chimichurri was my favorite dish. The lamb chops were good too. I personally think mashed potatoes would pair better than fries but still worth trying. The French Toast Suzette was a nice fruity option if you want something on the sweeter side.

Service was friendly and the drinks were well made. I even had a signature cocktail that was so good I forgot the name so ask your server for their best one.

If you are looking for a quiet dining experience this may not be for you. But if you love brunch with music entertainment and a social vibe you will enjoy Allure.

Me and my boyfriend went to Allure for dinner. It is a new establishment and it is absolutely beautiful inside. They recently opened so it was empty for a Friday evening but that didn’t bother us. Our waiter was very attentive and the staff was welcoming and ensured we were good.
The food was delicious! We had the lamb chops, shrimp skewers, salmon, and wings. Everything was cooked to perfection. They are in the midst of updating their menu so what you see online is not what’s currently available. However, we were informed that the new menu would be available next week so we will definitely be back to try more.

We had such an enjoyable time here — the food was outstanding, the service was attentive, and the ambiance was perfect for a romantic night out.  Had the Tostones (fried plantains), grilled lamb chops and soncocho soup which were very tasty and flavorful. Truly a delightful dining experience and will return.

We ordered the Braai Lamp Chops and the Curry goat with jollof rice. The food tasted great and the atmosphere inside was very nice. The cocktail were great. We haven't had a good cocktail in a while so this was refreshing. Also the beef empanadas were 10/10 and made from scratch. We went on a Monday night when it wasn't busy but we would like to come back during an event to see what it's like.

Unfortunately we did not check the events schedule and it was not one of their jazz nights like we hoped for. The place was pretty empty the night we went. Very beautifully decorated. Our server was nice, but for us to be one of two tables it took a long time for our orders to come. Service was extremely slow. We didn't really care for the appetizer but the entrees were ok. I would try this restaurant again.

name: Jam-Eng - Jamaican And English Cuisine
vicinity: 65 N Orange Ave, 14 E Washington St, Orlando

reviews.text: Unwelcoming.  Underwhelming. Dry. Sad & Salty. I just wanted a nice meal on my birthday.  Instead I  WASTED money on unspecial rubbish and meager meat portions. I was considering  hiring them for catering  my wedding...and after my first impression, I would  rather have ANYTHING ELSE. I was trying to introduce my husband to my culture through trying this "cuisine " and I  had to STOP HIM! Are you morally ok with charging Nearly $30  for 3 BARE BONES above potatoes swimming in oil? Embarrassing. This is as much  Caribbean for Caribbean people as Taco Bell is for Mexicans. Shame on you. Caribbean card REVOKED.

The food was damn good -- full of flavor, nicely seasoned, and cooked just right. I'd definitely order it again, but you really need to serve larger portions.

$20 USD fi 2 small food and a Bigga soda -- it's not bad, but honestly, I feel like I could get a bit more value for that price elsewhere. The portion size just didn't match what I expected based on how it's listed.

Also, you might want to update your DoorDash menu, because what exactly is "express serving"? When I ordered it, I thought I was paying for two large meals, since the label looked different from the "small" option. It was confusing, and I only realized after receiving the order.

Still, props to the chef -- the food was on point! Just a little menu clarity and bigger portions, and it would've been perfect.

The service was top notch, told the cashier it was our first time there and he made us a sample platter to help us decide. Everything was delicious but we went with the brown stew. Price and portion are unmatched

I love love love Jam-Eng! I work downtown and eat there regularly. The service is always wonderful, and the food is always on point. I hosted a Juneteenth party at my house, and decided to cater from here. I got jerked chicken, curry chicken, brown stew chicken, peas & rice, and plantains. They made me SO MUCH FOOD! And it was so good! We had about 50 people and they tore that food up and raved about it! And the prices are very fair! 10/10 recommend, and I will def be catering from them again!
We loved the vegan oxtail, black rum cake and spinach Caribbean patty! Staff was super friendly, our portion was good and the patty perfect 😁
Guy’s they have very good food there, I was in vacation I eating all my week there.

Honestly I wish I could give them zero stars. First off I ordered my food online and received a confirmation email but when I arrived they told me they don’t take online orders and that I had to repay for my order. I spoke to the owner who said that he cannot give me a refund and he will not give me a free meal to make up for the inconvenience I received. The owner then proceeded to be rude over the phone and kept saying “ what aren’t you understanding, you cannot get a refund from us” in a very disrespectful manner  that I did not appreciate. He then hung up the phone and I had to speak the assistant  manger ( who was very helpful. I feel bad that he had to work for that owner) he was the only person that even tried to help my situation. After 30 mins of arguing with the owner the assistant manger called and helped me. I did not get my food and I didn’t get my refund then and there I was told I had to wait 3-5 business days first. Overall I will not be going back unless I am going back and showing the owner how to run a business properly.

I ordered DoorDash they charged my card right away and my delivery driver told me restaurant said “no order came from DoorDash for Vanessa”. I waited an hour for food that never came since the restaurant claimed they never received my order. I added proof from my DoorDash driver.
I love to get food at place. My family and love to eat at this place especially if I don't cook this is where we always go to eat or take out!!!!
Food sucks and overpriced

We visited Nikki’s Place yesterday around 10 a.m. The restaurant was surprisingly empty for a Saturday morning, but we decided to give it a try. Our waitress, Tokyo, was absolutely phenomenal, truly the best part of the entire experience.

My boyfriend ordered the chicken and waffles with grits, and I ordered the pork chops with grits, a biscuit, and a side of catfish. The first red flag was being asked if we wanted to pay before or after our meal, something I’ve never experienced at a sit-down restaurant. We went ahead and paid, but unfortunately, that was the beginning of a disappointing experience.

My boyfriend couldn’t even eat his meal, his waffle was burnt, and the chicken was not edible. Both of our grits were runny and cold. My plate was mediocre at best, and for $70, it was one of the worst breakfast experiences we’ve ever had. When the untouched food was taken away, no one offered a refund or even asked if we wanted something else instead.

I genuinely try to support small, Black-owned businesses, but when you charge premium prices, the quality and care should reflect that. Sadly, this visit missed the mark completely.

LONG REVIEW:
I moved to Orlando in March and knew I’d be hard-pressed to find a decent soul establishment.  After seeing some of the reviews and the socials of the restaurant (an extremely friendly and personable woman always front and center) I figured I’d give Nikki’s a try.  My first time going a few months ago, I went in and the lady collecting the money and giving food was not friendly at all!  I can’t remember what entree I ordered (I do recall enjoying the gravy) but the “peach cobbler” was cakey (not doughy which I love) with a weird flavor which was not to my liking.  Did not want to hold that against them, so decided to pick up again.  Second time, went in and same unfriendly women took money and gave food.  Cannot remember what I ordered again, but it must not have been memorable.  Today (10/1) was my third time and when I tell you the food was diabolically terrible I am not exaggerating!  The mac was RUNNY, the greens were sweet, the salty chicken had no flavor (how is that possible) - all of these things didn’t prompt this review, what did was the “pound cake” - it was BAD.  It was cold, so I imagine that they freeze them, but even that didn’t matter.  I cannot even describe the flavor!!  It was disastrous!!

I now know I will never spend money in this establishment again and continue to go to the place around the corner, because their food is a better quality. Delivery guy (via Toast/Uber) was timely and perfect, food was still hot.

For those of you who enjoy Nikki’s, God’s speed!

I have been looking forward to eating from here for a long time. I have followed the restaurant for years on Facebook. When I finally got the chance to eat here i was disappointed. Maybe I caught them on a bad day I don't know. My mac & cheese got melted on to the foam plate you can see it in the pictures. My chicken tasted off like it was reheated it was also dry. Now the candy yams that was on point absolutely delicious. The cornbread was average. I might give them another try if I do and its better I will update this review.

I have not been to Nikki's Place in 5 years.
The flavor of my meal was as vibrant and fresh as it's ever been.
Thank you Nikki, I love eating at your place

First and foremost OMG!!! Small place but big in personality, professionalism, laughter and flavor. First time visiting here but they explained the menu and were also very helpful. Today they were also short staffed but that didn't slow them down in no way at all. I ordered pig feet, yams, cabbage with potato salad and a corn muffin. What they need to do is hand out pillows and blankets after your meal because there is nothing but bed time after you eat all that good food. EVERYTHING was good there was nothing that failed in the flavor department!!! A must visit if you've never been.

I went to The District GastroBar for brunch with a friend, and we had a great time! She ordered the shrimp and grits with a strawberry margarita, and I went with the steak and eggs paired with a strawberry lemonade sangria. Everything came out quickly, fresh, and flavorful.

We had reservations, which worked out perfectly because the place started getting busy a little after 1 p.m. The vibes were great, good food, good drinks, and a lively atmosphere without feeling overcrowded.

Definitely a solid spot for brunch. I’d go back again!

Black owned businesses downtown with A1 customer service! We came for brunch and the selection was fantastic. Drink selection was great. Lynn was amazing a she was very attentive to our needs even though she was the only one at the bar. They were slow only one cook so the food took a while to come out. We had to send the fried rice because it was a bit salty for our taste. Other than that PLEASE come check this place out.

Visited The District in Orlando while in town visiting a friend for Sunday brunch. We kicked things off with the bottomless mimosas, which were definitely a highlight—fresh, well-balanced, and kept flowing without too much delay.

To start, we ordered the avocado hummus, which was absolutely delicious—creamy, flavorful, and paired perfectly with the pita. The lobster wontons were also good, though a bit on the spicy side.

For our main dishes, we tried the steak and eggs, wings, and shrimp and grits. The standout was easily the shrimp and grits—perfectly seasoned, rich, and comforting. The steak and eggs were solid, nothing groundbreaking, but cooked well. The wings were probably our least favorite—nothing bad, just a bit underwhelming compared to the other dishes.

Service was okay—not bad, but not especially memorable either. We also wished the music had been just a bit louder to bring more energy to the brunch vibe.

this place has potential . very limited seating . we made reservations for 2:00pm, we did not get seated until 3:04pm . melissa was doing the best she can to accommodate us and for that we appreciate her . the bartender is terrible, while melissa was visibly busy…we asked for refills of water from the bartender she did not have any patrons she was tending to but proceeded to tell us she’d tell our waitress…i guess her text messages were more important because she then leaned on the counter and proceeded to get on her phone . chantal was helpful in the beginning but i guess we were asking for “too much” when she decided to start avoiding us at all cost . we just wanted to have a good experience especially since we’re spending money here . there is no teamwork in this establishment . if one server is busy, one that isn’t should step in instead of “that’s not my table” for this to be a black owned restaurant they aren’t very welcoming to black people but once a white person comes in they are doing tricks and splits . like are you serious ? i’m not saying they (yt people) should be treated differently but don’t treat your own with such disgust and displeasure . we were getting stale faces and mean mugs but again once a yt person/family came in, all smiles and sunshine . jordan stepped in towards the end of our visit and he was like a breath of fresh air, for the little time we spent together made the experience a little bit better . thank you, jordan . now that was got service out the way ! the food was really good . i had the chicken and waffles . the chicken seasoned and fried to perfection . what i didnt appreciate was they gave me burnt waffles but flipped them over to i guess “hide” the burn as if i wasn’t going to taste it ? that was dumb . instead of just remaking them which they had to do anyway . overall experience 3/10 . i would rate 1/10 if it wasn’t for melissa and jordan . and another thing, just because gratuity is automatically added doesn’t mean you treat people weird because depending on the service you will get a tip on top of the gratuity . and since when did they start letting kids sit at the bar . jon taffer would have a ball at this place .

The District Gastrobar is absolutely the place to be. My husband and I spent at least two hours here enjoying their bottomless mimosa's on their brunch menu, and their wings.

The owner, KC , has done a fantastic job with this place. The food, service and vibes were immaculate.

Shoutout to the bartender, Jason, who provided a magnificent atmosphere for us to enjoy our afternoon in downtown Orlando.

10/10 for sure recommend!

I stumbled upon this spot while heading to Tropical Smoothie, and I’m so glad I stopped! Their smoothies are incredibly fresh—made with real fruit, no powders, no artificial stuff, just pure goodness.

The service was just as refreshing! I always appreciate great customer care, and when I asked about a military discount (since Tropical Smoothie offers one), the attendant immediately said yes—no hesitation. I showed my veteran ID, and they took care of me with respect and kindness.

If you’re looking for a place that values both quality and service, this is it. Highly recommend—and I’ll definitely be back!

Everything was great except I felt anxious ordering in a new place. Grabbed a menus so I know what I want next time. The person working was nice. I just left awkward that she stood there while I was paying you have to select yes or no for a tip and confirm. Aside from that, great experience, nice place and good food. I order the large falafel bowl. Couldn't finish it. The rice is delicious!
Excellent quality of the food. And Kai attended us super fast and very kindly. Highly recommended

Just ate here a couple days ago. From the start the employees were very welcoming and helpful. They guided us through the menu and even informed us of future items they will be offering. We ordered two pita wraps and they were delicious and packed with flavor. We’re definitely coming back!

Got food delivered from here :] Very fresh and light, while also being filling and delicious. Service was great! They called me to double check a substitute I made, which I appreciated. They also sent us sauce with a nice note! We completely forgot to order some since we were hungry and excited, but they saved the day (especially with that garlic sauce). Everything was perfect.

Let me start by saying the food is amazing. Very flavorful, fulfilling, and so authentic. I would for sure eat here again.

HOWEVER, I need the service to do better. The people were nice it's just the young lady up front was unorganized and all over the place.

Long story short ordered online, went to pick up, she couldn't find my other but remember making it. She asked another woman to fix my order for me. As soon as that woman was done she found the original order that she had already prepared.

I felt so awful that that lady had to redo my food as well as that's food that is wasted. Overall experience the food all that is amazing just need to get better organized.

Update: got back to my destination to only find out my order was wrong. I didn't get sauce for the rice and pikliz like most restaurants do. So kinda disappointed and would overall give 3.5
My family absolutely love their food. Sometimes the line can be long or confusing but it doesn’t take away from the food.

Next to the public library in a heavily ethnic area , its colorful placards looked enticing. Inside I discovered authentic Haitian cuisine, of which I am extremely ignorant. I chose the chicken stew and Haitian rice, both had names I did not catch.

Food was extremely authentic, very tasty, and a new experience. Eating chicken with the bones cooked in was reminiscent of life in America in the 1980’s.

Beware, I was quoted $10.65 and my receipt reflects such, but my card was charged $11.05. I didn’t make a stink over a $.40 up charge. I felt it was a little pricey but will admit there was enough rice and chicken left over for a subsequent meal.

On my second go, I had the fried goat with fried plantains, and a meat pie stuffed with chicken, boiled egg, and vegetables. Still a bit expensive but definitely a authentic experience.

I live in Sanford and drove to obt for my food. They forgot a large part of my order after asking them if everything is in there. I knew I should have checked myself however I spent $50 on food and can’t go back. The one thing I was looking forward to. As someone who owned a restaurant quality of taking care of customers is my top priority. Highly disappointed.

Great food and they give a lot! I bought a plate of turkey meat with rice and beans. I also had their chicken patty. Everything was delicious and they were fast. My mom had their mais moulin and she enjoyed it. I would definitely come again.

The restaurant had a nice atmosphere and the service was definitely the highlight of the experience. Our server was attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. Unfortunately, the food didn’t quite live up to expectations — some dishes were a bit underseasoned and not as fresh as I had hoped. Still, the staff’s professionalism and positive attitude made the visit enjoyable overall. With a few improvements to the food quality, this place could easily become a great spot!

Do not eat here!!! First off, there were bugs crawling around the walls next to the table we were sat at which is absolutely disgusting. The restaurant overall was not clean, the plates were dirty, and the trays the food was being served out of were also dirty. The food itself was not good and tasted old. Nothing was hot either, everything I got was cold or barely warm. There also were not clear labels on anything which made it confusing when trying to understand what everything was. Eating here is a waste of your money and I strongly advise you avoid this place.

Really diverse buffet, they offer classic Latin dishes, as well as surprising ones like Mondongo, Goat, empanadas, a couple of different rice/ noodle options. They also offer the standard Chinese buffet in some of their dishes like beef and broccoli, and lo mein options to name a couple.

The service honestly wasn’t the greatest, but everyone was really nice, and the place was extremely busy. Maybe have more hands on staff to refill drinks, and collect dishes 🤷‍♂️.

You pay when you walk in, and they ask for tip as well, so bring cash if that’s not something you want to do up front.

I still think the food was amazing, everything I had was really fresh, and I definitely over ate lol.

Would return for sure.

This place is amazing if you leave hungry it’s your fault. You just can’t find food like this anywhere it’s older, but it’s super clean. I saw the guy moving the booth to clean behind it. Not even your nicest restaurants do that! my New Favorite Place. Latin flair with Asian on the side now that’s the best of both worlds !🔥you gotta try this place.You won’t be disappointed!

I've been here multiple times over the years this ust to be our very 1st stop once we made it to Florida however I think this will be our last time. The food wasn't the same it was very salty an just tasted like they cooked with just salt no love an flavors to it. Before 5yts ago amazing food not one complaint but as of today na 2025 I won't be returning.
One of a kind place, with one of a kind people. Never felt more accepted and at home - built in family !!! Hottest bartenders, hottest customers, best music, best drinks - Sly family for life! 🦊

Atmosphere was awesome, the music was on point. The bartender was funny as hell, I don’t remember his name but he had a mustache like Freddy Mercy’s. Oh my goodness the food was actually cooked by a chef. It was very tasty, flavorful and cooked to perfection.

Great bartenders to start with wonderful locals who always have bright attitudes. The Vegan Hotdogs are great. Also there's fun games and sometimes local hardcore bands play shows in the basement of the venue. 10/10

Sly fox has become a staple bar for myself and my friends during my adventures in Orlando. I absolutely recommend this bar to anyone with alternative tastes looking for their spot! Also recommended for tourists and travelers for aesthetics and quality service!
Always enjoy a genuine punk rock dive bar. It is about as divey as it gets. It isn’t faux dive either. Decent music. The bartender was nice beer was cheep and cold. definitely a decent spot.

The beer was cold and fresh.  They had a few selections of IPA on tap and enjoyed a the blueberry DIPA and East Coast IPA.  We did the nachos with beef and it was just ok.  The cheese was good but it felt like just eating chips and cheese still.   The nachos needed some fresh salsa (not salsa sauce baked onto 1% of the chips), and maybe lettuce, avocado etc.  I got the Carolina Reaper wings and wasmt expecting sweet but the smoked wings were juicy and tasty.

Service was good and so was the atmosphere.

Overall, just ok.

It's been many years since I've visited Ten10 Brewing, since I no longer live in the immediate area, but I'm happy to see they are still going strong.

It looks like they've added a kitchen since my last visit, and it's great to see if can grab some good while I enjoy some beers now. Their selection of drafts has always been varied and pretty creative. And their selection of sandwiches and appetizers now is pretty sweet. I tried their take on a cuban style sandwich and I was happy with how it turned out. It's not an authentic cuban but was still tasty and paired great with all my beers.

The atmosphere here is always fun. Music is always on point but never too loud where you cant hold a convo. The staff is friendly and happy to chat and make suggestions.

Hopefully I'm able to make it out here more often because Ten10 is still a great spot.

Walked into this one after a lousy experience at Ivanhoe (very unpleasant female bartender) and immediately felt at home. Vintage vinyl records and great brews. Bartender was the best, showcasing a pretty darn good voice when we were playing Iron Maiden! Monday night apparently Metal night🤘 Stayed way too long. Had a blast. Highly recommend.

I’m going to commit a cardinal sin and talk about the food at a brewery before the outstanding beer. The Italian Beef: It’s Last Meal worthy. Simply perfect in every component. And the other items were delicious as well (house made hotdogs?!? How cool is that?). And the beer! Stouts and ales and red and black and brown—a list that isn’t 9 IPAs and 2 others (though, as an IPA lover, I won’t knock those that concentrate on it). The nitro brown was as smooth as Marvin Gaye and the pale ale had as much flavor as a full IPA. And the stouts came home with us so we could try more after driving home. To top it off, the bartender was awesome, everything was spotless and they played real jazz and funk while we were there. It really doesn’t get better than Ten10. Wish I could give it ten stars.
The food is very good for a small kitchen, they have plenty of beer choices. Most beer is coffee stout. Friendly people

Mikayla was very attentive to our needs and went above and beyond with her service. She recommended the Hawaiian Chicken and it did not dissappoint. Went for the happy hour and that entire entree was only 13 dollars! A great meal for a great cost with a beautiful view, cannot beat that! Thanks Mikayla!

Great place sit and have a drink and people watch.   Service was great,  but there were so few customers,  I think see we were her only table.  The food would have taken very little to make it good,  but the kitchen didn't bother.   Blackened Caesar was subpar.   It wasn't even tossed in dressing, chicken was very dry and almost no flavor.  For Blackened,  it wasn't.   I would venture it was pre cooked and reheated
Philly was meh.  Very little pepper/ onion,  like 2 pieces of pepper and no onion.   Again,  likely pre cooked and reheated.  Cheese wasn't melty good but more congealed.  No flavor at all.   Season the meat people!  Fries were good,  beer was good, prices were resonable, portions good.
Would easy their again but not for the location,  and I would probably go for the fish and chips next time.

Amazing amazing amazing !!! i been visiting this spot for years now . Food never disappoints , the staff always friendly and welcoming . Sarah , Nicole and the entire crew were great like always . See you soon . 💟💟💟 Sunrail 🚞🚞🚞 Crew 💟💟

Before theatre bite to eat on a beautiful October evening in O-Town. Philly cheesesteak had a great flavor, but the 6" sub roll was old. Chewy, not in a good way. Fries were delicious & lots of them. The  fish was decent, again, lots of fries. No condiments or platicware on the tables, huge turnoff. Ketchup packets? So 1970's, folks. With all the fries you serve, put a bottle of ketchup on the tables. Server was cute as a button, 4th day, right out of training. She tried her best, what can you do? Answer: management, make the rounds! Check on the tables the newbies are serving, ALONE. Nice vibe with the kitties roaming around. No sarcasm there, I love animals & I'm happy they're not shooed away. It was decent but I wouldn't return a bunch. The End.

My husband and I stopped here with our kids after walking around Lake Eola this weekend because we desperately needed a break. Fair warning: this is not the place for a quick bite, especially with hungry kids. My youngest was already starving and cranky, and the food took forever to come out. The wait time was honestly excessive, and the kids got antsy fast.

That said, this place is redeemed by its service, drinks, and location. Both our phones were dead, so we couldn’t even look at the menu, which was frustrating—but our server, Briana, completely saved the experience. She gave great food and drink recommendations and somehow managed to get my shy, picky 5-year-old to actually choose a meal (which never happens).

She was incredibly attentive and clearly noticed the kids struggling with the wait. She engaged with them, entertained them, and they absolutely adored her. She even brought out orange slices and “fancy big kid drinks” (Shirley Temples), which made a huge difference. Truly a godsend—I wanted to take her home with me.

The adult drinks were excellent and honestly helped take the edge off the chaos. If you don’t mind waiting and crowds, you’ll probably leave feeling more relaxed than when you arrived. We’ll definitely be back for drinks and after the holidays.

Good Ethiopian food but by no means the best we’ve had—it was authentic, but didn’t seem to have been made “with heart”. We had their special Nile lunch for two. Of the items provided there were only two that we thought were above average, the collards and one of the two chicken preparations. The service and atmosphere were also pleasant enough but lacked “heart and conviction”. Though authentic, this restaurant smacks of being geared to the tourist market rather than set up to serve the best Ethiopian food, service and ambience possible at this price point.

This is by far the very best Ethiopian I've ever had! We had the chef's special, the in house wine, the Wolfstrap red wine, and the Ethiopian coffee. Everything was fabulous but besides the food, the honey wine and
Coffee really stood out. The honey wine is made in house and tastes like a carbonated mead - sweet and delicious. The coffee is strong and flavorful but the presentation is an experience you really shouldn't miss. Our waitress was so friendly and knowledgeable it made me brave enough to try new things and I'm so glad I did.
You should go. You're welcome 😋

Brought my family here after seeing it on IG. We were in town for the holiday break and upon arrival  were greeted immediately. We waited patiently for our food and have to say it was WORTH the wait. Food was excellent and satisfying. You can tell they took their time and have earned a returning customer in the near future.

Came here for lunch and ordered the dinner combo for two. More than generous portions, super flavourful, especially the red lentils and split pea, with once exception (one of the beef items which was chewy) the meat was tender and tasty. The service was excellent and atmosphere relaxed. It’s not too far from the convention center and would definitely recommend it.

We love to explore international food, and Nile Ethiopian was the perfect place to experience some incredible delicacies!  We had the tomato fitfit as our starter, which was incredibly fresh and delicious!  It was an excellent prelude to our main course: the meat combination and kitfo.  If you like living on the wild side, you’ll enjoy kitfo!  It’s semi spicy along with a savory spice mix that complement the raw, minced beef.  The meat combination includes a set of well spiced dishes, all incredible in their own right.  And, eating with your hands using the injera along with the decor gives you the sense that you’ve been transported overseas.  We had great discussion with our waitress, and learned quite a bit about Ethiopian culture, food, and life. We will definitely return!

name: The Wine Room on Park Avenue

reviews.text: Had a great time at The Wine Room this afternoon! The wine selection is phenomenal, the staff are knowledgeable and friendly, and the bbq chicken flatbread and cheese plate we had were nothing short of delicious. As an added bonus, got to hear some amazing a fun tunes down in The Vault, courtesy of Danny Flashback. His fresh takes on 50's, 60's, and 70's rock and roll tunes had us tapping our toes and singing along. Loved the opportunity to catch some great music along with a delicious glass of wine ... I will be recommending TWR to other friends in the area, especially if Danny Flashback will be making additional appearances. Thanks for a great afternoon!!

A fun way to spend the night with friends or your partner! However it can get pretty packed and difficult to move around, but the wines tasted great and bottles would be restocked pretty quickly! Their food and charcuterie options were also delicious and a great way to let all the wine soak up before you head home
Everything about this place is spectacular..Wait staff..On point! Food Delicious and the fun of walking around and trying new wines... Great experience.. 👍

Really cool wine room. They use cards that you load money on and then can go around and sample all different wines through their automated dispensers. Great wine, meat and cheese selections. Staff were very friendly and helpful. We will be back

Wide choice of wines that you can taste in any fashion as you wish. You get a card and choose your wine yourself among 100s of bottles .
The service is friendly and efficient & atmosphere is relaxed and cool.

Great customer service. Excellent food except for the veggies. I found the veggies to have a strong vinegar taste. 2 much vinegar for me but I think that's how most people like them. I am used to eating my veggies steam with no seasoning so that was a bad shock for me. Besides the veggies everything else was perfect. Very flavorful, the price was fair for the quantity. I will be back 😊😊❤️

This place has amazing Puerto Rican food and great prices!! We were headed to this shopping center to go get Jersey mikes and chipotle and happened to stumble on this gem. The passionfruit juice was amazing too! Oh and the rotisserie chicken is sooo flavorful!

The service was good.
The employees were good too.
The food was a good

The restaurant was super clean, and everything was good overall.

Nice experience

I had the bbq chicken, morcilla, yellow rice and beans, sweet potatoes, papa rellena, and an empanada. Pretty good spot, a little pricey but the food was good for sure. Empanadas were very excellent, just a bit skimpy on the meat. Rice was really really good, no complaints there. Chicken was good and everything else was good as well but nothing to brag about.

I ordered 2 family meals with pernil, and chicken for my coworkers. It was a great hit. The portion were huge that we ended up taking leftovers home. The arroz con gandules was very flavorful, but my favorite is the chicharrones. I will be making this place a regular for me.

Hubby and I had a wonderful experience. We ordered boneless chicken curry and roti. We got the channa and potatoes with it. The portion sizes are very big; hubby and I ate one together and I took my roti home. The lady also gave us this nice packets of sweet that tastes like the Indian sheera. Overall, a lovely place with helpful staff and food that is really worth your money.

Shorted me a doubles. Ordered six and was charged $19.17 and gave them a $5 tip because I was in a rush and they accommodated me. A simple, small order. Said six doubles at least twice when I picked it up and again when cashing out to be sure. Guy cashing even sad that it was the “call-in order” to the lady behind the counter and she said smiling, “yeah we got your order ready!”.  Reached to work and was ready to share with two co-workers who wanted to sample and was equally hungry, before the patients started calling…only had 5 doubles in the bag. We nurses work nights so don’t really have much places to get something to eat after 7pm. One was for then and one was supposed to be for later. Since I sponsored, I sacrificed…Chipotle the next time. Can call in and quickly pickup with a guarantee.
Oh, might add that I usually spend $45 - $60 when not in a hurry, because I buy for two sometimes three people, and I miss Trini food. Rethinking that now.

Absolutely not the place to get authentic Trini food. We ordered the chicken curry roti and doubles. The roti was so thick and floury, we choked on it. The chicken, potato, Chana all had NO flavor. Food was bland. The doubles wasn’t even made correctly. First time here and money wasted. Only thing good was the pepper sauce and you need that to cover how dry and flavorless the food is. Ordering the food was unorganized. There was people standing overtop each other trying to see the food made. Very uncomfortable and disappointed. I wanted to like this place with the way they are hyped up. Don’t waste your money.

I’m giving this restaurant 5 stars because although no restaurant in reality is 5/5, i I thought Singh’a roti shop deserves a grade better than an 80%. First of the front line service was good all around by all 6 employees that helped me. I got Trinidadian doubles and something called cassava pone. They were both great for what they are, I like doubles more than I like cassava pone. They were both doubles are only $3.00. The atmosphere was surprisingly clean, pretty, and enjoyable. They have tvs. I’ll leave pictures of the doubles I'm taking back to my roommates.

This is truly a hidden gem! I love my island food. It was full

We got the curry chicken roti. It was so delicious, a bit spicy but it was worth it. The serving portion is a lot, I was only able to eat half for lunch and I ate the other half the next day. You can get it wrapped or served separately.

I’ve eaten here in the past and the food has always been consistent. I will be back.

We recently visited The Mexican Camel and ordered  two chicken bowls along with a chicken nachos dish. Everything we tried was packed with bold, well-balanced flavors. The meat was tender, well-seasoned, and complemented perfectly by the fresh ingredients and sauces. Every bite felt balanced—nothing too heavy or overpowering. The bowls and nachos both had a great mix of textures and flavors that made the meal satisfying from start to finish. The staff were warm, friendly, and helpful throughout our visit. They answered our questions, guided us through the options, and made the ordering process quick and pleasant. Overall, The Mexican Camel is an excellent choice if you are looking for flavorful bowls or nachos with a Mediterranean-Mexican twist. Great food, balanced flavors, and wonderful service—definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area!

We recently visited The Mexican Camel and tried two of their bowls. The flavors were excellent—bold, well-seasoned, and satisfying. The bowls reminded us a bit of a “triple steak” experience, but since everything is halal, it was great to finally enjoy a bowl with meat on it. Usually, we go to places like Chipotle and stick to vegetarian options, so this was a nice change.

The meat was cooked perfectly and paired well with the fresh ingredients and sauces. Every bite was flavorful without being overwhelming, and the combination of toppings, grains, and sauces made each bowl satisfying and balanced.

The staff were very friendly and attentive, making the ordering process easy and pleasant. They were helpful with questions and ensured that everything was prepared just right.

Overall, The Mexican Camel is a great spot for anyone looking for halal, flavorful bowls with a Mediterranean-Mexican twist. The food is satisfying, the flavors are well-balanced, and the staff make the experience even better. It’s definitely worth checking out if you’re in the area!

I had a great experience at The Mexican Camel! The food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly balanced between Mediterranean and Mexican styles. Every dish I tried was delicious — especially the chicken fusion bowl and pita chips with hummus.

The place itself is clean and nicely set up, with a casual and welcoming vibe. What made the experience even better was how kind and helpful the staff were — the ladies working there were especially sweet, friendly, and attentive.

Friendly staff that will happily explain the menu to you in English and Spanish. My family came here 2x in one week. #1 bowl was good. The chicken Tingo was not very spicy on first time, second time it was. The chips and pita chips were a bit greasy but tasty!  Food is filling and good.

The only negative feedback would be the Cheesy Camel option. While the ingredients and inside were amazing, the outside was toasted but it seems like the device used al to toast added burned flavor into the 🫓 pita bread. Even though the bread wasn't burned.

I would return again. 😋

The Arab and Mexican fusion didn’t sit right with me. Also the chicken was cold. When I asked the server why it was cold, she had no response. They were also power washing the floor behind the food counter as food was displayed on the counter. I found that to be disturbing as chemicals and dust were being spread in the air and thus onto the food. I wouldn’t recommend this place at all. We only ate at this restaurant because it was halal.

This quality of Barria from a food truck is astonishing… When I tell you, it was so good. The meat was nice and tender, everything was delicious. You can tell that the cook put their heart and soul into this dish… I wasn’t even able to get a decent picture of my case of Food because I dove into it so quickly😂😂
Completely blown away by the food at this truck. I rarely leave reviews but I can honestly say those were the best tacos I’ve ever had in my life. Legendary. Worth the drive.

Birria is a 10/10
I had the birria pizza, the green sauce is slightly sweet but pairs perfectly well with the pizza. The birria ramen is packed with meat.

I absolutely loved my experience here! I got the birria tacos, beef empanada, and horchata and it was all delicious! The staff was friendly and the service was quick. It was a bit pricey, but definitely worth checking out.

I was visiting from Miami and found this little spot. I was skeptical at first, but once I order some Birria tacos and quesadillas, the taste was amazing. I have been to Mexico a couple of times and I can really say that these are the best birria tacos I have ever had. I highly recommended

Heard about this place through a friend. We stopped in today. So glad we did. This is a small restaurant/bar. We were greeted warmly, and menu was explained. We ordered a LARGE Jerk Chicken, white rice, green banana and dumpling along with a beef patty. Absolutely Delicious!!! Large fed both till we were completely full. Highly recommend.

Met the owner Mark while getting food, super friendly person. The food portions are absolutely huge, and I personally really like the plantains. I'd say the jerk chicken could be less dry, but the brown stew chicken was absolutely amazing. They give a discount to UCF students, and I would definitely come here again. The portion sizes are HUGE.

Oh my gosh, this is the best Jamaican food we’ve had in Florida! The oxtail was absolutely delicious, and the curry chicken was so tender it fell off the bone. The mac and cheese was also very nice, and the cabbage was very delicious. I give it a perfect 10 out of 10!

Never ever disappointed with the food music and staff. Great portions and reasonable prices. Come here at least twice a week. Today we had the oxtail curry chicken and curry goat. Next time I will have pictures they ate too fast lol but here’s the rest of mine chicken and ice cold Guinness

We had the curried shrimp and rice dinner and fish dinner. To be fair, the pictures were taken after we had already eaten some of the food. We just could not wait to eat and then I remembered to take pictures. Both were good. The young ladies at the counter were courteous. Overall, it was a fair experience.

First time eating here!! I got the dinner combo sweet and sour chicken with pork fried rice. The chicken was so fresh and hot. Gave me plenty of sweet n sour. Pork fried rice was cooked so well and it was soft for all 3 of us. My son got the chicken wings combo. He got 8 wings. They're so crispy and juicy and fantastically delicious!! He said they're the best he's ever had at a Chinese food restaurant. My mom got the chicken and veggies combo. She got a lot of chicken and a ton of veggies. She had so much sauce..she added some to her pork fried rice. We have lots of leftovers because you get a lot of food for the money.

Our server was absolutely so sweet and attentive!!! I asked about the lunch buffet and she happily explained everything to me!!! We'll definitely check it out soon!!
The worse Chinese food I ever ate, burnt beef and dumplings. Very bad salt and pepper shrimps.
Great food!  This Chinese food is fantastic. Second time ordering and it is delicious.

This by far was NOT the best Chinese food I've had, but it worked in a pinch and we were really hungry.

The complimentary appetizer of fried wonton strips with a sweet dipping sauce was stale.

The Pu Pu platter was really oily/greasy with a lingering taste of not so fresh oil.

Mixed veggies with tofu was in a heavy sauce and not flavorful at all, but the veggies were cooked perfectly.... Soft with a bit of crisp still left.

The waitress was super sweet and very accommodating to any requests. Tea was good and soups were okay.

As I walked back to the restroom, I got a glance of what the chef was eating and wow..it looked great..light and fresh...veggies..fish..  I have no doubt that his food tasted terrific.  Unfortunately there was nothing like it on the menu.
I say it is time for this place to toss some of the outdated, greasy, fried, heavy sauced traditional Americanized Chinese food and cook for others what they cook for themselves!  I'd guess the restaurant with only 2 patrons while we were there could attract a lot more customers.

Ordered from China Chef for the first time last night. It was so good that I had to come review it right away. The sweet and sour chicken was unbelievable. The box was stuffed to the point that the top of the container couldn’t close! The chicken was so good that I ate half of it before I even got around to adding the sauce.
Very pretty inside very calming environment! Great service and tea options. The baked goods are very great and there are many different options for gluten-free customers.

We had the most wonderful experience hosting my daughter’s baby shower at Infusion Tea in Orlando. From start to finish, everything was just lovely. The food was delicious and beautifully presented, the table decorations were so pretty and perfectly suited for a baby shower, and the overall atmosphere felt warm and welcoming. A special thank you to Darcyne and Sarah, who were incredibly kind, attentive, and helpful throughout the entire event—they truly went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect.  Elizabeth was also very helpful and kind in the planning of the party. Our guests had such a great time, and the space made the day feel extra special and memorable. We couldn’t have asked for a better place to celebrate such a joyful occasion. Highly recommend for anyone planning a special event! 💕☕️

The atmosphere is so cozy! The Food ( vegan gluten free dairy free meatless organic huge selection 🎉)drinks, desserts delicious organic and fresh!!!! There is amazing gifts to buy as well! This is a must visit 🫶🏼😊✨ oh my goodness the customer service is absolutely amazing 🤩 so welcoming my Fave

One of the absolute best spots for gluten free folks, vegan, and just all around foodies. The menu is absolutely terrific and very unique. I wanted to order everything on it like seriously. This place is a true beauty in central Florida. They are doing something really special here plus my could take my doggo. If I lived closer I would be here every week!!

We stopped here for lunch expecting a fairly limited menu since it was a tea house. We were so wrong! They have a very large and interesting menu. We had the sweet potato tacos and the crunch wrap. To drink we had the rose lemonade and a coconut blend iced tea. The sweet potato tacos were very good, but definitely played second fiddle to the crunch wrap which was terrific. The iced tea and rose lemonade we're also very good. The food came out quick and everything seemed reasonably priced. There are a lot of other things on the menu that we'll be trying soon.

Easily one of the best pizza spots I’ve been to in Florida. Great toppings, the cheer, crust and sauce, everything was perfect. Fountain drinks so you get refills and variety. I will definitely be coming back.

The hottest pizza I have ever eaten. Great service. Great pizza. Very blue collar type of restaurant. A lot of bang for your buck. Chicken wings were made in the oven - so hot (temperature). Very close to Universal Parks.

Don't be scared to walk in.  Very inviting the minute you open the door.

Went back the next day to order again but they weren't open till 3:00 on Saturday.

This is a great place near universal hotels. They do deliver as well.

We will be back. Keep up the outstanding work.

Absolutely awesome pizza and service! Had 2 large pizzas delivered to our hotel room. Order was at our door in 20 minutes!! I couldn’t believe it! Amazing service, and the pizza was great! Kudos to the staff! Thank you!

We stopped by for lunch after doing some shopping in the area.  We were greeted with a smile immediately.  Ariana came to take our order quickly and she was incredibly friendly the whole time. She was attentive, warm, and literally had a genuine smile every time.

We each got the 2 slices and a drink option and the pizza was SO good!!  We’ve lived in Orlando for a long time and it’s some of the best pizza we’ve had.

We live about 40 minute away and will drive back just for this place!  If you’d open one near Horizon West in Winter Garden, that would be amazing. 😁

Love the food,fantastic. The hottest Oriana was amazing and polite, offering help if we needed it. Oriana also did multiple table touches to see how our meals was going. In all she is a superstar, made the meal and experience that much better

Great pizza
would highly recommend eating here,
The Wing shack is a great place to hang out, especially if you're an Eagles fan. They have fun, and games, and the best customers (all Eagle fans).

Wing Shack is hands down the best place to watch Eagles games! 🦅 The energy in the room is electric, the wings are absolutely delicious, and the service is top notch. Our server Selena went above and beyond to make the experience even better she’s amazing! Can’t wait to come back for the next game!

My first time here and into the “Eagles “ nest , I came for the wings and left with experience wanting me to come back , the staff was great and calm despite the rush during a busy night and Crazy game , food was fresh , and prompt given the circumstances and none of this possible without Amanda and of course the rest of the staff but definitely the lead handling all the things and more , thanks for your humble hospitality Ina first experience !

Pretty slow foot traffic for lunch hour on a weekday, but it was Christmas week when I tried them. The 14 wings with fries and celery was a great value for the amount of food during the lunch special. We tried the hot honey lemon pepper, which had great flavor, was nice and tender and juicy inside, crispy on the outside, but lacked any spice entirely, which was disappointing. The fries had good taste but were just barely warm, as if plated well before the wings, which was unfortunate. Service was polite but a bit disinterested, it seemed. Overall, it was a great lunch for value and quantity, but maybe take it to go and get a different flavor than the one I picked. 3.5/5

Been here a couple of times already. Service for the most part is great if they aren’t really busy at night. During the day though, service is usually amazing. Food has been consistent for me and the wings have been pretty amazing contrary to a few other reviews on here. Definitely also try their funnel cake fries while you’re here.

Went on a Saturday. Food and drinks were delicious, however the place is very disorganized and in huge need of training on greeting, taking orders, and even inventory. Two people in my party of 8 never got their food. They ran out of glasses and silverware so I had to eat my steak and eggs with plastic ware. Unfortunately at this time I would not recommend anyone spending their hard earned money there. Nothing against the staff though, they were friendly.

Very nice place , awesome staff and great food. I had the rack of lamb and the grilled octopus; they were cooked to perfection. The salted fish fried rice was a little bit too salty for my taste buds but nonetheless it was delicious. And also a great shout-out to the bartenders because they were on point.

Went for happy hour! They have a great happy hour, got there right when they opened! Had the blueberry lemon drop, truffle fries and wings! The service was good. It’s a nice spot but small all the great places are small lol I want to go back and try their brunch. I heard it was good and fun.

The food is soooo good!! I had the chicken and waffles, and was not disappointed. Most places in Orlando either have good food or a great vibe, but they definitely carry both! Lisa the manager was a sweetheart serving us!

I was excited to try this place based on the website’s photos of the food! It looked delicious. Upon arriving we sat out on the patio - there were only about 4 tables sat inside and none outside. Extremely slow for a Saturday night at 8pm. The drinks were delicious and the calamari was top tier. I ordered a Steak medium rare with Crabmeat and asparagus - my partner ordered the Salmon. Once my dish came it out it was plated gorgeously. Right on top of my beautiful sizzling steak laid COLD crabmeat. Completely turned me off my meal straight away.

The server was amazing - she offered another entree straight away. I ordered the Lamb rack medium rare. Unfortunately, as per the pictures below my lamb rack was over cooked and charred on the edges. It was quite chewy. I decided to box it up and it home not wanting to complain again.

Would return here just for drinks - as beautiful as the food is plated - for a restaurant on 1/4th full on a Saturday I would expect the kitchen to pay closer attention to the temperature of the meat as ordered.

This place didn't disappoint.  Saw it on a girl Instagram and had to go while visiting Orlando. The food was plentiful, hot, fresh, and tasty. My daughter said I give it a 10 out of 10. Awesomeness. Lots of food for your money.

Huge portions of fish, small little business in a strip mall setting no indoor seating if you know what you want you should call your order in or it’ll take about 15 minutes for them to fry up your fish. Forgot to use the hot sauce until I was finished next time, we’ll use the hot sauce.
Glad to be back!!!  Had basa and flounder dinners. Huge portions. Fish seasoned well. fries not seasoned, but excellent!

Going back on Saturday! Those cheese grits .... OMG! Our Food was hot, good, service was top tier and the prices were great for the amount of food you get. I went to the store for our wings and subs, then were informed by other customers to try the fish market also, we were very pleased. They offer pagers to alert you when the order is ready, so you can wait in the car. Glad we went around the corner for fish also! We tore that food down! Thanks so much! Prices were great!

I really enjoyed my experience here! I ordered the catfish dinner, and it was delicious. The only downside was that the fries were a bit bland. However, the portion sizes were generous, especially for the price. The establishment is small, with limited outdoor seating, so keep that in mind if you plan to dine in. If you’re in the area and craving some good fish, this spot is definitely worth checking out.

I just recently started coming to Earl’s. I had seen it for a long time but had not ventured in to try it out. I was amazed at how beautiful the place was inside. We also sat outside the next time and it was so pretty and beautiful to take in all the scenery. The drinks are absolutely amazing and taste perfect. The Cobb salad was excellent and so were the chicken tacos. This restaurant is extremely clean and well-maintained. You can tell the staff really care and are very kind and friendly they help you get anything that you need for your meal. The service was exceptional and I will definitely be back.

Went here for my friends birthday dinner and we were very well taken care of. The ambience was spectacular as well as our servers; Gigi and Corey. The group and I shared a couple appetizers. The guacamole was definitely a hit so we had ordered a second round for the table. We also had the truffle fries and tofu appetizer which wasn’t the best but not bad either. If you like you some expresso martinis y’all are in for a treat! i had 3 of them 😅. For my entree i went big and had the steak and sushi (spicy California roll). Absolutely my favorite part and i didn’t leave not one bite behind.

My husband and I went to Earls Kitchen for the first time, and we had such a great experience! The aesthetics and overall vibe were amazing. The food was absolutely delicious, definitely a 10/10.
Our server, Corey, did her BIG one, really made the experience extra special. She was energetic, super sweet, and went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. She even took pictures of us, which was so sweet!
We had such a great time and can’t wait to go back. Highly recommend!

I had an incredible experience at Earls! The food was absolutely amazing, everything was fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. You can really tell the kitchen puts care into every dish.

A special shoutout to our server, Corey, who made the entire visit even better. Corey was friendly, attentive, and genuinely went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. It’s rare to get service that feels both professional and personal, but Corey delivered exactly that.

Highly recommend Earls for anyone looking for great food and outstanding service. We’ll definitely be back!

My Vegan husband and I had a wonderful meal and service was top notch. The decor was lovely and comfortable. We went on a Thursday late afternoon for an early dinner and some light shopping. It was awesome to be able to dine in a location that had a separate Vegan menu. We were able to enjoy an appetizer- Vegan Charred Corn + Avocado Dip with the crispy corn tortillas chips (my favorite was the chips)! His vegan meal- Vegan Crispy Chili Tofu was fantastic he said. I enjoyed the spare ribs and the chicken. We topped it off with  a couple of beers, too. We will be back!

Stopped for a burger, hubby had wings and calamari. The burger was so good!!! The bun amazing 🥰. Had to finish it off with the brownie sundae. We’re so full and so happy! Joe waited on us and made the meal even better, he was busy busy but kept all his customers looked after and we didn’t wait long for anything.  Will definitely come back!!!

Rock & Brew is a great local spot near the airport—definitely worth checking out if you’re in the area. The menu is simple and everything we tried hit the spot. The burgers were juicy and flavorful, and the fries were crisp and perfectly seasoned.

Anthony, our server, was amazing—friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. The beer selection is huge, with tons of local options on tap. I went with a hazy (my favorite), and it did not disappoint.

The patio is fantastic—plenty of space and great vibes. It actually feels like they have more outdoor seating than inside, which I personally love. Perfect for a laid-back meal or casual drinks in the Florida sun.

Best of all, it’s local, not a chain—and you can really feel that in the quality and the service. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in Orlando!

OK, it may seem like I’m grading a little harshly, but overall it was a good experience.

The food was just OK, but I really did enjoy the atmosphere and the vibe. There was sports going on on the TVs, pretty good music from my generation, and the artwork and other attractions on the wall were fun to look at.

Service. Was. Horrible. Now I should be fair by saying that it appeared to be a last-minute rush that came in after we sat down, but the wait to get our drinks and food was exceptionally long and sort of ruined the mood for us for the night.

I ordered ribs with french fries and the ribs were tender, which means they were cooked long enough, and the taste was pretty good so whatever seasoning and or rub they used was great. I was disappointed in the amount of french fries I got with my meal, but hey, it’s a bar type atmosphere, so you get what you get.

This was a great meal! From the moment we sat at the bar Tiffany was so friendly & polite! She gave us a great drink recommendation, she was attentive & you can definitely tell that she cares about the customer. I’ve never been here before but I will definitely be back solely based on this interaction alone. The manager came by to check on us & he was excellent! I asked him about doing a holiday party here & he gave me so much information. His name is Tim & I can tell he cares about his employees & the customer experience! I will definitely be back here!

I happened to be driving through Orlando and stopped to get some food here to go. I was really impressed by the level of service and professionalism even though the place was packed. Special shout to George for going out of his way to help me rectify my ribs order. Those acts of service and courtesy go a long way. I high recommend this place. 👌👍
The food was excellent.  Bar none! I had the candied brussel sprouts and Caesar with salmon.  I've never been disappointed with my selections when I come.
Great vibes. Great drinks. Food took a while and the deep fried shrimp didn’t have much flavor. Other than that, I loved it. Lot of sitting room. ☺️

After ordering drinks and being seated in a booth by a server was then told by the manager sorry we would have to pay in order to stay in the booth due to all booths being previously reserved. Had to stand by the bar with our drinks until finishing quickly and leaving.

This place is great. Super chill. Friendly service. Excellent COVID restrictions. I felt completely at ease here, and the people who served my table were the *best*. I'd definitely return here, and I can't wait to see how the dance area evolves!

A real dope, good vibez spot to chill, listen to music, dance, & smoke 👌🏿. Been a few times But most recently went to a Family BDay outing & then came back to chill for my BDay which was a low key blast. The bartender was on point & made sure I Enjoyed my BDay nite. Will definitely drop in time after time

This is a quaint local establishment, it offers billiards and darts. It has a full bar and decent variety of taps. Smoking is permitted inside, which is the reason for food being limited. Chips, slim-jims, and a very delicious local gourmet dehydrated steak is available.

Amazing place. Sports are up, 3 pool tables ($1) with good players, cold cheap drinks, 3 dart boards, and a nice group of bartenders. The only thing is that they don't have a kitchen but they make up for it by allowing you to bring your own food. Jukebox could use an update as well.
Does anyone know what’s the phone number to this bar? I can’t get through to them at all with the number on Google. I have a issue I need addressed

Great spot for sports, food, drinks or pool! Jason, David and Bernie are great at making sure you and your party are taken care of. Promise they're not just staff, they become friends! Good music, plenty of dart boards snd pool tables. Highly recommended!

This is a fantastic pub. Every single bartender that works here are competent, respectful and most importantly, on point. They have 3 pool tables and 3 dart boards that work as they should. Great beer selection and even better liquor choices.

Tap Room does not offer food but does not frown upon having food delivered or brought in, so you can walk next door to grab sushi or have Josie's (the best) pizza delivered.

When it comes to watching your favorite sports team on TV, you will be happy to hear that it will most likely already be on. If not, just ask the bartender and they will switch it on for you on their many TVs.

I don’t usually leave reviews, but today I’m very disappointed. This is my third time visiting this restaurant. I’ve had the lo mein before and it was very good, which is why this experience was so frustrating.
I ordered the house lo mein with extra beef, but they forgot to add the shrimp, and there was no extra beef at all. I also ordered my mom a steak sub, and it had an excessive amount of mayo, completely overwhelming the sandwich. On top of that, the food was extremely salty, to the point where it was not edible.
It truly seems that when the manager/owner is present, the food is prepared with excellence. I was told she is currently on vacation, and I honestly can’t imagine her allowing food like this to come out of her restaurant.
If the cook cannot follow the recipe or special instructions, then changes need to be made. Some customers may not speak up, but I will. I spent $27.00+, and this quality is unacceptable.
If the owner happens to see this review and the pictures, this cannot be how food is intended to be served. Also, the tomato slices on the sandwich were extremely large—using a slicer might help with consistency.
Would I try this place again? Possibly—when the owner returns from vacation, because I truly believe she would make sure everything meets her standards.

The worst Chinese food I’ve ever gotten. Which is so disappointing because the woman at the front was very pleasant.
I ordered general Tso chicken… it tasted more like orange chicken I don’t like the citrus of orange chicken, which is why I didn’t order it… but then I found an actual orange peel soooo yeah.

Crab rangoon were not only dry inside they tasted like rubber and lack flavor. The sauce turned my fingers red.

My eggrolls were completely burnt crispy

And the rice was a weird texture .

Some of the worse Chinese food I’ve ever had. The wait time was 35-40 minutes when she told me it would be 15. She was very nice but it took way too long for food that wasn’t even good. It’s the most American Chinese food you’ll find, owned by middle easterners and the food is cooked by black people. Nothing Chinese about it. I ordered crab rangoons and sweet and sour chicken. I found them on Uber eats and saw a picture of their sweet and sour so that’s what I was looking forward to, I posted a picture of what they advertised vs what I got, NOTHING alike. The chicken was nonexistent it was 90% puffy flavorless breading with little to no meat the smaller pieces were literally just fried breading no meat inside at all. The actual sauce was sour and tangy not sweet at all. A radioactive dark red color not your typical deep orange color. The crab rangoons were fried so hard they were too tough to eat with little to no filling in them. The egg roll it came with was crispy but the inside filling was mushy with no flavor. It was mostly noodles not much veggies at all. Only the fried rice was okay. Not the best but not horrible like the rest of the food. Only good thing I can say is the prices are reasonable and the menu is big with plenty of options but if the food is trash then I don’t see a point. Maybe I just ordered the wrong things. This was my first and most definitely will be my last time coming here.

After over a decade of coming here I had the worst customer service experience ever with a young man at the register. After ordering online on their business website, I arrived to pick my food up. I gave my last name and phone number, the young man could not find the order evening after I gave the information and said he did not see one. Finally, he looked over saw food and my number on it and said I did not give him the right name. I gave my last name instead of first and he said that is why he did not see it, although my full name was on the ticket. Upon arriving home the 4wings and fries that were 8.99 were over done and looked like a kids size meal. I call back to ask about the quality of the food and quantity, but mostly wanted food that was not burned. The young man cashier went on speaking about DoorDash and the pricing and I shared I did not order from DoorDash. Nonetheless I wanted edible food and he continue to ramble about DoorDash prices, I asked him to listen as I wanted my food remade originally, but he hangs the phone up after saying he didnt have time.

Upon return I sat the food on the counter and asked for a refund at this point. He was then on the phone with the owner being dishonest about what was happening as I wanted edible food originally and he never told her he hung the phone up on me, because I called back and he did not answer. Once she arrives I explain all of this to her, and that what disturb me nost is not only did he not want to find the order originally, that even in doing my due diligence in calling back to get the food remade, the employee felt it was ok to hang up on a paid customer who had burned food, and then was rude and disrespectful once I came in while the owner was on the phone. All I wanted was food remade, but I was made to wait until the owner came. Another 10mins by now.

At this point it is important to say that I have always been fond of the owner, and shared how hurt and disrespected I felt by her young employee who did not exemplify her standard. She was not there for any of the encounters with him, and I expressed how his dismissive behavior is something so many people experience from young men like him which is why many like him get categorized. I only wanted food remade and 30mins later having to explain how rude the young man was while he had not yet apologized or cared was awful. I only wanted a refund after I was hung up on. The owner offered to remake the food and apologized, however, I let her know he needed to apologize, which he finally did after I told him do not ever hang up on a customer who just did business. After literally 45mins from the time I called back and was hung up on, I could not believe how much time was wasted for a remake or either a refund, and was disheartened that me expressing my disappointment would seem to offend anyone when the young man was dismissive and uninformed. I truly hope if  business owners are employing young people that those employees uphold the same standard as owners. After eating here over a decade and all that happened today I am sad that I do not feel comfortable coming back if she is not present. I literally only wanted quality food, and unfortunately the owner did not see how much her employee agitated and escalated things to begin with by calling and lying to protect his owner behavior.
