It was stated that his Father had come into the restaurant and I do hope the young man's Father and Mother share with him that in a right to work state, an employee should care as much about the customers as the owners do. Sad and disappointed. My food was remade, but I doubt anyone even understood the gravity of what all occurred and how all of it could have been avoided and it was at the customers expense. Online orders are not able to be refunded at the store in no kind of way, so the least her employee could have done was offered a remake, but he hung up and refused to hear me asking for a remake.

Absolutely delicious!!! I am from the Midwest, STL area, where we PRIDE ourselves for having exceptionally good rice joints. While visiting Orlando I came across this gem and I could not believe how closely the flavor of their fried rice resembled what I am used to Brown rice not Golden, assured the flavor was their, but the actual taste OMG!

This place has an extensive menu and cozy atmosphere. Plenty of parking was a plus on Colonial Dr. They have great happy hour specials on appetizers, rolls, and drinks. The scallops yaki was worth the trip by itself. Our server was extremely friendly and great with recommendations. It was a great dining experience.

Ok, listen…the service is a little slow…but the food is SO WORTH IT. check the menu before you go, we got the Cafe martini and cosmopolitan, hurrican roll, volcano roll and shrimp tempura but my favorite and the best thing was the salmon Nagiri. Holy cow! The salmon is perfect. I had like 8 of them! And since it’s on happy hour 2 for $5 was a great price!!!

The food is delicious and great portion sizes, sushi is well made and fresh. The Ramen with pork belly was very good with complex flavors. Can't really go wrong with anything on the menu and the atmosphere is nice too. Its always quiet and not very busy, which is nice except sometimes I worry they dont have enough patronage, if you haven't tried them, go now! They're on the second floor, stairs or elevator to take you up. Worth it!

We went here for an early dinner on a Monday. The staff was warm and welcoming. We ordered the spider roll, crazy yellowtail, Hawaiian and hurricane rolls. Everything was delicious- very fresh! I really enjoyed the presentation on the wood round as well. The sushi chef came out and asked us how everything was- he was very friendly and had great energy. I would definitely come here again!

Authentic Japanese restaurant, service is amazing.. custom service top notch, they pay attention to detail...food is very good. bathroom is super clean ...my Moto if the bathroom is dirty so are the employees.,.. Restaurant and Restrooms were clean during my visit. Sushi made fresh to orders

Definitely a hidden gem!
The biggest issue I had when I moved here to Florida from Chicago was that there weren’t very many ethnic stores. This market has everything Mediterranean and Middle Eastern! I’m able to get my spinacktopia, Ajvar (veggie spread), pistachio spread & Arab perfumes (yes, even the viral ones) all in one place!! I usually blind by my Arab perfumes by just going off of reviews online, but I’m able to smell all of them here before I buy them! I love this place and I also love that I’m supporting a family owned small business!🫶🏼

This shop has a great selection of very interesting Arab products. I love shopping here; it's a pleasant place, and Salma the girl who works there, is very sweet and friendly. She treats customers very well. 100% recommended.

I love the wide selection of Middle Eastern and Mediterranean food that this market has. And I'm impressed by their selection of Arabian Fragrances. Such a cool store and I had so much fun shopping here.

I absolutely loved the variety of foods items from so many countries you can find at this store. The owners are Egyptian so I learned about tons of delicious Egyptian treats but I found plenty of Turkish items I love. These included apple tea, baklava, Turkish delights, and Turkish coffee. They also have Indian frozen goods, kibbeh, za’atar, perfumes from Dubai, dates, olives and sooo much! This was the hidden gem I needed in my life.

Shopping is always a pleasant experience here. Their prices are more reasonable than other international/Mediterranean stores. They have good selection too. There are staple foods I keep coming back for. The cashiers are welcoming too. There are free pamphlets/books about Islam if you are curious to learn about it.

I’m haitian & im very embarrassed to even eat here. This is NOT how an establishment should be. I understand there’s pressure and everyone to serve , but the way i seen the way my food was handled was very concerning. A very small portion of legume, a literal small container where KETCHUP BELONGS, is my legume. That’s ridiculous, my plantain , looked undercooked. BARELY , im talking about BARELY any rice . When i ordered two platters of rice and received only one halfway full & dry. I cannot . I did not want to leave a review, but this was my first visit, & will be my last. Price was very unreasonable, nowhere near close to being good to even be that high. Im vacationing here and im just in disbelief.
Good food

A Deeply Disappointing Experience at Island Kitchen & Grill

I truly wanted to enjoy Island Kitchen & Grill—especially given how seamless and convenient the ordering process was. I had every intention of becoming a repeat customer. Sadly, what I received fell drastically short of expectations and left me with serious concerns about the kitchen’s standards and overall food quality.

To begin with, I waited over an hour for my order to be prepared, only to receive food that I ultimately couldn’t even eat. The rice was significantly undercooked—far too firm and dry to be palatable. It lacked both flavor and texture, making it difficult to enjoy even as a base.

I had paid an additional $4.00 for a large plate, which was supposed to include a third side item: a festival. Unfortunately, that item was never provided, and no explanation or acknowledgment was given at the time of pickup.

I had specifically requested oxtail gravy to be served over the entire meal, as this was clearly presented as an option during the ordering process. However, what I received was a disappointingly sparse drizzle—so minimal it seemed almost deliberate. It felt as though the kitchen was rationing it with extreme reluctance, which severely diminished the richness and cohesion of the dish.

The steamed cabbage, which should have added a fresh and comforting contrast, was borderline inedible. Its taste was so off-putting that I genuinely questioned whether it had spoiled—it emitted a bitterness and odor that rendered it entirely unappetizing.

As for the fried chicken, it was perhaps the most concerning aspect of the meal. It had a stale flavor, almost as if it had been previously cooked, left to sit, and then hastily re-fried upon ordering. Yet despite this, it still arrived undercooked—a perplexing and frankly alarming oversight. Undercooked poultry is not only unpleasant but a serious health risk.

I generally make it a point to support local establishments, especially those offering culturally inspired cuisine. However, this experience left me not just disappointed but genuinely uneasy. After waiting over an hour, to not even be able to eat the meal was incredibly frustrating. There’s a clear need for improvement in food preparation, quality control, and customer value. Until then, I simply cannot recommend this establishment.

Great guys, great food. We ordered some some jerk chicken and his ox tail sauce made waves. Very personable and kind. Will be back as soon as possible.
Highly recommended
The owner I would assume great conversationalist & welcoming, explained the menu very lovely it was a good experience.

If you are checking out a show at Level 13 and feel your stomach growlin’ at you for not eating all day before the big show, then stop here!! I had such a good experience at this cute little food truck.

I got the fish fry special! I said see you later vegetarian ways I’m eating deep fried fish from a food truck in Orlando! WOW! The tilapia was incredible! The batter was seasoned perfectly! A nice blend of flavors. It also came with these things called “festivals” it’s like a deep fried dough. Incredible!!

Also, side note, the head chef has a secret spicy sauce. Ask him about it!!!

Definitely worth a stop. Super happy to have made it. Shout out to the wonderful people in the truck making magic happen. They also cater events if you are looking!!

Worse Jamaican food I’ve ever had in my LIFE! Plantain was burnt. Jerk chicken had mustard drizzled over it. Cabbage was unidentifiable and rice was crunchy and not fully cooked. If I could give zero stars I would

I've been wanting to try Hot Pot for quite some time. We got there right when they opened, so we were seated right away. There was a robot that showed us to our table (innovation always impresses me) and a human waitress was there to greet us. She was very thorough in her explanation of how things worked and very helpful with choosing the seasonings. I thoroughly enjoyed the experience and would go back again. My only negative was I had problems mixing my seasonings.

We had a wonderful family lunch at Volcano Hot Pot on International Drive in Orlando. The food was delicious, and the variety was incredible—fresh noodles, veggies, dumplings, meats, and all the hot pot toppings you can imagine. The broth was full of flavor, and everything tasted amazing. A fun and tasty experience for the whole family.🥰😍

Food is great.
Typical KBBQ and Hot Pot AYCE.

If you have an alternative look, visible tattoos, just came from the theme parks, or are not East-Asian looking, please prepared to not be treated or taken seriously. You could be better off having a white person or somebody who looks like they just left a business meeting make the reservation. Have said person be the one to greet the host because the staff and management are trained to dismiss anyone who doesn’t look like them or appeal to their standard. ———-

This was not during a high dinner rush.
I was not rude.
I was not demanding.
I kindly requested how long was the wait for 7 people to 1 table?
I was told 7 people cannot be accommodated to 1 table so my party and I were split in 2 tables across from each other while a room of tables behind the sauce bar for parties of 8 were EMPTY.
Hands down one of the best hotpot & bbq restaurants in Orlando. The selection, quality, and atmosphere is top notch. Comfy seating. Attentive staff.

The best part about this place? You can eat hot pot and BBQ like a hungry dragon, and still walk out smelling fresh—no one will ever guess you just destroyed an all-you-can-eat feast.
The hot pot broth is so tasty it could cure a broken heart, and the BBQ is so juicy I almost proposed to the grill. Service is fast, friendly, and they don’t judge how many plates you order (thankfully).
10/10 would eat again. My stomach is full, my clothes are clean, and my dignity… well, that’s gone, but it was worth it.

The food was great. I ordered the ceviche spicy and it was a medium heat. The lomo saltado was quite good but kinda just tasted like grilled steak; very reminiscent of steak frites. Service was kind, helpful, and attentive. Atmosphere was fun but lacked real clarity of message about this being a Peruvian restaurant. Definitely worth checking out. The food was very enjoyable.

I absolutely love Braza’s Chicken. This place is the real deal-authentic, local, and consistently outstanding. The chicken is juicy, flavorful, and cooked just right every time. The sides are tasty, and every bite feels like comfort food done with care. The service is friendly and fast, making every visit enjoyable from start to finish. If you’re looking for bold flavor and a place that gets it, this spot hits it out of the park every time. Highly recommend.

Wow ! Highly recommend the family meal here. They have the best brasaa chicken in central Florida.

I loved the different sides they had to offer and my whole family was so happy with the quality. I would say it’s a 5 star. The service was great; the food incredible and it was quick. The only bad thing is only soft drinks and no juice options.

First time here and we loved it.
We had the family combo and it feeds 4 very hungry people. When we arrived there was no one there but I think we may have showed up too early because little by little the place started to get packed.
The food came and we did not have to wait much, smelled amazing and it was fresh and flavorful. We will definitely come back and try something else on their menu.

Honey, if Shakira's hips don't lie, then this chicken is out here delivering *gospel truths*! That skin is so crisp it practically crackles with confidence—like it knows it's the star of the show but is humble enough not to be greasy about it. And that marinade? All the way to the bone, so you’re not out here playing “guess the seasoning” like some other sad poultry offerings.

The ceviche? Sharp, tangy, and fresher than your latest gossip. The yucca? Oh, she came to SLAY—golden, crunchy, and ready to dunk on any sad, soggy excuse for a root vegetable. And let’s talk prices—reasonable enough to have you throwing a little extra *holla* to the chef because they deserve a standing ovation.

Honestly, this spot understood the assignment, and I am here for it. Who needs diamonds when you have food this good.

My husband and I are big bbq ribs fans. For the price, taste, and the amount you get, we would pick this one the best out of the ones we’ve tried. We enjoyed the juicy ribs, briskets and generous amount of sides. I especially liked hot beans, collard greens as well as green beans. Would definitely come back !

Saw this place on YouTube review and had to give it a go.
The meat was luke warm when it was served. I've had better tasting pulled pork and brisket back in Oz. Had to mix the BBQ sauces into the meat to give it some flavour. You pay extra for the brisket...  Had the 3 meat and 2 sides. BBQ beans and Jalapeno Mash potatoes were very good.
Nice free ice cream cone to finish off.

A friend referred us the first time.It was okay, we decided to give it a second chance.And bring some home for dinner, not feeling like cooking

Worst dinner in a long time
The ribs were dry. The sliced brisket was ripped apart. Cuz, it was overdone.
Could not even chew the ribs
Horrible experience never going back again.

Cecil’s Texas Style Bar‑B‑Q is hands‑down one of my favorite BBQ spots in the area. The smoked meats are rich, tender, and full of flavor - true Texas‑style goodness you don’t find everywhere. The brisket, ribs, and pulled pork all hit the mark, and the sides are hearty and delicious too. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, perfect for a casual meal with friends or family. Staff are friendly and make you feel right at home every time. If you’re craving authentic BBQ done right, Cecil’s is the place to go.

I used to come here years ago during lunch breaks when working in downtown/SODO area. Always a good meal, decent price, and fairly quick. This was a decade ago.

Came back to Cecil's again recently and feel like maybe I'm the one who changed. It feels the same, but the quality isn't what I remember. The sides feel kind of half assed, but the meat was good. The macaroni and cheese specifically tasted like it was made three days prior and just reheated over and over. There was no life in it.

Cafeteria style bbq can be good when done correctly. If your a law enforcement officer, you might like this place because everything is done in front of you. If you are not a law enforcement officer, you may not like it because you have to serve yourself.

Also, someone stole my drink cup. We have no idea who did it. Who does that?

I stumbled upon this spot on Google after seeing a ton of great reviews, so I decided to check it out, and I’m really glad I did. It’s a cozy, family-run Turkish restaurant that feels like one of those hidden gems you’re always hoping to discover. The place itself is pretty small and unpretentious, but don’t let that fool you because the food and the service are both top-notch. Honestly, I was surprised it wasn’t packed on a Saturday evening because it definitely deserves to be.

We started off with a sampler of four appetizers: baba ghanoush, eggplant sauté, tabbouleh, and a creamy, yogurt-based dip whose name I can’t remember, but every single one was excellent. Each had a fresh, homemade flavor that you just don’t get at big, commercial places. I kept going back and forth trying to decide which one was my favorite, and I still couldn’t pick.

For the main course, I went with the lamb sauté, and my wife ordered the okra sauté with chicken. Both dishes were bursting with flavor, and you could really taste the freshness of the ingredients and the care that went into the cooking. The portions were generous too, so you definitely get your money’s worth.

Service was another highlight. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without being overbearing. Overall, it felt like the kind of meal that’s prepared and served with pride, and that’s something I really appreciate.

If you’re craving authentic, mom and pop style Turkish cuisine with rich flavors, generous portions, and genuinely warm service, I highly recommend giving this place a try. I’ll definitely be back, and next time, I’m bringing friends.

We ordered the lavas bread with hummus, baba ganoush, and a few other dips, and everything was amazing. The chicken seekh kebab was flavorful and perfectly cooked. We also tried the freshly made baklava, and it was hands down the best I’ve had so far. Definitely a place we’ll be visiting again!

Zeytin Turkish Restaurant in Orlando is a wonderful spot for authentic Turkish cuisine. The staff were exceptionally kind and accommodating, even accepting our order at the very last moment — a gesture that truly stood out. The food was outstanding: the shish kebabs were perfectly grilled and juicy, the Adana was rich and flavorful, and their signature lavash bread was absolutely amazing — soft, warm, and beautifully puffed. Prices are on the higher side, but the quality and taste make it well worth it. Overall, a delightful experience with delicious food and genuine hospitality.

Delicious buttery rice and tender lamb! Cute decor as well. I liked the YouTube channel they had playing on the tv. Love that all the meat is halal (per server). Their hummus and bread is yummy- make sure to be careful as it’s super hot with the air still in it. Bathrooms were clean too. A little pricey to me but fair for restaurants that are similar to this. Excited to come back soon.

Thoroughly enjoyed dinner at this place in Winter Park. Had the “ pick four” with the babaganush with tremendous Smokey flavor.  Murat, our server, was super pleasant and attentive.  We also had the lavas and moussaka.  Everything was fresh and flavorful. Definitely recommend this place.

name: Heart of Jerusalem Restaurant
vicinity: 5683 Red Bug Lake Rd, Winter Springs

reviews.text:
I love coming here to relax and have a nutritious delicious meal. All the food is homemade and absolutely delicious!
I Highly -highly recommend. Bring your friends to enjoy authentic middle eastern food.
Trust me, this will become 1 of your regular places too! Thanks Mike for the wonderful food you cook us!
My personal favorite’s are Chicken Platter, Sage Tea and of course the Best Baklava ever!!

Great food, would come back again for sure. I had the chicken platter and the green mint sauce was fantastic!  Comes on either lettuce or rice, I got the rice and it was very good. Really enjoyed the little heart shaped falafels too!

I love it here! Everything is so flavorful and the man that is always there is so kind. I ordered the ultimate gyro and the sage tea (unlike anything I've ever tried-so delicious!) We are enjoying this at home tonight.
Food was phenomenal! I ordered the chicken plate and the meal itself, salad, falafel, and hummus were all excellent. Nice vibe on the inside too with pictures of Jerusalem and similar art.

We placed a catering order for after a small funeral. My husband and I have eaten in a few times, but we've never catered anything.  The owner was beyond kind, coming in on his day off to prepare the food. Everything was delicious.  There was so much food and everyone really enjoyed it. This is definitely a local gem.

this is a great place to pick up lunch and study! i don't think i've ever been in there where the coffee bar isn't busy. the atmosphere is great and it's relaxed and fun without being too loud or too quiet.
the coffee is enjoyable and i like trying the different varieties. very vegan friendly with both the coffee and the food! they always have multiple rotating specials that are roughly half vegan and there's a lot of already vegan items on the menu. i like to try the specials because they're always coming up with something new and creative (although the philly is arguably my favorite).
additionally, they have great nonvegan and vegan desserts! everything is clearly labelled and they have a fair amount of options. the baked goods are delicious and i would consider coming there just for the bakery.
i love coming here to eat and hang out for a while and i'll continue to do so in the future! i definitely recommend it for studying or just hanging out with friends.

Just discovered this spot on a trip to Orlando and I literally went 3 times in the span of 3 days. I’m vegan and it made me so happy to see all the options they serve, not to mention the food was more than delicious. The staff were super nice and the atmosphere was great. The Drunken Monkey is now a must for all of my future Orlando trips!

The Drunken Monkey is right on Bumby Ave, corner of Stanley St, next to Beefy King.
I was surprised by this small restaurant. It is family owned and has been operating for 17 years; something they're doing right.
I called and placed my order by phone, as I could not figure out how to place an online order; no big deal. The young woman that answered the phone was very polite and sounded so sweet and friendly. She helped me with my order and suggested alternatives to what I wanted, because what I asked for was not on their menu anymore.
I ended up with a Royale Panini which is very tasty and a Turmeric Latte (Golden Milk). I got the Turmeric Latte because I've been meaning to try it and for its potential health benefits. Now, that Royale Panini was stupendous, it was done almost to perfection; it came with a little side of potato salad, which was enough and tasty except that it needed a little bit of salt.
Order was done fast. I went in to pick up my order and order was ready for me to pick up and go. The staff is great.
I will be back to try other items that I saw on their menu and to try their Matcha; I love Matcha. Thank you for the great food and service Drunken Monkey!

A very great study spot with plenty of food options for all diets. The Mojo Jojo is a great choice for coffee and the staff is all kind and friendly. They also have a drive thru and great pastries, some are even vegan and gluten free.

Chill atmosphere with warm and inviting people. The food quality was wonderful with vegan and meat options. The drinks were in a wide variety and they also had comfortable seating with a lovely area to chat and/or read/study. I have frequented this shop multiple times and the workers are phenomenal. The prices are fair and the service is wonderful. Also, the baked goods ROCK! Get the banana nut or peanut butter brownies! It will change your LIFE!

Met up with some friends here before their flight. Only 10 minutes from MCO, it was a great spot to meet. There were options for our vegetarian friends and meat eaters alike.

All four of us got a sandwich combo, which was a great deal - sandwich, one side, and a drink. The fountain drink machine was done, so we got cans of soda instead.

The beef and chicken were cooking on those giant skewers behind the counter and smelled delicious!

It was a one man team when we went, but he was very patient with all of our separate orders and got them together quickly. He let us wait at a booth until our whole party had arrived, which was nice since we weren’t technically paying customers yet.

I would go back when I’m extra hungry to try one of the platters. Those portions look huge online!

We had an amazing experience at this family owned restaurant. From the moment we walked in, the owner treated us like family. He took the time to talk with us, check on us, and make sure we were comfortable the entire time.

My family and I felt welcomed right away. The atmosphere was family friendly and relaxed, which made the experience even better.

The Mediterranean food was incredible. Everything was freshly made, and we were able to watch the owner prepare the food right in front of us. You could tell how much care and effort went into every dish.

The food tasted fresh and authentic. Overall, this place offers great food, great service, and a genuine connection between the owner and customers. We will definitely be coming back.

Stopped by for lunch expecting a legit Mediterranean meal, but this place missed the mark. The vibe was dead , not a single customer eating inside. No staff in sight either; had to wait until another customer literally yelled to the back to get someone to come out.
It’s one of those “order yourself, sit, and wait” spots, but the service felt half-asleep.
Disappointing Lunch Experience
The food didn’t make up for it either — the chicken in the wrap was weirdly grainy, and the garlic potatoes were way too salty. I couldn’t even finish a quarter of my plate.
Overall: weak flavor, low energy, and not worth the stop. This time around this place right now it’s far from "Habibi", but I won't be going back!

My concern is fry price too but Shawarma was dry and EXTREMELY sour. I thought it was the pickle but it was the garlic sauce. It was horribly made. These types of sandwiches are meant to be juicy and flavorful but it was like eating a lemon. The chef was a kind man. The place has potential but definitely needs new ingredients. I got fries for $7…. and look how much it got me.. it was also undercooked and nasty. Sorry but take your $ elsewhere.

Normally, I don’t leave negative reviews, but this order really needs to be addressed. I placed an order through the Uber app for 9 shawarma sandwiches, and we ended up waiting 1 hour and 40 minutes for the food to be ready for pickup. I understand that restaurants can get busy, but this was well beyond a reasonable wait time.

To make matters worse, the order was a mess. The meats were mixed, and this was the first time I’ve ever seen a shawarma sandwich made with French fries inside. I’m not sure if this was a mistake or intentional, but it definitely wasn’t what we expected.

I hope this review helps the restaurant improve its service.

What a great experience.

This is an amazing authentic Brazilian restaurant.

All the crew are amazing, since the beginning with the reception welcoming the guests.

All the waiters and staff are friendly, welcoming and very knowledgeable about all menu choices. A big thanks for Cris for the hospitality and customer service.

The food is another extraordinary experience with a surprising and delicious 🤤 flavour.

The dishes are very well served with big portions.

I really enjoyed and recommend this place.

🍽️What we ordered:
- Family-size Picanha with side dishes
- Caipirinha

✨Atmosphere:
So lively and joyful. Families were celebrating birthdays, there was live music, and the whole place felt warm.

💬Service:
The staff were incredibly attentive and friendly; it genuinely felt like chatting with friends. I guess it's the Brazilian warmth

⭐Overall: 5/5

One of the best restaurants in International Drive. The food is amazing full of flavor. We ordered the Smoked Ribs (Costela no Bafu), cooked to perfection bones coming off the meat. The portions are enough for 4-6 people so don’t look at the prices and think it’s a lot.
Also, try the Risotto with Heart of Palms. The best!!

The restaurant is big, food is OK, and you can share some dishes like the one we ordered for 4 people (bobó de camarão). Very noisy place, loud music and very difficult to talk on a saturday night dinner with family and friends. Service is good and the restaurant is very well located.

Such a fun Brazilian bar! The live music was amazing, the food was delicious, and the beers were super cold, they even serve them in icy cups! ❄️🍻 The whole vibe was just perfect, great energy, great people, and great drinks. Can’t wait to go back! 🇧🇷🎶

Me senti no Brasil!!! Parabéns!!!👏🏻👏🏻⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Stopped into The Lucky Leprechaun while visiting Orlando and had such a great time! The Guinness was poured perfectly,  - smooth, creamy, and ice cold. The atmosphere felt authentic and welcoming - we were able to request some songs, plenty of TVs, pool tables, and good tunes. The owner was amazing - very hospitable and full of great conversation, which made the experience even better. You can tell he takes real pride in the place. Definitely a must-visit spot for a true Irish pub vibe!
Excellent little Irish pub in Orlando! Lots of screens, clear and perfect volume speaker and the food and drink are excellent and cheap! Perfect place to come watch GAA!

This bar is a little off the beaten track and could be easily overlooked.
We found it via chance and popped in on a number of occasions as the staff give a friendly welcome and it had a friendly atmosphere. It's well known for showing soccer matches and a broad variety of music. You can even purchase some of your favourite shopping supplies. We never tried any meals but the ones we witnessed looked good.

The Irish Fry is unreal literally thought I was back home. It has a real pub atmosphere and is the best place to watch all the sports, GAA, football etc. The staff are amazing and there is a wee import shop with UK,Scottish and Irish crisps, sweets etc! They also serve Prosecco which makes it the best Irish pub in the whole of Orlando! Very kid friendly and my 2 year old loves it!!!! Don’t miss it on your next holiday to Orlando!

Been coming here for years. Helpful and very entertaining/funny bartender Alex. We sang karaoke, picked the songs that we liked. Service always the best! Great selection of beers. Very affordable prices! Tuesday nights are home made tacos night with variety of delicious tacos, also quesadilla, rice, corn n so much more…

Before entering you might get a bit disappointed because of the atmosphere outside but trust me when you will get inside you will feel great. A middle eastern vibe, very clean and neat. And food was very good. Will definitely recommend if you visit to orlando.

This place was a delightful treat for dinner. My boyfriend and I actually meant to try the place next door and mistakenly walked in here, but it turned out to be a wonderful accident - we had a delicious dinner and our server Muhammad helped us pick traditional Arab options. Would absolutely recommend!

While visiting Orlando, Florida, we stumbled upon World’s Magic Restaurant, a hidden gem serving authentic Saudi cuisine. This was a rare and delightful surprise—while Mediterranean and Arabic restaurants are quite common, it’s not often you come across a true Saudi restaurant outside of Saudi Arabia itself.

We ordered the Lamb Mandi and Chicken Mandi, and both dishes were nothing short of fantastic. The rice was fragrant, perfectly seasoned, and absolutely bursting with flavor. The meat was tender, juicy, and cooked to perfection, with just the right blend of spices. The hummus was smooth and delicious—though I would have loved a slightly larger portion. The Arabic salad was fresh, crisp, and the perfect complement to the mandi, while the stuffed cabbage leaves were a pleasant surprise—honestly better than grape leaves in both flavor and texture.

A side of garlic sauce elevated everything on the plate; in my opinion, it’s a must-have with mandi. The restaurant itself had a welcoming and well-kept atmosphere, with tasteful décor that set a warm tone. A particularly thoughtful touch was the musalla area at the front for guests to perform salah, which we deeply appreciated.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel at home from the moment we walked in. While I do wish the menu had a few more unique Saudi dishes to explore, it was refreshing to see authentic flavors from Saudi Arabia represented so well.

If you’re in Orlando and want to try something beyond the usual Mediterranean or Middle Eastern fare, World’s Magic Restaurant is well worth a visit.

So delicious!
The Saudi food here is amazing full of flavor and so fresh! Loved every bite, can’t wait to come back.we ordered mandi, hummus and more

Amazing food. It’s a family run atmosphere. Expect great home cooked food in a warm inviting atmosphere. If you are looking for sterile white tablecloth service look elsewhere. The meat with rice was to die for.

Great Thai Spot!
We had such a good experience here. We ordered a Singha beer to start and shared the Samui Crystal Crab, which was crispy and flavorful. For our mains, I got the Salmon Glory and my boyfriend had the Massaman Curry Supreme. Both dishes were delicious and really well seasoned.
The service was super nice and the restaurant itself is really pretty and cozy. We loved it and would definitely come back!

You always want to make your customers feel welcome — after all, they’re the ones who pay the bills. The staff and our waitress were absolutely amazing, and the overall service was great. The food was very good as well.

If I’m being honest, the Penang curry could’ve been better, but everything else was solid. A little more attention to the initial greeting and making sure every customer feels valued would go a long way.

Still, great team and a good experience overall.

NXTGEN Marketing Group
‘Honest and Accurate Reviews Since 2011”

We just did Thailand this year and here we are a holiday light show...we found this fabulous Thai Restaurant. Wow! When you walk in, it's like a time and distance warp back to southeast Asia. And you can even buy the art! What a great authentic decor.
As for the food, fabulous. Large portions so dinner is also lunch tomorrow
Now the service was very friendly. Filled our drinks, asked if we were good and the food came quickly. The noodles in the Pad Thai Chicken were just right. The steak was also perfect. And the won ton was very Thai!
This is a definite don't miss if you're on international drive.

Great food, attentive service. We got the Pot stickers, Wonton soup and fried Egg roll as appetizer, yeah we had an appetite 😊. And as main dish we ordered Chicken Phad Kee Mao and Ginger beef, very refreshing and authentic flavor. Crisp vegetables and fresh herbs. As last, however not the least, I had the Coconut delight, best of both worlds, ice cream and banana wrapped in pastry skin. Decor was interesting, it's like you landed in a totally different vibe. As I mentioned before, service real simple, basic ethics how it supposed to be. Food came out quite rapidly, despite having several big tables at the moment we were presented a table. Last, but not least, music choice wasn't what we expected, rather listen to some Thai music, instead than some piano music. Worth the visit, and we will be back.

The atmosphere is very unique. Anyone who can appreciate a little taste of what cultural immersion would be would also love this place visually. The food was pretty good, portion sizes were more than enough for every dish we had. Everything was flavorful in such a way you will not be able to stop eating after the first bite. Definitely would Recommend any of their noodle dishes as a first-timer. This is a wonderful way to introduce someone into certain flavors and styles of Thai cuisine. Wonderful and beautiful restaurant. Will definitely come back.

If you're in the Apopka area and looking for a quick bite and good coffee you have to try the propagate social house!
I dropped by here after visiting a state park in the area because it was dog friendly.
The Bourbon latte was amazing and the bacon, egg and cheese was perfect.
It's all fairly customizable as well with non dairy options.
They have a really cute patio area to eat with your dog which was great because I always feel bad when I being my dog inside places.
The pup cups are adorable and it came out a slice of bacon ! - which got no complaints for the pup at all!
The staff was cheerful and friendly even showing me a few things around the area to do for fun.

The only "critique" I would give this place is that it hard to identify off of the street so more signage would be amazing, but overall I would recommend going out of your way to try Propagate Social House! 🙂
I haven't tried their food but I didn't like thei drinks! Went here after a Pilates session but unfortunately, the drinks are not that great. I would love to see improvements in case we come back.

Cute little location. Staff doesn’t clean the tables and if you want to eat, you have to get there 1 hour before they close because we got there at 3 pm, picked a menu in front of the cashier, when to grab a seat and decide what we wanted and by the time we got to the cashier at 3:25 pm, I was not even greeted with a hello! How can I assist? Nothing. No smile. Just a stare. So I said okay… I’ll have croque monsieur and she said, “I already cleaned the hot foods. So I’m done cooking for today. Lol okay. “ I also paid extra for 16 oz. Friends, here is my 16 oz. At least I can smell the peanut butter.

Everything was so amazing! The atmosphere is so aesthetic and comfortable, you feel very peaceful. The mimosas are very tasty, we also had the matcha and it was awesome! We came for the monday night barbecue and it was all so tasty and flavorful. Definitely a go to for a nice date night! Also the staff is so helpful and kind! 10s all across the board!

Super cute little coffee shop! Has lots of charm and a nice spacious outdoor area that I will love to come back to in the evening, they have live music too!
You scan a QR that takes you to the menu and you can place your order through there as well and they bring it out to you. I got a bacon egg and cheese croissant sandwich that was VERY good and not one but two coffees because I just had to try them. My first was the creme brulee coffee and the 2nd was the Tahini biscoff..I'm not sure which one I loved more because they were both very good. I would love to come back again and explore the menu some more. The espresso spritzer my friend got was super unique I had never tasted anything like that before. All the drinks were good. Service was fast. And the price was reasonable.

Great food, wonderful atmosphere, and genuinely friendly people. We tried the Pork Dinuguan and Pork Sinigang, and both were excellent. The Pork Sinigang was slow-cooked, incredibly tender, and literally fell off the bone. The Pork Dinuguan had a very unique and bold flavor—possibly from ginger or galangal—which made it stand out.

The fried fish served with rice was also delicious and perfectly cooked. Overall, the food truly represents authentic Filipino flavors. The Pork Dinuguan, in particular, was exceptionally flavorful and distinctive; it quickly became our favorite dish and was enjoyed by everyone at the table.
Brought my family from out of town here and they absolutely loved it! Everything was delicious and the service was great! Definitely a hole in the wall with authentic Filipino food
Once we came in the staff was very inviting and nice. They also gave us suggestions on what to eat and how big or small everything was. The dinuguan was AMAZING! Probably my favorite dish.
The food was amazing, the restaurant itself is there family oriented and has a warm feeling to it. From the service to the food- you should definitely try it.

if this isn’t a blast from the past.

everything tasted like childhood.

what an experience.

the service was hospitable & the food was heart warming.

forgot to picture my favorite. the dinaguan.

but i had a lot of everything else.

highly recommended if you’ve never had filipino food.

i will definitely be back & take my friends with me!

kindly,
GTB

I had the crawfish boil. There was supposed to be 1 pound crawfish, and there was every bit of a pound and more. The were two good size pieces of corn on the cob, a lot of med/large shrimp, 4/5 potatoes, and sausage. The spice was not like any other I’ve had. It was full of flavor, and very tasty. Our server Nova, is the best. The made sure that our drinks were topped off, and that we had what we needed to enjoy our meal. She is friendly, very interesting, and an excellent server. This restaurant is worth finding, and when you do, you’ll return.

Nova took care of us; she had such a bubbly personality and was so nice. I didn’t get the man's name, but thank you as well. We had the Cajun Snow Crab Combo, and I was able to accommodate myself as well. I know I’m missing out on the butter, but the food was still great. Best seafood boil I ever had and definitely worth the drive. The drinks are fire, definitely have to try more when we come back.

The seafood here is absolutely incredible! The snow crab is packed with sweet, juicy meat, and the blue crab is unbelievably fresh and huge—one of the best I’ve ever had. Every bite is bursting with flavor! The spicy juicy sauce is a game-changer, perfectly balancing heat and richness. It takes the seafood to another level! Plus, the prices are very reasonable for the quality you get. If you love seafood, this place is a must-try! Stop reading and come here now—you won’t regret it!

My first time coming and now my new go to spot.  I received Awesome customer service from Amy. Our Food was hot fresh and soooo good. Me and my family Highly recommend if you’re looking for seafood or fried shrimp and fish. you won’t be disappointed.

Amy was special; full of kindness, contagiously joyful, smiles galore!!!

First time in the restaurant and my wife and I already have a nickname.  We're just going to call it...

"The Spot"

Cajun Boil was the 💣 my ma would have loved the Blue 🦀  not shy on the seasoning and a heavy pour from the bar.

name: The Madras Cafe
vicinity: 7730 W Sand Lake Rd, Sand Lake

reviews.text:
Was excited about thali
Which is why we came
No thali
So
We order Dahi puri it was ok no green chutney just tamarind
The butter dosa we order was dry and almost empty of filling
No tomato chutney just watery sambar and tasteless coconut chutney?
We also had rasam no spice but it was hot and tangy
My husband had beer
Food came out to fifty dollars a little high
We left full
I was slightly dissatisfied not desi flavor or fresh
But filling
My husband (he is American) didn’t know the difference and thought it was great
Chole batura for $20
Wow
Very expensive
Thumbs up $8
I don’t recall a chai but if I did it might have been $8 as much as a starter almost
Would I go back no
For me no

Absolutely delicious! We ordered five menu items to split, all as vegan and 10/10 would get each one again 🤩
Our server was Anthony, he was friendly, service was quick, and our water was always filled.
We will definitely come back!

Ordered Mysore Masala Dosa and Chilli Garlic Noodles. The dosa tasted good but wasn’t hot enough, same with the noodles.
I understand the restaurant was short-staffed and dine-in was closed early. However, it’s better to say no upfront than serve food with long wait times or compromised quality.
We also ordered two Kathi rolls to go. Waited 30–40 minutes, which was fine since they informed us. But the rolls were very disappointing — extremely small portions, $16 each is not justified, and they were not properly stuffed.
Overall, poor value for money. Quality and portion size need improvement.

The restaurant’s name suggests an authentic South Indian experience, but the reality was a major disappointment. While the dosa texture was good and the North Indian dishes (chapathi and paneer) were decent, the South Indian staples were a total letdown. The sambar and rasam lacked any depth of flavor and tasted like they were made from instant "ready-to-eat" mixes.
To make matters worse, the pricing is exorbitant. Since they don't offer thalis on holidays, we ordered rice, sambar, rasam, and yogurt individually—only to be charged $8 per item. Paying that much for "miserable" tasting food feels like a total rip-off. We ended up paying over $200 for a family of 4 adults and three children. To top it off, an 18% gratuity was automatically added; given the poor food quality, I truly hope that money actually went to the hard-working waiters rather than the management. It seems the kitchen understands North Indian cooking but is totally lost when it comes to South Indian cuisine.

Paid ~$45 for filter coffee, Gobi Manchuria, and an onion dosa, and honestly, it felt overpriced.

Filter coffee at $8 didn’t feel special enough to justify the price.
Gobi Manchuria was okay but served in a plastic bowl—if this place considers itself fine dining, the presentation should match the pricing.
Onion dosa was average; the sambar was very thin (almost rasam) and the chutney was cold.

I will stick with old friend, woodlands

Genuine question guys,: Is it just me, or does this place feel way too expensive for what you get? Almost like a rip-off?

name: Zaman Hookah cafe and Lounge(by Lake Sandy)

reviews.text:
This was my third time visiting Zaman Hookah Cafe, and once again, it didn’t disappoint! Casper, the manager, is truly amazing—friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable with 15 years of experience. He made us feel welcome, remembered us from before, and ensured we had a calm, relaxing visit.

The hookah was incredibly smooth, especially with the ice tip. We tried Blue Lit and Lime Pistachio—both were fantastic, but that Lime Pistachio really stood out. We came in around 6:30 and enjoyed a two-hour session. Everything from the ambiance to the service was top-notch. Can’t wait to come back again!
Cozy place, the host is extremely kind and helpful. He knows how to assemble and deliver the perfect hookah for use. I highly recommend it.

A warm and friendly welcome from Casper! He made us feel right at home and prepared us a special tailored mix to try with no obligation. It was perfect... Very smooth and we loved the flavour. Thanks so much

Hookah is great, customer service also if the best 😁! Love the guy named kacper. He’s so polite, sweet and friendly. Love talking to him and seeing him any time I come stop by. Literally loving this place!!! 😛❤️

Please note that I am reviewing about Zaman Cuisine that is beside Sushi shop and the branch of this Zaman Hookah. So Im gna post there inner pics too.
Zaman Cusine was very good with true Arabic Egyptian Hummus taste with Arabic Bread and Shawarma served as platter but delicious.  I liked the atmosphere as well as the serving style and food itself. I also loved the refreshing Mint lemonade 😍

Authentic Japanese restaurant (authentic doesn’t mean the best taste), prices are reasonable, portions are on the smaller side, but everything is consistent. I feel like this is a random restaurant that you’d stop by in an alleyway in Tokyo suburb.

Most authentic japanese restaurants taste bland, if you want something that tastes strong with lots of sauces, mayonnaise, teriyaki sauce you’ll be very disappointed. Imo the Koreans and Chinese make the best tasting Japanese food in America. When we ate here there were at least 10 other guests speaking Japanese eating here

End up having diarrhea 2x about 1hr after…. Changed review from a 5 to a 3…

Absolutely excellent Japanese restaurant!  we ordered a bowl of Tonkotsu and Shoyu Ramen, with a side of Gyoza and karaage chicken. My wife fell in love with the Karaage chicken here and said we might have to stop by several more times on our trip. The Ramen was authentic and excellent, would highly recommend this place. We have been to many Japanese restaurants over the years, searching for something that reminds us of our trips to Japan and this place nailed it.
Oh my gosh. I got the Salmon Scallop Ikura Don bowl. It was super fresh and tasty. Will definitely come back again.

This is a very quaint, authentic Japanese restaurant, with some excellent flavors that rival the best around.  We had the takoyaki, yakisoba, and gyūdon, all of which were fantastic! The takoyaki might seriously be some of the best I've had in Orlando, which is definitely saying something.  The prices are comparable to most other Japanese restaurants, and I believe some items are even a little cheaper.  Well worth the trip, especially if you're in the I-Drive/SeaWorld area!

I am picky about Japanese food, especially sushi and sashimi, and after the second visit, I decided this is the only place I would choose go in Orlando (or maybe the entire state) for Japanese food fix.

The fish is fresh, and the rice is done just right.  Even Udon noodle is done just right, simple with lots of umami with the real Western (=Kansai) clear-broth style.
You probably can get good sushi at Michelin-rated restaurants if you fork out $100+, but for the majority of the humanity, if you really want to taste what Japanese people eat, this is THE place.  In Japanese they say 財布の味方; “an ally for your wallet.”

The staff is friendly.  The cashier told us that the ones who prepare the food are all Japanese, which says something about the authenticity of the food.

This place is more like food-court style.  You order and pay for the food, find your seat, wait for the food to come out, and throw out your own trash and return the dishes.

This is a matter of preference, but for the kaisen don (fish bowl), by default the fish will come dipped in soy sauce and sesame oil.  Some might prefer to have nothing on it, and just use the soy sauce and the wasabi that will come on the side.  Check with the cashier.

The ambience: comfy and clean, nothing extravagant.

Update: I see that they added an ordering kiosk.  I put on “notes” that we wanted the soy sauce on the side.

Update as of July 2025: price on seafood has gone up, but the taste and the quality of the food is the same.  Actually, I like the hardness of the rice better than before.

Barkhaven is an absolutely wonderful place. My pitty mix, Callie, thinks she’s a little dog like her 18 year old brother, but she’s very timid around dogs outside our social circle, especially dogs her size or larger. Barkhaven helped me recognize this and has been an incredible support in helping her work through it. It’s a great place to meet dog friendly people, properly socialize, and learn more about your own pup and others. As a frequent traveler to Orlando who truly cares about his fur babies, the small monthly membership is more than worth it. There are plenty of fun events throughout the month, the staff is amazing from the front desk, groomers, pack leaders, bar staff (especially Ms. Anna), and the other dog owners and pups are fantastic. Callie even enjoyed a groom during our visit last month. Highly recommend Barkhaven to any dog parent.

First time at Bark Haven- I’m moved from Des Moines where I’m used to Paws n Pints (look it up) so this was… quite a step down. Well maintained however a small dog park. I’m sure someone else owns the land behind Bark Haven otherwise that would be such an awesome extension for large dogs to have free opening running space!

-Lack of balls / toys
- a good suggestion would be a harness / leash hooks in the lobby or outside, glad I brought my big bag otherwise I would have had to carry them the whole time🦮
-Can’t tell if they have staff on the actual dog property, no one was wearing a black uniform besides the servers.  It’d be nice if they do have employees for the park if they wore vests, name tags or something.
-I ordered the buffalo chicken wings and they were SO good, loved the jalapeño ranch. Crispy and good sauce.
-they were playing house music which was fun
-however I ordered a water when I ordered my wings, wings came out, server walked by- still no water, asked again, still no water, by then I was getting quite thirsty so I had to go ask the bartender for a water, I finished my meal- never came back with a water nor asked if everything was tasting okay. I’m also a server so I get it but it’s not like they were crazy busy. Can’t help but imagine lack of good service is due to the automatic 20% gratuity for every check. 😬

Will we be back? Maybe in the summer when they have small pools for the dogs to splash in.

If you have a dog or dogs, this is definitely the place to go.  Play yard is clean.  Pools and water bowls are cleaned and refilled as needed.  The food is great and drinks are always perfect.  A special shout out to Lilly, she is truly a dog whisperer.  My 6 month old pups love her and i always know they are treated like family when she's attending the play yard.

Was told by some people to come here and totally went above all my expectations! My dog gets to run around while I’m in the park with him and get to enjoy some drinks!! You can even sit outside right outside the park so you can enjoy some food while still getting to keep an eye on your dog. Overall great experience everyone is so friendly, the staff in the park and the servers. Kiley has been an amazing server totally attentive, so sweet and hope to see her again soon!

I wanted to like this place more. I went on a Sunday & ordered a day pass $15!
filled out the paperwork which I recommend doing at home.
We got a table outside near the play area.

The menu online is not the same menu you get at the table kiosk we had two different people trying to take care of us, but none of them were very attentive. We ordered adult beverages. Wich were club pricing at $12/$17 a piece!. I got the Frenchy drink which was OK. We asked the server if there was a pepperoni pizza was told no.
so my son ordered a cheese pizza which he got food poisoning from!!
When we checked the online menu they’re actually was pepperoni pizza. He wanted a Sprite, but when the Sprite was delivered, it was flat. We told the waiter & they brought him a can of Sprite. When he wanted a refill, they charged me for each can when it was their fault the fountain drinks were not working properly!!
I ordered a cheeseburger at $16. It was nothing extraordinary but very overpriced and did not come with anything for sides.
We ordered french fries to snack on and they were half hard and undercooked with no seasoning.
The potato wedges were better but had a weird sauce on them

My dog enjoyed playing in the play area. However there were very rambunctious dogs that were starting 2 fight. It seems some people just let their dogs lose without properly watching them. There was plenty of water tubs and sprinklers going, but it’s a very small area full of fake grass.

So, I paid $15 to get in over $100 in crappy food that my son got food poisoning from but I forgot to mention the parking isn’t that great either.

Overall, it’s not worth the money. There are better dog parks out there. I don’t see the point in paying for a membership to eat overpriced food.

Once private and now public. London House is a fine dining treat! Serving a course layout and wine list to suit any pallet. We Very Much enjoyed our food and cocktail. But the service was really just spectacular💯 sharp professional and friendly. Lastly the atmosphere and decor is cool. I think some aspects could seem dated. Personally I think everything matched comfortably.  Will definitely return.

First visit. Drinks were declicious. They make a wonderful old fashioned presented beautifully. We had a 7:15 reservation and had drinks in the lounge first while we waited for the rest of our party. Once we sat down the service was very slow. It took so long for us to get our drinks.  Which I found crazy since it wasn’t overly busy. We had the charcuterie cheese board and it was delicious. It had a great assortment. While We didn’t get our food until 10pm, it was very good. We waited a really long time for food and drinks. That is my only complaint. Service was very slow to refill waters and drinks. But The food was fantastic. Very flavorful. Food 10/10, drinks 10/10. Service was decent. Server mixed  up our check and charged us for another persons  bill but she apologized and fixed it. The music, ambiance and decor was beautiful.

The London House nightlife offers a sophisticated and intimate atmosphere, exuding class in its ambiance. The overall vibe is lively and fun, complemented by good music and a dancing crowd that adds to the energetic atmosphere. The crowd is stylish and exudes a sexy charm.

However, the bar service, unfortunately, tends to be on the slower side, which may test your patience during peak hours. The indoor environment can also feel a bit stuffy at times. Fortunately, the venue has an outdoor patio where you can escape the congestion and enjoy a breath of fresh air. Despite these minor drawbacks, the London House remains a compelling choice for those seeking a refined and vibrant night out.

Moreover, the London House distinguishes itself with an exceptional dining experience that stands out among its other offerings. The culinary offerings are noteworthy, showcasing a commitment to quality and taste. The menu presents a diverse array of delectable dishes, further enhancing the overall appeal of the venue. Whether you're here for the vibrant nightlife or a delightful dining experience, the London House manages to excel, making it a versatile destination for those seeking both quality cuisine and a lively atmosphere.

This was by far a premier culinary and social experience. The best date night we've had in Orlando. The food is delightful, with expectacular  ambience, and attentive staff.  The most elegant place for fine dining in Florida.

So underwhelmed by the whole experience. Nice atmosphere, but there was really nobody there and it was pretentious and the drinks were way overpriced. If the scene was great, then I would be OK paying so much for the drinks. But the scene was really overall underwhelming and desperate. Super expensive. And by the way, I’m not cheap. $75-$100 for three drinks

I have had one delivery order (door dash gift card) and have also tried the lunch buffet.

The delivery food was pretty damn good. We ordered chicken Tikka Masala with basmati rice, garlic naan, lentil soup, paladins, 4 different chutneys, and vegetable samosas. Lots of food, enjoyed over a couple of days.

We decided to check out their lunch buffet. We strolled in on a Friday (October 17th) around noon. It was not crowded and we were immediately seated.

Lots of options to choose from. I was a big fan of the lentil soup that we had ordered previously, but barely had any since I wanted to try the lineup. It was $15.99 per person at time of writing.

Dining area was nice, well lit, and very clean. Staff were attentive, offering refills and taking away used plates.

More people came in after us, with a lot of working dudes grabbing to-go containers. A lot of the guys knew the staff, and it seemed like most of the other patrons were regulars.

If you're in south Orlando and want some Indian food that won't break the bank, check them out.

COME HUNGRY!!! Food is amazing 🤩 portions are very generous and everything tastes extremely fresh! Been eating from this place for over a decade and just now I come and eat inside the restaurant.
Loved their service. They could lower their ac a bit and have some music. Besides that. Everything was on point.
I had shrimp biryani, chicken samosas, and mango lassi — absolutely delicious! All the staff were very nice and the restaurant had a cozy atmosphere.

My son loves Indian Food and for our mommy date we came to Ahmad’s, and of all the places we have gone in Orlando,Daytona Beach , Kissimmee , and Jacksonville; Ahmad’s is still the best and has been the best for us now the past few years. Best bang for your buck whether you order ala carte or buffet. Buffet is daily and delicious. The service is great ! Very attentive! The people are nice ! The buffet is clean ! Plenty of options for people that are vegetarian, chicken, or meat eaters. My son is a very very very picky eater, however the chicken tikka masala is his number 1 every time. If there are any complaints, which I have no complaints about the restaurant; is that you have to wait for food to be put back into the buffet, especially the naan, because for some reason every idiot that doesn’t think about world hunger fills plates on plates on platesssss of food and takes 283637 pieces of naan at a time only to be left on the table and thrown away because of some fear that the naan will have legs and run away or the chicken comes back to life and flies away. Im being so serious regarding the wasting of food. It’s ridiculous to watch people fill plates just to be thrown away. I’m honestly surprised this place doesn’t charge a “wasted food & bread” fee like some of the other buffets around Orlando do because once food comes out everyone swarms like ants and it’s gone in less than 30 seconds. The bathrooms are clean every time we go. I’m an avid soap checker when I go to restaurants and theirs is always full. They also have wash hoses for the ungodly parts which if you’re Muslim you appreciate this just as much as I do. In addition, they also have a prayer area and it’s open to everyone equally. Currently they are a running a lunch special buy 1 get  one  free on the lassi and I gotta say apart from their naan and samosas; which is always amazing and soft with crisp pockets for their naan and all the different samosas they offer are finger licking amazing . You automatically know after the first bite that it’s not frozen and processed ; the second best is the lassi  as it is always made fresh, served cold, and absolutely refreshing. They do have a points program so you can always earn rewards as a thank you for your regular patronage and I appreciate that being on a single mom budget. The gentleman who checked us out did originally make a mistake and charge my son as an adult, which I understand I have a really tall not so little boy, but as soon as I told the gentleman my son’s age he gladly corrected it without any attitude and if you know some of these other Halal establishments around Kissimmee/ Orlando they will argue you to a stomach ache. I’m not saying everyone is honest so I can understand why some places give you a hard time, I’m saying I appreciated his kindness towards me and understanding that I was being honest. Kindness goes a long way in my book. It is always a pleasant experience dining here and it doesn’t matter if it’s the buffet or the dinner it’s always hot, fresh, and tastes homemade.  I recommend this place hands down to any and everyone! If your kids want chicken nuggets and not Indian food they got that too so it’s a MOM WIN just in case. 5 stars and 5 chef’s kisses, so I give Ahmed’s Restaurant a 10.

Today i was craving a Good home cook meal and i was also having a taste for Indian Food . Im glade i came here today . The food was so warming exactly that good home food i was looking for . i also try the Samosa chaat , That is a must try and mango lassie 😋
and the butter chicken felt  taste like my Punjabi mother  was in the kitchen cooking . and the staff were very helpful and Kind
Place was clean, my order arrived quickly. The hamburger was quite tasty 8/10. I also really liked the chili cheese fries 8/10. Onion rings could have been better 7/10.

Steak ’n Shake has always been one of our go-to spots for a sweet treat, and today’s visit reminded us why. We tried the Nutella shake, which was rich, creamy, and absolutely amazing. The KitKat shake was also really good, with that satisfying crunch blended into the smooth ice cream, and the Orange Creamsicle shake was refreshingly sweet with the perfect balance of citrus and cream.

Their milkshakes have always been some of the best, and while we usually grab them through the drive-thru in standard styrofoam cups, today we decided to sit inside. The kids loved seeing the shakes served in their signature tall glasses with whipped cream and toppings—it made the whole experience feel extra special.

We did miss the Biscoff milkshake, which we tried at a different location and instantly fell in love with. Sadly, this location was out of it today. Still, with flavors like these, it’s always a treat we look forward to enjoying again and again.

So I tried Steak & Shake for the first time tonight and boy oh boy! We ordered our food and drinks through the kiosk which was super convenient. As we proceeded to get our drinks, we noticed none of the fountain drinks were working. There was a note on top saying that the only drinks available were Sprite, Hi-C, sweet & unsweetened tea, lemonade & Dasani water bottles - LIES, bc nothing came out of those! As I poured myself some sweet tea, it was pretty much done, literally drops. I asked the employee if they’d be refilling and she says yes. We finally got our food & the fries were cold! I took a bite out of the burger and that was also cold but I was starving, so I took a few more bites. Finally the tea was done & I poured myself a little bit…. Worst tea ever, super bitter & grainy! No care in the world to make sure the rest of the  drinks were ready. The whole vibe was off and the food was horrible. If I can rate from 1-10, I’d for sure give them a -10! I wouldn’t go there again even if they paid me 👎🏼

Placed online order and we were told would it would be ready in 5-10 minutes. We were there in 10 mins and the food was ready. 45 minutes later still waiting on the shakes. We have been told several times they are coming out in just a minute but have yet to see them. The shining star was the cook that replaced our fries because we waited so long. He is amazing!

I got to steak n shake expecting to wait a bit for food, but it came out so fast. I loved the customer service of repeating my order back, giving me my total and soon as I get to the window somebody was there to greet me and take my credit card. Soon as the receipt was handed back to me food was done along with my shake! The best part is I open the bag and see my burger looks just like you would see in a commercial and then the food hot and tasty! This is my own review I felt like leaving because I was impressed.

Service was spectacular they were very nice and respectful, I had the curry chicken plate and it was good but a lil on the spicy side and the drinks were ok not really my cup of tea but besides that the prices were good next time I will try the wings or the jerk fries
Big up Chef! I read all the  great reviews on the NextDoor app and after trying the jerk chicken/ ox tail plate, I see what all the rave was about. Great food! Great vibes! Great Chef!

This food made with real passion. They aren't just cooking, they are sharing the culture. The flavors are on point, the energy is welcoming, and everyone clearly cares about what they’re putting out. This is the kind of spot you want to support and come back to!
Amazing service and the food was like a part of my childhood. We can't wait to go back again!
First the customer service is awesome. The food is next level and look forward to to my next meal

I first tried Juici Patties while I was in Jamaica and it was so good. Hot, Fresh flaky crust filled with meat just how a patty should be. So when I heard there was a Juici Patties in West Orlando I was excited and had to stop by.

I ordered the curry chicken, mild beef, and beef and cheese patties. They were good and still hit the spot but my only complaint is that they need more meat filling especially compared to other local Jamaican restaurants’ patties. The restaurant was clean the service was good and they have a small bar seating area. They also have a lot of patty options but they should add a veggie patty to the menu.

Prices were reasonable and it’s a great place to grab a quick snack. Overall still good just not as generous as other places.

I think I will take the way longer drive to the original UCF location as just picked up dozen patties only to see some were OLD and not fresh. As you can see the difference. It wasnt busy yet no one answered the phone and their automated voice rep telling me to order online when it's disabled 🤦🏾‍♂️🤦🏾‍♂️. *Unfortunately we are on our way out of town. Please advise

So based off of my experience it was good but it still needed a little more flavor service was excellent the food came out hot
Thank you for your services
Very convenient, great parking and superb customer service

So glad I tried this place! The patties were fresh, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. You can tell there’s pride in the food here. Great service and even better taste. I’ll definitely be recommending this spot to everyone I know.
💯 100% authentic, great quality, will definitely be back

I've been praying for a Jamaican spot to open up near me and God delivered. I ordered the jerk chicken with the fyah spice level and rice & peas with fried plantain and kola champagne to drink. I've had jerk chicken from several Jamaican restaurants and in my 31 years of life, this was easily the best I've ever had. The jerk bbq sauce is amazing and has the littlest bit of sweetness to it while still real spicy. The rice & peas is also unlike any other rice & peas I've ever had and very delicious. Very friendly staff as well. This is definitely my go-to Jamaican spot from now on.

Terrific food, chicken perfectly smoked with Pimento chips. The owner goes out of his way to use this wood for authenticity, and has even planted his own trees to harvest. He also grows his own peppers, including the scotch bonnets, which is in the Fyah sauce (delicious, and just the right heat). I will be back.

I got the full jerk chicken meal with rice, but they also have a small jerk chicken if you aren’t too hungry that doesn’t include the sides.
This place is amazing it’s hidden inside auto sport in Orlando on orange blossom trail you have to come check it out
Good food great service and good vibes
One of the best in the 0
Good

Great spot, Quite and relaxing yet full filled atmosphere, Service is excellent, food is amazing 🤩 very tasty, everything spice and nice. I felt like I was at home, that mama love. The local drinks are great, passion fruit and the strawberry drinks nice, very chilled. It’s a vibe at Island Vybz. I’ll definitely recommend this restaurant. I did enjoyed everything. 💕❤️

I was so excited to come here today. I have been waiting for some time to meet the beautiful Ms. Yvonne in person and try her food after communicating with this incredible person over a social audio platform for close to 2 years. To see this amazing woman make her dream come to reality with all the hard work she has put in is truly inspiring.

I can say the food was worth the flight from New York. The restaurant is a comfortable gathering spot for meeting up with friends. The service was outstanding, professional, and attentive to all our needs. All of the staff greeted us with a smile.

While there, my friends and I ordered a variety of the menu from the tacos, chicken wings, and shrimp and crab dip for starters to ox tails, chicken, and ribs for our meals. Everything was delicious and fall off the bones. The food definitely was representative of the island culture. The portions were large and the prices were reasonable.

I can’t wait to be visiting the Orlando area again soon as I will definitely be back to try more food from the menu.

Thank you to Yvonne and all of her staff for a wonderful time at this beautiful restaurant. #leadershipondemand

Beautiful restaurant, friendly staff, Hot and delicious Carribean food 😋 Sebastian and the kind lady with short hair were so sweet when my family and I dine-in on two different occasions. We had to run it back! The jerk guava BBQ chicken with the 2 sides and plaintain garnish was the perfect meal for my brother after working a hard shift and my mom and I ate and had leftovers. Very clean restaurant, wish to see this place packed with customers! The atmosphere is great with the afrobeat Christian music playing. 🎶

My family and I went to get some nice Jamaican food. The chef cooked us up some Ribs that fell off the bone, Pineapple BBQ Salmon with rice, and another one with fries. We enjoyed the food and the service.

No atmosphere but Toni at the counter was awesome, she should go work at an actual restaurant.  Fusion seems to be when you don’t have all the normal ingredients so you use random stuff like yellow shredded cheese to top Alfredo but with penne pasta.  Wish them the best but won’t be back.  Their stew chicken had no stew also, fyi.

We came here after a day a Universal Studios (which closed at 5pm for HHN). We didn’t want to compete with the crowds that were at City Walk and I wanted to get some good food that was close by and reflective of the local cuisine.  So, I looked for a place that people I’m the area would frequent and also give good reviews, and this was the place!  We tried almost every dish on the menu with our party of 7 and we weren’t dissapointed. We devoured it all. A few quotes from our very satisfied members of our group were “This was one of their best meals, ever”, “10 out of 10”. “That was so good”. I rarely, if ever, leave reviews, but this place deserved one . It seemed to be a family run business with customers coming in to pick up a few dishes for dinner for themselves and others on they came in talking to on the phone. I loved seeing them greet a few others who also came in (it was a weeknight) with a hug and smile asking how so-and-so is doing and to tell ‘em I say hi. Needless to say this is not a fancy smancy establishment, it’s home style flair and place to sit comfortably and enjoy good food, and it’s just what we were looking for.  Great food, great people, great prices. Everything cooked perfectly and they triple checked our order to make sure it was right. They even brought us a complementary speciality drink, a yummy strawberry watermelon drink, which they make in house!  I cant say enough about this place and our experience. It wasn’t until after our meal that we realized that Walmart and Target was a few blocks away, so conveniently stopped to get some things for the next day at another Universal park.

I literally would not go anywhere else. You can't make me say otherwise.

The vibes ✨️ the FOOD 🔥I would probably fight for these people. They are so nice. You should definitely have a try
What an amazing experience!! From food to hospitality they succeeded all the way around!

Mobile Food Kitchen Customer, great service, generous proportion, and I can attest that the Oxtail is delicious...  Love the converted school bus, the generator needs a little more quieting down.  Appears that they specialize in chicken, by peer had the chicken and was very happy.  Ask them to service your onsite lunch needs.

I had the jerk chicken plate, with rice and Mac n' cheese, from their food truck/bus. It was delicious! Spicy, but not so much that it was uncomfortable. My favorite part was the delicious, we'll seasoned, rice.

Finally a taste of Jamaica in Orlando. This is the best Jamaican restaurant in Orlando and this was my first time there but most definitely not the last.The atmosphere was welcoming, everyone that I interacted with made me feel welcomed. The food reminded me of being in Jamaica I had to ask for the chef to commend about the delicious food and also the presentation.I had curry goat with rice and peas along with vegetables and chicken soup.Trust me you won't be disappointed 💯 I know I was, absolutely best authentic Jamaican food in Orlando and I've tried a couple in Orlando and none compare to Love Birds Jerk Spot.Oh they have a natural mango juice absolutely must try.

THE BEST FISH IN THE WORLD! I literally come here, at the least, once a week. Please try the fish… even if you don’t eat fish- you will now. very authentic Jamaican recipes top tier. This chef is easily one of the best in the world & no this isn’t paid promo. (Try it fried or steamed, either way 10/10)

Out of all the Jamaican restaurants I've been to, this one has the best rice in Orlando! Don't make you feel heavy, not starchy, cooked to perfection! I've been coming here ever since I discovered this place 2 years ago!  If you don't like your rice making you feel like you gained 10 Ibs after eating, come here, you won't be disappointed! Great service, family oriented and owned, great reggae music, all around, great atmosphere! Based in Orlando Florida, off Silverstar Road! Come visit!
I haven't had breadfruit and over 7 years. The rice and peas were simply delicious. Everything was good the jerk chicken and the Curry goat this is now my official go-to spot

Food was delicious. Ordered jerk chicken curry chicken and a steamed fish all with rice and beans and vegetables. Everything was very enjoyable! The owner provided great service and a very enjoyable atmosphere! If you want amazing Jamaican food this is the place to go!

After reading reviews I was excited to order takeout from here. Only to receive scraps filled with gravy and carrots. I mean it should have been called oxtail gravy and rice because there was hardly ANY oxtails. Especially, for this to be a large. My dinner ruined. I would have sent this back if I was sitting in the restaurant. I really want a refund. The person who fixed this plate should be ashamed of themselves. I’m disappointed and disgusted that this was even served

Great food!! Very authentic and flavorful.
We even tried Peanut Punch! It’s a smoothy and creamy smoothie in a juice box.

So impressed with the food , service and prices ! I ordered the Goat soup omg , it was amazing !! Please look at my pictures . The brown stew fish was superb !! I will be a loyal customer! So happy I stopped and saw your Goat sign in front of your door !! 10 out of 10 💕💕

Wish this was all a joke because I just wasted my money on a spoiled patty, almost cold food, missing dumplings..
This is criminal to Caribbean Cuisine and service.. Why was there other meats mixed in with my Curry Goat?

Do better man.

The food here is amazing, a lot of flavor no matter what you get it’s always good.. the place is very clean at all times.. it’s the first Jamaican restaurant bathroom I ever use and it’s clean and smell great… I would recommend anyone here..
Very great fresh oxtails i will be back i cleaned the whole plate and wanted more.

We got the jerk chicken, oxtail, and curry chicken with roti it was all amazing! It was better than a lot of the stuff we get in NY. The owner mentioned being around for 31 years and my family and I definitely see why. Service was great too, the owner was exceptionally kind to everyone who came through the door. 10/10 would recommend!

9.24.23 - when I entered the atmosphere the staff wasn't very welcoming nor pleasant.... UNTIL I let them know that I was a first-timer! Then, they seemed a little interested in my order.  I was speaking to the young lady behind the counter first. Because she only stared at me with no responses I went to the older lady. My overall take is below...

Food - the only thing worth raving about was the Roti SKIN; not the curry chicken roti which was dry.... just the ONE plain skin I ordered. Rice was overcooked. The only veg available was mixed veggies.
