Groceries - if you're big on shelf life, check the dates (see pic). I saw some perfect West Indian food staples. Some overpriced; Yet a nice assortment!

Other notes: takeout only, no fish on Sundays (maybe just saltfish breakfast)

I don't regret spending $75+ here that day as I love the back story shared by the lady. Apparently, the biz was started by her father about 30y back and her Mother still makes the dessert! I'm proud of their longevity as a small, family-owned biz; not sure that I need to return though.

NO WHERE TO SIT AND WAIT ON YOUR FOOD AT THIS RESTAURANT.
First let me start by saying that have some delicious food, and my husband likes eating there. HOWEVER, they don’t do have a place for anyone to sit when order and waiting on your food to be prepared.  My husband has some health issues and can’t stand for a long period of time.  So I took down one of the chairs they had to the side for him to sit wait for his food.

When this woman came run out the kitchen saying we are not doing dine in anymore only take out. I said yes, we know, he is sitting in the chair waiting for his food because he can’t stand for too long.  So the lady said , “he is not suppose to be even sitting down in the chair because we don’t want anyone to say they got monkeypox or covid from our restaurant. “  I just looked at her like 🤨🧐, seriously?  I asked if you can get his food ready we can leave. So she looked 👀 at our ticket and went back to the kitchen to get my husband food.  So if you are handicap, elderly, or have health issues you might not want to eat here because they can’t accommodate while you wait on your food to be prepare.  They don’t even have a call to order system in place.

The food is ok the portions are small even when you get a large. I got a large jerk chicken dinner. I was given 1 quarter leg cut up for 15.00 not again. If you go around lunchtime be prepared to wait at least 30 minutes.

name: CALYPSO FLAVORS OF THE CARIBBEAN
vicinity: 2611 N Pine Hills Rd, Pine Hills

name: Island Jam Caribbean
vicinity: 2615 N Pine Hills Rd, Pine Hills

reviews.text:
I am visiting from California and haven't had Oxtails in a long time.  I ordered the Oxtail Plate, Akra side dish, & Macaroni and Cheese side dish.  Maybe it is a lack of knowledge on food portions, there was a HUGE Portion of Rice (it was supposed to be Rice and Beans but one could only see the Rice with very FEW Beans...Beans are not very expensive so I couldn't understand the lack of Beans in the Rice).  The Salad Portion was very small with one tomato, a slice of red onions, with a couple pieces of Lettuce.  The Oxtails were DROWNING in OIL, Oxtails already have fat on them so there is no need to add more OIL to cook the Oxtail or make the Sauce.  The Macaroni and Cheese was OILY and had no taste.  The Akra was ok.
Knowledge on Spices, Calories, and Food Portions is essential to obtain when running a Restaurant.
Da pink potato salad is great… real Haitian food

Amazing food, amazing service!!!! 10/10 food. I ordered through UberEats. Originally the restaurant forgot my legume, but they quickly fixed the issue and delivered it straight to my home. The owners are sweet and kind
I got the oxtails. The food was delicious & it was worth the money. I will definitely eat here again.
Food is great, I ordered on ubereats and the portions are good for the price and the plantains were the best fried plantains I’ve had in a while. Definitely will order again.

12.23.25 - 3p - this was my first visit inside. The previous morning we had breakfast dashed to us. If you want authentic Jamaican flavors, this is the real deal! I love that everything we wanted was actually available and satisfying. The veggie portion size can increase by a cup. The bread pudding was not a texture I was used to; yet my husband enjoyed it. Their line of juices are like diabetes in a bottle.... TOO darn sweet; that's the old Caribbean style! Let's change up our style to help others live a healthier lifestyle.

I'll eat here again before my visit is over

Drove 45 minutes to try this place and will likely not go back. Prices were $5 more than what is reported online. I went a little before 1pm, and the cashier said there are no lunch specials, only Monday thru Thursday,  but online is different.

My brown stew chicken is dry and tasteless despite extra sauce and my jerk chicken is average at best.  Wasted time and money on this.

Also got a beef patty (2/5 stars)
Correlation was diabetic sweet.

Went to get food after work, live over an hour away bought 3 meals. I was very disappointed when I got home, I ordered a fish dinner granted yes they did open the tray in-front of me, but because everything else was packed on top, I didn’t notice there was no gravy on the meals. After I got home I realized there was no gravy on the rice and of course I order a fish meal. Hence dry rice, dry fish, and yes there was fried dumplings in there so just picture the texture of that tray. While  live too far to return it.

I don’t know I purchase from here every week but it seems to be getting worse each and every time I visit. Last Friday I ordered a fish and chicken meal no gravy when I went home the food dry. When the owner is present everything seems to be great but when the owner is not present they are rude and they don’t present the food the way it’s supposed to be. Just disappointing

I was in the area following an appt and wanted to try some Caribbean food in the area. This place had over 1,000 reviews so I was looking forward to trying it. From the reviews I read, they were mixed but mostly good, so I figured it was still worth a try. The place was clean, service for ordering was prompt, about 5-7 mins from arrival, and the lady who took my order was very pleasant, patient and helpful. There was only one person waiting to order in front of me but various people were around waiting for their order. From the reviews, I saw quite a bit of people recommended the beef patties, curry goat and jerk chicken so I figured I'd try those. The only thing additional I ordered were the drinks and coconut cake. I got the pineapple ginger and passion fruit drinks, the food, and some mild and spicy beef patties. I did like that they had the option for mild and spicy, because I can only tolerate a little spice, enough to flavor the food.

The food was ok. The curry goat was salty and the texture was a tad bit too chewy. Between that or the combination of that and the pineapple ginger drink, it left a weird sensation on my tongue, almost tingly and it felt as if it had this weird coating on my tongue following me eating it and drinking. At some point I had stopped eating not because I was full but it was becoming a chore to try to finish, so I stopped eating. My rice was fine but I just got white rice, plaintains were good, fried dumpling was ok, wasnt fond of the texture, not ftied dry enough, and the cabbage was spoiled so I couldnt eat it. When I first opened the plate I didnt pick up on the scent of the cabbage until I was about to eat it. I still tried a little bit to confirm if thats what I smelled, and for sure it was off. My girls had the curry goat as well but with rice and peas. The rice and peas was ok for them as well but my oldest didnt care for the texture of the curry goat either. She ended up trying the cabbage before I realized it was spoiled, but didnt eat any more because she said it tasted horrible. For the jerk chicken it was beautiful, I'll give them that. I was almost sorry I didnt get that when I saw the beautiful presentation. When we opened the plate though that jerk scent never hit us and we smelled the chicken closely but couldnt pick up on the jerk scent. The chicken was also dry with very minimum spice. We're used to jerk chicken that smells so good the scent hits your nose from the block as your passing whoever is making it, and they would make it dripping with juices and spicy and served with bread. Its usually so spicy that I can only have a little bit but would always try it because its so mouth watering good. Yes, so the jerk chicken was no jerk chicken we are familiar with and the seasoning was like a dry rub seasoning but still not much seasoning to the pallete. My husband asked me if I saw Jamaicans working there, I told him I heard a few of them speaking who were Jamaicans but I dont know about the chefs. None of the food tasted like any of the food were used to in the Caribbean. I'm not from Jamaica but we have a lot of Jamaican restaurants back home, and quite a bit of our foods are intertwined; the curry goat, beef patties, jerk chicken and oxtails to name a few. So, we were hoping for some good Jamaican food to remind us of home but we didnt find it here. I was supposed to try the fried fish, it looks like they have snappers, and we love fried snappers and make a lot of fish and seafood back home in the Caribbean, so I would still go back again to try the fish and oxtail, then I'll be able to say whether or not I'll go back. The beef patties, were ok but doesnt come close to home, it was too crusty.
The drinks werent bad. The ginger in the pineapple ginger drink was potent and the pineapple was sweet, too sweet for my liking. It was made with pineapple nectar I believe, and I'm never a fan of nectars because their sugar content is too high, and its usually too thick. My neice liked the pineapple ginger drink; however, and my oldest daughter liked the passion fruit drink.

Last night my family and I went to MARDEE’S for my dad’s birthday dinner, and we had such a lovely time. We were a large group of about 15 people, and although I didn’t catch our server’s name, she was incredibly accommodating and provided excellent customer service throughout the night.
The manager was also amazing—very nice, friendly, and funny. She came out to talk to us and built great rapport with everyone at the table, which made the experience even more special. For appetizers, the manager brought us salad, freshly made chips with dip, and accra with pikliz—everything was delicious and fresh.
For my entrée, I ordered the fried chicken with diri djondjon, along with plantains and pikliz, and it was absolutely amazing. As a Haitian family, we truly appreciated how welcomed we felt. The atmosphere felt warm, familiar, and full of culture.
To top it all off, the manager surprised us with cake for my dad’s birthday, and we all sang happy birthday to him. She has such amazing energy and, along with our server, consistently checked in to make sure we were okay, especially since we were such a big party.
I will definitely be coming back—next time with my boyfriend—for the outstanding customer service, great food, and wonderful ambience. Highly recommend!

I give service a 3 star only because I waited so long that I had to take my food to go instead.  When I got home OMG, I was super impressed and said I must definitely return.  Everything was so tender and delicious!  I haven't had a Haitian plate this flavorful in a while.  The restaurant had the right ambiance, a perfect cozy set up for a date or a girls night out catching up with friends but it's the food that will always steal the show.  I had the black rice with fried pork and the sauce was perfectly spiced, the peppered coleslaw (pikliz) was just chef's kiss. The side order of flattened plantain (bannan peze) was so moist and delectable, just two slices weren't enough.  Literally mouth watering.  Everything was seasoned to perfection and with food this good, there is no price complaint. The price is fair.  Can't wait to try their fried fish and bean sauce 😍!

From the moment we walked in, They made us feel completely at home. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, but what truly elevated our experience were the people. A huge shout-out to Deedee, our server, who was nothing short of amazing. She was attentive, friendly, and genuinely made sure every detail was perfect. Her energy and professionalism set the tone for a great evening.
And major props to the owner, who personally checked in to ensure we were comfortable and enjoying our time. That level of care is rare and truly appreciated. The food was fantastic, already started eating before I could take pictures. The service was exceptional, and the hospitality was unmatched. Mardee’s Restaurant has definitely earned a top spot on our list. Highly recommended! 🙌🍽️

Mardee's Bistro & Lounge delivers a brunch experience that feels both elevated and welcoming. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere sets the tone; stylish without being pretentious, lively but still comfortable enough to settle in and enjoy a slow morning.

The menu has a mix of classics and creative twists. Every dish full of flavor and you can tell there’s intention behind the ingredients and preparation. The standout for me was the balance of savory and sweet options; perfect for groups who like to share and sample a little of everything.

The staff were attentive, friendly, and genuinely made the experience feel personal. The cocktails deserve their own mention; fresh, well-crafted, and clearly made with care. Whether you’re a mimosa person or prefer something a bit bolder, their brunch drink menu has something for every vibe.

Overall, Mardee's feels like a place you look forward to returning to for great food, service, and an atmosphere that makes brunch feel like a real occasion. Absolutely worth the visit.

I took my mom to Mardees Bistro & Lounge for lunch to celebrate her birthday, and this was our first time visiting. The location is easy to find and there’s plenty of parking, which is always a plus. There is a side entrance that looks like the main entrance, which is where we initially went and couldn’t enter. I do wish there was a sign directing guests to the main entrance around the corner, which we later discovered.

I had made a reservation for two, but it didn’t seem necessary. When we walked in, the space itself was nice and had a good atmosphere. However, there was no hostess to greet us. I walked up to the bar and asked a waitress if we could sit anywhere since I had a reservation. She seemed a bit confused and just pointed to an area where we could sit.

After sitting down, it appeared our waitress was busy with a larger party, so we waited patiently. When she came over with menus, we noticed that several items we wanted to order were unavailable, which was disappointing especially since the restaurant had only been open for about two hours. I ordered the Griot bowl, thinking it would come in an actual bowl, but it didn’t. My mom ordered the fried goat, and we both had passion fruit drinks. I was also disappointed that there wasn’t a drink menu, as I was hoping to have a celebratory cocktail with my mom but we just settled for water and passion fruit juice.

On a positive note, the food came out quickly and tasted good. Overall, I’m glad we tried a new spot, but I probably wouldn’t dine in again. I would consider ordering pickup or delivery in the future.
Food was good and cheap. I had no complaints the lady was very nice, and friendly. We had soup joumou and pates. New Taste Island Restaurant represented Haitian food.

There are other Haitian restaurants that I like but this one is my favorite..it's very close to my house..Soup joumou is perfect,legume as well..gratinee is delicious..the lady owner is nice..I go there pretty often like 2 times a week...

I had a terrible experience with the guy that works here. I am visiting from out of state and I wanted some authentic haitian food. I looked up the reviews and I was really looking forward to try this place out.

Upon placing my order the man informed me that the fried fish would take 15 mins to be ready. I said no problem. He said, "I will even take it out to you." 15 mins passed and I see him helping other customers and even those that he is familiar with. But he did not once address me. I am seeing plates come out and mine still had not come out. So I approached him and asked  "how much longer?" He informs me that it will take 5 more minutes. I just stare at him and proceeds to inform me that it is a big fish. So I say, no problem. As I am waiting there he finally comes out with my fish and proceeds to charge me over $53 when the menu price states $30-$35. I informed him that your menu price does not even state this price so how are you charging me this much. "OH its a big fish" So why didnt you give me the fish on your menu price. "Oh you will have to wait again"
When I say I am beyond disappointed at the lack of customer service from this establishment. First you took way longer than you originally stated and then you would rather throw this food out then sell it to a paying customer for the menu price? I will NEVER visit this establishment ever again!

The food is tasty and fresh at a reasonable price, but if you are in a hurry, this is definitely NOT fast food.  The service was courteous and professional. We ordered the Red Snapper.
UPDATE: I recently returned for the same and was served a much smaller fish and charged 40$!
Definitely NOT worth it for a mall food court!!
I doubt I will ever return.
The only place I get Haitian food. Service is great and they don’t give you no attitude for sure! Food taste like home. I love it.

name: Benita's Kitchen
vicinity: Inside The Chevron Gas Station, 5419 Silver Star Rd, Orlando

reviews.text: Great food and nice portions, good prices, and good friendly service! I appreciate the options of of gravy for my rice (curry goat and black bean sauce). Don't be intimidated by the location,  the food does not disappoint....look at the beautiful presentation. I highly recommend

Benita’s Kitchen is amazing! The food is cooked in a perfect timely manner with each ingredient made with love and passion, This woman was born with a gift to cook. Her personality so warm and welcoming. My husband and me both enjoyed our food.

Benita's Kitchen

---

✅ Highlights
- Homestyle comfort food with authentic flavors.
- Friendly and welcoming staff creating a cozy atmosphere.
- Generous portions at reasonable prices.
- Popular for breakfast and soul food dishes.

---

👎 Considerations
- Some say wait times can be a bit long during peak hours.
- Casual setting, not for fine dining expectations.

---

🎯 Overall
Benita’s Kitchen is a great spot for hearty, flavorful comfort food with a warm, friendly vibe. Perfect for a casual meal with a home-cooked feel.
Rating: 4 / 5

The food is so amazing. We order from her almost every day.
With all the junk food out there it's good be able to eat real home made food for the same price.
It's a small kitchen in the Chevron Gas station but she puts out big flavor and quality. Thank you Benita
This is the best Haitian food in Orlando! Benita has a beautiful aura which makes the food taste even better. You will not regret going here.

Great atmosphere with an amazing reggae band.  They played all my favorites and made our meal so much more enjoyable.    I nodded to the rhythm all through my meal!!

We had curry stewed goat with carrots and white rice.  The flavor and spice level was just right.  This is coming from me, a Tobagonian islander.

Had a Jamiacan side salad that had mango salsa and a tasty vinaigrette.

Love the atmosphere love the band. Service was great. Ordered the curry goat there was a little lack of attention in the flavor food tasted more just like salt and pepper. A lot of history and wonderful people.

Honestly I wasn’t expecting this place to be as good as it was. Most of the food near universal studios seems to be very touristy. This place wasn’t that. Awesome staff, good prices and the quality of food was top notch and the decor was really cool too. I got the jerk chicken meal which was like $24. Came with half chicken, rice and peas, and fried plantains. Solid 9/10 meal. The food had fantastic flavor and the chicken had a good spice to it. Will definitely be back next time I’m out here.

Such a cool restaurant located just outside of Universal Studios offering tasty Caribbean food and live music. The vibe there was wonderful and the music was great. You can sit down and eat or just come and get a drink from the bar and listen to the music. I was excited to see people of all races, ages and walks of life there enjoying the food and music. Definitely a must-do if in the area just outside of Universal. Note that there is a hefty charge for parking at Universal and there is quite a bit of a walk to get to this restaurant from the parking lot - there are also stairs to climb as it is located on the top level of restaurants.

We absolutely loved this place! It feels beautiful and tucked away — almost like it’s not even part of CityWalk. The atmosphere is so authentic and welcoming, and the food was fantastic. The drinks were great too, and next time we visit we’re hoping to catch one of the live reggae bands.

Special shoutout to our server, Tiny, who was absolutely amazing (not sure if she’s still there, but she made our visit extra memorable).

🌿🍹 Between the vibe, the food, and the service, this spot is a must-visit if you’re at Universal!
Really good place they’re  always fast and friendly and struggle  to give a good service ever .

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Amazing service and delicious food! Allyha Cuisine truly knows how to deliver both quality and care. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared, and the service was professional and welcoming. Everything was well organized and on time, which made the whole experience even better. You can really tell there’s passion behind what they do. I highly recommend Allyha Cuisine for anyone looking for great food and excellent service!
Very nice place and the food is good. The customer service is really nice too. I will definitely recommend it to anyone who loves good food quality
The foods was excellent and great customer service, recommended
The best Caribbean food you will ever taste 💖🥘

Hay every body I heard about this place Island Moon Bar & Grille on the  Radio 📻 and my husband, son and I are here to check them out.   😃  The atmosphere is nice,  the restaurant is very clean,  The staff is upbeat and friendly. 😄  I wasn’t looking my best 😎 today and I was still treated like royalty 👸 .  It’s a very nice place to dine in too.  They are located inside of the Caribbean Sunshine Bakery right next to the Orange County Sheriffs Office.

The food was amazingggg!!!! Fresh, nice and hot and flavorful. The atmosphere was good they had good music playing.  I wish I lived close by I would go everydayyy! ❤️❤️❤️ Customer service wasn't all that great 🥺

I was skeptical at first due to the this establishment only having 5 star reviews but now I see why, the food is the bomb!! The cashier was also very nice and pleasant. Whenever I’m in the area, I’m definitely stopping. Highly recommend!
Food was good and fresh,  atmosphere was nice has an island 🏝 feeling,  coming back to listen to the live music 🎶 session

Best place to go to if your looking for Diri Djon djon! (Mushroom black rice).
By far my favorite Haitian restaurant.
Reasonable price for the portion you get!

name: Jamaican Me Happy Jamaican and American Restaurant

html_attributions: Jamaican Me Happy Jamaican and American Restaurant

reviews.text: They were so nice. They even carried our plates to the car. We went the day before and the card machine was down and we didn’t have cash. They gave us an order of jerk chicken on the house so we had to go back. I’m so glad we did. In a world where everyone is so mean and selfish it was a blessing to come across such nice gentlemen. The jerk chicken is delicious. I finally had a real patty and it was good. We also had ox tails and curry chicken. Yums. It was lunchtime and there was also a fresh fruit juice truck in the parking lot. It was our best Orlando experience thus far.

I ordered a brown stew chicken meal and it didn’t really taste like brown stew. It tasted more like oven baked jerk chicken. The rice wasn’t shelly and didn’t have much flavor. It’s my first time trying this place so maybe I went on a bad day. All in all for $16.58 I’d rather go to Love Bird’s Jerk Spot.

Via my family: Food is really good. Wish they had some options for us non-meat eating plantbased food lovers.  I did taste the rice and peas, very tasty.  There's a natural fruit juice stand a few feet away; that was a plus for me.

It's okay I ordered the fried chicken, it was seasoned but It's supposed be a leg qauter but Really was 2 legs and half of a thigh. Which is less chicken than i was told. Now for the rice it was decent and cabbage was just alright. I also ordered mac and cheese, it was straight kraft trash! The food is just okay from my experience it may be different for you.

I just happened to stop here as I was passing by and I’m so happy I did. The food was sooo good especially the jerk chicken and cabbage 😋. The cabbage has the perfect balance between soft and crunchy and the flavor was amazing. This will definitely be my new spot.Look at the pictures if you don’t believe me lol.

Real good authentic Haitian food that was cooked to perfection and had plenty of food in the plate but the service sucks. The young lady at the front counter taking orders was nice but it took 40 minutes to almost an hour to get my food and also walking in I wasn't sure if it was an restaurant. It was a lot of other things going on.

Wow, delicious Haitian food.  Will be back again. Its a little warm inside so i would order ahead.  But portions were great and flavor wow.  Thank you for a delicious lunch. Also be sure to try out there papaya juice was amazing!  Get the homemade juice/lemonade.

---

Review for Coquillage Restaurant, Orlando, FL

I recently had the pleasure of ordering at Coquillage Restaurant, and I must say, it was a fantastic experience from start to finish. The staff was incredibly welcoming, making us feel right at home as soon as we walked through the door.

Now, let's talk about the food – it was absolutely delicious! I ordered the large griot, and it was cooked to perfection. The flavors were rich and satisfying, and every bite was a delight. It was evident that a lot of care and passion went into the preparation of each dish.

If you haven’t stopped by Coquillage yet, I highly recommend putting it on your to-do list. You won’t regret it!
I like the food but I would suggest you order online.

Unprofessional
Rude
Wasting people time,  doesn't have the food. No call or never heard from them .

I’m tried a lot of Haitian places in Orlando. I’m from South Florida so the Haitian food in South Florida is amazing. I was pretty disappointed when I came to Orlando and the Haitian food wasn’t as good but I found this place where the Haitian food mirrors South Florida Haitian food it’s really really good.

They have amazing pate kode and diri Kole. The only thing is that the prices are high there and they promote a lunch special that they don’t do. The lunch specials that is all over the RESTURANT they don’t do it anymore but all the signage is still up. Also the legume isn’t the best.

Another thing that’s annoying is they’re on DoorDash and when you order it on DoorDash you’ll order diri Kole and they’ll ignore it and just give you white rice or Jhon Jhon  like they won’t call you and explain they just give you something different than what you actually ordered on DoorDash, which is really annoying

But food is great. I go there about once a week when I’m in town.
Food is really good ! Nice people! Comfortable place! Friendly service! Whew that food was great !😍

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Outstanding!
I had the pleasure of dining at PLUS CAFE RESTAURANT, and wow what an experience! I ordered the black rice with chicken and plantains, and it was super duper delicious. The rice was perfectly seasoned, the chicken was crispy and flavorful, and the plantains were cooked to perfection crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Every bite was a burst of flavor that made me want more.

The service was warm and welcoming, this guy knows how to convince people and Make you feel comfortable and the atmosphere made me feel right at home. This is definitely a place I’ll be coming back to and recommending to everyone I know.

If you’re looking for a spot where the food tastes like pure love on a plate, PLUS CAFE RESTAURANT is it! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I recently ordered takeout from Haitian Plus Cafe & Bakery Restaurant in Orlando, Florida, and I was beyond impressed. The food was absolutely delicious, authentic, flavorful, and clearly made with care. What really stood out, though, was the exceptional customer service.
In a community where great service can sometimes be hit or miss, this place truly sets a high standard. The staff was friendly, professional, and made the whole experience pleasant from start to finish. It’s refreshing to see such dedication to both food quality and customer satisfaction in a Haitian restaurant.
Highly recommend and definitely looking forward to my next visit.
Oh my god! The food is so fresh and flavorful🤤🤤

I was visiting universal studios and was searching for Jamaican restaurants and found Rose’s island spice restaurant and decided to give them a try. The food was so delicious I was truly impressed. You can taste the real authentic coconut milk in the rice & peas and the fry chicken was well seasoned, full of flavor I highly recommend them.

At this moment They are an ill-prepared food truck out here at the Caribbean  Festival in Clermont. 1 hour to order and am still waiting on my food. Will update the taste and see if waiting I predict 2 hours total to eat it.

Update: We got our food 1 hour 45 minutes total waiting time. I assessed that the food is on par, not worth the time frame wasted waiting.

I tried Rose Island Spice for a catering of 37 guests. It was very last minute. They were very professional in handling the last minute request. The food was well prepared and tasty. Thank you Rose Island Spice for a tasty dinner. I strongly recommend this restaurant for the best to a home cooked meal from yaaad.

Jerk chicken is to die for
We had a college grad party, and a guest brought jerk chicken from Rose's. This was something that we hadn't experienced since we left Jamaica. We had to stop by and pick some extras for ourselves. Rose carved out time to prepare for us. We are grateful for such a superb service. I have recommended a few friends of mine. When I visit Florida, I will definitely load up for my trip back to Virginia! Thanks so much for taking the time to prepare such delicious jerk chicken!

All on the menu is great at the Nova Rd. location in Daytona Beach.
I'm from New York and it was hard to find a Caribbean restaurant with spices used straight from Jamaica. Miss Rose and her son Jordan are the best. Pleasant and kind atmosphere. Food always fresh. Jerk chicken is my favorite. Look out for the sour sop drink about to hit the menu I'm so excited I've eaten there about 3 times this week. Oh and of course the rice and peas is on point don't forget little oxtail gravy over it lol.

This food was amazing!!! Such high quality and the woman running it is so sweet and comforting she packed the bowls UP. We will be back ASAP! Everyone needs to try it the prices are so insane, the fruit punch, oxtail, curry chicken, cabbage, rice and peas were all so delicious we can’t wait to come back! Bowls had 3 options first being $5,$16,$18. A must try hidden gem!

We have been looking for a good Jamaican restaurant for a long time. We saw this one had a high rating so made the drive towards downtown, hoping that it won’t disappoint. And to our pleasant surprise, it was an amazing experience! The food was sooooo tasty - oxtails, goat curry, chicken curry, rice and peas, cabbage, ALL of it was delicious 👌🏽 a former nurse who has magical fingers to cook the food she does, runs her restaurant with her young son out of this small space, but very very clean and hygienic. She was so generous with her portions and very helpful to choose what we should get. There was a little display case with some tasty looking pastries and cakes. I highly recommend visiting this little gem 👍🏽

Mama we made it! Walk by here all the time and decided to stop by for lunch. Glad I did. Haven’t had too much Jamaican but tasted like some delicious home cooking. Got the medium bowl that came with rice, side of cabbages, and split two sides. Topped off with Jerk sauce. YUM

This is my second time here and I'll say it is one of the best places I've met the son very beautiful and amazing person the mom same thing beautiful and amazing. This ìs my favorite spot and I love recommending people here. I wish I could eat here every day. The price is worth it for me. But definitely check it out.

I had the most incredible dining experience at this restaurant. Omg the FOOD was everything and more. Definitely top tier! And I love the fact that they also serve delicious desert if you want something sweet right after. :). Every dish wonderfully made and the staff were just as amazing. Best restaurant in town (in my opinion) if you’re looking for really great authentic Jamaican food :) 🙌🏾

Rock n Rev Ocoee is a great new spot in town. The menu has a cool mix of dishes from all over the country, with flavors inspired by different cities and regions. Everything we tried was delicious, and the staff couldn't have been friendlier. The vibe is relaxed and welcoming, and it’s clear they’re building a fun community here. We’ll definitely be coming back, especially for weekly trivia or bingo nights.

Newly opened with friendly staff and great food. A diverse and interesting menu that also has vegetarian and vegan options created by Chef James. Live music venue on weekends, yet also a good spot for lunch and dinner any time.

Went for Disney Trivia and the restaurant was busy but not packed. No line out the door and several open tables. Was able to sit right away, but the server didn’t take our order for close to 20 minutes.

The trivia host (who I recognize is contracted and is not a restaurant employee) set up and had his music turned so loud, the whole restaurant had to yell to be heard and several people asked him to turn it down. No staff asked him to turn it down, just yelled along with the rest of us.

Once we ordered, it took probably 20 minutes to get food, which wasn’t terrible. However, I ordered the Oklahoma Burger (see photos) and asked to add barbecue sauce because just a burger and fried onions sounded a bit dry. My friend ordered a bacon cheeseburger, no adjustments. The waiter said no problem and entered the orders. When we got our food, both burgers were charred and dry. The onions on my burger were sautéed, not fried. When I asked the waiter, he agreed it was wrong and stated he’d speak to the chef about it.

While waiting for him to come back, we ended up speaking to the table behind us as they were also trying to catch their waitress, who couldn’t be found (often we’d look up and not a single employee could be seen, not even the bar tender). One of the people at the table had ordered a Philly cheesesteak and had received a sub bun with a hamburger patty cut in half and topped with cheese. They finally got their waitress to come over who also agreed it was wrong. Eventually, both our waiter and their waitress returned to our tables. Our waiter said per the chef, the onions are fried because they’re “fried in a pan”. The waitress brought the other table’s Philly cheesesteak out and it was the same hamburger patty but cut up.

We all opted to just give up and eat what we had because we were ultimately there for trivia. When it came time to pay, the waiter (who was nice and you could tell this isn’t his fault, just how he’s trained) handed me the tablet to pay and I noticed a $1 upcharge for the barbecue sauce on my burger. When I asked if that was correct, he stated he’d get the manager to confirm. I told him not to worry about it as we were ready to leave, but he still went and got him. The manager came over and opted to start the conversation with “so you’ve got a problem?” I asked him about the upcharge for the sauce, stating the waiter didn’t mention it and there was nothing on the menu about it. The manager cut me off, stating it is on the menu, so I asked to see it. He proceeded to show me where the extra sauce pricing is listed under the wings section on an entirely different page of the menu. At this point trivia was over but the music was still blaring from the host so I asked to just pay so we could leave. He ended up comping my meal, which was nice but felt more like a bribe to get us not to leave a negative review as I had already mentioned we likely wouldn’t be back.

I was really hoping this would be a good restaurant as it’s so close to my house but even despite winning a gift card at trivia I’m not sure we’ll even use it.

The food was okay, but not the best. I ordered the 3 different egg rolls. There were large chunks of fatty pieces in a couple of them that made it difficult to enjoy. We were seated at the bar, so it was pretty easy to get someone's attention when needed. The live music started towards the end of my visit and I think the music was too loud. It made it very difficult to have a conversation without having to repeat myself. I would probably won't go back

I don't leave reviews often but this one is deserved. My boyfriend picked this spot, it's like a hole in the wall but the place is actually huge. My waitress, Kaitlyn was great. Most people who serve try to just get it done & over with. She was super friendly, we shared laughs, she helped me pick out something on the menu & helped me tweak it a little bit because im difficult. She was so patient & such a joy to interact with. Such a genuinely nice person, will literally come back just for her, she made the experience fun even though the place was dead. I hope she See's this & her managers.

name: Annie’s Roti Shop / Annie’s Island Breeze

reviews.text: Best food period! The vibe, new location and music was on point. I love a great atmosphere with great food and Annie's is the place. I will definitely be back to visit when in town!

Today was our first time here at Annie's and met Bobby on entering. He is a cool dude in his own way and was welcoming.
The place was very clean.
The roti and doubles were really tasty and filling and worth the price and drive for Orlando Central Florida.
The Chinese fried rice and fried chicken was also tasty but the portion was really a bit too small for the price, could use some more fried rice for the price. However, since we can't ever be satisfied in every way , I must say, the taste of the food , and atmosphere was NOT disappointing.  Excellent job Bobby and hope your business continue to grow and be a great success. I would recommend your place to anyone with full confidence.  God Bless ! David and family, Apopka Florida.

Let me first say that I’m still Trini-to-de-bone although I’m an American. With that said; a couple people recommended that I try Annie’s because I complained about not getting the bus-up-shut skin at the other Trini place that I patronize.  I was the only customer there, then the little girl who was at the door came to take my order…Lawd! I went from hungry to hangry after 5 minutes of trying to order a chicken bus-up-shut and a goat roti. Said I wanted a chicken bus-up-shut, it comes with potato & chana right?…good…add some pumpkin too please…”pumpkin by itself or as a side, because that’s two different prices”  🤨 I want it added with the potato & Chana on the side.  Then she went on about the bus-up-shut saying it $5 and if I want it by itself because it can’t wrap…well duhh, OMG WTH! 🤦🏽‍♀️  Next was to order the goat roti…SMH. I said wrap it for me please. “Want it by itself, because the roti alone is $5.”  WHAAATT??  Never been so confused 😵‍💫.  Someone from the back (who was definitely Trini too) happened to be passing and heard the confusion and took my order by mouth…’a chicken bus-up-shut with pumpkin and a goat roti, no pepper.’ Thank God for small mercies, order was in. I gave up trying to figure out or explain what I wanted to the little girl, was honestly too confused and stressed after it all.And she was not adamant about getting her point across. I stopped talking and the little girl disappeared. As I waited I saw ‘currant rolls’ on the counter, and of course, ordered one, lol, I was given a bag of Khurma…lol, had to show and tell what that was too, lol. Granted, that individual said she was new, so the same Trini who took my order, came out and got me the current roll. Thank you mums from the back kitchen whomever you are! Without you I don’t think I would’ve gotten the correct order!
Bus-up-shut skin was small in comparison, Roti was huge and tasty, goat was seasoned, and no pepper as I requested, thank you…Not sure if I’ll be back anytime soon though…smh

Windermere, if you haven't patronized Annie's Island Breeze, you're missing out on a new hidden gem.

It is a lovely familiar space that's been given new light.

It's a short distance in the Metro West area on Westpointe at Haiwasee.  A mere short gallop from the equestrian ⛲️.

The cuisine is superior, fresh, & made to order.  You're not just eating food. You're eating culinary delights.

A heartfelt thank you to Annie’s for hosting a truly memorable Divali Dinner on October 20th, 2025. The décor and ambience were absolutely exquisite — warm deya lights, soothing traditional music, and elegant tablescapes built an atmosphere that beautifully captured the spirit of the festival.

The authentic traditional Trinidadian menu was nothing short of perfection — from savory favorites to delightful sweet treats to take home, every bite was a taste of heritage and love.

For those of us living in Orlando, it was more than just a dinner — it was a comforting sense of home and community. 🪔❤️

#Divali2025 #Annie’sOrlando #TriniFlavor #HomeAwayFromHome #FestivalOfLights #CommunitySpirit

Just had the most amazing Caribbean food at Franceella's Caribbean Cuisine! 🤩 This hidden gem is tucked away inside the Exxon gas station, and I'm here to tell you, it's a GAME CHANGER! 🤯 You won't find a more unlikely spot for a culinary treasure, but trust me, it's worth seeking out. The $8.99 daily special is a steal - a hearty plate of meat, veggies, and rice that's cooked to perfection. We went with the curry chicken and jerk chicken, both were TO DIE FOR! 🤤 Don't skip the roti and daal on the side, and if you like a little heat, grab a bottle of their signature hot sauce! 🔥

What really struck us was Franceella's warmth and community spirit. She's soon going to be collecting food and clothing for those impacted by the hurricane in Jamaica, so if you have any items, I’m sure she would be happy to take your donations. Her generosity and kindness shine through in every aspect of her restaurant.

Portions are generous (our to-go bag was heavy!), and the flavors will transport you straight to Jamaica. We devoured every bite, and we're already planning our next visit. If you're in the area, do yourself a favor and get to Franceella's - you won't be disappointed! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

5-Star Review: A Hidden Gem for Authentic Jamaican Food!

Stopped by this amazing spot after a doctor’s appointment, and let me tell you—John and his team are serving up real, soul-satisfying Jamaican food. Even though I haven’t been able to eat much since my accident, I had to give this place a try. The smell alone? Incredible. And my father? He got the last of the oxtails at 6:00 PM on a Monday—so you know they’re selling out for a reason!

For just $8.99, you get a hearty meal—jerk chicken, perfectly seasoned rice and beans, and some of the best cabbage around. Flavorful, authentic, and worth every penny. Ignore the two-star review from that so-called “expert.” This spot is the real deal.

John, thank you and God bless. Wishing you a smooth recovery and strength for your upcoming surgery. You’ve got our prayers, and we can’t wait to see you back in action. To anyone reading this: support this business! Go get yourself a plate, and taste some of the best Jamaican food in town.

🔥 Rating: 5/5
✅ Fresh, flavorful, and authentic
🍗 Get there early—oxtails sell out fast!
💯 Highly recommend!

If you’re looking for Jamaican food on the east side of Orlando, this is a great option. I had the oxtail special, very well priced, very wellportioned, fall off the bone, and well seasoned. The woman who was working there, I’m not sure if she was France-Ella or not, but she was very friendly, and I enjoyed the brief conversation as she prepared my food. I will 100% return. I also had their pineapple fruit punch, it was delicious!

We got delivery, so we can't speak for service or atmosphere. The food was just ok. The jerk chicken didn't have enough jerk seasoning and had an odd sweet BBQ sauce on top. Also, chicken was a bit dry. The rice with beans, as well as, the vegetables were very bland. The Mac and cheese was good. We never got the patty we ordered, which was disappointing. We probably won't come back.

I just discovered France - Ella's Caribbean Cuisine and I am beyond thrilled to have a taste of the Caribbean right in my neighborhood! The Curry Chicken daily special was a flavor explosion that left me craving more. The portions were generous, and the rice & beans were perfectly cooked, soaking up all the delicious curry flavors. The bonus Mac & Cheese was a delightful surprise and I could eat it all day long. The gentleman who served me was friendly and made sure my meal was packed with care. The authenticity of the food truly transported me to the Caribbean with each bite. I was very impressed with the cleanliness of this small restaurant with separate utensils being used for each item and each utensil cleaned before being stored into an individual container as the gentleman filled my to-go container. I can't wait to return and explore more of their menu. If you're looking for a true taste of Caribbean cuisine, look no further than France - Ella's. A hidden gem that deserves all the praise!

I was in love with this place.. after today i will no-longer come here again.. the oxtails were ruff cabbage wasn't seasoned and the person taking my order kept repeating my order back to me wrong. I'm going back to sunshine bakery...  Good bye..

When I say this is by far the best Jamaican food I’ve had in all of America since I’ve been living in the states!!! And I’ve lived here for 10 years and the food here is a true taste of home. This is coming from a foodie, I love this food!!!
Authentic jamaican food. The lady serving me was very friendly and informative and the food was amazing! Would recommend

Overall the taste was pretty good but was disappointed with the portions of food and also accustomed to a rich thicker gravy for my oxtails. I gave it a 3 because the oxtails were seasoned well, at least.
The best curry goat and service in the Orlando area..must try..it's on 5500 Beggs rd

Amazing Haitian food with authentic flavors! The Diri djon djon  and Legim was rich and perfectly seasoned, the banann peze were crispy and delicious. Everything tasted fresh and homemade. The staff was friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend calling ahead before you arrive, as they can get busy and availability may vary. Definitely worth the visit!
Since I moved to Orlando, this is the best Haitian pattie I’ve ever tasted! Always fresh, flavorful, and never disappoints. Highly recommend! 🥐🇭🇹

If i could give this place no stars i would The food service is not satisfactory the way I only receive one meat for a lalo meal makes no sense the restaurant charged me alot for food that is not good at all and is smelly and nasty.i had to trash the food unhappy with the order I got for me and my brother
Du riz lalo no meat smelly terrible.

Besides the occasional Haitian Pattie in Brooklyn or NJ it had been many many years since I'd had a full Haitian meal and this spot did not disappoint. I ordered 2 meals, the griot with black rice and strew chicken with white rice plus some Haitian patties and everything was incredible. It will be my go to spot when I'm back in Orlando for sure!
The food is great. Never lets me down, I love my people and this really hits the spot. If you’re down to try some Caribbean food, I highly recommend!

First time ordering here! I ordered via Uber eats, I wish the delivery drivers would follow directions and pictures were provided to where they should delivery my order 😅

In honor of Haitian Flag day! 🇭🇹 I decided to support a local Haitian business. I ordered fried pork, brown rice, two chicken patty’s,  two salt fish patty’s, watermelon soda and some Haitian bread. When I tell it’s hard to find a good Haitian restaurant in Orlando. When I reviewed the comments I saw not so good ones. I had to try it for myself. Everything was good and great portions. I will definitely be ordered here again!
One of the best place to buy “Pate Kode” in Pine Hills. Also great food. I love their goat and chicken! Good job !

I ordered diri djodjon, griot, with a side of mac and cheese, the food was not bad, needs more flavor, i dont know what kind of sauce they sent me but i didn’t like the smell, im not sure it it was old , the pikliz was old i did not even touch it, Haitian restaurants need to do better, invest in brown bags for doordash/ubereats orders please
Service is always good. Communication on wait times are accurate. The quality of the food is always up to par and fresh!

Very disappointing. I agree with the other reviewer, the legume was actually very bland. No seasoning nor flavoring of any sort. Also would like to mention it didn’t come with any sort of side just like any other place. White rice didn’t come with the black bean purée. For a $15 medium legume, I can’t justify myself suggesting it.
My food was so good! I’ll definitely be trying other dishes from Ladies of the Caribbean. 9/10 would recommend
Beautiful setting and welcoming people. I’llBeautiful setting and welcoming people. I’ll definitely come back! definitely come back!

Ordered the fried pork and it came with great portion sizes for the protein and the sides. Ended up being two meals for me and I can put some food down. All in all, the experience was amazing and the food was delicious. Definitely will be ordering again and highly recommend the food.

I ordered a cake from Ladies of the Caribbean recently and it has been one of the best cakes I’ve had in a very long time. It was moist and the flavor was spectacular. I definitely recommend. Communication was also spectacular.
Food is flavorful, cakes are the perfect texture and sweetness, and the ladies are very kind and welcoming!! I would order everything 100 times if I could!

I placed an order on their website hours ahead of time before I started a road trip to Orlando. The food was ready minutes before the scheduled time. I brought it home to my family and everybody enjoyed everything. The curry chicken, jerk chicken, and wings were among the favorites.

I ordered off the haitian food menu the “Tasso and black rice (Diri DjonDjon),” and it was a total knock-off… not authentic -haitian food,  did not taste well… maybe should consider hiring a haitian Cook maybe.  Because, that was not haitian food; I really dont know what that was,; it taste more like Jamaican food trying to past of as haitian food!   If u are looking for a real authentic haitian food —  do not waste time here, because; you will not find here!!!

Respond to owner:  Had nothing to do with the driver, the driver did not prep, and cook your food!

I would not recommend anyone buy food from this place.  This is not caribbean good at all.  First time I ordered from here, the fried fish I received was so over fried, I could not eat it.  The tostones was so hard I almost lost a tooth trying to bite it.  2nd time, I ordered chicken which was clearly not jerk chicken. It was burnt and old chicken covered in some sort of light brown sauce that was terrible.  The best thing in the plate was the tostones and rice.  Save your money and eat elsewhere.

I basically waited 15minutes for food that was not fresh. The jerk chicken was sour, coco bread hard as a rock, and the Mac n cheese was trash. Maybe they were better when the first started but if you go now check your food before you leave. I wasted $25 bucks and felt sick a few hours later.

The food is amazing, the griyo/Griot & Haitian pikliz is the best I’ve had in a very long time best in town by far, the Service is A1,  and customer service is top notch. This is my new Favorite place/restaurant.

My experience here was a bit of a mixed bag. On the negative side, the service was very slow with a 30-40 minute wait, the furniture looked quite worn out, and the staff seemed exhausted.
The only thing that brightened our visit was the dessert. It was absolutely delicious, and what really saved the mood was a sweet birthday surprise—a small chocolate 'Happy Birthday' print on the plate. It was a thoughtful touch that we truly appreciated.
While the dessert and the birthday gesture were wonderful, the slow service and tired atmosphere definitely need improvement

During our visit at Universal's Sapphire Falls Resort, we had the pleasure of enjoying breakfast at Amatista Cookhouse, and it turned out to be one of the most memorable dining experiences of our trip — thanks in large part to the exceptional service we received from Hiwot and Tash.
From the moment we were seated, both servers made us feel welcomed and well cared for. Without delay, they offered us freshly brewed coffee, chilled juices, and refreshing water. It was clear they took pride in ensuring that every guest started their morning with comfort and ease.
Though it’s a buffet-style breakfast — and a delicious one at that, featuring an impressive array of items — what truly stood out was the personalized attention Hiwot and Tash offered. They kindly let us know they’d be happy to bring special items such as waffles or turkey bacon directly to our table if we wanted them. The omelette station was a standout as well, with custom-made omelettes prepared to your liking, cooked fresh and packed with flavor.
Hiwot and Tash checked in on us often, never intrusively, but always with a warm smile and genuine care. Their attentiveness, positive energy, and professionalism elevated the entire experience. What amazed us even more was learning that Hiwot is still in training — a surprise, considering the top-tier service she delivered. Her natural attentiveness and poise made it feel like she’d been doing this for years.
Thanks to these two incredible ladies, breakfast at Amatista Cookhouse was not just a meal, but a delightful way to start the day. If you’re staying at Sapphire Falls, don’t miss this spot — and if you're lucky enough to be served by Hiwot or Tash, you're in for a real treat.

While the service was truly excellent—we were quickly seated and our server was incredibly attentive—the food unfortunately missed the mark entirely.
Despite the prompt and friendly service, the dishes left much to be desired.
The empanadas were decidedly average, and the chicken wings were so bland we had to season them ourselves. Even the pizza, which had decent dough, was spoiled by what tasted like a plain, straight-from-the-can sauce. Because of the food quality, we won't be making a return visit.
Our waiter Jimmy provided the best and most welcoming service on our first ever time eating here. He was attentive and polite and offered great hospitality throughout our entire visit.

Appetizer bread with walnut - fantastic;
Rotisserie chicken - fantastic, not sure how they made it to be so much more tastier than the rotisserie chicken in the park lol;
Mussels - fantastic, served with breads grilled on wood fire I feel, so great!!
Cheese pizza - the cheese sooo deep

Cocktail - tequila old fashioned, pretty good.

Probably because we went into the restaurant after 9:20 pm, the speed wasn’t too slow as others complained.

We were so exhausted after a long day, but in the middle of the dinner, I was feeling very happy because this dinner is good retreat to us. Server also nice and checked on us several times, made jokes even though it was late. Anyway, I’m very impressed by this restaurant. Worth specifically leaving a nice review.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The cashier was AMAZING — she promised me I wouldn’t regret a dime, and she was absolutely right! She even gave us a loyalty card with $10 off our first online order, which was such a nice surprise.

I’m a total rib lover, and the second I caught that smoky aroma, I couldn’t resist — made my hubby U-turn even though we really shouldn’t have splurged. And let me tell you… SO worth it! 🤤

The ribs were tender and flavorful, and the mac & cheese was a perfect 10/10. Comfort food heaven! Can’t wait to come back on payday to try more. 🥰

Run, don’t walk to get your food! I have zero complaints about the entire process and the product. I placed the order online, which was very simple to do, and it gave me a time of 4:06 that it would be ready. I walked in at 4:07 and my food was handed to me. The Customer Service from the employees was great! I ordered rib tips, jerk fries and lemon pepper wings. EVERYTHING was good! 😩 The rib tips were my favorite. I can’t wait to place another order. Keep up the good work!

Absolutely the best Jamaican food in Florida, the different sauces and food options they have are unbeatable including the price all the way to New York. As I was looking for authentic Jamaican food and someone who values there food I found this place and let me tell you what you’ll be going here everyday of the seasons the food is amazing the sauces are skeptical at first but turned out amazing. The prices are amazing and then the smell you get before you even get to the location is unbearable. Best experience I’ve had since my first time in Orlando and since I work here every few months I feel like I need rehab after leaving bc I can’t stop thinking about this place especially after a night out of drinking!

If you're looking for an authentic taste of Jamaica, look no further than Jerkman BBQ. Let's be upfront: this isn't a fancy spot. The physical appearance of the place isn't particularly appealing, and the surrounding area isn't what you'd call beautiful. But honestly, none of that matters once you taste the food.
The moment I took my first bite, I was instantly transported directly to Jamaica. The flavors were absolutely amazing, incredibly rich, and unmistakably genuine. This is the real deal, a true Jamaican culinary experience that delivers on every level where it counts.
Despite the unadorned setting, I would absolutely return to Jerkman BBQ for the food alone. It's a testament to how truly delicious and authentic their dishes are. Don't let the aesthetics deter you; this is a must-visit for anyone craving a true taste of the Caribbean.

This was my first time here. This place has the best jerk chicken I’ve ever had! Everything was fresh, even the fries. The chicken was tender, the flavor of the sauce was perfect with just the right amount of spice/kick, and the portion size was great! If you’re debating on the jerk fries, GET IT! You won’t regret it. It was soooo good. This was my first time here, but definitely won’t be the last!

Well this was a wonderful surprise! This was mine and the hubby’s  first visit and were beyond impressed from the moment we stepped in. The cocktails offered at the bar were wonderful, had a lot of seating on a Saturday afternoon. Plenty of green space for kiddos to play and run and a lot of seating available inside as well. Great parking garage making eat easy accessible. My husband at at the Cuban location ordered the pork belly with tostones, amazing! The pineapple chutney was delicious 😋. I could decided so ordered a mix and match from the Asian location and the Krab Rangoons were outstanding! I would highly recommend also had the loaded potatoes from the Mexican style location with the birrira meat- so tasty! We will definitely be back to try the other options as there were so many to choose from. I do want to mention how impressed I was with the service as we walked around many of the staff greeted us and some even took it as far to share the specials and speciality dishes offered off their menu. Great experience we will be back!

This is for Bangkok Style Street Food. Not sure why they don't show up in the directory but the owner should fix that.

Love their food! The panang Curry is the absolute best in Orlando. My wife and son are Thai and we've lived in Thailand so it's great having real Thai food here in Orlando, not much of that around.

Our go to is the popcorn chicken, cream cheese wonton, panang Curry and pad Thai. You can't go wrong with anything here and Nung the owner is such a sweetheart. Stop in and get some authentic Thai food, you won't be disappointed!

Great place for picky eaters or Groups, the seating is plentiful and really nice.  Food was amazing shout out the birria egg rolls and the pizza!  Huge bar, free parking garage, atleast 8 different food options.  They had a DJ on Saturday when we visited.  You can hang inside or outside even seating outside, kids were playing in the “green space”, this place is very much a vibe.  I recommend it and will be back for sure!

Went to the hall on a thursday afternoon and had a wonderful time! My friend and I ate at Kabob to go?
Got the spicy potatoes which were delicious and spicyyyy. Beef shawarma, mixed platter, and the veggie sambouseks.
The ladies were very sweet and the food was very yum!
Also got drinks at the bar from DJ Candy Yams; she’s got great energy and can make a nice drink
Ended our time w coffees from the cafe bar; the barista was very knowledgeable, nice energy, and made us delicious coffees

13+ food/bev spots inclu long bar, sports bar & coffee, Parking garage, open space, great seating, free games for family, good atmosphere.  I was surprised I hadn't heard about it.

Came early evening on the Friday after New Year's.

This place is absolutely amazing !!!! The food is sooo good and the presentation was so gorgeous!! I ordered the oxtail pasta and oxtail bous . Everything was so delicious. The drink was on point and not watered down at all. My server was Kerry she was absolutely wonderful, very kind. I rate this restaurant a 10/10 definitely recommend and I will most definitely be coming back. The vibes was amazing.

We visited this location on Sunday, November 16 for their bingo brunch, and unfortunately it was very subpar. When we arrived, our waitress mentioned she was the floor manager, but honestly she seemed to be doing every job bartender, server, running food, outside, in the kitchen she was everywhere. Because of that, we had long waits just to place orders or ask for anything we needed.

I ordered the French toast with an extra side of bacon. When the food came out, they forgot my syrup. When I asked for it, someone told me I had to pay for syrup, even though I never received any in the first place. I also ordered a lychee mimosa, and it took about 20 minutes just to get the drink, which was frustrating.

The bingo portion was fun, but the rounds felt spaced out about every 20–30 minutes. If you’re sitting inside, the caller is hard to hear because the music continues to play, so you end up asking for numbers to be repeated.

Overall, the whole experience felt unorganized. They definitely need more staff or better management during brunch events. This was my third time giving this location a chance, and unfortunately I will not be returning.

We drove two hours for brunch to close out my birthday week. We were a party of 14.

There weren’t a lot of brunch options, so most ordered off the regular menu. My Top Class Burger was cooked to perfection—and whatever is in that jerk jam is chef’s kiss. The food overall was absolutely amazing—authentic, flavorful, and worth the drive.

Unfortunately, the service didn’t quite match the food. They definitely need more space, waitstaff, and kitchen staff, as servers were stretched thin playing double and triple duties.

The DJ kept the vibe going and Bingo was a fun touch, but those can only distract so much from slow service.

Highly recommend, but if there’s a themed event happening or it’s during a popular time like Sunday Brunch, plan accordingly.

We ordered a large catering order with this restaurant. The oxtail, curry chicken, brown stew chicken, steamed vegetables and mini beef patties were great. The shrimp Rasta pasta was great, but the price didn’t match the amount of food given. The half size pan was much smaller than your typical half size pan & the cost was $100+ for it! The mac & cheese was very dry, I’d refrain from ordering that as a side dish.

Phenomenal food and experience! The staff is so friendly especially our waitress Kerry! Everything was so good 😊 I had oxtails, jerk chicken and the coconut shrimp. I recommend all three! We also met the owner and he was very welcoming. My cocktail was a Rum Punch made with Wray & Nephew rum. Thank you for the great service!  #authentic

Hands down the BEST Carribean food in Orlando! I drive over 35 minutes just to come here. Staff is always extremely friendly, food is always hot and delicious! I highly recommend you try it if you haven’t already!
Had chicken Soup taste like home cooked Jamaican Soup. My compliment to the chef

Best Jamaican restaurant in Orlando. Their fried chicken is phenominal... Only complaint is that they don't deliver...

The chef is the best I tell you... It doesn't matter where in central florida I am, I will drive to them, simply for the food..

I cannot emphasize enough how delicious the food really is!

Just bursting in perfectly blended flavors.
They are finger licking, fork licking, plate licking good!
I eat here almost everyday. They have the best fried chicken hands down and I’ve never had rice so good keep it up Clarendon. Oh and they are very friendly people with a clean dining area.

Went to this Restaurant for the first time in January,  I called my order in and the customer service was great. Had brown stew fish with rice and peas , it was delish. Real authentic Jamaican cuisine,  they didn't put all those extra things like all the other N amaican restaurant I have eaten from. Definitely recommend this Restaurant. 👌👍👍

My husband and I were in Orlando in early December and made it a point to visit Juici Beef Patties—and it was absolutely worth the 40-minute drive from our hotel. We love Juici patties with coco bread, and these never disappoint. Fresh, flavorful, and delicious!!😀

The service was a mix. One female server wasn’t very pleasant and had a bit of an attitude, which was disappointing. However, a male staff member completely turned the experience around. He was super awesome—kind, patient, and very accommodating. I wanted a mix of mild and spicy patties, and since they only had spicy at the moment, he kindly asked if I preferred to wait until the next batch of mild was ready. That level of customer service really stood out.

We ended up buying a dozen patties to bring back to Georgia! Despite the small service hiccup, Juici Beef Patties remains a must-visit for us whenever we’re in Orlando.

We stopped by on a Sunday afternoon and there was no wait. My hubby ordered the 6-pack and I ordered a spinach patty with avocado, a curry chicken patty, and a spicy beef patty. We also ordered a coco bread, a mango drink, and a dragon fruit drink.

Everything was hot and fresh, like piping hot. I don’t know which patty was better, they were all SO good. The patties are a good size too.

The staff was super friendly as well.

I’m so excited that there’s a Juici Patties in Orlando now! Definitely check them out if you’re in the area 🔥

Very clean inside and outside. Plenty of parking.  Eat outside  or take out but either way you will be glad you stopped to try the food. Guaranteed you'll be back for more. Nene was so pleasant when she served us with a beautiful smile and sweet voice. We bought a combo a mild and a spicy with a drink. The food was bursting with flavor from a giant soft  flaky patti. It was so delicious we went back in to buy another. I love that she wrote on the bag a saying. Just another reason I would return.
Delicious patties! The taste is authentic and fresh ingredients. This is a new location and very clean.

I've been wanting to check this store out since they opened it's a little way from me but I finally made it and I wasn't disappointed the patties hot just as how most Jamaicans like it I choose spicy first two bites I thought it was a bit too spicy but after it tasted how I know juici patties should they also have mild, oh and there coco bread oh my goodness so soft... and if you are wondering does it taste like our authentic Jamaican Juici yesss! It does. And they put cute little notes on the bags.

Hidden Burger is overcooked and not tasty, fries are decent ... Bear claw / cinnamon almond pastry is overrated and overpriced.    My delivery driver was nice enough to go back to get my pastry because they forgot it the first time in my order.

EZ Eats at West Lake Food Co. has terrible customer service. On August 29th, I ordered the Salmon and Shrimp Rasta Pasta, which was so overly seasoned and spicy that it was completely inedible. I attempted to resolve the issue with the business, but received no response. If I could give zero stars, I would.

Ordered from restaurant name StreetNoms Ramen soup miso and curry ramen . We loved them. The Philly cheese steak egg roll was big portions. Mochi donut was surprisingly good! Spicy pork bowl was delicious as well. The chicken wings were big wings. Strawberry lemonade is a bomb !!!!!!!!We will order again.

Amazing gem, a bunch of restaurants under one roof. When you walk in you can order in a table if walking in. And  wait for your food in the waiting area. When your food is ready it comes out in a robot food carrier but the employs behind the counter, hands you your food by calling your name. However, if you food is ready and your not around it's place in a locker. Pro tip  make sure to open you food and make sure it is what you order. Mistakes happens and you could take someone else food home. Clean place inside and out and it, the bathroom was spacious just need to let the cleaners know to pick it the trash when i walk in it was a bit of a mess. Food is great I order from Ez eats Afro food, I order a nice plate of food. However, why is the cornbread the size of the whole platter??? It really was good but it got soggy, and takes half of the plate space  cutting the other portions been place on top in half. For a $26 plate the cornbread should have gone outside of the plate separated. MY THOUGHTS. HOPE IT HELPS SOMEONE ELSE ORDER GREAT FOOD NEVER THE LESS, KEEPING IT REAL. Excellent food and great taste.  I Wish I could try the other restaurants popular  plates.

I ordered Thai steamed dumplings it’s huge! And tasty. Cheese roll and crab curry Rangoon was so creamy!! I like the yellow curry I ordered so amazing
We had mango sticky rice as dessert so yummy.
We ordered from yumfinity viet bite Thai spice at the location! Food came out quick didn’t wait long.
Excellent! Owner came our and ran down what he had. It was still early so settled for 3 beef patties🔥 and 3 saltfish🔥. And they did not disappoint. 👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾

My husband and I were referred her by one of his colleagues, and we ended up grabbing a quick snack.
We got the beef and fish patties, and they were amazing! Fresh, flavorful and packed with meat, we really enjoyed how quickly we were served. We'll definitely be making this one of our regular spots.

Drove by this place and wanted to give it a try. I got jerk chicken with cabbage and Mac and cheese… The chicken was very good and seasoned well. But they didn’t put jerk sauce on top, just gravy from the stew chicken. The rice was good as well. The portion sizes fit the price you pay, which is reasonable. I wanted to try a patty, but they didn’t have any. For the price and the flavor, I’ll definitely return.

*** Best Food We had in Florida ***
This dive is the one thing we can't stop talking about after our most recent visit to Florida. The area seemed a bit rough. Well worth the stop ! The food and fresh juices...... we couldn't get enough. Infact we ordered an entire round to go itvwas so good. The ratings don't do this place justice.
This evening was my first time here. I rarely eat oxtail, i love my goat. All of the food was delicious, oxtail, mac and cheese and veggies. I will be back again

name: POLO CHICKEN CARIBBEAN RESTAURANT AND BAR

I had the Cuban sandwich, coleslaw & unsweetened mango tea. Food was good & lady at the counter was friendly and pleasant. I enjoyed my visit today!

Good food but way too expensive, all that were over 37$ along with a grenadia drink.

I ordered an oxtail entrée from Caribbean Sunshine Bakery, and according to the menu description it clearly says the meal is served with rice & peas or white rice, steamed veggies or salad, fried plantains, and dumpling. However, I received absolutely none of that, just a small portion of oxtails by themselves. Which was spilling everywhere.

When I called the restaurant, the lady on the phone tried to argue with me and claimed I needed to select the sides, even though there was no option anywhere to do so. Instead of apologizing or trying to make things right, she told me I would have to purchase the sides separately, which makes no sense since they’re listed as part of the entrée.
The oxtails themselves tasted good, but the service was awful and completely unprofessional. DoorDash only refunded me $3.33, which doesn’t come close to fixing the issue.

I will never order from this place again. Terrible communication and zero accountability.
I ordered the oxtail plate and this was what I got. I've never had boiled dumpling with oxtail at a restaurant but I wasn't mad at it.

The prices here are great and they have many different options for patties! I did like the chicken 🐔 and beef 🥩 ones better from their competitor though, as I thought the flavor could’ve been better. I would stop by here to try the other ones again!
TikTok Reviewer: acaicaitlin

Absolutely love this place. Nice people buy from there and nice people work there. Food is fantastic, huge drink selection, they sell bread as well, and have a nice dessert selection as well. My favorite is the curry shrimp and curry chicken with rice and peas, cabbage, a mild beef patty, and cream soda.
I love the food, vibes and top notch customer service. Allison is always so pleasant and friendly. Food always on point 5 ⭐️’s

I was very disappointed with my order. The food did not taste good, and I even found hair in the pork meat, which was very unpleasant. The lalo was also way too spicy and had a bad taste. Overall, I was not satisfied with this meal and would not recommend it. I really hope the restaurant can improve the quality and cleanliness of the food. When will you start doing better in your business? Customers deserve good, clean, and tasty food.

So I walked into this place with the idea knowing I love Chinese food! I guess during my review of the place the paranoia sets in and the guy starts sweating like in a worrysome way! He was really rude and the restaurant also lacked a restroom I could use. The vibe was stale at the time and I think they need to revamp their customer service as a priority.
You get a one star review for trying to rush me out of your restaurant.
If I could rate « 0 », I would!! Bad customer service! We ordered an oxtail and it was watery and disgusting . We also ordered a rague beef foot. Pa bon du tout. Avoid going at all cost.

If i could put zero stars in this place i would. This girl with the long curly braids, didnt greet me when i came in, the girl was giving attitude and answering the questions with attitude. Find better employees. I asked her a question and she cant even speak up and answer correctly like she bebe or something. Never again am i coming to this oak ridge location.
