Well my food was delicious.. Girls were very friendly.. my family loved our dinner 🥰
The turkey ,Goat was delicious and the rice and beans 🥰
I thoroughly enjoyed my meal. My meal was packed with great authentic Haitian flavor, and priced very decently for the amount of food received. New go to spot for sure!

Oxtails are the bomb! Round the corner from the warehouse.  Huge portions.  Was suggested by a trusted local.  So happy I decided to try this homey little spot. Not much seating but you can take out. All the food was good. Plantains were perfect and meat pies too.  Will be back for sure.

I like there food menu. These are nice people. They listen to a lot of Christian music and speak Creole. They serve me very well. They sometime make me laugh. I went inside of restaurant and they blast there music that was on tv. It was like a church show and it was playing Christian Haitian music. I don't know what happen there someone must pissed them off.
Not the best haitian food. Its okay. The legume definitely not the best legume. The rice is really good though. $12 plate

Today was my first time here i ordered the chicken meal and my food smelled like fish. I’m pretty sure y’all used the same oil you fried the fish to fry the chicken and that is not okay because if i was allergic to fish that would cause me to be sick. I really hated the fact i had to smell that fishy smell because i don’t like fish and i hate the smell. The chicken had no seasoning. Where’s the epsi on it to make it good? It seems like it was deep fried and not boiled before frying it. I was disappointed most in the fact my chicken smelled like fish. The rice was good and plantain was extra because i added it it was good too. The only bad thing was the chicken and i wasn’t sure what sauce you give me with the food.

This was my first visit since the renovation/move from across the street. When they were at the old location I did not like the food at all, it was bland. I had some family in town that convinced the group to come here and at first I was apprehensive but I’m glad I gave them another shot. I got stew chicken with rice and peas. They give a fair portion size and they have decent prices. The stew chicken was juicy and had a good spicy flavor to it. I did not enjoy the rice however. It tasted like parboiled rice which I don’t like and it was a bit more on the softer side almost mushy. I prefer my rice and peas to be shelly not soft. My other family members got jerk chicken. They said they enjoyed it and it was also spicy nicely seasoned. Next time I’ll try the oxtail plate or the oxtail rasta pasta which looked really good. We ate in stores and I’m glad we came at the time we did (about 2:10-2:15pm) bc right after we paid for our meals a bunch of people came and they were waiting for a really long time. As we ate it didn’t seem like the line was moving at all. At one point all of the workers went into the back and no one was serving food. I guess it’s a hit or miss if you’ll be there a while. The restaurant is clean with a decent amount of seating area both inside and outside.

I love this place. I drive 40 minutes to go to this particular location. The service is great. The food is amazing. I really love that book sometime. I just drive over there for the jerk pork and a large red bean soup which is so good all their soups are good. I eat their pretty frequentbecause it taste like New York Jamaican food to me but check them out. They are really nice people there.

Great place. I love Golden Krust ....especially their beef patties. The service was decent. We ordered curry goat and curry chicken entres, red peas soup, bun and cheese, plantain, and sodas ( ginger beer etc). They served us in a timely fashion and were polite.

Mouth watering and amazing service!!! They had so much to choose from that taste just like the islands. Superb service from the girls with a smile. This place has drinks from the islands and everything was made fresh. The jerk meat pie was flaky and tasty. The ribs were full of flavor and lots of meat. The cabbage had just enough snap and lots of flavor too. You have to try this place!

Ordered some oxtails from them on Uber Eats and was mightily impressed with how delicious everything was. The oxtails were amazing,cabbage was delisious and mac and cheese was perfect. Prices were fair and overall I highly enjoyed the experience. Highly recommended!

Went in with soup on my mind but I notice the soup was sitting on the counter along with the jerk chicken and not in a warmer as I ordered my soup small and jerk chicken small I noticed the server just started putting water in the warmer just started turning on the warmer. I asked her is my soup gonna be cold or my chicken she said no but then before she bagged it up and try to charge me I felt the soup was very cold to almost room temperature She asked me if I wanted to get it warmed up. I told her yes she went in the back came back in the soup was still cold. Food especially soup should not be sold cold do better with food temperature I will not be going to this location was very disappointed

I got a large oxtail 2 drinks and one coco bread. Spent 37$ portion size was nice, flavor was not the greatest but I was hungry so I ate it. After about 30/45 minutes of eating the food I have been in the bathroom since. It’s horrible and I let my daughter have some and it’s affecting her too. I will never come here again. I feel so bad I let my daughter get some.
I’ve tried a lot of different food and thus far this restaurant is my favorite place to go to,  excellent customer service and not to mention the food …  I highly recommend this place…

reviews.text: The Vegan spot wasn’t open yet, so I found this little gem at the Lexington Market and I was pleasantly pleased. I got the Fufu, Peanut Stew, and half Egusi/Spinach and it was delicious! I definitely recommend Amala and the service was great as well! Very courteous and I will be returning for sure. Thank you!
Very friendly location, delicious nigerian in west african foods sold here 😋 11/4/25

Extremely unprofessional business. They ran out of an item and failed to notify me, leaving me waiting over an hour until they closed. I don't know what happened, but the food isn't good anymore. 3 weeks ago it blew my mind, but now the curry tastes watered down and they added potatoes to it for some reason? Flavor completely gone. Last week I tried the stewed chicken and the meat was old/dry. I'm also pretty sure they used turkey, not chicken. It was uncharacteristically huge and looked like cheap GMO meat.

Food absolutely horrible. The bag was dripping with excessive grease and so was the food. I ordered spinach without meat and yam. I get this dish from other places that was closed  today. Thought I try here. Never ever again.
All our order was so on point. The service was top notch.  Thanks for the african food you're giving us.the taste is so good.

First off… The food is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! I’m not from this area so when I found a place to get my favorite, I jumped on it. The packaging needs a lot of work.. it does not hold up at all. The only food packaging they did great with was the Suya. The amount of Suya you get for the prices doesn’t match up either.. will I eat there again?! Maybe.. it all depends on what kind of time I have to go somewhere else.

I’ve ordered here a few times and the suya is always good and cooked well (not over cooked like the Towson location). The place is well-kept and clean. Customer service is good, the staff is always pleasant, food is ready fast, and packaged well. The food is pricey and portion sizes are highly debatable by anyone’s standards given the cost. I’ve always found the beef in the stew to consistently be tough and over cooked which is quite annoying- especially for the cost. It’s nice to have a place to order Nigerian food in a pinch, but you will pay for it. They offer a modest rewards program.

I bought food worth of $160.
If you have a big appetite, this place is not for you. Their pounded Yam comes in small sizes. You have to pay separately for the stew to eat the rice you ordered.  The rice don't come with stew even if you ordered for the meat.
So I got rice and beans with assorted meat with absolutely no stew in it. How do you expect someone to eat rice with no sauce.
The only sauce I got was the ayamase sauce. The rest of the orders came with only the protein in it and no single sauce with it. When I called them, I was told I had to order the stew or sauce separately.  I have never experienced such a service like that before.
You have to pay for sauce that is supposed to come with the complete meal? That is crazy!
The food is extremely pricey for it not to make sense.
The atmosphere is beautiful but the food isn't worth it.
Will definitely not return back.

The restaurant's ambiance is top-notch. However, I agree with other reviewers that the food price is steep. The food did taste good, but I was taken back that we had to pay $14 to eat there. That didn't make sense to me but we paid. The guy that attended to us was nice.

The decor is top notch and has always been. Very clean environment and food display/presentation was great. I have been here a few times and I’m always wowed by the interior decorations. The food has never disappointed either but this place is slightly priced higher than typical West African carry out place. It’s easily a high end restaurant so bare that in mind when you see the price.

I see lots of negative reviews about gratuity being added to bill and I think the owner should address the issue to avoid confusion. Someone else complained about shrink wrap on the swallow when they warm up the food, not great. My only negative experience was that my plantain was delivered to the table after I was done eating. There’s always room for improvement but this restaurant is a positive representation of naija culture and resourcefulness so they have all my 5 star plus more.

Note: The level of spice is intense so thread carefully.

My wife and I had lunch here on a Sunday.  We were greeted warmly as we made our order and all questions we had were answered in a friendly and amiable manner.  The staff showed real appreciation for our business and went out of their way to make sure everything was good with us.

The food was ABSOLUTELY WONDERFUL.  I had the lamb chops and my wife had the steak plate.  We both had the spinach, I had the rice and stew with Plantains, she had the Jollof Rice with Plantains.  Everything was delicious.  Perfectly seasoned and prepared.

The restaurant is beautifully appointment with images and patterns of Africa and it's painted in a beautiful dark orange.

Truly an extraordinary dining experience.

I also grabbed the Goat Eggrolls to go.  Fantastic.

Explore Baltimore - Spice Kitchen West African Grill

Spice Kitchen West African Grill is a popular restaurant in the DC/Baltimore area (DMV) known for authentic, modern West African street food, especially Suya (spicy marinated grilled meats/seafood) and flavorful dishes like Jollof Rice, Efo Riro (spinach stew), and Spice Honey Wings, aiming to celebrate West African culture and connect community through bold, accessible cuisine.
What it offers:

Signature Dishes: Chicken Suya, Lamb Chop Suya, Salmon Suya, Shrimp Suya, Spice Honey Wings, Asun Goat Egg Rolls, and tender Spice Honey Ribs.
Sides: Famous Jollof Rice, Fried Plantains, and Spinach (Efo Riro).
Drinks: Refreshing options like Zobo (hibiscus) Lemonade and Mango Passionfruit Lemonade.
Concept: Blends fast-casual style with traditional West African flavors, offering comfort food, quick bites, and family-friendly options.

Key Points:

Owner: Olumide Shokubi, a Nigerian-American, started it from a ghost kitchen to introduce his culture's food.
Locations: Has physical spots in Hyattsville, MD, and Baltimore, MD, with pop-ups sometimes appearing in other areas.
Mission: To elevate African cuisine, build community, and educate people about West African flavors.

In essence, Spice Kitchen is a destination for delicious, spice-forward West African food that's both authentic and appealing to a broader audience.
If you're interested in trying it, would you like to know about their specific location in Hyattsville or Baltimore, or perhaps see a sample menu?

This meal was honestly delicious. The suya beef and chicken were well-seasoned, smoky, and full of flavor and had a nice kick to it. You could taste that classic suya seasoning in every bite, and the meat was tender and cooked just right to perfection.

The jollof rice was also rich and flavorful, just how good jollof should be. It wasn’t dry, and it had that familiar taste like it was made in someone’s home. The plantains were sweet, soft, and perfectly fried, which balanced out the spices from the suya and jollof really well. I will definitely come again whenever I am on that side of town.
I see a lot of reviews saying it’s too pricey. The price is completely justified in the quantity and quality of the food in my opinion. The corn is AMAZING. I will definitely be back.

This place is amazing! The staff was very friendly and their food was delicious. The original spice level was perfect for me. I also love that they use self-service kiosks and don’t ask for tips. The menu pricing clearly reflects equitable pay for the staff, which I really appreciate and am happy to support. On top of that, the portion sizes are generous. I can’t wait to go back and try their other entrees. Highly recommend.

Nailah’s Kitchen was amazing! My fiancé and I had a wonderful time. The owner has such a beautiful spirit, and the food was outstanding. Hands down the best jollof in the DMV area—we’ll definitely be returning soon!

Food was delicious. Me and my family really enjoyed the quiet setting. The staff was very nice and friendly. I ordered the tilapia and broccoli . The garnish was perfect. The sorrel was very tasty. Definitely worth the price you get a great portion size of food . I would recommend this place. Especially if you love African food. I will be back to visit ! 😋😍.. to be continue I came back here for a date in late August it was very nice the food was good my second time here.. came back my third time earlier in November of this month we did take out foods always good . Service is always good .

I chose this spot to go to after my graduation ceremony. Overall, my family and I had a great experience. Our server was very kind and attentive. The atmosphere was very aesthetically pleasing. The food was great, it was my first time trying Senegalese food and I was not disappointed! I tried a lamb dish and it was very tasty. The pineapple ginger drink was very good. I would highly recommend.

I was in town with my family doing a college tour and we looked up this place since we were hungry.  Let me tell you this Senegalese place was the highlight of the day. We walked in and the owner greeted up and was the nicest man you could meet.  We had a few questions and he patiently answered all of them. The food was OUTSTANDING. We had the Dibi chicken, Dibi lamb and the Mechoui.  All were well seasoned and you had a choice of mild or spicy. We went with spicy with the chicken and mild with the rest.  We also had the seasoned rice.   Everything was great there wasn't one wrong thing with the entire experience.   This is truly a 10/10 place, if you get a chance to visit when you're in the area don't hesitate!

A great spot to eat after a movie at the Senator. We enjoyed the lamb shank and fish dishes. Beautifully spiced, large portions and delicious appetizers and sides.

Friendly owner, clean and comfortable, inviting, modern decor.

If i could give this business less stars I would.  The woman at the counter has a vile attitude and the food she gave me was inedible. I ordered egusi with chicken and the chicken was rock hard. It could barely be pulled apart. You can tell when someone takes pride in the food they serve and their culture. This clearly is not the case here. I had to throw half of my food out it was so bad. 0/10. I do not recommend. Save yourself the $25-$30. There’s a sign that says no refunds so choose wisely.

Do NOT spend your money at a place that treats Black customers unfairly.

The food here is usually okay, but the service is consistently awful. During my recent visit, the woman behind the counter came out to confront me after I asked a simple question. I ordered my food and asked for the price. She pointed to a small monitor and said, “It’s right there!” I have a vision impairment that makes it difficult for me to read certain displays, but I typically keep that private. I didn’t see the price on the monitor, so I politely asked her to tell me.

Instead of answering, she snapped, “Oh, you cannot see!?” She still never told me the price. At that point, I told her to cancel the order. She then came from behind the counter and said, “You people always doing this!”

That comment made it clear to me that she holds prejudice against Black Americans. I will never eat here again. My decision may not impact their business, but it will certainly protect my peace.

Omgggggg first time trying this kind of food and I’m soooo thankful I came here !!! Won’t be my last time. Food was freshly cooked and made with love 10/10 . Egusi and fufu.. with fish is a must try . I will be back

Beulah Africa Restaurant serves up some of the most soul-satisfying Nigerian dishes I've ever tasted. The egusi soup,okro soup with goat meat, and fish—is rich, flavorful, and deeply comforting. You can tell every dish is made with love and tradition.

Order Okra Stew and this was the best i had delivered to me. Will be my go to from now on. The meat was not dry and they gave decent portion sizes. Had to add this before i finished it all. Went back for a second time and the food is still amazing and the flavors are beyond. The chef does a great job at keeping the food fresh

The food is delicious. Very friendly cook and owner. The price is very reasonable and the jollof rice meal is amazing. $15. I placed my order on phone and was ready on time for pickup. I recommend this restaurant.
It’s would been great if I had fresh chicken I had to throw away my chicken and only had soup chicken was so old and dried my swallow was great

Food is so amazing!
First time eating from this wonder African Restaurant, and trying African food. The food is amazing and hot when delivered. I will definitely be ordering from here again.

Ordered the pepper soup with extra Fufu for $17. A little pricey for smaller portion but was tasty. If you don’t like spice don’t bother coming, very well seasoned.

Will be returning. 10/10.

The food was good but we were missing a part of our meal. I think there was a misunderstanding with what we ordered! I would still recommend, just make sure you get what you ordered by checking the bag.

I'm so disappointed in the quality of food I received, it was not fresh, like it was taken from the freezer and reheated. I placed my order 7pm if the food was finished for the day , I'm a very reasonable person and would have ordered another day, but to take my money and give me old food is not acceptable.  However I'm willing to give her another chance to redeem the disappointed that was caused from old food.

Update: She never disappoints! I got ayamase stew rice this time and it was soooo DELICIOUS!!!!!! Until next time...😊

I had the BEST experience!!! The customer service was GREAT! The food was soooo goodt! 1000/10! Would definitely recommend! The food taste so fresh ESPECIALLY the JOLLOF rice! 😊

I gave a 4 stars due to customer service. I went there on a Sunday and I guess there was no fresh food made that day. I visited from Atlanta and I wanted something close to home. I don't understand why ayamase stew only had about 3 little pieces of liver, an egg with one strong tiny gbomo i couldn't  chew and lots of oil. I was disappointed at the stew and the meatless stew. The rice was a lot and soup was a full plate. I just didn't enjoy the food. The seafood okra soup was not fresh.  I was just disappointed.

Today was my first time ordering from here. My first time tasting goat in the Euigisi soup and everything was delicious! Service was great and professional as well. I would highly recommend. Thank you!!

OMG THE FOOD WAS SO GOOD!!! The customer service was amazing and I even tried new foods that I’ve never had! I ordered egusi with fish, afang soup with chicken a meat pie and fufu! If I could give 1000 stars I would! Even my kids love the food, I definitely recommend Shai’s Keecheen LLC

I was REALLY REALLY excited to try this place. I was in the area snagging free books with my friend at the Book Thing of Baltimore and my friend and I came here after. I ordered half jollof rice and half spaghetti, suya beef, and then spicy slaw on the side. I also got the passion fruit ginger drink to complement my drink. My food was SOOOO GOOD. The spaghetti and rice was GASS. The suya was delicious. My friend got chicken and it was sooooo good, I definitely need to get chicken next time. There are so many options for sides and sauces to add - I didn't know what to pick. My biggest critique is that I would like them to have toppings that are cooked/warm. I chose not to get any toppings. My friend got corn and it was cold. I do think they should swap their current toppings with steamed corn, sautéed onions, etc. We spent about $21-22 for a bowl and a drink, and with the amount we are paying, I feel like they should fill our bowl up more.

Everyone was super nice and cool. Service was smooth and quick. There was a decent line when we arrived but it moves fast, we probably waiting about 10 mins but that's not too bad with how long the line was. This place is in the food hall, so there's plenty of seating to eat. I would definitely come back when I'm in the area and try a different combination.

I stopped by Jollof Bowl on a whim and I’m glad I did. The jollof rice was on point flavorful, not dry, not bland, just right. Everything tasted fresh and well-seasoned, the kind of food you keep thinking about after you’re done eating.

What really stood out to me was how comfortable the place felt. No rush, no attitude, just good food and good energy. If you’re tired of eating the same things and want something that actually has flavor and soul, this spot is worth the stop. Definitely adding this to my Baltimore rotation. OH LAWDD

I went to Jollof Bowl with some skepticism at first, but I have to say I was pleasantly surprised!

The food was absolutely delicious — the jollof rice was perfectly seasoned, and the variety of dishes they offer was just right. The portions were huge, and everything was cooked to perfection.

What really stood out to me was the price — four of us ordered a ton of food, with plenty of extras, and it came out to less than $100. Talk about a steal! I can’t recommend this place enough, especially if you’re in the mood for something flavorful and filling without breaking the bank. Definitely will be coming back!

I learned about Jollof Bowl from a post on Instagram. It looked interesting, so I sent it to a friend who also enjoyed these foods. She said "When are we going?", and so we went the next day.

Like others have said, the food is delicious. They are not stingy with their portions, and the food has genuine spice to it. They made it feel like home cooking.

I would definitely come through again.

Located inside Charles street market . The menu is easy to read and line moves along not too long of a wait . You will have to find seating in a booth . I ordered the chicken bowl with rice and noodles . The chicken was cooked good and not over seasoned same as the rice and the noodles are spaghetti which was different but tasted great. I would just recommend a better drink selection like maybe bottled water and or a juice or tea , the only beverage offering is a variety of non alcoholic ginger beer . Parking is not that great since it’s downtown Baltimore.

YO, BALTIMORE—DROP EVERYTHING AND RUN TO PAPARAZZI GRILL ON PARK HEIGHTS AVE RIGHT NOW!!! 😱🇳🇬 This place is straight-up THE BEST-KEPT NAIJA SECRET in the whole city—authentic West African fire that will RUIN all other food for you!!! I swear on everything, I walked in last week and the aromas SLAPPED me in the face like “Welcome home!” 🍲💥
The JOLLOF RICE??? OH. MY. GOD. 🤯 Perfectly smoky, that legendary party-jollof char, spiced to PERFECTION—not greasy, just pure magic! Paired it with the grilled peppered fish platter and I’m still dreaming about it: flaky fish exploding with spice, crispy fried plantains that melt in your mouth, fresh coleslaw, and that zesty sauce that ties it all together like a boss. PORTIONS SO MASSIVE I ate like a king and had leftovers for days!!! 👑🍚
Then I hit the BEEF SUYA—thin slices marinated in secret spices, grilled to smoky perfection, loaded with onions, tomatoes, and cucumber. NUTTY, SPICY KICK that had me sweating and smiling!!! 🌶️🔥 Everything halal, super fresh, made with LOVE.
Staff? Like family—incredibly friendly, quick service, chatting and hyping your order. Spot is clean, cozy vibes (even if it’s small), prices are an absolute STEAL ($10-15 for platters that DESTROY fancy chains), and parking is easy-peasy.
If you’re in Park Heights, Pimlico, or anywhere in Bmore—SKIP the overpriced downtown spots!!! This is where the real locals feast. I’m already addicted… next visit: ASUN ALL THE WAY!!! Baltimore, we NEEDED this gem!!! 🌟🌟🌟 #JollofKings #NaijaFire #BaltimoreEats #WestAfricanBmore #PaparazziGrillOrBust #FoodgasmAlert 🍴🇳🇬💯
Like a African people it sound like a ai make it sound like a Nigeria people

The good: This was probably the tastiest Turkey wing I’ve had, The Jolloff rice was so delicious..

The Bad: They only except cards no cash. I do thank them for making the exception since I travel a long way.

The Ugly: While the Turkey wing was so Flavorful it ruined the experience because it was cold. But not warm, because of my travel but cold as it was stored in a refrigerator or maybe even a freezer. It’s was warm on the outside but the core and around the bone was refrigerator cold. This is not acceptable, I am not sure if I will try it again.

The plantains were dried out like they could have been reheated as well.

I usually don't write reviews but with me being someone who has had a deep appreciation for African food since trying it for the very first time a few years back, I have to say that I really appreciate all the love that was put into this food in terms of taste, and the aesthetic and presentation of the food is definitely something to appreciate and I will definitely be ordering again. Thank you!

Also, if you happen to be congested but would still like to have something flavorful, their jollof rice and it's spices are definitely the answer for that problem 😉

Side Note: my food choice was a platter that came with peppered fish w/jollof rice and a side of plantain. I also bought a separate side of Plantain because I didn't know beforehand that the platter already had plantain included, but I was glad I did because my platter came with so much rice to save for later and I'll have more plantain on the side to go with it 😊

I don't even know where to start, it's has been about two years since I started coming here. I do  go there once in a while but I started noticing a downward trend in the quality of the food and atmosphere. My last four visits within the last 3 months, I noticed a very unpleasant smell inside the place. It has a stench of mold, or a cracked vent piping. I average about $65 during my visit there for a carryout order. This last time yesterday, I bought jollof rice, fried rice and goat meat, fortunately or unfortunately they were out of moin-moin. On my way home, I started smelling a faint sour smell, when I got home I noticed that the smell was coming from the food. Due to the time of day and distance, I couldn't go back there. Upon further investigation, I noticed it was a little slimy. I felt so bothered about the whole situation, I'm surprised the lady at the counter could sell a spoilt food. I understand the owner has some other takeout restaurants, but why neglect one for the other. At this point, I wouldn't recommend this place.
Delicious, well cooked food, everything food is here, and I enjoyed my food. Best takeout restaurant in the DMV area!

The food here is EXCELLENT😋 and the owner Femi is  awesome! Haven’t met his wife yet but I’m  sure she’s amazing! She does the majority of the cooking. So my hubby and I visited when they first opened this summer and tried the Steak Suya Platter and it was absolutely delicious!!!
The platters here are very hardy and the food is flavored to the bone!! I decided to use Jembis Grillz to cater my brother’s wedding and all I kept hearing was how flavorful and delicious everything was! Our orders were ready on time and packaged well for the 1hour travel time. Femi even called later on to make sure everything was to our liking. Now that’s FIVE STAR customer service and appreciation! Definitely a must try if you enjoy Nigerian cuisine. Oh and you can control the spice levels, that was a plus for me!

One of the best place to get good and tasty african food. Lovely and neat environment with soft music to entertain customers while enjoying their meals. A place to be. You can't get it wrong with Jembis

I went to Jembis a couple of weeks ago, and i picked up a shawarma appropriately called Nigerian Shawarma and some suya. I see how people would like the Nigerian Sharwarma, i enjoyed it especially the sauce, i wish it had more meat tho. The suya was also delectable solid enough. I will go the again.

Absolutely spectacular, from food to customer service to overall ambiance. This place was lovely and delicious and as a first timer, the gentleman help in the front led me in the right direction. This place is fantastic and so unbelievably authentic. Thank you so much for being so welcoming. I will be dining here again soon!!

Impressed with the services here, Jembis suggested we tried the Suya Sharwama and Zino. It was very tasty and rich ! Naija standard sharwama

I highly you recommend you visit..

I try to support local small businesses but this is beyond ridiculous. Now which kind scam this be o?! I tried to give this place 1 last try and again I’m disappointed. The food and quantity used to be good and worth the money but now since they moved to this bigger location, they’ve increased the prices ($17 per combo) and decreased the portions of food. Extremely unethical. Not only have they increased the prices they charge EXTRA $4 for 1 piece of meat such as beef, goat, and Pomo (cow skin) etc... PER PIECE!! Small pieces at that. No bigger than an .50 cent piece.. And more bone than meat. Even the moi moi is $3 for a mouthwash cup size each. I ordered 1 order and was charged $6 for 2 little cups..When the website clearly states 2 pieces for $3.. RIDICULOUS! They never have puff puff or meat pies. The prices change daily regardless of what the website says. There’s always an excuse. Even the jollof is tasting different. Honestly that was the only reason I was patronizing this place because of the rice. No longer will I after this final attempt .. So don’t order and think you’ll get what you see advertised on their website or the price shown.. lai lai..  on top of that they are extremely slow. It’ll take over an hour after you place your order, even if you want to dine in.  I ordered an efo combo it had a plantain sticker in it. Yuck!  GBEGIRI-EWEDU should have assorted meats but nope they are charging for each piece. Ordered this as well and of course Looks nothing like the advertised picture. ALL The portions are extremely small no matter which combo or side you order.  Other small businesses aren’t trying to bust your head with over charging and give you tiny portions.. These containers aren’t the large size and definitely aren’t filled up. If you call in to order and ask for a total,  they tell you to call back in 10-15 mins about 3xs.. why? When you go pick up the order something is always missing. ALWAYS! It’s not even worth it anymore. They should humble themselves and stop cheating people. If people stop patronizing their business then they will rethink business ethics. I won’t waste money here again.  I’ll spend my money at the Jamaican or Latino spot. I won’t be disappointed about the portions. Buyer Beware!!

DoorDash order. The asaro was not asaroing. More like old yam n stew mixed together to say they had asaro. I literally picked it up like a chicken nugget. The meat was fried good but flavorless. The ayamase looked disgusting, smelled spoilt and only had fatty parts. I didn’t even bother with that. The rice was mid and the only thing that was great was the $4 piece of chicken. Pls update menu to say “one choice of” and not “one of each”. Kind of wild to pay $4 for a piece of chicken when a pack of obasanjo is like 6 bucks… but I get it convenience. I wish I could have tried the moin moin and meat pie because maybe that would have been redeeming because these reviews gave me high hopes. Overall trash, inedible and a waste of $55.33, but a lesson in laziness…Who sent me to go order food I can make myself? Really disappointed though.. This can’t be Nigerians making this food.
The service was pleasant. The atmosphere was comfortable and clean. The food was fresh and seasoned well.
This restaurant need complete renovation. You can see flies flying around. Chef/server/ host all was handled by one person. Kitchen look dirty from outside. Food was not good at all.

My husband and I visited. The egusi and fufu was great. It was recommended that I have it with both vegetable and beef which was a good combination. We even took food home for later.  Definitely want to come back soon!

name: Saviour African Food Restaurant And Catering

reviews.text: this the 2nd time I ordered for delivery and got the wrong order, the 1st time I ordered I got the wrong soup and meat and no drink, instead of chicken they gave me 2small fatty beef meat. I even called twice in advance to make sure they don't mess my order again and the older guy called "Zee" assured me I'll be fine only to realize It was a Lie, i got the wrong soup and meat again. They never even gave me the 5$ Ginger juice drink he said I would, instead gave me 1$ ginger ale can soda!? This was no mistake but intentional,rude and disrespectful. You can see the food presentation itself looks messy n small like Cat food, it went to the trash. I had to order again from a different restaurant on the same belair rd. Be warned!

My first time getting takeout here last night & the food was good and hot! I only took a few bites when I left (due to my fast) and it knocked me right out lol. The cashier was very nice and patient with me while taking my order, and I didn’t wait long for the food to come out either. The plantains were soft and sweet just how I like it. The jollof rice was good, but I would’ve loved it to be super spicy (I love very spicy foods lol) but the curry goat was very spicy just like I requested & the meat was tender and juicy. Very reasonable prices too! If takeout slaps like that, I could only imagine what the dine-in experience will give🤩 I will definitely be back!!

Hidden gym in Baltimore! Don’t expect the red carpet treatment; however, staff are helpful in assisting you with making a food selection. Very clean and great musical vibes.

Food: every-time I’ve come, I’ve always tried to order something different. To try new and exotic things. Always happy and satisfied. FLAVORFUL, tender, and hot. I have no complaints. The food has gotten smaller over the last year but I’m still left satisfied.
*Try the OHA soup
My food was fresh and delicious! I only got chicken and rice,  but it was good! Chicken was nice and spicy, the plantain and was rice was nicely seasoned. I would definitely go back and get more.

Food: Equsi Soup with 2 meat (goat) and Pounded Yam Fufu
Comments: It was our first time trying and it was very good and unique. The fufu had a great consistency and the soup tasted very good. Price was affordable for amount of food.

My experience was not the greatest to be honest and I wasn’t too surprised because the reviews had hinted that. I got different Nigerian foods and none of them hit the “very good” rate for me. They were just very basic and quite overpriced. The suya was very dry, like very dry and the food aesthetic is actually a 1-start. For a restaurant that charges $26 for a dish, I expect you to use actual plates and not plastic plates and spoons to serve. The fact that the food does not also come with water for a dine-in- common!

The asun was just okay but very small for the price.

I will not be returning to the restaurant. It has several potentials for market at its current Towson location but I think it needs an evaluation of food taste, customer service, presentation, prices, to mention but a few.

Having been a soldier and traveling the entire globe I can consider myself a picky experienced food connoisseur. So I must reject some of the other reviews and share my own experience. The staff were thankful, polite, informative, and the food was ready relatively quickly.  The flavor varies between your own choices of heat and/spice levels.  My wife had shrimp suya and fish suya and jollof and loved it. I had the egusi with meat/pounded yam, and turkey tips.

The restaurant was clean. The bathrooms were clean. The ambience was delightful. The music was entertaining, and they boxed up our food before departing (huge in my book). Also, the restaurant is BYOB!! We cannot wait for the outside area to be open in the summer.

Extremely expensive $22  flavorless food. Tough meat seasonless tasteless jollof egussi was very spicy but still had no good flavor. Smelled weird very small bowl for $21 paid. Almost $50 for a disgusting meal never again

Amazing! Happened to be in the area and saw the restaurant and took a chance.  I am sorry to disagree from the other recent reviews here. But, we all have our opinions. This food was just great! My husband and I have dined worldwide and I’m not exaggerating. I consider him a picky eater. The fish soya, egusi, turkey wings (my husband had), and jollof were extremely flavorful. The staff were polite and even boxed up our meals after we dined in. That is hard to find anywhere these days! Give them a try.

Very terrible and horrible foods. Extremely expensive and displeased with the services. We drove very far away to try this restaurant for the very first time. Extremely limited foods they have at this restaurant. When you plan to eat out or dine in, NEVER order from here. Do not go here when hungry or craving African/Nigerian foods. Because you will be very UNHAPPY! Ridiculously more expensive than other African restaurants we have ever visited. All their foods are open and COLD inside the restaurant! The bow of fried rice tastes NOTHING like Fried Rice, we all know. Be WARNED ⚠️!!!

ONLY good thing about this restaurant is that the environment is OK and private parking space.

name: Foodsleeve African Restaurant and Catering Service

reviews.text: I bought egussi  and Efo riro today it was yummy.It was prepared by the time I got there (I called ). Will definitely be back when am in Baltimore. Plenty of parking too and price is affordable

The food is really good! I got jollof, fried rice with tilapia, turkey. Got beans and corn, ayamase sauce. Very delicious and fresh!
Only thing is make sure you call ahead to place your order, it’s not a dine in restaurant.
I fully recommend the food!

"Food Sleeve in Essex delivers an authentic taste of Africa! With a wide variety of choices, their dishes truly capture the essence of African cuisine. Eating their food is like taking a culinary journey to Africa, and I highly recommend it to anyone craving the real deal."

Although this is home based, my family enjoyed the food. We'll be trying other dishes. Hopefully they're able to get a brick establishment and or food truck at some point if that's their desire. Times are tough so nothing wrong with starting where you are. I wish them well.

What a phenomenal experience with Foodsleeve amazing gourmet yummy African meals. Concisely, I always order food for myself as well as my out of state guests at Foodsleeve and we are never disappointed no matter what food we ordered as the food is always superb. Foodsleeve ihas definitely earned a lifetime customer in me! The service experience is excellent!

Experience:
It’s always a great and excellent experience ordering African food from Foodsleeve. I’m always delighted with my orders, no matter what I order, the food is always freshly prepared and hot, yummy and fantastic.
The Amala and Semo with Efo Riro and ewedu with gbegiri and Efo elegisi are out of this world, my favorites, though, omg, they gives you that absolute rich 9ja flavor able taste that opens up your tastebuds and importantly the meals comes at a very reasonable and affordable Price. I wouldn't hesitates to recommend Foodsleeve to anyone anytime,  any day! Big kudos to Foodsleeve! Highly recommended!

After my dad chemo's treatment. We always take turns choosing somewhere to eat before we get back on the road. For the 2 hours drive home. I was surprised when my dad chose this african restaurant Bossb 4517 Bowleys Ln, Baltimore, MD 21206 Because I'd love African cuisine food. It's one of my favorite cultural food. We stop here at Bossb African Restaurant. My dad and his wife wasn't too pleased. It was just ok for them. I ate when I got home. The food was good.The flavors was there, but very, very small portions that I got for $30.72 Appetizers: Asun=$7.99 Entrée: Abula On Spot with assorted meats =  $19.99 which I attached pictures below. I wasn't expecting for my order to be loaded with food. Upon checking my order before before leaving the restaurant . It was unbelievable I could not believe what I had received and paid for  😳. So I approached the young man behind the counter and ask him was this My order and he said yes. In a very kind and respectful voice. I was like wow in disbelief.  I said OK respectfully tied the bag back up and left to never return. We did received  great customer service.The atmosphere was  good.  Parking lot was very limited. 4  parking space Which made it very hard and difficult to park

Let’s talk about the lady behind the fantastic food first. From the first time I entered the owner has been a blessing to know and eat from. She is a fantastic spirt and chef. The food is hands down the best and the love in each ingredient while preparing the food is great. I suggest you stop by immediately to enjoy lunch and dinner. This African cuisine has a home cooked taste, the food is a plus for me!!!

I ordered through DoorDash. I ordered white rice with Ayamase, jollof rice, Efo riro and pepper soup. The rice is okay but the Ayamase does not have pepper at all. The efo riro is great but the pepper soup which I paid 14.99 for is too small compared to the picture on their website. I would have attached a picture below but there’s no option. I should have just ordered one thing first. Anyway, I don’t think am ordering any food from there anymore.

I’m honored to be the first reviewer! The staff were incredibly kind and professional over the phone. It was very inexpensive so i decided to go all out. I ordered three suya sides, asun, and gizdodo. When I arrived to pick up my order, everyone greeted me with a warm welcome.

My total came to $37, and I added a $9 tip. I asked the cashier if the food was good, and without hesitation, she raved about it. I was a bit skeptical—but let me tell you, as a Ghanaian, after tasting the food, I’m seriously considering switching sides! The food was absolutely delicious, and I’ll definitely be coming back! 👍🏾
Jollof rice is heavenly ! Price reasonable I spoke wit her over the phone amazing  woman ! Keep the quality the same ! I will spread the word about how amazing your food is !!! Ese 🤎

I wish I could give this place zero stars. I ordered the beef with rice and fried wings with fries, and the experience was extremely disappointing. The wings and fries should be described as cold, burned wings and fries. To say the wings were overcooked is an understatement — they were nearly inedible, dry, and absolutely unpleasant to eat. The fries were just as bad, limp, and cold.

The beef and rice were average at best, but after biting into those wings, I lost my appetite altogether. This was not worth the money, and honestly, I feel like I deserve a refund.

Shekinah Glory needs to seriously step up their food quality if they want returning customers.

I’m having to trash 30 dollars worth of food
This is the worst jellof and fried rice I’ve had in my life and I definitely do not recommend

Worst oxtails I’ve ever had rip off literally 3 small pieces of oxtail with little meat a lot of fat and the plantains are super dry don’t waste your money on the oxtails smh I have to order some more food because I’m still hungry smh really am disappointed in the oxtail platter with plantains 👎🏾

Lousy service and customer service. Ordered Gbegiri and ewedu  through Door dash and specifically requested for a beef and fish. Then I called to confirm the details of the order to avoid issues.First the stew was more of oil than Gbegiri and I was given turkey ( which was mostly bone). This was after calling to confirm the details of my order. The customer service actually told me there were other stores I could order from if I did not like the food.
Man was very rude to me , but food was okay.  Don't prefer food to be placed in microwave to be heated when you have hot wells to hold food. The  heated table must Don't work properly 😒.

I’m very disappointed in what was sent to me after I ordered. I have been looking for cassava leaf near me for a long time. I usually drive to silver spring to get it. (Sweet sweet kitchen) I ordered through their website and they sent me a container full of OIL. Barely any cassava. The meat was so TOUGH. I could barely chew it. This was completely unhealthy and unacceptable. $47 for a container full of OIL!!!

I had a rather disappointing experience. I love African food and was hoping to find a spot to go to on occasion on my way to work, but I shall not come here again. To start, the atmosphere was rather uninviting-- one of two large overhead lights was out, making it fairly dark inside, and the snack display was sparsely stocked, and I think a bit dusty. There was no music so it was dead silent except for the Christian preaching radio outside. Also, it smelled a bit like fish. Nobody else was there and I could understand why. I had time to stay and eat but was not interested in doing so.

I ordered a meat stew and although the flavor of the spices was good, the meat was grisly and tough. I heard them using the microwave a number of times which had me concerned about what else they were skimping on in my $25 meal. The use of the microwave was also likely why the meat was so tough.

My suggestions to the owner:
-Put some garlic in the oven so the place smells fragrant and inviting.
-Keep the snack display well stocked so you present the aire of abundance.
-Have some African High Life music or other African music playing at a low level inside
-Fix the big light
-Dont use the microwave (just throw things in a pan. Water will be better retained that way, keeping meats relatively tender. I would have been happy to wait 20 mins rather than the 10 the waitress told me.)

Ok so I went to Tola today even though some of your reviews told me the place and food is trash and to go to hell instead of coming here but me I like to experience my own whahala when it comes to food so I’m just here to say you guys are liars and may GOD forgive you all😂

So let’s get to it, when you walk in it does smell like gas but that’s not an issue for me because I like good food infact it don’t seem like anything was burning or anyone was dying so which one concern me? 🤷🏽‍♀️

Anyhow let’s continue I got there and I called in advance to ask about the Acheke so as I walked in my aunty at the register was nice smile and said did you call about it, I said yes she disappear and went to get my food.

You people told me the kitchen give suspect so I stood on the side and watch them put my food together the whole time and nothing suspicious was happening at all. In fact it was just my three African aunties in the kitchen talking to each other and gathering my food for me and making it hot, one of my aunties even cut the tomatoes and onions for my food fresh as I watched.

Anyways my food arrived again two of my aunties came to the counter one told me to enjoy my meal and the other one took my card. They both looked on edge and as an African I think they thought i wasn’t American  and was trying to figure out if it was my first time trying African food and if I was going to like it, that’s my assumption or maybe they look like that because you crazy people have left so many madness as reviews so they were overly trying to impress me either way I felt welcomed so aunties thank you.

Finally I came and I have consumed this meal like someone who was starving for 10years. The food was hot in temperature and spices just the way I like it. Infact Jesus himself baked the fish. I am full and  happy. Highly recommend this place go there eat and enjoy and support Africa.
Oh and to my three aunties in the kitchen I’m from Liberia and listen this food was delicious!!!!!!!

The meat was tough and you couldn't chew it. The lady did not explain the the menu. When we walked in all we could smell is gas. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone. The food I brought is going in the trash. My dog will not eat the food . The food is greasy with a lot of spices. It did not look clean. I should have listened to my brain and turned around and left. Do the health department know that that is a restaurant.

Amazing Meal, everything is delicious.
Restaurant is clean. Served with love
Great African food. The grill lamb is the best
Delicious food thank you

I absolutely LOVE this place. I come here every time I’m in Maryland. The portions are great, the customer service is EXCELLENT, the food is so delicious. I highly recommend this Nigerian food for people who are African or even just us regular Americans! I’ve included a photo of their menu below. Everything tastes so good, but my favorites are the meat pie, the fried fish, and the jollof rice combo meal with stew and two pieces of chicken. I also like to order goat and cow skin on the side. Sometimes I get tripe too or beef! I can’t wait to come back.

I have been to many Nigerian restaurants in the DMV area and this establishment is BY FAR the best! Top service that makes you feel like you are visiting your auntie, great tasting and FRESH food, coupled with very reasonable prices. I make it a point to buy dinner for my family from Auntie Mary almost every Saturday! I highly recommend this restaurant...you will not be disappointed!

Been coming here 5 years consistently no complaints… I’ve tried all of the Nigerian restaurants in the Baltimore city area and this is the BEST!!! Flavorful, filling, authentic and most importantly the customer service is OUTSTANDING. Check them out and try their fried fish to get you started!!!😋

What a hidden gem! Mary’s food is AMAZING. This place never misses. Authentic and Fresh. I even ordered catering for a large party and the food was great. Everyone kept asking where the food was from.
Reasonably priced for a top quality service. The local pounded yam (not poundo) was surprising. It was my first time having having it in many years and it paired well with their eguisi.

Hands down one of the best Jollof rice I have ever had. I mean everything is so delicious. Everything is well made / cooked. Seasonings, spices, & etc were on point. I would highly recommend this to everyone. Can’t wait to come for more!!

- Food was very delicious.
- Service was on point.
- Very friendly & welcoming.
- Overall a great experience & enjoyable food.
I brought fufu from this place and the soup was nasty, the goat meat was raw, the tomato stew was like a whole paste of tomato with a little oil around it.
Very kind and amazing jollof and Suya!

Absolutely amazing experience at Sobajo Grill! The customer service was excellent from start to finish, and the food was outstanding. I tried the beef suya, jollof rice, and plantains. Everything was full of flavor and cooked perfectly. You can really tell there’s passion behind the food. I will definitely keep supporting this business and highly recommend it to anyone looking for great food and great service!

Delicious Soya! Great quality. I have bought and shared with family and friends including taking it to different states …All arrive the same conclusion, it is the best they’ve ever had! You will love it!

The best barbecue I’ve ever eaten, so tasty a juicy and perfectly spicy as we like.
Just try it once and you’ll come back forever. God bless Sobajo Grill.
The meat is so tasty...authentic African suya flavor....th chicken wings were yummy too. Generous portions and unique environment.
This is how it is on Sunday evenings. Keeping warm have great conversation and delicious suya with corn and red plantain. Sometimes with grilled chicken too

I am East African and I love trying out African foods from all over. This place has potential because the food is flavorful. But the service needs to improve immediately. The waiting time is too long ( I was the only one on site, and may three or four online orders). They also asked me to pay before food since I wanted to step out to park my car. Very unusual. There should be a sink to wash hands. The bowl didn’t cut it because my hands needs sanitizing. I greeted a couple of homeless dudes outside.  I don’t believe this food was worth $68. I felt uncomfortable paying this much since I don’t believe the quality was that much. I was thinking about $50 in my head.

I got white rice and stew with goat meat. Rice was well cooked - not too hard, not too soft. The stew was really tasty with the right spice level. The attendant was also super respectful and attentive.

Ordered through door dash and I don’t know how you make chicken. Tough but the skin tasted like leather they gave me chicken scarp bones their aren’t any meat on the chicken for $20 not even a side of rice to eat it with Horrible not ordering here again and and the indone didn’t have meat in it ! $50 down the drain could have ordered somewhere else !!! Look at the soup I’m expecting and the soup I receive THAT IS FALSE ADVERTISING!!!

The food is sooo good! It’s fresh, perfectly seasoned, and full of flavor. It honestly tastes like a home-cooked meal made by your mom. I wish the quantity was more but it is well. I really hope the quality stays the same because I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

This is a review from a doordash driver. Having to be told it would be a 15 minute wait after arriving to what I thought was an already prepared order, I waited for the alloted time, and then came back to be told it was almost ready. I came in around 6:55 to 7, and it is now 7:30 as of writing this. The entire time, I only see 3 employees from my POV, but 2 of them were on their phones the entire time of waiting, and I cant get any help from them now that everyone is moved to the back, so I don't know how much longer it is to wait. I'm not grading the food since I am only picking it up, but I hope waiting this long is worth it for yalls food.

First time eating here and I am absolutely in LOVE. From the decor, to music, and most importantly the food everything was impeccable. I order a cinnamon toast matcha latte, shrimp fries, and my friend had the chicken bowl. The latte definitely lived up to the hype and the shrimp fries were crispy and flavorfilled.

Popped in for a snack on the way to my train. Great vibe, fantastic meat pie, and I loved the apple pie matcha.

Next time I'm in Baltimore I'll stop in for a proper meal, the full menu looks great!

From the moment we stepped inside Posi's, we knew we would be in for a treat. The decor was sophisticated and chic, with warm lighting creating a welcoming atmosphere. The attentive service was impeccable. Our server, Ola, was incredibly welcoming and offered a contagious smile from the moment we walked in. But the food itself stole the show. The meat pie was absolutely fantastic, with a buttery, flaky crust and a warm, seasoned beef filling. We also devoured the shawarma, where the perfectly seasoned beef practically melted in the mouth, and the jollof, which had a wonderful smoky flavor that perfectly complemented the umami of the roasted chicken. Ola made sure we were satisfied with all our food and drink, and his enthusiasm for the cuisine was contagious. Posi's is a hidden gem that needs to be shared. I highly recommend it to anyone who appreciates authentic and flavorful West African cuisine.

Ordered the Chicken Shawarma and was very disappointed. The majority of it was filled with hot dogs and not chicken pieces. Have had Chicken Shawarma elsewhere and it was a lot less money and was all chicken. The flavor was good, but for the price and what I received I will not order that again. It was the size of a small burrito for $15.

Not sure why it was full of hot dogs and I didn’t have time to go back since I was on lunch break.

11/10 every time I come here it’s a hit! They have a new menu now after being closed for renovations for 2 months and it’s even better than before. bowls, jollof, salads, coffee, matcha!!! OMG I love it here… I order almost everyday! This family business is one you WANT TO SUPPORT!

The food is good and very tasty. I really enjoy the jollof rice. The serving for the jollof rice isn't bad but like others have said, the soup serving size needs to be more. The ambience is nice and peaceful. I love the fact that i can feel the spice in the things I get. Whoever is complaining about the spice should go sit down somewhere and not ruin the experience for people like us that love authentic Nigeria food. Maybe Nigerian food isnt for you. It's really just the perfect amount of spice. More people should patronize this restaurant.

some of the most authentic nigerian food i've had in the area! the jollof is smoky and their fish stew is wonderful. the suya is also very good, although the portion could've been a bit more. they also called and warned me that my door dasher was not assigned yet as they were about to close, instead of just canceling my order, which i really appreciated. i will definitely order again

I will say that I am very picky eater, especially when it comes to traditional food. Ms. Adeola knows how to make this food feel like home and I couldn’t recommend it enough! My favorite dish is the egusi and pounded yam. I continue to order here every time I feel homesick and it always make me feel better. This here is a real taste of Africa!

I can’t rave enough about how smoky the jollof was. I’m weird and sometimes like to pair my rice with egusi, and they didn’t disappoint at all. Would recommend to anyone who is as excited about food as I am, because it was a wonderful time.

Absolutely one of my favorite places to get food!! There’s always a level of consistency and quality that’s really hard to find. The portions are so great too, I usually get meat pies and the spicy stew, I’m in love!!

Wow oh wow, what a treat I just experienced.  From the moment walking in I felt the good vibes. Greeted with a wall of books and great tunes playing throughout the place. I was welcomed pleasantly, allowed to even sample some dishes I was not sure about, and served timely. While waiting I browsed the shop and got some great finds as well. They even support local entrepreneurs products.  Now the the vibes were too good to leave and I sat and ate my to go meal here! The food didn't disappoint one bit. Oh my im so stuffed and satisfied while I type this. Please come through and support this local gem.

PRO: customer service and atmosphere is great
CON: This is by far the most tasteless Jamaican food I have ever eaten. It is very bland.
Plantain: thin, over cooked and mushy
Stew Chicken: taste like plain chicken even with the sauce
Rice and Peas: just rice

Cost: over $30
This place is fire!!! From the wellness to the herbs and spices to the books and the FOOD! The prices were great and the portion was huge! One of the best tasting brown stew chicken I’ve ever had

I've never had a bad meal or a bad time here. I've been here often and enjoy all the food. Jerk chicken is one of my favorite foods, and theirs is on point! The flavor is great, and it's tender and juicy. I got an order of plantains the other day, and they were honestly the best Ive had at a restaurant. I like my plantains a certain way, not cut too thick, not slimy, and a little crisp around the edges... they got it perfectly. Their veggie chunks and curry chickpeas are great, even for the non-vegans. Service is impeccable, and I've always been treated well, with prompt attention. Even when it's busy, the staff maintains great service. The dining area is clean and well decorated, and is great for a solo visit, group trip, or even to host/attend an event. I've done them all. The dining area also serves as a retail space with plenty of books, herbs, incense, etc. It's always a pleasure.
I use to drive across town to Park Heights to get my Jamaican food fix.. Not after today! Season very well and great portions. Im hooked . Thanks

Swung into Dukem before catching an Amtrak train at Baltimore Penn Station.  The dinner was delicious and service was both quick and attentive.  Enjoyed the 7-part vegetarian dinner with a friend.  Will be back next time I'm in Baltimore!

WORST doro wat ever. I got the take out today and the chicken looked like it was microwaved a lot, and as you can see in the video it was super dry and very unappetizing. And 26$ for a dish like this?
Save your money and go somewhere else guys..

I recently visited Dukem Ethiopian Restaurant in Baltimore, excited to try Ethiopian cuisine for the first time. We arrived early for our reservation, but the server's blank expression didn't exactly welcome us. We kindly asked to be seated early and were shown to a booth.

The ambiance and aroma inside were pleasant, although the space felt a bit small. Fortunately, it wasn't busy during our visit.

Despite mentioning it was my first time trying Ethiopian food, our server made no effort to explain the menu or offer recommendations. Luckily, I had watched some YouTube videos beforehand, which gave me a basic understanding.

We ordered water, which arrived as bottled Deer Park – a bit unusual. It would have been nice to have glasses provided. Considering the spicy nature of Ethiopian food, not offering free water refills seemed unreasonable.

I started with the vegetarian sambusa, which was dry and could have benefited from a sauce. For my entrée, I ordered a veggie platter with fish. Unfortunately, the fish arrived whole, with bones throughout, making it difficult to eat. While it had good flavor, the bones made it hard to finish.

The rolled injera tasted fine, but the larger portion underneath the veggie platter was quite sour and lacked flavor. The combination of items on the platter didn't complement each other well. The only standout components were the greens and the red lentils with berbere spice.

Throughout our meal, our server never checked in or offered refills on our water. The check was dropped off without asking if we wanted dessert or coffee. The service was subpar, and I reluctantly left an 18% tip.

While I'm glad I got to try Ethiopian food for the first time, I'm disappointed that Dukem didn't live up to my expectations. I wouldn't return and would recommend exploring other Ethiopian restaurants with better service and more flavorful food.

Love finding Ethiopian places to eat when traveling, since we don’t get that opportunity locally. Not too busy. Had a ton of takeout orders being picked up while dining, which was a good sign. Will definitely come back when in town.

This was a completely new cuisine for me, so I didn't know what to expect. The crepe-like side dish (Njera?) was delicious and I could really eat it plain as well. The curries were all flavorful as well.

I would highly recommend the sampler of vegetarian curries. There were so many options that came on the plate and I was the most full I'd been in a while after down it.

The prices are solid, and both times I visited, they were consistently good. Come with really hungry guests prepared to eat with their hands!

8

I was craving for Suya and work in Bmore on weekends, so I decided to look them up. Amazingly, they open on Sundays. You need to order in advance over the phone. Got the Half Tray Suya for $45...compared to Suya Guys, this is a steal...$20 less and about the same or more. Customer Service was top notch and as a first time visitor, I also got extras. If you are looking for a bang for your buck ...suya without breaking the bank, I would recommend the suya. I might need to add more spicy because it was mild spicy, which I understand giving the diverse customer base. They also cater and do parties and events. I am definitely willing to patronize that service in the future given my experience with the customer service. Lots of Parking..it would be nice to add extra signs to direct customers from the street though...or lights and colors to showcase where they are. I would definitely be returning back. Check them out and thank me later.

Great suya, kilishi, and even better customer service! Was visiting the Baltimore area and decided to seek out some suya. Found this spot on Google Maps and came here based on the reviews. This place and business owner has good reviews for a reason! I was looking to purchase something to pack to take back to ATL and purchased four packs of kilishi. The four packs were only $22! There's suya for purchase to grill/prepare but I didn't have anything to pack that in for the plane. The owner gave my some pieces of suya to sample during my stop. Suya is GREAT. Spicy, flavorful, and all of the other good adjectives to describe a perfect piece of food. Highly recommend for people in the area who are close enough to buy some to take home and even for people like me who are visiting the area. The kilishi is amazing. Better than any jerky related product you can get anywhere! Hit this place up!
I enjoyed my suya and highly recommend this place. I felt bad that I couldn’t order a small plate however, the $45 pan is huge. I’ll eat it for days with my family. Best suya and kilishi in Maryland.

I visited from Atlanta and decided to try out his suya. Let me tell you, this suya is gooooood. And he gifted me a bag of kilishi also known as jerky beef.  I wished I ordered it as well. Next time I visit, I will definitely order some bags of the kilishi as well. Good customer service as well. I bought the 20 sticks.

My daughter asked for jollof rice and suya on her birthday. Consulted Google and took a chance patronizing this place, round trip 90 minutes drive from DC to Baltimore. It was well worth it. I got the family platter for a reasonable price, paid him using cash app and picked up my suya on time. It was delicious. I'm going to go back again. Another satisfied customer. (For my Nigerian family: Oh and he was even kind to dash me a pack of kiliishi).... great service with smiles!! Highly recommended.

Bright airy eatery in the Mt. Vernon area with multi-level seating, free WiFi, and a fusion menu of Latin and Mediterranean food. Had the hummus with lamb chorizo and the chicken kabob plate. My friend had the lentil soup and said it was delicious. Our food came out fast and our server was attentive. I’d definitely go back to use the cozy work space on the balcony level.

Mera was the perfect cozy spot for brunch on a cold winter morning. The service was friendly and attentive. The food was beautiful and full of delicious flavors. I definitely would love to return to try their dinner offerings.

We loved everything about this restaurant.  We stopped in for dinner beforea show, and the servers immediately greeted us and got us to our table.

We each had a cocktail (my husband had something with gin & I had the date old-fashioned). We had the crispy cauliflower as a starter, which tasted AMAZING.  We also got the chicken kebab and Kafta burger,both of which were very flavorful. We each got a baklava for the ride home.

Everyone in this restaurant is super friendly and happy. The ambiance is comforting & cozy with its plants and little lights in the windows.

Wealso "paid it forward" by making a meal donation, which we added to our check.  This is a lovely restaurant, and I love the feeling of community that they inspire.

We will be back!

I was the first one to get there for lunch on Dec 30. It quickly got full of people. This place seems to be popular in the area. Staff were friendly and attentive. Food was fresh and delicious. I loved the latin american infusions on the menu items.

Everything was so good! It was fresh and tasty, cooked to perfection! It was so good that i ordered every dessert 😋. The only thing that wasn’t perfect was the young waiter didn’t seem excited. However, everyone else made up for it. Great food, great place, i will definitely come again and bring others again!!!

Me and my family came here to eat today. We had the oxtail platter with mac and cheese, the curry chicken platter and a fish platter. It was an amazing experience, the owner was warm and he put effort and the love of his craft into our food, so much so that we could taste it. We fully enjoyed our delicious meals. We also had 2 sweet teas a half and half and a ginger tea and omg everything was fresh and delicious. We can't wait to return we really appreciate that there are still places around like this where we can take our kids and enjoy our meals thank you

It's a hole in the wall, but not the good kind.
There was a TV blasting in the corner of the grody seating area.
The frying oil was really dark and looked like it hadn't been changed in days. The place was generally lacking cleanliness.
They were out of several menu options. The food was average.
The biggest positive was the price. You can get a meal with 2 sides for less than $15.

I had been looking for a great place where I could eat some African cuisine and I was satisfied by the service. The food was bursting with flavor, portions were generous,  and the service was warm and attentive. Vasachy’s easily one of the best dining spots I have visited in Baltimore and will definitely come back.

Walked passed many times.. finally decided to go in & experience off of praised reviews..N my taste buds are pleased...My platter was aesthetically appeasing & YUMMMY!! Very hopeful for my next venture to try Everything especially the Okra...Thank You for the meal!!
Today Oct 2025 (🍋 Ginger tea Filet Tilapia fried, plantain, jollof rice, greens 🥰
The food is amazing every time! Vasachy is very kind and make sure the food is always fresh!

If I can rate them a negative I would. This restaurant had been a go to for us especially for their Jollof rice. We buy frequently, we refer friends and family because we believed in the quality of the food, however this recent experience today with their customer service was absolute trash. You people should be ashamed yourselves, you are a disappointment to the African food community in particular. I called to order half pan of Jollof rice as we frequently do, and I was told it was $50. I was shocked and inquired further if the pricing was correct as I had just purchased the same pan a week or two prior or $35. The lady was so rude saying they've been selling it for over a year for $50 which was absolutely not true!! I explained to her the situation, and she said that's how they sell, yelling on the phone, I had to caution her several times to bring her voice down and then proceeds to hang up the phone on me. My household alone has spent over $2000 with these people since we moved to the area. You will not be getting another dime of my money or anyone I know, and I will be sure to let everyone I have referred know that your service is absolute trash. If I was the owner best believe whomever that woman I spoke to would be fired immediately. And absolute disgrace.

I eat here all the time, and for good reason—this place serves some of the best Nigerian food I’ve had outside of home. It’s super convenient since it’s close to my university, and after a long day of classes and athletics, nothing hits like food from Nu’Shiloh.

My go-to combo is the jollof rice with plantain and goat meat—it’s perfectly spicy, the plantains are always fried just right (crispy edges, soft in the middle), and the goat meat is tender and well-seasoned. You can tell they take their time with the cooking.

The vibes are calm and welcoming, whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeout. Service is friendly and they’re supplied with a great assortment of beverages!

Definitely recommend if you’re craving authentic, homemade-style Nigerian food. 10/10, I’ll keep coming back!

I previously had a problem and went to speak with the owner. She was very apologetic, understanding &  completely listened to my concerns . It could have very well been a misconception on my part. Sometimes all it takes is a conversation. The food is  consistently delicious & fresh. You can tell the food was made with love. Try them. You will not regret it.💕

I don't know how this so called "restaurant" is still in business, the food is disgusting, the pounded yam tasted like they put soap in it and the fish as well. I don't trust these people, the ladies here are very rude and nasty. Never again. This place is a disgrace. Messing with people's food is never good! God sees everything. Very wicked people. And the food is not fresh.

If i could give them a 0 i would. Only good thing about this place is how affordable their food is, besides that you’re in a for a ride. Food is old and stale, the restaurant staff are very rude, it’s like you’re begging them to do their job for food you’re paying for. 0/10 would not recommended.

Plantain was tough and not fresh at all, jollof was mediocre, and the goat meat was very salty and didn’t taste fresh. I also ordered on UberEats, so I wonder if my experience would have been different if I’d actually went there.
Say much love this place.... It's very clean, organized with VIP options. I visited from Ohio for the first time and had the best cuisine treat ever. Keep up guys !!!👏👏👏👏🎊
close, quiet, n da food is good...

I was just recently at this establishment. I asked for the vegetable soup. Because i am vegetarian. They still preceded to add goat meat to my meal. This is crazy. I told the bartender to several times please do not add any meat!!!!

Last night was an amazing girls night out! 🎉 The DJ was on fire, and Kia the bartender was absolutely killing it! Whoever made my Honey Old Bay wings and fries had me licking my fingers in public like I had no home training. 10/10 night! Thanks for the night out🙌🏾🔥

My visit this establishment Thursday and Saturday.  The music was good along with the vibe of the place. The both bartenders was very friendly and attentive especially Special K ( I name her that) lol. I try the wings and some of my friends Curry chicken,  goat meat. I would say the food was good some alittle spicy 😋. I enjoyed the hookah for some reason on Thursday instead of Saturday maybe it was my choice in favor 😅.  I highly recommend this place if you are looking forward to chill and relax.

Bar service was slow despite there being a minimal amount of people and the food service was even slower. All seating except the back bar was either reserved or taken. DJ was great. There was a fight but security said that never happens. They also offer hookah, but we didn't get to try it... Despite a somewhat negative experience, I'd go back again.

Came here few times all of a sudden they want to charge to get in nothing changed inside not even the huge dirty mirror in the fake vip area lol just want to charge for the hell of it place not packed or anything so I just don't understand it's a cool spot but definitely not no where near all that ..

Ordered the full platter or the whole bird with 2 sides. Juicy plus flavor never fails. Brussel sprouts stay on point hearty with the balsamic sweetness. The interior decor takes you to another place! Bit rich on the pricing, compared to the serving portions. Service was hospitable and welcoming! Close to fells point and 83.

The interior decorations on this branch is pretty cool :) The location has one of the best team probably… they accommodate our group of 5 even they are about to close in 30 minutes on a Christmas Eve.

Highly recommend this Nando’s location and I hope they stay in business for a long time ❤️

We had great service around 7pm on Sunday the 19th even when ordering from the table. Our food came pretty quickly and was fresh and good. Glad I finally got to try Nando's while visiting Baltimore for the first time as I try to visit all 50 states.

Nando's Peri-Peri in Baltimore offers a fantastic dining experience where the food and vibe truly jive—the atmosphere is vibrant and welcoming, perfectly complementing the delicious, flame-grilled cuisine. The wait staff is excellent, providing genuine conversation about their best-selling dishes without ever being pushy, making the experience feel personalized and enjoyable. Beyond the famous chicken, the menu thoughtfully includes several tasty vegetarian options, ensuring everyone can find something to savor with that signature Peri-Peri kick. Be sure to order one of their sensational beverages, as the lemonades are awesome and the perfect refreshing complement to the spicy flavors.

Note: You need to order at front counter or via QR code at table.
Super friendly and helpful staff! Manager greeted us and checked on us several times, staff very friendly and polite.

Chicken was delicious with spices and nicely grilled skin. The sauces are if you want to bump up the heat. We had 2 legs and 3 thighs plus corn on the cob and fries. All we're good and full of flavor. Fries were not hot, but that's ok for me.

Would eat here again.

name: KSB African and Caribbean Cuisine catering

reviews.text: Flavor was good but ridiculously expensive for the amount of food you get. I ordered an oxtail dinner plus additional oxtail..after fishing thru the gravy, I only received 6 pcs?!  When I called back to make sure they didn’t forget the extra oxtail, the owner said she gave me a lot and the rest of what was in the pot. Not to mention only 4 small pcs of plantain..Not worth the $36.

Usually the food is good but this oxtails was nasty.  Taste over cooked and cold.  The Drinks were too expensive.   The sorrel was great but it's small bottle was not worth it.  The malta was not worth the $4.50.  Serious over charge.  Go to the grocery store. You can get it for $1.00.  I love my people and will support especially if the food is great. But when you try to hustle and over charge me, I can no longer support and dont have respect.

My boyfriend and I stopped at KSB yesterday after checking the wait for another popular restaurant in the area. We decided to take a gamble since neither of us had ever been here and I'm glad we did!!!!
