Plantains were also perfectly cooked. Seating is very intimate and close but not really an issue. Can’t wait to see what they do with the bar and patio space in the back. Besides the food being so great, the staff truly made the experience so memorable. It felt like I was being taken care of by family and will definitely be returning!

My girl and I love trying different food places. We went to YARD and when u walk in it takes u away into it's own bright cool space. The customer service and the owner/chef were amazing, he ask for real reviews of their food and genuinely want to know the good, or bad. We didn't try as much as we usually do, but we'll be back. The pasta with the shrimp & chicken added, the patties were amazing! Job well done!

Ok yall I’ve been waiting for a while to come because every time I think about going it’s on a day they are closed. They are located in the heart of fed hill. I went on a Wednesday and found close parking although there is a garage nearby. The service was great. I got the jerk bird and red snapper fried. Just an fyi the rice for the rice and peas is coconut rice. The plantains were ok but with an up-charge for the meal  you can get Brussels sprouts. They were good and I don’t even like sprouts. The jerk sauce had a kick and the red snapper was cool. The jerk chicken was so good the day after. I would like the fish to have a more robust flavor but the prices are affordable so go check them out. The space is cute and they have outside. They are a byob establishment so that makes them even more affordable ..  oh and I love the fact that they have the jerk mushrooms for those who don’t eat meat!!

Nice small cozy resturant. The owner and staff me the experience worth the money. But the owner held out on the curry goat. JK The owner is young black owner love that for him personality was on point. Even brought Santa Claus with to see if he was naughty or nice. Lol oxtails were great

name: Jamaican Kitchen Ms Rose Kubuli Culture

reviews.text: Best curry chicken I've ever had. Crazy flavor and so tender a baby could eat it 😩

The boo brought me here for my birthday. We had a blast from the amazing food, to the great service, and nice ambiance/music. We had the jerk tacos, beef patties, coco bread, escovitch, & oxtail meal. We had no complaints with the food and drinks. Drinks had decent amount of alcohol. Go and check them out! You won’t regret it. It’s difficult finding good Caribbean food in the DMV. Highly recommended to make reservations. Parking has to be on the street or garage and you will have to walk a little bit.

Second time going to jerk at night and it was phenomenal. I tired  salmon nachos,  the chicken and salmon tacos, the oxtails, the jerk chicken, the fried snapper, the Rasta pasta, the rum cake, and the bread, pudding, the lamb chops, and the mac & cheese. Everything was superb from  the seasonings, presentation and  the customer service was immaculate.  Special  shout out to my girl Maya, who was very attentive, very welcoming very warming. It was a phenomenal experience. I definitely will come back again. The ambience is very unique. It looks like something from a storybook with all of the low lighting the pictures on the wall and they have a lot of ethnic decor, which I totally appreciate. The owners were both very charming and very personable. He had a DJ which played some nice tunes as we ate and enjoyed. It was a great experience.

So I've been wanting to visit Jerk At Nite for some time now. First glance,  it seemed like a cool spot. Mixed crowd and vibes throughout the dining area. I was a bit disappointed that the menu items I was most interested in were no longer available for the evening.  FYI- I was told the lamb chops (Di Choppa Dem) were a popular specialty item... A.k.a- they may run out or may not be available. Despite the initial let down,  I still enjoyed the Kingston Kurry Chicken (sides rice and cabbage). The Oxtails were good as well. Very tender, but a more on the sweeter side vs spicy. Drinks, were great. Just a heads up the cocktail menu is limited. Overall, I had a good experience. The staff were super friendly and welcoming (especially Mercedes). I'm hoping to visit again.  Hopefully they will have the menu items I initially wanted to try.

I dined in for brunch on a Sunday about a year ago (12/22/24). It was empty when I arrived so I was seated right away. A couple of guests came in after me. I loved the decor and atmosphere. The music was good. My waitress was sweet. The food was pretty tasty. One thing I had an issue with was the hair still being on my chicken. The seats are also very close together with small tables. I would like to go back for dinner and drinks.

Absolutely amazing! The food was PHENOMENAL! Fresh ingredients and full of flavor! From the gracious host to the wait staff everyone was genuinely helpful and happy to has us! Very pleasurable experience! We will return! Might need to use this place for my events!!

First time visiting Brudah’s Kitchen and it definitely won’t be my last. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and made with care. The staff was friendly and welcoming, and the service was fast. You can tell they take pride in what they do. Highly recommended!

I got oxtails, red beans, rice and cabbage I thoroughly enjoyed everything. The food was appetizing, seasoned well, hot and they gave good portions. I called my order in and Eugene took my order. When I went to get my food he addressed me by my name. He was friendly and gave great recommendations. I will definitely return. You won’t be disappointed if you give them a try.

I was excited to try this location on Key Highway.  My order tailed curry, chicken with rice and peas, cabbage, and a beef patty.  I am very disappointed that I spent $30 on a meal and did not enjoy any of it.  The chicken looked seasoned, but was not thoroughly cooked and the meat did not taste the matching herbs on the skin.   The skin was rubbery and was not well done at all.  My rice was still mushy and did not have a good flavor, for me.   I was looking for authentic Caribbean juices however they did not have any homemade.   I spent $40 on food and more than 80% is still in a container going in the garbage.
This food may be tasty for someone who is not used to authentic, Caribbean cooked food

Ordered brown stew chicken. The smell was amazing. The taste was an absolute disappointment. The chicken had absolutely no seasoning, not even salt. It was inedible. It was as though it had been boiled and all of the flavor was boiled out of it.  The gravy on top of it could not save it
The cabbage very salty. The rice was sticky.  The entire meal was thrown away. Would have taken it back but they were closed.

I don't know about a lot of y'all, but It was rude just by just how the host begun treating me. As soon as I stepped in no greeting, no nothing. Automatically rude for reasons unknown. I don't know who he thought I was, or what I was on, but I'm definitely never going back to that place again. And the thing is I sense good vibes from there too. Idk

Really good Jamaican food. The portions are solid, and every time I’ve come, the food has been hot, fresh, and delicious. The staff is nice, and there’s never a long wait. I got the curry chicken, and it did not disappoint. I also love that they give you the option to add gravy to your rice — small detail, but it makes a difference. Definitely will keep coming back to try more of the menu!
This has been the most authentic Jamaican restaurant I’ve found in the Baltimore area. I am a repeat offender here almost weekly! 10/10 recommend.

This is the only thing I have say the food is good everything is good .Except for the Sorrel there is alcohol in it. I haven’t tasted alcohol since 2003 and in November 2025 I was drinking the Sorrel it tasted a little fermented and wanted to be sure so I called to asked if the wine is Alcohol or non alcohol sure enuff they said it was alcohol. I think it should be written in the ingredients how much content of alcohol was added . At this point I have been violated. And this day 11/15/2025 is my last day

The food is amazing, I had  the red snapper estrovich numerous times. Their rice, cabbage, macn cheese, balmy, coco bread all is delicious. On my way now to order! Every weekend. Try tgem u won’t be disappointed ❤️

Stopped in with my wife and we got 3 dishes to share  - oxtail, brown stew chicken and curry chicken, along with rice & peas and plantains.  Everything was absolutely delicious, oxtail was melt in your mouth tender, chicken was moist and juicy, and the sides were perfect.  We'll undoubtedly be adding Reid's to our regular dinner options!

Used to be one of my favorite places to eat. I’d go here all the time. The staff played a sick joke on me that I didn’t find funny at all, and as a result, I will never be back again.

I usually order the brown stew chicken platter with a side of cabbage and a patty—about $35–$40. I always leave a note explaining how I want my food prepared, and I ask for extra sauce. I guess they got mad because I asked for extra sauce, because they gave me no sauce and no chicken.

What’s a brown stew platter without brown stew? I was left with nothing but dry rice and macaroni.

I reached out to the team—unhelpful. I reached out to the manager—robotic, unconcerned, and unhelpful. I reached out to corporate—they ignored me completely.

I think it’s safe to say this is no longer my favorite place to eat. I haven’t been back since. I don’t think playing pranks on consistent, loyal, unproblematic customers is funny. My feelings are genuinely hurt.

I usually skeptical of chain restaurants as I see they have a few locations. I tend to think something gets lost in flavor. But this was quite surprisingly good. I ordered Jerk pork "Roti", a pound of jerk pork, mac and cheese  and spinach patty.
The Roti was huge but it was more a jerk pork burrito,  the wrap used doesn't give me buss up shut vibes but it was delicious none the less. I would repurchase  just the same.
The jerk pork as a stand alone is great as well.  The mac was slightly salty and the spinach patty good but peppery,  I'm not sure what that was about.. I did enjoy everything and their portions are great as well.

Toady me my daughter went to Dat Jerk and the food is always amazing. The ladies were so sweet me my daughter had them cracking up with our banter back in fourth lol my daughter loves their food she saving some for school tomorrow and she said she is not sharing her food it is to good to do all that lol. Thank guys for the amazing meals never disappoint. If you never been here please check them out.

This is what they delivered me. The bag had a hole in it and was leaking at the time of delivery, and when I opened the bag, the stew peas inside were completely opened. The lid wasn’t even on and it had soaked and ruined all the other food making everything else was inedible On top of that, I couldn’t even get a refund from UberEats despite the photo evidence of the ruined food and delivery photo of the food being delivery like that. Besides that, there was something brown smashed onto the roti that wasn’t part of the tortilla and isn’t from the pan or grill. That was enough for me to never order from here again.

We were in the area and needed a quick bite. Soooo glad we ended up coming in here. The smell was divine from the second you walked in- i just knew we were about to have a GOOD meal… and we did! I got the brown sugar chicken and loved it! Totally plan to come out of my way to eat here again and bring some back for my family. The staff was so kind and fun. It’s actually pretty uncommon these days to have friendly (like actually happy to be around other humans, friendly) service. Overall, so good. And a must try

My other go to spot was closed so I decided to stop in. I was afraid to go here because it's a club at night but luckily it was empty. I ordered 3 platters; Jerk & Curry Chicken, Curry Chicken and Curry Goat, and Oxtails. The food was so hot that I drove around for 45 mins and it was still hot. The portions sizes were good. My only critique was that the jerk Chicken was kinda dry. A little sauce would have helped it. I'm definitely going to return for some dinner and rum punch.

The food at Royal Maroon is SCRUMPTIOUSLY DELICIOUS!!! I must admit, I looked up and down the block for this restaurant after hearing about it on TikTok and how good the food is. A customer going in smiled and directed me to the restaurant inside of Blue Caribbean. NOTE: Royal Maroon is not West Indian Flavor II, which is next door.

The smiling staff were pleasantly attentive in helping with my menu choices. Costs were reasonable.

The oxtails, curry chicken, cabbage rice and peas were so good. Spices were wonderful. Sauces were plentiful and tasted superb.  Honestly, I wish I had seconds!

Royal Maroon is now my go to for Jamaican food. I give Royal Maroon my highest rating of 5!

Unfortunately, I am leaving this bad Review because I just ordered some oxtails and curry chicken when I called to place my order, I specifically asked the young man that answered  The phone where the oxtails tender Fork, tender well I guess I should’ve assumed that he was gonna tell me the truth because it was a bold face lie they’re not fork tender. They are not tender at all.I always raved about their curry chicken. I thought they had the best curry chicken in Baltimore. Well, not anymore. I am done with them. The curry chicken is not good like they used to be. I’m assuming they have a different cook I haven’t eaten from them in about a year, but I’m one person they don’t have to worry about no more. I’m not going out my way. They are totally a disappointment and on top of that the food is salty.

I 've been patronizing this place for over 20 years and even have my kids coming to this spot. Best Jamaican food in town. Stew beef, curry chicken and oxtail are my favorites. The staff never disappoint and  they treat my family like family. This will always be my number one  spot.
Authentic Carribean Cuisine cooked with love. Small Family owned business with quality affordable home cooked meal options serving big portions. Royal Maroon located inside of Blue Caribbean.

I placed a pickup order from Sweet Home Jamaica today for oxtail with rice & peas and cabbage, plus a mango sea moss drink.

Oxtail:
🔥 10/10. Perfect seasoning — a little Cajun kick blended with rich Caribbean spices. The meat was tender, flavorful, and the portion size was great. Only small note? I wish they had added a little more of that delicious oxtail gravy on top. That would’ve made it perfection. (So technically 9.5/10.)

Rice & Peas:
Cooked perfectly — not mushy, not dry, just right. Balanced flavor that complemented the oxtail beautifully.

Cabbage:
…Yeah, no. 2/10 (and honestly, it felt more like a 0). The flavors just weren’t there. It gave “Here you go since you asked” energy, like when your mom throws something on your plate so you’ll stop talking. Definitely not the highlight of the meal.

Mango Sea Moss Drink:
Love mango, love sea moss, and this combo works. Refreshing and smooth. Solid 8–9/10, but felt like it was missing a little something extra to make it pop.

Extra Notes:
They forgot my cocoa bread in my pickup order, which was disappointing. On top of that, they completely forgot an entire order for someone I was with. When they went back to pick it up, they were told the restaurant had run out of everything — which is why those items weren’t in the bag in the first place. That information would have been great to know ahead of time or at least when picking up the order, rather than after making a second trip.

Overall:
If I average it out, this meal lands around an 8.5–9/10. The oxtail and rice & peas will have me coming back for sure. But I’ll skip the cabbage next time, double-check my bag before leaving, and hope the communication is better in the future.

I come here a lot on my lunch break, love the food... Wife always hear me speaking of the great food.

Today was my first time trying this restaurant after hearing good things. I meant to order through DoorDash and pick up but my order never went through but the food came out piping hot and when I finally settled in to eat, I was not disappointed
Oxtails a Plenty !! Tender and falling off the booooonneee
Coco head soft and warm and I got like six patties in assorted flavors! No notes. No complaints. Kudos to the chefs 👏🏾🖤 (sidebar: didn’t get a before picture, this was my first meal of the day )

Stopped by for lunch during a work meeting. Order the goat curry with rice and peas, Mac and cheese and a beef patty. The goat was absolutely delicious. It was flavorful with just the right amount of heat and the meat was tender. Same for the beef patty, the crust was flaky and meat well seasoned and delicious. I would skip on the Mac and cheese though. I was not expecting the rainbow noodles used which had a pasty consistency. Overall though super solid food and I would definitely go back.

I was in the mood for some Caribbean food on a Friday. I was in the neighborhood and decided to give them a try. I thought that this was just a carryout so I was surprised to see that the restaurant was filled with nice seating and decor.

The menu had so much to choose from but I picked a few things for my to-go order. I ordered a large Curry Goat, a large Brown Stew Chicken, and a small Curry Chicken. The food was full of flavor and the portion sizes for the chicken dishes were good. The only complaint was the Goat. The Goat itself was good but it seemed like the dish was filled with a lot of vegetables and rice. An extra scoop of goat would have been love.

I'll be back soon to try more dishes.

I was in the mood for some good Caribbean food and went looking for another spot but they were closed for the day.  We found Judy's on a humble.
We got a parking spot right at the front door. The staff was very accommodating, allowing my wife to use a first-floor restroom due to her being on crutches.
The atmosphere was chill. The decor reminds me of Montego Bay, and they had some reggae and hip  hop playing in the air.
The drinks we ordered were tasty. The food was great, the wait staff was friendly. We'll most definitely be back.

Judy's Island Grill — A Caribbean Flavor Explosion You Won’t Forget!

If you’re looking for flavor, vibes, and phenomenal service — Judy’s is it. From the moment we walked in, the energy was vibrant and welcoming. We were greeted by an amazing bartender who introduced us to the happy hour specials and gave us the lowdown on karaoke nights — already a win!

🥂 Drinks First!
Whether you're going the cocktail route or keeping it fresh with non-alcoholic juice flights, Judy’s serves up freshly squeezed magic in a glass. Each drink was bursting with flavor and tropical soul — sweet, tangy, smooth, and perfectly chilled. Honestly, it’s hard to pick a favorite — so just try them all!
📸 (See pics — our flight looked too good to drink... almost.)

🍽️ Now Let’s Talk Food.
Whew. Where do we begin? Everything that hit the table was an absolute banger:
🔥 Oxtail – tender, juicy, full of deep island flavor.
🔥 Curry Goat – rich and comforting, just like grandma used to make.
🔥 Rice & Peas, Fries, and Cabbage – all done with love and skill.
🔥 Salmon Bites – sticky, sweet, spicy perfection! Paired with sautéed greens, they were the surprise knockout of the day.

📸 (Those salmon bites? Look at the shine in that glaze. That’s flavor you can see.)

To top it all off, the Caribbean chefs came out to check on us — real ones! Friendly, passionate, and proud of their craft, they made us feel like family.

✨ Between the warm hospitality, top-tier food, and island cocktails worth writing home about, Judy’s is officially on our list of go-to gems. Don’t sleep on it — and bring your appetite!

Came in on a quiet evening. I ordered the Shrimp Rasta pasta, and a spicy beef patty. The pasta was actually pretty good. The shrimp were quite large and everything was seasoned well! The beef patty had a flavor that I didn't like. I will come back next time to try the jerk chicken!

Went for a lunch date and I will not be returning. First off the rice was nasty and over cooked sent it back and asked for white rice for that to come out just as nasty as the rice and peas....I got oxtails and they was not it 😑 flavor was WAY OFF...THEN only to order brown stew chicken to go and again WHERE IS THE FLAVOR...PISSED OFF BECAUSE WHY DO THEY TASTE THE SAME $170 DOWN THE DRAIN...side note the young lady that waited on us was very nice and made a good rum punch....oh and the cabbage was the only this good
Derricka was absolutely wonderful! She’s truly a gem! Great hospitality, great conversation and amazing food! Love this business and I’ll definitely be back!

#1. The young lady was kind and greeted me as I walked in the door. People don't realize how important making customers feel welcome is!! Great 😃

Very clean small restaurant in East Baltimore next to the University of Maryland Midtown Campus Hospital.

I was craving Jerk Chicken and Beef patties. This place did not disappoint!! The jerk had a nice sauce that you can taste isn't from a can! Awesome variety of Juice and Soda. Loved that.

The patties were overpriced but cooked well and good.

I usually don't like plantains since people can't cook them but their version was awesome!! I smashed them!

The cabbage was on point and overall it was a great meal. I will definitely go back.

2 Patties (1: Spicy Beef & 1: Chicken)
Jerk Chicken Medium Size
2 Drinks
$31.00

The food was tasty but I am disappointed. This was the smallest portion of oxtails I've ever gotten at any Caribbean spot. They were mostly fat/gristle and a small portion of it. There was a better portion of curry goat. It was also the first time I've gotten Caribbean food without any plantains as part of the meal.

I come here like 3-4 times a week. The lunch specials are great, I enjoy the curry chicken lunch special and when I’m really hungry, I go for the curry goat.

I like to have a side of the patties as well, the curry chicken and the veggie patties, and typically wash it down with a bottle of ting.

Highly recommend! I think this is only Jamaican restaurant in Mount Vernon!

I came in for the curry chicken, but unfortunately, they were sold out for the day. The very kind lady that was working the front suggested I try the brown stew chicken. The brown stew chicken was phenomenal! Best I’ve had here in Baltimore city. I also tried the chicken patties and they were packed with flavor. Everything tasted very authentic. Can’t wait to come back and try more menu items and update this review. Great service and great food is always a win!
Great Food, Great Customer Service. As a Jamaican I am going to support my local restaurants. This one hit different. Jerk chicken 🍗 is great!

name: Konoko Jamaican Restaurant
vicinity: 8153 Honeygo Blvd Suite A, White Marsh

reviews.text:
I couldn’t wait to write this review.  It was a super cold day in Bmore and we decided on Jamaican food . First , the establishment is located in a sort of outdoor outlet mall. Very nice area . The building itself was a statement . They prefer reservations and while we thought our reservations were solid we actually scheduled them for the wrong day , but they quickly accommodated us and that was very kind of them . The service and hospitality was above board . They really went above and beyond to make sure we were having a good experience. Can’t say enough about their customer care . The manager was exceptional.
The only reason I didn’t give the restaurant 5 stars is because our wait time for the food was a little long , and the seating was snug . The booth was a semi - circle and it was nice but it was just a tight fit .  If you’re voluptuous or a big guy you may not need a booth .  But they did squeeze us in after our own failure to make sure we reserved for the correct day .
Now for the best part . The food . When I say 10/10 I mean that with my whole chest . I don’t give 10s a lot . This Jamaican food was the best I’ve had . I ordered their famous braised oxtails with rice and peas and a side of plantain . Top notch . The oxtails were tender falling off the bone and the flavor was rich and savory and just plain wonderful . The gravy that was made was so freaking amazing and I scooped my rice and peas into the bowl and ate it that way . Now , I don’t do Jamaican often so I may not be well versed on the flavor profiles but the rice and peas alone isn’t my thing , a bit dry and lacking in flavor but when added to the oxtail gravy it’ll make you slap your mama .
My dinner partners went with the Rasta pasta with oxtails and there wasn’t  anything left on their plate . My nephew had chicken tenders and fries and he left nothing . He got a chance to taste one of my oxtails and he cleaned the bone . He says he is now an official oxtail eater lol …
Drinks were had and from what I heard from my dinner partners they were absolutely amazing . So the bartender was superb . I think there was rhum punch , bob marley, and a few glasses of moscato which was top tier .
They do have a lounge that opens at a certain time in the evening , but we left right before that kicked off , but seemed like it gets pretty live and if you like live music and that sort of thing if could be right up your alley .
I cannot wait to go again .

Rasta Pasta, the creamy sauce and fresh peppers and onions. Shrimp. It was a great portion size for lunch. The atmosphere was modern-contemporary with a Carribean flight vibe. The service was great and it has been consistent for years at this location and the Aberdeen location (Island Spice). The price is a little high but it is worth it for the food, service and atmosphere. Overall, Konoko is worth a visit if you have never been and you will not be disappointed. My favorite part about this restaurant is the music, it fits the vibe well.

This was my first time trying konoko and I was very excited to try it because I love Jamaican food however my experience there was horrible. Let me first start off by saying the host was very sweet and nice and I love the Way the servers greet you with their theme. The place was clean and decorated nicely. I ended up ordering their signature jerk Wings as my appetizer and they were really good and flavorful. For my main dish, I had their famous oxtail. and I was so disappointed the oxtails was flavorful, but they barely had any meat on them, it was just fat and bones the rice was very dry and before ordering my meal I asked my waitress if I was able to substitute the salad with a different side and she told me I was not able to do that I would have to pay extra. Which is ridiculous, if I’m already paying $38 for the dish, why am I not able to choose which side I want. Oh and one more thing, my waitress did not come off very friendly. We had to keep asking other people who was not servers for help because she would go away and not come back for like 10-15 minutes. Didn’t check up, ask how everything tastes not even a refill and when I ask to add an extra side with my meal she gave me a weird look. At that point I was over it!! Which is upsetting because I would have gave this place another chance maybe next time trying something different, but it’s not worth the money very expensive not enough hospitality and the quality of the food is not that good.

Definitely not worth the price. Small portions. The salmon bites were unseasoned and greasy, not good at all. The seafood pasta tastes like tuna Mac, had 3 scallops, 4 shrimp, a lobster tail that cost 8.99 in store, and about 4 pieces of lump crab meat, not worth 57.00. They also add gratuity, there were 2 of us and the gratuity for my check alone was 17.00 for the salmon bites and seafood pasta. Not worth the money at all.  The jerk chicken wings were good though. The service was good at first, our “attendant” was SweetPea, she was kind at first and then she got an attitude out of nowhere, there was no courtesy and her service lacked after we ordered our food and got our appetizers. She was doing her best to avoid us and eye contact with us after we got our appetizers(I’m thinking bc she saw me spit the salmon bites out and then they remained untouched), she also made a comment about being “triggered” to another bartender, it was weird and VERY unprofessional. The drive from Pennsylvania was NOT worth it.  Definitely won’t be back and I’m very disappointed, it was a waste of both money and time.

KONOKO's food will definitely take your taste buds on a trip to Jam Rock! Reserving a table was fairly simpe and they have a rewards program for those whom wish to frequent the restaurant. Me amd my date had the oxtl platter, shrimp rasta pasta, salmon bites and 2 drinks from the bar. It was all well worth the $$$!

name: The Caribbean Stop Take out & Catering

reviews.text: Only Jamaican spot I’ll go to. Stacy is literally the best, she knows my order and everything. I’ve been going to this spot for probably over a year, close to two now. I recommend this spot to all my friends and family. It’s authentic with true, genuine people running it. The food is good, but also consistent. There hasn’t been one time I picked up food and it didn’t taste like the last time I picked up. I typically order the curry chicken w/ rice n peas, plantains, curry & beef paddy, a side of jerk chicken. I’ve also had the oxtail, Rasta pasta and so much more and all of its banging!!

We ordered online close to 730pm and they were closing at 8pm. The Food was complete and hot when We came to pick it up. The Door was locked when We showed up at 750pm, the Lady who opened the door was very friendly and retrieved Our food. I ordered the Jerk Chicken and mistakenly did not order the sauce, don't be like Me. My Wife had Jerk Wings and they tasted so so good. We were able to eat in the vehicle. It was limited parking in the side of the building where the restaurant is but the complex parking is plentiful.

I visited The Caribbean Stop off of a whim & was pleasantly surprised.  Curry Goat, Rice & Peas, Plantain and the Cabbage were a 10/10. Proportions filled the entire container and the curry goat was perfectly tender, marinated, spicy & steaming hot! If you like plantain, be sure to order extra. What you see is what I got. Nonetheless 10/10.

Ordered Curry Chicken and peas & rice for a family function. Priced very competitively. Definitely a hit. Sweet and delicious. Mr. Gordon was great with communication. The restaurant was experiencing problems with the phone line. So I used the contact us link on the website. The owner returned my message shortly thereafter, answering all my questions. (I had so many) They are willing to customize your order to your needs. Great experience.

Finally found a perfect place to get amazing jerk chicken and ox tail! I have been staying in MD for quite some time now and i’ve been craving for some good Caribbean food and today I finally had that and more. 💯 I ordered in this place for the first time through Doordash for pick up and I was so amazed how I got my food still hot despite being 20 mins late for pick up, and driving 30 mins back home with it still steaming hot upon opening the container. I also had to request some changes with my jerk chicken as I like it bone in than boneless and they did just that for me. I had to add $2 more for it but it was totally worth it! I highly recommend this place and we will definitely come back soon!

As a Jamaican, not many Jamaican restaurants in Maryland live up to my expectations, but visiting here for the first time exceeded them. I had the rasta pasta with oxtail and jerk chicken with a mild jerk sauce. Everything was 10/10, the pasta was very creamy, oxtail was very tender and the jerk chicken was jerked the proper way. On top of that everything was very flavorful and you get a lot of food for your money. I even asked for festival which wasn’t on the menu and the owner surprised me by making me some anyways. I live an hour away and will definitely be making this drive again. I will definitely be recommending this place to others.

Jamaica Flava is honestly a true Gem for those seeking delicious/authentic Jamaican food at affordable prices. The customer service was OUTSTANDING! The restaurant owner acknowledged me & my family the instant we walked in, he was able to give us knowledge about every ingredient in every dish. All his recommendations were perfect so we decided to get the Sweet Chili Fish 🥰👏🏾🙌🏾🔥! I will continue to show my gratitude to this restaurant as long as I’m here in Maryland.

First off the guy at the front is so friendly and professional. He takes customer service to the next level getting to know his customers. 5 stars for him!!!

Next the food is 10/10 always hitting. So far I had the brown stew chicken and just recently tried the jerk chicken. Omg sooooo delicious. I can’t wait to try the chili snapper soon. My all time favorite Jamaican spot.

Food is out of this world best Jamaican cuisine I’ve experienced  and also good service the owner served me he’s passionate at what he does and a very kind person that explains why the food is great! Go check them out😊
Food was really good. As a Jamaican,  I can say its authenticity Jamaican.

KM island Cuisine is a small family owned gem on 25th offering delicious Jamaican food at reasonable prices, simple. Customer service is excellent and the food is always fresh. After I get my haircut I usually get a jerk or curry chicken platter and it’s always on the spot.

Today was the 2nd time I’ve visited this establishment and to be truthful this place is now my go to spot for Caribbean food. I can’t recall the names of either of the women  that took our order, but both were so very nice and personable. On both occasions, we ordered both the large Brown Stewed Chicken and the Curry Chicken, they were soooo delicious. What sets them apart from my former go to spot is that they’ve added potatoes and the chicken is so tender and flavorful. The rice and peas were exceptionally good because rice was cooked to perfection, the food is definitely cooked with love. I’m going to return in 2 weeks to try another dish which I know will not disappoint. Kudos to them all, I’m hooked now! ❤️
Service was great. Beautiful ambiance but good very mid. Has the oxtail…… toooooo much browning not enough seasoning. Cabbage was great!

KM Island Cruise is definitely the place to be if you’re craving real, flavorful food. I’ve been on the hunt for a restaurant that brings me back to the taste of home in Jamaica, and I must say, this restaurant is truly the best I’ve found. The seasonings, the portions, the richness—everything is on point! The environment is warm and inviting, and the food is nothing short of incredible. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a true island experience.
Everything about this place was fantastic. Customer service was a A+ very pleasant and polite. The place was very clean and the food was very delicious.

Extremely overpriced, mediocre service and little flavor. For one small stew chicken and a curry goat. I spent over $48 on pure disappointment. As a Jamaican that only likes to eat JA food for takeout I will never go here again. Stew chicken is normally under $12 and curry goat is under $18. that's nearly a $18 in up cost for dry and unseasoned food

The owner and his family are the most realest people ever. It seems to be a God driven environment. If you do not fear Jah you still should come because the conviction is in the building.

I had the Red Snapper Escovitch and the Mac, rice and beans . Had the jerk with cabbage yesterday. Don't worry about the jerk, I finished that before the photos

As for the food, bro, try the menu, it is so good that you would want to slap yourself for not trying it earlier.

As an American Caribbean myself I give this a ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 12

I ordered a small curry goat with white rice through GrubHub. My order was 100% correct and on time. No issues with customer service. This is the BEST white rice I've had in MD. Tastes just like when my dad makes it. The curry goat had a lot of bones and didn't have too much of a curry flavor, but it was good. It tasted even better the next day. They even gave me a plantain. Most places these days make you order them as a side.

This food was awesome. An the owner is cool as well. I would have taken a pic but its gone 🤣🤣 I have the salmon wit rice an peas with cabbage

*update 3/2/23
Food is still amazing. Owner still cool. Got a pic this time. Half eaten though🤣🤣🤣 sorry guys. One bite an I couldn't stop.

Deliciousness go straight to the veins, be careful
*Mango seamoss - flavor and viscosity👌🏿
*Curry Chicken Roti + Pie on the side 🔥🔥🥵🤤👌🏿👌🏿 - well balanced, juicy, and flavorful - and light touch with the salt/sodium ;)
Authentic Caribbean flavor. The jerk chicken is perfect, and portions are generous. Highly recommend.
Food is always fresh and tasty! The fried fish and jerk chicken are top-tier. I’ve seen them at the Baltimore food truck, and it’s always worth the stop

Atmosphere was good however the food is not as flavorful and tasteful as other say. We ordered a curry chicken bowl and a jerk chicken bowl along with 4 honey old bay wings. The wings was the best part but the bowls disappointing. Both bowls for some reason had clam shells in them and we didn’t order anything with seafood. Not to mention we waited over an hour for the order and I never had soupy curry chicken but that’s what I was served.

First, I just want to say 10 out of 10. (:
I am visiting from out of town for work. I work late at night, so I get off around 2 am.
I googled late night food open near me. I found this place. I had no idea what to expect when I pulled up.
I walked in and immediately saw a chess board and welcoming smiles from Tony and his brother.
The atmosphere is authentic and comforting with a  jovial mood. They have lofi music playing, setting the vibes of the chill atmosphere.
Tony whipped up an imperial salmon dish for me, and the smell had my stomach growling.  The food is amazing and the secret ingredient is love forsure.

He boxed up my food, and after he played a round of chess with me.

I am at my airbnb right now enjoying this incredible food. I absolutely will be back while I am here visiting, and I recommend this place to everyone.

It is such a vibe, and you can feel the energy. It is kind and genuine.

Thank you so much, Tony. Thank you for existing. (:

A HIDDEN GEM 💎

Stumbled on to Monah’s searching for Caribbean good food. The owner answered the phone and I am a fan! The food is spectacular and delicious non- traditional unique. I will be buying again!!! And again!!! I still want my blue Mountain dew, I paid for. Overall spot on goodness!!!

The food that we ordered was made with a lot of love. The cook made sure everything was hot and fresh. He made sure to pay attention to details of the order and came out the back to introduce himself. The place is a nice hang out eat play connect 4 watch the football game and eat. Whatever floats your boat at the moment all I know is 5stars to the chef and the service. Just would love to see a pretty lady in the front taking orders or serving.

My husband and I ordered the birria tacos and the jerk chicken ramen bowl and we originally ordered 2 of each but they only had enough ingredients for the 1 ramen but I was so grateful they called personally and he was so nice to let me know and ask me what else I wanted and it was no problem, he didn’t rush me or anything they have the best customer service!! The food is also savory and delicious & cooked with love and soul & we will definitely order again it’s our favorite place now !! We ate it up so fast before thinking of taking a picture for the review but best believe it was worth it & delicious, y’all should get it don’t hesitate just order you won’t regret it !! 🥰🫶🏼😍💕 perfect for a busy night when you want a hot tasty meal !! The meat falls right off like that type of thing 😩😍

I came here on a whim but I must say that I really enjoyed the food that I purchased from this restaurant.  I wanted to try a couple of dishes, so I got a small Curry Chicken and a small Jerk Chicken with a side of Plantains.  Everything was delicious.  The chicken was properly cooked and not dry.  The Jerk and Curry sauce was perfectly flavorful.  The Rice and Peas and Cabbage was on point, and the Plantains were soft and sweet.

I really enjoyed my meal which was brown stew chicken. I love gravy on any dish with rice. I asked for gravy on my meal, but I didn't receive any. Also I requested a ginger ale but got tea. Thanks so much for this delicious meal.
Best jerk chicken done on a grill daily Rain or Shine. Great brown stewed chicken,  and even brown stewed pork.

I had ordered in door dash and gotten the fried chicken and it was good. I decided to drive 20 minutes as I said it was worth it. I called ahead and ordered two fry chicken white rice and 1 brown stew chicken white rice. When I got there they didn't have my order and it was not ready. The fair lady was giving me attitude but I stood my ground was respectful and ordered the same thing above plus two patties as the fried chicken was gonna take 5 minutes. They asked me again if I wanted rice and peas and I said no white rice for all my meals. Why I got home and the 3 meals had rice and peas. I specifically ordered white rice as I tried both rice and the white rice was better. The patties were delicious. The chicken was dry and not like I had had it that night I ordered off door dash. I like consistency in cooking, it is what makes repeat customers. The lady with the braids was polite. Will I order again, maybe not.

As a Jamaican American, I hold native food in high regard, making my recent experience particularly disappointing. I requested extra sauce and a spicier option, but the results were unsatisfactory. The chicken was dry, and the rice was overcooked, presenting a burnt flavor. Additionally, the cabbage lacked any discernible taste, mirroring my feelings towards the other dishes, except for the potatoes, which were acceptable. I was disheartened by both the taste and presentation of the meal. The plantains were particularly underwhelming and devoid of flavor. I find it perplexing how such a result could occur. At present, I am at work, feeling undernourished and financially constrained. Regrettably, I will not be returning to this establishment; however, I wish them success in the future.

Brand new, woman owned restaurant on   Broadway. The atmosphere is clean and neat with a chic design. I thoroughly enjoyed how they played the best damn 90s/2000s era R&B for ambiance. The food was incredibly flavorful and tasty. Beautifully plated in an artistic fashion and still delicious. I got the Jambalaya with chicken and turkey andouille sausage on top of dirty rice. I had to stop from finishing it because we intended to get dessert. We split EVERY dessert because we couldnt decide. The beignets are damn near perfect. They also have sweet potato cornbread, bread pudding, banana pudding, and peach cobbler. The owner is a gorgeous lady and she came out to say hi from time to time. Definitely check this place out. It's a gem.

This place is amazing. The servers were friendly and helpful. The drink menu is diverse. The food was fresh and well-seasoned. I loved my catfish and grits and my mom loved her steak and wild rice, and we finished with their amazing red velvet cornbread. We couldn’t stop complimenting them. I highly recommend this family-run spot!!!

We went because I just NEEDED some good oysters. I wasn't disappointed! We had the Crab Stuffed Oysters Rockefeller.  They were creamy and delicious! Next time I'm in the DMV, this will be a must! Our server, Ruth, was very pleasant.  Clean restaurant. Nice atmosphere.

My friend and I visited this restaurant on 11/21 around 6pm. The establishment wasn’t that crowded only two other patrons at that time. My friend and I order the fried fish and dirty rice, the friend green tomatoes, & the seafood platter. Everything came out in a timely manner and was delicious, our only problem was the lobster tasted and smelled like ammonia. The manager was extremely understanding and accommodating about our issue, which we were so thankful for. We’ll most definitely be back.

Creole Soul Kitchen & Bar is a whole vibe—and I absolutely love it! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and everyone here treats each other like family. We probably ordered way too much food, but every single bite was incredible.

We had the fried catfish, seafood gumbo, mixed greens, dirty rice, and—my personal favorite—the crab dip, which was absolutely unforgettable. I’m already looking forward to coming back and trying more from the menu. Amazing food, great energy, and hands-down delicious!

The curry goat and chicken were everything — perfectly seasoned, tender, and served piping hot. The portions were generous and left us full and happy. On top of the amazing food, the atmosphere was just as warm. The bartender, chef, and owner were incredibly friendly, and we enjoyed some great conversation that made the experience even more memorable. It was truly time well spent. If you love good Caribbean cuisine, we definitely encourage you to visit — you won’t be disappointed!
The food is absolutely da bomb.  Super duper clean and very affordable.  The food was so darn good me and my wife ordered items to take home. Show up hungry and you'll leave stuffed and satisfied.

If it wasnt for the bartender this would have a 0. The food wasnt real carribean food at all. The sauce thrown on my fried fish was horrible, and fish was overcooked. No flavor at all. They had no sides except for 2 out of the 8 a wait for certain meals, and food is over priced for it to not be real Carribean food. Not authentic at all. Ill only go here for the drinks nothing else.

I walked into this establishment 10/30/25 and the lady behind the glass was on the phone. I patiently waited to be acknowledged. After a minute or so, I had to ask to get buzzed into the door. I sat and waited while she was still on the phone. The gentleman next to me was so kind as to let me see the menu he was finished looking at. After a few mins, she came over and said “do u know what u wanna eat” . Never greeted me or anything. I said no, I just got the menu. She walked away and came back and asked moments later if I knew what I wanted to eat. I said I would let her know when I was ready. I asked her if they had white meat chicken, she said not today. I asked if they normally have it, she said yes. I asked if she knew if they had boneless skinless breasts (when they have them) or breasts and wings. She said we have all parts of the chicken. I digress.

I was in the process of telling her to just give me the shrimp bowl and she walked off and proceeded to help the people standing in line outside of the door to order package alcoholic goods. After helping 2 people, I then asked her if I could place my order. She said “I’m only one person” and that she would be placing my order soon. She told me she heard me and would walk back to tell the cook my order. When she returned, she gave the couple their to-go order. After 26 minutes of helping others, she walked over to the register/computer and asked what I wanted to eat. I  was shocked and appalled as I thought my order was in the process of being made.

I will not be returning. I am new to East Baltimore after moving from West Baltimore County and had been looking for a Jamaican restaurant on this side of town. Your establishment came highly recommended!! I even went to Google to look through reviews and everyone praised the great food and service. Being a black business owner myself, I pride myself and praise businesses with stellar customer service. I was completely taken aback by the dismissive tone from the woman there that day. She seemed to be completely unphased by me being upset with her tone and poor service and wanted me to understand that she was “new.” When I mentioned that she didn’t seem apologetic or like she cared, her rebuttal was “I don’t have a problem apologizing”. Beyond disappointed!!! I would have reached out last week but I am dealing with a lot already going through this furlough. I did send the establishment a direct message on Instagram 11/6/25, but no one responded.

I just really wanted to stress to “Wayne” (that is the name I was given as manager/owner) my experience in hopes that others won’t be faced with the same treatment and blatant disregard of customer service.

I had this amazing Caribbean bar and grill cater my Mom’s birthday party and the guests are still talking about how delicious the food was:-) I will use their services again for the holidays. They are also a great food option for lunch on the go.

The customer service was good. The jerk wings: the flats were good, the drumsticks were rubbery. The mac and cheese was burnt brown on the top and hard. The middle was ok. I was provided more that looked better. The French fries and the triple mix drink was good. ⭐️⭐️⭐️ — 6/10 Experience at Waiting to Oxtail
I visited Waiting to Oxtail this past Saturday after seeing a TikTok review that made the food look amazing — flavorful, well-seasoned, and overall worth the trip. Unfortunately, my experience didn’t fully live up to the hype.

The location is inside the Inner Harbor Mall in Baltimore, and it’s more of a carryout setup with just a few tables in the middle of the mall — not really a restaurant vibe. I understand it’s a newer business, but presentation matters, and it could definitely be improved.

When we arrived, we asked for menus, but they told us everything is digital — no physical copies available. So if you don’t have your phone, you can’t order. Once we looked online, we noticed a lot of items were sold out. I originally wanted to try the mac & cheese with oxtail, but they were out of that and several other dishes. My friend and I ended up getting the Oxtail Rasta Pasta.

The Rasta Pasta was okay — I’d rate it a 6/10. It tasted decent but was too watery and lacked that rich, flavorful sauce you expect. The seasoning didn’t really stick to the noodles, and it didn’t feel like a true Rasta Pasta. They also didn’t have Parmesan cheese, even though it’s shown in the photos, and were out of collard greens too.

A few groups actually walked away while we were sitting there, and I could see why — being out of so many menu items so early is not a good look for a new spot.

When it came time to pay, we ran into another issue. We had $100 cash, but they didn’t have change and said they don’t start the day with any cash on hand — they rely on what comes in from customers. For any business, you should at least start the day with a small amount of cash for change. They ended up sending someone to another store to get change, which took a while. It would help if they had a sign saying they don’t accept bills over $20 or that they’re card-only.

Customer service was also just okay. It seemed like a new server was in training, but no one came to check on us after dropping the food, and the team overall seemed flustered. The man behind the register was trying, but they were definitely understaffed or overwhelmed.

I also tried the Blueberry Ginger drink — it was very blueberry-forward with no real ginger flavor, which was disappointing (especially as someone who loves ginger-based drinks).

Overall, it was an okay experience. I’m glad I tried it, but it didn’t live up to what I saw on TikTok. The food was fine but not worth the hype. I’d give it a 6/10 overall — hopefully, they can improve consistency, service, and supply management as they grow.

I rented the private lounge area at The Reserve Restaurant in Woodlawn, MD for my friend’s baby shower, and I cannot recommend this venue enough! From start to finish, Phil, the owner, was prompt, responsive, professional, kind, and incredibly accommodating. He made the entire planning process smooth and stress-free.

The space was already beautifully decorated, which made it easy to add our own touches and truly make the event unique. Our bartender, Aliyah, and our server, Makenli, provided amazing service—they were attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to make sure our party of about 30 people was well taken care of the entire time.  Aliyah even helped to set up our dessert table and other decor when we were running short on set up time!

The food was delicious, hot, fresh, and ready to be served at our desired time. The ambiance was perfect, with soft jazz playing outside as guests arrived and lighting options to set the scene perfectly. There is plenty of available parking, and they even had a playlist ready that fit the vibe of our event effortlessly. Phil ensured the lounge was spotless inside and out and that the furniture placement was exactly how we wanted it.  The spacious and nicely appointed patio area was made available to our guests, which was awesome.

Phil and his team truly took all the headache out of planning and set-up, so we could actually relax and enjoy the party. Everything went off without a single issue. I would recommend this venue over and over again. In fact, I’m already trying to think of another reason to host an event there as soon as possible!

For the package price, you truly can’t beat what you get—trust me, we’ve tried. Phil was by far the most responsive, hospitable, and thorough venue owner we contacted in the area. Don’t hesitate to reach out to him to book your next intimate affair!

My experience today was amazing Phil, Sam, and Shawn’s hospitality was truly a blessing. This establishment is a hidden gem. As we prepare for my upcoming ventures I will utilize The Reserve and Still Smoking Caters to its full capacity.
I am most grateful for all that I’ve encountered.
