It was spicy and sweet. The shrimp and grits were delicious (and a lot milder). They could have used at least one more employee on a Saturday. The one waitress/cashier was not enough. Would I go there again? Absolutely.

Alright cousins, Doc back outside, true to this, never new to this, and today Bobby D’s in Towson got the spotlight.” 🕶️🍛

Small, niche Caribbean spot, the kind where the flavor’s supposed to hit before the music does. Service was friendly and quick enough, no side-eyes needed. Started off strong with the jumbo shrimp and fries, fried hard, crispy, and fresh enough to earn a slow nod of respect. Added some plantains and cocoa bread, and yeah, those hit like home, warm, soft, and exactly what you want with a cold drink in hand.

Now the main plate… oxtail, rice & beans, and mac & cheese. The oxtail? Tender, but the flavor didn’t clock in for the full shift. Rice & beans leaned more African-style, a little dry but edible. Mac & cheese held its own, not bad, just not that “let me text somebody about this” good.

Overall? Solid 6.5 to 7 outta 10. It’s giving “neighborhood staple with potential,” not “tell-mama-to-get-her-purse.” The apps and sides carried, but the mains stayed humble. Still, I might spin back for that carrot cake because self-control left the chat. 🥕😎

So if you’re in Towson, pull up and try it yourself, maybe your taste buds catch what mine missed. Either way, tell ’em Doc sent you. Lastly very reasonably priced.

I ordered the red velvet, wanted to spoil myself a little ordered delivery. Tell me why I pay nearly $7  for the thinnest slice of red velvet cake I've ever seen. I literally thought half my dessert was missing when I opened the delivery bag. Don't get me wrong, it's still good quality cake but I'm never ordering delivery from here again because apparently if you're not sitting in the restaurant you get half a portion. ($7 was before delivery and tip by the way. $12  and I got half a dessert is ridiculous)

This was our second visit and the food and service have been consistently great. We shared the Ribs & Wings Platter w/ 4 Sides. Everything was delicious and our server checked on us regularly. The back patio area looked cool but we sat inside due to rain. Definitely recommend giving Chef BobbyD a try. We’re already looking forward to our next visit.

Took my aunt to this Resturant for her birthday. She absolutely is obsessed with their pasta’s every pasta that they sell. I had the jerk chicken it was underwhelming. I didn’t like the sauce on it however, I also ordered ribs and macaroni and cheese and plantains that was OK the macaroni and cheese was a little too cheesy for my liking overall, the temperature of the food was amazing my server Janieke (I’m positive I spelled her name wrong) was awesome!!! Big up St Elizabeth. 🤣

I just had to share our awful experience at Judy's because honestly, it was the WORST dining experience we've ever had. My husband and I went there expecting a nice meal, but what we got was nothing short of a nightmare. 😤

First off, we waited for TWO HOURS before our food finally arrived. TWO HOURS! Can you believe that? Meanwhile, we were sitting there hungry and frustrated, watching other tables get served first. When my food finally came, it was completely wrong. I clearly ordered the broiled crab cake, but they FRIED it instead. 😠 I had to take it back and tell the lady at the counter, but she lied to us about when it would be ready again.

And that's not all! I also ordered ground provision with yum, and what they brought me looked nothing like what I expected. Seriously, it was such a disappointment. 😞

To make matters worse, we spent a total of $153 on this terrible meal. For that price, I expected at least decent food and service, not this mess. Please, stay away from Judy's if you want to avoid wasting your money and having a stressful experience like we did. 🚫🍴

Really disappointed,
Cassandra

Ordered thru the kiosk but the gentleman at the counter told me if I needed help to let him know. The jerk chicken was well seasoned. They packaged the food well with plastic around the to go container so it didn’t leak. First time here but definitely will be back.

I can truly say this is the best Caribbean dish I ever had , Ordered jerk salmon Salmon was fresh and so delicious with the jerk sauce , Mac and cheese tasted like I was back in North Carolina for thanksgiving and the rice and peas was amazing, truly a wonderful experience . This was my first experience I ordered though Ubers eats which i was surprised how warm the food was when it arrived also I ordered a side of cabbage which good also , definitely give this amazing restaurant a try .

I’ve eaten here before and really enjoyed it, but tonight felt like an off night. I ordered the brown stew chickpeas, which were delicious, but my husband had a different experience. He ordered the island fried chicken and requested dark meat, but received a mix instead. Unfortunately, they were also out of several menu items, and the biggest issue was the wait—his plate didn’t arrive for nearly an hour, long after I’d already finished my meal

Happy hour was a huge disappointment! Ordered a Strawberry Henny drink & the wings (from HH menu) & 2 sides (reg. menu).  The sides came out 1st & the mac was cold but cabbage medley was good. The wings taste like mass produced wings that were re-fried for serving. And the drink was tart.  The waiter was kind enough to make the drink taste better & bring a fresh hot order of mac. All in all - HH is not worth the time or money- even with the sub-par discounts.  Only order from the main menu if you want to enjoy your experience & have your money well spent.

On Friday, October 3rd 2025, ordered a large curry chicken and brown stew chicken plate, both with rice & peas and cabbage with a side of plantains. They didn't have jerk chicken.

Portions were huge! More then expected. Everything was tasty, we didn't have any complaints.

Not sure what's happening with inside of the restaurant, but they were serving from the food truck. Online is saying it's closed, but I took a chance and drove up there to see for myself and they were in the food truck. So they are definitely open!

Their jerk chicken is flavorful smoked  and jerk. The chicken is tender. It goes fast so order early. Oxtail juicy goodness. The drinks are good especially the ginger lemonade and punch. When it's warm they serve Italian ice. Love this place has flavorful food for a great price.

Going here for yearsss‼️‼️hands down the best cabbage... I haven't been to s Jamaican spot yet that can top it... Customer service has always been A1 and never had any complaints when it comes to the food because it's always delicious and fresh..

I was on my way to Lexington Market for my weekly Friday lunch break. I usually drive past Culture Caribbean Cuisine (windows up and A/C blasting) and admire the artwork and design of the restaurant’s exterior. Today was the day that the smell of jerk chicken on the grill hit my nose when I had the windows down, enjoying the nice weather. I decided to make a U-turn to check it out. As I was pulling up, I saw the grill outside, and I already knew this place was the real deal. The restaurant has a relaxed vibe inside and out. I placed my order, and while waiting, I witnessed one of the customers behind me practically annihilating a big juicy jerk chicken leg. When I looked back a few seconds later, only a tiny piece of the bone remained. I was flabbergasted and excited simultaneously. As soon as I got my food, I checked my plate and tasted the jerk chicken. Let’s say I made it back to work in no time, as time was of the essence, and the food was calling my name. I will be back for sure!

In town for cheer competition goodies Jamaican food near me stumbled across this place the food is good cabbage is cooked to perfection stew chicken is just like I like it not over cooked and not the parts of the chicken that you trying to figure out what part it is like most places lol. Fruit punch super sweet like koolaid

Went two days in a row, and the food was consistently well made, and tasted amazing. There was a wonderful flavor profile in the curry, jerk had just right amount of spice, and brown stew sauce was savory. The Nice lady who answers the phone is always polite and repeats everything back to you. Definitely 💯 recommend if you want good Jamaican and Caribbean food. And the prices compared to others is affordable and good size portions. These were small platters Curry Goat 🐐 n Brown Stew Chicken 🍗

This is my third time grabbing carry out and it’s always SO good! The food is fresh! The food is alwayyysss fresh!!! The curry does not taste as if it was sitting all day and you can find the same freshness with the oxtail and stew chicken as well. As you can see from this pic the string beans are definitely freshly picked and not caked with a whole bunch of unnecessary garlic salt. The flavor of the curry is flavorful and the spicy/heat is just right. The ladies ask if you would like light, medium, or heavy gravy once you are ready for pick up which I truly appreciate. The staff is SUPER friendly. (Medium gravy with a large curry chicken and 2 sides is what’s pictured here) After three visits, I can honestly say this is much better than Golden Krust and Tasha’s. Mi belly nah run me either so that’s also a plus😉
I recommend calling beforehand and it is cash only. If you forget to grab cash there is a Wells Fargo Bank right in front of the shop. You can park either on the side street or right in front of the store with ease.
Best Caribbean food in Bmore! Hands down! Super nice sisters that can cook like nobody's business! Love the energy 🙏🏾💯

This food is so delicious, always piping hot fresh and the portions are large and it's a affordable!  The only down side is they are only open Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, it's cash only, the food full of flavor!!

I have to be honest, the food was abysmal. I don’t like being negative, and this was only my personal experience.

Judging by the 4.4 star rating, it could’ve just been an off-day for the restaurant

Pros:
The customer service was great and they were very friendly.

The jerk chicken was pretty good

Cons: the stewed chicken had 0 flavor. The max and cheese had very little cheese/little flavor (see picture below). The plantain was VERY chewy (almost leathery) and had no salt or sweetness

I always get a dinner from this place, so we decided to have an event catered. The food was awesome and delicious and on time. I will definitely keep them in mind should I need catering again in the future. We ordered jerk chicken, curry shrimp and chicken, rice and cabbage. Everything was excellent!
The oxtails were meaty and delicious.  I called my order in, so there wasn’t a wait.  Pricey, as oxtails typically are, but great serving size.  Very flavorful!

6/29/2025 -

Outstanding customer service..... wow!

Pepper Steak - It was merely ok. It wasn't flavorful at all. It seemed as though it was just thrown together.

White Meat Curry Chicken was good. The meat was tender.

White Meat Stew Chicken was good. It had a lot of carrots and green peppers......Loved that, and the meat was  tender. The cabbage was awful.

The gravy at this location wasn't as good as the Catonsville Golden Crust on Rolling Rd. Unfortunately, Catonsville Golden Crust doesn't offer white meat anything.

Portion sizes were perfect. Thank you for giving us our monies worth.

Side note - All meals came with a lot of carrots and green peppers and 2 slices of plantain.

Also, be prepared for a long wait for your orders.

I absolutely love the way Trecie catered to us. We were new to the Island Quizine experience, and she wanted to make sure that we got a 5star introduction of the business. She did not disappoint! So much so, that when she had to leave us, Me and my Mom almost didn't want anyone else to take our order.

The drink and food presentation was beautiful and full of beautiful, bold flavor.

One thing that is hard to find is outstanding customer service and delicious quality food. I appreciate that they are holding up to this standard. It makes me want to support their business more. And I love that they treat my food and money I spend with respect.

Will be back!!!!

I was really looking forward to enjoying some authentic  escovitch fish but what I got was a flavorless, overcooked disaster. The fish was dry and burnt, with an overwhelming amount of salt that completely masked any potential flavor.
Disappointing to say the least 🙄

When I tell y’all the food was amazing, this was my first time trying them out, the food was sooooo good I called them back to tell them!! I need everyone go support them, y’all won’t be disappointed i promise, I had the combination platter with ox tail, jerk chicken, cabbage and rice & peas, a bomb, my husband had the seafood platter, a bomb, side of mac & cheese, grandma house on Sunday good!! We’ll be back soon

HeyDaddy's is owned by a 19 year old in Baltimore. After being opened for almost a year, he has made so much progress. The food is so good and the customer service is great. You may have a little wait, but once you taste the food, it will be well worth it. I recommened calling your order in and picking it up. This restaurant is also a carryout and not an eat in restaurant.

I got a too good to go bag & it was worth every penny! the chicken is succulent and tender, i do t typically like rice and peas but this was made perfectly some of the best jamaican food i e had in the area!

The chicken and goat curry I ordered was good, and the 2 out of 3 drinks we received were good. However, the cheesesteak combo we got was not pictured as it has been online, and we ended up throwing half of it out. The sauce on the cheesesteak was not appealing at all. It also was not delivered with the drink it was supposed to come with. Not sure I will order again unless all I want is curry/coco bread.

2nd time trying them and the jerk chicken never fails. First time I got the jerk Alfredo that is a bit on the spicy side. Second time I got a small jerk which I would put in the top 3 in the city. The rice and peas are not dry and the cabbage not over cooked or greasy. S/N I would suggest going during day time hours not the best side of town.

Jerk chicken was tender and juicy with the rice. The lunch special is a real deal. I wish I had the option to have bread pudding served hot. The cashier was very patient and kind asked questions about menu options. I wish a printed menu was available because menu on TV kept moving. I definitely will be returning for the lunch special 😋

I had a terrible experience with this restaurant. In the past the food was salty and I said I was done but recently I decided to try them again. Because it had been about a year. That was a huge mistake.
I made an order through Uber Eats for delivery. They sale was for stew chicken buy one get one free. I added my sides and even more so extras (sides).
I get a message for my uber driver saying they are waiting and they have been there for a while.
After I get a call from the restaurant saying every side except cabbage is out. And I ordered 5-6 sides. They only had about two sides one of which I don’t eat.
I suggest more chicken then and was told that was extra money but the restaurant was at fault so they pretty much had no way of helping me at all. So I told them to cancel they said I had to.
Later I called Uber Eats and was told the restaurant told informed me I had to call Uber Eats about the problem and not to cancel. And now they had my money and gave nothing to me. And the restaurant never even offered a credit in the future.
I just know better now. And I will no longer go there again. I should have learned the lesson the last time.
Don’t waste your money go to a better place with better food and better customer service.
I am from the area and there are at least 5 other Carribbean restaurants within a 3 mile radius.
One Jamaican spot on Rodgers ave is delicious.

Ordered takeout from Judy’s and was pleasantly surprised! The portion size was generous for the price, which is always a plus. The curry chicken had a rich, flavorful sauce really hit the spot. The rice and peas were decent, though a bit underwhelming compared to the rest of the meal. The  cabbage was well seasoned and cooked just right. Overall, a solid meal and great value. Will definitely be back to try more dishes!
I give up on this place…oily and inedible. The rice also had crunchy bits in it. It was mushy and crunchy. What a shame to pay so much money for food that has no quality.

I didn’t get what I originally ordered which was the oxtail quesadilla. I placed my order and was told I would receive a text once it was finished. I waited in my car for nearly 30 minutes before I returned inside only to be told that my quesadilla was still not ready. I informed the woman at the pick up window that I needed to get my kids and she stated just 5 more minutes. The food wasn’t ready still so I told her I wanted my money back. At that time the woman who originally took my order stated “quesadilla is cooked to order” I then replied  what quesadilla takes 30 minutes?” She then asked me if I wanted something else I stated it didn’t matter since I wasn’t going to get my money back. I was given oxtails with cabbage and Mac and cheese which she stated cost more than an oxtail quesadilla. The meal was underwhelming to say the least. The Mac and cheese taste like sugar noodles the cabbage wasn’t seasoned and the oxtails taste like sugar and cinnamon. I was disappointed and I’m not sure if I would even try anything else on the menu

Honest truth from someone who NEVER whines and who has been going here for years. The food is not tasty, hot, or well seasoned like it has in the past. I went there this evening and ordered the oxtail (you can only order large for $25). I was hungry too and drove a far distance. The rice and peas, plantain, and cabbage was cold. Not even warm. The oxtail wasn’t bad and it was the only hot item. It should have a little less fat. The last time I ordered the curried goat. It looked like beef. It LACKS the curry like how it once was. That was barely warm also. They must have changed chefs because it’s progressively gone to subpar. PLEASE take the feedback in good spirit because I’d still like to support you but you have to pay better attention to ensure your paying consumers are actually getting what they ordered. No one likes cold food when they have to pay. I barely ate it and had to waste it of which I regret.

Sigh....ordered the stew peas today for $18 was given 2.5piece of fine chopped pig tails. No other meat was in the stew peas just pigtails. They fill the meat section of the box with rice and place the 2pieces of pigtail on top. I have pics and videos I wish I could post here. The rice was mushy and the cabbage had nothing called seasoning or of any taste. The 2pieces of plantain were the only thing palatable. The Indian lady here is very rude and thinks people have to support her restaurant 🙄. Today was a lunch offer from someone and thats the only way Montego Bay  Bakery gets a penny from me. The food is cold and tasteless here so if you are not on your way home to re-season and apply heat to your food, save yourself and go somewhere else! If there was a no star they would have gotten it. Highly disappointed! After calling them to let them know that was a disappointing experience the lady said "bring it bck" like I guess they think gas is free. Like you reach work n gone miles away to open your food box in disappointment!

Great food, I've been ordering the jerk chicken lunch specials for about 3 days now, the lunch specials is only $6.50 and it's a great size portion. Only thing that sucks at this place is the $10 card minimum 🤦, it sucks because what if I only have money on my card for lunch specials and I don't have cash, I've seen other establishments get in trouble for using the card minimum trick but other then that this is a great place to eat good island dishes.
I've been here for brunch a few times and I love and enjoy my time at this restaurant.  The service is good and so is the food. So I want to go on another night and check out the atmosphere!

This should be jerk chicken inspired. Not an ounce of seasoning, no spice, just chicken.

Rice is over cooked. Plantains is probably the most edible thing on the plate.  Not sure where these 5 star reviews come from.

The first time I couldn’t get a picture… it was so good. I had to go back for the pineapple snapper (picture below). Oh wow I think this might be my weekend treat. My daughter absolutely loves the brown stew chicken and brown stew snapper. The service was fast. Food fresh. They had selfish fritters. Yummmmm go try anything I might be there as well.

I’ve been coming here since I was 18, back when it was in the shopping center next to Alko’s. That alone should tell you how real this place is to me.

The food is always on point.
•	Curry chicken and jerk chicken never disappoint
•	My daughter’s favorite: cow foot stew, spinach patty, and a side of brown stew chicken
•	My personal favorite: the escovitch snapper always made perfectly

It’s always a hit, never a miss. The juices are refreshing every single time, and to finish it off, you can’t go wrong with rum cake or sweet potato pudding.

Those are just my favorites though honestly, everything here is top notch. This place is my comfort zone, the spot I come to when I need to shake off the blues of life.

Highly recommended. Always.
Never disappointed when I visit Tashes for Jamaican food. I find them reasonably priced for delectable food and quantity. Service reps are always accommodating and pleasant. Thank you!

So I ordered here for the first time two days ago. I was slightly hesitant based on the reviews as some are good and some are off.
I ordered the curry chicken with a side of plantains and white rice/pea’s. It was delicious I would order again. However, I also ordered their bread pudding but I didn’t like it, it had an undesirable taste so I disposed of it. I will return though.

The new location has dine in seating. The food is good but the level of seasoning varies and sometimes can have too much pepper.  The sorrel drink is always a good choice. The rotis are large and well stuffed. The porridge of the day is always on point. The ackee and saltfish with a fried dumpling is a must.

Came here this evening and got a small oxtail and lg stew beef , spent about $40 and the food was absolutely disgusting !!! 🤮. Idk who taught them how to cook but it’s not Jamaican food the gravy was so thick and sweet idk where they do that at . I guess that’s why you can’t get an exchange or refunds or the fact that they don’t let you have a taste test  cause they already know it’s nasty cooking. If you’ve never tried Jamaican food DON’T I repeat DON’T go to this spot !!! You’ll be deprived of tasting some good authentic Jamaican food . They put Jamaicans to shame !

Came here on 12/13/25 for the 1st time to get an oxtail meal for my Mom. Simply amazing service, plentiful food for the price and the owner was professional, engaging and what a delight. I will definitely be returning and can't wait to try something different also. Thanks again Sir for waiting patiently for me to arrive for my order and being a true gentleman and awesome business owner. Wow, what a breath of fresh air to experience exceptional customer service. Thanks, Ms. Pat😊😊

They will openly which is a plus but your food will be microwaved. The portion size seem good but you will get a lot of rice. The flavor was authentic but don't get the callaloo. The portion size is so ridiculously small for the price.

Their Jerk Chicken was good. The curry chicken portion is fire 🔥, but they put way too much rosemary which is throwing the taste off and made it hard to eat.  The portions are amazing for the price.

Please taste the food while cooking. I'm hopeful this is just a bad batch. I know it can be sometimes.

Spicy Beef patty was fire 🔥

Jamaican owner who knows how the food is supposed to taste and representing the culture. Please fix yardie.

Prices are on point!

The Everest Juice is cold!

Note for Fireside Cuisine:
People will come and support and pay, but you have to have food that tastes good every single day. If you don't have enough people buying. You lose the business. Please use common recipes. The flavors were off a little bit.

Customer service is extremely rude. Food appears to be left in steamer over night. Guy in front is not clean sweating over food with holes inside sleeveless shirt. Guy in front chicken on chop board that’s not sanitized. Will not patronize or support this establishment. Do not recommend. Not a good experience compared to other great Jamaican carry outs in Baltimore I’ve tried.
I had the curry chicken, pea n rice and cornbread. Omg, it was really tasty. There was a food truck by my job, I'm definitely looking forward to them coming back.
The goat curry meal was quite delicious, I loved the flavor very much and loved how welcoming the workers are. Keep it going, you're doing great!

Had wings, margaritas and Mac and cheese
They served home made honey mustard and ranch
Everything was delicious!!!

So upset went there spent $28 on food that I could not eat.  First of all, I go there I asked for the oxtail dinner with macaroni and cheese and cabbage. I told the lady I cannot eat spinach because I’m allergic Get home is spinach on my plate instead of cabbage do not go here ended up giving the food to my son and he said the food was horrible.

This meal really brought it home for me.
I have a spot near my house in NY and I was craving some Caribbean on my last day of a business trip in Greenbelt, MD
I stumbled across this lovely place that is in the middle of renovating it seems. But let me tell you the lovely women who was assisting 2 others as I arrived was sweet and kind and really believed in her food and walked them through the options. Me, I already knew what I wanted. When she finished and greeted me with that broad welcoming smile I already knew I was in for a treat.
The oxtail dinner is so flavorful. The gravy was savory and rich and the softness of the rice and peas was like I was invited into her home.
Thank you for a wonderful experience and I wish you all the best! Next time I am in town I will stop by again!
The best after you get off work and don't feel like cooking
This was my first time eating here me and my husband LOVED IT FOOD IS FRESH AND DELICIOUS 😋... WILL BE BACK CUSTOMER SERVICE WAS GREAT 👍
Great food and great lady. Went twice in 3 days. Never a bad pice of food! Thank you.

The location is definitely a hole-in-the-wall kind of place but the food is really good and well priced. The lady that makes plates knows how to fill a plate so you will be eating for days. I’ve had great service thus far. People really like the yams, Mac and cheese, pork chop, collard greens, cabbage, watermelon, potato salad, and wings.
Overrated I am people tell me it was good but it was overrated

Hands down the best Jamaican food in the area. I can't believe I have not reviewed this establishment until now, I also can't believe it's only 5 reviews. He always has a long line and is sold out down at JH University. My hubby and I came into contact a couple years ago at Afram and we have been hooked on this good food. This is authentic Jamaican cooking, not just pepper but actual seasoning. We enjoy the curry chicken, jerk chicken, pastas, and the Mac and cheese is fire! The drinks are also very good. I'm so happy we found him because it is the best food in the area.

I came by twice in 2024. They were open. Since the start of 2025 I have never seen their food truck open. So i dont waste my time coming by... especially if i visit the K&Gs on a weekend afternoon, and they are still closed. Shameful business ethics.

Absolutely disgusting, this food truck parks outside of my office in Baltimore. I've tried their food 1 because I love Caribbean cuisine and 2 for support of a black business. Each visit had been utterly disappointing. If you want quality and flavor the best options are Culture cuisine food truck and Hummingbird carryout. I'm attaching pictures the food was at least a day old. This is a bug No No with my Trinidadian family as Caribbean food is cooked fresh l. The truck is smoking but the quality is horrible. Do NOT patronize this BUSINESS

I always get service with a smile. The owner maintains high standards for cleanliness and customer service. I love the Sorrell and Pineapple Ginger drinks.  My go to order is the oxtail and Mac and cheese with a side of veggies but the jerk, curry goat, barb- fry, and stew peas specials are also good.  I haven't gotten around to trying the fish as yet but it always looks good.  This is one food truck I can say for 1000% certain takes great pride in making their food with love.  They also do catering orders.  Try them out and you will not be disappointed!

We had the chance to try their jerk chicken during the kite festival at Patterson Park. This was the closest we've ever gotten to getting that authentic jerk flavor from Jamaica. By far the best tasting plate we've had outside of the island. Surprising bonus, the mac and cheese was excellent as well. Can't wait to see them out again at a future event.

Ate at this place for the first time while I was visiting Baltimore, and honestly, it was such a letdown. My partner and I took maybe three bites each before tossing the entire meal in the trash. That’s $33 completely wasted.

We ordered the jerk chicken and the Rasta pasta, expecting at least some flavor — especially since this spot has a 4.5 rating. But the Rasta pasta was shockingly bland. It tasted like plain buttered noodles with just a hint of spice thrown in, nothing close to the rich, creamy, well-seasoned dish it’s supposed to be. The jerk chicken wasn’t any better: overcooked, dry, and rubbery, which made it almost impossible to enjoy.

What really gets me is how misleading that 4.5 rating feels. There’s no way this is what people are raving about. At this point I can only assume most of those reviews came from friends and family, because this was genuinely some of the worst Rasta pasta I’ve ever had in my life — and I’ve had plenty.

Super disappointing experience all around. I wouldn’t recommend it, and I definitely won’t be back.
Food was tasty just had entirely Too many Onions. Very flavorful. Very affordable! Would give 5 stars without the onions & better location (neighbor restaurant smelled bad)

The chicken pot pie was phenomenal. They sent a side of jerk sauce, not something i would have considered but AMAZING! The blackened chicken wrap was really good as well. I'm back in NYC wishing this place was local

Came one time and was absolutely blown away by the food. Now every time I'm in town I have to stop by.  Literally have a friend bring me up two platters of jerk chicken to Philly because it's that good. Amazing customer service. Looking forward to going back!

Read about Sugarbee’s on the Nextdoor Neighbor app. Thought I’d give them a try. I started with their cheese steak and their tuna melt. Both sandwiches, outstanding. Used DoorDash for the delivery. Food was still hot when it arrived. I’ll be back.

Bf was looking for some good fried porkchops 🥩 to go and found this place online. Only Soul/Jamaican food spot near our way. The food was very good with very nice portions! The meals are made to order. I suggest you call in before pickup. They are also on Doordash for delivery. The family that runs the business were also friendly. Will try other items on the menu on the next round. We ordered the porkchops and jerk chicken meal 😋 and a side order of Mac and cheese 🧀.

Ordered again on 10/12/21...for some reason I couldn't do another review but I will just add to this. Ordered catfish platter with cabbage and mac for bf. Once again he enjoyed his dinner. He said definitely down home flavor, fresh and totally satisfied with the Mac and cabbage. He felt that he was back at grandma's house. It was a pleasure coming back. Met and got to talk with the owner. She was pleasant to talk to and so sweet. She and her daughter really takes pride on what they do. Even her daughter have her own little business with Italian ices and clothing line. Check them out.

Let's start with this is my second order from this restaurant. My first order everything tasted great. I can't say the same this time. Imma break down each dish and the problems. First Lake trout with greens and candies yams the fish were a bunch of little pieces and they were beyond dry and over cooked like so overcooked if you squeezed them it disintegrated. Second was whiting and it looked exactly the same as the trout and the Mac and cheese was dry and overwhelmed with pepper. The third was fried chicken the chicken was good but Mac and cheese not so much. Also we ordered dinner roles but instead dry cornbread. Oh yeah and we order chocolate cake and received Lil Debbie cakes. IM BEYOND IRRITATED I FEEL LIKE I JUST WASTED $80

**Review of Zanzibar Café – A Taste of Authentic African Cuisine in Charlotte, NC**

Zanzibar Café is a hidden gem in Charlotte, offering a vibrant and flavorful journey into African cuisine. Located at *3720 N Tryon St Ste 101* , this restaurant stands out for its diverse menu, warm atmosphere, and commitment to authenticity.

**Food & Menu Highlights**
The menu is a delightful mix of African and American fusion, with standout dishes like:
- **Grilled Specialties**: Beef & Chicken Kabobs, Grilled Blackened Salmon, and Whole Tilapia—perfectly seasoned and cooked .
- **Fish Meals**: The Fried Croaker with Plantains or Acheke (a West African side) is a must-try .
- **Liberian Dishes**: The Palm Butter and Cassava Leaf stews are rich, aromatic, and highly praised by patrons .
- **Unique Sides**: Fufu, fried plantains, and corn beef rice add an authentic touch .

For lighter options, their salads (like the Blackened Salmon Salad) and grilled chicken dishes are equally satisfying .

**Service & Atmosphere**
The staff is noted for being friendly and efficient, whether you’re dining in or ordering takeout . The atmosphere is casual and family-friendly, with TVs and a welcoming vibe . Reviews highlight the restaurant’s cleanliness and the owner’s responsiveness to feedback .

**Pricing & Practical Info**
- **Hours**: Open Tue–Fri (11 AM–8 PM), Sat (Noon–8 PM), closed Sun–Mon . *Note:* Some sources list slightly different hours , so checking ahead is wise.
- **Price Range**: $$ ($10–$25 per person) .
- **Service Options**: Dine-in, carryout, and delivery available .

**Final Verdict**
Zanzibar Café delivers an unforgettable culinary experience, especially for those craving African flavors. Dishes like the Pepper Soup with Fufu and Palm Butter come highly recommended by regulars . While the restaurant’s Google ratings are mixed, the passionate reviews from diners—especially those familiar with African cuisine—speak volumes.

**Rating**: ★★★★☆ (4/5)
**Recommendation**: A must-visit for adventurous eaters and anyone missing homestyle African cooking. Don’t skip the ginger lemonade! .

The menu has a variety of protein options and staple favorites like jollof rice, rice n beans, fufu, etc. I ordered Jollof w/chicken and it came with plantain n  cabbage. This is by far the most authentic, flavorful food I've had in charlotte since I moved here in May (2021).  Drops Mic!

I couldn't even take a picture of the food before I started eating because after the first fork full I fell in love and needed to quickly get better acquainted with the goodness that was in the container. This meal gave me the comfort that I've been missing.

I ordered several dishes from Serengeti Kitchen for Thanksgiving and everything was absolutely amazing. The food was delicious and everyone we hosted was genuinely impressed.

The samosas were generously filled, flavorful, and a huge hit. The chapatis were soft and pillowy, just perfect. The pilau rice was fluffy and delicious, and the mandazis were sweet, fresh, and beautifully made.

We’ll definitely be ordering from them again — highly recommended!

I loved it, plain & simple. Saw this place being reviewed on TikTok, and I wanted to try.. I was not disappointed in doing so. The food was seasoned well, with a pretty large portion (see pics below 📸.) Also for myself the sanitation score is important. They have a A. 👍🏾

Chef Ammalu was fantastic in helping me plan a tasting menu that would go along with my preschool class' Uganda/East Africa theme. Today, I brought in four and five year olds and she made them feel at home.  She shared some of her story with the children and helped them feel connected to the food, which was above and beyond.  And then the food - y'all, it's so good!  We had two chaperones order more food to take home.  And every single child found at least one thing on their tasting plate that they liked.  For me, it was the beef samosas and the coconut rice cakes (and everything else).  Go and try her food, it's amazing!

WOW!!! This was our first experience trying Tanzanian food. We were excited to try and the very nice young man gave us his recommendation and we tried it. Swahili Chicken Biryani and Samosas were perfection. The flavors were absolutely amazing. I can’t wait to bring my friends and family to try this.

This was the best food I had in awhile and probably the best vendor at 7th street market. My family was hesitant but once they saw my lamb plate they went and got food from Serengeti Kitchen too! A must try.

Abu works hard on making his food appeal to all customers. The signature dish, the Afro Burger, is full of fresh ingredients and amazing flavor. I am pleased and looking forward to another. I hope his Senegal flavor will turn into a restaurant as well someday.
They are too good and delicious 🤤 I can't wait to buy again 😋🤤❤️
Very good food
They sell very delicious food and it's safe😋

My wife and I have been going here regularly since we moved to Charlotte, and it’s become our favorite restaurant here. The food is amazing and the atmosphere is very welcoming (especially to newcomers). We also love the honey wine which is made in-house, so definitely try it!

We started with the sambusa, one of each flavor and although they were all delicious the lentil was the favorite! The meat platter was the perfect amount for our table of four, but the food was so good we kept ordering more. If you want authentic cuisine definitely come by, but be prepared to possibly wait on a weekend night as table space is limited and demand is high!

My My where do I begin, I absolutely enjoyed my experience dining at this restaurant, the food is impeccable and amongst some of my most desired! This Family inspired establishment deserves to be recognized in the Carolinas! Guys, pay a visit and dive into this deliciousness!!

As an Ethiopian, I can say the food has the real, authentic taste. The portion was generous, the price was fair, and the flavor was just right. The service was kind and attentive, and the place had a warm, welcoming feel. Highly recommend for anyone looking for true Ethiopian cuisine!

This was our first time trying Ethiopian food, and it was all amazing! The cashier was super helpful in helping us decide what sides to get with the meat platter. The green beans were delicious. We will definitely be back!

name: Enat Ethiopian - Optimist Hall
vicinity: 1115 N Brevard St Enat Ethiopian, Charlotte

reviews.text: I’ve been to Optimist Hall several times, but this was my first time trying Enat. I will definitely be back, it’s the best Ethiopian that I’ve had in the Charlotte area. Flavors are amazing and the portion sizes match the pricing.

This was such a good dish! We got the large plate that has a few different options on it (beef, lamb, chicken, etc.). We shared it between 3 people and it was more than enough. You can probably share it between 4 people to be honest. Note that some of the stuff is pretty spicy!

If you’re looking for an Ethiopian restaurant, you’re in for a treat! They offer gluten-free Injera made with teff, which is a fantastic option. The staff is super friendly and really knowledgeable about the menu, so feel free to let them know you want the 100% Injera made with teff. Plus, there’s a delicious vegan option available right on the menu.
Enjoy your meal!

This is my 2nd time trying Ethiopian food. I ordered Lamb Tips with pea split and beans and carrots as sides. All of them taste great! The size is decent too. I will definitely go back and try other food there
Enat is simply an authentic Ethiopian staple in Charlotte. The food is warm, fresh, and delicious ALL THE TIME! Keep up the great work Enat 💪🏾🏁

Great injera! Great honey wine!
And some of the best Fitfit I have ever had. Often people don’t spice their fitfit correctly, and this was spiced perfectly. They also chopped up bits of injera in their Fitfit, and I’ve not always seen that.

The food is outstanding! We have eaten a lot of authentic Ethiopian food, and I always judge the quality of the restaurant by their injera. And I’m always hoping that they have some sort of honey wine, whether it is homemade or it is tej.
We had the Abugida Feast, which included chicken or beef and all of the veggies. It was plenty of food for two people. Although I’m still glad that I got the Fitfit.

The atmosphere was good, a little bit chilly inside, but the plates were very pretty as well as the glassware. The servers were attentive, and the food came out very quickly.

The staff was excellent with explaining the menu & asking if we will be eating off the same dish. The food displayed beautifully and tasted great. I wish there were better options on the drinks  such as traditional iced sweet tea or fountain drink soda for refills vs. the can. The restaurant was cozy. The unisex restroom was clean. We ended up parking in the parking lot beside the  business instead of in back. We will be back.

This is one of my favorite restaurants in Charlotte, and certainly the best authentic Ethiopian restaurant. I have been a frequent customer for a few years. I’ve never had an unpleasant experience. The staff is very friendly, and the restaurant is very well kept.

The chicken, beef and lamb tibs dishes here are all great but I lean toward the lamb.

This is a different kind of experience as you eat your meal with the bread that's served. There are plenty of vegetarian options for those looking for that.

The wine and coffee available here are also very good.

The food was pretty good. Not the greatest. Tried the non-veg platter. The Doro wet was great. The service was good.
Loved the experience with the coffee. The ambience is okay. The restrooms are pretty neat. A quick stop to have some decent Ethiopian food. Price is more on the higher end.

This is a food truck uptown, Charlotte! I ordered the wings, the fried sweet plantains, and African jollof rice  All the food was just extremely delicious. But please bear in mind that they are not whole wings they’re halfling so I only receive six wings and not 12 however this is an excellent place to Splurge on because it’s authentic! Cook, fresh and delicious. Some thought that I was not African, but I can cook African food very well! This spot is a great treat. I’m not a big fan of partying Amen ( from patron buying food at the location). However I enjoy the food very much, and will definitely visit and buy again! Thank you to all the staff.
Unfortunately, I can’t provide feedback on the service or atmosphere as I ordered through Uber Eats. I placed two orders of suya, and I must say it met my expectations and satisfied my suya cravings.
The food is so good the flavor the seasoning the easy it's cooked is perfection. Customer service is good as well.

I had this & immediately wished I had ordered 2 plates ! Because half of it was gone in the car & by time I got home I needed more !! It was so good I had jerk chicken with jollof rice ! 10/10 I will be back & I will be recommending thank you !
Great flavor. Will definitely be back. Wings were my favorite.

The food was absolutely delicious and truly a hit with everyone at our event! Everything was well-prepared, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. We received so many compliments from our guests. I will definitely be ordering again and highly recommend their catering services.

i got yam, tsofie, & fried rice. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, flavorful, and prepared with so much care. On top of that, the owner was incredibly nice and welcoming. Definitely a spot worth coming back to!

I saw Adepa’s Kitchen on Google and I am a Ghanaian so even from the pictures and videos I could tell that’s a real authentic Ghanaian foods and not one of the “wannabes” so i took a short trip from Charlotte to Mount Holly with my mom to get the Yam And Chofi and Babyyy that was worth the one hour trip we did. From the flavorful Chofi to the perfect crispy yam to three different sauces( brown sauce, green sauce and red sauce) and all tasty too. Let’s just say I am going to go back until I have tried everything and oh both her and her husband are so welcoming and so sweet.  And I will recommend you order ahead so that by the time you get there your food will be done and ready. Thank you Adepa’s Kitchen.

We stumbled upon Adepa’s Kitchen while in town for our family reunion, looking for something different to eat and they popped up at just the right time. It turned out to be the hidden gem we didn’t know we needed.

From the very first bite, the food absolutely blew us away. Every dish was full of rich, authentic flavor and clearly made with love. But what truly made the experience unforgettable wasn’t just the amazing food it was the spirit of the people making it. The team at Adela’s Kitchen radiates warmth, joy, and genuine care, and you can taste that in every bite.

The interaction and disposition of the staff made us feel right at home, and it became instantly clear why their food is so good: it’s made by people who truly love what they do.

We wholeheartedly recommend Adepa’s Kitchen to anyone in the area. If you haven’t tried it yet, make it a priority you’re not just getting a great meal, you’re getting a piece of their heart and soul on a plate.

We are here from NY and possibly will make the move to NC just to continue having the good lol.
Adepa never disappoints. The food is always fresh and delicious. Ordered through DoorDash and was a seamless experience

name: Queen Sheba Ethiopian Restaurant & Bar in Charlotte

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Wow — what a beautiful experience at Community Kitchen Cafe! The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with love. You can taste the care in every bite. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff made you feel right at home. This place is more than just a cafe — it’s a true gem in the community. I’ll definitely be coming back again and again!

Very very delicious! This was my first time eating Ethiopian food. I loved it! I tasted so many new flavors. Everyone was very kind to me. The chef was great!!! He taught me how to eat Ethiopian bread with my hands, as it's a different culture than my own, since I'm from Cuba. I give it 5 stars. I'll be back.

This restaurant is under new management. The Ethiopian cuisine is fantastic. The Awase and legaTibs plate was huge, and the beef was tender and perfectly seasoned. We also had the Vegetable Combo plate, and everything was excellent. The cabbage dish was my favorite. We ended the meal with traditional Ethiopian coffee. I highly recommend Queen Sheba Restaurant.

One of the best unique experiences in Charlotte. The food is great, definitely try the avocado salad, a unique item many Ethiopian restaurants do not make in this specific manner. In addition they do Ethiopian coffee ceremony another very special experience rarely seem in the USA. The owners are good people that treat you like you are in their house.
Amazing coffee ☕️ food was a delicious vegetarian option.

name: Red Sea Ethiopian and Eritrean Cuisine

reviews.text: Great food. Pricey, so i got an appetizer. Delicious.  If you've never had Ethiopian food it may be odd to you just without silverware etc. Just a heads up. Great service and great food. They have pool tables in the back room too, that's kinda fun.

I've been going to Red Sea for years on and off, I would recommend it, it's fantastic but the service is subpar and confusing... Every time I go there, they're confused about my pickup order.... this is going to sound weird but sometimes, some of their food is bland like the lamb chops had zero seasoning very surprising... And there is zero presentation to their food but it does taste good I would probably rate it like a 5.94 out of 10...🤷🏽‍♀️. It could be better... it's just okay.

Came here for the first time today, it’s sensational! My friend and I split the veggie platter and the lentil sambusa because I am vegetarian, and it was so delicious and so much food that we took a to go box as well. Mella, the girl who served us, was so kind and attentive! It’s a beautiful restaurant as well with lots of art and very clean. You should go here for sure!
Food was banging I love to eat with my hands every now and then and this is the spot to some to

The service was great, nice people. I think it was the owner who went around the store greeting the guests. My only complaint is that the rice was soggy to me which when you add the stew to it, it makes me more wet. Plus, I wanted it spicy and didn't get it spicy. Next time I'll ask to have the stew separated from the rice. The sambusas was delicious though

name: Nile Ethiopian Restaurant LLC, DBA Nile Grocery and Cafe

reviews.text: This is a very small place but has some of the best Ethiopian food in Charlotte. We did not plan going there but just ended up as the place we wanted to go was super crowded. The sega wot was just amazing. Tasted like home made food. She was really friendly and helpful. There is a small area dedicated for some Ethiopian grocery items. You can also get some cute crockery’s there. Injera is available as well.
Excellent food and friendly staff.  Best Ethiopian food outside of Addis!

I got the vegetarian sampler plate. To preface, this was my first time having ethiopian food.

I would say the food was pretty good, but to me, I thought it could be a little more flavorful/spicy.

We also had to wait around an hour to get our food, and one of the dishes was not prepared so they replaced it with a repeat of another dish.

Our server was so kind and completely helpful though. In fact, everyone there was so helpful and accommodating.

She even brought out another dish because we were missing one. I don’t know the name of it but it was honestly the best one. I’ve attached a picture of it though. It’s the bright orange side dish.

Nile was simply lovely. You walk in and the dining room is to your right. We went on a Saturday evening and it was empty, super peaceful. We ordered the veggie platter, beef tibs, Doro Wot, and the tea. Everything is delicious. The beef tibs were seasoned and very flavorful. Doro Wot had a good spice level, also very flavorful and I loved that it came with a boiled egg. And to finish the meal, the tea is a must. It was really nice to enjoy an empty restaurant, sipping on our tea. The owner also treated us with so much motherly love, I felt like I was at a home with the treatment she gave us. She served the Tibs and Doro Wot on the veggie platter for us, taught us how to properly enjoy the food. She also packed our leftovers for us which she absolutely did not have to do. I’d highly recommend this place if you want to enjoy some real good home-y food.

The food was amazing! We will definitely come back my husband and I drove two hours to get to this location the food was homemade the Injera bread was so soft and light the vegetables OMG! I can’t even explain the flavors.  I remember corn,collard greens, and some other type of veggie stews, it was amazing! We started with coffee with no sugar it was quite tasty but of course all coffee with no sugar you know it’s bitter, but it was amazing as well the tea I cannot even explain so many flavors! We will definitely be back thank you for the hospitality and the great food. This location also has a different variety of items from popcorn kernels, grains, to home decor definitely a one stop shop amazing people great customer service. Great Prices! We ordered the veggie platter and Beef Tibs.

name: Oh My Soul On The Moo’ve
vicinity: 601 S Tryon St Suite A137, Charlotte

reviews.text:
I was really impressed with the food selection and ended up visiting twice. On my first visit, I tried the burger with onion rings—the burger was decent, and the onion rings were great. I also had the peach drink during this visit, but it wasn’t very flavorful, so I wouldn’t order it again.
On my second visit, I had the cauliflower bowl with added protein, which ended up being my favorite dish. I also ordered the banana bread latte; while it was decent, it didn’t stand out as I was expecting to taste some banana flavour. I would also say that the pricing overall is on the higher side.
The young woman at the front was wonderful—kind, welcoming, and provided excellent service. The staff overall were attentive and regularly checked in to see how I was doing, including two of the male staff members. it was cozy, quiet, and had interesting decorations, which made for a pleasant experience.
The only challenges I encountered were that some items I wanted to try were unavailable, which was disappointing. I was also very disappointed with the blondie (white brownie). It was extremely stale and hard—even after microwaving it—and nearly impossible to bite into! It was definitely not made fresh.

Grateful for this fully vegan cafe! We really liked the S.A. Spicy Macaroni Salad and Banana Bread (which reminded us of french toast) but we could’ve done without the Howzit Boet Wrap. For the wrap (and most of the food I think), it was not made-to-order. They took it from the prepared food section and heated it up for us as we requested.

So excited to have this new vegan option in Downtown Charlotte.
For my first visit I tried the Sausage Roll. Easy to find in the Ally building. I walked in and was helped immediately.
Side sample of a corn salad was delicious as I waited for my order. But I didn't have to wait long, my pastry was handed to my promptly.
I stayed to look at some of there assortment of snack items and grab and go sandwiches. I'll be back to try more.

The sausage roll pastry was fresh, flaky and savory. Comes with a side of sweet acidic chutney. Compliments the item well.

Nice,cozy environment that is suitable for a small meet up with 1 or 2 people. Coffee shop vibes.
I really loved the atmosphere staff was super friendly, and very informative about all the options they had.will definitely be back tomorrow!

Sometimes I get the craving for a big bowl of roasted veggies, and I usually get my fix from Oh My Soul in Noda. However, the craving hit on a Monday this time and OMS wasn’t open. To my luck, I found their sister restaurant OMS On the Moo’ve in downtown was open for delivery! I had the Mama Africa Bowl and now I am happy and full :)

name: 231 Authentic Flavors
vicinity: 9640 S Tryon St unit k, Charlotte

reviews.text:
Amazing authentic African cuisines.
Made with love & a lot of flavor.

I genuinely always enjoy my food when I go there. I love my Haitian peoples and the food. It's always a nice environment and very pleasant customer service. Thank you for not permanently, closing. See you again sometime soon. 10 out of 10 always will recommend. I was so happy when I walked in, and I seen that they had Crémas and they are not shy with the alcohol.

Amazing delicious food!! The food is fresh and made to order. My go to order is stewed chicken with Djon Djon rice and green plantains with a cup of their soursop lemonade!! I’ve been a regular for about a year!!!

I’ve recently came here earlier Sunday Afternoon, 6/29, & drove at least 3 1/2 Hours from Wilmington NC to eat some Authentic Haitian Food. I’ve found out about Rasin Haitian Restaurant through Google. I understand that this was a Small Business, I wasn’t greeted immediately when I first walk in, & didn’t know what to expect. But, as soon as I’ve placed my Order to the Sweet, Friendly Young Lady at the Counter, all of my unsuspecting thoughts shifted away. I was concerned about whether had enough Tables to sit, since it was a smaller place. But, there was more than enough Tables to dine in. The Owners/Staff treated us with Super, Warm Hospitality. Also, their Food was the best that I’ve ever eaten since I’ve visited Fort Lauderdale. Had to wait for a little bit for the Food, but it was worth the wait. The Griot was cooked & seasoned perfectly, the Meat wasn’t fried too hard, Black Rice was great, & the Fried Green Plantain was the best, not too dry. All of the Food had great flavor. Prices were a little bit pricy, but it was reasonable for the quality & quantity of the Food. The Food has very large portions. Thank you, Rasin Haitian Restaurant for creating a great, memorable experience during my Charlotte Road Trip. I’ll give this place a 10/10. It’s great to know that I’ve found a great Haitian Restaurant here in NC. I will definitely return back to this Restaurant, it’s well worth the 3 1/2 Hour Drive. 👍🌴🇭🇹💯

Update: This was my second time visiting this Haitian restaurant, and once again they did not disappoint! Everything was fresh, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. The seasoning and authentic flavors really stood out, you can tell the food is prepared with care and love. The service was top-notch as usual; the staff was attentive, friendly, and made the whole experience even better. Definitely one of my favorite spots, and I’ll keep coming back whenever I’m craving Haitian food!

Overall, this restaurant continues to impress me. It’s rare to find a place that delivers on both amazing food and excellent service every single time, but they do it effortlessly. I highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys authentic, delicious Haitian cuisine, whether it’s your first time trying it or you’re already a fan, this is the spot to go!

A Hidden Gem for Authentic Haitian Cuisine!
I had the absolute pleasure of dining at this incredible spot recently, and I can’t say enough good things about it. If you’re looking for authentic Haitian food packed with flavor and made with love, this is the place.

We ordered the oxtails with black rice and plantains, along with the stewed chicken, cabbage, and red beans and rice—and every single bite was amazing. The oxtails were perfectly tender and seasoned to perfection, and the black rice had such rich depth of flavor. The stewed chicken was equally delicious—juicy, well-spiced, and comforting, with the cabbage and beans rounding it out beautifully.

We also tried the beef and chicken patties—flaky, savory, and just the right amount of spice. And to top it all off, the passion fruit lemonade was the perfect refreshing finish. It was sweet, tangy, and so refreshing.

The food was fantastic, the service was warm, and the atmosphere was welcoming. This is the kind of place that makes you want to come back again and again. Highly recommend!
Side note: I wish we had taken pictures but we dug right in as soon as we received our order.

🔥 **STOP what you’re doing!!!**🔥 Rasin Haitian Restaurant is THE TRUTH!!! 🙌🏽 They catered my aunt’s 50th birthday and our family reunion in June 2025, and let me tell you… I’m STILL dreaming about that food!! 🤤✨ The flavors? UNMATCHED. The staff? So sweet, professional, and made us feel like family. 🥹💛 Every single dish was fresh, flavorful, and served perfectly on time. If you want Haitian food that’ll have you licking your plate and asking for seconds (and thirds 👀), Rasin is IT. 10/10 highly recommend!!! 🌺🇭🇹

name: Island Flavors II Restaurant and Catering

reviews.text: Tried a new Jamaican restaurant for us. Saw pretty good ratings, so thought we do a "Taste Test"... my partner in food ordered Curried Goat, candied yams, cabbage and I got two beef patties since I ate a little earlier. The Goat meat was seasoned just right and it was tender. They provide decent portions for your money so that is a definite plus.  Give them a try! We will be back!

Love the fact that if you’re unable to place your order at the register, they do have a kiosk on the wall where you can place your order as well and pay. I ordered the  salmon With peppers and onions, rice and peas, mac & cheese, and cabbage. Everything Was equal in flavor. The only thing I really didn’t care for was there was too much gravy on the rice. The atmosphere was welcoming, and the staff was very friendly.

This is definitely one of the greatest jamaican spots i’ve been to. The portion sizes are HUGE especially for the price. The customer service is also amazing, they tend to remember their frequent customers as i’ve been back quite a few times after trying it for the first time 😂. Would definitely recommend anyone to try and come to this spot. It’s not in the greatest location but that never bothered me.

This restaurant is decent but has room for improvement. I placed my order online 30 minutes ahead since I live a bit far. About 10 minutes before arrival, I received a polite call informing me they were out of jerk chicken and it would take an extra 10 minutes to prepare. Unfortunately, the order ended up taking an hour longer than expected before it was ready.

The woman I spoke with on the phone was very kind and professional, which I appreciated. The food itself was okay. Overall, I would suggest paying in person rather than online to avoid delays or issues with substitutions.

I finally found my spot for Jamaican food in Charlotte.  Best brown stew chicken I’ve had since moving here.  It tasted just like Mama Mertz’s, my great grandmother.  I wish the plantains were a bit dryer and overcooked, (personal preference) but they still tasted very good.

Ordering for delivery was easy on their website and the food came in a timely manner.  I will definitely order from them again and recommend them to friends and family.
They made my day. I came all the way from hickory after not having them in years and they made sure to take care of me. Thank you for your amazing service and I loved the jerk chicken.
Okay amount on the portion size. Cabbage didn't have much taste. Yams were just that, not candied yams. Meat was very tender but they needed more of the seasoning. Service was good.

First picture is how the food was handed to me in a tied bag that i immediately opened in the car. That’s cleaned up it was completely worst. Upon tasting this 25 dollar box of Alpo. I’m sure Alpo tastes better. I can’t even describe the taste. Burnt gravy. Nasty meat and on the pic i didn’t even Attempt the macaroni. Runnnn as fast as you can from this place
Food was delicious and the staff was great. Located right near downtown. Will definitely come back

I have been to a few Caribbean food spots in Charlotte and this is my final stop. The food was delicious jerk chicken  plate and the combo curry chicken and jerk chicken and plantains the portions was not bad.

DASHER REVIEW:
First thing I noticed upon walking in this place is there is very limited seating giving off the vibe that this is a grab-n-go type of restaurant. The lights weren't near off in the seating area. I didn't mind. I from this type of atmosphere.
The food looked great! I started to place another order. Service was fair and prompt. Nothing to complain about...nothing to celebrate neither. Although the place was not dirty, it also did not give off cleanliness as well.
The prices were pretty reasonable. In that $10-20 range.

Ok....just listen. I've said this in many of my review but I'll say it again. I feel uneasy about culture food being made by folks NOT of the culture in "authentic" restaurants.
Yo this is a SOUL FOOD restaurant that is made my Latinos. To me, it doesn't sit well. I want Latinos making my authentic Mexican food. My Greek folks making my Greek food. Etc.

All-in-all, I would recommend visiting this location for some soul food. I just don't know if I would have make it a mainstay

This was absolutely pitiful. This is a joke of a BBQ chicken. Pork chop look and taste old. The cabbage looks dry and taste like it’s been sitting for forever. Was excited to try because I heard great things but they obviously were paid reviews cause this is embarrassing.
Omg when I tell you mommy good surprise me but yes and very nice portion. The only thing is no where to sit inside and they only got two tables outside.

I was visiting from out of town and found this place on Google. It definitely is worth the price point. We didn’t have to wait. I guess we went out a good time. The food is great. I met some good local people that told me about it while my food was waiting in. The food was definitely good. This place is a gem in the city I highly recommend you take this location out if you in the Charlotte area

Zero Stars 1st. And definitely the last time ordering from this place the Chicken was refried 10 times just Flour that was so burnt 🔥 you can't even chew, everything taste old and refried you need  to do better

name: Sol'Delish CLT Restaurant
vicinity: 8927 J M Keynes Dr suite 100, Charlotte

reviews.text:
I came here at 9:05pm on a Saturday night with my friend. The first observation was that the interior is small. Our Waitress was Lee.

We ordered “berry blast” and “giving me the blues” at 9:08pm. We ordered food at 9:12pm. We got salmon bites for appetizer. My friend got 2 bakes turkey wings with rice and seafood Mac. I got the 3 friend wings.

Berry blast was delicious! I think our waitress made our drinks.

9:24pm is when salmon bites arrived. Food came at 9:39pm. We also got corn bread.  The Food was DELICIOUS and fresh! Music was great! My friend was visiting from out of state and I was visiting from another part of NC. We were in the area for pride events. We both desire to return! We didn’t have a single complaint regarding the food. Highly recommend!

Also, I believe someone told me that they were moving locations to a bigger spot, which would be great!

The customer service was good. I was greeted very well. I gave four stars because, I asked to sample the mac & cheese, the young lady, said okay. I was there waiting on my food, for over 30 mins. I wanted to taste it because i was considering, ordering another item. I told her this. Instead, she just quoted me a crazy price. I even said, my meal is already 33.00. I would be paying another 7.00 for something, I can't sample. If she couldn't give me a sample, just say say, i'm sorry, I can't offer you a sample. Just don't leave me, sitting there, with my mouth watering. Especially, after I told you, I would leave you guys a review. Well, here is my honest review. Jump off the wagon, and do the righteous thing. Resturants, needs the cosumer's, but the cosumer's in all honesty, DO NOT, need the resturant industry. Thanks for your service

Ordered the salmon nuggets, crab cakes, greens, broccoli, yellow rice, jerk turkey wings and the Parmesan garlic turkey wings. Sides were good 9/10. Crab cakes 10/10 and full of fresh crab meat. Parmesan garlic wings were great too. Only thing jerk wings could have had a little more spice. Will be back 👍🏽 $88 for all of this, nice size portions.

5 stars for the Business Sense to keep both locations and make one a Take Out ONLY and dine in at the Boardwalk. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

3 stars for the food.
❤️❤️I wish they'd place liquid foods in a separate container.
⚜️I got the Turkey Wing as so many raved about it and the issue: the meat didn't taste seasoned nor drained to the bone. It's baked so an overnight seasoning so things can macerate isn't asking for much but their recipe/style relies on the garlic Parmesan on top (since that's the one I ordered). Maybe the other offerings like Jerk have been seasoned so you can enjoy all of item. ⭐⭐⭐

I appreciate the Kale and Collard Greens offering. Now, they were in a well seasoned spice-a-rific POT LIQUOR. However, collards are tough on their own so a longer cook down would have been wholly appreciated by me. Nonetheless, I'd totally order again and just hook up at home. This is the healthier version so you don't cook away all the vitamins as slow stewing/slow cooking can do.

My folks got the whiting. I wish they had more grilled options for fish. Why? My family enjoys whole fish grilled.

The delight on their plates was the fries for me. Often, Togo fries can be a gut punch of limp and cold. Not these seasoned fries. I'd totally recommend. 5 ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

P.S. You can not order any breakfast "brunch" sides at the Tryon location. I asked for a side of grits and learned quickly. I'm figuring they don't offer any brunch items per the cashier's statement but the menu posted on Instagram should denote that. Why? To avoid confusion and manage expectations BECAUSE I spent a good amount of time asking family if they wanted fish and grits or chicken and waffle.

P.P.S. there's no seating here. They'll call when the order is ready which was a lovely and needed gesture. It was offered without me having to ask.

‼️In all, I hope they continue to grow and expand on what they can do best.

Pictures of 2 of 3 plates.

The service was fast. Love the atmosphere. Not very spacious but great ambiance. I enjoyed the drinks. Bartender did a great job. I would recommend and I do plan to return next time I am in town. The fried fish was so good along with the yams. Mac n cheese was okay just a little different for me. I LOVE the collards😋

name: Afro caribbean soul food & catering
vicinity: 9640 S Tryon St unit k, Charlotte

reviews.text: I cannot comment on service or atmosphere as I had my food delivered but every single item I ordered was AMAZING!!! Large portions and so reasonably priced! The pork chops, collards, rice and Mac and cheese were all very good but the cabbage is the absolute best!!!!
Ordered an 8 piece chicken. Waited 3 hours and there was 3 pieces in the bag and it was soggy with the skin falling off. Awful food and service don’t go to this place unless you want to get scammed.
told me to cancel order even though they weren’t even locked yet
Excellent

I ordered a large brown stew chicken plate and it didn’t look like a large so I showed staff and they stated a small is 3-4 pieces and a large is 4-5 pieces. I got 4 very small pieces. My 1 and 2 year old ate the entire meat portion and spent just under $30 for my entire order. Just don’t waste your money ordering the large, you’ll get the same portion for a small.

They changed the sauce!!!!
I've been coming here for over three years, enjoying the jerk chicken, rice and peas and cabbage however, today's experience was extremely disappointing. The flavor on the chicken has changed, the sauce is different. Nothing tastes as authentic Jamaican as it use to. No spice, no heat just bland. I hope they're not whitewashed but I'm very disappointed.

Over the last few months I’ve tried this location three different times because the jerk chicken wings were amazing on my first visit. Unfortunately every visit after that has been frustrating.

First visit: The lady at the register was snippy when I asked questions about the menu, but the wings were excellent. The shrimp curry, however, lacked flavor.

Second visit: I was told there was no chef and they couldn’t make wings. I ordered the only item available for my wife, then drove to their other location—only to be told again there was no chef. I ended up getting wings next door instead, which were great.

Third visit (today): I went in around 1:50 PM and was told I couldn’t get wings because there was no chef. They told me to come back in 30 minutes. When I returned 45–50 minutes later, a different staff member came out and again told me there was no chef.

At this point it seems like they’re serving limited food without a chef on site, which would explain why the last meal we ordered tasted off—likely reheated or from the previous day.

If you’re coming here specifically for wings or fresh food, call ahead. The pattern of “NO CHEF” has happened on three separate visits now, and it makes it impossible to rely on this place despite how good the wings are when they actually have staff.
You did not disappoint!! I especially appreciated the option for extra gravy. I googled best oxtails near me and again - you did not disappoint!! It’s my first but not last time here.

Ordered this past week. Food way too spicy for me and my children. Also, my order was incorrect . I paid extra for Mac and cheese, plantain and coco bread .. never received it. Instead I was flooded with rice and beans and again TOO SPICY !

Frightening Fish Friday!!
I Have To Start By Stating This Is The Sadest Looking Plate Of Food I've Seen In A Long Time..I Warn You!! Dont Go There If Your Hungry!! As You Can See Extremely Small Portions!!! It's The Rellplica  Of A Generous Appetizer.  Theres More Bread Then Fish!! You Literally Have To Go FISHING FOR THE FISH!! The Fruit Punch Taste Like Sugar Water? I Specifically Asked  To Please Refrain From Frying My Fish Too Hard & Had A Long Conversation In Detail With The Cashier. Of Course It Was Over Cooked!! Over All, If You Decide To Take A Chance And Try This Restaurant!! I Definitely Dont Recommend You Order Fish!! Hopefully The Chicken & Ribs Are Much Better!!

Chicken was real homemade chicken!  Seasoned perfectly!  The greens were bland but the beans were good.  Different but good.  I had to go back for the potato salad & overheard the cashier say I was the second person that day. 😂
The ribs were cooked well & saucy like I prefer.  The flavor was okay.
They only have outdoor seating & it was raining.  I also thought the ladies at the front could have been friendlier.  Particularly the shorter lady that initially bagged my food.  They weren’t rude but act like y’all are happy to be there, hell.
Still recommend.
Oh, & I’m glad I returned for the potato salad because it was as the kids say, “BUSSIN”.

I noticed this spot because I have to pass it on my way to campus & it seemed like a real mom & pop restaurant so I was really eager to try it. It’s a very small restaurant, the ordering area can maybe hold 6 people comfortably. There is outside seating that seem like it could be very cozy on a good weather day. I ordered a Rib & Wing dinner combination. You could choice between Pork or beef ribs, light meat, dark meat or 3 wings! I chose the pork ribs & 3 wings with my sauce on the side. For the side I had French fries & collard greens! I love the crinkled cut fries and how they were seasoned. The collard greens didn’t have enough unique flavor for my liking but they were not bad. The chicken wings were good & the ribs were nice & meaty. I tried the homemade lemonade & it was perfect. I have tasted nice sweet lemonade that good in along time. I would definitely go back to try other items off the menu. The two ladies at took the orders (Neveah) both were very nice & answered all my many questions about the restaurant and the menu. Both ladies made my visit welcoming.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had the fried chicken and fries, and both were spot on—crispy, seasoned just right, and full of flavor. The lemonade was also really refreshing and hit the spot. The wait was a bit long, but honestly, it was worth it once the food came out. Great spot if you’re looking for comfort food done right.

Came across this restaurant as I was in town. Was a great option. Had the wings and fried and very delicious. Lemonade was great and sweet but not super sweet. The pork ribs were okay but sauce was amazing. Only cons is the limited parking and the inside was a little tight but overall worth a visit.

If you’re looking for the best wings and Philly cheesesteaks in Charlotte, Buffalo Eatz is the spot! The food is packed with flavor, fresh, and made with so much love. The wings are perfectly seasoned, crispy on the outside and juicy inside definitely some of the best wings in Charlotte. Their Philly cheesesteak is a must-try: tender meat, melty cheese, and that authentic taste that’s hard to find anywhere else.

Portions are generous, prices are fair for the quality, and the service is friendly and fast. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or craving comfort food, this place hits the spot every time.

Highly recommend Buffalo Eatz if you want top-tier wings, an amazing Philly cheesesteak, and one of the best food experiences in Charlotte!

I've never been here because I'm not from NC but looked on Google maps for the closest place I could get something quick. I called and asked was it a parking lot or park on the side and pay? The young lady named Treasure said, they have a parking lot. I said ok and decided on this spot. The employees were nice and the service was quick even though the place was packed and ppl outside waiting on their food as well. It's no place to sit so, it's a to go place only. Either you take it home or eat in the parking lot. When I went in, I asked what flavor for the wings were the to go flavor. Dude said, loganberry and kickin' bourbon so, that's what I went with. I got 5 of each. I got the combo which comes with 10 wings, your choice of fries and a can drink for $21.64($19.99+tax). I'll say this, the loganberry was the best for me. You also get a choice between Bleu cheese and ranch. The Bleu cheese to me, was too powerful and took the flavor of the wings away. The ranch though, you just got a different flavor but was good. The fries(crinkle cut) were seasoned well. If I'm in the area again, I'll most likely stop by. Pix....before and after. Just bones lol.

Went in to order for the first time, got their new item on the menu, the Stinger Loaded Fries (i think that’s what it’s called) as well as a philly cheesesteak and an additional stinger for my friend. The wait was 10-15 minutes, food was hot, on time, and delicious. I will be coming again! Hopefully one day we will be able to sit in and eat too :).

Side note, I have so much leftover to eat because the container was filled to the top! Wonderful service and nice people up there!
The food was great. The tenders tasted freshly made and were crispy. We will definitely come back.
Solid Halal spot that opened up in 2021. Food has spice if you ask and I'd say it has the NY/New England feel to it. Tasted like home.

Try this place- you will not be disappointed. Anyone can and will enjoy this restaurant. This was a truly superb experience. The owner is personable, kind, and passionate. He made some great suggestions which served vegan and non-vegan alike. We ordered the nachos, wings, and elote corn ribs. The corn ribs were the star for me. Their homemade desserts are also so good. The ambiance is specular. I wish I was a local as I’d definitely be a regular.

Absolutely amazing. Anything you order hits the spot. My most fav vegan spot of Charlotte. This time we ordered South coaster quesadilla, protein rich and delicious 🤤. Also crunchy mom and waffle
Great service and live music. Love it
First time at here, very pleased. Fresh food and portion are the right size.  Restaurants has a nice outdoor place as well. You are vegan or vegetarian you must try this place

Oh My Soul – Where Plants Play Pretend and Fool Your Tastebuds
