I’ll be honest, when I hear “100% vegan,” my carnivore brain usually translates that to “prepare to chew on leaves and smile politely.” But Oh My Soul flipped that script faster than you can say Macho Nachos.

Speaking of those nachos, good grief. I braced myself for the telltale “healthy” flavor, but my tastebuds were too busy doing the Macarena to notice any difference from the cheesy, meaty versions I’ve known. Layers of flavor, perfect crunch, and a little bit of spice made me forget that no cows or pigs were invited to this party.

And here’s the kicker: I’m not vegan, but I left wondering if I could be, at least until I got hungry again. This place isn’t just “good for vegan food,” it’s just good, period. The kind of good where you look at your plate mid-bite and think, What sorcery is this?

After your meal, roll yourself out the door and take a lazy stroll through NoDa. The eclectic shops, colorful murals, and people-watching opportunities make for the perfect dessert.

Recommendation? Go. Eat. Be fooled. Leave happy.

Absolutely incredible! This vegan restaurant proves that plant-based food can be bold, satisfying, and unforgettable.

Our dishes were bursting with flavor, beautifully presented, and clearly made with care and creativity. We tried the Spirit Rolls, Crispy Peri-Buffalo Wings, and the Crunchy Mom crunch wrap, and it all was amazing.

The staff were warm, welcoming, and genuinely passionate about the food, which made the experience even better. Whether you’re vegan or not, this place is a must-visit. We’ll definitely be back!

Had our anniversary dinner 11/4 and everything we ordered was delicious. Highly recommend the soul rolls, salmon cakes and fried green tomatoes. We had the seafood platter and shrimp with grits entrees. So good and will be back before our next anniversary. Deondre was our kind, polite, fun and hard working server. Definitely made our first visit here memorable. Thank you for a wonderful experience.

The first time I was introduced to Mertz Cafe was back in 1996. I’ve talked about it ever since. Finally I’ve got the chance to revisit when my daughters and I took a girl’s weekend trip to see Wicked (10/24/25) When I tell you nothing changed about Mertz. I mean nothing! The atmosphere was top tier! The service was impeccable. The food….oh man…the food was awesome! So many restaurants would have changed after that amount of time has passed. Definitely won’t be staying away for that long again😂

My friend recommended this place to me for some “good soul food” while I was visiting from New Jersey. This was the best soul food I’ve ever had, and one of my favorite meals. The food came out quickly but home cooked and steaming hot. I got the fried chicken tenders, yams, mac ‘n cheese, and it comes with cornbread with some sweet butter. The chicken was seasoned perfectly, the mac was perfectly cheesy without being too much, and the yams were sweet, soft, and refreshing. The prices were great for the amount of food you receive. Additionally, my server Kashima was extremely kind, informative, and attentive. I highly recommend you don’t miss this spot when you’re in Charlotte!
We were looking for a great spot that served collard greens and fried chicken. This spot was recommended and boy it did not disappoint. Such a simple, delicious and not over done type of joint.

The host was rude. I ordered my food online at 3:36p and got there at 4:25p to pick it up. It wasn’t ready and the host got an attitude when I asked why it wasn’t ready when I ordered it almost an hr ago. He said they didn’t get it until 4:05p and they “don’t control when the orders come in”.

Then after waiting an additional 25 minutes; the food was bad. They gave me a burnt chicken wing which honestly should’ve been thrown out not served to a customer. I spent $26 for this horrible food and poor customer service. I wouldn’t recommend this place to my worst enemy.

Very disappointed in the food portion. Yes the food taste great however I barley had 4-5 ox tails maybe 2 big the rest very small. I only had four small pieces of yams and that was it. For the price Caribbean Hut food portions are WAY better. My husband plate was the same two main oxtails and rest super tiny.

Ya'll are missing out. The food is great. The hospitality is outstanding. When you dont have to add seasoning to your food... baby, they like that. It's  been a while since I had good jerk and there is nothing to complain about here. Thank you!!! I'll be back!
I highly recommend the oxtails or the brown stew snapper. Both dishes were amazing. As sides we enjoyed the cabbage, greens, candied yams or plantains. The chef and owner is very talented and nice.

We hadn't been here in a while! It looks like they have added to their menu. Hubby and I both ordered the oxtails-his sides consisting of collard greens ⁹(very tender and tasty) and cabbage, along with rice and peas. I got rice and peas, mac and cheese (don't judge me), and collard greens. We asked if the plantains were ripe, and the young man that waited on us said yes, so we ordered a side of those. They were very delicious! Everything was tasty, so hats off to the chef!! We will be back!

I came on my lunch break abt 3:30. I guess earlier lunch crowd wiped them out because they were out of so much. But I was able to get me some oxtails and curry chicken. It took a good min for it to be cooked and I was really the only sit down customer but I believe they had a lot of take out orders to make. Anyways, once the food came out it was well worth the wait. Meat was so tender and flavorful, cabbage was beautiful and cooked perfectly. Rice was awesome and those yams definitely were not from a can. Overall good experience and I would certainly go back. Only reason why I knocked down 1 star was because I couldn’t see what their grade was, I don’t know if I completely overlooked it but usually I would expect it right there in plain view behind a register.

I love this place. The food for the most part is always delicious.. and I like when the guy (maybe the owner not sure) with the locs is there bc he cooks the food to perfection!

Today I placed an online order... It wasn't ready when I arrived and waited over 30 mins. I placed an online order for convenience and fast paced service... Any who.. I ordered the fry chicken and you can select a sauce .. usually I get the sauce on the side (never had to put it in notes) it's just always on the side in a round container. Today the sauce was on the chicken... It was sauce everywhere.. on the chicken... Rice.. cabbage.. plantains... Sometimes when I'm there the cook asks if I want sauce on the side.. but this time it was just dumped on the food. Everything taste like Hennessy gravy lol. And it made the chicken soggy and not fried like I like it!

Also it was two bites of cabbage! I'm not understanding why the cabbage portions are so small???? I seen other comments with the same complaint. Less rice more cabbage!!

The food was just alright today... I would like to know when the guy with the locs works bc the food is always good and portion sizes for cabbage is good too. I asked if I could just order more chicken ... And was told I would have to order a whole plate again... Idk... Should of been able to just order chicken by it's self.. but i didn't finish my plate.. And felt I wasted my money. Unfortunately I will remember to ask for sauce on side for future.

Also the app has not worked for a while so I place the order online.. But doesn't seem like my orders are linking to my account.. Not sure what's going on.

But I usually write reviews for good service.. but I just had to say this! Sorry!!

I was going to give this place another chance after my last review, but I just cannot deal with the rough attitudes, confusing price menu, or the service. It costs very little to show people respect, especially people who promote and support your business, like I do, and tell everyone to come here, which I won't be doing anymore. I believe in good business and treating your customers with respect, like people who are actually paying to keep your business running. Also I heard there's a way better Jamaican restaurant called Quidley's in North Charlotte, but I have not been there so I cannot attest to that, yet. I'll be checking it out.

Been coming here for years and have put numerous of people on here. Coworkers, friends, a lot of people. But after yesterday i won’t be returning. I wasn’t gone write a review but it rubbed me the wrong way. They have a star system which you can redeem rewards. I had 23 stars and went to get my free jerk salmon meal. I wasn’t able to do it on the app so i went up to order. The lady in the front, i forget her name but she’s always so kind and helpful when i come in. Anyway she had me log my number into the register to select my reward.

The register wouldn’t let her close the order out or something. So she goes to get the owner in the back he comes out and said i don’t have 23 stars because he checked last week and the register and the app isn’t linked together. Which I’m confused because it’s all registered under my number. Me and the lady are explaining to him what’s going on. I show him my phone and show the stars it says i have. He tells me again i don’t have 23 stars. I go to the star history and show him every time i gained a star. He doesn’t accept it so i change my mind and leave. I will never eat here again. Not good business especially when someone eats at your establishment 2+ every week.

UPDATE: He made it and up and we’re straight!

The food could be great if you give equal portions. If I order a veggie plate, I’d like equal portions. Not just half of a teaspoon of cabbage, mad rice, and mad mac. I like cabbage too. The lady at the counter who’s always there needs to work on her customer service and stop snapping at people who don’t understand her and her slow speech. Also, she talks about customers. Never talk about people who choose to go out of their way to patronize you. Unprofessional. I won’t be back.

Customer service was one of the best that I’ve ever experienced. But unfortunately, the food was not good. I ordered curry chicken with macaroni and cheese that came with cabbage and plantain then I ordered jerk chicken with peas and rice. The jerk chicken which taste like sweet honey hot barbecue chicken it was not authentic jerk chicken at all. The curry chicken wasn’t hitting on anything either. The macaroni and cheese wasn’t cheesy and honestly, I didn’t give anything else a chance & I threw the plates away. I should’ve known to leave when I asked for “macaroni pie” and she didn’t know what that was but still in all the customer service was one of the best I’ve ever received, but unfortunately, I will not be back Not to mention, I drove an hour and 30 minutes to this establishment because I live in the country in North Carolina. I’m a New Yorker and this was not a taste like home at all

Incredible! I had the jerk salmon with spinach and rice & peas ($23). Absolutely delicious. Well presented. Scrumptious. Seriously.

Signed a half-Jamaican Brooklynite so my taste buds are primed! lol.

Really great. Highly recommend.

Ok so atmosphere like others have said was dark needing better lighting especially for it having been lunch time it felt gloomy. First time there, was drawn in from how confident and nice the young lady was over the phone regarding vegan options and loved that it was made to order and didn’t involve all the processed meats. However for the price the food was mid. I ordered the curried chickpeas with an additional side of spinach paying $21 and then was told for fountain water after spending that much I would need to pay $.75 for water. I’m just saying there might be a need for better budgeting where customers that have the money to spend can feel like their time there was worth it and they weren’t being penny pinched. In terms of taste, everyone knows ethnic food is all about the seasonings. Unfortunately all I could taste was the butter and slight coconut flavor and not curry at all besides the yellow color. The spinach and cabbage was delish though with great flavors. Thank you but will be trying other places for my visit here to Charlotte🤔

Always love to come into Island Cuisine. I'm always greeted with a friendly smile by GG at the register. When I crave Jamaican food and missing traveling there, the stew peas, oxtails and BBQ never disappoint!  And they make fresh black cake!

The stewed chicken from Island Cuisine looks amazing — perfectly plated and full of color. But once you taste it, the flavor just isn’t there. It’s bland and lacks the rich, seasoned taste you’d expect. Beautiful presentation, zero flavor.

Food is great when it’s great!!, and not good at all when it’s not good.

Too inconsistent for the price.

The jerk salmon sometimes is cooked to perfection with a beautiful crispy glazed top,
When it’s not it’s super soft and barely cooked  with a sweeter taste, not much jerk flavor  …

The first spinach I ordered had an
amazing creamy rich flavor,
other times it’s simply canned spinach warmed up

The rice and peas are 6/10

The Mac and cheese absolutely not
the noodle choice was disappointing
flavor 4/10

It’s simply a gamble to order sometimes good sometimes not good at all..

They have some great juices!! 10/10

I tried the infamous Oxtail pizza. It was delicious fresh the sauce on it was good. Next time I am definitely getting the oxtail shrimp pasta because it sounds so delicious. The service was amazing. My pizza was ready literally in one minute. Everyone was super friendly and polite. They have unique items on the menu. You must try this place.

Had the opportunity of visiting Renaldo's today 7/5/2025 for my Baby Girl's birthday celebration!! Hands down this is the BEST pizza I've ever had, we ordered the famous Oxtail Pizza, cheese pizzas, pepperoni pizzas the hot honey wings and fries and a side order of strawberry wings. EVERYTHING WAS PHENOMENALLY DELICIOUS, OMG 🤤🤤🤤 COOKED TO PERFECTION there were absolutely no complaints about the food at all!!! I do have one complaint and its not that bad its just that we were expecting to walk in and sit down and enjoy our wonderful cuisine but this is a walk-in take out type of restaurant. That was the only con to today's visit, the place was clean, service was great and like I said the food was top of the line and the price wasn't bad at all either!!! Thank yoy so much for giving me my oxtail pizza because I did not want to have to go all the way to DC  🤭🤣. Keep cookin like you're cooking brother, im sending everybody your way 🤞🏽

The food was wonderful. Wish it were hot, but the taste and flavors made up for it. Definitely got the urban Caribbean just on the small size of stature with the BG music audible from outside. Service was good, direct, and professional. Food matched price. Would definitely comeback.

You all know if I am not going to do anything else, I am going to keep it real about my food. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND! Customers raved about the Lobster grilled cheese, I got it.. it was a no for me! Customers raved about the wings, I got them… it was a no for me! Customers raved about the bang bang shrimp, I got them… more like pow pow shrimp, they were aight but where is the sauce? The restaurant was not a place I would normally eat from but I was there and hood food be some of the best food, not tonight. The establishment was dirty, the wait was long, the food was mid! I will not be going back #ThatIsAll

I was surprised at how eclectic the chef has made simple dishes. The flavor was bursting from the food. The mac + cheese egg rolls are huge and the jerk chicken pizza is amazing. This place has so many unique dishes that you can eat here regularly for a month and still find something new.

Glad to see Phat Burrito back open and thriving, brought back memories of the "old days" in SouthEnd.
Got a steak and black bean burrito and it did not disappoint. The tomatilla salsa was on point (but I was disappointed that the old salsa bar didnt make it to the new version of the restaurant)
Will definitely return!

We wanted to try a new spot to us and so happy we did! The food did not disappoint. We came in early afternoon so there was still some parking available. The customer service was welcoming and everyone checked in. We had the chicken quesadillas, steak burrito, southwest taco, empanadas, and street corn. Everything was delicious! Burrito was perfect size, had to save half for later.
Only feedback is the street corn should be creamy and empanadas more flavor, just preference! Definitely will be returning and recommend!

If you’ve seen my reviews before, you know I’m all about great food and meeting new people. My recent visit to Phat Burrito in LoSo Charlotte was a blast! I ended up here thanks to my brother’s suggestion, similar to my experience at Mad Greek Charlotte(definitely check that review out!).

As soon as I walked in, I got this awesome vibe that reminded me of ‘Donna’ from That '70s Show. If you’re not familiar with her, you might miss the reference, but trust me, Liz totally nailed that energy. While my brother was pondering the menu, I struck up a full-blown conversation with her, and she instantly knew who I meant!

Liz is not just friendly—she’s absolutely charming, with long blondish-red hair. Her customer service was incredible. She took our orders while keeping our chat lively and even helped me choose my meal. I asked for half tofu and half veggies, and I ended up with a bowl instead of a burrito, but honestly, I didn’t mind at all. The food was fantastic! Liz apologized for the mix-up, but I was just happy to dig into my meal.

The only downside? Parking can be tricky. But the location is super convenient, so I’ll definitely be back! Thanks, Liz, for making my visit so enjoyable!

If you loved the original - you will love the redux.  Original owner Steve Justice came in to help them get the recipe's right- and my favorite BBQ Chicken Taco is always perfect here.  Will always miss the original - but this version is worth the effort to find the parking.  Old school fans will not be disappointed.

The new owner brought back key features such as the checkered floor pattern and the comic book covered pole for the right touch of nostalgia.  The logo remains the same but this version is in a newer building and so its a little less dingy and lived in than the original.  Clearly a labor of love from someone else who loved the original location like so many of us did.

Tried Phat burrito on a Friday afternoon for lunch and the place wasn’t too busy. The hubs ordered a chicken, steak, and shrimp tacos while I ordered a burrito kids meal that came with a burrito, a side (which I chose chips and queso), and a drink. We also had an order of churros. I believe the total was around $25, with the kids meal being $8, which I thought was great. The churros were simply delicious. They are mini churros with no filling, and it comes with a caramel sauce. The hubs loved the shrimp and steak tacos, but wasn’t a fan of the chicken one. I truly loved the chips and queso and most likely will be back to get that, tacos, and the churros. I was not a fan of the beef burrito. It was bland. Just a heads up that the company does not accept cash, also parking is horrible as this location is located at the end with no direct parking attached to it. The atmosphere was great and we loved the staff. The lady that greeted us at the front was very knowledgeable and had great suggestions. We will definitely be back.

Every plate comes with a complementary rice you get a 10% discount for seniors & military. This is a black owned establishment. It’s more like an order to go, but you can dine in. I got the mac & cheese with greens fish, rice, and cornbread. The food is great Season to perfection and served with a smile. They make their own seasoned tartar sauce, and hot sauce. The tartar sauce goes very well with the fish.They offer daily specials. When I went, it was three pieces of fish for $10. The lemonade is homemade. It tasted great and very thirst quenching although I could stand a little less sugar. I suggest you give this place a try. It was quick in and quick out. Parking could be somewhat difficult, but this is an express where many people come just to pick up. The restaurant is quaint and cozy. Stop in and tell them Lisa sent you. Be aware that LOTS of food comes on the plate. If I’m remembering correctly my servers name was Sydney thank you for your great service. 😊 btw My total was 19 bucks but 17 with the discount. (sign the wall ✍🏽)

I ordered the catfish plate and the fish was seasoned good but I didn’t care for how they fried it, it was soggy and battered with what appeared to be flour.. which explains why the fish came out soggy. I’m from the Midwest and we fry our fish using cornmeal which allows it to fry with a crispy texture. We had no condiments in our bag and when we went back in to let them know they forgot, they said we don’t put any condiments in unless you ask. 🫤 They charged $5 for a piece of cornbread, and I wanted to try it because I said this cornbread must be slappin.. to my disappointment it was only jiffy cornbread with some so called honey butter spread… NOT!!! I wanted to give them a try, but won’t be coming back again.

If You Like Grease More Than Chicken, This Is Your Spot 🤢

I thought I was getting fried chicken… turns out I got an oil sponge with a side of sadness. The fries? Soggy little survivors of a grease storm. The chicken? Crunchy on the outside, bone-dry on the inside, like it’s been deep-fried in disappointment. Even my soda looked like it was trying to escape the meal. I wouldn’t feed this to my worst enemy. Whoever’s cooking needs a long vacation — far away from the kitchen.

#FoodFail #GreaseFestival #NeverAgain #WorstChickenEver #DisasterMeal #FriedRegret #TikTokWouldCry #FoodReviewGoneWrong #GoogleMapsReview

First time visiting here, decided to try the crab cake. The crab cake was delicious and meaty, but the wait was almost an hr. While waiting, I watch others come order and leave. 45 mins wait for crab cake is a no me. Definitely delicious for sure.

I don’t even usually like fried fish, but LuLu’s might’ve changed my mind! We got the fried fish and shrimp platter with seafood mac, asparagus, and collard greens—and everything was so good. The fish was perfectly seasoned and crispy, the shrimp were juicy, and the seafood mac was rich and flavorful without being too heavy.

My only small critique is that the asparagus portion was pretty small, especially considering there’s an upcharge for it. Would’ve loved just a little more of that. Also, they add a bit of sugar to the collard greens. They were still really good, but just a heads up if you’re not a fan of sweet greens.

Overall, everything hit. Definitely a solid soul food spot I’d come back to!

Tried Wingstop for the first time tonight and the evening crew absolutely nailed it. The wings were awesome super flavorful, juicy, and cooked perfectly. All the food was delicious, fresh, and came out faster than I expected. The staff was superb and efficient, and you could tell they were on top of everything. Definitely impressed for a first visit. We’ll be back!

Please ignore the other reviews. It’s senseless to give one star reviews just because they weren’t open yet. Me & my partner ordered this for dinner last night and everything was phenomenal. We ordered the tenders and two different flavors of wings and they were great and the service was nice. (We had already started eating before I took the pictures.) They JUST OPENED. Give people grace.

This is probably the best wing stop I have ever visited.  The food was fresh and tasted amazing.  The restaurant was very clean.  The staff was happy to serve and very friendly.  The bathroom was clean.  I would come here again.

I have ordered at this location several times. Wings are always perfect and my daughter absolutely says they are the best. Besides how awesome their wings are, the staff there is and has always been top notch. Everyone there is always super friendly, no matter how busy it is and even on our scorcher days I see everyone there smiling and talking and are the most pleasant group of people. The staff makes this location truly unbeatable. Thanks to everyone.
My order was wrong after waiting 40 mins for a pick up. I ordered mild which ended up being plain and lemon pepper. Business phone is going straight to voicemail! 😳
Best fish in the whole city of Charlotte! Customer service is top tier! I eat here at least once a week! Keep doing what you're doing! You definitely have a customer over here!

"As we enter into a smart, successful, abundant season of increase, it’s important that we truly embody those qualities. Our decisions and communication strategies should only reflect our awareness and emotional intelligence. Every act of projection, deflection, acceptance, or honoring is simply a signal—a mirror—of ourselves. #WeAreBlessed"

Fried flounder plate was amazing 😍 y'all I went back today and ordered fried lobster tails. I also ordered my usual fried flounder. I am even more impressed! It's funny how I want this restaurant to succeed but want to keep it as my own jewel. With that being said I love this place! The food is seasoned extremely well. Thanks to the young men in the back frying up that goodness!!!!!!

This is a pickup spot. Take your food to go. The fish and shrimp were acceptable.  Will visit again when on this side of town. Good seafood is hard to find in Charlotte for a gal that lived in a beach town for 15 years.
Food is awesome and prices are affordable.

name: Zodiac Bar & Grill
vicinity: 200 W Woodlawn Rd Suite G, Charlotte

reviews.text: First time in charlotte and came to visit my sister so wanted to visit a happy hour spot that had hookah and food and place was amazing. Chris the bartendee was helpful, knowledgeable and she gave great vibes. Definitely will come back the next time im hearing visiting.
My server was Brenay. She catered to my needs and even made a drink tailored made for me. Customer Service was top tier and my experience was great. I had the Samon pasta and it was delicious!! 10/10
Our bartender Chris made us the perfect drink and suggested the most delicious salmon pasta I ever tasted. Will definitely be returning soon !!!

We visited Friday before there was hardly anyone there. There appeared to be only the person at the bar and the kitchen staff. Maybe 2 patrons. It took some time for us to be acknowledged and asked where we would like to sit. Our initial interaction with our server was dry. However, we chatted her up, and she was more interactive. We had water initially definitely tap water. We ordered 2 drinks from the bar, Taurus White Tea & Pisces Margarita, we were not impressed, no salt, no sugar, not really flavorful. Several dishes were ordered, the food was fresh, hot, and delicious. We hated that dessert is listed on the menu, but none of the three was available. We enjoyed the decor and the music that was streaming. The loaded fries were good but you do have to eat the immediately the cheese is not compliant once it's cold.

Amazing service from Chris!!!

First time here!

Chris is hands down one of the best bartenders I’ve ever had the pleasure of being served by. She’s friendly, fast, and knows exactly how to make you feel welcome the moment you sit down. Her cocktails are perfectly balanced and always made with care — you can tell she takes real pride in her craft.

What really sets Chrissy apart is her personality — she’s attentive without ever being pushy, remembers your order after just one round, and somehow keeps the whole bar happy even on a packed night. If you’re lucky enough to catch her behind the bar, you’re in for a great experience.

Can’t recommend Chris enough — she’s the reason I’ll keep coming back! 🍸👏

We just discovered this little gem of Jamaica! Good polite service, tasty food, and amounts are plentiful. A little tricky getting into the parking lot, but that should not deter you! We dined on my favorite dish! Oxtails. Hubby had oxtails, rice n beans, yams, cabbage, and plantains. Of course, he got their homemade sorrel.
I had oxtails, rice n beans, oxtails, cabbage, and plaintains, and I had to try the mac and cheese. I had the house drink, which I believe consisted of lemonade and fruit punch! We also, of course, got our beef patties to go!
If you haven't been here,I come. by 3011 West Blvd in Charlotte NC and check them out!

Went here for lunch and can absolutely say this place needs to be rated higher. The service was fast and helpful, the menu had plenty of combo or à la carte options, and it all came out in a fairly quick manner. Price was reasonable the only thing I would say is maybe have somebody come out and check in on dining options every now and then to see if there’s anything they need. Other than that atmosphere was good music was great and most importantly food was amazing.

The red pea soup was delicious. This place is the place I plan to go to often. The service was amazing! The food smelled so good when I walked in. I told my friends and family about Lawrence! I definitely plan on going back again and again and again.

Went on a Saturday night for the first time. I totally enjoyed my food and will be returning. The rice was a little under cooked but overall the food was good, big portions, the sweet plantains were sweet & I appreciated the sauce on the side. The cabbage was beyond delicious. I'll have to get a extra side of cabbage next time. That's how tasty it was.Thank you Lawrence Caribbean for bigging my back on a Saturday night 😋😄

Come here! Don't hesitate to try this place. My wife and I stopped here while in the area. The service was great with the staff providing recommendations. The atmosphere was a vibe. The food was wonderful. We both ordered oxtail with plantain and everything was cooked to perfection. We spent around $68 (including tip). We would 1000% return if/when back in the area.

Heard the suya from this place was bomb. I decided to have the frozen suya shipped to me since I’m out of state. Website promises 1 day processing and fast shipping but that’s not true. It’s been almost a month and I still haven’t received my order. I called and emailed seller multiple times and have not heard back from him yet. Thank goodness I ordered through PayPal so I can get a refund. Will not be doing business with them again.

I called to place the order drove 20minute to the wrong location,
Called and got the right adress. Went to pick up and was giving 3 pieces of chicken barely 10 suya and fried plantain for $47! And the food was too salty
Will never eat again

I’ve been wanting to try Suya since I came across this type of food on youtube & I had the  pleasure of my Uber eats driver to go grab me some from here on yesterday and all I can say is 10/10 I got the jollof rice & the beef suya spicy & omg delicious!!!
First time having this food last night after Safari lounge. This was so good. I will be back for the beef suya, rice and plantains!!!
They have a number but they never answer or call back. Terrible

The service was fantastic, drinks were AWESOME, good was great, music played was essentially my playlist. This place was a great choice by our small out of town crew.

Get the seasonal martini! (Mine was pumpkin spice espresso martini). I had another martini off the regular menu that was great as well.

The mac and cheese was phenomenal - I asked for a little buffalo wing sauce on the side instead of drizzled. It was delicious. The broccolini (topped with garlic, lemon, and parm) was very good, too.

If you're in the area and not sure what to have for dinner, you cannot go wrong here.

This restaurant is walkable distance from Nascar hall of fame, excellent for hanging out with a group and to watch sports on giant TV. They got a huge bar and a massive dining area. The restaurant in general has dark ambiance lighting with some sunlight from the front.

I got the waffle and chicken from brunch menu. The waffle was really good but the chicken could have been more moist. The hot chicken biscuit was a good sandwich. We switched my fries for a salad, but then later found out I was charged for it.

The staff were friendly. Food didn’t take too long to come out. It was a decent place to grab a casual quick bite.
Great beer selection. Menu is a bit limited but the options are well made. My steak was so tender it could have been a filet. Plenty of indoor and out door seating.

Came on a late December weeknight, so less crowded than peak times. Enjoyed sitting outside since it was so warm out.  Fast friendly service, and our craft beers were good.  Had the wonton nachos but they disappointed.  The chicken was mostly at the bottom of the pile of chips for some reason, and those were all overly covered with a strong heavy bbq sauce, a “Kewpie mayo” and some scallions.  The bbq sauce was tangy but overpowering and the dish seemed very basic, didn’t finish it. Shared a side of Brussels sprouts which were tasty but a bit soggy.  They’d have been great if they’d been crispier; a good serving for the price.

What a cute place but the service was not what I expected. I sat at the bar and it took a while for anyone to greet me. I was then handed a clipboard with like 6+ pages of taps and drinks. Some of the pages were exactly the same. I had to ask for a food menu. Not one person checked on me during my visit. I had to ask one of the bartenders to order me dessert. Food was tasty and would have given the place better stars if service was better. Seemed to be a good spot for locals as they seemed to have all the bartenders attention.

If I could have given 0 stars that would be more appropriate to describe my experience at this place. I'm from Alabama and visiting Charlotte for the holidays and decided to try this place. I waited for 1 hr for a chicken sandwich, fried shrimp sandwich, and some wings and it was all nasty. Fries were soft and soggy. Took them forever to get my order and it was still wrong. If you're reading this do yourself a favor and go somewhere else. You'll thank me later trust.

DASHER REVIEW:
The one thing about this place that makes it a go-to are the prices. The prices are very affordable.

The service is on the bad side though. As I'm sitting here, there is a pregnant woman here that has a mistake with their order that she's trying to correct. Her and the owner are going back and forth, and as I'm eavesdropping on the convo, she's right. She placed her order over the phone and the owner misunderstood her request. She's asking if she can get the order fixed and she's willing to pay, but he seems to not want to do it. Instead she's just gonna have to get what the owner said she ordered. To his defense, he's right because he made what she asked for and she admitted that she did, but made a mistake.

I don't know....I'm on both sides here..but to run a small business like this I would do all I could to satisfy my customers even if they were in the wrong. I need that business lol. But I suggest you give then a try though. After all, he did apologize to the other person that was with her.

Mistakes happens. Just so what you can to make them right.

The smallest wings ever.  Some looked like they were for a 6 month old.  And also not great.  Fries were absolutely horrible.  Just soft shoestring.  The fried mushrooms are a disgrace. Absolutely horrible. Do not eat here.

Love the food here!! Small takeout only but the food is fantastic! Their Strawberry wings are the best!!! Friendly staff too 🙏 take out only (small shop). Burger special (cheese/mushroom/onion ring) was great!! So good it didn’t even need catsup!
Friendly and quick staff - highly recommended

I love the food here it’s always so good!
Girls in the front always so helpful.
Today I ordered Chef Salad add grilled chicken with extra cheese and ranch for lunch but I picked up
Always get a Westside Combo with sandwich wings extra wet and fries for dinner on DoorDash …. Check them out on your favorite online delivery platform because I order from here at least 4-5x a week

Such a great find, it was our first time and the owner was so nice and brought us complimentary appetizers and gave us advice on the best meals. The portions were huge and the food was cooked perfectly. A hole in the wall place that I would love to see have more business. I will definitely be a new regular here.

We ordered three items. The lamb shank was flavorful and enjoyable, while the half chicken didn’t quite meet expectations. The hummus was decent, but the pita bread was too dry and didn’t seem freshly baked. On a positive note, the rice was very good.

5 stars! The food here is authentic and delicious. The Baba Ganoush with green chili is a must-try, and the Beef Kabobs were incredibly juicy. I loved the texture of the Kibbeh and the crispy Falafel. What really sets this place apart is the owner’s hospitality; he truly cares about his customers' experience. Great food and great service. I’ll definitely be back!

La Shish Kabob is hands down our favorite spot for Middle Eastern cuisine! My husband, who is from the Middle East, introduced me to this gem while we were dating, and we’ve been hooked ever since. It was my first time trying Middle Eastern food, and this place set the bar incredibly high.

We’ve ventured out and tried a few other spots in Charlotte, but nothing compares to La Shish Kabob. The food here is always fresh, warm, and absolutely delicious—it hits the spot every single time. The menu is full of flavorful options, and we genuinely love everything we’ve tried.

The staff is wonderful, always so kind and attentive, and they bring the food to you as soon as it’s ready. The service and quality are unmatched. If you’re looking for authentic Middle Eastern food in a welcoming atmosphere, this is the place to go. We can’t recommend it enough!
The food was amazingly delicious!  The portions were large and the food was well prepared. The hummus was the absolute BEST I ever had!

We had a pretty decent time eating bar food and watching football. It's a bit loud in there (as expected) so don't plan on having any meaningful conversations lol. The service was great, fast and with a smile. The food was your typical bar food, salty, fried and perfect for the environment. We went in at 7 pm on a Saturday and brought our 14 year old and it was totally ok.

Ate outside and the food and service was superb. If ever in the area I will be back. The pimp cheese, wings, smash burger (lol) was great! I have  never been to a restaurant with the wrong food brought to you. This was not noted by the person consuming the food. However, the manager brought the ordered burger out and sent the guest home with it. High five to this business.

Went in at 10:05pm-seated ourselves as the signs said to  waited 10 minutes before our drink orders were even taken and as soon as our drinks were ordered the waitress walked off because we could even tell her we were ready to order. Our food order was taken around 10:30 because the waitress kept walking around and joking and chatting with the bartender and other waitresses. The menu says that party’s of 5 or more or orders done after 11pm had an automatic 20% gratuity included in the total. We had a party of 4 and were there for an HOUR before 11 and still had the 20% gratuity included. The food while it came out semi fast was not good or worth the prices. I asked for my burger well done and the center was pink. The tater tots were so salty that they tasted like ocean water. This was our first time eating here and WILL be the last. If we could rate this place zero stars we would. I’m not typically one to post a review like this but this experience was truly the worst we have ever had.

That might be the largest salad I've ever been served. It was delicious and everything was fresh. The chips and salsa was also really good. The server was there every time we needed her but she didn't stand on top of us.

Shout out to Mike- he was bartending and waiting tables, really hustling, and still very friendly and attentive! We needed to find a place for food after 10 pm on a Tuesday, called they said kitchen was open. Food was really good, we had the quesadilla burger and onion rings. Burger was not too big, my husband and I split it, which we always do and it was perfect size for us, onion rings were really flavorful, usually with onion rings I think they need some dipping sauce, there had good flavor in the batter on their own. Good meal for our 8 hour stay before catching a flight.

First time here- omg!! I’m sick with the flu and baby, they had my favorite Dominican soup (sancocho). The soup made me feel so much better and it was so delicious, I’ll be back when my taste and smell comes back, I need to try some more food from them.  LOL!

The food is hot, fresh, and delicious. I've been looking for a place to eat Puerto Rican/Dominican food since I've moved here from NYC. All you see here in NC is Mexican food it's not the same type of food. As soon as I walked in, the smells OMG the smells. The selection of food is amazing. They have a hot bar of all this beautiful hot food just waiting for me to eat. Everything we had was so good. Pernil, pasteles, tostones, yellow rice rotisserie chicken, etc. You name it, they have it & it's good

I have to say, Authenticity shows and the food is always good!! They have these pickled onions, I have to get them every time I come!! This is the only place I've ever had them and they are  AMAZING 👏

Bohio Típico is truly a good place, especially when it comes to their buffet. The variety of dishes, the atmosphere, and the kindness of the employees make the experience even better — everyone is genuinely friendly and attentive, which adds a special touch to the visit.
The only thing that didn’t quite meet expectations this time was the pastel en hoja; it lacked the flavor and quality I was hoping for. However, everything else balanced the experience beautifully.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at Bohio Típico Restaurant inside Compare Foods Supermarket on Sunset Rd.

I stood at the counter for over five minutes without being greeted or acknowledged. During that time, a Spanish-speaking couple walked up behind me. The employee, a young Spanish woman immediately greeted them and attempted to take their order while completely ignoring me, even though I had been waiting first.

To their credit, the couple kindly told her that I was next. Instead of correcting the situation, the employee walked away and still did not take my order when I attempted to speak. I was left standing there, embarrassed and confused, ultimately unable to place an order at all so I left.

This experience felt biased, disrespectful, and unwelcoming, especially as an African American customer. No one should be made to feel invisible or disregarded while simply trying to order food. Basic customer service, acknowledgment, fairness, and respect, should be extended to everyone regardless of race or language.

I truly hope management takes this matter seriously, provides proper customer service training, and ensures that all customers are treated equally and with dignity. No one should leave a business feeling the way I did today!

Where in the CLT can you find a place that has it all: fantastic food and excellent service? Loved the Mexican Theme! - Made the place super fun and relaxing! The wait staff is highly knowledgeable, friendly, and makes it a point to really spoil the customers. Fried Pickles and the Fried Chicken Bites were absolutely off the chart. Save room for the incredible Banana Pudding that I saved with my fried. Next time, I may curtail the appetizers and have one of those excellent triple custom hamburgers that were truly delicious—had a great time! Plenty of parking is available, but you will need to walk a block. It was well worth it. Tasty and excellent service!

It’s definitely got a cool vibe going on inside.

Most of our food, although, delicious was served cold. My salad came out perfectly as did our Pimento Cheese Wonton appetizer (SO GOOD).
However, The El Santo hot dog was so cold that even the cheese came to the table without melting. The Popcorn Chicken Salad, too, was cold. We figured the food may have sat while waiting for the salmon to cook for my salad.

Our server was attentive and friendly. The gentleman that sat us and helped run food lacked personality.

Another Uber Eats from: Pinky’s Westside Grill.

Absolutely recommend their food! As you can see, I tried a variety of items. Everything was excellent.

I have to admit one of my favorites - other than the shrimp - was definitely the crab hush puppies!

If you do the onion straws, it’s probably best eating them fresh on site so that they are crispy. They were understandably softer, but the flavor was good. Rueben Dog, Falafel, Skrimpz, White Trash Burger.

Highly recommend giving them a try.

Pinky's Grill was good. The burgers were on point!! I had a double patty (no smash burgers here) with FRESH jalapeños ketchup & mayo. I saved 1 patty and bun for later as it was enough for 2 meals and the fresh cut waffle fries were crispy. The drink menu not my favorite as I prefer bar drinks not ready-made pour cocktails. I requested Tequlia sunshine & it was juicy!! My daughter has a Shirley Temple with pretty halloween garnish with a Salmon ceaser salad wrap. Total meal was about $50 for drinks & meal.

Fabulous spicy Bloody Mary. The burger was amazing. The corn dog battered fried skrimps were incredible. You HAVE to get their waffle fries with pimento cheese on top. Everything was awesome! Great service, as well!

name: JINYA Ramen Bar - Ally Charlotte Center

reviews.text:
The overall aesthetic is nice and clean. The food was subpar at best, and the customer service was awful from Ms. Jay. Please train her to be better or remove her entirely.

Our small group was not even greeted but every other family or group after us was, with the standard, "Irasshai"; not cool. This is my first time here, so already off to a rocky start.

I ordered the Tonkatsu Red Bowl, I asked for spice Level 6. Ms. Jay proceeded to talk me down to a Level 3-4, and when I tried to reason with her and tell her I can handle a considerable amount of spice, she insisted and said "You're going to want to trust me on this one."  I yielded for the sake of not going back and forth. Wrong move. The bowl basically lacked spice or any depth of flavor at all.

Ms. Jay didn't offer refills on our drinks until we were already done with our meals. She barely checked on us. The couple next to us complained and got free mochi, we got nothing but a scolding for asking to have a chili paste removed from the tab since neither of us used it.

Ms. Jay yelled for everyone  within earshot to hear, "my manager said that this is a one time thing. If you come back again and ask to have something removed, it's not gonna happen!"

First and last visit, for me. Even if the food isn't that great, customer service goes a long way with me. Ms. Jay is sorely lacking in that department.

I've been wanting to come here for so long and thankful I finally did! I started with sake flight which was sooo good not too strong but hit just enough. The bao bun was sooo good but crispy chicken was for sure my favorite app. All the ramen were so good and we all got different ones. Server was amazing!!

We visited for my birthday and the atmosphere was lovely. Our server Ashley was incredible going above and beyond with her service. She was very attentive, personable, and friendly. Our experience with her was delightful and she made sure our first time there was very memorable. The food was delicious and so were the cocktails. I was pleasantly surprised by how many different vegan options they had to offer as one of the members of my party is a vegan and it can be hard to find places that accommodate. Definitely worth the trip from High Point. 10/10

Nice Japanese restaurant with good choice of ramen and rice.  The garlic rice is very tasty and special.  For appetizer I love the miso eggplant, absolutely delicious.  There are not a lot of dessert  choices.  The mocha tiramisu is very good.  The service is great, everyone works there are very attentive and friendly.

JINYA! What an absolute delight. This was our first time going and needless to say, we will be returning for so many reasons. Firstly, the staff are absolutely incredible. Brady, the manager, is one of the best in the business. He is kind, knowledgeable and was an absolute JOY to us. Rony, our server, was also absolutely stellar- amazing recommendations, menu knowledge and such a genuine, caring human. We felt so welcomed! It’s clear the team works hard but they don’t let that compromise a joyful, vibey atmosphere. Secondly, the FOOD! You are in for a treat- the menu has so much variety and something for everyone- omnivore and vegetarian included! The ramens were incredible and were served in beautiful custom bowls made in Japan- stunning. The atmosphere is elevated and intimate without being pretentious or stuffy. Thank you so much to the whole crew- from chefs to the serving team- our experience was wonderful and memorable! If you’re in the area, this is the spot you need to go for Ramen, etc!! 5 Stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Laid back spot with cold draft beer and solid chicken wings. The wings were flavorful and well cooked, the beer was fresh, and the overall vibe made it easy to relax and enjoy the night without feeling rushed.

Wings are great. Beer selection good. Atmosphere very relaxed but fyi music is pretty loud if you have some sensitive ears and if your wanting a cocktail this is not the place but if you just want beer or seltzers and good good then this is the place. Uncle Donny’s wings and Bee Sting are my recommendations for wings.

From the moment we sat down, Cynthia made our experience unforgettable. She was attentive without being overbearing, always ready with a quick joke and a warm smile that made us feel right at home. Her upbeat, joyful attitude added just as much flavor to the evening as the food itself — and that’s saying something!

We tried a variety of dishes, and everything hit the mark. The salad with warm bacon dressing was fresh and flavorful, the wings were perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the meatloaf sandwich? Massive, hearty, and absolutely delicious. One of our group ordered the nachos and couldn’t stop raving about them — “awesome” doesn’t even cover it.

Thanks to Cynthia’s stellar service and the fantastic food, we’re already looking forward to our next visit. Highly recommend!

I've heard that this place had some of the best wings in charlotte so I decided to give it a shot. We got a table pretty quickly, it's really small on the inside, but they have a very large patio that is 2 stories. The staff was very nice food came out really quickly. Definitely tried some wings and a philly...both were delicious.  Will definitely come back.

My daughter and I love wings so we decided to check this place out. We were not disappointed. They have a lunch menu on the white board and the prices are really good. We tried four different types of wings and they had very good flavors and char. Too many places have wings that are not crispy and thankfully, Moosehead knows how to make some crispy and flavorful wings. We do like hot wings and found out the Carolina reaper wings were a bit too hot for us and we can eat pretty hot stuff. The blackened wings, Killer bees and hemo-goblins were much less intense in heat than the reaper wings. Fries were excellent as was the Mac and cheese. The inside is fun and the staff was friendly and attentive. We will be back!

If I could put 0 stars I would. I ordered a salmon caesar salad from this location via door dashed. The bag was delivered sealed closed. I began to eat my salad and discovered a large bug at the bottom of the salad (photos attached). I immediately threw up and called the store to let them know what happened. I asked to speak to a manager and then was hung up on. I called back and asked once again to speak to a manager . I explained what had just happened and that I found a bug, and the manager instead of apologizing and acknowledging the awful situation , told me that this was not possible and if I was looking for a refund to contact door dash.not once did I mention a refund because I had already spoken to door dash and received the refund, I more so cared about the awareness and integrity of the restaurant , but unfortunately I was not greeted kindly or nicely and the manager lacked remorse. I then just asked for a name of the manager so I could call corporate, the manager said her name was Ky wannamaker. Which I know is a fake name . This manager needs to be terminated .

Went for lunch with my daughter while in Charlotte. I ordered the lobster roll, minus the roll. She had the shrimp. They have you take a number and they deliver your food to you. Service seemed slow for the number of customers in the store. The shrimp was delicious. The lobster was good. One of the lobster chunks was chewy but the rest were delicious. The Parmesan tots were awesome! Parking was challenging as you need to park in a garage. But we were already there for an event so no issue for us. The atmosphere was better than fast food and less than a sit down place but matched the place.

Saw a BOGO deal on DoorDash for the grilled chicken. I chose salad as the base, which comes topped with sweet potato, shaved parm, and crispy onions. The chicken was a bit on the salty side, but had good flavor and went well with the salad. Overall, a pretty good salad especially with the deal.

This is one of my absolute favorite places uptown. The food is great especially the salmon & quinoa as well as the lobster roll. Hoping they bring back the lobster Mac & Cheese which was also delicious. The whole staff is super friendly and will always make sure that all the customers are satisfied with the service and food. Cena goes above and beyond remembering your name to add a personal touch that is lacking in so many businesses. Highly recommend!!!!

The team working the night of 12/23 really assisted in a first time experience.  I got the fish and chips asked for crispy and with a 9 min drive home everything was still hot and perfectly crispy.  Asked how the chowder was.  They said it's amazing and no lies were told.  Best I've had in a while. The tarter sauce is chefs kiss. .10/10 I'll be back for sure.

The tacos were absolutely delicious but a little pricey for what you get. A teenage boy could easily eat 4-5 of them at $5 a piece.
There was enough seating mid afternoon but during peak hours It would definitely be a bit of a challenge I imagine.

The Smash burger and the Shrimp tacos are both excellent. The smash burger is well seasoned and well cooked. It has a really tasty sauce on it. The fries are well seasoned and the shrimp in the taco was amazing.

Had a long layover in Charlotte and decided to explore the city. Wanted something light to snack on and ordered a side of fries which I customized with onions and jalapenos.

The service was amazing! The lady working the counter was very attentive and helpful explaining my options! The fries were cooked to order and were AMAZING!!! Fresh cut, and perfectly seasoned and even more importantly they were NOT greasy!!!

Highly recommend if you are in the area! Support small business!

While visiting uptown we decided to stop at 7th street market for the variety of food options. I chose Mad Dash and I was impressed.

The food was delicious. I ordered a chicken sandwich for me and it was so crispy I even kept the pickles on my sandwich which I typically remove but these were so crunchy I chose to keep them on. The inside was perfect on the sandwich just the right amount of juicy.

The fries were nice and crispy I had to rub some salt off but other than that they were good. My little ones enjoyed the wings and fries I order for them.

I look forward to giving this place another try.

Me and my daughter enjoyed our burgers and homemade fries. It was our very first time eating at the Market on 7th street. Mad Dash did not disappoint. The service and food was great we will definitely eat there again soon!

🗣EVANNNNNN🗣 HAD TO SHOUT OUT MY MANZ‼️‼️‼️ A DOPE individual whose food is 🔥   THE BEST VEGAN CHEF I have ever met. Thank you for the LOVE you put in your culinary delights. The Carolina burger was amazing. The chili cheese fries were well seasoned and HOT and FRESH. Kudos. Can't wait to go back❤️

First time here, really cool spot. I tried the classic burger, the wings, and the fries. The food definitely could have been hotter especially since I believe it is all made to order. The flavor was good on everything I tried, the place itself is really cool inside as well. Would return for sure

This is my 2nd time at Mike’s Vegan Grill. The first was at their food truck, this time I had the pleasure of stopping by their establishment in Charlotte. The waitress was friendly and helped us order as it was the first time my family member had been there. It’s reasonably priced and the food was fresh & delicious. Everyone was full from what they ordered. Would definitely recommend!

I cannot say enough about how good the food and service was here at Mike's Vegan Grill. We felt very welcomed when we arrived there and we were taken care of quickly by a very nice gentleman. You order your food at a counter, but they do bring it to you. I would have liked to try more items, but I can only eat so much and was in the area on vacation. If I ever come across one again I will definitely go there.

This is a restaurant among a number of others. They have a small waiting area with chairs. This place has is indoor/outdoor seating. The cashier was very friendly and knowledgeable of the menu. We had the Crunch Wrap, 3 Tacos, and fries. Their wrap and tacos were delicious. The fries were ok.

name: Craft City Social Pub
vicinity: Sheraton Charlotte Hotel, 555 S McDowell St, Charlotte

reviews.text: Bartender and service was a much better experience than the rooftop upstairs. Customer service is everything, I’m very pleased . Moving forward I’d rather visit this bar instead.

Had the privilege of visiting Craft City Sports Pub first time during one of Charlotte’s rather busy weeks. However, I had to take the time to express the “Outstanding customer service received from the manager ‘Felice”! I arrived at the establishment around 8:30/9 after attending a cheer conference. We wanted to walk out due to the overwhelming group of people but, knew it would be crazy pretty much everywhere, so we stayed. Once we found a place to sit “Felice” gave eye contact and, assured us that should we be right over. Felice was incredibly friendly, attentive, and offered suggestions for me especially since I can be very picky. We had a fantastic time and will be back. Overall experience was an A+ how quickly the drinks and food were prepared especially due to the crowd of people. Thank you again Felice!

Food menu is very small but decently priced for being a restaurant in a hotel.  The pool chairs and cabanas could definitely use an update. Most of The chairs are falling apart and unusable but still sitting out there for use. There are 2 grills near the pool as well but rusted and don't appear to be usable either.

The hotel restaurant is amazing simply because of the Manager Ms. Felice. I have an allergy and she helped me since the first night I stayed at the hotel until my last night. She made sure everything was prepared correctly and made sure there was no cross contamination. She checked on me throughout my dining experiences and allowed me to reach out to her whenever I needed anything. She was beyond helpful and gracious towards myself and sorority sisters. Any time I’m back in Charlotte, I will make sure to stop by and dine there simply because of her.
I went for the pool party. It was nice inside. The bartenders were attentive, especially Shane. Hope to visit again the next time I'm in Charlotte!

Perfect hookah spot where the music, wide screen TVs, games, and drinks are good. Champagne bottles are flowing but it’s shots that made the day. Special during the week. Be prepared to spend $$$$ for a good time.
Seating is tricky so plan ahead. Bar seating, tables, some outdoor seating.

I was genuinely looking forward to lunch, my experience was beyond disappointing. First, an automatic 18% gratuity for **parties of ONE or more** felt excessive, especially given the circumstances. The kitchen was closed when I arrived because staff had to leave to buy fries, so I waited with a drink.

Unfortunately, things went downhill from there. After staff returned with fries the bartender stated the kitchen was now open. I placed an order for the Big Catfish Platter with Brussel sprouts no bacon. While sitting at the bar enjoying my now late lunch, the bartender casually sprayed RAID insecticide—without warning—right near where we were eating and drinking. She explained it was to get rid of gnats, but spraying chemicals near open beverages without notice is completely unacceptable. I went to the bathroom because I felt sick. To make things worse, the can of RAID was left sitting visibly on the bar.

To top it off, a staff member had their dirty crew shoes resting on the same table where they prep to-go orders. The lack of basic cleanliness and professionalism was appalling. Absolutely disgusted with this experience.

This was our Happy Hour spot of choice on a Friday afternoon after work. There was plenty of available seating when we arrived. Our server greeted us promptly and took our food and drink orders. The portion sizes are generous. The brussel sprouts were definitely the star of the night. We ended up staying for about 5 hours, ordering drinks throughout the night. Things were going great until it was time for our server to leave for the evening. She checked us out and specifically stated that the tip was not included on the bill. However, when we received our receipts, there was an 18% service charge that was added, even though we only had 4 people in our group. All of us had left an additional tip, not knowing the service fee was charged. By the time we realized it, our server was gone for the evening. She also did not assign another server to us even though we were still planning to order. We let the manager know and she immediately worked to make it right. Our service for the remainder of the evening was impeccable. The music was good, although the volume was a little low on the side where we were sitting. I would definitely plan to return in the future....although I will keep a much closer eye on my bill.

Pro-tip: Plan time for parking. There is a free lot nearby but it is pretty small..

It pains me to be writing this review, but almost five years later, I am officially over it!

I live in the same condo building as Reds, and they have been driving residents absolutely insane for years. Whether it’s blasting music, staying open well past closing hours, or bringing in outside speakers that somehow make things even louder, it’s a constant issue.

Some highlights no one asked for:
• Seeing customers have sex on the side of the building while I walk my dog early in the morning
• Ongoing noise disturbances at all hours
• And most recently, weapons being pulled on 12/28/25

I truly tried to stay positive and hopeful for years, but this place is a never-ending hole of problems. Our HOA, condo management, and residents have repeatedly attempted to communicate and work with Reds, and nothing ever changes.

If I could give zero stars, I absolutely would. Reds consistently makes life miserable for the people who actually live here. If you’re looking for a hookah bar with zero regard for its neighbors, congratulations, you’ve found it!

Music is great but the hookahs are bad. You barely taste the flavor just coals. For $27 you would think it would be flavorable. Sent it back and still same result so we just kept it. I am content creator and came with another content creator since we have large following. Was gonna record the experience but nahh. This was somewhat disappointing! Food was ok no complaints on that ..but the hookah are waste of money.

My family and I ate there today and we loved it. This is an authentic place recommended to us by a Jamaican friend. The food was excellent and the owner was very friendly. He told us about how they prepare and cook the food. They don’t use any artificial ingredients, no added sugars or anything. We will definitely be back!

I used to love this place but I will never again. I ordered jerk chicken ans as soon as I opened it smelled sour like vinegar. I didn't even eat it but my boyfriend did and it tore his stomach up, had him 9n the toilet. Apparently they are using the resturant as a drop for hurricane relief which I commend them for but it stanks and is so clutered im sure its a fire hazard. Try another jamacan spot cause this aint it anymore

Have lived in Charlotte many many years and finally decided to try this place out for dinner.  It is located off Central Ave. Parking can be a hassle, so just expect to spend a few extra minutes finding parking. It's a small little restaurant with plenty of seating inside. The place does look a little run down, but I promise you the food makes up for it! We ordered 2 beef patties, coconut bread, and the oxtail platter with rice, cabbage, and Mac and cheese! It was DELICIOUS! the oxtail fell right off the bone, and it had plenty of flavor! The cabbage and Mac and cheese had so much flavor that it all paired well with everything. The beef patties were a little but spicy, but it didn't get in our way. I am definitely going to come back and try some more of their other dishes. I definitely recommend this place. The server there was super friendly and offered great recommendations and was super pleasant to speak with.

This was my first time having oxtail and even my first time at a Jamaican restaurant, and I was impressed! The oxtail was super tender and flavorful. The owner’s son was very friendly and explained that they only use natural ingredients and not added sugar like many Jamaican restaurants do. Go check Mama’s out!

Date night on a Tuesday. I'd never been here and the love of my life loves Caribbean food. He is from Barbados. The gentleman that served us was very polite and helpful. He was patient with me when I was ordering because I had no clue. They play reggae so it got my love in the dancing mood which is not something that happens on a regular basis lol. So while we waited for our food we danced. It was a Tuesday evening, so it was just the two of us that were dining in. There were plenty of take out orders. I got off work at 7:30pm so I was grateful for the hospitality. They served our food hot and great portion sizes. I would recommend trying Mama's punch. It was awesome and I don't drink alcohol so it was an actual fruit punch with fruits I've never had. I loved the atmosphere. We will go back again. I had curry shrimp and he had goat

Sub One Hoagie House is a genuine old-school grinder shop, and they absolutely nail it. If you’re looking for a classic, no-frills sub experience, this is the place.
We tried two different grinders, and both were excellent. The bread was fresh, the fillings were generous, and everything tasted perfectly put together. This is the kind of neighborhood joint where you know you're getting quality ingredients and a sandwich made right.
Highly recommend stopping by if you're in the area and looking for a truly solid grinder/hoagie.

My sister & I stopped at Sub One Hoagie House for lunch last week. I had the Jersey sub, and she had a chicken sub. We both agreed that these were the best subs that we had ever had.  The atmosphere was quaint, warm, inviting, and genuine. The flavorful aroma of seared meats, cheese, onions, and peppers added a newfound anticipation to my appetite as I waited for our name to be announced.
I was equally impressed with the kind, respectful attentiveness that each customer was given. This is definitely a place that I will put on my radar whenever I am in Charlotte. As we stood up to dispose of our empty wrappers and to-go cups, I felt a sense of community, drive, gratitude, greatness, strength, resilience, fierce productivity, and phenomenal history all rolled into one.
We will definitely be back.

I am so ashamed that I’ve been in Charlotte all my life and never been here before now lol. I looked up best subs near me and they popped up. When I arrived I realized I’ve past this strip plenty of times over the years but not once have I looked and noticed it. The signage isn’t very visible, but no matter I’ve found it now and believe me I will be back. I tried the New Jersey cheesesteak and it was oh so good! Got sweet tea to drink and it was pure perfection. When I walked in the, the nostalgia of an old school sub shop just puts you right at ease. I spoke with an older gentleman who worked there and was cleaning tables and he was just the nicest person ever. So funny and friendly. I can’t wait to get back and try more items.

I’m not sure how all these people are satisfied with this place. I got the Italian hot and literally had like three slices of meat, I had to open it up and check to see if there was meat on it, That’s how slack it was !Taste was good, but stop being so greedy wit the meat ! and left $10 tip. You would think that they would hook it up a little better but nope.

Sub One Hoagie House has been on my radar for a while now and I finally got around to trying them out.

I went around 1pm on a Tuesday to avoid the noon lunch rush. There was a steady stream of customers while I was there and it took about 25 minutes for me to get my food ordered and out the door (so I recommend calling ahead and ordering if you are in a hurry).

I ordered the cheesesteak because 1) I love a good cheesesteak and 2) theirs gets great reviews. It was a good cheesesteak but a little heavy on the black pepper and not on the traditional Amoroso roll. But it was also not super greasy like other cheesesteaks are. The size was also pretty big for the price.

I’ll be back to try some other menu items.

Big parking lot, locally black owned business.

Note- they accept credit cards but they charge you fifty cents for the transaction

The food is delicious. I got the arepa and my husband got one of the beef soups. At first I was worried about the prices. The arepas I'm used to would be too small to be worth the prices on the menu. But when the food came out it was so much. Definitely worth the price. The arepa was cooked wonderfully. It was too much food to bite into. The stand is nice. I ended up eating the arepa with my fork. The soup was a nice hearty comforting soup, without being heavy, similar to chicken soup but with a tender beef. And a mild broth. With an underlying bright acidity. Some reviewers say service is slow. It's a casual laid back place. You are given time to enjoy the food and relax and digest.
Like most Venezuelan restaurants great food! Pricey but great food!! Will definitely come again!!!

Loved our weekday lunch visit to Brasas. You can smell the deliciousness from a block away. The arepas and empanadas were incredible. Reina pepiada reminded me of a chicken salad and was made with fresh ingredients stacked high inside a perfectly cooked arepa. Empanadas came hot from the kitchen filled with juicy shredded meat. Definitely try the sauces that come with it they were a great addition. This place is a must try if you like authentic Venezuelan food.

Updating with a great review for the carne asada, grilled chicken and mini arepas! All must try’s

The food was absolutely delicious. We ordered breakfast soup, beef soup and the typical plate, Bandeja Paisa. Great portion. Natalia was our server and she was very attentive, courteous and efficient. Good job! The atmosphere is very cool, soft music and nice decor. I will for sure be back some day.

The service was good, we wasn't seated that long before we were waited on. I got the vegetarian arepas and shredded chicken on plantines  Both dished were full of flavor and delicious. I will definitely come back to try another dish.

My boyfriend said enjoyed the food, the menu was very easy to understand especially if you're a lover of trying all kinds of foods from any ethnicity. This place is nice looking inside and clean. Staff makes you feel very welcome and doesn't rush you at all. We ate lunch here and I must say I can NOT complain about anything 😍😍😍😍

I’ve been here a few times and the food is always fresh and hot.

Edit: I hadn’t eaten here in a while and decided to place an Ubereats order. I ordered egusi soup and pounded yam, and to my surprise, the quality of food has gone down DRASTICALLY. My initial review is from a year ago, so I know what quality to expect. The portion of food I received wasn’t enough for a child, yet I was charged nearly $20. I was also charged extra for goat meat and received all bones!!! I was livid, but wanted to give them an opportunity to make things right.

I called the restaurant and spoke with Kenric, who advised he would reach out to the owner. I took pictures of my meal and sent them to the email address he provided. Long story short, the cook told Kenric that they’d actually put extra meat in my soup (a complete joke!!!), and the owner said he’d put extra meat in my food the next time I ordered. No offer to remake my food or partially refund my order.

Judging by the reviews, my experience is not unique. They’d better make some changes before no one wants to eat here. I certainly won’t be back. I attached pictures of my food so we ALL can see that there was no meat in my soup, and how tiny the bowl is. If you don’t want to be cheated out of your money, try Royal African Cuisine. The food is priced about the same and the portions are way bigger.

I just ordered Okro soup and pounded yam from here and couldn’t even eat more than 2 bites. This soup is so disgusting and tastes old or spoiled. The pounded yam was burnt or old and re warmed. I would not recommend ordering from this restaurant… I’ll stick to Samoha African Cuisine !

First time trying Authentic African food and it did NOT disappoint!
Cashier was extremely helpful, I went with family and he let us try a sample before we ordered as well as answer all our questions (and there was a lot).

Went last week and already been back multiple times definitely recommend!

Pictured: Egusi Soup & chicken w/ Fufu , Pineapple Jamaican Sof Drink

I ordered food here around christmas time, kept the food in the fridge so we'd have food on christmas day and the food was good. Today, I visited here with a friend around 5pm. He got his food and walked out without looking at it. When he got home, he called me and said OMG did you say this place was better than samoha it can't be. I said what happened? He said the food was old and stale. I asked him to send me a pic and he did. I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw it. When I called to complain to the owner she was extremely rude and almost screaming ontop of her lungs. It's simple - apologize and make up for it but no. She then put me on hold for almost ten minutes, got back on the phone and started arguing with me. It was so bizzare to get such a reaction. She didn't even say bring the food back, let me see nope. Just rude, combative and obviously lacking any customer service skills whatsoever. Shameful. I've included a pic of the food. Even the plantain looks old and stale. My friend said it was the worst experience he ever had at a restaurant here in Charlotte and he was better off going to jack in the box. I'll also be posting about my experience on my blog. Never again.

Edit to add: I just read the comments left under my post. This owner isn't only unethical, she's a liar. I paid for the food with my own money. Again, I paid for the food. I drove my friend to this restaurant when this happened. It does NOT matter whether HE paid for the food or not. What matters is the food left a lot to be desired. It was absolutely awful.

Long but necessary! I first want to start by saying had I trusted the previous reviews I would have truly missed out on the most authentic African food Charlotte has to offer. I had my very first taste of Egusi and fufu here with the Jollaf rice and I can truthfully say in my experience there is NOT another African restaurant that compares. My food is always fresh and hot. I have enough to get full and still take home leftovers. I am truly hooked on this place. On days the cooking pot was closed I tried other African restaurants and never received the same quality of food, service or consideration. I now wait until they are open, no exceptions. People go where they feel welcomed but stay where they feel valued and let me tell you,  I have received nothing but great service every visit. She even remembers my order and that I do not like meat. She challenges me to try other dishes and have really opened my palates, and as a pickey eater. That’s talent!! You can literally taste the love in every dish and that’s what makes this place so special. I do not leave reviews often but there is a disservice being done here as I read through some of the reviews. I absolutely love everything about this place and if your looking to try good African food, consider forming your own opinion from your own experience.

I really want to give this place 5 stars; however the food quality is hit or miss and I absolutely love authentic African food. The Moi Moi (grounded and seasoned to perfection black-eyed peas) is my absolute favorite thing to get here. When it comes to the chicken- it has never seemed like fresh chicken as it is always fried extremely hard and then sauced, it seems like day old chicken. The jollof rice is good; however I wish that they would make a milder version so those who can’t tolerate spice that well can enjoy or at least try it out too.

Everything looks delicious from the photo but the chicken was a miss. The moi moi didn’t disappoint.

Update in response: I’ve actually frequented several African restaurants and this restaurant several times and depending on time of day of arrival the food consistency differs. I wouldn’t have left a review stating my thoughts if I had only visited once or twice. African food is one of my absolute favorites as it intertwines closely with Gullah cuisine. I’m not saying based on this review that I’ll never visit again, it’s just the quality has not been consistent on the times that I’ve been. Again the Moi Moi, has never disappointed me.

Now wonder they been closed down for almost 3 months....Rude customer service and miserable staff how is this even a business... must be a joke the lady working behind the counter yelled at me and told me that i couldn't talk to anyone in the store after I purchased my food and told me I was not allowed back into the store because I was talking with another customer about the experience I encountered with being shorted on a party jollof rice I ordered. I ordered a party jollof and plantains and was only served 2 spoons of rice. But wanted to give me gravy for free I did NOT request for gravy I requested for rice!  lol if that the case why notú charge me for the gravy instead of UNDER portioning me on the rice that I paid for. Under portioning and rude and I wouldn't advise any one to eat here!
