The police was called out because she refused to refund me and made me pay for my food before serving me and they advise me to file a claim through the BBB & file a claim through my bank which im going to do ! U were yelling at me I wasn't yelling at all  I was calm until the police came ! I was never escorted out by the police ! I even sat outside to file a claim ! All of your reviews say the same thing UNDER portion and rude SCAM ! U won't be open long and GOD don't like ugly u will see ! U are a compulsive liar all ur customers can't be lying it's literally repetitive complaints about your restaurant

This is what you get for $30, a spoonful of egusi with fufu & side of jollof rice that tasted burnt. I walked into the restaurant and asked for a menu, was told they dont have menus and then she proceeded to ask me what i want. First red flag. You would think with charging this amount of money for these tiny portions you would at least receive good service or something that would make you feel like what you just paid for was worth it but that wasnt the case. I rarely ever write reviews but this was not a good experience overall. And from the looks of the responses of these other reviews on here, this business doesnt seem to take accountability or know how to provide customer service.

The pictures are before anything was eaten. On the left is how the food came & was presented to me. On the right, i scraped some egusi to the side so you can see the depth & actual amount that was given.
The food was amazing if you don't like spicy beware, I got the egusi soup with chicken and beef with pounded yam. They gave me some nut thingy they sweet kinda than very spicy. Plantains are amazing.

I ordered from this restaurant through Uber eats. I would give more than 5 stars if I could. It was so good. I called the restaurant to ask questions and the multilingual gentleman was super polite and helpful. Bonne continuation!

I ordered Cassava leaf and they gave me chopped up collard greens and they were dry. Fufu tasted old. Very disappointed especially coming from Philadelphia and eating cassava. Waste of money. I do not recommend going there.
Excellence!!! If you really want to discover how good Congolese cuisine taste like? Give it a try ! You will ask for a membership 🤣🤣🤣
The food is delicious.
Love the place and food 😋

This might be my new favorite restaurant in Charlotte, i will be talking about this place for the rest of the week. Food, service, atmosphere even the music was great! I ordered the lamb kefta, whipped feta, spicy pickled okra for appetizers. My entree was the trout with potatoes and brussel sprouts. N/A sparkling wine. Everything was 10/10. Nailah was a great server! Thank you for a lovely dinner.

Recently celebrated my 30th with some close friends and we were all very impressed with the experience. From start to finish, all needs were met! From service, to taste, to attentiveness from the whole entire staff! Mary…thanks again for the phenomenal service and care ❤️ It’s hard to find around the city these days so we appreciated it. The quality cocktails, delicious and savory dishes and perfect wine pairings all complemented the experience just right. Can’t wait to come back and do it all over again!

What an incredible meal!  Our server Abigail was so friendly - expertly guided us through the menu.  Cam came through with some amazing drinks.  Highlights were the hot quail of course, liver toast, the crispy malawach, the pasta special, all the dips, all the breads and many more.  Will visit again next time we're through Charlotte.  Thank you Team for making our last night in town unforgettable!

We celebrated our 1st wedding anniversary at Albertine last night, on 11/09, and it couldn’t have been more perfect for our celebration! From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel so special and welcomed. Even when I called to confirm that I booked the correct room, I was met with excellent customer service. The ambiance was moody, romantic, and beautifully set up—exactly what we hoped for on such an important night.

Every dish was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. We started with two dips: The whipped feta and the zaalouk. Both delicious. Steak Frites and Rock Crab Mafaldine pasta for dinner. Kataifi Cheesecake for dessert. You can really tell chef puts their heart into every plate. The service was also impeccable—attentive and friendly without being intrusive— gave us warmed lavender and eucalyptus towelettes and wiped our table in between courses. They even took a Polaroid photo of us and left us a note at the end of the evening.

It was an evening we’ll never forget. Thank you to the Albertine staff (Jake, Khad, and Anna especially) for making our milestone celebration so memorable. We’ll definitely be back for many more special occasions!

We don’t venture uptown often because generally the restaurants are disappointing. However, we are glad we made an exception for Albertine. The decor and vibes were wonderful and so unique without trying too hard or being too trendy. The bar is absolutely gorgeous and I plan to go back and sit at it at some point.

The food was great. The mezze options stole the show. They have so many options and all of the ones we go were so good with the bread they came with. The crispy quail was also wonderful. I was skeptical of the hot honey it came with but it was more of a tangy sauce than sweet. Between the quail and mezze I was full before my entree even came. However, the lamb entree was also very flavorful and delicious.

Our server, Bailey, was wonderful throughout our meal. She explained nearly everything on the menu and there were many things I was not familiar with. Her descriptions helped us pick things we probably would not have selected on our own and they were delicious!

This would be a great place to come with 4-6 people and share a bunch of things, particularly if there are some vegetarians in the group. I’ll definitely be back!

The Huba found this restaurant and we stopped by on a Friday evening. It wasn’t too busy and we were promptly seated. The restaurant has a parking lot but we found street parking.

We were surprised to find that it was a hookah lounge and a couple were smoking it. The smell wasn’t too overpowering.

We ordered the suya platter and lamp chop with respective sides. Honestly, we were sure if it was an  African restaurant, we thought it was going to be but don’t know.

Didn’t have to wait long for our food. The lamb chop was really good. Jollof rice was just okay. The suya platter was good as well.

There was a Dj that started to play by the time we left around 9:30pm.

Overall, lovely experience. Our waiter was good and checked in several times.

I took out a star because we were given plastic utensils for a seat down menu? That’s a first. We didn’t order a take out so having to use a plastic ware with a plate versus paper plates was a bit irritating.

Decided to meet a friend here after church for brunch which was around 1 pm. The location is in a decent place However, parking Could be better (street parking ) They do have parking in front of the building, but it was blocked off at the time . The place Has a beautiful aesthetic we ended up sitting at the bar, but it is recommended that you make reservations. I got two shots Which was $17 apiece , A fire in the hole (amazing ) $15 , Lamb chops with jollof  rice and side of eggs and me and my friends split a $30 hookah. I spent  $97 they do add on 18% gratuity Which made my total $122, but that can be managed if you scan your receipt and pay online. The service was wonderful. The cook was amazing. Definitely recommend for a nice date night or girls outing But do not come if you want to budget this ain’t that 😂

I visited this spot once and was super impressed, but wanted to try again just to double check.  OH MY HEAVENS!!! The food was so delicious that my friend who doesn't even eat in public was tasting everything.    The drinks were so perfectly crafted and the hooka was flavored so well.  The DJ that was spinning did his thang too.  Slim was out server and she was on point with everything.  4 people, 5 different plates, 4 different drinks twice refilled) and a hooka, we paid $300. That bill is always crazy in these times, but was totally expecting with the service we received.
Definitely on my list of best hangout spots.

The chef made an amazing meal. The Tropical Platter was a perfect blend of fruit, sauces and flavor that left me wanting to order a second. My bartender was social, kind and mixed amazing drinks. They hit the spot to refresh after riding over 600 miles in the extreme heat and she was always presenting a welcoming smile that mixed with the atmosphere. A beauty all around.
An amazing place tucked away that you need to visit.

Sierra was so sweet, very hospitable, very helpful with the specials. Only thing was the chairs were not made for plus size women (so we got a booth, it was great) and even though it was only 10pm the music was WAY too loud. My friends and I couldnt even talk while we ate. Food was great tho! Overall great experience as it was my first time going inside. Definitely will be back because of the service!!!!
I went Taj oils to grab some smells good stuff and I walk by saw this restaurant.  The food was good.  Definitely will come back.

Very expensive didn’t order food once I was told the price! Nothing has names or price! I saw no customers was inside so thought great timing! I guess only 1 person speaks English and you have to wait for him to do everything while at least 3 ppl in the back…
Super delicious and super fresh. I loved it. A lot of varieties of food choices. I recommend it 👌
The food is delicious.  Pick up only. Quality Spanish food. Authentic. I couldn't even finish it all. We have to save some for tomorrow.
Great place love it here I will be back

name: Mar y Tierra Restaurant South Tryon

reviews.text: Don't let the humble exterior fool you—this place is a hidden gem serving up exceptional Mexican food. Every dish is a testament to authenticity, crafted with care and bursting with flavor. The portions are incredibly generous, so you definitely won't leave hungry. If you're in the area and craving a truly authentic meal, this is a must-visit.

So. Good. Crab legs were delicious!!!!! Tacos awesome. My daughter was adventurous and tried the octopus/squid? I don’t know but was cooked perfectly. Price was reasonable for the quality of food. 100% would recommend.

Wow! What a fun place. Great and affordable food, friendly staff, and great vibes that have left me thinking about this dining experience for two years. I kid you not I dined here two years ago with one of my good friends and we have spent the last two years trying to find this place again and finally found it! Can’t wait to go back and enjoy this wonderful restaurants cuisine🤗🤗highly recommend five stars.🥰
Fantastic family lunch here! So glad we swerved the McDonald’s next door. Very nice atmosphere, imported Mexican Cokes, big portions of tasty food, and good prices. Highly recommend for Mexican food.
We had dinner here while staying at a nearby hotel. Very pleased with the food and service. Awesome selection to choose from. Will certainly be back when traveling through again.

name: sweetgreen - Healthy Salads, Bowls and Plates

reviews.text: This is a big space- high ceilings and very open. I have to say, their new special garlic parm cauliflower sounds good and probably tastes good, but it was smelly. They do a big take out business as not many people were seated. It’s a kiosk ordering only place, so that’s something to get used to. It took a bit of time between ordering and receiving food.
Staff was kind and friendly. Even though we had an order for 5 at 8:30 pm, they were all smiles and seemed to not mind! We choose to eat our salads outside on the picnic tables.

We were in Uptown for a meeting and decided to stop at Sweetgreen for lunch.

I ordered the fries, the steak kale salad and a Hibiscus tea in a bottle. We were shocked that after placing the order 5 minutes later it was ready to pick up! Impressive during a busy lunch rush.

The staff was friendly and Reginald took especially good care of us. I loved that two different staff members walked around the restaurant and checked on the customers.

We loved the entire experience and look forward to dining there regularly for fresh and healthy food at a reasonable price.

Oh and the pickle flavored ketchup is delicious!

I would definitely recommend.

Do I need to open the bowel and see everything is good every time I order from here ?? Look this avocado it don’t look fresh at all and smell so nasty. Do better! And this is not my first time getting this kind of avocado.

Customization and quality! Once the food order was placed in the kiosk, the machine makes the bowl ready and the restaurant guyz add the hot food on top and voilà, the food was ready in 3 minutes. I loved the hot food and the friendly staff and the calm and nice atmosphere.
Must visit place if you are ever thinking to try something new.
Spl mention about the kimchi sauce. Oh! Gosh! Too good.

name: Chicken King on Nations Ford Rd I-77 exit 4

reviews.text: Looks like a typical fast food burger place.  The food and the service was phenomenal.  Hot quick and tasty.  Try the po'boy or the pork chop sandwich. Bring a friend to share the generous portions. Cheerwine is on tap

Just excellent. I’ve had a week of awful food and Chicken King hooked me up and I truly thank you guys for that! The seafood platter was amazing like always I got fries and fried okra. I also got the chef salad and it was delicious! Everything came HOT and fresh. The portions are always overflowing and packaged to perfection. I had to call them and tell them my food was fye 😂. Thanks yall, I’ll be back soon!

I enjoyed this location because of the quick and polite service. Although my order was quite large with specific choices; everything was exactly what we ordered. We used the drive through and I can say that the overall appearance of the building from the outside was not too pleasing. The whole area needs some attention. There were holes in the drive through, paint was badly needed in the order area. In my opinion I feel an overall appearance check is needed to appear more inviting. The only reason it didn't deter me from ordering was that I had eaten their food through a delivery service. This was my first time visiting this location to get my food. Just something for the owners to consider.

This was my first time eating at this establishment. In ordered the fish and shrimp combo, I was so excited to eat it bc they do give you a large portion every thing was hot and looked goodt! However….I don’t know if the fish was uncooked or if it was bad fish but it was mushy on the inside and fell apart and I don’t know what I was eating really bc it was NOT catfish it’s some type of “white fish”. I did give yall 2 stars bc the shrimp, fries and hush puppies were good. SN I put the fish in my air fryer and it’s still NOT catfish.

Honestly my favorite place to eat when I’m on the go!!! The staff inside are very nice and professional. The food is always fresh!!! The only downside to this is when I’m on my lunch break I take a lot of time. I can’t seem to cut down the time it takes to order and ask questions because that hideous!!!! atrocious!!!! MENU!!!! It is by far thI would consider myself a seasonal regular and they are very patient with questions  I’m “indecisive ”. I am always kind but I can only imagine the people that are rude because they are trying to figure out what in the world is going on with that daggon menu!!! - I feel this may truly benefits the community and the work culture for the employees if this issue is fixed expeditiously.

name: Caribbean Hut
vicinity: 200 W Woodlawn Rd Ste D, Charlotte

reviews.text: This has been my go-to restaurant for caribbean food for several years now. Unfortunately,  today I had to place an order for delivery since my car is in the shop. I ordered 1 shrimp curry roti and 2 chicken curry roti. I requested the roti be put separately so it isn't delivered soggy. I was sent containers of curry and no roti. Not even 1. That was going to be our dinner for tomorrow

I came from Atlanta for a conference and always look for good Jamaican food since I’m of Nigerian descent and love Caribbean cuisine. This spot did not disappoint! The food was delicious — the meat was tender and falling off the bone, full of rich flavor. The cabbage was soft and well seasoned, and the plantains were perfect. The young gentleman who served me was very kind and accommodating. No complaints at all — keep up the great work! I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in town.

The goat meat in the curry goat roti was very salty. And the next day I'm on the 🚽... So maybe this is a "me" problem, but I probably wouldn't get it again. To their credit, they didn't skimp on the meat, it was loaded up. Just too salty and not enough potato in the curry to balance the meal. And they also had a nice spicy pepper sauce on the side when I asked for it.

I agree the goat is a little salty. Still decent though. Good sorrel and god coco bread. Unpleasant on the phone and in person. Plantain very dry/not fresh zero sweetness, kinda like the customer service. Maybe they should be a food truck or something. Look stressed and uninterested in your money. Ialso never seen or heard of corn in the cabbage at a Jamaican spot but to each its own. Had the food been better I’d suffer the bad attitude and come back again but no thanks

I literally just left there. The man working behind the bar was one of if not the rudest person I've ever encountered in my life. When I walked in with a smile I asked if I may use the restroom before I order. He looked at me with the most angry expression and said nothing. So I repeated myself and he literally said nothing. Then I noticed when I was in the bathroom that the soap dispenser was not working. Of course this is concerning because the employees should wash their hands before leaving the restroom. So when I came out I tried to explain this to him and he said in the most rude way that it works I just didn't know how to use it. But I do know how to use a soap dispenser. It's the kind you motion in front of or underneath. I tried both repeatedly. I explained this to him and he just kept repeating himself in the most angry tone and appearance. So I said I'm going to leave and go somewhere happier. I need to eat at and support places that are nice, appreciative and respectful to their customers. This is not that place. The lady working behind the counter wasn't nice either.

Carolin, Cam & Kat are the BEST!!!!
So friendly & funny and they just wanted us to have the best time possible!!    This place has the BEST FOOD EVER!!  The egg rolls, buffalo dip, like literally all the food was BOMB!!!!!!  The drinks were the BEST I have ever had!  I didn’t get a chance to take a pic of the food because it was gone immediately lol LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS SPOT!!!!!!

We went there for a birthday party and it was a lot of fun. They have several arcade games that are similar to Dave & Busters, plus bowling alleys. There was plenty of space for a big group and they allowed us to bring a bday cake that they nicely offered to keep in their fridge for us. I will definitely go back for another party there!

Really cool space, went during Christmas time and everything was really well decorated. Lots of seating with tables, high tops, benches etc. then tons of room to the right with games, TVs, & places to lounge. Walked over from OMB on a Sunday afternoon & tried to get a Sprite for my daughter, it wasn't super busy very chill spot unfortunately no one was working the bar near the games & I couldn't find a server or wait staff to ask, so we hung out for 10 minutes and left.
It was My Niece’s 18th birthday. We had a wonderful time beautiful place.

Me and my family had a great time here. Perfect spot for kids and adults. We had cocktails and some bar food which was so delicious especially their chicken wings. I love the Mango Habanero and Thai Chili. The nachos were really good too especially the beef. Everyone enjoyed eating, playing arcade and some bowling too. Highly recommend this place. Staff were nice and service was great.

I ordered the Orville and Wilbur’s sushi roll, as well as the classic martini. Enjoyed the roll and realized I don’t like martinis, but I think that last part was due to me and not the restaurant.

Service was relatively quick; it took about an hour to get from sitting down, taking order, receiving food, and now more than halfway done, and the seated area was almost full when I sat.

The view from the seating area is wonderful. The concourse windows are huge and overlook the American Airlines plane taxi area, and there’s a lot of foot traffic for people watching right next to the seating area.
This bar, conveniently located in the middle of the airport, offered a remarkably tranquil atmosphere. They served delicious sushi and featured calming live music.

We ordered 4 standard cocktails and the bill came in at $105. My girlfriend and I were both shocked at how high that was. We looked at the menu to confirm the pricing, and they don’t list drink prices. Pretty deceptive if you ask me. Interesting way to increase margins, trick your customers.

I would get a drink somewhere else.

After American Airlines had a glitch causing us to be stuck at the airport for 9 hours they gave us vouchers to go sit down and eat and recommended this sushi place. We waited in line for over 10 mins to have a lady tell us we had to place our order at the kiosk. So we ordered some sushi rolls and3 miso soups. We got our rolls quickly and sat down and unpacked them then shortly after our soups were delivered in a bag and styrofoam bowls. So we took them out and started eating. The “manger” came almost running over and told us to “get out”. I thought we did something wrong and said uhh is there a problem.? She said this is for paying customers only you need to leave. I said uhh I’m confused are we not paying customers this is food from this restaurant is it not? She said yes but you ordered to go this is for people dining with us. I said ok you need to change the attitude you’re the one that made us order at the kiosk never saying that meant it was to go we wanted to sit and eat we are here for 9 hours. She said not her problem pack it up and get out. I asked can I order something else from you and be considered a dine in customer we literally just opened everything and have all our other stuff with us carry ons and such. She said if you’re actually going to buy something I said I will I need a menu. She hands me the menu and as I take it from her she says “so what do you want?!”  I said uhh I haven’t even looked at the menu yet you just handed it to me can I have a minute and she said “no I know you’re not going to order anything” I said so i literally just told you I would I haven’t looked at the menu you just handed it to me what do you recommend other than what we have?  She said she will be back in 1 minute and I need to know what I want or get out. She walked away and I waved over another worker that was now standing by the kiosk and said are we not allowed to eat here we didn’t get an option to order with a server or anything we were told to use the kiosk and that employee apologized and said “don’t worry about it you’re fine”. I saw her talk to the manager and the manager came back and I thought she was going to apologize but she walked up and said you need to order now or get out. I said “ok she just said we were fine to sit here but anyway I think I’m ready how is the tuna po…” and she didn’t even let me finish, she interrupted me and told us to get out that she heard me say under my breath that I was going to just stall so we could eat our food. I swear to you on everything that never came out of my mouth and when would I have said it? I waved that other employee over as soon as she left and talked to her for about 15 seconds then I was looking at the menu while that other employee went and talked to the manager then the manager came back all in about 1 minute time. This lady was an absolute nut job. I looked at her and asked is that how you treat paying customers by lying and being on a power trip maybe you should have greeted us and explained how the restaurant works instead of making us wait over 10 mins and just yelling across the bar that we had to use the kiosk to order. She said she was going to get the food court manager and we will be escorted out of the restaurant. That lady comes over tells us sorry you have to leave if you’re not going to order. I said I tried to order and already have ordered but I guess this is considered take out even though we were told we had to order using the kiosk. She goes yes they have signs posted you have to dine in to sit her and pointed to a small sign next to a pillar that you can’t see from the kiosk because the kiosk is literally right in front of it. I told the lady she needs to go back and talk to that manager because I attempted to order so we could stay seated but she’s power tripping and made up in her head she heard me say I would stall until we were done eating, but that lady just kept asking us to leave and apologizing for the rule. A mom alone with 4 small children was also kicked out after unpacking the food she just bought and sitting the kids down.

First In Flight - A Hidden Gem at CLT!

First In Flight has always been one of my go-to spots whenever I fly through Charlotte, and it never disappoints! The miso soup is consistently hot, flavorful, and comforting – a perfect way to start a meal. On this visit, I had the Sunset Roll, which was fresh, beautifully presented, and absolutely delicious.

The service was just as impressive as the food. A big thank you to Ed for taking such great care of me – attentive, friendly, and made the experience even better.

If you’re traveling through CLT and have some time, I highly recommend stopping by First In Flight. Great food, excellent service, and a relaxing atmosphere – you won’t regret it!

Unfortunately... my fried Chicken Sandwich was chewy and couldn't even bite through it with my teeth. It was bad!!! my colleagues salad for which she ordered steak ( additional $14.00 ) as her protein. It was terrible also... service was great.The atmosphere was wonderful, but the food was terrible!!!

My family and I need a place to dine after the L.A. and Charolette game. We decided to let the kids choose, surprisingly enough the choice was 204 North. Quick reminder, we are not from the Charolette area, just out-of-towners looking to catch a vibe. For those who don't, the restaurant is in the downtown area, so we had to walk about three blocks, which was absolutely fine. The stree was well shaded for the walkie. Upon entering the restaurant, to our surprise there was a beautiful wedding ceremony going on. Congratulations to the lovely couple. The ambiance was beautiful, the tables and chairs were clean, windows we well maintained,no dust in the rafters of the ceiling, so the restaurant has great air flow........two thumbs up! My family ani didn't have to sit very long before we were welcomed by our waiter, who was very patient and informative about the menu. We ordered, waited maybe 35 to 40 minutes and the food was served. Deep breath........the food does not match the service and the environment at all. Super bummer! My daughter ordered the steak  well done,  the order wasn't well but pink and tough with no taste. She decided to return the item, explaining the waiter what the issue was. My wife order the lamb meatballs, again the food doesn't match the environment. The meatballs were just that, meatballs and red marinara sauce and nothing extra. My son order the garlic herb wing, that were missing the garlic and the herb, pooey! The wings taste fried naked with an attempt of seasoning, try marinating. I (poppa bear) ordered the burger with the caesar salad, which the caesar was served with iceberg lettuce, a big no no. I do not mind in house sauce and croutons, just make sure that the flavor is there, in which the caesar dressing needs help. For this restaurant, i purposely refused to order any alcoholic beverages, curious to see if the alcohol would enhance the foods taste, sure enough it would have if a buzz the direction. All I all not a bad restaurant, just dont leave me unbalanced, great presentation, but mediocre food.

The best part was that we were able to walk in without a reservation. The food was good but nothing unique, and the service was fair for how busy they were. Drink menu was a little lackluster but the espresso martini was good. Overpriced in my opinion for what you get (paid $24 for water...) but all in all, not bad in a pinch.

We recently had our Rehearsal Dinner for my son and his bride on June 28th and it was beautifully decorated and the food was great and the staff provided great service!  I have to give a BIG shout out to Claudia who was our event coordinator.  She was phenomenal in handling all the details and she provided excellent service!  Claudia was easy to talk to and was definitely professional in how she handled everything.  Thanks Claudia for a job well done and 204 North for hosting us!!!  Beautiful venue, great staff, and great food!!!  5 stars and highly recommended!!!
I was here for Thanksgiving. The menu was fantastic for Thanksgiving. The only thing not recommended is the stuffing, everything else was lovely. The location has an upscale industrial feel about it.
Ordered on postmates and they’re great tasting empanadas! Highly recommend!

The food arrived hot, well-packaged, and with an authentic flavor that transported me to Venezuela. The empanadas were fresh and well-filled, delicious. The shredded beef bowl is highly recommended. Plus, the order arrived on time and was beautifully presented. I will definitely order again!

I didn't understand anything. Closed Sunday, 8 p.m.
. Thanks. Please update the hours at least. Thanks again. Delivery only.
The best Venezuelan empanadas in Charlotte! The flavor and texture are all delicious! They arrive at your door, hot and crispy, and delicious.

I'm giving it 3 stars because everything tasted great when I ordered, but today I ordered and the food smelled burnt. Bad service and little consideration for the customer, knowing that it has that bad smell, give food to a customer like that.

name: Community Kitchen Cafe Fusion of Ethiopian, Latin & American Cuisine

html_attributions: Community Kitchen Cafe Fusion of Ethiopian, Latin & American Cuisine

reviews.text:
Community kitchen cafe ,delivers not only rich, flavorful cuisine but also a warm and personal touch that makes the experience stand out. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was inviting, and it only got better when the owner himself came around to greet us. It's rare these days to find that kind of hospitality, and it really added to the authenticity and charm of the evening.

The food was absolutely delicious – from the perfectly spiced lentils to the tender, flavorful meats, every dish felt like it was made with care. The injera was soft and tangy, exactly how it should be. You can tell there’s pride in the kitchen and a strong connection to tradition.

Whether you're new to Ethiopian cuisine or a longtime fan, is worth a visit. It's the kind of place that makes you feel like a guest, not just a customer. We'll definitely be back!
Community kitchen cafe i love ❤️ 😍 💖 ❣️ 💕 💘 ❤️ 😍  thanks
Community Kitchen is an amazing cafe that works to serve the Charlotte community! The most friendly family owned cafe! The coffee and the food is beyond amazing!
My experience was awesome! The culture and the food was great.
Highly recommend stopping by for a cultural food to go or a sit down meal.
This place is amazing—fresh, delicious food and excellent customer service!

We ordered Plov, Lagman, Manty, Samsa with pumpkin.  We loved every dish!
Pasta for Lagman is handmade, meat and vegetables are cooked in front of you and this is a show! The seating area is decorated in Uzbek style. We will come back many times, Mazali.

1: Best noodles in the universe!
2: Nicest owners in the universe.

Because of a work opportunity, I was able to watch their team making various dishes a few months ago.  Tonight I finally got to try things: yum!

Manty with pumpkin, samsa with pumpkin & samsa with potatoes, boso lagman & guiru lagman…tasty,  handmade comfort food that’s good for you.

But those noodles: wow!

I took a bite of noodle before combining things.  Flavorful, delightfully chewy, and about a mile long, therefore just fun to eat.  Perhaps criminal but I ate half totally as-is (dare I call them naked?!).

Wishing Mazali continued success!

I visited Mazali yesterday for first time. We were looking for Uzbek food in Charlotte for long and accidentally found about Mazali. The food is great. Very flavorful and tasty. 😍
The plov rice is fluffy and the tase is very rich. Samsas dough is crispy and filling are juicy. Soooooo gooood! 🥰
Chef said they  are moving to the front kitchen in November and they will have some sitting available for 12 people. Will definitely visit again.
Thank you very much!

I have never tried Uzbek food but was craving something cozy for a cold winter night. The plov, achik-chuchuk, and kulcha were delicious! The plov was well seasoned with warm spices and crispy chicken. I did find the bread to be a bit on the drier side but still good. Will definitely be back!

Was in the building buying food from another place and decided to check their menu. I'm glad I did!! Every single item I purchased was GREAT. I ordered the 4 vegan items I saw on the menu and loved them all. The potato and pumpkin Samsas I ordered with hesitation being that I've never had anything like it before, but I'm glad I did. Especially the pumpkin which was super flavorful. The Achik- Chuchuk salad was super refreshing and light on the palate, and the boso lagman was great as well!! I will be back. I just wish I didn't live across town!!

Tucked away under a blue corrugated roof, the hidden gem crafts some of the best pho in Charlotte, complete with a complex, rich broth and all the accoutrements. Though the menu may be small, the owners focus on creating exceptional pho and banh mi with generous portion sizes at fair prices. Do yourself a favor and discover this treasure.

So my review is purely on the pho so there is some bias. The rule of thumb is, if they don’t have pho on the name of the restaurant, it’s not their specialty and that rings true here. Their pho is a 5/10. On that note, the high rating is deserving of the rest of the food. The bahn mi is fantastic. Although I like the carrots to be a little thinner, the flavor of the bahn mi was still legit!! 9/10. I will say their eggroll sauce and their bun sauces were only okay to me. If you prefer the rice plates and bahn mis, definitely give this place a try. If you’re wanting pho, keep looking on central! Lastly, the owner of this place is the sweetest!!

First pho experiences in North Carolina!
Didn't expect Large portion just for 13.95$! If you visit first time and want to try pho, here you go!

This is absolutely the pinnacle of the American pho experience. This is how pho should taste and what a pho place should be. I loved it. I couldn't be happier.

Edit: I've been around and the Bahn Mi's are some of the best in town AND you can't beat that $6 price

Delightful little gem on Central! The food is so fresh and the taste is out-of-this-world good! The European market next door has a great selection of pantry, frozen and cold foods to cook up a little bit of European cuisine in your kitchen. The family-owned business of Cafe and market are run by two of the kindest and humorous gentlemen I have had the pleasure to meet.

An absolute gem in Charlotte. Home cooked, authentic and family owned. Everything was made fresh it was SO good and my kids loved trying new foods, sodas, and snacks. The chef was very nice and welcoming too.

Charlotte is the city that’s still trying to find its identity in so many ways. Our visit to Euro Grill and Cafe reminded us that spaces like these allow Charlotte to breathe easy as it navigates the journey of arriving at a solid footing in terms of its identity.

The Bosnian restaurant is quaint and yet it feels like it’s trying to hold on to something precious, which reflects in its food, which despite being not especially piquant, still tastes flavorful enough to keep you wondering if the magic lies in the simplicity of the recipe and the cooking.

We got the Chicken Shish Kebab with fries and the Grilled Chicken Sandwich with fries. The chicken was tender and juicy and perfectly cooked. The fries were your regular fries which were a nice accompaniment to the main dishes. The finely cut onions were a nice touch too!

I don’t eat red meat, but their menu options(including cevapis, sandwiches, gyros among other items) looked quite extensive.

There is an Eastern European grocery store right next door that’s run by the same people. The seating area inside is small and cozy, accommodating around 5-6 tables. There’s seating available outside as well. The staff was quite kind and polite and had a sense of humor, which we appreciated.

Parking is available in the back.

Best bread I’ve ever had. Very delicious meats. Coffee seemed a little weak but I’m not sure how it’s supposed to be as I’ve never had Bosnian coffee before but the little rose flavored candy with it was tasty.

Great little Serbian restaurant in Plaza Midwood area. Food is delicious and reasonably priced. Service is friendly and fast. Little Serbian grocery connected has great products you won't find anywhere else.

Service was okay, food had more to be desired. As an Avid foodie and Latin. I know Latin food and this is definitely NOT the best I've had. Almost as if there was something missing or not the right ingredients. Presentation was okay, the taste was not all that great. I don't recommend this restaurant.

For what it’s worth, I really enjoy going to places in the United States where I forget I’m in the United States. Restaurants off of Central Avenue in Charlotte are perfect for that and Adamary’s is no exception. Do they speak English here? Possibly. Or maybe they speak as much English as I do Spanish. Either way, I never found out. The menu: Spanish. The tela novellas on tv: Spanish. So I broke out the 20% of Spanish I remember from high school and had a great time at this place. Now onto the food... I ordered the Arroz Con Pollo which is one of my favorite Mexican dishes. It came with chips and three salsas: a tomato, green, and pepper (???) salsa. I was a fan of the first two but couldn’t really vibe with the last. Didn’t matter. I liked that the chicken had a fair amount of cheese. And the rice was tasty. Friendly service. I don’t know if she could tell I don’t speak a lot of Spanish (let’s be honest, she probably could) but I think she appreciated the effort. I hope to return and try some other goodies that caught my eye: pupusas, tortas, tacos.
So delicious and easy to pick up. Hot and fresh and yummy.
Food was authentic and delicious. I would not recommend going at night but for lunch a great hidden gem. Ordered the guac and California burrito.

Got 6 tacos and a drink and came out paying 28.34 which is a lot compared to some other nearby taco places… that’s not including tip.
3 tacos were 11.25 and the other 3 were 9.50 the drink (horchata) was a whopping 4.50$ plus a service charge? .76$

The food was excellent in quality and flavor, big portions, and very humble prices. We tried the combination mix kabob entree and all 3 kabobs are made very well here, I was surprised by how much I liked my food. I think it has become the norm to be disappointed by restaurants these days in my experience, but this place is awesome. The Tabouleh is tasty and the flavors pair very well with kabob, hummus was nice, and the delicious homemade dressing on the salad is a unique twist on Italian. The host made us feel right at home in this quiet gem of a diner. Loved the whole experience and enjoyed my leftovers the next day.

Been coming here for years. Love the authenticity of the food. The Mediterranean salad is always well seasoned.  The lamb and turmeric rice well prepared.  I like I can shop and purchase authentic seasons, teas , dates and olives. Small dine in eatery very quaint. Relax atmosphere.  Customer service is great. Always professional and pleasant.  Limited parking. Dinning area very clean and neat. Large supplies of olives my favorite. One of my favorite jewels in Charlotte.

I finally stopped in and picked up a too good to go bag and ordered $30 worth of food. I was not disappointed. I will definitely be back I want to get the some of the desserts and that hummus and labneh… so so good! The staff is also very friendly and happy to assist with any questions that you may have. They also have a storefront with many different options. Stopped in here again I am not disappointed The pistachio baklava is out of this world. They also threw in some samosas for me to try, which was so great. Do yourself a favor expand your horizon and go try this restaurant.

It was my first time eating here. I was greeted when I entered. It's a small grocery store that sells food and also raw meat. The rice was delicious. The chicken was good too. I had half a chicken and I had Lipton soup. I definitely will try it again. The prices were reasonable. The customer service you will receive Will be great. And the wait was nothing but roughly 5 minutes.

If I could leave 0 starts I would. If you’re looking to purchase a goodie bag from this location I would not recommend. I waited about 10 minutes for the food which was not a problem. After receiving the food I noticed the chicken was extremely dry as if it had been sitting out all day long. I did not eat the food due to food safety concerns. When I called to tell them they claimed to have cooked the chicken the same day but the chicken was old or either sitting out. This is safety issue for customers and against proper food safety regulations.

Ordered the Bandeja paisa and it was excellent! Everything was tasty and good portion size for the price. Last time I came the empanadas were good but this time around they were old and burnt. Maybe just a bad day but overall, great columbian food!

Delicious Colombian Comfort Food! 🇨🇴

The chicharrón con yuca was crispy, juicy, and perfectly paired with tender yuca and a zesty ají sauce. The empanadas de carne were golden and packed with flavorful beef—crispy on the outside, savory inside. And the Desayuno Mi Tierra? A hearty, soul-warming combo of eggs, arepa, chicharrón, chorizo, beans, rice, and sweet plantains. Highly recommend!

I love this restaurant in all. I typically frequent the arrowood location, but Im a bit upset. It's only 1152am. I ordered the steak rice and beans with cassava. The only thing that was hot was the steak. Like how are my beans still cold rce lukewarm. Pandebono cold.
Outstanding food in a lovely little restaurant. The Carne asada and the Picada were delicious, and we can't wait to go back and try more items from the menu.
YUP! Ordered from DoorDash and was very pleased! The different meats are well worth the price! Well seasoned and cooked perfectly! Delicious rice and beans!

The waitress we had was welcoming, friendly and patient. The fresh mango juice was really good, it was made from fresh fruit and a must try. We got falafel and it was worth trying. The fries were fresh and crispy. Got the mixed kebab platter, it was a huge let down, it looked good but the the meat was very chewy, and eating that felt like a chore.

Really good Mediterranean food! The kabobs were flavorful and cooked perfectly, and the hummus and rice were both excellent. The staff was friendly and made sure everything came out fast and fresh. Portions are big for the price, so you definitely get your money’s worth. Great local spot if you’re in the mood for kabobs or shawarma.

Unfortunately the food here was garbage.
Been here a year ago. Ended up throwing up later that night. Decided to give it another shot a year later maybe it was a small food bug.
Got the Mansaf, grape leaves, and hummus a try.
Trash. Mansaf was horrendous, rice seemed old, beef was insanely cold and covered with this sauce that smelt really bad. Grape leaves the rice was chewy like gum. And the hummus was just in half an inch of straight oil.

Would steer clear of this place. Wanted to support their business but can’t even provide decent just decent food.

I drove over two hours hoping to enjoy Mansaf, and I contacted the restaurant before coming to make sure it was available. Unfortunately, the experience did not meet my expectations. The taste of the food was not what I was hoping for, especially the rice and the Mansaf broth. The service was also quite slow.

After the meal, we ordered a Spanish latte that was listed at $5, but we were charged a different amount at checkout.

I believe that being honest with customers is always appreciated. If a specific dish is not prepared well, it would be better to recommend another option instead. I truly hope this feedback helps improve the experience in the future.

I have found yet another favorite spot in Charlotte. We went in between lunch and dinner so it was very quiet in there. The young lady that helped us was so sweet and made the best iced banana latte. Our food was so good and the portions were kind of big and we had leftovers for later. This place seems like a great place for a birthday/event dinner.

name: Banh Mi Brothers
vicinity: 230 E W.T. Harris Blvd suite a7, Charlotte

reviews.text:
I recently visited Banh Mi Brothers during their Black Friday promotion, which offered an impressive discount on their bánh mì selections. I ordered both of their specialty sandwiches—the Korean Beef and the Porchetta—and was genuinely impressed by the quality and authenticity of each one.

My father and I were stunned by how closely the flavors and textures resembled the traditional bánh mì we grew up with. It truly felt like a taste of home brought to America. The restaurant also delivered excellent service, with fast-paced order preparation and an attentive staff. In addition, the owner personally extended a kind gesture by offering my father extra porchetta on the side as a sign of appreciation, which made the experience even more memorable.

Overall, Banh Mi Brothers exceeded our expectations in both flavor and hospitality. I will absolutely be returning to explore the rest of their menu—this is a restaurant worth revisiting again and again.

4⭐️
I have never had Banh Mi and I was super surprised at how good this was. I got the Traditional Grilled Chicken Banh Mi. My husband got the Specialty Korean Beef Banh Mi, and then we got seasoned fries to share.
The Banh Mi was super flavorful. Fresh, light, but still flavorful. My husband said the exact same thing about his. It’s a perfect lunch.
I wish I got a good picture of the Banh Mi on the wall, but I like to let people enjoy their food. 🤣 definitely recommend if you’re in the area though!

I had a great first experience at Banh Mi Brothers. I already love Vietnamese food, I saw it in the area and decided to try it. The music vibes were great in my opinion, each staff member was very friendly and helpful. I ordered the vermicelli noodle bowl with the bulgolgi beef, 10/10 recommend! Food was fresh, flavorful and delicious. Can't wait to come back and try the Banh Mi's! I love giving random good reviews. Charlotte can be a little shaky when it comes to food, this may be a place where you don't have to guess if it's going to be good or not.

Tried banh mi for the first time and it was delicious. The meat was tender and juicy. The bread was the best part. It was thin and very crispy on the outside and soft and fluffy on the inside. Would eat here again

Best Bánh Mì in Charlotte….and it’s not close.

Really love our experience here from start to finish.

We ended up getting pretty much everything on the menu and all of it was delicious.

Even though Hal (the owner) wasn’t there like he promised (just kidding Hal), he still was thoughtful enough to send a message through someone else working that day, and they took care of us.  Give us a great reason to come back!

Definitely check this place out and get adventurous with the menu, it’s worth it!

Cool spot to unwind and relax. Great views of the city while enjoying a cocktail.
Sit at the bar or your own little cabana area. On the 5th floor of the Marriott Hotel. Bartenders were friendly. Also has a pool behind the bar if you’re a guest staying at the hotel. Awesome place to stay of meet up for drinks with friends or coworkers. If you’re visiting charlotte I recommend checking this place out !

I can’t only grade the drinks because we didn’t order and food. This place is such a lovely establishment, perfect to relax and chill in any sunny weather. Just no rain. However THE DRINKS. PERFECT O M G!!!! The DRINKS, whatever you go for, even the non alcoholic drinks are delicious. Will return in the summer or spring actually.. go on a nice 70 outside or even night OMG. It’s inside the JW MARRIOTT, we got lost trying to find the entrance however once we did.. it’s a beautiful place.

Halle was absolutely amazing! She was super friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our time drinking there. Her energy and warm personality really made the experience enjoyable. You can tell she genuinely cares about her guests. We’ll definitely be coming back..  thanks to Halle for such great service!

I didn’t have a reservation, but the host was still able to seat me—right around 5 p.m., just as the happy hour crowd was rolling in. Spoiler alert: the rooftop view overlooking the city is absolutely worth it, so I’d recommend making a reservation to secure your spot.

Since this was just a stop before my dinner plans, I kept it light and ordered the spicy guacamole (and yes, it lives up to its name—spicy but so good!) along with the burnt end lollipops (smoked brisket). To sip, I went with a refreshing Charlotte mocktail.

Another perk? During happy hour, all appetizers are $3 off, which makes it the perfect time to sample and share.

What would have been this establishment a five star for me would have been attentiveness and hospitality.

I stayed one night at the JW Marriott Charlotte and had dinner at Aura Rooftop.

I tried two rice bowls—the Salmon and the Wagyu. Both were quite good, but what really stood out was the atmosphere. Even though the rooftop is only on the 5th floor, the vibe was amazing with a stylish and relaxing setting.

Perfect spot to enjoy good food, cocktails, and city views while unwinding. Definitely worth a visit if you’re staying at the hotel or nearby!

-- Recommend to do reservation

name: Salata
vicinity: 601 S Tryon St Suite No. 131, Charlotte

reviews.text: This location is my favorite! Everything is always so fresh and I love that they tons of vegan options! I dont necessarily understand why quinoa is extra but I’m still gonna get it everytime 😂

For what it is, Salata hits the mark more than similar types of fast casual salad spots.  The food is fresh, the portions are plentiful (pictured is the regular size, and there is a large!), the service is helpful and nice, and the price is reasonable.  Not to mention, comfortable seats with power outlets and bottomless iced teas and lemonade.  I just wish the place was a bit bigger- during peak times, I can imagine things getting crowded quickly.

I'd definitely return here if I lived in the area. Well done!
food was yummy and fresh, man named malik had free drinks on him and was very friendly to me and my sister. clean place and great food honestly a great salad place

Great value! Considering the inflation on food in the past two years, this place is great value for what you get. Also can choose as many toppings as you like in the salad price. I found the small size even generous portion. Clean place, nice atmosphere. Can dine in or outside option. Quality of ingredients was as expected.

Great place for a quick and light lunch!
Came in and got a small bowl (which was big enough). You can build it however you want, and the number of toppings and options can make you dizzy.
I got the chicken, added some apples and blueberries (big hit!!!). As well as some fresh veggies and sesame sticks.
It was a full meal, that kept me full until dinner bit not heavy.
Everything was fresh and good, and I know I'll be back.

Our dinner was amazing and highly affordable! The service was wonderful, our waitress was so kind and really knew her stuff! The restaurant was cute, cozy, welcoming, and clean! Delicious food!! Will definitely be revisiting whenever we find ourselves in Charlotte again!

Had a great experience ordering from this pizza place for a party! We got pizzas, wings, breads, salads, and pasta—everything was fresh and everyone loved it. I placed the order over the phone, and the agent was incredibly patient and helpful. At the end of the call, he even made sure to ask about all the extras we might need, like plates, sauces, chilli flakes, Parmesan, and cutlery.
Everything was packed neatly and in a way that made it super easy to carry. Really appreciated the attention to detail and customer service. Highly recommend!

The primary difference between good pizza and great pizza is the next day cold pizza for breakfast test. I can tell you that compared to Ohio Pizzas  the toppings were a  on the sparse  side and the pizza needs  a little more a little more sauce. From past experience that will drop this pizza from great into good. It was tasty…There are leftovers I may have to reevaluate, but in the meantime, I submit my review. BUT with Lasagna and Veal Parmesan on the menu,
I will be back. Update I was so impressed by their pizza that been back twice. I had the veal Parmesan. It was very good.. then I had wonderful lasagna and I also enjoyed it. They’re definitely one of the rare gems in the area and I will go back again.
The staff were very friendly, and the spaghetti and meat sauce was solid and tasty. Too much food for one sitting but will make a great lunch for tomorrow. 😜

This is for Ms Sherry !  She was absolutely pleasant .  Very inviting and sweet she is .  Will come back just for her ❤️.

The chicken picatta was very light and citrusy, just the way I like it !  Though it was a tad too too lemony for my preference, but it’s nothing like some table side garlic powder, salt and Parmesan cheese couldn’t fix !

Got a slice of pizza to go as well, after all, it’s a pizzeria too!  Give it a solid 7.2 on the pizza and 7.4 on the chicken picatta .  Will come back for the creamier based sauces since they’re made to order .

I went to this place because I had work in the area I ordered and asada sandwich it was okay more beans than steak. It left a lot to be desired, service was good atmosphere was okay maybe I ordered the wrong thing not my favorite spot

Just finished a great meal at this nice restaurant. I must say the food was very well presented and pleasant. The taste however was very exceptional. I haven’t had a more pleasant experience while dining in public in a long time.
I highly recommend this Resturant’s especially if you like home cooked flavor,fresh, vegetables and salads. The cucumbers and romaine lettuce and tomatoes are like just picked from the garden and chilled. This is good eating that may be passed over. I enjoyed the food the hospitality and the atmosphere was extremely nice

Super friendly, great food, and not Mesican but I think Honduran or maybe Guatemalan (?)so some unexpected twists and the owner was super friendly, great English, veey attentive. Sure the Spanish music was a little loud but that's part of the value of a badass meal@

Just ate here for the 1st time tonight for my B-day. It was delicious!! My wife and I both had the Tres Primo (Three Cousins) dinner. It has a little pico salad, guacamole, chicken, bacon wrapped shrimp, skirt steak (with a scallion), a light rice and beans. It comes with corn tortillas as well. They were thicker than what I'm used to. We both left good and full. The staff were very friendly. We will definitely be back!
Great place to get El Salvadoran food. I got a bean & cheese and a pork & cheese pupusas. Cabbage slaw is flavorful with a little bit of spice that goes great the tomato sauce.

Food was absolutely underwhelming. I don’t have high expectations for airport food, but this was beyond disappointing. We got chicken tenders that had zero seasoning and looked like they came from a freezer bag in the way back. Especially for the price. Do watch out that the cocktails are made with double pours so that does mean double pour price ($25 for a Moscow mule). Service is very nice.

We decided to dine here while our flight was delayed.

Food: Overall, the food was overpriced and lacked flavor. We ordered the 6 chicken wings for $20. I had the cheese and pulled pork potatoes — the pulled pork was hot, tasty, and honestly could be a dish by itself, but the rest was just okay. I also had 6 lemon pepper wings, which were a decent size, but the taste and the wet/tempura-style batter were not appealing. My husband had a burger, which was just okay as well.

Drinks: Cocktails are pricey — a Long Island iced tea was $22.

Availability: They were out of ranch dressing, beef brisket, and corn relish, and my husband ended up getting the last two burger patties they had. Staff explained that the commissary was short on or missing these products.

Service: Our waiter was quirky and friendly, and we appreciated the military discount they offer.
Got to CLT airport before 7am and went to Whiskey River to have a beer before my flight. Bartender was nice and prompt. I didn’t order food but peoples orders came out fast and looked/smelled good.

Just going to keep this short shove I’m traveling. Got the dirty tots, the Texas tequila bacon cheddar burger and a double shot of moonshine.

It took forever to even be sat, then about 10 minutes for my drink order to be taken, another 10 min for the food order to be taken. Drink came out quick and was surprisingly really smooth with a great corn taste.
The tots took about 20 mins to come out and were stale and cold.
The burger came out about 35 min later. It was overcooked, dry, flavorless and cold.
Much like the owner, Dale Earnhardt Jr, it’s overpriced, overhyped, slow and mediocre at best.

Save your money and only go if everything else is closed and you have at least a 2hr layover, otherwise you’ll miss your flight.

Whiskey River at Charlotte Douglas Airport offered a truly unique atmosphere—definitely a standout among typical airport dining options. The rustic-meets-modern vibe, combined with live music and a lively bar, makes it feel more like a destination restaurant than just a quick airport stopover.

One of the biggest highlights of my visit was the live music. The artist performing during my meal was exceptionally talented and really elevated the whole experience. It gave the space a great energy and made waiting for my flight genuinely enjoyable. It’s rare to find such quality entertainment inside an airport!

When it came to the food, I was pleasantly surprised by the portion sizes. Everything served was generous—especially for an airport restaurant—and the flavors were solid. I didn’t feel like I was being shorted just because it was a quick-grab meal while traveling.

That said, the service could have been better. It wasn’t terrible, but definitely slower than expected, especially considering airport travelers are usually on tighter schedules. The staff was friendly enough, but there seemed to be a staffing shortage that affected the speed of both seating and food delivery. It’s something I hope they improve because the rest of the experience was worth it.

Prices are what you’d expect at the airport—slightly higher than normal, but nothing outrageous. For the portion sizes and the overall vibe, I felt it was fair.

Cleanliness was also on point. The tables were wiped down promptly, and while the floors weren’t spotless, they were relatively clean and definitely not a concern. For a high-traffic airport venue, they’re doing a decent job keeping things in order.

Overall, I’d probably visit Whiskey River again if they’re a bit better staffed. The atmosphere, live music, and satisfying food make it a worthwhile stop if you’ve got some time to spare during a layover. Not perfect, but definitely one of the better airport dining experiences I’ve had.

Halal Street Food serves strong flavors and fresh ingredients. My lamb gyros tasted good once they were finally finished. The problem is the service. I waited more than 40 minutes for three orders of fries. The cook started my two lamb gyros, stopped to help someone else, and left them sitting on the counter. He came back about four minutes later and finished them. I brought it up. He decided to make them again, which pushed my wait even longer. The food is solid. The service is not. If you go, expect delays and check your order before leaving.

It a good spot for Mediterranean food… Rabeya was very friendly and easy to order a meal. She had a great customer service experience. Food service is super quick and friendly. Thank you to make my first time easy and quick.
Absolutely obsessed with this place. I come here weekly and the staff is super friendly. The manager goes above and beyond for her customers! Thank you !!!! Food is always fresh and hot.

The chicken over rice is so good! My order came with pita, TWO white sauces, and hot sauce - I didn’t even have to ask!

Best halal in the area 🙌🏼

I am here to leave my review.  On more than one occasion I have ordered food and requested white sauce for my lamb gyro rice through DoorDash which was not given to me. I can only eat the food with the sauce. Without it it’s bland. When I complained nothing was resolved and the person on the phone was acting confused.  I won’t be ordering again.   This has happened to me repeatedly.  The pita bread I was given was also stale.  I paid for the food it wasn’t free so why are you rendering me a service like it’s free.
I've been coming here for years, and the sopa de marisco is always so delicious! It's one of our absolute favorite dishes. Me and my family enjoy coming here and the service is amazing .
The best Central American food DELICIOUS 😋
Amazing Pupusas de Loroco in Charlotte 😍😍😍. Delicious tamales and michelada. Excellent service and clean atmosphere. New favorite spot.
The food and service has improved from my last visit. Everything is tasty and the staff is friendly. I recommend trying it out again for those one stars out there. This was morning service.

The chicken fajita was really tatsy!

It was served very hot as you can see in the pictures and it came with rice, refried beans, salad, hot flour tortillas, and pico de gallo.

They don't skimp on the meat nor the veggies, and it even had 🥦 broccoli in it 😊.

I only gave them ⭐⭐⭐⭐'s because it was a weird smell in there to me, and it wasn't a pleasant smell. Other than that, the food is authentic and tastes good.

I ordered from Halal Kitchen Ink, The Mix Over Rice which is Lamb and Chicken over rice . One of my favorite dishes to order from Halal spots . This was my first time , hopefully not my last . Ordered directions sauce on the side . Tasted everything seperate and then together , as I was eating I felt something was just really salty . Really could not put my finger on it , it's one thing to be seasoned it's another to have way too much salt . I suggest who ever is seasoning possibly the meat or sauce watch out for the sodium . You can add salt but you can not remove it , which makes the dish less desirable.  When I first retrieved  my order from Uber delivery driver I held that order and was like this is pretty light . Opened my order and said really , for the price yall could of packed a bit more rice . Portion was way to small for that price , maybe If thee was some falafel  or a piece of Nan bread something it would complete the meal but it just didn't  hit . I read so many reviews and watch TikTok reviews; not sure what went wrong

I travel over 90 miles from Columbia, SC to Charlotte, NC just for Halal Kitchen Ink—and let me tell you, it’s worth every single mile. This isn't just a food truck; it's a full-blown culinary experience on wheels.

From the moment you step up to the window, you’re greeted like family. The service is top-tier, fast, friendly, and professional. But let’s talk about the real star: the food. The flavors are phenomenal. Whether it's the juicy lamb over rice, perfectly seasoned chicken, or that mouthwatering white sauce they should bottle and sell—it’s all cooked to perfection, fresh, and Halal-certified.

You can taste the love and pride in every bite. The portions are generous, the prices are fair, and the consistency? Impressive every single time.

This place has officially ruined all other food trucks for me. If you're in the Charlotte area—or even hours away like I am—make the trip. Halal Kitchen Ink isn’t just good, it’s destination-worthy.

🔥 Pro Tip: Order ahead. They get BUSY for a reason.

Got it the first time and it was good. The second time it was a mess. No consistency on the service.  Paid extra for no salad and extra rice but I got half of the plate salad.  The chicken was old and tasted bad.  It really depends on the time and luck.  Will not repeat. Funny, I had to travel 2.5 hrs thinking this is the best in NC. The same halal cart that got me excited, now it is making hate chicken or lamb over rice.

Great food, good location, will definitely be returning. I suggest the lamb and chicken combo w/extra white sauce. The best one I've been to, right amount of salad sides and distributes the sauce just right.

Halal Kitchen Ink is an absolute gem! The food is always fresh, flavorful, and 100% authentic halal — you can truly taste the quality in every bite. From the perfectly seasoned meats to the delicious sides and sauces, every dish is made with care and attention to detail.

The service is just as impressive as the food. The staff is friendly, welcoming, and always ready to offer great recommendations. Whether you're a regular or a first-time visitor, you’re treated like family.

If you're looking for top-notch halal food, Halal Kitchen Ink is the place to go. Highly recommended!
Chicken stew, yellow rice & cabbage. Tasty, no complaints. Super full. $15

I was working in Charlotte for a month, then finally I found this amazing place. My last 2weeks  I ate here everyday. Food, service and staff polite and just as beautiful as the food served. Can't wait to come back. GOD WILLING!!

I love this place so much!! I am a regular and the staff is so welcoming and patient and the food is sooooooooooooo good! I highly recommend! If you are new to Charlotte and you want some authentic dominican food and some soul food this is the place to be! The mangu, The arroz, The pollo, The sweet potatoes,  The Mac n cheese, The flan(desert) and so much more!  OMG it’s all on point I promise you!  😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋😋

The food here is amazing. The Mac and cheese tastes homemade. The chicken must be slow cooked because it’s extra tender. The rice is great. The portion size is also good so the price is worth it. I can eat it a few times since I’m a light eater. I’ve never been disappointed eating here. Try it out!

The food and service was ZERO STARS! My friends so spoke so highly of this place so we decided to patronize. We first placed an online order that was never received, called in and was told no one spoke English so they couldn’t help. i then switched to spanish and they confirmed they didnt have the order but I spent $40+ dollars so after speaking to online support I got and refund and we went in person. They spoke english with no problem when we arrived which made mw think they just didnt want our business. I asked for no onions and peppers and got them both in abundance. My food was cold and my friends that recommended the place also did not enjoy his normal meal.

We weren't aware it was an actual hookah lounge.  It was very dark ans the music was extra loud but thebcibe was there. Just wasnt what we expected. Beautiful decor and the staff was great. The food was amazing.  Not a single thing we didn't like and the drinks were on point. Would absolutely return for the salmon ceasar alone. They were out of a couple menu items but we tried everything else we wanted.
My only complaint was the volume of the music which absolutely matched the vibe. Staff was amazing. Food was great. I would definitely celebrate there again.

Not from Charlotte. But my girlfriend and I decided to take a little trip for the weekend. We were recommended to come to the spot and we obliged.

Out the gate we noticed that making a reservation will go a long way. It definitely guaranteed seating for us.

One of the things that stuck out was the pricing. Mac and Cheese was $15?! A double shot was $39?! Now mind you... that price alone would make you say "damn, It must be hitting on something for that price". Like at least a fair portion size. But unfortunately.... it was childish of them to provide you with a small portion.

The DJ was on point so no complaints there atmosphere was decent. But overall it's a three from me.

The server was A1 she was super cool and our drinks were good but the food wasn’t it!  I had the snapper and grits with creole sauce and eggs.  The grits were watery, the creole sauce had no flavor and was watery too, the eggs were extremely overcooked and hard, the snapper was good but that was it.  The hookah is electric which I didn’t like at all because you have to pull so much harder to get any smoke or flavor.  All around, I wouldn’t come back.  First time in Charlotte and first stop, this is not a good way to start off Charlotte lol.

Really nice place. Dj was jamming! Had a great time. Food was excellent! Alcoholic drinks were a little expensive but they were good. They were very accommodating with our large group of 11 people especially just to walk in. Visited this place on 4th of July weekend.  Not packed. Good crowd. Customer service was 👍. I would visit this establishment again!!

We visited North Italia last night, on a weekday. The place was busy but not so busy that we had to wait to be seated. Our server was prompt, kind, knowledgeable and overall good company. The bar was a bit backed up as a large party had just arrived but the manager eventually brought us our drinks himself. There was a small wait for the food as well but it was well worth it. The atmosphere is nice as well. You can see the kitchen from your seats; it was really cool to see everyone cooking. If I ever come back to Charlotte, It'll be for the bolognese & meatballs.

WOW — absolutely incredible! They have gluten-free options for both pizza and pasta, which made me so happy. I went with the seafood pasta and every single bite was packed with flavor — perfectly cooked shrimp and plenty of crab throughout. The sauce was rich and seasoned just right!

Our server, Tyren, was also amazing — friendly, attentive and made the whole experience even better. 100% recommend this spot!

Overall experience was okay. Food was good for me because I got the farm salad. Plus the white truffle garlic bread was very good. That earned a star. But some of our party's pasta came out on the cold side. Waiter took longer than one would expect with the caliber of service and atmosphere this restaurant tries to convey. Not to mention we had to repeat things back to him several times. And I mean like... not just twice... about 4 times. Prices are typical of this type of restaurant. The hand made pasta was cooked well even though it was not warm. Just an overall okay experience. Somewhere I'd go maybe once a year or if invited. But not 1st choice Italian.

They need better lighting! At 5 oclock, it was brighter outside than it was at our table. Server was nice but clearly new as we watched her go in circles trying to find items we requested like straws and togo boxes. Food was good, our sides for the table were really hot while our mains were lukewarm.

First time there visiting the area we can across this  Italian restaurant. The only complaint is that we waited for 10mins for someone to greet us at our table.. other than that the food was made to perfection the alcoholic drinks were very good with fresh ingredients. I highly recommend this place..

This is the largest Asian market in Charlotte, in my experience. This store offering a wide variety of fresh seafood, including fish, lobsters, crawfish, shrimp, mussels and live crabs. Their vegetables have a lot of option and they are so fresh. They carry a vast selection of seasonings, from all over Asian and even have some from South America as well. They isle is arranged in very organized way, you can tell that they put by almost each country per isle such as Thailand, China, Japan or Korea. They have many kind of ingredients dry or wet, hotpot bases, instant noodles, and more. You’ll also find imported Asian snacks, beverages, and a variety of frozen foods like dumplings, noodles or vegetables. They also offer freshly cut pork, beef, and chicken in different cut. Also, if you hungry, they have some type like small food court that you can should and pick to eat, roast duck, chicken or pork roasted. Definitely come back for this location.

My son and I love this place! It’s an Asian supermarket with a large counter that serves a ton of prepared foods, freshly made crab boils, deep fried crabs, and more!  There’s a small area where you can eat in if you’d like.  There are huge fresh seafood and meat counters. You can also purchase whole or half marinated and smoked ducks.  The staff was friendly and helpful and they gave my son several free items to sample. These were not sample size, they were full size.  I was amazed by the selection in the supermarket part of the store.  We’re already planning what we’ll order our next visit.
The crabs are fresh.. for there to be so much seafood out on display it doesn't smell like Harris Teeter lol there was so much to take in. I felt like a kid in the candy store.

I love the Asia Mart had everything that I was looking for but the people that was at the counter that was cooking the food was not pleasant at all the service was not good they was trying to tell us to go home and cook the food but we wanted to have it there because we came so far from Charleston South Carolina to Charlotte but when the Asians came there and we paid attention to them they were much nicer nicer to them

Store is great. The hot food seafood hotpot is not as great. Made the shrimp too soft. Overall cash register people should be able to help customer sign up for the store points right there and than. Instead of having customer try to scan the barcode on their phone to sign up. Better customer service would be nice.

It’s good enough to take care of a craving. No major issues, just wished they’d followed instructions better. I asked for extra gravy on my jerk chicken, and did not get it. My patty was burnt on the bottom it was still ok, it’s kind of hard to mess up premade patties. The cabbage was ok, just missing something. The plantains were plantains, and my rice and peas were good. I will say the my chicken was cooked over fire the right way. The portions for a large plate are very small.
DELICIOUS and fresh food, and great and kind service! You’ll be happy you've ordered from here! I can't wait to return. A hidden gem!

Ventured here to see what the Jamaican cuisine was like in Charlotte. Carry out or food service seem to be the most popular style of experience, although there is a countertop for stand up eating.  I ordered oxtail and curry goat, both were flavorful and portioned well - the side of plantain and steamed cabbage were also delicious. Although they were not busy, the food took quite a while to be served. If you’re in the area, I would give it a try. Street parking 🅿️ is available but could be tricky during peak hours as it is in a residential areas.

Not mouthwatering. At all. The service was friendly, so points given there. However, the food was a bust for me. This is not authentic Jamaican food. It’s just a place that makes it. Rice and peas is just white rice and beans with some seasoning. Cabbage and greens were not cooked the best, and too salty/vinegary. No real balance. Brown stew chicken was pretty dry and NO sauce! Never had any Jamaican meat served dry and no sauce whatsoever! This was a huge let down and unfortunately I won’t be back.

I ordered the jerk chicken with Mac and cheese and a beef patty and everything was amazing. The food took about 10 minutes and it was very hot and tasted fresh. There is a very distinct smoky taste to the jerk chicken which I enjoyed. The jerk chicken is chopped up to fit into a smaller container but the portion size is big (I ordered a small). The jerk chicken was pretty spicy so if you are more sensitive to spicy foods I would suggest getting the mild jerk chicken. I would definitely suggest trying this place out if you like Jamaican food, and I look forward to coming back and trying something new. It is also worth noting that this restaurant is take out only, and does not accept cash.

name: Cayo Caribe - Restaurant
vicinity: Inside Compare Foods, 5601 South Blvd, Charlotte

reviews.text: I ordered my shrimp cake, very delicious.
My first time having Haitian food and this place truly set the bar. The service and the food was phenomenal. Everything was fresh and seasoned to the gawds. 10/10

So I was really looking forward to eating here and the food looks great. It’s very clean and it’s also Haitian owned so I was very excited to support my own culture, but I got the.Legume with beef Which was $27 and I only got two pieces of meat very small pieces so that was very disappointing for the price. It is a very pricey, but if the food is good, I do not mind paying for the price legume good I proceeded to eat it in the more I ate it the spicier I got and I was like why is it so spicy well come to find out habanero pepper have popped which it is part of the culture to cook with habanero peppers, but it is not OK to let it pop in a meal cause then it just ruins the whole dishso I was not able to eat it because because it was so spicy so I was a little scared to say something because I know how Haitians are and stuff but I was like hey I paid 30 something dollars after taxes for this. This is uncalled for I’m gonna see if I can get an exchange.  so I was not able to eat it because because it was so spicy so I was a little scared to say something because I know how Haitians are and stuff but I was like hey I paid 30 something dollars after taxes for this. This is uncalled for I’m gonna see if I can get a change So I proceeded to tell the host it was too spicy. I showed her where I found the habanero pepper that had popped in my food. She tried to tell Miss Didi and Miss didi looked up with an attitude and said what do you want me to do about it I thought that was very disrespectful  even though you owned something customer service is always firsthand.
