I have worked in customer service for a long time so I said can you fix it so she They didn’t take it out back or anything And she fixed it, and she proceeded to give me legume with no meat in a smaller bowl. As the American Haitian, born and raised in Haiti, been eating this food for a very long time I just feel like it was very disrespected, and if you are a Haitian trying to own a I feel like you should have customer service. Customer service should always be your number one priority because at the end of the day they’re the one putting money on your table. I know it’s not a bad restaurant because they did have a lot of people. I will try to give it a second chance and I will try something else on the and  pray for better, Service and before anybody says anything I do have proof.

This was the best Haitian food I had in a long time!! The food is fresh and definitely tasty!! I had the legume and griot combo Au-Cap Deluxe with diri djon djon (black mushroom rice) and sweet plantains and the pikliz  was good!! A good size portion too!!! thanks to the recommendations of Ms Didi’s son (I forgot his name) who was a great host and made me feel welcomed!  This is my go to spot whenever I’m in NC!!

The food is great but very tiny portions for the price not worth it. Not even Jamaicans charge this much. I paid $32 for two small side off grio that was $10 each and some tiny picklez in tiny ketchup condiments.

I’ll say this loud and clear: ignore the recent 1- and 2-star reviews. Whatever they experienced, I didn’t. Ms. DiDi’s isn’t just serving food—they are serving home.

I ordered the whole snapper with rice and peas and a side of Caribbean mac and cheese, and from the first bite, I knew I was in for something special. The snapper was flawlessly done—crispy skin giving way to tender, seasoned meat. The rice and peas were rich and comforting, and the mac and cheese? Creamy, flavorful, and full of island soul.

What made the experience even better was how seen and welcomed I felt. I asked a few questions before ordering, and the staff answered with genuine care. No rush, no attitude—just warmth, like stepping into a family kitchen.

Ms. DiDi’s brought me back to the flavors and feelings of home.

We thought it was a bit strange at first with the no-contact order and pickup process—it felt a little unusual. But once we tasted the food, none of that mattered anymore. The flavors hit hard! I had the chicken stew, and my wife had the oxtail—OMG. I literally wanted to jump out of my seat. Everything was rich, tender, and full of that deep island flavor. It was a touch salty, but honestly, still divine. Irie Rhythms definitely knows how to bring the flavor. We’ll be back for sure!

This was one of those, “I should’ve gone to Bojangles instead” moments. 😞

Let’s break it down:

The Good

The beef patty was easily the highlight of the meal. The crust was golden and flaky, encasing a spicy beef filling that was served hot and fresh. Honestly, this is the only item I’d consider ordering again.

The rice and peas were decent, with a touch of jerk seasoning that gave them some much-needed lift.

The Bad

The plantains were a complete disappointment—flat in flavor, as if they were simply peeled and thrown on the stove without a second thought.

The main entrée, the jerk chicken, was the ultimate letdown. Not only was the chicken overcooked to the point of mushiness, but the seasoning felt lazy. Instead of layered, smoky spice, what I got was chicken drowned in a jar of Walkerswood Hot & Spicy.

In the end, this meal didn’t just miss the mark—it felt like a disservice to the very Caribbean flavors it was supposed to celebrate. #GratuityAdded

I ordered from this place today for the first time. I tried out something small first just for a tester so I got the brown stew chicken snack box and oh my goodness this place is amazing!! So much flavor & definitely gave a good amount of food as well even though it was just a snack box. I loved the secure process of your food being in a locker that you can only access when you arrive. I definitely give this place a 10/10. I’ve found a new spot for sure.

Wow, I had an incredible experience at Irie Rhythms! The oxtails are truly mouthwatering. Tender and flavorful, they are the star of the show! It’s amazing how the rich, fall-off-the-bone goodness of oxtails can transport your taste buds to the heart of Jamaica.
And let’s not forget the Rice & Peas; it’s a classic that perfectly complements the hearty oxtails. The combination of coconut milk and spices have added a delightful twist that made every bite a joy to savor. Then, there's the mac and cheese—out of this world, it was the perfect creamy, cheesy side that everyone craves!
I had a consistent experience of excellence at Irie Rhythms. It’s always great to find a spot that delivers authentic Jamaican cuisine time and time again. My recommendation will surely make your mouth water and ignites a craving for delicious Caribbean food! What an amazing culinary adventure!!

Wow!  I love authentic caribbean cuisine!  This place is top notch!  The portions are very generous, the menu  has something for everyone!   My new favorite is curried shrimp!! OmG! Price point is fair and order prep is FAST!  I am going back today for a stewed chicken family sized take out meal for my whole crew!  Definitely a 10/10 for me for good carribean food take out option!

name: Crav’n Caribbean
vicinity: inside The City Kitch, 2200 Thrift Rd, Charlotte

reviews.text: The food is really good! Been wanting to try it for years. The taste did not disappoint. The oxtail cheesesteak was amazing as well as the rice and beans. The plantains were okay a little too sweet and mushy. I would have to say the prices and wait times were ridiculous. You could eat at a fancy restaurant with their prices honestly. And they were out of a lot of things, including oxtails. You can’t be a Jamaican spot known for oxtails and not have any! Good food, service and prices need work.

7/29/25-This place deserves cussing words.... IN A GOOD WAY! How their 4.3 stars is laughable (seems like haters). Were not from Charlotte but was recommended here, and oh boy!!!! My daughter ordered the jerk chicken, mac-n-cheese and sweet potato. I was literally going to go somewhere else until I saw her plate AND how she devoured it (unusual for her) I turned back around and ordered the oxtail, added jerk shrimp, with collard greens and of course the mac-n-cheese. They would hate us if we lived here!!! Their food for obvious reasons sell out fast. I'd be waiting at the door BEFORE they could even clock in.  Please go and give them the praise they definately deserve.  The ordering process is a bit different but actually smooth. Don't walk,  don't run,  sprint.  HIGHLY recommended. I can't wait to go back to NC!

Tonight was my first time trying the food. I enjoyed the Mac n cheese and yams, also wings. I would definitely suggest trying the food. I need to try the cabbage and rice and peas. I finished all of my Mac n cheese, yams and wings. Thank y’all!
Order online, to beat the wait. Food was definitely a treat like always. So impressed , and humbled when the owner delivered the food to us. Worth the 3 hr drive. Will definitely be back!

ever since ive visited charlotte, ive loved the food here. the mac and cheese stands out the most, and it's truly unforgettable. my favorite meal had to be the salmon cheesesteak as it was very flavorful and filling. after being denied service yesterday, this restaurant came in clutch even while being so close to closing. this restaurant shows reliability and a respectable amount of dedication to creating quality food and providing good customer service. this will always be my staple in the area

This was my first time trying Nigerian food, and it absolutely did not disappoint! I ordered the egusi soup with fufu and the jollof rice with chicken through Uber Eats, and every bite was bursting with flavor. The seasoning was perfect—spicy enough to enjoy, but not overwhelming.

The fufu was a revelation—I’d never had it before, but its soft, mild texture paired perfectly with the rich, well-seasoned egusi soup. The jollof rice was amazing too, and the chicken was so tender it fell off the bone. Portions were generous, so we even had leftovers for the next day, making it totally worth the price.

I can’t wait to order again and explore more of their menu. Highly recommended!

Food was very yummy and flavorful! Went with three of my very close friends and we had a great time. The service was amazing and when the food came out it was sizzling and boiling, definition of fresh and hot! We had the seafood ila, jollof rice with chicken, egusi with chicken, and the efo riro with assorted meat (cow skin, tripe, and beef). The flavors were so good and the spice was great.

Mold or fungus was growing on literally every egg yolk in the salad. This is the third time now I have received spoiled, moldy or expired food or drink from this restaurant. This is a major health safety issue especially as it relates to food poisoning. They have good flavoring but I won’t trust the food quality. I won’t be giving them any more of my business.

Great place, and the food was tasty. The owner is very nice but one of the workers was rude. We called her, and she pretended she did not hear us. Plus I asked to change money  for tip but she said there was no change. When the owner came to the register, she said there was change and very willing to help us. The other worker was great. Even though she had a tongue tie, she tried to communicate with us and was all smiles.

The owner is really great and was very accommodating.  The place is clean and the toilet was clean too. You should visit.

1st time eating here and did a pickup in person order. The eforiro was tasty and had some assorted meat. The pepper stew had only 1 small piece of over fried hard fish, this was not worth it. The taste of the food was 3/5 but the value of $70 worth of food was 2/5. The pounded yam was a small one too. The asun had fried and not grilled meat and had some tiny pieces .

Not going to lie, when we first walked in, it looked like a game room. We sat down and while looking at the menu, the owner? Not sure, came up and sat in our booth and gave some suggestions. We did want to try the egusi soup, but he said, “Umm, try the plain one before then come back and see if you’ll want to try the egusi.” After our meal, he came back to see how we liked it? I asked what it tasted like. He offered a taste, and let me tell you I’m glad he gave us the suggestion, but we personally wouldn’t have liked the egusi. Whatever he offered was very delicious ngl would definitely order to go next time.

It’s so great here. I didn’t even get to take a picture of my food. But I finished it. You should give this a try. An amazing Experience. If you haven’t tried different culture, food, peaceful in here.

Me and my friend came to try Nigerian food for the first point and it did not disappoint! We both tried the egusi soup and it was so good. Workers were so nice and welcoming and i’d definitely recommend! The place is small and has a home-like atmosphere. Would truly recommend if you’re looking for an underground spot with great food!

I’m Nigerian and it’s always hard finding a Nigerian restaurant than can deliver quality food but this restaurant really does it well. Food is always seasoned and portion sizes are always large. I do not eat meat or fish and this is one of the few Nigerian restaurants that will honor my request and not put any meat or fish in the soups, so if you’re vegan, vegetarian or pescatarian, I’d highly recommend this place as well.

Good African place to eat and shop.

This restaurant also offers a shopping experience to pick up your African food stuff.

The food is decent and prices are decent also.

They have loads of beer from many African countries . In all I enjoyed myself eating and watching the US presidential debate. All the best Austin. Thank you Sam and team

Drove all the way from Waco for a nigerian food experience with my family. I thought it was a restaurant but to my surprise it wasn’t. I was impressed by the setup though; multiple food vendors, one location. That right there was a red light for me but I still tried it. I ordered 2x vegetable soup and poundo, they charged an extra $3 for goat meat and then the basmati fried rice.
Soup was watery, with a sweet taste, it was mostly the tomato paste and few vegetables, with 3 small pieces of boney goat meat and nothing else.
A $5  goat meat was compulsory to complete the order for the fried rice or else the kiosk won’t let you check out. And I had the-same 3 pieces of the annoyingly tiny goat meat in my pack. The Rice was good though, my kids ate it. But the vegetable soup was horrible, I would ask for a refund but the stress ain’t worth it.

I have tried to give this restaurant a lot chances, I’m new to the area and need places to get some good food. I have ordered three times online and once on the phone and all the times I have requested fish. It clearly states in the menu description fish or goat. I don’t like goat and also have hesitations eating goat in general. I put my request of fish in the special instructions and it’s never complied. Which makes me wonder if someone who has allergies or dietary restrictions puts something in the instructions and it’s blatantly ignored? When I eat the Egusi it is Oily and room temperature. The goat I receive is all fat/ cartilage and doesn’t seem properly cleaned. I am disappointed but will just save myself the trouble and eat elsewhere.

I loveeeeeee this place!!! I am obsessed with the egusi soup I want it everyday. I stay in Roundrock so I couldn’t get to it as much BUT they are now available on uber eats 🙂‍↔️ which I just found out yesterday and I’m so happy! Very delicious food and very happy to be able to order for delivery now 😊

I have always wanted to try Nigerian food and finally tried at this restaurant. The food was great and I really enjoyed it. However, it would have been nice if some meat was ready (like goat). I wanted to really try goat egusi but the fish one was really good regardless! so tasty

Quality of Food was poor - Food wasn’t fresh- and still was handed to me. What’s painfully annoying is that I made a large purchase. Paid over $300 for large portion of food and it was obviously not cooked same day. This will unfortunately be my last time patronizing this business.

My food was very delicious !!! I got the egusi which is my very favorite. I did request no meat and I had bits of beef, which I was kinda bummed about but nevertheless it was my first time trying this place because the one I usually go to doesn’t deliver so I was skeptical at first but it was worth every penny. I also love the spinach portion. Very tasty

The BEST and most authentic Nigerian food in Austin. The owner is so kind and generous, she’s makes her food with the right amount of spice and taste. You won’t regret ordering from here! Oh and HUGE portions. I couldn’t even finish one bowl.

I got the egusi soup with some fufu. It was great, meaty and fishy with bold flavors. At first I had thought it was a bit pricey but I got 3 meals out of it and enjoyed them very much. I recommend trying it if you’re like me and wanting to experiment with some new cuisine flavors. I would describe the experience as confusing and intriguing at first followed by much warmth and satisfaction, it might take some time to get used to but I would get again. The fufu was my favorite.

Christiana was wonderful to work with! I called midweek to put an order in for two, and she had it ready the next day. We ordered fish stew, jollof rice, and moi moi (pictured), ayamase and white rice (not pictured). All of it was delicious, and we’ll definitely be ordering again!

They rob you when you order online. Literally they try to give you the smallest portion size possible. We ordered the soup and added meat to it but the cut these small pieces of meat and added it to the soup bowl so you dont get the full portion of soup ans huge bones with hardly no meat. This is a shame for what they charge you.

I got the Asun Jollof rice and Ewa Agoyin,it’s so delicious.
Definitely coming back

I cannot wait to come back and dishes which are unknown to me, and this place is perfect.  My first visit last month was made amazing by the service and atmosphere of the place. I literally had aunty's serving me and sharing stories of Ethiopia with the most beautiful smile and energy. I started with some hot tea, and can tell you that it puts to shame in flavor and health, the typical Texas sweet tea. I had a chicken dish which I sadly do not recall, and I wonder if, while it was good, it's flavor was dialed down for the American palate, because I felt it was but with safe a flavor. This dish seems similar to the POLLO GUISADO in many Latin American countries and It would not surprise me. since we get many of our culinary and musical history from Africa. The spot is large, yet cozy and the price was adequate for the serving of the meal. However, I highlight that I had a super friendly, fast and courteous serving and can't wait to go back and feast while getting a cultural education. This is a family managed spot and encourage you all to try it and support it!!

Flavorful, filling, and wholesome food!! The atmosphere is so welcoming and the staff is wonderful. Our favorite was definitely the lamb over their other popular dishes. Also loved the spinach sambusa and Doro Wot!

I cannot recommend this place enough. I was very happy!
I love Ethiopian food, and this place is very solid. I went with a group of 8, and their banquet options were perfect, especially with portion sizes. Half of us got the vegetarian banquet and the other half got some meat plates. Between us, we almost didn't finish!
I thought everything we were served was very flavorful, and there were a ton of options. Even the coffee and tea were very solid. Our waitress was also extremely nice and conversational with us. Definitely coming back!

Our 4th visit and it just keeps getting better! The service is always amazing!! and the food is beyond our expectations.
The vegetarian sampler is always a great option!
Highly recommend!

I brought all my friends here for our first time trying Ethiopian food and we were blown away! The food is served family style, perfect for a large group. We loved every single dish, my favorite was the eggplant and doro wot. The service was spectacular. Jeremiah was very helpful in explaining the ordering and dishes and gave great recommendations. Mariam brought the entertainment with her stories and jokes! It really felt like being around family. You can feel the love in this place. Can’t wait to eat here again

Soooo good.  We got the family meat for 4 and it was so tasty esp the fish and chicken tibs. The collard green were super tasty.  I wasn't feeling brave enough to do jalapeño tonite but evidently those were real super fresh.

We’ve lived in the same neighborhood as Habesha for 19 years, and today was the first time we’ve visited. We’d been going to Aster’s for ages, but Habesha was fantastic. Big, clean dining space. Friendly service. Most of all, the food was fantastic. Would definitely come back!
The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was excellent. Our waiter was energetic and full of life, which made the experience even better.

I stopped by here for lunch today, and it was my very first time trying Ethiopian food… I was not disappointed, they recommended some restaurant favs and I gave them a try and they did not miss! The iced tea is absolutely lovely! Black tea, with cardamom, cinnamon and cloves. The baklava is a must try.
If you’re ever curious, just go for it!

Will be back for sure

Keep up the good work

This place is truly a hidden gem. The food is absolutely incredible and Michael gave us the best customer service ever! He helped us so much from giving us food preferences to amazing hospitality. I definitely recommend you try what he recommends!

I’ve been a loyal customer to this store since they opened! I’m highly displeased at my recent experience on Sunday. The very rude cashier packed my groceries in such a way it caused my loaf of bread to be flat. We didn’t noticed until we put the groceries in the car. I immediately went back into the store to inform her that the method she used flattened my bread and requested to switch for a normal loaf. She rudely dismissed me and told me to talk to the manager. He was very unhelpful and blamed me for flattening the bread. He said no one else will buy the bread if I exchange it. If I went to HEB/Walmart/Trader Joe’s this would not be a problem at all!
Please train your staff how to properly bag groceries and to have good customer service. Even the manager was out of line!
Imagine arguing back and worth about a $5 loaf of bread after spending over $300! Very embarrassing and poor service. Don’t get into the customer service industry if you hate customers.

I recently purchased goat at this place. I got 10 pounds of goat meat. After I purchased it I placed it in a freezer bag and headed straight home. After I got home I marinated it and let it stay in the fridge . Tell me why the morning of Christmas as I am cooking the goat it starts stinking up and falling apart. The goat wasn't even on the stove for 30 minutes. The meat was falling apart like it was pressure cooked but the skin was still hard . They sold us spoiled goat and when I called the owner they said we must have passed some place else before heading home. They refuse to refund us. This is honestly very upsetting and disappointing, I will not be buying any meat here again!
They have every African food stuffs u can think of.
Scotch eggs was basically like eating raw dough. Gave 3 stars because cashier was friendly. Otherwise the service at the kitchen needs better work.

The baker woke up and chose violence today on the buns. The stars is for the puff puff. The buns were a terrible disappointment.  I don’t think anyone even tasted these before they were put out for sale. Straight to the trash. I opened several to see if maybe it was just one but the entire batch of buns were tasteless, no sweetness at all and undercooked. It’s like they too puff puff mix and said let's add flour to it and call it buns.  Please do better.  We are already having to pay higher prices for your items so make them worth it please.

If you’re looking for a flavorful and filling meal; look no further. We enjoyed our meal. I’ve had cow skin before elsewhere and wasn’t a fan… I would highly recommend it at this establishment! 10 out of 10 highly recommend 🫶🏽
False advertisement the pictures shows 5 turkeys for 14$ and I only got 1 the other photo shows 3 eggs in the food but I only received 1. And they refused partial refund
Have no manners, took over 30 minutes to make soup and chicken wings that were preordered
Shawarma was nasty. J rice was cool meat pie was alright. 4/10
The food is beyond bland and bad. Please stay away

5/5 – A must-try hidden gem!
This was my third time at Saleem, and each time feels like discovering it all over again. The sizzling anjera, the perfectly spiced veggies, the rich and flavorful dips—it’s a full sensory experience. The smell of the food hits you before you even sit down, and the traditional Ethiopian coffee seals the whole moment. The owner cooks everything himself with so much care and passion, and you can taste it in every bite. He’s just now expanding the restaurant, and it deserves all the love. Warm, welcoming, and unforgettable. Don’t sleep on this place—it’s worth it!
Best Ethiopian restaurant in Austin.the food is Delicious and very nice people.
Selam Cafe has a perfect sized international market and great menu items for lunch/ dinner… big portions and fair prices, thank you Sitota and friends!

A real gem! Authentic, delicious and fresh food. Limited menu but the two dishes I had were amazing! Coming from NYC I have been looking for authentic ethnic food spots and this place reminded me of the favorite Ethiopian spots I used to go to. Very friendly and accommodating staff. Also a great place to pick up spices and other Ethiopian speciality groceries.
Selam mart the best i ever seen good food and good service
The food is yummmmmyyy. And the guy is so kind! The music vibes were also amazing. It’s just in a slightly sketchy place but didn’t have any issues. I will 100% be back.

AB was amazing. We got a combination of everything. Wings, the chicken, beef, and tuna fataya and fries. Oh MY GOD. It was soooo good everything we took a bite of was instantly the favorite. I couldn't decide if the chicken, tuna, or beef was my favorite. The fries with the onions and peppers were amazing, no sauce needed. We'll for sure be coming back!
Sweetest man behind the counter, let me split up my Fataya into Tuna, Beef and Chicken. I hate tuna, first time with whatever spices used I liked it. Overall, Guinean food, is incredibly tasty.

I visited this food truck a few nights ago. The food was so good. I got the fataya and fries. They were crispy and flavorful, just like the ones I grew up eating. The owner was so nice and accommodating, excellent service all around.

Had some of the best West African home recipes from TCHIADAI Guinea Conakry on 5th Street this week while visiting in Austin.  Located in the food truck plaza next to Westin Austin Downtown, and only 1 street over from the busy 6th Street corridor.  A definite MUST if you are ever in Downtown and wanting something flavorful.  The owner puts great focus on quality and customer experience...and be sure to try the home made Hibiscus or Ginger juices to go with the meal!!  Great for dinner or a post night out treat!  Keep up the great standards team TCHIADAI!  Will be back on my next trip to Austin for sure!!

This is such a great spot.  You start with the friendliest owner and fantastic customer service.  His kind demeanor and genuine interaction were refreshing after a long day.  Next, you start smelling your order as he begins cooking it, building anticipation…and the anticipation worth it.  DELICIOUS!   Quite possibly the best meal I’ve had in a long time.  Great job young man!

AB knew exactly what I meant by im here for the flavor. Ginger 🫚  is his forte!

Chicken hit my stomach well and sometimes he's cooking up noodles with beans, ill need to try the OG rice because this guy can feed you!

Food was great. The menu was easy to understand. You can customize your spice level and spicy wasn't too too hot. The plantains were amazing. I've never had them savory before. Everything is served to order and the service was great!

Food and Service were excellent. I got the combo plate with the OG wings, rice, plantains, and salad. I got it spicy and it was a great level with a kick but not too spicy that it overwhelmed the flavor. Wings were juicy and crispy but not greasy. I also got the ginger drink out of curiosity. It was very strong ginger flavor and sweet, but I overall enjoyed it.
The chicken was crispy and delicious, the rice full of flavor, and jinjanma ginger drink cold and refreshing. Combined with the smiles and sincerity from the owner, absolutely earned a 10/10.

name: Whole Lotta Soul
vicinity: Pickup @ Expo Window, 3400 Comsouth Dr, Austin

reviews.text: I'd already read the glowing reviews, but I STILL was not prepared for the deliciousness that I was in store for! Man, you can taste the love in every bite!! I ordered my food online and it was simple, and received a call from the owner stating that one of the sides is ordered was not available but if I wanted to wait he would oblige. I opted for a substitute but how often does that level of service occur these days? The gentleman was super nice, the food was amazing, I would highly recommend Whole Lotta Soul!!!

Food is so good my big back ordered 2 plates. I ordered a first one had a little taste and went back for the second plate. The food came out quickly and it was so yummy! The gentleman that cooked the food ( also the owner) was also very kind. I am from Houston so it makes me very happy to be able to get some soul food😋😋. 10/10 everything was wonderful! I am definitely coming back soon.

The food was A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!! There was a short wait, BUT I didn't mind because the food was piping hot and fresh!!! The oxtails are 🔥! OMG...they are FULL of flavor! (11 out of 10) It is definitely worth the 35 minutes drive. The mac and cheese was good as well! They had the right balance of cheese and pasta; and a decent pull with the cheese. (8 out of 10) I am more of a creamy mac girl, that is the reason I gave it an 8 but the flavor is definitely there! The price was definitely fair for the amount of food that was given! The owner, Shaq, customer service was wonderful! You can definitely tell he puts the love and pride in his food! I am definitely going back to try the other items on the menu!! Worth the time and price for great food and customer service!!
Be mindful that this is a pick up location, with tables to sit and eat on the outside only if you choose. Very nice set up.

The owner, Shaq, cooks the food fresh. It's piping hot and delicious. We got the fried fish (not pictured because I devoured it too fast. But it was crispy and seasoned well. I ate it with no sauce it was that good.) and the oxtails with cabbage, mac and cheese, and candied yams. Everything was seasoned deliciously. Will definitely be back next time we're in the area.

The owner came and greeted us with our food and it was delicious, tastes amazing with plenty of flavor. got the red drink and chicken brown stew with yams and Mac. Yams were really good, brown stew was good. I recommend getting the cornbrea, it was soft and fluffy, goes well with the stew and red drink to wash it down. 10/10 would come again and worker does all the work BY HIMSELF.

Nando's Peri Peri Chicken in Austin's Mueller neighborhood is a must-try! Their flame-grilled chicken is super delicious with the peri-peri sauce - it's got just the right amount of heat and flavor.

The atmosphere is lively and perfect for a casual dinner with friends or family. Plus, the service is top-notch, with staff going above and beyond to make sure you have a great experience.

Some highlights include:
- *Juicy Chicken*: Their 24-hour marinated chicken is cooked to perfection, with a nice char on the outside and tender meat on the inside.
- *Flavorful Sides*: The Brussels sprouts and garlic bread are must-try sides that complement the chicken perfectly.
- *Dairy-Free Options*: They've got plenty of options for those with dietary restrictions, making it a great spot for groups with different needs.

Overall, I'd give Nando's Peri Peri Chicken Austin Mueller 4 stars - it's a solid choice for anyone craving flavorful, spicy chicken.

Very shocked that we were told to order from a QR code or come up front. Had questions to ask and had to leave our table to do so. We sat outside as the weather was awesome on a warm Jan evening 🤪
Anyway, we ordered the 12 piece grilled wings w/ fries and rice. The happy hour menu is extra minimal. My friend had a glass of wine. The wine was less than half full in a tumbler type glass. lol Wow!
The grilled chicken while very seasoned and well marinated, the grill marks made the chicken taste bitter… with every bite. I have never! I could do without the deliberate grill marks. I mean you want to taste the smokiness of the grill not the burn of the marks. Maybe the bigger pieces of chicken are better cooked. Not sure that we will be back. The menu didn’t offer too many options. But, you never know! Our order was out less than 5 mins of ordering so they may have been prepared very fast or the grill was too high. Who knows!

Really nice place it has indoor and outdoor dining. Chicken its good lots of flavor and all the sauces are good. Kids plate has just a little pieces of chicken for 10 dollars not enough. The rainbow bowl was not good don’t recommend. The mac and cheese its good. I personally dont like that you hace to get up for every single thing. You have to get up for the drinks.napkins, forks and water. Robert was really attendant with us explain everything on the menu.

The Mac and cheese was THE BEST Mac and cheese I’ve ever had and I’ve tried well over 20 different Mac and cheeses. I wish I would have ordered the 1/4 chicken b cause the 1/2 was way too much definitely enough for 2 people. The brussel sprouts and sauce were sooo good although I believe that the brussel sprouts could be cooked a little more and the stems cut off. The chicken with the medium sauce was very good as well! It was about $50 for 2 people as well which is pretty pricey for lunch but next time I’ll be getting a smaller portion

I’ve had Nando’s in the Middle East and this location is great! I love the two kinds of chicken grill we had. The lemon and the garlic sauce was great with the chicken. The fries had its own dip I used for everything lol. My friend ordered ahead for all of us so it was nice not to have to think and decide and I was healthily fed! I wasn’t successful on refraining from eating the fries. Nice flavor to it! The servers were sweet, quite a busy place! The area was buzzing. I wasn’t able to take much pictures as it was crowded. Our group was  still able to chat and catch up. They have a QR code to get 2$ discount at the McBee parking garage. Parking area scarce. Valet and parking fees available too but I don’t think there’s any free parking I saw? Cool little area where u can walk to the nice little park with ducks. Catching the sunset was a plus!

I was very pleasantly surprised by this restaurant. I didn't expect such solid Cajun food within Austin, much less with the decor of this place. It really felt like a small slice of Louisiana!

We loved all of the food we got. The Étouffée and the catfish were both very well seasoned, and the gator was tender and juicy. Definitely recommend for Cajun food in Austin!
What a fantastic authentic Cajun flavors!! The atmosphere was electric. The service was outstanding!! The food was perfect. The live music was a bonus. Felt like we were in New Orleans.
Best Cajun spot in Austin. I've been looking for a good spot for over 2 years and im glad I found this spot. Relaxed vibes. Good food. Friendly people. Cool decor. I will be coming back with friends!
Most authentic Cajun food you can find outside Louisiana!!! Food was DELICIOUS, service was GREAT! Appreciated the Cajun hospitality!

I have never had a bad meal here. My husband is Cajun, raised in Louisiana, and he absolutely loves the food. The atmosphere and wait staff are fantastic. We like to go a little early to avoid the lunch rush. They have beer and wine and fountain drinks, entrees, appetizers, desserts, baskets and po boys. They are closed Sundays and have live music during the week. Highly recommend!

the food here is delicious so i hate reviewing it negatively, but they have skimped out on sauce for me at least 4 times. today, as well as the previous times, i ordered 2 plates of fries and i only received the amount of sauce for 1 order of fries. today, i actually asked for extra hot sauce and they not only didnt give me extra, they actually gave me less then its supposed to come with. i also noticed that today, when i asked, there was actually no hot sauce on my wrap as well. again, they have great food and ill keep eating here, im just very fed up with this.
Love this place! Huge portions, cheap prices and really tasty food. Only spot in town I’ve found that just gives you extra sauce automatically, too!
the first time i had the gyro wrap which is amazing very good price when you buy at the truck employee friendly & happy.thanks halal hub❤️

They are very rude and have bad behavior. They also treat customers very poorly.
My order was not made the way I wanted.
I strongly recommend that you do not come here.

Eating the falafel wrap here was a religious experience. Unassuming outside. Simple menu. But the food is absolutely incredible. Especially for the location

The sauces were super tasty, the falafel soft on the inside and crispy outside. The pita bread was fluffy and soft too. So so tasty!
The combo chicken and gyro rice plate I heard was fabulous too. Staple for the area, must visit! Can also sit outside on the free picnic benches

Oh they also had gulab jamun as a dessert! We didn’t try the desserts but I’m sure they’ll be as good as the food
Most options with meat but few vegan ones available

The food was absolutely delicious, I tried fried green tomatoes for the first time, and now I’m a forever fan! The chicken fried steak was phenomenal, the green beans were fresh and crunchy with a great flavor. The wagu steak and eggs was beautiful, but not my favorite. The drinks were flavored well, but could have been better.  it’s an absolute must for great food in the domain!

After two disappointing prior experiences, the third time was the charm! My party and I were greeted by Josh at the host stand who was wonderful and very accommodating. We had some notes on our reservation and he went above and beyond to make sure we were set up and taken care of! Our server Darun was incredible! He was informative, personable, engaging and gave great feedback. He truly made the experience above and beyond and it completely smoothed over any negative experience in the past!

As for the food, we got the ceviche, pork belly bites, and onion rings to start. For entrees we got the farmhouse bowl, redfish, 12oz NY Strip, Chicken fried steak and ribs! Everything was delicious and wonderfully seasoned.

Overall, we were able to sit in a nice, private room and enjoy each other's company with great service and full bellies! Thank you Josh and Darun for making our night so wonderful!

This place was every bit the experience you expected. It is an upscale restaurant with several bars throughout. We sat upstairs, so it was a little cramped. The tables are right next to each other, so if you are on the larger size then it is a tight squeeze. I'm small, so I didn't have a problem sitting right up on the table, but the man behind me had his chair pushed all the way back where it bumped up against my chair the whole time we were there. Even though the place was crowded and everyone was talking, you could still hear your guests clearly without having to shout. The ribs were fall off the bone good. The other dishes were good also. The price was reasonable for the meal I ordered. Our waiter was very personable. He was a young African American thin guy who knew the menu inside and out. He made great recommendations for the food and the drinks. This is a truly hip and trendy place, but the order crowd would enjoy it also.

First timer to Haywire. It happened to be my 48th birthday. Hands down one of the best dinners I have had yet. From the moment Kyle introduced himself and took our drink order I knew we were in good hands. I’ve been blessed to dine in some of the most prestigious restaurants in the US. I must admit Haywire did not disappoint. From the ambience, service and quality of our meals I will be returning. Kyle set the bar very high to say the least..The double cut pork chop was honestly the best chop I’ve ever had. Hat is off to the chef 110%. 48th birthday dinner to remember without a doubt!!!  Mahalo Haywire and no doubt you have found a first class service provider in Kyle!

This was a good restaurant with a great ambiance.  We came here for a date night wife myself and the wife.  The service was friendly and helpful. We started with pork belly and it was delicious. For entrees my wife had the redfish and although the flavor was good the entire center portion of the fish was completely raw. I opted for the double cut pork chop basically because the waitress told me it was better than Perry's.  It was a good pork chop,  but I don't think it was quite lived up to the claim. Would try them again.

The brisket, mustard sauce and spicy Cole slaw were fantastic. The meat was perfect -- juicy and delicious. Combine that with the beautiful grounds and taproom at Meanwhile Brewing, plus some seriously good beer, and you have a winner. I'll be back!

Not only is the BBQ delicious, but the grits are the best we've had. And the black eyed peas were flat out superb.

AND the bread was GRILLED. As it should be!!
Wow this was great BBQ. Best I’ve had in a while. Chicken and pork belly were the standouts imo. Sides were terrific, especially black eyed peas and the grits.

The bbq is great, all of their food is good.
I have to say though, I have been here twice, the woman who works at the register could use some training in professionalism and courtesy. She barely acknowledges you, doesn't smile or says thank you. While I love the food their help could use some help! Lol

Finally had a chance to visit Distant Relatives trailer at Meanwhile Brewing after multiple friends recommending it. I’m glad I went and will definitely be back! I got the brisket sandwich and the sausage mac n cheese. I love the West and South African spices in the food. Food comes out quickly. I’m sure it gets quite busy on weekends. Thanks guys!

They offer two vegetarian tacos along with yucca chips and corn fritters. The Yawdy was a little bit too BBQ flavoured for me but still a great portion and filled with fun incredients. I preferred the Yucatan- it had nice flavors with pineapple and red onion.

The fried yucca was fun and had a delicous chimichurri sauce. But my favourite were the crispy sweet corn fritters with chipotle mayo. I probably should have just ordered like three of those - they were perfectly crispy with big chunks of corn and other delightful peppers. Wow they were really good.

The food is very affordable and outside of Hi Sign brewery which is super fun. Would definitely order those corn fritters again!

Yawdy Bowl was the bomb! The food truck owners were nice and sweet. Def try other one next time!

Update: Just tried Yucatan Bowl and it's awesome 🥣! The cooks were extremely nice, and they deserved to get recognized.

So delicious!! I got the Yawdy Bowl and wow! The chicken is cooked to perfection, and all of the flavors go together beautifully. 10/10 recommend.
There’s plenty of seating outside as well as indoor seating in the brewery. The women working the truck were super sweet. I’ll definitely be going back!

I love Nyan. I have followed them through 2 locations and I'm happy they are near to me as they are dear. The tacos are packed. It's definitely going to leave you with that fresh homemade feeling no matter what you order. The owner let me try the corn fritters and I loved them and I always order the Yawdy and I can't seem to get off of it. I'd love to become brave and try everything because I'm confident everything is fantastic. Super moist and savory. 10/10
Really quality and delicious food with good portions. The tacos were amazing, good sweet potato fries, and my friend enjoyed her bowl.
